        }

        // ÐŸÐ ÐÐ’ÐÐ¯ ÐŸÐÐÐ•Ð›Ð¬: Ð¡Ð±Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð°Ð²Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¼Ð°Ñ‚
        int rightX = x + 192;
        int rightW = 232;
        context.fill(rightX, y + 20, rightX + rightW, y + 20 + panelH, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(rightX + 1, y + 21, rightX + rightW - 1, y + 19 + panelH, 0xFF28292C);

        // Ð¡Ñ‚Ð°Ñ‚ÑƒÑ Ð°Ð²Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¼Ð°Ñ‚Ð° Ð²Ð²ÐµÑ€Ñ…Ñƒ (LED + Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ°Ð»Ð¸Ð·Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ñ‚ÐµÐºÑÑ‚)
        Text statusText;
        int ledOuter, ledInner;
        if (!handler.isPowered()) {
            statusText = Text.translatableWithFallback("gui.factoriocore.status.no_power", "ÐÐµÑ‚ Ð¿Ð¸Ñ‚Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ñ");
            ledOuter = 0xFF661111;
            ledInner = 0xFFFF3333;
        } else if (handler.getRecipeId().isEmpty()) {
            statusText = Text.translatableWithFallback("gui.factoriocore.status.no_recipe", "Ð ÐµÑ†ÐµÐ¿Ñ‚ Ð½Ðµ Ð²Ñ‹Ð±Ñ€Ð°Ð½");
            ledOuter = 0xFF664400;
            ledInner = 0xFFFFAA00;
        } else if (handler.isWorking()) {
            statusText = Text.translatableWithFallback("gui.factoriocore.status.working", "Ð Ð°Ð±Ð¾Ñ‚Ð°ÐµÑ‚");
            ledOuter = 0xFF115511;
            ledInner = 0xFF44FF44;
        } else {
            statusText = Text.translatableWithFallback("gui.factoriocore.status.missing_ingredients", "ÐÐµ Ñ…Ð²Ð°Ñ‚Ð°ÐµÑ‚ Ð¸Ð½Ð³Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð¾Ð²");
            ledOuter = 0xFF661111;
            ledInner = 0xFFFF3333;
        }

        int ledX = rightX + 6;
        int ledY = y + 25;
        context.fill(ledX, ledY, ledX + 6, ledY + 6, 0xFF111111);
        context.fill(ledX + 1, ledY + 1, ledX + 5, ledY + 5, ledOuter);

        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, statusText, rightX + 16, y + 24, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);

        // 3D-Ð¾ÐºÐ½Ð¾ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾ÑÐ¼Ð¾Ñ‚Ñ€Ð° ÑÐ±Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‰Ð¸ÐºÐ° Ñ ÑˆÐ°Ñ…Ð¼Ð°Ñ‚Ð½Ñ‹Ð¼ Ñ„Ð¾Ð½Ð¾Ð¼
        int viewLeft = rightX + 6;
        int viewTop = y + 34;
        int viewRight = rightX + rightW - 6;
        int viewBottom = y + 110;
        context.fill(viewLeft - 1, viewTop - 1, viewRight + 1, viewBottom + 1, 0xFF141414);
        drawCheckerboard(context, viewLeft, viewTop, viewRight, viewBottom, 8);

        context.enableScissor(viewLeft, viewTop, viewRight, viewBottom);
        renderAssembler3DPreview(context, (viewLeft + viewRight) / 2, (viewTop + viewBottom) / 2 + 8, delta);
        context.disableScissor();

        // Ð¡Ð¢Ð ÐžÐšÐ Ð Ð•Ð¦Ð•ÐŸÐ¢Ð: [Ð˜ÐºÐ¾Ð½ÐºÐ° Ñ€ÐµÑ†ÐµÐ¿Ñ‚Ð°] + ÐÐ°Ð·Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ðµ Ñ€ÐµÑ†ÐµÐ¿Ñ‚Ð° + ÐšÐ½Ð¾Ð¿ÐºÐ° [âš™]
        int recBtnX = rightX + 6;
        int recBtnY = y + 116;
        boolean hovRecBtn = mouseX >= recBtnX && mouseX <= recBtnX + 22 && mouseY >= recBtnY && mouseY <= recBtnY + 22;
        context.fill(recBtnX, recBtnY, recBtnX + 22, recBtnY + 22, 0xFF141414);

            context.drawItem(activeRec.output(), recBtnX + 3, recBtnY + 3);

                    Text.translatableWithFallback("gui.factoriocore.choose_recipe_prompt", "Ð’Ñ‹Ð±ÐµÑ€Ð¸Ñ‚Ðµ Ñ€ÐµÑ†ÐµÐ¿Ñ‚..."),

        int gearX = rightX + rightW - 28;
        int gearY = y + 116;
        boolean hovGear = mouseX >= gearX && mouseX <= gearX + 22 && mouseY >= gearY && mouseY <= gearY + 22;
        context.fill(gearX, gearY, gearX + 22, gearY + 22, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(gearX + 1, gearY + 1, gearX + 21, gearY + 21, hovGear ? 0xFFE59524 : 0xFF383A3D);

        // Ð¡Ð¢Ð ÐžÐšÐ ÐšÐ ÐÐ¤Ð¢Ð: [Ð¡Ð»Ð¾Ñ‚Ñ‹ ÑÑ‹Ñ€ÑŒÑ] -> [Ð—ÐµÐ»ÐµÐ½Ð°Ñ Ð¿Ð¾Ð»Ð¾ÑÐ° Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð³Ñ€ÐµÑÑÐ°] -> [Ð¡Ð»Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð²Ñ‹Ñ…Ð¾Ð´Ð°]
        int slotRowY = y + 144;
        int ingCount = activeRec != null ? Math.min(4, activeRec.ingredients().size()) : 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < ingCount; i++) {
            int sx = rightX + 6 + i * 19;
            FactorioRecipes.Ingredient ing = activeRec.ingredients().get(i);
            ItemStack currentStack = handler.getSlot(i).getStack();
            boolean enough = !currentStack.isEmpty() && currentStack.getCount() >= ing.count();

            context.fill(sx, slotRowY, sx + 18, slotRowY + 18, 0xFF141414);
            context.fill(sx + 1, slotRowY + 1, sx + 17, slotRowY + 17, enough ? 0xFF3A3C3E : 0xFF5A2424);

        int barH = 12;
        context.fill(barX, barY, barX + barW, barY + barH, 0xFF141414);

        float ratio = (handler.getMaxProgress() > 0 && handler.getProgress() > 0)

        // Ð¡Ð»Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð³Ð¾Ñ‚Ð¾Ð²Ð¾Ð¹ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð´ÑƒÐºÑ†Ð¸Ð¸
        int outX = rightX + rightW - 24;
        drawSlotFrame(context, outX, slotRowY);
        if (activeRec != null && handler.getSlot(4).getStack().isEmpty()) {
            context.drawItem(activeRec.output(), outX + 1, slotRowY + 1);

            context.getMatrices().pop();

        context.fill(rightX + 4, y + 168, rightX + rightW - 4, y + 169, 0xFF1A1B1C);

        for (int m = 0; m < 4; m++) {
            drawGhostSlot(context, rightX + 6 + m * 19, y + 174);
        }
        for (int gy = y + 198; gy <= y + 210; gy += 4) {
            context.fill(rightX + 6, gy, rightX + rightW - 6, gy + 1, 0xFF202123);
        }
    }

    private void drawSlotFrame(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy) {
        context.fill(sx, sy, sx + 18, sy + 18, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 1, sx + 17, sy + 17, 0xFF3A3C3E);
    }

    private void drawGhostSlot(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy) {
        context.fill(sx, sy, sx + 18, sy + 18, 0xFF1A1B1C);
        context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 1, sx + 17, sy + 17, 0xFF222325);
    }

    private void drawCheckerboard(DrawContext context, int left, int top, int right, int bottom, int cellSize) {
        for (int py = top; py < bottom; py += cellSize) {
            for (int px = left; px < right; px += cellSize) {
                int gx = (px - left) / cellSize;
                int gy = (py - top) / cellSize;
                int color = ((gx + gy) % 2 == 0) ? 0xFF262729 : 0xFF2E3032;
                context.fill(px, py, Math.min(px + cellSize, right), Math.min(py + cellSize, bottom), color);
            }
        }
    }

    private void drawGearIcon(DrawContext context, int gx, int gy, int col) {
        context.fill(gx + 4, gy + 2, gx + 12, gy + 14, col);
        context.fill(gx + 2, gy + 4, gx + 14, gy + 12, col);
        context.fill(gx + 6, gy + 6, gx + 10, gy + 10, 0xFF141414);
    }

    private void renderAssembler3DPreview(DrawContext context, int centerX, int centerY, float delta) {
        MinecraftClient client = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        MatrixStack matrices = context.getMatrices();

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(centerX, centerY + 8, 150.0f);
        matrices.scale(this.previewZoom, -this.previewZoom, this.previewZoom);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(this.previewPitch));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(this.previewYaw));

        matrices.translate(-0.5f, -1.0f, -0.5f);

        float angle = (handler.isWorking() && client.world != null)
                ? (client.world.getTime() + delta) * 10.0f : 0.0f;
        AssemblerRenderer.renderAssemblerModel(
                matrices,
                context.getVertexConsumers(),
                LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE,
                OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV,
                angle
        );

        matrices.pop();
        context.draw();
    }

    private boolean isInsidePreviewViewport(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        int rightX = x + 192;
        return mouseX >= rightX + 6 && mouseX <= rightX + 226 && mouseY >= y + 34 && mouseY <= y + 110;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        if (!recipeSelectionMode && isInsidePreviewViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.previewZoom = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewZoom + (float) verticalAmount * 1.5f, 6.0f, 28.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mouseX, mouseY, horizontalAmount, verticalAmount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;

        if (recipeSelectionMode) {
            // ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ ÐºÐ½Ð¾Ð¿ÐºÐµ [X]
            if (mouseX >= x + backgroundWidth - 17 && mouseX <= x + backgroundWidth - 4 && mouseY >= y + 4 && mouseY <= y + 16) {
                if (!handler.getRecipeId().isEmpty()) {
                    setRecipeSelectionMode(false);
                } else {
                    this.close();
                }
                return true;
            }

            // ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ 4 Ð²ÐºÐ»Ð°Ð´ÐºÐ°Ð¼ ÐºÐ°Ñ‚ÐµÐ³Ð¾Ñ€Ð¸Ð¹
            int tabY = y + 20;
            int tabW = (backgroundWidth - 16) / 4;
            int tabH = 24;
            FactorioRecipes.Category[] cats = FactorioRecipes.Category.values();
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int tx = x + 8 + i * tabW;
                if (mouseX >= tx && mouseX < tx + tabW && mouseY >= tabY && mouseY < tabY + tabH) {
                    this.activeCategory = cats[i];
                    return true;
                }
            }

            // ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ Ñ€ÐµÑ†ÐµÐ¿Ñ‚Ñƒ
            int startX = x + 12;
            int startY = y + 48;
            int rows = 9;
            int cols = 22;
            int[] colInRow = new int[rows];

            for (FactorioRecipes.Recipe recipe : FactorioRecipes.getByCategory(this.activeCategory)) {
                int r = Math.min(rows - 1, recipe.row());
                int c = colInRow[r];
                if (c >= cols) continue;
                colInRow[r]++;

                int sx = startX + c * 18;
                int sy = startY + r * 18;
                if (mouseX >= sx && mouseX < sx + 18 && mouseY >= sy && mouseY < sy + 18) {
                    handler.setClientRecipeId(recipe.id());
                    ClientPlayNetworking.send(new SetAssemblerRecipePayload(handler.getTargetPos(), recipe.id()));
                    setRecipeSelectionMode(false);
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        // Ð—Ð°ÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ñ‚ÑŒ Ð¾ÐºÐ½Ð¾
        if (mouseX >= x + backgroundWidth - 17 && mouseX <= x + backgroundWidth - 4 && mouseY >= y + 4 && mouseY <= y + 16) {
            this.close();
            return true;
        }

        // ÐŸÐµÑ€ÐµÑ‚Ð°ÑÐºÐ¸Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ðµ 3D-Ð¼Ð¾Ð´ÐµÐ»Ð¸
        if ((button == 0 || button == 1) && isInsidePreviewViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.draggingPreview = true;
            return true;
        }

        // ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ Ñ€ÐµÑ†ÐµÐ¿Ñ‚Ñƒ Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ ÑˆÐµÑÑ‚ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ½ÐºÐµ Ð´Ð»Ñ ÑÐ¼ÐµÐ½Ñ‹ Ñ€ÐµÑ†ÐµÐ¿Ñ‚Ð°
        int rightX = x + 192;
        int rightW = 232;
        int recBtnX = rightX + 6;
        int gearX = rightX + rightW - 28;
        if ((mouseX >= recBtnX && mouseX <= recBtnX + 22 && mouseY >= y + 116 && mouseY <= y + 138)
                || (mouseX >= gearX && mouseX <= gearX + 22 && mouseY >= y + 116 && mouseY <= y + 138)) {
            setRecipeSelectionMode(true);
            return true;
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (this.draggingPreview) {
            this.draggingPreview = false;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.draggingPreview) {
            this.previewYaw += (float) deltaX * 1.5f;
            this.previewPitch = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewPitch + (float) deltaY * 1.5f, -80.0f, 80.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(int keyCode, int scanCode, int modifiers) {
        if (this.recipeSelectionMode && (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE
                || (this.client != null && this.client.options.inventoryKey.matchesKey(keyCode, scanCode)))) {
            if (!handler.getRecipeId().isEmpty()) {
                setRecipeSelectionMode(false);
                return true;
            }
        }
        return super.keyPressed(keyCode, scanCode, modifiers);
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        if (!this.initialSyncChecked && handler.isSynced()) {
            this.initialSyncChecked = true;
            setRecipeSelectionMode(handler.getRecipeId().isEmpty());
        }
        this.handler.setSlotsVisible(!this.recipeSelectionMode);
        super.render(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);

        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        FactorioRecipes.Recipe hoveredRecipe = null;

        if (recipeSelectionMode) {
            int startX = x + 12;
            int startY = y + 48;
            int rows = 9;
            int cols = 22;
            int[] colInRow = new int[rows];

            for (FactorioRecipes.Recipe recipe : FactorioRecipes.getByCategory(this.activeCategory)) {
                int r = Math.min(rows - 1, recipe.row());
                int c = colInRow[r];
                if (c >= cols) continue;
                colInRow[r]++;

                int sx = startX + c * 18;
                int sy = startY + r * 18;
                if (mouseX >= sx && mouseX < sx + 18 && mouseY >= sy && mouseY < sy + 18) {
                    hoveredRecipe = recipe;
                    break;
                }
            }
        } else {
            int rightX = x + 192;
            int recBtnX = rightX + 6;
            if (mouseX >= recBtnX && mouseX <= recBtnX + 22 && mouseY >= y + 116 && mouseY <= y + 138) {
                String rid = handler.getRecipeId();
                if (!rid.isEmpty()) {
                    hoveredRecipe = FactorioRecipes.getById(rid);
                }
            } else {
                FactorioRecipes.Recipe activeRec = FactorioRecipes.getById(handler.getRecipeId());
                boolean drewGhostTooltip = false;
                if (activeRec != null && this.handler.getCursorStack().isEmpty()) {
                    int slotRowY = y + 144;
                    int ingCount = Math.min(4, activeRec.ingredients().size());
                    for (int i = 0; i < ingCount; i++) {
                        int sx = rightX + 6 + i * 19;
                        if (mouseX >= sx && mouseX < sx + 18 && mouseY >= slotRowY && mouseY < slotRowY + 18 && handler.getSlot(i).getStack().isEmpty()) {
                            FactorioRecipes.Ingredient ing = activeRec.ingredients().get(i);
                            context.drawTooltip(this.textRenderer, List.of(
                                    Text.translatableWithFallback("gui.factoriocore.ghost_slot.filter", "Ð¤Ð°Ð½Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¼Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÑÐ»Ð¾Ñ‚ (Ñ„Ð¸Ð»ÑŒÑ‚Ñ€ Ñ€ÐµÑ†ÐµÐ¿Ñ‚Ð°)").formatted(Formatting.GRAY),
                                    Text.translatableWithFallback("gui.factoriocore.ghost_slot.required", "Ð¢Ñ€ÐµÐ±ÑƒÐµÑ‚ÑÑ: ").formatted(Formatting.RED)
                                            .append(Text.literal(ing.count() + " \u00d7 " + ing.item().getName().getString()).formatted(Formatting.WHITE))
                            ), mouseX, mouseY);
                            drewGhostTooltip = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    int outX = rightX + 232 - 24;
                    if (!drewGhostTooltip && mouseX >= outX && mouseX < outX + 18 && mouseY >= slotRowY && mouseY < slotRowY + 18 && handler.getSlot(4).getStack().isEmpty()) {
                        context.drawTooltip(this.textRenderer, List.of(
                                Text.translatableWithFallback("gui.factoriocore.ghost_slot.output", "Ð“Ð¾Ñ‚Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ñ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð´ÑƒÐºÑ†Ð¸Ñ").formatted(Formatting.GRAY),
                                activeRec.output().getName().copy().formatted(Formatting.YELLOW)
                        ), mouseX, mouseY);
                        drewGhostTooltip = true;
                    }
                }
                if (!drewGhostTooltip) {
                    drawMouseoverTooltip(context, mouseX, mouseY);
                }
            }
        }

        if (hoveredRecipe != null && this.client != null && this.client.player != null) {
            FactorioCharacterScreen.renderRecipeCard(
                    context, this.textRenderer, this.width, this.height,
                    hoveredRecipe, this.client.player.getInventory(), mouseX, mouseY, false
            );
        }
    }

public class BurnerDrillRenderer implements BlockEntityRenderer<BurnerDrillBlockEntity> {

    public BurnerDrillRenderer(BlockEntityRendererFactory.Context ctx) {} @Override public int getRenderDistance() { return 48; }

    @Override
    public void render(BurnerDrillBlockEntity entity, float tickDelta, MatrixStack matrices,
                       VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers, int light, int overlay) {
        BlockState state = entity.getCachedState();
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof BurnerDrillBlock)) return;
        // Ð Ð¸ÑÑƒÐµÐ¼ Ð²ÑÑŽ 3D-Ð¼Ð°ÑˆÐ¸Ð½Ñƒ 2x2x2.5 Ð¾Ð´Ð¸Ð½ Ñ€Ð°Ð· Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð¸Ð¼ÐµÐ½Ð¸ Ð³Ð»Ð°Ð²Ð½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ° (part=0, upper=false)
        if (state.get(BurnerDrillBlock.PART) != 0 || state.get(BurnerDrillBlock.UPPER)) {
            return;
        }

        Direction facing = state.get(BurnerDrillBlock.FACING);
        float drillAngle = (entity.getWorld() != null && entity.isWorking()) ? entity.getClientDrillRotation(tickDelta) : 0.0f;

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(0.5, 0.0, 0.5);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(-facing.asRotation()));
        matrices.translate(-0.5, 0.0, -0.5);

        // Ð’ Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ñ… ÐºÐ¾Ð¾Ñ€Ð´Ð¸Ð½Ð°Ñ‚Ð°Ñ… (ÐºÐ¾Ð³Ð´Ð° facing = SOUTH, +Z):
        // Ð“Ð»Ð°Ð²Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð±Ð»Ð¾Ðº (part=0) Ð·Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ð¼Ð°ÐµÑ‚ X: [0..1], Z: [0..1]
        // ÐŸÑ€Ð°Ð²Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð±Ð»Ð¾Ðº (part=1) Ð·Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ð¼Ð°ÐµÑ‚ X: [-1..0], Z: [0..1]
        // ÐŸÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð½Ð¸Ð¹-Ð›ÐµÐ²Ñ‹Ð¹ (part=2) Ð·Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ð¼Ð°ÐµÑ‚ X: [0..1], Z: [1..2]
        // ÐŸÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð½Ð¸Ð¹-ÐŸÑ€Ð°Ð²Ñ‹Ð¹ (part=3) Ð·Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ð¼Ð°ÐµÑ‚ X: [-1..0], Z: [1..2]
        // Ð—Ð½Ð°Ñ‡Ð¸Ñ‚ Ð²ÐµÑÑŒ Ð±ÑƒÑ€ 2x2 Ð·Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ð¼Ð°ÐµÑ‚ X: [-1.0 .. 1.0], Z: [0.0 .. 2.0], Y: [0.0 .. 2.5]!
        renderDrillModel(matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, drillAngle);

        matrices.pop();
    }

    public static void renderDrillModel(MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers,
                                        int light, int overlay, float drillAngle) {
        BlockRenderManager brm = MinecraftClient.getInstance().getBlockRenderManager();
        BlockState darkIron = Blocks.NETHERITE_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
        BlockState steel = Blocks.IRON_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
        BlockState stoneBase = Blocks.POLISHED_DEEPSLATE.getDefaultState();
        BlockState firebox = Blocks.BLAST_FURNACE.getDefaultState();
        BlockState yellowChute = Blocks.YELLOW_CONCRETE.getDefaultState();

        // 1. ÐÐ¸Ð¶Ð½ÑÑ Ñ€Ð°Ð¼Ð° Ð¿Ð¾ Ð¿ÐµÑ€Ð¸Ð¼ÐµÑ‚Ñ€Ñƒ 2x2 (X: -0.95..0.95, Z: 0.05..1.95)
        drawBox(brm, stoneBase, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.95f, 0.0f, 0.05f, 0.35f, 0.35f, 1.90f);
        drawBox(brm, stoneBase, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay,  0.60f, 0.0f, 0.05f, 0.35f, 0.35f, 1.90f);
        drawBox(brm, stoneBase, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.60f, 0.0f, 0.05f, 1.20f, 0.35f, 0.35f);
        drawBox(brm, stoneBase, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.60f, 0.0f, 1.60f, 1.20f, 0.35f, 0.35f);

        // 2. Ð§ÐµÑ‚Ñ‹Ñ€Ðµ Ð¼Ð¾Ñ‰Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ Ð¾Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ ÑÑ‚Ð¾Ð¹ÐºÐ¸ Ð´Ð¾ Ð²Ñ‹ÑÐ¾Ñ‚Ñ‹ 2.2 Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ°
        drawBox(brm, darkIron, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.88f, 0.35f, 0.12f, 0.24f, 1.85f, 0.24f);
        drawBox(brm, darkIron, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay,  0.64f, 0.35f, 0.12f, 0.24f, 1.85f, 0.24f);
        drawBox(brm, darkIron, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.88f, 0.35f, 1.64f, 0.24f, 1.85f, 0.24f);
        drawBox(brm, darkIron, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay,  0.64f, 0.35f, 1.64f, 0.24f, 1.85f, 0.24f);

        // 3. Ð’ÐµÑ€Ñ…Ð½ÑÑ Ð±Ð°Ð»ÐºÐ° Ð¸ Ñ€ÐµÐ´ÑƒÐºÑ‚Ð¾Ñ€ (Ð²Ñ‹ÑÐ¾Ñ‚Ð° Ð´Ð¾ 2.5 Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ¾Ð²!)
        drawBox(brm, darkIron, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.90f, 2.05f, 0.10f, 1.80f, 0.25f, 1.80f);
        drawBox(brm, firebox,  matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.55f, 1.20f, 0.15f, 1.10f, 0.85f, 0.75f);
        drawBox(brm, steel,    matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.35f, 2.30f, 0.65f, 0.70f, 0.20f, 0.70f);

        // 4. Ð–Ñ‘Ð»Ñ‚Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð²Ñ‹Ñ…Ð¾Ð´Ð½Ð¾Ð¹ Ð¶Ñ‘Ð»Ð¾Ð± ÑÐ¾ ÑÑ‚Ñ€ÐµÐ»ÐºÐ¾Ð¹ Ð½Ð° Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð½ÐµÐ¼-Ð¿Ñ€Ð°Ð²Ð¾Ð¼ Ñ‚Ð°Ð¹Ð»Ðµ (X: -0.75..-0.25, Z: 1.65..2.02)
        drawBox(brm, yellowChute, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.75f, 0.30f, 1.60f, 0.50f, 0.22f, 0.42f);

        // 5. Ð’Ñ€Ð°Ñ‰Ð°ÑŽÑ‰Ð¸Ð¹ÑÑ Ñ†ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ñ€Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð±ÑƒÑ€ Ð¸ ÑˆÐµÑÑ‚ÐµÑ€Ð½Ñ Ð² Ñ†ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ñ€Ðµ 2x2 (X = 0.0, Z = 1.0)
        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(drillAngle));

        // Ð¦ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ñ€Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð²Ð°Ð»
        drawBox(brm, steel, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.15f, 0.10f, -0.15f, 0.30f, 2.00f, 0.30f);
        // Ð›Ð¾Ð¿Ð°ÑÑ‚Ð¸ Ð±ÑƒÑ€Ð¾Ð²Ð¾Ð¹ ÐºÐ¾Ñ€Ð¾Ð½ÐºÐ¸ Ð²Ð½Ð¸Ð·Ñƒ
        drawBox(brm, darkIron, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.45f, 0.15f, -0.10f, 0.90f, 0.45f, 0.20f);
        drawBox(brm, darkIron, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.10f, 0.15f, -0.45f, 0.20f, 0.45f, 0.90f);

        matrices.pop();
    }

    private static void drawBox(BlockRenderManager brm, BlockState state, MatrixStack matrices,
                                VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers, int light, int overlay,
                                float x, float y, float z, float sx, float sy, float sz) {
        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(x, y, z);
        matrices.scale(sx, sy, sz);
        brm.renderBlockAsEntity(state, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay);
        matrices.pop();
    }

    private void renderDrill3DPreview(DrawContext context, int centerX, int centerY, float delta) {
        MatrixStack matrices = context.getMatrices();
        float drillAngle = handler.drillEntity != null ? handler.drillEntity.getClientDrillRotation(delta) : 0.0f;

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(centerX, centerY, 150.0f);
        matrices.scale(this.previewZoom, -this.previewZoom, this.previewZoom);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(this.previewPitch));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(this.previewYaw));

        // Ð¦ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ñ€Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÐ¼ Ð¼Ð¾Ð´ÐµÐ»ÑŒ 2x2x2.5 Ð²Ð¾ÐºÑ€ÑƒÐ³ (0, 0, 0)
        matrices.translate(0.0f, -1.1f, -1.0f);
        BurnerDrillRenderer.renderDrillModel(
                matrices,
                context.getVertexConsumers(),
                LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE,
                OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV,
                drillAngle
        );

        matrices.pop();
        context.draw();
    }

    private void drawCheckerboard(DrawContext context, int left, int top, int right, int bottom, int cellSize) {
        for (int py = top; py < bottom; py += cellSize) {
            for (int px = left; px < right; px += cellSize) {
                int gx = (px - left) / cellSize;
                int gy = (py - top) / cellSize;
                int color = ((gx + gy) % 2 == 0) ? 0xFF262729 : 0xFF2E3032;
                context.fill(px, py, Math.min(px + cellSize, right), Math.min(py + cellSize, bottom), color);
            }
        }
    }

    private void drawSlotFrame(DrawContext context, int slotX, int slotY) {
        context.fill(slotX, slotY, slotX + 18, slotY + 18, 0xFF18181A);

public class ElectricDrillRenderer implements BlockEntityRenderer<ElectricDrillBlockEntity> {

    public ElectricDrillRenderer(BlockEntityRendererFactory.Context ctx) {}

    @Override
    public int getRenderDistance() {
        return 48;
    }

    @Override
    public void render(ElectricDrillBlockEntity entity, float tickDelta, MatrixStack matrices,
                       VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers, int light, int overlay) {
        BlockState state = entity.getCachedState();
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof ElectricDrillBlock)) return;
        if (state.get(ElectricDrillBlock.PART) != 4 || state.get(ElectricDrillBlock.UPPER)) return;

        Direction facing = state.get(ElectricDrillBlock.FACING);
        float angle = (entity.getWorld() != null && entity.isPowered()) ? entity.getClientDrillRotation(tickDelta) : 0.0f;

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(0.5, 0.0, 0.5);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(-facing.asRotation()));
        matrices.translate(-0.5, 0.0, -0.5);

        renderDrillModel(matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, angle);

        matrices.pop();
    }

        drawBox(brm, darkPillars, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.88f, 0.35f, -0.88f, 0.28f, 1.85f, 0.28f);

    private static void drawBox(BlockRenderManager brm, BlockState state, MatrixStack matrices,
                                VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers, int light, int overlay,
                                float x, float y, float z, float sx, float sy, float sz) {
        matrices.push();

        int ledOuter = !isWorking ? 0xFF661111 : 0xFF115511;
        int ledInner = !isWorking ? 0xFFFF3333 : 0xFF44FF44;
        int ledX = x + backgroundWidth - 19;
        context.fill(ledX, y + 5, ledX + 10, y + 14, 0xFF111111);
        context.fill(ledX + 1, y + 6, ledX + 9, y + 13, ledOuter);

        int viewBottom = y + 78;

        drawCheckerboard(context, viewLeft, viewTop, viewRight, viewBottom, 8);

        context.enableScissor(viewLeft, viewTop, viewRight, viewBottom);
        renderDrill3DPreview(context, (viewLeft + viewRight) / 2, (viewTop + viewBottom) / 2 + 12, delta);

        int greenBarY = y + 83;
        int greenBarW = 192;
        int greenBarH = 18;
        context.fill(greenBarX, greenBarY, greenBarX + greenBarW, greenBarY + greenBarH, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(greenBarX + 1, greenBarY + 1, greenBarX + greenBarW - 1, greenBarY + greenBarH - 1, 0xFF222325);

        int progress = handler.getMiningProgress();
        int maxProgress = Math.max(1, handler.getMaxMiningTime());
        int percent = MathHelper.clamp(Math.round((progress / (float) maxProgress) * 100.0f), 0, 100);
        if (progress > 0) {
            int fillW = Math.min(greenBarW - 2, Math.round((progress / (float) maxProgress) * (greenBarW - 2)));
            context.fill(greenBarX + 1, greenBarY + 1, greenBarX + 1 + fillW, greenBarY + greenBarH - 1, 0xFF38B828);
            context.fill(greenBarX + 1, greenBarY + 1, greenBarX + 1 + fillW, greenBarY + 5, 0xFF5CE64C);

    private void drawCheckerboard(DrawContext context, int left, int top, int right, int bottom, int cellSize) {
        for (int py = top; py < bottom; py += cellSize) {

                int gx = (px - left) / cellSize;
                int gy = (py - top) / cellSize;
                context.fill(px, py, Math.min(px + cellSize, right), Math.min(py + cellSize, bottom),
                        ((gx + gy) % 2 == 0) ? 0xFF262729 : 0xFF2E3032);
            }
        }
    }

    private void renderDrill3DPreview(DrawContext context, int centerX, int centerY, float delta) {

        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(this.previewPitch));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(this.previewYaw));

        matrices.translate(-0.5f, -1.1f, -0.5f);

        ElectricDrillRenderer.renderDrillModel(
                matrices,
                context.getVertexConsumers(),
                LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE,
                OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV,
                drillAngle
        );

        matrices.pop();
        context.draw();
    }

        int viewLeft = x + 10;

        int viewRight = x + backgroundWidth - 10;
        int viewBottom = y + 78;
        context.fill(viewLeft - 1, viewTop - 1, viewRight + 1, viewBottom + 1, 0xFF141414);

        int invFrameX = x + 37;

            }

    private void renderFurnace3DPreview(DrawContext context, int centerX, int centerY) {
        MatrixStack matrices = context.getMatrices();
        int tier = handler.furnaceEntity != null ? handler.furnaceEntity.getTier() : 1;
        boolean burning = handler.furnaceEntity != null && handler.furnaceEntity.isBurning();

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(centerX, centerY, 150.0f);
        matrices.scale(this.previewZoom, -this.previewZoom, this.previewZoom);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(this.previewPitch));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(this.previewYaw));

        matrices.translate(0.0f, -1.1f, -1.0f);
        FactorioFurnaceRenderer.renderFurnaceModel(
                tier,
                burning,
                matrices,
                context.getVertexConsumers(),
                LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE,
                OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV
        );

        matrices.pop();
        context.draw();
    }

    private void drawCheckerboard(DrawContext context, int left, int top, int right, int bottom, int cellSize) {
        for (int py = top; py < bottom; py += cellSize) {
            for (int px = left; px < right; px += cellSize) {
                int gx = (px - left) / cellSize;
                int gy = (py - top) / cellSize;
                int color = ((gx + gy) % 2 == 0) ? 0xFF262729 : 0xFF2E3032;
                context.fill(px, py, Math.min(px + cellSize, right), Math.min(py + cellSize, bottom), color);
            }
        }
    }

    private void drawSlotFrame(DrawContext context, int slotX, int slotY) {
        context.fill(slotX, slotY, slotX + 18, slotY + 18, 0xFF18181A);
        context.fill(slotX + 1, slotY + 1, slotX + 17, slotY + 17, 0xFF3A3C3E);
    }

    private void drawFlameSilhouette(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy) {
        int c = 0xFF626466;
        context.fill(sx + 7, sy + 3, sx + 9, sy + 6, c);
        context.fill(sx + 5, sy + 6, sx + 11, sy + 10, c);
        context.fill(sx + 4, sy + 9, sx + 12, sy + 13, c);
        context.fill(sx + 6, sy + 13, sx + 10, sy + 14, c);
    }

    private void drawDivider(DrawContext context, int x, int y, int width) {
        context.fill(x, y, x + width, y + 1, 0xFF202122);
        context.fill(x, y + 1, x + width, y + 2, 0xFF3E4042);
    }

    private boolean isInsideViewport(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        return mouseX >= x + 10 && mouseX <= x + backgroundWidth - 10 && mouseY >= y + 18 && mouseY <= y + 78;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        if (isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.previewZoom = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewZoom + (float) verticalAmount * 1.8f, 7.0f, 32.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mouseX, mouseY, horizontalAmount, verticalAmount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if ((button == 0 || button == 1) && isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.draggingPreview = true;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (this.draggingPreview && (button == 0 || button == 1)) {
            this.draggingPreview = false;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.draggingPreview) {
            this.previewYaw += (float) deltaX * 1.5f;
            this.previewPitch = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewPitch + (float) deltaY * 1.5f, -80.0f, 80.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        super.render(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);
        drawMouseoverTooltip(context, mouseX, mouseY);
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.client.content.research;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.research.LabBlock;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.research.LabBlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.block.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient;
import net.minecraft.client.render.LightmapTextureManager;
import net.minecraft.client.render.VertexConsumerProvider;
import net.minecraft.client.render.block.BlockRenderManager;
import net.minecraft.client.render.block.entity.BlockEntityRenderer;
import net.minecraft.client.render.block.entity.BlockEntityRendererFactory;
import net.minecraft.client.util.math.MatrixStack;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Direction;
import net.minecraft.util.math.RotationAxis;

public class LabRenderer implements BlockEntityRenderer<LabBlockEntity> {

    public LabRenderer(BlockEntityRendererFactory.Context ctx) {}

    @Override
    public int getRenderDistance() {
        return 48;
    }

    @Override
    public void render(LabBlockEntity entity, float tickDelta, MatrixStack matrices,
                       VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers, int light, int overlay) {
        BlockState state = entity.getCachedState();
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof LabBlock)) return;
        if (state.get(LabBlock.PART) != 4 || state.get(LabBlock.UPPER)) return;

        Direction facing = state.contains(LabBlock.FACING) ? state.get(LabBlock.FACING) : Direction.NORTH;
        float angle = (entity.isWorking() && entity.getWorld() != null)
                ? (entity.getWorld().getTime() + tickDelta) * 8.0f : 0.0f;

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(0.5, 0.0, 0.5);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(-facing.asRotation()));
        matrices.translate(-0.5, 0.0, -0.5);

        renderLabModel(matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, angle, entity.isWorking());

        matrices.pop();
    }

    public static void renderLabModel(MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers,
                                      int light, int overlay, float workingAngle, boolean working) {
        BlockRenderManager brm = MinecraftClient.getInstance().getBlockRenderManager();
        BlockState baseFrame = Blocks.POLISHED_DEEPSLATE.getDefaultState();
        BlockState whiteHull = Blocks.IRON_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
        BlockState darkRibs = Blocks.NETHERITE_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
        BlockState glassDome = Blocks.CYAN_STAINED_GLASS.getDefaultState();
        BlockState coreBlock = working ? Blocks.SEA_LANTERN.getDefaultState() : Blocks.PRISMARINE_BRICKS.getDefaultState();
        int coreLight = working ? LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE : light;

        // 1. Ð¢ÑÐ¶Ñ‘Ð»Ð¾Ðµ Ð¾ÑÐ½Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ðµ 3x3 (X: -0.95..1.95, Z: -0.95..1.95)
        drawBox(brm, baseFrame, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.95f, 0.0f, -0.95f, 2.90f, 0.35f, 2.90f);

        // 2. Ð‘ÐµÐ»Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð½Ð°ÑƒÑ‡Ð½Ð¾-Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼Ñ‹ÑˆÐ»ÐµÐ½Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÐºÐ¾Ñ€Ð¿ÑƒÑ Ð¸ ÑƒÐ³Ð»Ð¾Ð²Ñ‹Ðµ Ð´ÑƒÐ³Ð¸ ÐºÑƒÐ¿Ð¾Ð»Ð°
        drawBox(brm, whiteHull, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.80f, 0.35f, -0.80f, 2.60f, 0.65f, 2.60f);
        drawBox(brm, darkRibs,  matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.86f, 0.35f, -0.86f, 0.38f, 1.35f, 0.38f);
        drawBox(brm, darkRibs,  matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay,  1.48f, 0.35f, -0.86f, 0.38f, 1.35f, 0.38f);

    @Override
    protected void drawBackground(DrawContext context, float delta, int mouseX, int mouseY) {

        if (progress > 0) {
            int fillW = Math.min(greenBarW - 2, Math.round((progress / (float) maxProgress) * (greenBarW - 2)));
            context.fill(greenBarX + 1, greenBarY + 1, greenBarX + 1 + fillW, greenBarY + greenBarH - 1, 0xFF38B828);

            }

        for (int col = 0; col < 9; col++) {

        }

    private void drawCheckerboard(DrawContext context, int left, int top, int right, int bottom, int cellSize) {
        for (int py = top; py < bottom; py += cellSize) {
            for (int px = left; px < right; px += cellSize) {
                int gx = (px - left) / cellSize;
                int gy = (py - top) / cellSize;
                context.fill(px, py, Math.min(px + cellSize, right), Math.min(py + cellSize, bottom),
                        ((gx + gy) % 2 == 0) ? 0xFF262729 : 0xFF2E3032);
            }
        }
    }

    private void drawSlotFrame(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy) {
        context.fill(sx, sy, sx + 18, sy + 18, 0xFF18181A);
        context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 1, sx + 17, sy + 17, 0xFF3A3C3E);
    }

    private void renderLab3DPreview(DrawContext context, int centerX, int centerY, float delta) {
        MinecraftClient client = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        MatrixStack matrices = context.getMatrices();
        boolean working = handler.getResearchProgress() > 0;
        float labAngle = (working && client.world != null)
                ? (client.world.getTime() + delta) * 8.0f : 0.0f;

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(centerX, centerY, 150.0f);
        matrices.scale(this.previewZoom, -this.previewZoom, this.previewZoom);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(this.previewPitch));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(this.previewYaw));
        matrices.translate(-0.5f, -1.0f, -0.5f);

        LabRenderer.renderLabModel(
                matrices,
                context.getVertexConsumers(),
                LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE,
                OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV,
                labAngle,
                working
        );

        matrices.pop();
        context.draw();
    }

    private boolean isInsideViewport(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        return mouseX >= x + 10 && mouseX <= x + backgroundWidth - 10 && mouseY >= y + 18 && mouseY <= y + 78;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        if (isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.previewZoom = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewZoom + (float) verticalAmount * 2.0f, 8.0f, 40.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mouseX, mouseY, horizontalAmount, verticalAmount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if ((button == 0 || button == 1) && isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.draggingPreview = true;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (this.draggingPreview && (button == 0 || button == 1)) {
            this.draggingPreview = false;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.draggingPreview) {
            this.previewYaw += (float) deltaX * 1.5f;
            this.previewPitch = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewPitch + (float) deltaY * 1.5f, -80.0f, 80.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        super.render(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);
        drawMouseoverTooltip(context, mouseX, mouseY);
    }
}

    private List<TechNode> getSortedFilteredList() {
        List<TechNode> list = new ArrayList<>();
        String queryLower = this.searchQuery.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        for (TechNode t : ResearchManager.TECHS) {
            if (!queryLower.isBlank() && !t.name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains(queryLower)) {
                continue;
            }
            list.add(t);
        }
        list.sort(Comparator.comparingInt(t -> switch (t.status) {
            case AVAILABLE -> 0;
            case LOCKED -> 1;
            case RESEARCHED -> 2;
        }));
        return list;
    }

        return hoveredUnlock;
    }

    private void drawMiniTechTile(DrawContext context, TechNode tech, int tx, int ty, int tw, int th,
                                  boolean selected, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        boolean hovered = mouseX >= tx && mouseX < tx + tw && mouseY >= ty && mouseY < ty + th;
        int borderCol = selected ? 0xFFFFCC44 : (hovered ? 0xFFE6E6E6 : 0xFF0E0E0F);

        int topBg = switch (tech.status) {
            case RESEARCHED -> hovered ? 0xFF38A838 : 0xFF2B872B;
            case AVAILABLE -> hovered ? 0xFFB89228 : 0xFF96751E;
            case LOCKED -> hovered ? 0xFF942E2E : 0xFF752222;
        };
        int topHighlight = switch (tech.status) {
            case RESEARCHED -> 0xFF48C848;
            case AVAILABLE -> 0xFFD4AC36;
            case LOCKED -> 0xFFB03A3A;
        };

        int footerH = (th >= 38) ? 12 : 8;
        int bodyH = th - footerH;

        context.fill(tx, ty, tx + tw, ty + th, borderCol);
        context.fill(tx + 1, ty + 1, tx + tw - 1, ty + bodyH, topBg);
        context.fill(tx + 1, ty + 1, tx + tw - 1, ty + 2, topHighlight);

        float iconScale = (tw >= 40) ? 1.35f : 1.0f;
        int iconPx = Math.round(16 * iconScale);
        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(tx + (tw - iconPx) / 2.0f, ty + (bodyH - iconPx) / 2.0f, 100.0f);
        context.getMatrices().scale(iconScale, iconScale, 1.0f);
        context.drawItem(tech.icon, 0, 0);
        context.getMatrices().pop();

        if (!tech.badgeLevel.isEmpty()) {
            drawScaledText(context, tech.badgeLevel, tx + tw - 7, ty + 2, 0.65f, 0xFFFFE066, true);
        }

        context.fill(tx + 1, ty + bodyH, tx + tw - 1, ty + th - 1, 0xFF1B1C1E);
        if (th >= 38) {
            int fx = tx + 2;
            for (SciencePack sp : tech.packs) {
                drawScienceFlask(context, fx, ty + bodyH + 1, sp, 0.55f);
                fx += 6;
            }
            drawScaledTextCentered(context, "\u00d7" + tech.costCount, tx + tw / 2 + 4, ty + bodyH + 3, 0.58f, 0xFFDDDDDD, false);
        }
    }

    private void drawBigSelectedTechTile(DrawContext context, TechNode tech, int tx, int ty, int tw, int th) {
        int topBg = switch (tech.status) {
            case RESEARCHED -> 0xFF2B872B;
            case AVAILABLE -> 0xFF96751E;
            case LOCKED -> 0xFF752222;
        };
        int footerH = 14;
        int bodyH = th - footerH;

        context.fill(tx, ty, tx + tw, ty + th, 0xFF111111);
        context.fill(tx + 1, ty + 1, tx + tw - 1, ty + bodyH, topBg);

        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(tx + 6.0f, ty + 6.0f, 100.0f);
        context.getMatrices().scale(2.0f, 2.0f, 1.0f);
        context.drawItem(tech.icon, 0, 0);
        context.getMatrices().pop();

        if (!tech.badgeLevel.isEmpty()) {
            drawScaledText(context, tech.badgeLevel, tx + tw - 9, ty + 3, 0.85f, 0xFFFFE066, true);
        }

        context.fill(tx + 1, ty + bodyH, tx + tw - 1, ty + th - 1, 0xFF1A1B1D);
        int fx = tx + 3;
        for (SciencePack sp : tech.packs) {
            drawScienceFlask(context, fx, ty + bodyH + 1, sp, 0.65f);
            fx += 7;
        }
        drawScaledTextCentered(context, "\u00d7 " + tech.costCount, tx + tw / 2 + 4, ty + bodyH + 5, 0.62f, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);
    }

    private void drawScienceFlask(DrawContext context, int x, int y, SciencePack pack, float scale) {
        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(x, y, 150.0f);
        context.getMatrices().scale(scale, scale, 1.0f);
        context.fill(3, 0, 5, 1, 0xFF8D6E63);
        context.fill(3, 1, 5, 4, 0xFFD0E8F2);
        context.fill(2, 4, 6, 6, pack.bodyColor);
        context.fill(1, 6, 7, 9, pack.bodyColor);
        context.fill(2, 5, 4, 8, pack.liquidHighlight);
        context.fill(1, 9, 7, 10, 0xFF141414);
        context.getMatrices().pop();
    }

    private TechNode renderRightTechGraph(DrawContext context, int canvasX, int canvasY, int canvasW, int canvasH, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        TechNode hovered = null;
        int centerX = canvasX + canvasW / 2 + (int) this.canvasOffsetX;
        int centerY = canvasY + canvasH / 2 + (int) this.canvasOffsetY;

        if (this.showFocusedBranchOnly && this.selectedTech != null) {
            TechNode focus = this.selectedTech;
            List<TechNode> parents = new ArrayList<>();
            for (String pid : focus.prerequisites) {
                TechNode p = ResearchManager.getById(pid);
                if (p != null) parents.add(p);
            }
            List<TechNode> children = new ArrayList<>();
            for (TechNode t : ResearchManager.TECHS) {
                if (t.prerequisites.contains(focus.id)) children.add(t);
            }

            int focusW = Math.round(58 * zoom);
            int focusH = Math.round(74 * zoom);
            int smallW = Math.round(38 * zoom);
            int smallH = Math.round(48 * zoom);
            int gapX = Math.round(50 * zoom);
            int rowGapY = Math.round(82 * zoom);

            int fx = centerX - focusW / 2;
            int fy = centerY - focusH / 2;

            for (int i = 0; i < parents.size(); i++) {
                TechNode p = parents.get(i);
                int px = centerX + (int) ((i - (parents.size() - 1) / 2.0f) * gapX) - smallW / 2;
                int py = fy - rowGapY - smallH / 2;
                drawOrthogonalLink(context, px + smallW / 2, py + smallH, fx + focusW / 2, fy, true);
                drawMiniTechTile(context, p, px, py, smallW, smallH, false, mouseX, mouseY);
                if (mouseX >= px && mouseX < px + smallW && mouseY >= py && mouseY < py + smallH) hovered = p;
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < children.size(); i++) {
                TechNode ch = children.get(i);
                int cx = centerX + (int) ((i - (children.size() - 1) / 2.0f) * gapX) - smallW / 2;
                int cy = fy + focusH + Math.round(34 * zoom);
                drawOrthogonalLink(context, fx + focusW / 2, fy + focusH, cx + smallW / 2, cy, focus.status == TechStatus.RESEARCHED);
                drawMiniTechTile(context, ch, cx, cy, smallW, smallH, false, mouseX, mouseY);
                if (mouseX >= cx && mouseX < cx + smallW && mouseY >= cy && mouseY < cy + smallH) hovered = ch;
            }

            drawMiniTechTile(context, focus, fx, fy, focusW, focusH, true, mouseX, mouseY);
            if (mouseX >= fx && mouseX < fx + focusW && mouseY >= fy && mouseY < fy + focusH) hovered = focus;
        } else {
            int stepX = Math.round(54 * zoom);
            int stepY = Math.round(82 * zoom);
            int nodeW = Math.round(38 * zoom);
            int nodeH = Math.round(48 * zoom);

            for (TechNode t : ResearchManager.TECHS) {
                int tx = centerX + t.treeCol * stepX - nodeW / 2;
                int ty = centerY + (t.treeRow - 2) * stepY - nodeH / 2;
                for (String preId : t.prerequisites) {
                    TechNode pre = ResearchManager.getById(preId);
                    if (pre != null) {
                        int px = centerX + pre.treeCol * stepX;
                        int py = centerY + (pre.treeRow - 2) * stepY + nodeH / 2;
                        drawOrthogonalLink(context, px, py, tx + nodeW / 2, ty, pre.status == TechStatus.RESEARCHED);
                    }
                }
            }

            for (TechNode t : ResearchManager.TECHS) {
                boolean isSel = (t == this.selectedTech);
                int w = isSel ? Math.round(46 * zoom) : nodeW;
                int h = isSel ? Math.round(58 * zoom) : nodeH;
                int tx = centerX + t.treeCol * stepX - w / 2;
                int ty = centerY + (t.treeRow - 2) * stepY - h / 2;
                drawMiniTechTile(context, t, tx, ty, w, h, isSel, mouseX, mouseY);
                if (mouseX >= tx && mouseX < tx + w && mouseY >= ty && mouseY < ty + h) hovered = t;
            }
        }
        return hovered;
    }

    private void drawOrthogonalLink(DrawContext context, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2, boolean activeLine) {
        int col = activeLine ? 0xFFB8BABC : 0xFF686A6E;
        int midY = (y1 + y2) / 2;
        context.fill(x1 - 1, Math.min(y1, midY), x1 + 1, Math.max(y1, midY) + 1, col);
        context.fill(Math.min(x1, x2), midY - 1, Math.max(x1, x2) + 1, midY + 1, col);
        context.fill(x2 - 1, Math.min(midY, y2), x2 + 1, Math.max(midY, y2) + 1, col);
        context.fill(x2 - 2, y2 - 2, x2 + 2, y2, 0xFFFFCC44);
    }

    private void renderFactorioTechTooltip(DrawContext context, TechNode tech, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        int cardW = Math.max(176, this.textRenderer.getWidth(tech.name) + 24);
        List<OrderedText> descLines = this.textRenderer.wrapLines(Text.literal(tech.description), cardW - 14);
        int unlockRows = tech.unlocks.isEmpty() ? 0 : 1;
        int cardH = 22 + descLines.size() * 10 + 26 + unlockRows * 30 + 6;

        int tx = mouseX + 12;
        int ty = mouseY + 8;
        if (tx + cardW > this.width - 6) tx = mouseX - cardW - 12;
        if (ty + cardH > this.height - 6) ty = this.height - cardH - 6;
        if (ty < 6) ty = 6;

        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(0.0f, 0.0f, 400.0f);

        context.fill(tx, ty, tx + cardW, ty + cardH, 0xF8111214);
        context.fill(tx + 1, ty + 1, tx + cardW - 1, ty + cardH - 1, 0xF4252629);
        context.fill(tx + 2, ty + 2, tx + cardW - 2, ty + 18, 0xFF42331C);
        context.fill(tx + 2, ty + 18, tx + cardW - 2, ty + 19, 0xFFE59524);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, tech.name, tx + 6, ty + 6, 0xFFFFDCA0, true);

        int curY = ty + 23;
        for (OrderedText line : descLines) {
            context.drawText(this.textRenderer, line, tx + 6, curY, 0xFFCCCCCC, false);
            curY += 10;
        }

        curY += 3;
        context.fill(tx + 4, curY, tx + cardW - 4, curY + 20, 0xFF1B1C1F);
        drawClockIcon(context, tx + 8, curY + 6);
        drawScaledText(context, String.valueOf(tech.timeSeconds), tx + 18, curY + 7, 0.80f, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);
        int fx = tx + 36;
        for (SciencePack sp : tech.packs) {
            drawScienceFlask(context, fx, curY + 5, sp, 1.0f);
            fx += 11;
        }
        drawScaledText(context, "\u00d7 " + tech.costCount, fx + 4, curY + 7, 0.80f, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);
        curY += 23;

        if (!tech.unlocks.isEmpty()) {
            drawScaledText(context,
                    Text.translatableWithFallback("gui.factoriocore.tech.effects", "Ð ÐµÐ·ÑƒÐ»ÑŒÑ‚Ð°Ñ‚").getString(),
                    tx + 6, curY, 0.75f, 0xFFFFCC66, false);
            curY += 9;
            for (int i = 0; i < tech.unlocks.size() && i < 8; i++) {
                int ux = tx + 6 + i * 19;
                context.fill(ux, curY, ux + 18, curY + 18, 0xFF141414);
                context.fill(ux + 1, curY + 1, ux + 17, curY + 17, 0xFF383A3E);
                context.drawItem(tech.unlocks.get(i), ux + 1, curY + 1);
            }
        }
        context.getMatrices().pop();
    }

    private TechNode getHoveredGridTech(int x, int y, int w, int h, double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        int listY = y + 38 + 3 + 98 + 3;
        int listH = (y + h) - listY;
        int gridStartX = x + 5;
        int gridStartY = listY + 18;
        if (mouseX < gridStartX || mouseX > x + w - 2 || mouseY < gridStartY || mouseY > listY + listH - 2) return null;
        List<TechNode> gridTechs = getSortedFilteredList();
        int cols = 6, tileW = 33, tileH = 42, gap = 2;

        for (int i = 0; i < gridTechs.size(); i++) {
            int col = i % cols;
            int row = (i / cols) - this.gridScrollRow;
            int tx = gridStartX + col * (tileW + gap);
            int ty = gridStartY + row * (tileH + gap);
            if (mouseX >= tx && mouseX < tx + tileW && mouseY >= ty && mouseY < ty + tileH) return gridTechs.get(i);
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        int screenW = this.width, screenH = this.height, leftW = 218;
        int canvasX = leftW + 4, canvasY = 20, canvasW = screenW - canvasX - 3, canvasH = screenH - canvasY - 3;

        if (mouseX >= screenW - 17 && mouseX <= screenW - 4 && mouseY >= 4 && mouseY <= 16) {
            this.close();
            return true;
        }

        if (mouseX >= screenW - 170 && mouseX <= screenW - 6 && mouseY >= canvasY + 4 && mouseY <= canvasY + 18) {
            this.showFocusedBranchOnly = !this.showFocusedBranchOnly;
            centerCanvasOnSelected();
            playClick();
            return true;
        }

        // 1. Ð£Ð´Ð°Ð»ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ðµ Ñ‚ÐµÑ…Ð½Ð¾Ð»Ð¾Ð³Ð¸Ð¸ Ð¸Ð· Ð²ÐµÑ€Ñ…Ð½ÐµÐ¹ Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸ Ð¸ÑÑÐ»ÐµÐ´Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ð¹ Ð¿Ð¾ ÐºÐ»Ð¸ÐºÑƒ
        if (!ResearchManager.RESEARCH_QUEUE.isEmpty() && mouseX >= 7 && mouseX <= leftW && mouseY >= 23 && mouseY <= 55) {
            int idx = (int) ((mouseX - 7) / 34);
            if (idx >= 0 && idx < ResearchManager.RESEARCH_QUEUE.size()) {
                ResearchManager.removeQueueAt(idx);
                ClientPlayNetworking.send(new ResearchActionPayload(ResearchActionPayload.ACTION_REMOVE_AT, "", idx));
                playClick();
            }
            return true;
        }

        // 2. ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ ÐºÐ½Ð¾Ð¿ÐºÐµ "ÐÐ°Ñ‡Ð°Ñ‚ÑŒ Ð¸ÑÑÐ»ÐµÐ´Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ðµ" (Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ Shift + Ð›ÐšÐœ Ð´Ð»Ñ Ð¼Ð³Ð½Ð¾Ð²ÐµÐ½Ð½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ Ð¸Ð·ÑƒÑ‡ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ñ Ð² ÐºÑ€ÐµÐ°Ñ‚Ð¸Ð²Ðµ/OP)
        int infoY = 20 + 38 + 3, infoH = 98, btnW = 86, btnH = 15;
        int btnX = 3 + (leftW - 1) - btnW - 4;
        int btnY = infoY + infoH - btnH - 4;
        if (this.selectedTech != null && mouseX >= btnX && mouseX <= btnX + btnW && mouseY >= btnY && mouseY <= btnY + btnH) {
            if (hasShiftDown() && this.selectedTech.status != TechStatus.RESEARCHED) {
                ResearchManager.completeImmediately(this.selectedTech.id);
                ClientPlayNetworking.send(new ResearchActionPayload(ResearchActionPayload.ACTION_COMPLETE_NOW, this.selectedTech.id, 0));
                playClick();
            } else if (this.selectedTech.status == TechStatus.AVAILABLE) {
                ResearchManager.queueTech(this.selectedTech.id);
                ClientPlayNetworking.send(new ResearchActionPayload(ResearchActionPayload.ACTION_QUEUE, this.selectedTech.id, 0));
                playClick();
            }
            return true;
        }

        int listY = infoY + infoH + 3;
        if (!this.searchActive && mouseX >= leftW - 16 && mouseX <= leftW && mouseY >= listY + 3 && mouseY <= listY + 15) {
            this.searchActive = true;
            return true;
        } else if (this.searchActive && mouseX >= leftW - 76 && mouseX <= leftW && mouseY >= listY + 3 && mouseY <= listY + 15) {
            if (button == 1) this.searchQuery = "";
            return true;
        } else if (this.searchActive && this.searchQuery.isEmpty()) {
            this.searchActive = false;
        }

        // 3. ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº (Ð¸ Ð¿Ð¾Ð²Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÐºÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð´Ð»Ñ Ð¿Ð¾ÑÑ‚Ð°Ð½Ð¾Ð²ÐºÐ¸ Ð² Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´ÑŒ) Ð¿Ð¾ Ñ‚ÐµÑ…Ð½Ð¾Ð»Ð¾Ð³Ð¸Ð¸ Ð² Ð½Ð¸Ð¶Ð½ÐµÐ¹ ÑÐµÑ‚ÐºÐµ
        TechNode gridClicked = getHoveredGridTech(3, 20, leftW - 1, screenH - 23, mouseX, mouseY);
        if (gridClicked != null) {
            if (button == 0 && this.selectedTech == gridClicked && gridClicked.status == TechStatus.AVAILABLE) {
                ResearchManager.queueTech(gridClicked.id);
                ClientPlayNetworking.send(new ResearchActionPayload(ResearchActionPayload.ACTION_QUEUE, gridClicked.id, 0));
            }
            this.selectedTech = gridClicked;
            centerCanvasOnSelected();
            playClick();
            return true;
        }

        if (mouseX >= canvasX) {
            TechNode graphClicked = findClickedGraphNode(canvasX, canvasY, canvasW, canvasH, (int) mouseX, (int) mouseY);
            if (graphClicked != null && button == 0) {
                this.selectedTech = graphClicked;
                centerCanvasOnSelected();
                playClick();
                return true;
            }
            this.isDraggingCanvas = true;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    private TechNode findClickedGraphNode(int canvasX, int canvasY, int canvasW, int canvasH, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        int centerX = canvasX + canvasW / 2 + (int) this.canvasOffsetX;
        int centerY = canvasY + canvasH / 2 + (int) this.canvasOffsetY;

        if (this.showFocusedBranchOnly && this.selectedTech != null) {
            TechNode focus = this.selectedTech;
            int smallW = Math.round(38 * zoom), smallH = Math.round(48 * zoom);
            int focusW = Math.round(58 * zoom), focusH = Math.round(74 * zoom);
            int gapX = Math.round(50 * zoom), rowGapY = Math.round(82 * zoom);
            int fx = centerX - focusW / 2, fy = centerY - focusH / 2;

            if (mouseX >= fx && mouseX < fx + focusW && mouseY >= fy && mouseY < fy + focusH) {
                return focus;
            }

            List<TechNode> parents = new ArrayList<>();
            for (String pid : focus.prerequisites) {
                TechNode p = ResearchManager.getById(pid);
                if (p != null) parents.add(p);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < parents.size(); i++) {
                TechNode p = parents.get(i);
                int px = centerX + (int) ((i - (parents.size() - 1) / 2.0f) * gapX) - smallW / 2;
                int py = fy - rowGapY - smallH / 2;
                if (mouseX >= px && mouseX < px + smallW && mouseY >= py && mouseY < py + smallH) return p;
            }

            List<TechNode> children = new ArrayList<>();
            for (TechNode t : ResearchManager.TECHS) {
                if (t.prerequisites.contains(focus.id)) children.add(t);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < children.size(); i++) {
                TechNode ch = children.get(i);
                int cx = centerX + (int) ((i - (children.size() - 1) / 2.0f) * gapX) - smallW / 2;
                int cy = fy + focusH + Math.round(34 * zoom);
                if (mouseX >= cx && mouseX < cx + smallW && mouseY >= cy && mouseY < cy + smallH) return ch;
            }
            return null;
        } else {
            int stepX = Math.round(54 * zoom), stepY = Math.round(82 * zoom);
            int nodeW = Math.round(38 * zoom), nodeH = Math.round(48 * zoom);
            for (TechNode t : ResearchManager.TECHS) {
                boolean isSel = (t == this.selectedTech);
                int w = isSel ? Math.round(46 * zoom) : nodeW;
                int h = isSel ? Math.round(58 * zoom) : nodeH;
                int tx = centerX + t.treeCol * stepX - w / 2;
                int ty = centerY + (t.treeRow - 2) * stepY - h / 2;
                if (mouseX >= tx && mouseX < tx + w && mouseY >= ty && mouseY < ty + h) return t;
            }
            return null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        this.isDraggingCanvas = false;
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.isDraggingCanvas) {
            this.canvasOffsetX += deltaX;
            this.canvasOffsetY += deltaY;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        if (mouseX < 220) {
            int maxRows = Math.max(0, (getSortedFilteredList().size() + 5) / 6 - 3);
            this.gridScrollRow = MathHelper.clamp(this.gridScrollRow - (int) Math.signum(verticalAmount), 0, maxRows);
            return true;
        } else {
            this.zoom = MathHelper.clamp(this.zoom + (float) verticalAmount * 0.1f, 0.65f, 1.65f);
            return true;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean charTyped(char chr, int modifiers) {
        if (this.searchActive && chr >= 32) {
            this.searchQuery += chr;
            this.gridScrollRow = 0;
            return true;
        }
        return super.charTyped(chr, modifiers);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(int keyCode, int scanCode, int modifiers) {
        if (this.searchActive) {
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_BACKSPACE && !this.searchQuery.isEmpty()) {
                this.searchQuery = this.searchQuery.substring(0, this.searchQuery.length() - 1);
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) {
                this.searchActive = false;
                this.searchQuery = "";
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ENTER || keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_KP_ENTER) {
                this.searchActive = false;
                return true;
            }
            return true;
        }
        if (this.client != null && this.client.options.inventoryKey.matchesKey(keyCode, scanCode)) {
            this.close();
            return true;
        }
        return super.keyPressed(keyCode, scanCode, modifiers);
    }

    private void drawFactorioHeader(DrawContext context, int hx, int hy, int hw, String title, int rightPadding) {
        context.fill(hx, hy, hx + hw, hy + 14, 0xFF232426);
        drawScaledText(context, title, hx + 5, hy + 4, 0.82f, 0xFFFFDCA0, true);
        int titleW = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(title) * 0.82f);
        for (int rx = hx + 10 + titleW; rx < hx + hw - rightPadding; rx += 3) {
            context.fill(rx, hy + 3, rx + 1, hy + 11, 0xFF17181A);
        }
    }

    private void drawFactorioCheckbox(DrawContext context, int cx, int cy, boolean checked) {
        context.fill(cx, cy, cx + 9, cy + 9, 0xFF111111);
        context.fill(cx + 1, cy + 1, cx + 8, cy + 8, checked ? 0xFFE59524 : 0xFF3E4044);
        if (checked) {
            context.fill(cx + 2, cy + 4, cx + 4, cy + 6, 0xFF141414);
            context.fill(cx + 4, cy + 2, cx + 7, cy + 5, 0xFF141414);
        }
    }

    private void drawIconButton(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw, int bh, String sym, int mouseX, int mouseY, boolean active) {
        boolean hov = mouseX >= bx && mouseX < bx + bw && mouseY >= by && mouseY < by + bh;
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + bw, by + bh, 0xFF111111);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + bw - 1, by + bh - 1, active ? 0xFFE59524 : (hov ? 0xFF4C4E52 : 0xFF35373A));
        drawScaledTextCentered(context, sym, bx + bw / 2, by + 3, 0.75f, active ? 0xFF111111 : 0xFFE6E6E6, false);
    }

    private void drawClockIcon(DrawContext context, int cx, int cy) {
        context.fill(cx + 1, cy, cx + 7, cy + 8, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(cx, cy + 1, cx + 8, cy + 7, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(cx + 1, cy + 1, cx + 7, cy + 7, 0xFFD8D8D8);
        context.fill(cx + 3, cy + 2, cx + 4, cy + 5, 0xFF232426);
        context.fill(cx + 4, cy + 4, cx + 6, cy + 5, 0xFF232426);
    }

    private void drawScaledText(DrawContext context, String text, int x, int y, float scale, int color, boolean shadow) {
        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(x, y, 200.0f);
        context.getMatrices().scale(scale, scale, 1.0f);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, text, 0, 0, color, shadow);
        context.getMatrices().pop();
    }

    private void drawScaledTextCentered(DrawContext context, String text, int centerX, int y, float scale, int color, boolean shadow) {
        int w = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(text) * scale);
        drawScaledText(context, text, centerX - w / 2, y, scale, color, shadow);
    }

    private void playClick() {
        if (this.client != null && this.client.player != null) {
            this.client.player.playSound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), 0.35f, 1.15f);
        }
    }
}

    private static void renderAltModeWorld(WorldRenderContext context) {
        if (!altModeActive) return;

        MinecraftClient client = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        World world = client.world;
        if (world == null || client.player == null || context.consumers() == null || context.matrixStack() == null) {
            return;
        }

        Vec3d cam = context.camera().getPos();
        MatrixStack matrices = context.matrixStack();
        VertexConsumerProvider consumers = context.consumers();
        VertexConsumer lines = consumers.getBuffer(RenderLayer.getLines());

        BlockPos playerPos = client.player.getBlockPos();
        int radius = 22;

        List<AltBadge> badgesToRender = new ArrayList<>();

        // Ð•Ð´Ð¸Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ñ…Ð¾Ð´ Ð¿Ð¾ Ñ€Ð°Ð´Ð¸ÑƒÑÑƒ Ð²Ð¾ÐºÑ€ÑƒÐ³ Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÐ°: Ñ€Ð¸ÑÑƒÐµÐ¼ Ð»Ð¸Ð½Ð¸Ð¸ ÑÑ€Ð°Ð·Ñƒ Ð¸ ÑÐ¾Ð±Ð¸Ñ€Ð°ÐµÐ¼ 2D-Ð±ÐµÐ¹Ð´Ð¶Ð¸ Ð² ÑÐ¿Ð¸ÑÐ¾Ðº
        for (int dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -radius; dz <= radius; dz++) {
                for (int dy = -3; dy <= 3; dy++) {
                    BlockPos pos = playerPos.add(dx, dy, dz);
                    BlockState state = world.getBlockState(pos);
                    if (state.isAir()) continue;
                    Block block = state.getBlock();

                    if (block instanceof InserterBlock) {
                        Direction facing = state.get(InserterBlock.FACING);
                        int reach = (block == ModBlocks.LONG_HANDED_INSERTER) ? 2 : 1;
                        drawInserterOverlay(matrices, lines, cam, pos, facing, reach);
                    } else if (block instanceof OffshorePumpBlock && state.get(OffshorePumpBlock.PART) == 0 && !state.get(OffshorePumpBlock.UPPER)) {
                        Direction facing = state.get(OffshorePumpBlock.FACING);
                        drawFluidPortArrow(matrices, lines, cam, pos.offset(facing.getOpposite()), facing.getOpposite(), 0.15f, 0.75f, 1.0f);
                    } else if (block instanceof BoilerBlock && state.get(BoilerBlock.PART) == 1 && !state.get(BoilerBlock.UPPER)) {
                        Direction facing = state.get(BoilerBlock.FACING);
                        Direction left = facing.rotateYCounterclockwise();
                        Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
                        drawFluidPortArrow(matrices, lines, cam, pos.offset(left, 2), right, 0.15f, 0.75f, 1.0f);
                        drawFluidPortArrow(matrices, lines, cam, pos.offset(right, 2), left, 0.15f, 0.75f, 1.0f);
                        drawFluidPortArrow(matrices, lines, cam, pos.offset(facing, 2), facing, 0.92f, 0.95f, 1.0f);
                    } else if (block instanceof SteamEngineBlock && state.get(SteamEngineBlock.PART) == 1 && state.get(SteamEngineBlock.LAYER) == 0) {
                        Direction facing = state.get(SteamEngineBlock.FACING);
                        drawFluidPortArrow(matrices, lines, cam, pos.offset(facing.getOpposite()), facing, 0.92f, 0.95f, 1.0f);
                        drawFluidPortArrow(matrices, lines, cam, pos.offset(facing, 5), facing, 0.92f, 0.95f, 1.0f);
                    } else if (block instanceof AssemblerBlock && state.get(AssemblerBlock.PART) == 4 && !state.get(AssemblerBlock.UPPER)) {
                        if (world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof AssemblerBlockEntity asm) {
                            String rid = asm.getRecipeId();
                            if (!rid.isEmpty()) {
                                FactorioRecipes.Recipe rec = FactorioRecipes.getById(rid);
                                if (rec != null) {
                                    badgesToRender.add(new AltBadge(
                                            pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 1.25, pos.getZ() + 0.5,
                                            1.75, rec.output(), 0.65f
                                    ));
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof FactorioChestBlock && world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof FactorioChestBlockEntity chest) {
                        List<ItemStack> top = chest.getSortedContentSummary(1);
                        if (!top.isEmpty()) {
                            badgesToRender.add(new AltBadge(
                                    pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.55, pos.getZ() + 0.5,

                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlock && state.get(FactorioFurnaceBlock.PART) == 0 && !state.get(FactorioFurnaceBlock.UPPER)) {

                            ItemStack icon = furnace.getStack(2);
                            if (icon.isEmpty() && !furnace.getStack(0).isEmpty()) {

                            }
                            if (!icon.isEmpty()) {
                                Direction f = state.get(FactorioFurnaceBlock.FACING);
                                Direction r = f.rotateYClockwise();
                                double cx = pos.getX() + 0.5 + (f.getOffsetX() + r.getOffsetX()) * 0.5;
                                double cz = pos.getZ() + 0.5 + (f.getOffsetZ() + r.getOffsetZ()) * 0.5;
                                badgesToRender.add(new AltBadge(cx, pos.getY() + 1.15, cz, 1.25, icon, 0.62f));

                        BlockPos outPos = BurnerDrillBlock.getPartPos(pos, f, 3, false).offset(f);
                        drawYellowOutputArrow(matrices, lines, cam, outPos, f);

                        if (world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof BurnerDrillBlockEntity drill) {
                            ItemStack ore = drill.findResourceUnderneath(world, pos, f);
                            if (!ore.isEmpty()) {
                                Direction r = f.rotateYClockwise();
                                double cx = pos.getX() + 0.5 + (f.getOffsetX() + r.getOffsetX()) * 0.5;
                                double cz = pos.getZ() + 0.5 + (f.getOffsetZ() + r.getOffsetZ()) * 0.5;
                                badgesToRender.add(new AltBadge(cx, pos.getY() + 1.20, cz, 1.35, ore, 0.60f));
                            }
                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof ElectricDrillBlock && state.get(ElectricDrillBlock.PART) == 4 && !state.get(ElectricDrillBlock.UPPER)) {
                        Direction f = state.get(ElectricDrillBlock.FACING);
                        BlockPos outPos = pos.offset(f, 2);
                        drawYellowOutputArrow(matrices, lines, cam, outPos, f);

                        ItemStack ore = findOreUnderElectricDrill(world, pos);
                        if (!ore.isEmpty()) {
                            badgesToRender.add(new AltBadge(
                                    pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 1.35, pos.getZ() + 0.5,
                                    1.70, ore, 0.65f
                            ));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // ÐžÑ‚Ñ€Ð¸ÑÐ¾Ð²ÐºÐ° Ð²ÑÐµÑ… ÑÐ¾Ð±Ñ€Ð°Ð½Ð½Ñ‹Ñ… 2D-Ð±ÐµÐ¹Ð´Ð¶ÐµÐ¹
        for (AltBadge badge : badgesToRender) {
            renderFactorioAltBadge(
                    client, context, matrices, consumers, cam,
                    badge.wx(), badge.wy(), badge.wz(),
                    badge.pullTowardsCam(), badge.icon(), badge.scale()
            );
        }
    }

    private static ItemStack findOreUnderElectricDrill(World world, BlockPos centerPos) {
        for (int dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -2; dz <= 2; dz++) {
                Block b = world.getBlockState(centerPos.add(dx, -1, dz)).getBlock();
                if (b instanceof ResourceOreBlock) {
                    return new ItemStack(b.asItem());
                }
            }
        }
        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
    }

    private static void drawInserterOverlay(MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumer lines, Vec3d cam,
                                            BlockPos pos, Direction facing, int reach) {
        int col = FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.altArrowColor;
        float r = FactorioConfig.getRed(col);
        float g = FactorioConfig.getGreen(col);
        float b = FactorioConfig.getBlue(col);

        double y = pos.getY() + 0.22 - cam.y;
        double cx = pos.getX() + 0.5 - cam.x;
        double cz = pos.getZ() + 0.5 - cam.z;

        double fx = facing.getOffsetX();
        double fz = facing.getOffsetZ();
        double px = -fz;
        double pz = fx;

        // Ð›Ð¸Ð½Ð¸Ñ Ð·Ð°Ñ…Ð²Ð°Ñ‚Ð° Ð¿Ð¾Ð·Ð°Ð´Ð¸ Ð¼Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ð¿ÑƒÐ»ÑÑ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ð° (Ð¿ÐµÑ€Ð¿ÐµÐ½Ð´Ð¸ÐºÑƒÐ»ÑÑ€Ð½Ð°Ñ Ð·Ð°ÑÐµÑ‡ÐºÐ° ÐºÐ°Ðº Ð² Factorio)
        double backX = cx - fx * (reach - 0.15);
        double backZ = cz - fz * (reach - 0.15);
        drawLine(matrices, lines, backX - px * 0.25, y, backZ - pz * 0.25, backX + px * 0.25, y, backZ + pz * 0.25, r, g, b, 0.95f);

        // Ð¡Ñ‚Ñ€ÐµÐ»ÐºÐ° Ð²Ñ‹Ð³Ñ€ÑƒÐ·ÐºÐ¸ Ð²Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸ Ð¼Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ð¿ÑƒÐ»ÑÑ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ð°
        double frontX = cx + fx * (reach - 0.10);
        double frontZ = cz + fz * (reach - 0.10);
        drawLine(matrices, lines, backX, y, backZ, frontX, y, frontZ, r, g, b, 0.90f);
        drawLine(matrices, lines, frontX, y, frontZ, frontX - fx * 0.22 + px * 0.18, y, frontZ - fz * 0.22 + pz * 0.18, r, g, b, 0.95f);
        drawLine(matrices, lines, frontX, y, frontZ, frontX - fx * 0.22 - px * 0.18, y, frontZ - fz * 0.22 - pz * 0.18, r, g, b, 0.95f);
    }

    private static void drawYellowOutputArrow(MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumer lines, Vec3d cam,
                                              BlockPos outPos, Direction facing) {
        int col = FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.altArrowColor;
        float r = FactorioConfig.getRed(col);
        float g = FactorioConfig.getGreen(col);
        float b = FactorioConfig.getBlue(col);

        double cx = outPos.getX() + 0.5 - cam.x;
        double y = outPos.getY() + 0.25 - cam.y;
        double cz = outPos.getZ() + 0.5 - cam.z;

        double fx = facing.getOffsetX();
        double fz = facing.getOffsetZ();
        double px = -fz;
        double pz = fx;

        double tailX = cx - fx * 0.30;
        double tailZ = cz - fz * 0.30;
        double tipX = cx + fx * 0.25;
        double tipZ = cz + fz * 0.25;

        drawLine(matrices, lines, tailX, y, tailZ, tipX, y, tipZ, r, g, b, 0.95f);
        drawLine(matrices, lines, tipX, y, tipZ, tipX - fx * 0.24 + px * 0.20, y, tipZ - fz * 0.24 + pz * 0.20, r, g, b, 0.95f);
        drawLine(matrices, lines, tipX, y, tipZ, tipX - fx * 0.24 - px * 0.20, y, tipZ - fz * 0.24 - pz * 0.20, r, g, b, 0.95f);
    }

    private static void drawFluidPortArrow(MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumer lines, Vec3d cam,
                                           BlockPos portPos, Direction flowDir, float r, float g, float b) {
        double cx = portPos.getX() + 0.5 - cam.x;
        double y = portPos.getY() + 0.45 - cam.y;
        double cz = portPos.getZ() + 0.5 - cam.z;

        double fx = flowDir.getOffsetX();
        double fz = flowDir.getOffsetZ();
        double px = -fz;
        double pz = fx;

        double tailX = cx - fx * 0.28;
        double tailZ = cz - fz * 0.28;
        double tipX = cx + fx * 0.28;
        double tipZ = cz + fz * 0.28;

        drawLine(matrices, lines, tailX, y, tailZ, tipX, y, tipZ, r, g, b, 0.95f);
        drawLine(matrices, lines, tipX, y, tipZ, tipX - fx * 0.22 + px * 0.18, y, tipZ - fz * 0.22 + pz * 0.18, r, g, b, 0.95f);
        drawLine(matrices, lines, tipX, y, tipZ, tipX - fx * 0.22 - px * 0.18, y, tipZ - fz * 0.22 - pz * 0.18, r, g, b, 0.95f);
    }

    private static void drawLine(MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumer lines,
                                 double x1, double y1, double z1,
                                 double x2, double y2, double z2,
                                 float r, float g, float b, float a) {
        MatrixStack.Entry entry = matrices.peek();
        float dx = (float) (x2 - x1);
        float dy = (float) (y2 - y1);
        float dz = (float) (z2 - z1);
        float len = (float) Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
        if (len > 1.0e-4f) {
            dx /= len;
            dy /= len;
            dz /= len;
        } else {
            dx = 0.0f;
            dy = 1.0f;
            dz = 0.0f;
        }
        lines.vertex(entry, (float) x1, (float) y1, (float) z1).color(r, g, b, a).normal(entry, dx, dy, dz);
        lines.vertex(entry, (float) x2, (float) y2, (float) z2).color(r, g, b, a).normal(entry, dx, dy, dz);
    }

    private static void renderFactorioAltBadge(MinecraftClient client, WorldRenderContext context,
                                               MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumerProvider consumers,
                                               Vec3d cam, double wx, double wy, double wz,
                                               double pullTowardsCam, ItemStack icon, float scale) {
        if (icon.isEmpty()) return;

        Vec3d toCam = cam.subtract(wx, wy, wz);
        double dist = toCam.length();
        if (dist > 1.0e-3) {
            double shift = Math.min(pullTowardsCam, dist * 0.65);
            Vec3d dir = toCam.normalize().multiply(shift);
            wx += dir.x;
            wy += dir.y;
            wz += dir.z;
        }

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(wx - cam.x, wy - cam.y, wz - cam.z);
        matrices.multiply(context.camera().getRotation());
        matrices.scale(scale, scale, 0.02f);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(180.0f));

        client.getItemRenderer().renderItem(
                icon,
                ModelTransformationMode.GUI,
                LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE,
                OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV,
                matrices,
                consumers,
                client.world,
                0
        );

        matrices.pop();
    }
}
