    public static void register() {
        toggleMapKey = KeyBindingHelper.registerKeyBinding(new KeyBinding("key.factoriocore.toggle_minimap", InputUtil.Type.KEYSYM, GLFW.GLFW_KEY_M, "category.factoriocore"));
        zoomInKey = KeyBindingHelper.registerKeyBinding(new KeyBinding("key.factoriocore.minimap_zoom_in", InputUtil.Type.KEYSYM, GLFW.GLFW_KEY_EQUAL, "category.factoriocore"));
        zoomOutKey = KeyBindingHelper.registerKeyBinding(new KeyBinding("key.factoriocore.minimap_zoom_out", InputUtil.Type.KEYSYM, GLFW.GLFW_KEY_MINUS, "category.factoriocore"));

        ClientTickEvents.END_CLIENT_TICK.register(client -> {
            while (toggleMapKey.wasPressed()) minimapVisible = !minimapVisible;
            while (zoomInKey.wasPressed()) if (blocksPerCell > 1) blocksPerCell /= 2;
            while (zoomOutKey.wasPressed()) if (blocksPerCell < 4) blocksPerCell *= 2;

            if (client.world != null && client.player != null && !client.isPaused()) {
                if (minimapVisible && FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.enableMinimap) {
                    updateMapSlice(client.world, client.player, nextSliceRow, nextSliceRow + 11);
                    nextSliceRow = (nextSliceRow + 11) % MAP_CELLS;
                    if ((client.world.getTime() & 7L) == 0L) updateRadarEntities(client.world, client.player);
                }
                tickMiningProgressBar(client);
            }
        });

        HudRenderCallback.EVENT.register(FactorioHudOverlay::renderHud);
    }

    private static void tickMiningProgressBar(MinecraftClient client) {
        if (client.player == null || client.world == null || client.player.isCreative() || client.interactionManager == null) {
            prevMiningProgress = 0.0f;
            miningBarProgress = 0.0f;
            lastMiningPos = null;
            return;
        }

        if (client.options.attackKey.isPressed() && client.interactionManager.isBreakingBlock()
                && client.crosshairTarget instanceof BlockHitResult hit && hit.getType() == HitResult.Type.BLOCK) {
            BlockPos pos = hit.getBlockPos();
            BlockState state = client.world.getBlockState(pos);
            Block block = state.getBlock();

            if (BlockHealthManager.getMaxHealth(block) > 0 || block instanceof ResourceOreBlock || block instanceof PavementBlock) {
                int currentOre = -1;
                if (block instanceof ResourceOreBlock && client.world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof ResourceOreBlockEntity oreBe) {
                    currentOre = oreBe.getOrInitAmount();
                }

                if (!pos.equals(lastMiningPos) || (currentOre != -1 && lastSeenOreAmount != -1 && currentOre != lastSeenOreAmount)) {
                    lastMiningPos = pos.toImmutable();
                    lastSeenOreAmount = currentOre;
                    prevMiningProgress = 0.0f;
                    miningBarProgress = 0.0f;
                }
                lastSeenOreAmount = currentOre;

                prevMiningProgress = miningBarProgress;
                float delta = state.calcBlockBreakingDelta(client.player, client.world, pos);
                miningBarProgress += delta;
                if (miningBarProgress >= 1.0f) {
                    miningBarProgress = (block instanceof ResourceOreBlock) ? 0.0f : 1.0f;
                    prevMiningProgress = miningBarProgress;
                }
                return;
            }
        }

        prevMiningProgress = 0.0f;
        miningBarProgress = 0.0f;
        lastMiningPos = null;
        lastSeenOreAmount = -1;
    }

    private static void updateRadarEntities(World world, PlayerEntity player) {
        cachedRadarBlips.clear();
        int radiusBlocks = (MAP_CELLS / 2) * blocksPerCell;
        Box radarBox = player.getBoundingBox().expand(radiusBlocks, 24.0, radiusBlocks);
        List<Entity> entities = world.getOtherEntities(player, radarBox);

        for (Entity ent : entities) {
            int color = 0;
            if (ent instanceof Monster) color = 0xFFFF2222;
            else if (ent instanceof PlayerEntity) color = 0xFF44FF44;

            if (color != 0) {
                double dx = (ent.getX() - player.getX()) / blocksPerCell;
                double dz = (ent.getZ() - player.getZ()) / blocksPerCell;
                int ox = MathHelper.floor(dx * PIXEL_SCALE);
                int oz = MathHelper.floor(dz * PIXEL_SCALE);
                cachedRadarBlips.add(new RadarBlip(ox, oz, color));
            }
        }
    }

    private static void renderHud(DrawContext context, RenderTickCounter tickCounter) {
        MinecraftClient client = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        if (client.player == null || client.world == null || client.options.hudHidden || client.getDebugHud().shouldShowDebugHud()) {
            return;
        }

        int screenW = context.getScaledWindowWidth();
        int nextPanelY = 6;

        if (minimapVisible && FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.enableMinimap) {
            float mapScale = MathHelper.clamp(FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.minimapScale, 0.5f, 2.0f);
            context.getMatrices().push();
            context.getMatrices().translate(screenW, 0, 0);
            context.getMatrices().scale(mapScale, mapScale, 1.0f);
            context.getMatrices().translate(-screenW, 0, 0);

            int frameSize = MAP_SIZE_PX + 6;
            int x = screenW - frameSize - 6;
            int y = 6;

            context.fill(x, y, x + frameSize, y + frameSize, 0xFF141414);
            context.fill(x + 1, y + 1, x + frameSize - 1, y + frameSize - 1, 0xFF313234);

            int mapX = x + 3;
            int mapY = y + 3;
            context.fill(mapX - 1, mapY - 1, mapX + MAP_SIZE_PX + 1, mapY + MAP_SIZE_PX + 1, 0xFF141414);

            for (int gz = 0; gz < MAP_CELLS; gz++) {
                int drawY = mapY + gz * PIXEL_SCALE;
                int rowOffset = gz * MAP_CELLS;
                for (int gx = 0; gx < MAP_CELLS; gx++) {
                    int drawX = mapX + gx * PIXEL_SCALE;
                    context.fill(drawX, drawY, drawX + PIXEL_SCALE, drawY + PIXEL_SCALE, colorBuffer[rowOffset + gx]);
                }
            }

            int centerPxX = mapX + MAP_SIZE_PX / 2;
            int centerPxY = mapY + MAP_SIZE_PX / 2;

            PollutionClientRenderer.renderMinimapPollutionOverlay(context, centerPxX, centerPxY, MAP_SIZE_PX / 2, (float) blocksPerCell / PIXEL_SCALE);


            for (RadarBlip blip : cachedRadarBlips) {
                int ex = centerPxX + blip.offsetX();
                int ez = centerPxY + blip.offsetZ();
                if (ex >= mapX + 2 && ex < mapX + MAP_SIZE_PX - 2 && ez >= mapY + 2 && ez < mapY + MAP_SIZE_PX - 2) {
                    context.fill(ex - 1, ez - 1, ex + 2, ez + 2, blip.color());
                }
            }

            drawPlayerMarker(context, centerPxX, centerPxY, client.player.getYaw());
            if (AltModeRenderer.isAltModeActive()) {
                context.fill(x - 28, y, x - 2, y + 14, 0xEE141414);
                context.fill(x - 27, y + 1, x - 3, y + 13, 0xEEAC6E14);
                context.drawText(client.textRenderer, "ALT", x - 23, y + 3, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);
            }
            context.getMatrices().pop();
            nextPanelY = (int)(6 + (frameSize + 4) * mapScale);
        }

        if (FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.enableTargetInfoPanel) {
            float infoScale = MathHelper.clamp(FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.infoPanelScale, 0.5f, 2.0f);
            context.getMatrices().push();
            context.getMatrices().translate(screenW, nextPanelY, 0);
            context.getMatrices().scale(infoScale, infoScale, 1.0f);
            context.getMatrices().translate(-screenW, -nextPanelY, 0);

            renderTargetInfoPanel(context, client, screenW, nextPanelY);

            context.getMatrices().pop();
        }

        if (FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.enableCraftingQueueHud) {
            ClientCraftingQueueHud.renderBottomLeftQueue(context, false);
        }
        renderMiningProgressBar(context, tickCounter.getTickDelta(false));
    }

    private static class InfoSection {
        String title;
        int iconColor;
        List<Text> lines = new ArrayList<>();
        InfoSection(String t, int c) { title = t; iconColor = c; }
    }

    private static void renderTargetInfoPanel(DrawContext context, MinecraftClient client, int screenW, int topY) {
        if (!(client.crosshairTarget instanceof BlockHitResult hit) || hit.getType() != HitResult.Type.BLOCK) {
            return;
        }
        World world = client.world;
        if (world == null) return;

        BlockPos rawPos = hit.getBlockPos();
        BlockState rawState = world.getBlockState(rawPos);
        if (rawState.isAir()) return;

        BlockPos pos = BlockHealthManager.getCanonicalPos(rawPos, rawState);
        BlockState state = world.getBlockState(pos);
        Block block = state.getBlock();

        int maxHp = BlockHealthManager.getMaxHealth(block);
        boolean isFactorioOre = block instanceof ResourceOreBlock;

        if (maxHp <= 0 && !isFactorioOre) {
            return;
        }

        Text title = block.getName();
        TextRenderer tr = client.textRenderer;
        FactorioConfig cfg = FactorioConfig.INSTANCE;

        List<InfoSection> sections = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Text> headerLines = new ArrayList<>();
        BlockEntity be = world.getBlockEntity(pos);

        // --- 1. ÐžÐ¿Ð¸ÑÐ°Ð½Ð¸Ðµ ---
        if (cfg.showInfoDescription) {
            String descKey = block.getTranslationKey() + ".desc";
            String desc = Text.translatable(descKey).getString();
            if (!desc.equals(descKey)) {
                String[] words = desc.split(" ");
                StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
                for (String word : words) {
                    if (tr.getWidth(sb.toString() + word) > 180) {
                        headerLines.add(Text.literal(sb.toString()).formatted(Formatting.GRAY));
                        sb = new StringBuilder();
                    }
                    sb.append(word).append(" ");
                }
                if (sb.length() > 0) {
                    headerLines.add(Text.literal(sb.toString()).formatted(Formatting.GRAY));
                }
            }
        }

        // --- 2. Ð¡Ñ‚Ð°Ñ‚ÑƒÑ (Ð¸ Ñ€ÑƒÐ´Ð°) ---
        if (cfg.showInfoStatus) {
            if (block instanceof ResourceOreBlock oreBlock) {
                int amount = ResourceOreBlockEntity.getClientDisplayAmount(world, pos, oreBlock.getOreType());
                headerLines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.expected_resources",
                                Text.literal(String.valueOf(amount)).formatted(Formatting.YELLOW))
                        .formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
            } else if (be != null) {
                boolean isWorking = false;
                boolean noFuel = false;
                boolean noPower = false;

                if (be instanceof ElectricDrillBlockEntity eDrill) {
                    isWorking = eDrill.isPowered();
                    noPower = !isWorking;
                } else if (be instanceof BoilerBlockEntity boiler) {
                    isWorking = boiler.isBurning();
                    noFuel = !isWorking && boiler.getStack(0).isEmpty();
                } else if (be instanceof BurnerDrillBlockEntity drill) {
                    isWorking = drill.getClientDrillRotation(0.0f) > 0.0f || !drill.getFuelStack().isEmpty();
                    noFuel = !isWorking;
                } else if (be instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity furnace) {
                    isWorking = furnace.isBurning();
                    noFuel = !isWorking && furnace.getStack(1).isEmpty();
                } else if (be instanceof InserterBlockEntity ins) {
                    boolean isBurner = block instanceof BurnerInserterBlock;
                    isWorking = !ins.getHeldStack().isEmpty() || ins.getArmProgress(0.0f) > 0.01f;
                    boolean powered = isBurner || PowerNetworkManager.isMachinePowered(world, pos);
                    noPower = !isBurner && !powered;
                    noFuel = isBurner && ins.getFuelStack().isEmpty();
                } else if (be instanceof com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.research.LabBlockEntity lab) {
                    isWorking = lab.isWorking();
                    noPower = !lab.isPowered();
                } else if (be instanceof AssemblerBlockEntity asm) {
                    isWorking = asm.isWorking();
                    noPower = !asm.isPowered();
                } else if (block instanceof com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.electricity.ElectricPoleBlock) {
                    isWorking = PowerNetworkManager.isPoleEnergized(world, pos);
                    noPower = !isWorking;
                }

                if (noPower) {
                    headerLines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.status_no_power").formatted(Formatting.RED));
                } else if (noFuel) {
                    headerLines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.status_no_fuel").formatted(Formatting.RED));
                } else if (isWorking) {
                    headerLines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.status_working").formatted(Formatting.GREEN));
                } else {
                    headerLines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.status_waiting").formatted(Formatting.YELLOW));
                }
            }
        }

        // --- 3. Ð–Ð¸Ð´ÐºÐ¾ÑÑ‚Ð¸ ---
        if (cfg.showInfoFluids && be instanceof BoilerBlockEntity boiler) {
            InfoSection waterSec = new InfoSection(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.consumes_water").getString(), 0x33CCFF);
            waterSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.water_line", boiler.getWaterMb()).formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
            waterSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.temperature", "15 Â°C").formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
            sections.add(waterSec);

            InfoSection steamSec = new InfoSection(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.produces_steam").getString(), 0xDDDDDD);
            steamSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.temperature", "165 Â°C").formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
            sections.add(steamSec);
        } else if (cfg.showInfoFluids && be instanceof SteamEngineBlockEntity engine) {
            InfoSection steamSec = new InfoSection(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.consumes_steam").getString(), 0xDDDDDD);
            steamSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.steam_line", engine.getFluidAmount()).formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
            steamSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.max_temperature", "165 Â°C").formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
            sections.add(steamSec);
        }

        // --- 4. Ð­Ð»ÐµÐºÑ‚Ñ€Ð¸Ñ‡ÐµÑÑ‚Ð²Ð¾ / Ð¢Ð¾Ð¿Ð»Ð¸Ð²Ð¾ ---
        if (cfg.showInfoElectricity) {
            if (block instanceof ElectricDrillBlock) {
                InfoSection elecSec = new InfoSection(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.consumes_electricity").getString(), 0xFFD700);
                elecSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.max_consumption", PowerNetworkManager.formatWatts(90_000L)).formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
                sections.add(elecSec);
            } else if (be instanceof com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.research.LabBlockEntity) {
                InfoSection elecSec = new InfoSection(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.consumes_electricity").getString(), 0xFFD700);
                elecSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.max_consumption", PowerNetworkManager.formatWatts(60_000L)).formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
                sections.add(elecSec);
            } else if (be instanceof AssemblerBlockEntity) {
                InfoSection elecSec = new InfoSection(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.consumes_electricity").getString(), 0xFFD700);
                elecSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.max_consumption", PowerNetworkManager.formatWatts(75_000L)).formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
                sections.add(elecSec);
            } else if (be instanceof SteamEngineBlockEntity engine) {
                InfoSection elecSec = new InfoSection(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.produces_electricity").getString(), 0xFFD700);
                String kw = PowerNetworkManager.formatWatts(engine.isGeneratingPower() ? 900_000L : 0L);
                String maxKw = PowerNetworkManager.formatWatts(900_000L);
                elecSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.energy_production", kw + " / " + maxKw).formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
                sections.add(elecSec);
            } else if (be instanceof BoilerBlockEntity) {
                InfoSection fuelSec = new InfoSection(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.consumes_fuel").getString(), 0xFF8C00);
                fuelSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.max_consumption", PowerNetworkManager.formatWatts(1_800_000L)).formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
                sections.add(fuelSec);
            } else if (be instanceof InserterBlockEntity ins && !(block instanceof BurnerInserterBlock)) {
                InfoSection elecSec = new InfoSection(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.consumes_electricity").getString(), 0xFFD700);
                boolean active = !ins.getHeldStack().isEmpty() || ins.getArmProgress(0.0f) > 0.01f;
                String usage = PowerNetworkManager.formatWatts(active ? 13_000L : 400L);
                elecSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.consumption", usage).formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
                sections.add(elecSec);
            } else if (block instanceof com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.electricity.CreativeEnergySourceBlock) {
                InfoSection elecSec = new InfoSection(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.produces_electricity").getString(), 0xFFD700);
                elecSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.energy_production", PowerNetworkManager.formatWatts(500_000_000L)).formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
                sections.add(elecSec);
            }
        }

        // --- 5. Ð¡ÑƒÐ½Ð´ÑƒÐºÐ¸ ---
        List<ItemStack> chestTopItems = Collections.emptyList();
        if (block instanceof FactorioChestBlock && be instanceof FactorioChestBlockEntity chest) {
            chestTopItems = chest.getSortedContentSummary(4);
            if (chest.getUnlockedSlots() < chest.getTotalSlots()) {
                headerLines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.slots_available",
                                Text.literal(chest.getUnlockedSlots() + " / " + chest.getTotalSlots()).formatted(Formatting.RED))
                        .formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
            }
        }

        int panelW = Math.max(160, tr.getWidth(title) + 40);
        for (Text line : headerLines) panelW = Math.max(panelW, tr.getWidth(line) + 16);
        for (InfoSection sec : sections) {
            panelW = Math.max(panelW, tr.getWidth(sec.title) + 24);
            for (Text line : sec.lines) panelW = Math.max(panelW, tr.getWidth(line) + 16);
        }
        if (!chestTopItems.isEmpty()) panelW = Math.max(panelW, chestTopItems.size() * 20 + 16);

        int hpBarH = (cfg.showInfoHealth && maxHp > 0) ? 14 : 0;
        int chestIconsH = chestTopItems.isEmpty() ? 0 : 22;
        int panelH = 26 + headerLines.size() * 11 + hpBarH + chestIconsH + 4;
        for (InfoSection sec : sections) {
            panelH += 18 + sec.lines.size() * 11 + 4;
        }

        int x = screenW - panelW - 6;
        int y = topY;

        context.fill(x, y, x + panelW, y + panelH, 0xFA1E1E1E);
        context.fill(x + 1, y + 1, x + panelW - 1, y + panelH - 1, 0xFA2C2C2C);
        context.fill(x + 2, y + 2, x + panelW - 2, y + 22, 0xFFE2C899);
        context.fill(x + 2, y + 22, x + panelW - 2, y + 24, 0xFF000000);

        ItemStack iconStack = new ItemStack(block.asItem());
        if (!iconStack.isEmpty()) {
            context.drawItem(iconStack, x + 4, y + 4);
        }
        context.drawText(tr, title, x + 24, y + 8, 0xFF000000, false);

        int cursorY = y + 28;
        for (Text line : headerLines) {
            context.drawText(tr, line, x + 8, cursorY, 0xFFFFFFFF, false);
            cursorY += 11;
        }

        if (cfg.showInfoHealth && maxHp > 0) {
            int curHp = BlockHealthManager.getCurrentHealth(world, pos, state);
            float ratio = MathHelper.clamp(curHp / (float) maxHp, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            context.drawText(tr, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.health", curHp + "/" + maxHp).formatted(Formatting.WHITE), x + 8, cursorY, 0xFFFFFFFF, false);
            cursorY += 10;
            int barX = x + 8;
            int barW = panelW - 16;
            int barH = 4;
            context.fill(barX, cursorY, barX + barW, cursorY + barH, 0xFF141414);
            int fillW = Math.round(ratio * barW);
            int barColor = (ratio > 0.6f) ? 0xFF38B828 : (ratio > 0.3f ? 0xFFE59524 : 0xFFD93025);
            if (fillW > 0) context.fill(barX, cursorY, barX + fillW, cursorY + barH, barColor);
            cursorY += 8;
        }

        for (InfoSection sec : sections) {
            context.fill(x + 4, cursorY, x + panelW - 4, cursorY + 1, 0xFF444444);
            cursorY += 4;
            context.fill(x + 8, cursorY + 2, x + 12, cursorY + 6, 0xFF000000 | sec.iconColor);
            context.drawText(tr, Text.literal(sec.title).formatted(Formatting.YELLOW), x + 16, cursorY, 0xFFFFFFFF, false);
            cursorY += 12;
            context.fill(x + 4, cursorY, x + panelW - 4, cursorY + 1, 0xFF333333);
            cursorY += 4;
            for (Text line : sec.lines) {
                context.drawText(tr, line, x + 8, cursorY, 0xFFFFFFFF, false);
                cursorY += 11;
            }
        }

        if (!chestTopItems.isEmpty()) {
            cursorY += 2;
            int slotStartX = x + 8;
            for (int i = 0; i < chestTopItems.size(); i++) {
                ItemStack st = chestTopItems.get(i);
                int sx = slotStartX + i * 20;
                int sy = cursorY;
                context.fill(sx, sy, sx + 18, sy + 18, 0xFF141414);
                context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 1, sx + 17, sy + 17, 0xFF3A3C3E);
                context.drawItem(st, sx + 1, sy + 1);

                String cntStr = formatCompactCount(st.getCount());
                context.getMatrices().push();
                context.getMatrices().translate(0.0f, 0.0f, 200.0f);
                context.getMatrices().scale(0.65f, 0.65f, 1.0f);
                int tw = tr.getWidth(cntStr);
                int tx = (int) ((sx + 17) / 0.65f) - tw;
                int ty = (int) ((sy + 12) / 0.65f);
                context.drawText(tr, cntStr, tx, ty, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);
                context.getMatrices().pop();
            }
        }
    }

    private static String formatCompactCount(int count) {
        if (count >= 1000) return String.format("%.1fk", count / 1000.0f);
        return String.valueOf(count);
    }

    private static void renderMiningProgressBar(DrawContext context, float tickDelta) {
        if (miningBarProgress <= 0.0f && prevMiningProgress <= 0.0f) return;

        float smoothProgress = MathHelper.clamp(MathHelper.lerp(tickDelta, prevMiningProgress, miningBarProgress), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        int screenW = context.getScaledWindowWidth();
        int screenH = context.getScaledWindowHeight();
        int barW = 182;
        int barH = 5;
        int bx = (screenW - barW) / 2;
        int by = screenH - 54;

        context.fill(bx - 1, by - 1, bx + barW + 1, by + barH + 1, 0xEE141414);
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + barW, by + barH, 0xEE26272A);
        int fillW = Math.round(smoothProgress * barW);
        if (fillW > 0) {
            context.fill(bx, by, bx + fillW, by + barH, 0xFFE59524);
            context.fill(bx, by, bx + fillW, by + 2, 0xFFFFCC66);
        }
    }

    private static void drawPlayerMarker(DrawContext context, int cx, int cy, float yaw) {
        context.fill(cx - 2, cy - 2, cx + 3, cy + 3, 0xFF111111);
        context.fill(cx - 1, cy - 1, cx + 2, cy + 2, 0xFFFFCC00);

        double rad = Math.toRadians(yaw + 90.0f);
        int tipX = cx + (int) Math.round(Math.cos(rad) * 3.0);
        int tipY = cy + (int) Math.round(Math.sin(rad) * 3.0);
        context.fill(tipX - 1, tipY - 1, tipX + 1, tipY + 1, 0xFFFFFFFF);
    }

    private static void updateMapSlice(World world, PlayerEntity player, int startRow, int endRow) {
        int centerX = MathHelper.floor(player.getX());
        int centerZ = MathHelper.floor(player.getZ());
        int half = MAP_CELLS / 2;
        BlockPos.Mutable pos = new BlockPos.Mutable();

        int maxRow = Math.min(MAP_CELLS, endRow);
        for (int gz = startRow; gz < maxRow; gz++) {
            int wz = centerZ + (gz - half) * blocksPerCell;
            int rowOffset = gz * MAP_CELLS;

            for (int gx = 0; gx < MAP_CELLS; gx++) {
                int wx = centerX + (gx - half) * blocksPerCell;

                if (!world.isChunkLoaded(wx >> 4, wz >> 4)) {
                    colorBuffer[rowOffset + gx] = 0xFF18191B;
                    continue;
                }

                int topY = world.getTopY(Heightmap.Type.WORLD_SURFACE, wx, wz) - 1;
                if (topY < world.getBottomY()) {
                    colorBuffer[rowOffset + gx] = 0xFF18191B;
                    continue;
                }

                pos.set(wx, topY, wz);
                BlockState state = world.getBlockState(pos);
                if (state.isAir() && topY > world.getBottomY()) {
                    pos.set(wx, topY - 1, wz);
                    state = world.getBlockState(pos);
                }

                colorBuffer[rowOffset + gx] = resolveFactorioMapColor(world, pos, state);
            }
        }
    }

    private static int resolveFactorioMapColor(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        Block block = state.getBlock();

        if (block instanceof BeltBlock belt) {
            return switch (belt.getTier()) {
                case 2 -> 0xFFE53935;
                case 3 -> 0xFF29B6F6;
                default -> 0xFFFDD835;
            };
        }
        if (block instanceof com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.production.burner_drill.BurnerDrillBlock || block instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlock) return 0xFF42A5F5;
        if (block instanceof InserterBlock || block instanceof FactorioChestBlock) return 0xFFFFB300;

        if (block instanceof ResourceOreBlock ore) {
            return switch (ore.getOreType()) {
                case 0 -> 0xFF5B9BD5;
                case 1 -> 0xFFED7D31;
                case 2 -> 0xFF1A1A1D;
                default -> 0xFFD2C290;
            };
        }

        Block below = world.getBlockState(pos.down()).getBlock();
        if (below instanceof ResourceOreBlock oreBelow) {
            return switch (oreBelow.getOreType()) {
                case 0 -> 0xFF5B9BD5;
                case 1 -> 0xFFED7D31;
                case 2 -> 0xFF1A1A1D;
                default -> 0xFFD2C290;
            };
        }

        if (block instanceof PavementBlock) return 0xFF70757A;
        if (state.isOf(Blocks.WATER) || state.isOf(Blocks.SEAGRASS) || state.isOf(Blocks.LILY_PAD)) return 0xFF2471A3;
        if (pos.getY() >= 66 && (state.isOf(Blocks.DRIPSTONE_BLOCK) || state.isOf(Blocks.GRANITE) || state.isOf(Blocks.TUFF))) return 0xFF424949;

        MapColor mapColor = state.getMapColor(world, pos);
        if (mapColor == MapColor.CLEAR) {
            BlockState groundState = world.getBlockState(pos.down());
            mapColor = groundState.getMapColor(world, pos.down());
        }
        int rgb = mapColor.color;
        int r = (rgb >> 16) & 0xFF;
        int g = (rgb >> 8) & 0xFF;
        int b = rgb & 0xFF;
        return 0xFF000000 | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
    }
}

    private void rebuildMapPreview() {
        previewDirty = false;
        int half = MAP_GRID / 2;

        for (int gz = 0; gz < MAP_GRID; gz++) {
            int wz = (int) Math.round(mapCenterZ + (gz - half) * blocksPerCell);
            for (int gx = 0; gx < MAP_GRID; gx++) {
                int wx = (int) Math.round(mapCenterX + (gx - half) * blocksPerCell);
                previewColors[gz * MAP_GRID + gx] = sampleMapColorAt(wx, wz);
            }
        }
    }

    private int sampleMapColorAt(int x, int z) {
        double elev = NauvisChunkGenerator.evaluateElevation(x, z);
        if (elev < 0.0) {
            return (elev > -0.09) ? 0xFF2980B9 : 0xFF1A5276;
        }

        if (NauvisChunkGenerator.evaluateCliffHeight(x, z, elev) > 0) {
            return 0xFF3E444A;
        }

        BlockState ore = NauvisChunkGenerator.evaluateOrePatch(x, z, elev);
        if (ore != null && ore.getBlock() instanceof ResourceOreBlock oreBlock) {
            return switch (oreBlock.getOreType()) {
                case 0 -> 0xFF5B9BD5; // Ð–ÐµÐ»ÐµÐ·Ð¾
                case 1 -> 0xFFED7D31; // ÐœÐµÐ´ÑŒ
                case 2 -> 0xFF161618; // Ð£Ð³Ð¾Ð»ÑŒ
                default -> 0xFFD2C290; // ÐšÐ°Ð¼ÐµÐ½ÑŒ
            };
        }

        if (NauvisChunkGenerator.hasForestAt(x, z, elev)) {
            return 0xFF1E4D20;
        }

        NauvisChunkGenerator.NauvisBiome biome = NauvisChunkGenerator.getBiomeAt(x, z);
        return switch (biome) {
            case LUSH_GRASS -> 0xFF3B6E28;
            case DRY_GRASS -> 0xFF4F772D;
            case DRY_DIRT -> 0xFF6E4E37;
            case SAND_DESERT -> 0xFFC5A878;
            case RED_DESERT -> 0xFF8C4A32;
        };
    }

    @Override

        context.fill(x + 8, y + 22, x + 204, y + 36, 0xFF18181A);

        drawFactorioButton(context, x + 258, y + 22, 46, 14, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.reset").getString(), mouseX, mouseY, false);

        drawFactorioButton(context, x + 8, y + 40, 144, 15, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.tab.resources").getString(), mouseX, mouseY, currentTab == 0);
        drawFactorioButton(context, x + 156, y + 40, 148, 15, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.tab.terrain").getString(), mouseX, mouseY, currentTab == 1);

        int leftBoxX = x + 8;

        context.fill(leftBoxX + 1, leftBoxY + 1, leftBoxX + leftBoxW - 1, leftBoxY + leftBoxH - 1, 0xFF28292C);

        drawLegendItem(context, mapX + 96, legY, 0xFF161618, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.coal_short").getString());
        drawLegendItem(context, mapX + 148, legY, 0xFFD2C290, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.stone_short").getString());

        drawFactorioButton(context, x + panelW - 126, y + panelH - 23, 118, 17, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.done").getString(), mouseX, mouseY, true);

    private void drawLegendItem(DrawContext context, int lx, int ly, int color, String name) {
        context.fill(lx, ly + 1, lx + 7, ly + 8, 0xFF111111);
        context.fill(lx + 1, ly + 2, lx + 6, ly + 7, color);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, name, lx + 9, ly, 0xFFD0D0D0, false);
    }

    private void drawSliderRow(DrawContext context, SliderRow row, int rx, int ry) {
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, row.label, rx, ry + 1, row.color, false);
        int sliderX = rx + 172;
        int sliderW = 72;
        context.fill(sliderX, ry + 4, sliderX + sliderW, ry + 7, 0xFF141414);

        float val = row.getter.get();
        float ratio = MathHelper.clamp((val - row.min) / (row.max - row.min), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        int knobX = sliderX + Math.round(ratio * (sliderW - 6));
        context.fill(knobX, ry + 1, knobX + 6, ry + 10, 0xFF111111);
        context.fill(knobX + 1, ry + 2, knobX + 5, ry + 9, 0xFFE59524);

        String valStr = row.signedPercent
                ? String.format("%+d%%", Math.round(val * 200.0f))
                : String.format("%d%%", Math.round(val * 100.0f));
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, valStr, sliderX + sliderW + 5, ry + 1, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);
    }

    private void drawFactorioButton(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw, int bh,
                                    String label, int mouseX, int mouseY, boolean highlighted) {
        boolean hovered = mouseX >= bx && mouseX <= bx + bw && mouseY >= by && mouseY <= by + bh;
        int bg = highlighted ? 0xFFD4881E : (hovered ? 0xFF4A4C50 : 0xFF383A3D);
        int textCol = highlighted ? 0xFF141414 : 0xFFEAEAEA;

        context.fill(bx, by, bx + bw, by + bh, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + bw - 1, by + bh - 1, bg);
        int tw = this.textRenderer.getWidth(label);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, label, bx + (bw - tw) / 2, by + (bh - 8) / 2, textCol, false);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        int panelW = 510;
        int panelH = 256;
        int x = (this.width - panelW) / 2;
        int y = (this.height - panelH) / 2;

        int mapX = x + 310;
        int mapY = y + 22;
        int mapSize = MAP_GRID * MAP_PIXEL_SIZE;
        if (mouseX >= mapX && mouseX <= mapX + mapSize && mouseY >= mapY && mouseY <= mapY + mapSize) {
            if (button == 1) {
                this.mapCenterX = 0.0;
                this.mapCenterZ = 0.0;
                this.previewDirty = true;
            } else {
                this.draggingMap = true;
            }
            return true;
        }

        if (button == 0) {
            if (isInside(mouseX, mouseY, x + 208, y + 22, 46, 14)) {
                NauvisConfig.ACTIVE.randomizeSeed();
                pushSeedToParent();
                this.previewDirty = true;
                return true;
            }
            if (isInside(mouseX, mouseY, x + 258, y + 22, 46, 14)) {
                NauvisConfig.ACTIVE.resetDefaults();
                customConfigTouched = true;
                this.previewDirty = true;
                return true;
            }
            if (isInside(mouseX, mouseY, x + 8, y + 40, 144, 15)) {
                this.currentTab = 0;
                return true;
            }
            if (isInside(mouseX, mouseY, x + 156, y + 40, 148, 15)) {
                this.currentTab = 1;
                return true;
            }
            if (isInside(mouseX, mouseY, x + panelW - 126, y + panelH - 23, 118, 17)) {
                pushSeedToParent();
                this.close();
                return true;
            }

            List<SliderRow> activeList = (currentTab == 0) ? resourceSliders : terrainSliders;
            int rowStep = (currentTab == 0) ? 13 : 20;
            int startY = y + 57 + 6;
            int sliderX = x + 8 + 6 + 172;
            int sliderW = 72;

            for (int i = 0; i < activeList.size(); i++) {
                int ry = startY + i * rowStep;
                if (mouseX >= sliderX - 4 && mouseX <= sliderX + sliderW + 4 && mouseY >= ry && mouseY <= ry + 12) {
                    this.activeDraggingSlider = activeList.get(i);
                    updateSliderValueFromMouse(this.activeDraggingSlider, mouseX, sliderX, sliderW);
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    private void updateSliderValueFromMouse(SliderRow row, double mouseX, int sliderX, int sliderW) {
        float ratio = MathHelper.clamp((float) (mouseX - sliderX) / (float) sliderW, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        float rawVal = row.min + ratio * (row.max - row.min);
        float stepped = Math.round(rawVal * 20.0f) / 20.0f;
        row.setter.accept(MathHelper.clamp(stepped, row.min, row.max));
        customConfigTouched = true;
        this.previewDirty = true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.draggingMap) {
            this.mapCenterX -= (deltaX / MAP_PIXEL_SIZE) * blocksPerCell;
            this.mapCenterZ -= (deltaY / MAP_PIXEL_SIZE) * blocksPerCell;
            this.previewDirty = true;
            return true;
        }
        if (this.activeDraggingSlider != null && button == 0) {
            int panelW = 510;
            int x = (this.width - panelW) / 2;
            int sliderX = x + 8 + 6 + 172;
            updateSliderValueFromMouse(this.activeDraggingSlider, mouseX, sliderX, 72);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        this.draggingMap = false;
        this.activeDraggingSlider = null;
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        int panelW = 510;
        int panelH = 256;
        int x = (this.width - panelW) / 2;
        int y = (this.height - panelH) / 2;
        int mapX = x + 310;
        int mapY = y + 22;
        int mapSize = MAP_GRID * MAP_PIXEL_SIZE;

        if (mouseX >= mapX && mouseX <= mapX + mapSize && mouseY >= mapY && mouseY <= mapY + mapSize) {
            if (verticalAmount > 0) {
                this.blocksPerCell = Math.max(1.0, this.blocksPerCell - 1.0);
            } else if (verticalAmount < 0) {
                this.blocksPerCell = Math.min(16.0, this.blocksPerCell + 1.0);
            }
            this.previewDirty = true;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mouseX, mouseY, horizontalAmount, verticalAmount);
    }

    private boolean isInside(double mx, double my, int x, int y, int w, int h) {
        return mx >= x && mx <= x + w && my >= y && my <= y + h;
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        if (this.client != null) {
            this.client.setScreen(this.parent);
        }
    }

    private record SliderRow(String label, int color, float min, float max, boolean signedPercent,
                             Supplier<Float> getter, Consumer<Float> setter) {
    }
}

    public static FactorioConfig INSTANCE = new FactorioConfig();

    public boolean showInfoDescription = true;
    public boolean showInfoHealth = false;

    public boolean showInfoElectricity = true;

        this.infoPanelScale = 1.0f;

        this.enableCraftingQueueHud = true;
        this.replaceVanillaInventory = true;
        this.enableInventoryAutoSort = true;
        this.enablePavementSpeedBoost = true;
        this.showPoleSupplyWhenHoldingElectric = true;
        this.showDrillMiningArea = true;
        this.enableCopperWiresRender = true;
        this.enablePlacementParticles = true;

        this.showInfoHealth = false;
        this.showInfoStatus = true;
        this.showInfoFluids = true;
        this.showInfoElectricity = true;

        this.drillAreaColor = 0x33E68C;
        this.validPlacementColor = 0x26FF40;
        this.invalidPlacementColor = 0xFF2626;
        this.wireColor = 0xE08538;
        this.altArrowColor = 0xFFE026;
        save();
    }

    public static float getRed(int rgb) { return ((rgb >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255.0f; }
    public static float getGreen(int rgb) { return ((rgb >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255.0f; }
    public static float getBlue(int rgb) { return (rgb & 0xFF) / 255.0f; }

    public static void load() {
        if (Files.exists(CONFIG_PATH)) {
            try (Reader reader = Files.newBufferedReader(CONFIG_PATH, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                FactorioConfig loaded = GSON.fromJson(reader, FactorioConfig.class);
                if (loaded != null) {
                    INSTANCE = loaded;
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
        } else {
            save();
        }
    }

    public static void save() {
        try {
            Files.createDirectories(CONFIG_PATH.getParent());
            try (Writer writer = Files.newBufferedWriter(CONFIG_PATH, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                GSON.toJson(INSTANCE, writer);
            }
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.combat;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.fluids.BoilerBlock;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.fluids.OffshorePumpBlock;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.fluids.SteamEngineBlock;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.belt.BeltBlock;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.splitter.SplitterBlock;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.production.assembler.AssemblerBlock;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.production.burner_drill.BurnerDrillBlock;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.production.electric_drill.ElectricDrillBlock;

import net.minecraft.item.MaceItem;

import net.minecraft.server.network.ServerPlayerEntity;
import net.minecraft.server.world.ServerWorld;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundCategory;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundEvents;
import net.minecraft.text.Text;
import net.minecraft.util.ActionResult;
import net.minecraft.util.Hand;
import net.minecraft.util.Identifier;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Direction;
import net.minecraft.world.World;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

public class BlockHealthManager {

    private static final Map<BlockPos, Integer> SERVER_DAMAGE = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final Map<BlockPos, Integer> CLIENT_DAMAGE = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public static int getMaxHealth(Block block) {
        if (block == ModBlocks.SMALL_ELECTRIC_POLE) return 100;
        if (block == ModBlocks.MEDIUM_ELECTRIC_POLE) return 100;
        if (block == ModBlocks.ELECTRIC_ENERGY_INTERFACE) return 150;
        if (block == ModBlocks.STONE_WALL) return 350;
        if (block == ModBlocks.GATE) return 350;
        if (block == ModBlocks.LAND_MINE) return 15;
        if (block == ModBlocks.WOODEN_CHEST) return 100;
        if (block == ModBlocks.IRON_CHEST) return 200;
        if (block == ModBlocks.STEEL_CHEST) return 350;

        if (block == ModBlocks.BURNER_INSERTER) return 100;
        if (block == ModBlocks.INSERTER) return 150;
        if (block == ModBlocks.LONG_HANDED_INSERTER) return 160;
        if (block == ModBlocks.FAST_INSERTER) return 160;

        if (block == ModBlocks.PIPE || block == ModBlocks.PIPE_TO_GROUND) return 100;
        if (block == ModBlocks.OFFSHORE_PUMP) return 150;
        if (block == ModBlocks.BOILER) return 200;
        if (block == ModBlocks.STEAM_ENGINE) return 400;
        if (block == ModBlocks.ELECTRIC_MINING_DRILL) return 300;
        if (block == ModBlocks.BURNER_MINING_DRILL) return 150;
        if (block == ModBlocks.STONE_FURNACE) return 200;
        if (block == ModBlocks.STEEL_FURNACE) return 300;
        if (block == ModBlocks.ASSEMBLER) return 300;
        if (block == ModBlocks.LAB) return 150;

        if (block instanceof SplitterBlock splitter) {
            return switch (splitter.getTier()) {
                case 2 -> 180;
                case 3 -> 190;
                default -> 170;
            };
        }
        if (block instanceof BeltBlock belt) {
            return switch (belt.getTier()) {
                case 2 -> 160;
                case 3 -> 170;
                default -> 150;
            };
        }
        return 0;
    }

    public static BlockPos getCanonicalPos(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        Block block = state.getBlock();
        if (block instanceof OffshorePumpBlock) {
            return OffshorePumpBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        }
        if (block instanceof BoilerBlock) {
            return BoilerBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        }
        if (block instanceof SteamEngineBlock) {
            return SteamEngineBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        }
        if (block instanceof ElectricDrillBlock) {
            return ElectricDrillBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        }
        if (block instanceof AssemblerBlock) {
            return AssemblerBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        }
        if (block instanceof LabBlock) {
            return LabBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        }
        if (block instanceof BurnerDrillBlock) {
            return BurnerDrillBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        }
        if (block instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlock) {
            return FactorioFurnaceBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        }
        if (block instanceof SplitterBlock && state.contains(SplitterBlock.PART_RIGHT) && state.get(SplitterBlock.PART_RIGHT)) {
            Direction facing = state.get(BeltBlock.FACING);
            return pos.offset(facing.rotateYCounterclockwise());
        }
        return pos.toImmutable();
    }

    public static int getDamageTaken(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        BlockPos masterPos = getCanonicalPos(pos, state);
        Map<BlockPos, Integer> map = (world != null && world.isClient) ? CLIENT_DAMAGE : SERVER_DAMAGE;
        return map.getOrDefault(masterPos, 0);
    }

    public static int getCurrentHealth(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        int max = getMaxHealth(state.getBlock());
        if (max <= 0) return 0;
        int dmg = getDamageTaken(world, pos, state);
        return Math.max(0, max - dmg);
    }

    public static Map<BlockPos, Integer> getClientDamagedBlocks() {
        return CLIENT_DAMAGE;
    }

    public static void setClientDamage(BlockPos masterPos, int damage) {
        if (damage <= 0) {
            CLIENT_DAMAGE.remove(masterPos);
        } else {
            CLIENT_DAMAGE.put(masterPos.toImmutable(), damage);
        }
    }

    public static void damageBlock(ServerWorld world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, int amount) {
        int maxHp = getMaxHealth(state.getBlock());
        if (maxHp <= 0 || amount <= 0) return;

        BlockPos masterPos = getCanonicalPos(pos, state);
        int newDamage = SERVER_DAMAGE.getOrDefault(masterPos, 0) + amount;

        if (newDamage >= maxHp) {
            SERVER_DAMAGE.remove(masterPos);
            syncToClients(world, masterPos, 0);
            destroyFactorioStructure(world, masterPos, world.getBlockState(masterPos));
        } else {
            SERVER_DAMAGE.put(masterPos, newDamage);
            syncToClients(world, masterPos, newDamage);
            world.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.BLOCK_ANVIL_LAND, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 0.35f, 1.5f);
            world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.CRIT, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.7, pos.getZ() + 0.5,
                    6, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.05);
        }
    }

    public static boolean repairBlock(ServerWorld world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, int amount) {
        int maxHp = getMaxHealth(state.getBlock());
        if (maxHp <= 0) return false;

        BlockPos masterPos = getCanonicalPos(pos, state);
        int currentDamage = SERVER_DAMAGE.getOrDefault(masterPos, 0);
        if (currentDamage <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        int newDamage = Math.max(0, currentDamage - amount);
        if (newDamage == 0) {
            SERVER_DAMAGE.remove(masterPos);
        } else {
            SERVER_DAMAGE.put(masterPos, newDamage);
        }

        syncToClients(world, masterPos, newDamage);
        world.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.BLOCK_IRON_TRAPDOOR_CLOSE, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 0.6f, 1.8f);
        world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.ELECTRIC_SPARK, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.75, pos.getZ() + 0.5,
                8, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.02);
        return true;
    }

    private static void destroyFactorioStructure(ServerWorld world, BlockPos masterPos, BlockState masterState) {
        Block block = masterState.getBlock();

        if (block instanceof OffshorePumpBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(OffshorePumpBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part <= 1; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = OffshorePumpBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, part == 0 && u == 0);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof BoilerBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(BoilerBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 6; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = BoilerBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, part == 1 && u == 0);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof SteamEngineBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(SteamEngineBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 15; part++) {
                for (int layer = 0; layer <= 2; layer++) {
                    BlockPos p = SteamEngineBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, layer);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, part == 1 && layer == 0);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof ElectricDrillBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(ElectricDrillBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = ElectricDrillBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, part == 4 && u == 0);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof AssemblerBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(AssemblerBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = AssemblerBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, part == 4 && u == 0);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof LabBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(LabBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = LabBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, part == 4 && u == 0);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof BurnerDrillBlock) {
            Direction f = masterState.get(BurnerDrillBlock.FACING);
            for (int p = 0; p < 4; p++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos bp = BurnerDrillBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, f, p, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(bp).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(bp, p == 0 && u == 0);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(FactorioFurnaceBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = FactorioFurnaceBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, part == 0 && u == 0);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof SplitterBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(BeltBlock.FACING);
            BlockPos rightPos = masterPos.offset(facing.rotateYClockwise());
            if (world.getBlockState(rightPos).isOf(block)) {
                world.breakBlock(rightPos, false);
            }
            world.breakBlock(masterPos, true);
        } else {
            world.breakBlock(masterPos, true);
        }
    }

    private static void syncToClients(ServerWorld world, BlockPos masterPos, int damage) {
        SyncBlockHealthPayload payload = new SyncBlockHealthPayload(masterPos, damage);
        for (ServerPlayerEntity player : PlayerLookup.world(world)) {
            ServerPlayNetworking.send(player, payload);
        }
    }

    public static void registerServer() {
        PlayerBlockBreakEvents.AFTER.register((world, player, pos, state, blockEntity) -> {
            if (!world.isClient && world instanceof ServerWorld serverWorld) {
                Block block = state.getBlock();
                if (getMaxHealth(block) > 0) {
                    BlockPos masterPos = getCanonicalPos(pos, state);
                    SERVER_DAMAGE.remove(masterPos);
                    syncToClients(serverWorld, masterPos, 0);
                }

                if (!player.isCreative() && !(block instanceof ResourceOreBlock)) {
                    Identifier id = Registries.BLOCK.getId(block);
                    if (id.getNamespace().equals("factoriocore")) {
                        player.getInventory().offerOrDrop(new ItemStack(block.asItem(), 1));
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        AttackBlockCallback.EVENT.register((player, world, hand, pos, direction) -> {
            BlockState state = world.getBlockState(pos);
            Block block = state.getBlock();
            int maxHp = getMaxHealth(block);
            if (maxHp <= 0) {
                return ActionResult.PASS;
            }

            ItemStack held = player.getStackInHand(hand);
            boolean isWeapon = held.getItem() instanceof SwordItem
                    || held.getItem() instanceof TridentItem
                    || held.getItem() instanceof MaceItem;

            if (isWeapon && player.isSneaking()) {
                if (!world.isClient && world instanceof ServerWorld serverWorld) {
                    damageBlock(serverWorld, pos, state, 25);
                    int left = getCurrentHealth(world, pos, state);
                    player.sendMessage(Text.literal("HP: " + left + " / " + maxHp), true);
                }
                return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
            }

            return ActionResult.PASS;
        });

        UseBlockCallback.EVENT.register((player, world, hand, hitResult) -> {
            ItemStack stack = player.getStackInHand(hand);
            if (!stack.isOf(ModItems.REPAIR_PACK)) {
                return ActionResult.PASS;
            }

            BlockPos pos = hitResult.getBlockPos();
            BlockState state = world.getBlockState(pos);
            int maxHp = getMaxHealth(state.getBlock());
            if (maxHp <= 0) {
                return ActionResult.PASS;
            }

            int currentDamage = getDamageTaken(world, pos, state);
            if (currentDamage <= 0) {
                return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
            }

            if (!world.isClient && world instanceof ServerWorld serverWorld) {
                if (repairBlock(serverWorld, pos, state, 25)) {
                    if (!player.isCreative()) {
                        stack.damage(1, player, hand == Hand.MAIN_HAND
                                ? EquipmentSlot.MAINHAND : EquipmentSlot.OFFHAND);
                    }
                }
            }
            return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
        });
    }
}

    private static final VoxelShape OPEN_OUTLINE = Block.createCuboidShape(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 2.5, 16.0);

    public FactorioGateBlock(Settings settings) {

    }

    @Override

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.combat;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModBlocks;
import net.minecraft.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.block.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundCategory;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundEvents;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Direction;
import net.minecraft.world.World;

public class FactorioGateBlockEntity extends BlockEntity {

    private static final double TRIGGER_RADIUS_SQ = 3.6 * 3.6;

    public FactorioGateBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.FACTORIO_GATE_BLOCK_ENTITY, pos, state);
    }

    public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, FactorioGateBlockEntity entity) {
        if (world.isClient || (world.getTime() & 1L) != 0L) {
            return;
        }

        boolean shouldOpen = isPlayerNearGateLine(world, pos, state);
        boolean currentlyOpen = state.get(FactorioGateBlock.OPEN);

        if (shouldOpen != currentlyOpen) {
            world.setBlockState(pos, state.with(FactorioGateBlock.OPEN, shouldOpen), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
            world.playSound(
                    null,
                    pos,
                    shouldOpen ? SoundEvents.BLOCK_IRON_TRAPDOOR_OPEN : SoundEvents.BLOCK_IRON_TRAPDOOR_CLOSE,
                    SoundCategory.BLOCKS,
                    0.5f,
                    shouldOpen ? 0.9f : 0.75f
            );
        }
    }

    /**
     * ÐŸÑ€Ð¾Ð²ÐµÑ€ÑÐµÑ‚, ÐµÑÑ‚ÑŒ Ð»Ð¸ Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾Ðº Ñ€ÑÐ´Ð¾Ð¼ Ñ ÑÑ‚Ð¸Ð¼ Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ¾Ð¼ Ð²Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð˜Ð›Ð˜ Ñ€ÑÐ´Ð¾Ð¼ Ñ ÑÐ¾ÑÐµÐ´Ð½Ð¸Ð¼Ð¸ Ð²Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ñ‚Ð°Ð¼Ð¸ Ð² Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¼ Ð¶Ðµ Ñ€ÑÐ´Ñƒ
     * (Ñ‡Ñ‚Ð¾Ð±Ñ‹ ÑˆÐ¸Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÐ¸Ðµ Ð²Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ñ‚Ð° Ð¸Ð· 2â€“4 Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ¾Ð² Ð¾Ñ‚ÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ð²Ð°Ð»Ð¸ÑÑŒ Ð¸ Ð·Ð°ÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ð²Ð°Ð»Ð¸ÑÑŒ ÑÐ¸Ð½Ñ…Ñ€Ð¾Ð½Ð½Ð¾!).
     */
    private static boolean isPlayerNearGateLine(World world, BlockPos origin, BlockState state) {
        if (isPlayerNearPos(world, origin)) {
            return true;
        }
        Direction facing = state.get(FactorioGateBlock.FACING);
        Direction left = facing.rotateYCounterclockwise();
        Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();

        for (int step = 1; step <= 4; step++) {
            BlockPos leftPos = origin.offset(left, step);
            if (world.getBlockState(leftPos).getBlock() instanceof FactorioGateBlock) {
                if (isPlayerNearPos(world, leftPos)) return true;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        for (int step = 1; step <= 4; step++) {
            BlockPos rightPos = origin.offset(right, step);
            if (world.getBlockState(rightPos).getBlock() instanceof FactorioGateBlock) {
                if (isPlayerNearPos(world, rightPos)) return true;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static boolean isPlayerNearPos(World world, BlockPos gatePos) {
        double gx = gatePos.getX() + 0.5;
        double gy = gatePos.getY() + 0.5;
        double gz = gatePos.getZ() + 0.5;

        for (PlayerEntity player : world.getPlayers()) {
            if (!player.isSpectator() && player.isAlive()) {
                if (player.squaredDistanceTo(gx, gy, gz) <= TRIGGER_RADIUS_SQ) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}

public class FactorioWallBlock extends Block {
    public static final BooleanProperty NORTH = Properties.NORTH;
    public static final BooleanProperty EAST = Properties.EAST;
    public static final BooleanProperty SOUTH = Properties.SOUTH;
    public static final BooleanProperty WEST = Properties.WEST;

    private static final VoxelShape OUTLINE_SHAPE = Block.createCuboidShape(2.0, 0.0, 2.0, 14.0, 16.0, 14.0);
    // ÐšÐ¾Ð»Ð»Ð¸Ð·Ð¸Ñ Ð²Ñ‹ÑÐ¾Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¹ 1.5 Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ° (24 Ð¿Ð¸ÐºÑÐµÐ»Ñ), Ñ‡Ñ‚Ð¾Ð±Ñ‹ Ð½Ð¸ Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾Ðº, Ð½Ð¸ ÐºÑƒÑÐ°ÐºÐ¸/Ð¼Ð¾Ð½ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ñ‹ Ð½Ðµ Ð¼Ð¾Ð³Ð»Ð¸ Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ¿Ñ€Ñ‹Ð³Ð½ÑƒÑ‚ÑŒ ÑÑ‚ÐµÐ½Ñƒ
    private static final VoxelShape COLLISION_SHAPE = Block.createCuboidShape(2.0, 0.0, 2.0, 14.0, 24.0, 14.0);

    public FactorioWallBlock(Settings settings) {
        super(settings);
        this.setDefaultState(this.stateManager.getDefaultState()
                .with(NORTH, false)
                .with(EAST, false)
                .with(SOUTH, false)
                .with(WEST, false));
    }

    @Override
    protected void appendProperties(StateManager.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
        builder.add(NORTH, EAST, SOUTH, WEST);
    }

    public static boolean canConnectTo(BlockState neighborState) {
        Block b = neighborState.getBlock();
        return b instanceof FactorioWallBlock || b instanceof FactorioGateBlock;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockState getPlacementState(ItemPlacementContext ctx) {
        BlockView world = ctx.getWorld();
        BlockPos pos = ctx.getBlockPos();
        return this.getDefaultState()
                .with(NORTH, canConnectTo(world.getBlockState(pos.north())))
                .with(EAST, canConnectTo(world.getBlockState(pos.east())))
                .with(SOUTH, canConnectTo(world.getBlockState(pos.south())))
                .with(WEST, canConnectTo(world.getBlockState(pos.west())));
    }

    @Override
    protected BlockState getStateForNeighborUpdate(BlockState state, Direction direction, BlockState neighborState,
                                                   WorldAccess world, BlockPos pos, BlockPos neighborPos) {
        return switch (direction) {
            case NORTH -> state.with(NORTH, canConnectTo(neighborState));
            case EAST -> state.with(EAST, canConnectTo(neighborState));
            case SOUTH -> state.with(SOUTH, canConnectTo(neighborState));
            case WEST -> state.with(WEST, canConnectTo(neighborState));
            default -> state;
        };
    }

    @Override
    protected VoxelShape getOutlineShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        return OUTLINE_SHAPE;
    }

    @Override
    protected VoxelShape getCollisionShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        return COLLISION_SHAPE;
    }

    @Override
    protected float calcBlockBreakingDelta(net.minecraft.block.BlockState state, net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity player, net.minecraft.world.BlockView world, net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos pos) {
        return 0.10f;
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.combat;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModBlocks;
import net.minecraft.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.block.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.block.entity.BlockEntity;

import net.minecraft.entity.effect.StatusEffectInstance;
import net.minecraft.entity.effect.StatusEffects;
import net.minecraft.entity.mob.Monster;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity;
import net.minecraft.nbt.NbtCompound;
import net.minecraft.particle.ParticleTypes;
import net.minecraft.registry.RegistryWrapper;
import net.minecraft.server.world.ServerWorld;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundCategory;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundEvents;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Box;
import net.minecraft.world.World;

import java.util.List;

public class LandMineBlockEntity extends BlockEntity {

    // Ð’ Factorio Ð¼Ð¸Ð½Ð° Ð²Ð·Ð²Ð¾Ð´Ð¸Ñ‚ÑÑ Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ· ~1.5 ÑÐµÐºÑƒÐ½Ð´Ñ‹ (30 Ñ‚Ð¸ÐºÐ¾Ð²) Ð¿Ð¾ÑÐ»Ðµ ÑƒÑÑ‚Ð°Ð½Ð¾Ð²ÐºÐ¸
    public static final int ARM_DELAY_TICKS = 30;
    private int armedTicks = 0;

    public LandMineBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.LAND_MINE_BLOCK_ENTITY, pos, state);
    }

    public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, LandMineBlockEntity entity) {
        if (world.isClient) return;

        if (entity.armedTicks < ARM_DELAY_TICKS) {
            entity.armedTicks++;
            if (entity.armedTicks == ARM_DELAY_TICKS) {
                world.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.BLOCK_STONE_BUTTON_CLICK_ON, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 0.4f, 1.6f);
            }
            return;
        }

        if ((world.getTime() & 1L) != 0L) {
            return;
        }

        // ÐŸÑ€Ð¾Ð²ÐµÑ€ÑÐµÐ¼ Ñ€Ð°Ð´Ð¸ÑƒÑ ÑÑ€Ð°Ð±Ð°Ñ‚Ñ‹Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ñ Ð¼Ð¸Ð½Ñ‹ (Ð²Ñ€Ð°Ð¶Ð´ÐµÐ±Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ Ð¼Ð¾Ð½ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ñ‹ Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾Ðº, Ð½Ð°ÑÑ‚ÑƒÐ¿Ð¸Ð²ÑˆÐ¸Ð¹ Ð±ÐµÐ· Shift)
        Box triggerBox = new Box(pos).expand(0.85, 0.5, 0.85);
        List<LivingEntity> targets = world.getEntitiesByClass(LivingEntity.class, triggerBox, living -> {
            if (!living.isAlive() || living.isSpectator()) return false;
            if (living instanceof Monster) return true;
            if (living instanceof PlayerEntity player) {
                return !player.isSneaking(); // Ð¡ Ð·Ð°Ð¶Ð°Ñ‚Ñ‹Ð¼ Shift Ð¼Ð¾Ð¶Ð½Ð¾ Ð±ÐµÐ·Ð¾Ð¿Ð°ÑÐ½Ð¾ Ñ…Ð¾Ð´Ð¸Ñ‚ÑŒ Ð¿Ð¾ Ð¼Ð¸Ð½Ð½Ð¾Ð¼Ñƒ Ð¿Ð¾Ð»ÑŽ!
            }
            return false;
        });

        if (!targets.isEmpty() && world instanceof ServerWorld serverWorld) {
            detonate(serverWorld, pos);
        }
    }

    public static void detonate(ServerWorld world, BlockPos pos) {
        world.setBlockState(pos, Blocks.AIR.getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);

        double cx = pos.getX() + 0.5;
        double cy = pos.getY() + 0.2;
        double cz = pos.getZ() + 0.5;

        // Ð­Ñ„Ñ„ÐµÐºÑ‚ Ð²Ð·Ñ€Ñ‹Ð²Ð° Ð¸ ÑƒÐ´Ð°Ñ€Ð½Ð¾Ð¹ Ð²Ð¾Ð»Ð½Ñ‹ Ð±ÐµÐ· Ñ€Ð°Ð·Ñ€ÑƒÑˆÐµÐ½Ð¸Ñ Ð·Ð°Ð²Ð¾Ð´ÑÐºÐ¸Ñ… Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ¾Ð²!
        world.playSound(null, cx, cy, cz, SoundEvents.ENTITY_GENERIC_EXPLODE.value(), SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 1.1f, 0.95f);
        world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.EXPLOSION_EMITTER, cx, cy + 0.3, cz, 1, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
        world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.FLAME, cx, cy + 0.2, cz, 28, 0.6, 0.3, 0.6, 0.08);
        world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.LARGE_SMOKE, cx, cy + 0.3, cz, 18, 0.7, 0.4, 0.7, 0.04);

        Box blastBox = new Box(pos).expand(3.5, 2.5, 3.5);
        List<LivingEntity> victims = world.getEntitiesByClass(LivingEntity.class, blastBox, LivingEntity::isAlive);
        for (LivingEntity victim : victims) {
            double dist = Math.sqrt(victim.squaredDistanceTo(cx, cy, cz));
            if (dist <= 4.0) {
                float factor = (float) Math.max(0.25, 1.0 - (dist / 4.2));
                victim.damage(world.getDamageSources().explosion(null, null), 28.0f * factor);
                // ÐžÐ³Ð»ÑƒÑˆÐµÐ½Ð¸Ðµ / Ð·Ð°Ð¼ÐµÐ´Ð»ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ðµ ÐºÐ°Ðº Ñƒ Ð¼Ð¸Ð½ Ð² Factorio
                victim.addStatusEffect(new StatusEffectInstance(StatusEffects.SLOWNESS, 60, 2));
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
        nbt.putInt("ArmedTicks", this.armedTicks);
    }

    @Override
    protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
        this.armedTicks = nbt.getInt("ArmedTicks");
    }
}

    private static void register(String id, Category cat, int row, ItemStack out, int ticks, Ingredient... ings) {
        Recipe r = new Recipe(id, cat, row, out, ticks, List.of(ings));
        ALL.add(r);
        BY_ID.put(id, r);
        BY_OUTPUT_ITEM.put(out.getItem(), r);
    }

        public static int getRecipeIndex(String id) {
        if (id == null || id.isEmpty()) return -1;
        init();
        for (int i = 0; i < ALL.size(); i++) {
            if (ALL.get(i).id().equals(id)) return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    public static String getRecipeIdByIndex(int index) {
        init();
        if (index >= 0 && index < ALL.size()) {
            return ALL.get(index).id();
        }
        return "";
    }

    public static Recipe getById(String id) {
        init();
        return BY_ID.get(id);
    }

    public static Recipe getByOutput(Item item) {
        init();
        return BY_OUTPUT_ITEM.get(item);
    }

    public static List<Recipe> getByCategory(Category category) {
        init();
        List<Recipe> list = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Recipe r : ALL) {
            if (r.category() == category && com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.research.ResearchManager.isRecipeUnlocked(r.id())) {
                list.add(r);
            }
        }
        return list;
    }

    public static Map<Item, Integer> snapshotInventory(PlayerInventory inv) {
        Map<Item, Integer> map = new HashMap<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < inv.main.size(); i++) {
            ItemStack s = inv.main.get(i);
            if (!s.isEmpty()) {
                map.merge(s.getItem(), s.getCount(), Integer::sum);
            }
        }
        return map;
    }

    public static int getCraftableCount(PlayerInventory inv, Recipe recipe) {
        Map<Item, Integer> pool = snapshotInventory(inv);
        int crafts = 0;
        List<QueueStep> dummy = new ArrayList<>();
        while (crafts < 999 && tryConsumeOrSubcraftBatch(pool, recipe, 1, false, dummy, 0)) {
            crafts += recipe.output().getCount();
        }
        return crafts;
    }

    /**
     * Ð¡Ñ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ð¸Ñ‚ ÑÐ³Ñ€ÑƒÐ¿Ð¿Ð¸Ñ€Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð½ÑƒÑŽ Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´ÑŒ ÐºÑ€Ð°Ñ„Ñ‚Ð° Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ‡ÑŒ-Ð²-Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ‡ÑŒ ÐºÐ°Ðº Ð² Ð¾Ñ€Ð¸Ð³Ð¸Ð½Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾Ð¹ Factorio:
     * Ð¡Ð¿ÐµÑ€Ð²Ð° Ð´ÐµÐ»Ð°ÑŽÑ‚ÑÑ Ð’Ð¡Ð• Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼ÐµÐ¶ÑƒÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ Ñ€ÐµÑÑƒÑ€ÑÑ‹ Ð¿ÐµÑ€Ð²Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ ÑƒÑ€Ð¾Ð²Ð½Ñ (Ð½Ð°Ð¿Ñ€Ð¸Ð¼ÐµÑ€, Ð²ÑÐµ ÑˆÐµÑÑ‚ÐµÑ€Ñ‘Ð½ÐºÐ¸ / Ð²ÑÑ Ð±Ñ€ÑƒÑÑ‡Ð°Ñ‚ÐºÐ°),

     */
    public static List<QueueStep> planAndConsume(PlayerInventory inv, Recipe targetRecipe, int requestedCrafts) {
        Map<Item, Integer> initialSnapshot = snapshotInventory(inv);

        // ÐÐ°Ñ…Ð¾Ð´Ð¸Ð¼ Ð¼Ð°ÐºÑÐ¸Ð¼Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾Ðµ Ñ‡Ð¸ÑÐ»Ð¾ Ð¿Ð¾Ð»Ð½Ñ‹Ñ… ÐºÑ€Ð°Ñ„Ñ‚Ð¾Ð² (Ð´Ð¾ requestedCrafts), Ð½Ð° ÐºÐ¾Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ðµ Ñ…Ð²Ð°Ñ‚Ð°ÐµÑ‚ ÑÑ‹Ñ€ÑŒÑ
        int maxAffordable = 0;
        for (int test = 1; test <= requestedCrafts; test++) {
            Map<Item, Integer> testPool = new HashMap<>(initialSnapshot);
            List<QueueStep> testSteps = new ArrayList<>();
            if (tryConsumeOrSubcraftBatch(testPool, targetRecipe, test, true, testSteps, 0)) {
                maxAffordable = test;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }

        if (maxAffordable <= 0) {
            return Collections.emptyList();
        }

        // ÐŸÐ»Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÐ¼ ÑÑ€Ð°Ð·Ñƒ Ð’Ð¡Ð® Ð¿Ð°Ñ€Ñ‚Ð¸ÑŽ maxAffordable Ñ†ÐµÐ»Ð¸ÐºÐ¾Ð¼ Ð¸ Ð³Ñ€ÑƒÐ¿Ð¿Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÐ¼ Ð¾Ð´Ð¸Ð½Ð°ÐºÐ¾Ð²Ñ‹Ðµ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼ÐµÐ¶ÑƒÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ ÑÑ‚Ð°Ð¿Ñ‹
        Map<Item, Integer> simulatedPool = new HashMap<>(initialSnapshot);
        List<QueueStep> rawSteps = new ArrayList<>();
        tryConsumeOrSubcraftBatch(simulatedPool, targetRecipe, maxAffordable, true, rawSteps, 0);

        List<QueueStep> groupedSteps = consolidateStepsByFirstAppearance(rawSteps);

        // Ð¡Ð¿Ð¸ÑÑ‹Ð²Ð°ÐµÐ¼ Ð¸Ð·Ñ€Ð°ÑÑ…Ð¾Ð´Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð½Ð¾Ðµ Ð±Ð°Ð·Ð¾Ð²Ð¾Ðµ ÑÑ‹Ñ€ÑŒÑ‘ Ð¸Ð· Ñ€ÐµÐ°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ Ð¸Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð°Ñ€Ñ Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÐ°
        for (Map.Entry<Item, Integer> entry : initialSnapshot.entrySet()) {
            Item item = entry.getKey();
            int before = entry.getValue();
            int after = simulatedPool.getOrDefault(item, 0);
            int toRemove = before - after;
            if (toRemove > 0) {
                removeFromPlayerInventory(inv, item, toRemove);
            }
        }

        // Ð’Ð¾Ð·Ð²Ñ€Ð°Ñ‰Ð°ÐµÐ¼ Ð¸Ð·Ð»Ð¸ÑˆÐºÐ¸ Ð¾Ñ‚ ÐºÑ€Ð°Ñ„Ñ‚Ð° ÐºÑ€Ð°Ñ‚Ð½Ñ‹Ñ… Ð¿Ð°Ñ‡ÐµÐº (Ð½Ð°Ð¿Ñ€Ð¸Ð¼ÐµÑ€, Ð»Ð¸ÑˆÐ½ÑŽÑŽ 1 Ð¿Ð»Ð¸Ñ‚ÐºÑƒ Ð±Ñ€ÑƒÑÑ‡Ð°Ñ‚ÐºÐ¸)
        for (Map.Entry<Item, Integer> entry : simulatedPool.entrySet()) {
            Item item = entry.getKey();
            int before = initialSnapshot.getOrDefault(item, 0);
            int after = entry.getValue();
            int surplus = after - before;
            if (surplus > 0) {
                inv.offerOrDrop(new ItemStack(item, surplus));
            }
        }

        return groupedSteps;
    }

    /**
     * Ð“Ñ€ÑƒÐ¿Ð¿Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÑ‚ Ð²ÑÐµ Ð¾Ð´Ð¸Ð½Ð°ÐºÐ¾Ð²Ñ‹Ðµ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼ÐµÐ¶ÑƒÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ Ñ€ÐµÑ†ÐµÐ¿Ñ‚Ñ‹ Ð²Ð¼ÐµÑÑ‚Ðµ Ð² Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€ÑÐ´ÐºÐµ Ð¸Ñ… Ð¿ÐµÑ€Ð²Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ Ð¿Ð¾ÑÐ²Ð»ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ñ Ð² Ð´ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ²Ðµ Ð·Ð°Ð²Ð¸ÑÐ¸Ð¼Ð¾ÑÑ‚ÐµÐ¹.
     */
    public static List<QueueStep> consolidateStepsByFirstAppearance(List<QueueStep> steps) {
        Map<String, List<QueueStep>> intermediatesById = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        List<QueueStep> finalTargets = new ArrayList<>();

        for (QueueStep step : steps) {
            if (step.deliverToPlayer()) {
                finalTargets.add(step);
            } else {
                intermediatesById.computeIfAbsent(step.recipe().id(), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(step);
            }
        }

        List<QueueStep> result = new ArrayList<>(steps.size());
        for (List<QueueStep> group : intermediatesById.values()) {
            result.addAll(group);
        }
        result.addAll(finalTargets);
        return result;
    }

    private static boolean tryConsumeOrSubcraftBatch(Map<Item, Integer> pool, Recipe recipe, int batchesNeeded,
                                                     boolean isTopLevelTarget, List<QueueStep> outSteps, int depth) {
        if (depth > 8 || batchesNeeded <= 0) return false;

        for (Ingredient ing : recipe.ingredients()) {
            int needed = ing.count() * batchesNeeded;
            int have = pool.getOrDefault(ing.item(), 0);

            if (have >= needed) {
                pool.put(ing.item(), have - needed);
            } else {
                int missing = needed - have;
                pool.put(ing.item(), 0);

                Recipe subRecipe = getByOutput(ing.item());
                if (subRecipe == null) {
                    return false;
                }

                int subOutCount = subRecipe.output().getCount();
                int subBatchesNeeded = (missing + subOutCount - 1) / subOutCount;

                if (!tryConsumeOrSubcraftBatch(pool, subRecipe, subBatchesNeeded, false, outSteps, depth + 1)) {
                    return false;
                }

                int produced = subBatchesNeeded * subOutCount;
                int leftover = produced - missing;
                if (leftover > 0) {
                    pool.merge(ing.item(), leftover, Integer::sum);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < batchesNeeded; i++) {
            outSteps.add(new QueueStep(recipe, isTopLevelTarget));
        }
        return true;
    }

    private static void removeFromPlayerInventory(PlayerInventory inv, Item item, int amount) {
        int remaining = amount;
        for (int i = 0; i < inv.main.size() && remaining > 0; i++) {
            ItemStack s = inv.main.get(i);
            if (!s.isEmpty() && s.isOf(item)) {
                int take = Math.min(remaining, s.getCount());
                s.decrement(take);
                if (s.isEmpty()) {
                    inv.main.set(i, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                }
                remaining -= take;
            }
        }
        inv.markDirty();
    }

    public static Map<Item, Integer> calculateTotalRaw(Recipe recipe) {
        Map<Item, Integer> raw = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        accumulateRaw(recipe, 1.0, raw, 0);
        return raw;
    }

    private static void accumulateRaw(Recipe recipe, double multiplier, Map<Item, Integer> raw, int depth) {
        if (depth > 6) return;
        for (Ingredient ing : recipe.ingredients()) {
            Recipe sub = getByOutput(ing.item());
            if (sub != null) {
                double batches = (ing.count() * multiplier) / sub.output().getCount();
                accumulateRaw(sub, batches, raw, depth + 1);
            } else {
                int add = Math.max(1, (int) Math.ceil(ing.count() * multiplier));
                raw.merge(ing.item(), add, Integer::sum);
            }
        }
    }
}
