import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

public class AssemblerBlockEntity extends BlockEntity implements SidedInventory, NamedScreenHandlerFactory {

    public static final long POWER_CONSUMPTION_WATTS = 75_000L;
    private final DefaultedList<ItemStack> inventory = DefaultedList.ofSize(5, ItemStack.EMPTY);

    private String recipeId = "";
    private int progress = 0;
    private int maxProgress = 100;
    private boolean isWorking = false;
    private boolean isPowered = false;

    private static final int[] ALL_SLOTS = new int[]{0, 1, 2, 3, 4};

    protected final PropertyDelegate propertyDelegate = new PropertyDelegate() {
        @Override public int get(int index) {
            return switch (index) {
                case 0 -> progress;
                case 1 -> Math.max(1, maxProgress);
                case 2 -> isWorking ? 1 : 0;
                case 3 -> isPowered ? 1 : 0;
                case 4 -> pos.getX();
                case 5 -> pos.getY();
                case 6 -> pos.getZ();
                case 7 -> FactorioRecipes.getRecipeIndex(recipeId) + 1;
                default -> 0;
            };
        }
        @Override public void set(int index, int value) {
            switch (index) {
                case 0 -> progress = value;
                case 1 -> maxProgress = value;
                case 2 -> isWorking = value == 1;
                case 3 -> isPowered = value == 1;
            }
        }
        @Override public int size() { return 8; }
    };

    public AssemblerBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.ASSEMBLER_BLOCK_ENTITY, pos, state);
    }

    public String getRecipeId() { return this.recipeId; }

    public void setRecipeId(String newRecipeId) {
        setRecipeId(newRecipeId, null);
    }

    public void setRecipeId(String newRecipeId, @Nullable ServerPlayerEntity player) {
        String normalized = newRecipeId != null ? newRecipeId : "";
        if (!this.recipeId.equals(normalized)) {
            if (world != null && !world.isClient) {
                for (int i = 0; i < inventory.size(); i++) {
                    ItemStack st = inventory.get(i);
                    if (!st.isEmpty()) {
                        if (player != null) {
                            player.getInventory().offerOrDrop(st.copy());
                        } else {
                            ItemScatterer.spawn(world, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 1.0, pos.getZ() + 0.5, st.copy());
                        }
                        inventory.set(i, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        this.recipeId = normalized;
        this.progress = 0;
        this.isWorking = false;
        FactorioRecipes.Recipe r = FactorioRecipes.getById(this.recipeId);
        this.maxProgress = r != null ? Math.max(1, r.timeTicks()) : 100;
        sync();
    }

    public boolean isPowered() { return isPowered; }
    public boolean isWorking() { return isWorking; }

    public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, AssemblerBlockEntity be) {
        if (world == null || world.isClient) return;

        boolean hasPower = PowerNetworkManager.isMachinePowered(world, pos);
        if (be.isPowered != hasPower) {
            be.isPowered = hasPower;
            be.sync();
        }

        if (!hasPower || be.recipeId.isEmpty()) {
            if (be.isWorking) {
                be.isWorking = false;
                be.sync();
            }
            return;
        }

        FactorioRecipes.Recipe r = FactorioRecipes.getById(be.recipeId);
        if (r == null) {
            if (be.isWorking) {
                be.isWorking = false;
                be.sync();
            }
            return;
        }

        if (be.canCraft(r)) {
            if (!be.isWorking) {
                be.isWorking = true;
                be.sync();
            }
            be.progress++;
            if (be.progress >= be.maxProgress) {
                be.consumeIngredients(r);
                be.produceResult(r);
                be.progress = 0;
                be.sync();
            }
        } else {
            if (be.isWorking) {
                be.isWorking = false;
                be.sync();
            }
        }
    }

    private boolean canCraft(FactorioRecipes.Recipe recipe) {
        if (recipe == null) return false;
        for (int i = 0; i < recipe.ingredients().size() && i < 4; i++) {
            FactorioRecipes.Ingredient ing = recipe.ingredients().get(i);
            ItemStack slot = inventory.get(i);
            if (slot.isEmpty() || !slot.isOf(ing.item()) || slot.getCount() < ing.count()) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        ItemStack outSlot = inventory.get(4);
        if (outSlot.isEmpty()) return true;
        if (!ItemStack.areItemsAndComponentsEqual(outSlot, recipe.output())) return false;
        return outSlot.getCount() + recipe.output().getCount() <= outSlot.getMaxCount();
    }

    private void consumeIngredients(FactorioRecipes.Recipe recipe) {
        for (int i = 0; i < recipe.ingredients().size() && i < 4; i++) {
            FactorioRecipes.Ingredient ing = recipe.ingredients().get(i);
            ItemStack slot = inventory.get(i);
            if (!slot.isEmpty() && slot.isOf(ing.item())) {
                slot.decrement(ing.count());
            }
        }
    }

    private void produceResult(FactorioRecipes.Recipe recipe) {
        ItemStack outSlot = inventory.get(4);
        if (outSlot.isEmpty()) {
            inventory.set(4, recipe.output().copy());
        } else {
            outSlot.increment(recipe.output().getCount());
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isValid(int slot, ItemStack stack) {
        if (slot < 0 || slot >= 4) return false;
        if (this.recipeId.isEmpty()) return false;
        FactorioRecipes.Recipe r = FactorioRecipes.getById(this.recipeId);
        if (r == null || slot >= r.ingredients().size()) return false;
        return stack.isOf(r.ingredients().get(slot).item());
    }

    @Override public int[] getAvailableSlots(Direction side) { return ALL_SLOTS; }
    @Override public boolean canInsert(int slot, ItemStack stack, @Nullable Direction dir) { return isValid(slot, stack); }
    @Override public boolean canExtract(int slot, ItemStack stack, Direction dir) { return slot == 4; }

    public void sync() {
        markDirty();
        if (world != null && !world.isClient) {
            world.updateListeners(pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), net.minecraft.block.Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
        }
    }

    @Override public int size() { return inventory.size(); }
    @Override public boolean isEmpty() { return inventory.stream().allMatch(ItemStack::isEmpty); }
    @Override public ItemStack getStack(int slot) { return inventory.get(slot); }
    @Override public ItemStack removeStack(int slot, int amount) { ItemStack res = Inventories.splitStack(inventory, slot, amount); if (!res.isEmpty()) sync(); return res; }
    @Override public ItemStack removeStack(int slot) { ItemStack res = Inventories.removeStack(inventory, slot); if (!res.isEmpty()) sync(); return res; }
    @Override public void setStack(int slot, ItemStack stack) { inventory.set(slot, stack); sync(); }
    @Override public boolean canPlayerUse(PlayerEntity player) { return true; }
    @Override public void clear() { inventory.clear(); sync(); }

    @Override
    protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
        Inventories.writeNbt(nbt, inventory, registries);
        nbt.putString("RecipeId", recipeId);
        nbt.putInt("Progress", progress);
        nbt.putInt("MaxProgress", maxProgress);
        nbt.putBoolean("Powered", isPowered);
    }

    @Override
    protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
        Inventories.readNbt(nbt, inventory, registries);
        recipeId = nbt.getString("RecipeId");
        progress = nbt.getInt("Progress");
        maxProgress = nbt.getInt("MaxProgress");
        isPowered = nbt.getBoolean("Powered");
    }

    @Nullable @Override public Packet<ClientPlayPacketListener> toUpdatePacket() { return BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket.create(this); }
    @Override public NbtCompound toInitialChunkDataNbt(RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) { return createNbt(registries); }

    @Override public Text getDisplayName() { return Text.translatable("block.factoriocore.assembler"); }
    @Nullable @Override public ScreenHandler createMenu(int syncId, PlayerInventory playerInventory, PlayerEntity player) {
        return new AssemblerScreenHandler(syncId, playerInventory, this, this.propertyDelegate);
    }
}

public class AssemblerScreenHandler extends ScreenHandler {

        for (int r = 0; r < 3; ++r) {

        for (int c = 0; c < 9; ++c) {
            this.addSlot(new Slot(playerInventory, c, 12 + c * 18, 96) {

        return blockEntity != null || propertyDelegate.get(1) > 0;
    }

    public ItemStack getStack(int slot) {
        if (slot >= 0 && slot < this.slots.size()) {
            return this.getSlot(slot).getStack();

        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
    }

    public int getMaxProgress() { return Math.max(1, propertyDelegate.get(1)); }

        this.clientRecipeId = rid;

        }
        if (blockEntity != null) {
            return blockEntity.getRecipeId();
        }
        int encoded = propertyDelegate.get(7);
        if (encoded <= 0) return "";
        return FactorioRecipes.getRecipeIdByIndex(encoded - 1);
    }

    public BlockPos getTargetPos() {
        if (blockEntity != null) return blockEntity.getPos();
        return new BlockPos(propertyDelegate.get(4), propertyDelegate.get(5), propertyDelegate.get(6));
    }

    @Override
    public ItemStack quickMove(PlayerEntity player, int index) {
        ItemStack newStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        Slot slot = this.slots.get(index);
        if (slot != null && slot.hasStack()) {
            ItemStack originalStack = slot.getStack();
            newStack = originalStack.copy();
            if (index < 5) {
                if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, 5, 41, true)) return ItemStack.EMPTY;
            } else {
                if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, 0, 4, false)) return ItemStack.EMPTY;
            }
            if (originalStack.isEmpty()) slot.setStack(ItemStack.EMPTY);
            else slot.markDirty();
        }
        return newStack;
    }

    @Override public boolean canUse(PlayerEntity player) { return this.inventory.canPlayerUse(player); }

    private class FactorioInputSlot extends Slot {
        private final int ingIndex;

        public FactorioInputSlot(Inventory inventory, int index, int x, int y) {
            super(inventory, index, x, y);
            this.ingIndex = index;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isEnabled() {
            if (!AssemblerScreenHandler.this.slotsVisible) return false;
            FactorioRecipes.Recipe r = FactorioRecipes.getById(getRecipeId());
            return r != null && this.ingIndex < r.ingredients().size();
        }

        @Override
        public boolean canInsert(ItemStack stack) {
            FactorioRecipes.Recipe r = FactorioRecipes.getById(getRecipeId());
            if (r == null || this.ingIndex >= r.ingredients().size()) return false;
            return stack.isOf(r.ingredients().get(this.ingIndex).item());
        }
    }
}

    public static BlockPos getPartPos(BlockPos masterPos, Direction facing, int part, boolean upper) {
        Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
        BlockPos base = switch (part) {
            case 1 -> masterPos.offset(right);
            case 2 -> masterPos.offset(facing);
            case 3 -> masterPos.offset(facing).offset(right);
            default -> masterPos;
        };
        return upper ? base.up() : base;
    }

    /**
     * ÐÐ°Ñ…Ð¾Ð´Ð¸Ñ‚ Ð³Ð»Ð°Ð²Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð±Ð»Ð¾Ðº (part=0, upper=false) Ð¸Ð· Ð»ÑŽÐ±Ð¾Ð¹ Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ‡ÐºÐ¸ ÑÑ‚Ñ€ÑƒÐºÑ‚ÑƒÑ€Ñ‹ 2x2x2.5 Ð·Ð° O(1).
     */
    public static BlockPos getMasterPos(BlockPos currentPos, BlockState state) {
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof BurnerDrillBlock)) {
            return currentPos;
        }
        Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
        Direction left = facing.rotateYCounterclockwise();
        Direction back = facing.getOpposite();
        int part = state.get(PART);
        boolean upper = state.get(UPPER);

        BlockPos base = upper ? currentPos.down() : currentPos;
        return switch (part) {
            case 1 -> base.offset(left);
            case 2 -> base.offset(back);
            case 3 -> base.offset(back).offset(left);
            default -> base;
        };
    }

        public static boolean hasOreInFootprint(World world, BlockPos originPos, Direction facing) {
        for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
            BlockPos tile = getPartPos(originPos, facing, part, false);
            for (int dy = -2; dy <= 0; dy++) {
                if (world.getBlockState(tile.add(0, dy, 0)).getBlock() instanceof com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.world.ore.ResourceOreBlock) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockState getPlacementState(ItemPlacementContext ctx) {
        Direction facing = ctx.getHorizontalPlayerFacing().getOpposite();
        if (ctx.getPlayer() != null && ctx.getPlayer().isSneaking()) {
            facing = facing.getOpposite();
        }
        BlockPos masterPos = ctx.getBlockPos();
        World world = ctx.getWorld();

        for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
            for (int yOff = 0; yOff <= 2; yOff++) {
                BlockPos checkPos = getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, false).up(yOff);
                if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(checkPos) || !world.getBlockState(checkPos).canReplace(ctx)) {
                    return null;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!hasOreInFootprint(world, masterPos, facing)) return null;
        return this.getDefaultState().with(FACING, facing).with(PART, 0).with(UPPER, false);
    }

                    world.setBlockState(partPos, state.with(PART, part).with(UPPER, isUpper), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);

    }

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.production.burner_drill;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.combat.BlockHealthManager;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.belt.BeltBlock;

public class BurnerDrillBlockEntity extends BlockEntity implements ExtendedScreenHandlerFactory<BlockPos>, Inventory {

    public static final int MINING_TIME_TICKS = 80;
    public static final int FUEL_SLOT = 0;
    public static final int OUTPUT_SLOT = 1;

    private ItemStack fuelStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
    private ItemStack outputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;

    private int burnTime = 0;
    private int maxBurnTime = 0;
    private int miningProgress = 0;
    private int resourceCycleIndex = 0;
    private boolean sleeping = false;

    private float clientDrillRotation = 0.0f;

    protected final PropertyDelegate propertyDelegate = new PropertyDelegate() {
        @Override
        public int get(int index) {
            return switch (index) {
                case 0 -> burnTime;
                case 1 -> maxBurnTime;
                case 2 -> miningProgress;
                case 3 -> MINING_TIME_TICKS;
                case 4 -> sleeping ? 1 : 0;
                default -> 0;
            };
        }

        @Override
        public void set(int index, int value) {
            switch (index) {
                case 0 -> burnTime = value;
                case 1 -> maxBurnTime = value;
                case 2 -> miningProgress = value;
                case 4 -> sleeping = (value != 0);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public int size() {
            return 5;
        }
    };

    public BurnerDrillBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.BURNER_DRILL_BLOCK_ENTITY, pos, state);
    }

    public BurnerDrillBlockEntity getMaster() {
        if (this.world == null) return this;
        BlockState state = getCachedState();
        if (state.getBlock() instanceof BurnerDrillBlock) {
            if (state.get(BurnerDrillBlock.PART) == 0 && !state.get(BurnerDrillBlock.UPPER)) {
                return this;
            }
            BlockPos masterPos = BurnerDrillBlock.getMasterPos(this.pos, state);
            if (this.world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof BurnerDrillBlockEntity master) {
                return master;
            }
        }
        return this;
    }

    public void wakeUp() {
        BurnerDrillBlockEntity master = getMaster();
        if (master.sleeping) {
            master.sleeping = false;
        }
    }

    public boolean isWorking() {
        return !this.sleeping && this.burnTime > 0;
    }

    public float getClientDrillRotation(float tickDelta) {
        if (!this.sleeping && this.burnTime > 0) {
            return this.clientDrillRotation + tickDelta * 12.0f;
        }
        return this.clientDrillRotation;
    }

    public static void clientTick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, BurnerDrillBlockEntity entity) {
        if (!entity.sleeping && entity.burnTime > 0) {
            entity.clientDrillRotation = (entity.clientDrillRotation + 12.0f) % 360.0f;
        }
    }

    public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, BurnerDrillBlockEntity entity) {
        if (world == null || world.isClient()) return;

        if (entity.sleeping) {
            if (((world.getTime() + pos.asLong()) & 15L) != 0L) {
                return;
            }
            entity.sleeping = false;
        }

        Direction facing = state.get(BurnerDrillBlock.FACING);

        if (!entity.outputStack.isEmpty()) {
            if (entity.tryExportOutput(world, pos, facing)) {
                entity.syncState();
            }
            if (entity.outputStack.getCount() >= entity.outputStack.getMaxCount()) {
                entity.sleeping = true;
                entity.syncState();
                return;
            }
        }

        BlockPos targetOrePos = entity.findActiveOrePosUnderneath(world, pos, facing);
        if (targetOrePos == null) {
            entity.miningProgress = 0;
            entity.sleeping = true;
            entity.syncState();
            return;
        }

        ItemStack minedResource = mapOreBlockToProduct(world.getBlockState(targetOrePos).getBlock());
        if (minedResource.isEmpty()) {
            entity.sleeping = true;
            entity.syncState();
            return;
        }

        if (!entity.outputStack.isEmpty() && !ItemStack.areItemsAndComponentsEqual(entity.outputStack, minedResource)) {
            entity.sleeping = true;
            entity.syncState();
            return;
        }

        if (!entity.ensureFuel()) {
            entity.sleeping = true;
            entity.syncState();
            return;
        }

        entity.burnTime--;
        entity.miningProgress++;

        if (entity.miningProgress >= MINING_TIME_TICKS) {
            entity.miningProgress = 0;
            entity.resourceCycleIndex++;

            ResourceOreBlock.consumeOreAt(world, targetOrePos, 1);

            if (entity.outputStack.isEmpty()) {
                entity.outputStack = minedResource.copyWithCount(1);
            } else {
                entity.outputStack.increment(1);
            }

            entity.tryExportOutput(world, pos, facing);
            entity.syncState();
        }
    }

    @Nullable
    private BlockPos findActiveOrePosUnderneath(World world, BlockPos masterPos, Direction facing) {
        List<BlockPos> orePositions = new ArrayList<>(4);
        for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
            BlockPos groundPos = BurnerDrillBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, false).down();
            Block groundBlock = world.getBlockState(groundPos).getBlock();
            if (!mapOreBlockToProduct(groundBlock).isEmpty()) {
                orePositions.add(groundPos);
            }
        }
        if (orePositions.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        return orePositions.get(Math.floorMod(this.resourceCycleIndex, orePositions.size()));
    }

    private boolean ensureFuel() {
        if (this.burnTime > 0) {
            return true;
        }
        if (!this.fuelStack.isEmpty() && AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(this.fuelStack)) {
            Integer fuelTicks = FuelRegistry.INSTANCE.get(this.fuelStack.getItem());
            int ticks = (fuelTicks != null && fuelTicks > 0) ? (int) (fuelTicks * 0.35f) : 200;
            this.burnTime = Math.max(80, ticks);
            this.maxBurnTime = this.burnTime;

            Item remainder = this.fuelStack.getItem().getRecipeRemainder();
            this.fuelStack.decrement(1);
            if (this.fuelStack.isEmpty() && remainder != null) {
                this.fuelStack = new ItemStack(remainder);
            }
            syncState();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public ItemStack findResourceUnderneath(World world, BlockPos masterPos, Direction facing) {
        BlockPos targetPos = findActiveOrePosUnderneath(world, masterPos, facing);
        if (targetPos == null) {
            return ItemStack.EMPTY;
        }
        return mapOreBlockToProduct(world.getBlockState(targetPos).getBlock());
    }

    private static ItemStack mapOreBlockToProduct(Block block) {
        if (block instanceof ResourceOreBlock customOre) {
            return customOre.createProductStack(1);
        }
        if (block == Blocks.COAL_ORE || block == Blocks.DEEPSLATE_COAL_ORE || block == Blocks.COAL_BLOCK) {
            return new ItemStack(Items.COAL);
        }
        if (block == Blocks.IRON_ORE || block == Blocks.DEEPSLATE_IRON_ORE || block == Blocks.RAW_IRON_BLOCK) {
            return new ItemStack(Items.RAW_IRON);
        }
        if (block == Blocks.COPPER_ORE || block == Blocks.DEEPSLATE_COPPER_ORE || block == Blocks.RAW_COPPER_BLOCK) {
            return new ItemStack(Items.RAW_COPPER);
        }
        if (block == Blocks.GOLD_ORE || block == Blocks.DEEPSLATE_GOLD_ORE || block == Blocks.NETHER_GOLD_ORE || block == Blocks.RAW_GOLD_BLOCK) {
            return new ItemStack(Items.RAW_GOLD);
        }
        if (block == Blocks.REDSTONE_ORE || block == Blocks.DEEPSLATE_REDSTONE_ORE) {
            return new ItemStack(Items.REDSTONE);
        }
        if (block == Blocks.LAPIS_ORE || block == Blocks.DEEPSLATE_LAPIS_ORE) {
            return new ItemStack(Items.LAPIS_LAZULI);
        }
        if (block == Blocks.DIAMOND_ORE || block == Blocks.DEEPSLATE_DIAMOND_ORE) {
            return new ItemStack(Items.DIAMOND);
        }
        if (block == Blocks.EMERALD_ORE || block == Blocks.DEEPSLATE_EMERALD_ORE) {
            return new ItemStack(Items.EMERALD);
        }
        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
    }

    private boolean tryExportOutput(World world, BlockPos masterPos, Direction facing) {
        if (this.outputStack.isEmpty()) return false;

        BlockPos primaryTarget = BurnerDrillBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, 3, false).offset(facing);
        if (tryExportToPos(world, primaryTarget, facing)) {
            return true;
        }

        BlockPos secondaryTarget = BurnerDrillBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, 2, false).offset(facing);
        return tryExportToPos(world, secondaryTarget, facing);
    }

    private boolean tryExportToPos(World world, BlockPos targetPos, Direction drillFacing) {
        BlockEntity directBe = world.getBlockEntity(targetPos);

        if (directBe instanceof BeltBlockEntity belt) {
            Direction beltFacing = belt.getCachedState().get(BeltBlock.FACING);
            boolean inserted = false;

            if (beltFacing == drillFacing) {
                BeltLane rightLane = belt.getRightLane();
                if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(0) && rightLane.insertAt(0, this.outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                } else if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(1) && rightLane.insertAt(1, this.outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                }
            } else if (beltFacing == drillFacing.getOpposite()) {
                BeltLane lane = belt.getLeftLane();
                if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(3) && lane.insertAt(3, this.outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                }
            } else if (beltFacing == drillFacing.rotateYClockwise()) {
                BeltLane nearLane = belt.getRightLane();
                if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(1) && nearLane.insertAt(1, this.outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                } else if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(2) && nearLane.insertAt(2, this.outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                }
            } else if (beltFacing == drillFacing.rotateYCounterclockwise()) {
                BeltLane nearLane = belt.getLeftLane();
                if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(1) && nearLane.insertAt(1, this.outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                } else if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(2) && nearLane.insertAt(2, this.outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                }
            }

            if (inserted) {
                this.outputStack.decrement(1);
                if (this.outputStack.isEmpty()) this.outputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
                BeltBlock.syncManualChange(world, targetPos, belt.getCachedState(), belt);
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        BlockState targetState = world.getBlockState(targetPos);
        BlockPos canonicalPos = BlockHealthManager.getCanonicalPos(targetPos, targetState);
        BlockEntity be = world.getBlockEntity(canonicalPos);

        if (be instanceof BurnerDrillBlockEntity otherDrill) {
            BurnerDrillBlockEntity targetMaster = otherDrill.getMaster();
            if (targetMaster != this && AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(this.outputStack)) {
                if (insertSingleWithLimit(targetMaster, FUEL_SLOT, this.outputStack, InserterBlockEntity.BURNER_FUEL_LIMIT)) {
                    targetMaster.wakeUp();
                    targetMaster.syncState();
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        if (be instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity factorioFurnace) {
            int targetSlot = AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(this.outputStack) ? 1 : 0;
            int limit = (targetSlot == 1) ? InserterBlockEntity.BURNER_FUEL_LIMIT : InserterBlockEntity.FURNACE_INPUT_LIMIT;
            if (insertSingleWithLimit(factorioFurnace, targetSlot, this.outputStack, limit)) {
                factorioFurnace.wakeUp();
                factorioFurnace.syncState();
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        if (be instanceof AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity furnace) {
            int targetSlot = AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(this.outputStack) ? 1 : 0;
            int limit = (targetSlot == 1) ? InserterBlockEntity.BURNER_FUEL_LIMIT : InserterBlockEntity.FURNACE_INPUT_LIMIT;
            return insertSingleWithLimit(furnace, targetSlot, this.outputStack, limit);
        }

        if (be instanceof InserterBlockEntity inserter && inserter.isBurner()) {
            if (AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(this.outputStack)) {
                return insertSingleWithLimit(inserter, InserterBlockEntity.FUEL_SLOT_INDEX, this.outputStack, InserterBlockEntity.BURNER_FUEL_LIMIT);
            }
            return false;
        }

        Inventory inv = null;
        if (targetState.getBlock() instanceof ChestBlock chestBlock && be instanceof ChestBlockEntity) {
            inv = ChestBlock.getInventory(chestBlock, targetState, world, canonicalPos, true);
        } else if (be instanceof Inventory genericInv && !(be instanceof InserterBlockEntity)) {
            inv = genericInv;
        }

        if (inv != null) {
            for (int i = 0; i < inv.size(); i++) {
                if (insertSingleWithLimit(inv, i, this.outputStack, this.outputStack.getMaxCount())) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private boolean insertSingleWithLimit(Inventory inv, int slot, ItemStack sourceStack, int limit) {
        if (sourceStack.isEmpty() || !inv.isValid(slot, sourceStack)) {
            return false;
        }
        ItemStack current = inv.getStack(slot);
        int maxAllowed = Math.min(limit, Math.min(inv.getMaxCount(sourceStack), sourceStack.getMaxCount()));

        if (current.isEmpty()) {
            inv.setStack(slot, sourceStack.split(1));
            if (this.outputStack.isEmpty()) this.outputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
            inv.markDirty();
            return true;
        } else if (ItemStack.areItemsAndComponentsEqual(current, sourceStack) && current.getCount() < maxAllowed) {
            current.increment(1);
            sourceStack.decrement(1);
            if (this.outputStack.isEmpty()) this.outputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
            inv.markDirty();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public void syncState() {
        markDirty();
        if (this.world != null) {
            this.world.updateListeners(this.pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_LISTENERS);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int size() {
        return 2;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isValid(int slot, ItemStack stack) {
        return slot == FUEL_SLOT && AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(stack);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isEmpty() {
        BurnerDrillBlockEntity m = getMaster();
        return m.fuelStack.isEmpty() && m.outputStack.isEmpty();
    }

    @Override
    public ItemStack getStack(int slot) {
        BurnerDrillBlockEntity m = getMaster();
        return switch (slot) {
            case FUEL_SLOT -> m.fuelStack;
            case OUTPUT_SLOT -> m.outputStack;
            default -> ItemStack.EMPTY;
        };
    }

    @Override
    public ItemStack removeStack(int slot, int amount) {
        BurnerDrillBlockEntity m = getMaster();
        if (slot == FUEL_SLOT) {
            ItemStack res = m.fuelStack.split(amount);
            if (m.fuelStack.isEmpty()) m.fuelStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
            m.wakeUp();
            m.syncState();
            return res;
        } else if (slot == OUTPUT_SLOT) {
            ItemStack res = m.outputStack.split(amount);
            if (m.outputStack.isEmpty()) m.outputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
            m.wakeUp();
            m.syncState();
            return res;
        }
        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
    }

    @Override
    public ItemStack removeStack(int slot) {
        return removeStack(slot, 64);
    }

    @Override
    public void setStack(int slot, ItemStack stack) {
        BurnerDrillBlockEntity m = getMaster();
        if (slot == FUEL_SLOT) {
            m.fuelStack = stack;
        } else if (slot == OUTPUT_SLOT) {
            m.outputStack = stack;
        }
        m.wakeUp();
        m.syncState();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canPlayerUse(PlayerEntity player) {
        return Inventory.canPlayerUse(getMaster(), player, 10.0F);
    }

    @Override
    public void clear() {
        BurnerDrillBlockEntity m = getMaster();
        m.fuelStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        m.outputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        m.wakeUp();
        m.syncState();
    }

    public ItemStack getFuelStack() {
        return getMaster().fuelStack;
    }

    public ItemStack getOutputStack() {
        return getMaster().outputStack;
    }

    @Override
    public Text getDisplayName() {
        return Text.translatable("block.factoriocore.burner_mining_drill");
    }

    @Override
    public ScreenHandler createMenu(int syncId, PlayerInventory playerInventory, PlayerEntity player) {
        BurnerDrillBlockEntity master = getMaster();
        return new BurnerDrillScreenHandler(syncId, playerInventory, master, master.propertyDelegate);
    }

    @Override
    public BlockPos getScreenOpeningData(ServerPlayerEntity player) {
        return getMaster().getPos();
    }

    @Override
    protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
        if (!this.fuelStack.isEmpty()) {
            nbt.put("FuelStack", this.fuelStack.encode(registries));
        }
        if (!this.outputStack.isEmpty()) {
            nbt.put("OutputStack", this.outputStack.encode(registries));
        }
        nbt.putInt("BurnTime", this.burnTime);
        nbt.putInt("MaxBurnTime", this.maxBurnTime);
        nbt.putInt("MiningProgress", this.miningProgress);
        nbt.putBoolean("Sleeping", this.sleeping);
    }

    @Override
    protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
        this.fuelStack = nbt.contains("FuelStack")
                ? ItemStack.fromNbtOrEmpty(registries, nbt.getCompound("FuelStack"))
                : ItemStack.EMPTY;
        this.outputStack = nbt.contains("OutputStack")
                ? ItemStack.fromNbtOrEmpty(registries, nbt.getCompound("OutputStack"))
                : ItemStack.EMPTY;
        this.burnTime = nbt.getInt("BurnTime");
        this.maxBurnTime = nbt.getInt("MaxBurnTime");
        this.miningProgress = nbt.getInt("MiningProgress");
        this.sleeping = nbt.getBoolean("Sleeping");
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public Packet<ClientPlayPacketListener> toUpdatePacket() {
        return BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket.create(this);
    }

    @Override
    public NbtCompound toInitialChunkDataNbt(RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        return createNbt(registries);
    }

                if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, 2, this.slots.size(), true)) {
                    return ItemStack.EMPTY;

                    return ItemStack.EMPTY;
                }
            }

            if (originalStack.isEmpty()) {
                slot.setStack(ItemStack.EMPTY);
            } else {
                slot.markDirty();
            }
        }
        return newStack;
    }

    public static BlockPos getPartPos(BlockPos masterPos, Direction facing, int part, boolean upper) {
        int wOff = (part % 3) - 1;
        int dOff = (part / 3) - 1;
        Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
        BlockPos base = masterPos.offset(right, wOff).offset(facing, dOff);
        return upper ? base.up() : base;
    }

    public static BlockPos getMasterPos(BlockPos currentPos, BlockState state) {
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof ElectricDrillBlock)) return currentPos;
        Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
        int part = state.get(PART);
        boolean upper = state.get(UPPER);
        int wOff = (part % 3) - 1;
        int dOff = (part / 3) - 1;
        Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
        BlockPos base = upper ? currentPos.down() : currentPos;
        return base.offset(right, -wOff).offset(facing, -dOff);
    }

            public static boolean hasOreInFootprint(World world, BlockPos originPos, Direction facing) {
        // ÐŸÑ€Ð¾Ð²ÐµÑ€ÑÐµÐ¼ Ð²ÑÑŽ Ð·Ð¾Ð½Ñƒ ÐºÐ¾Ð¿Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ñ 5x5 Ð²Ð¾ÐºÑ€ÑƒÐ³ Ñ†ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ñ€Ð° ÑÐ»ÐµÐºÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ð±ÑƒÑ€Ð° (Ñ€Ð°Ð´Ð¸ÑƒÑ 2 Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ°)
        for (int dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -2; dz <= 2; dz++) {
                for (int dy = -2; dy <= 0; dy++) {
                    BlockPos checkPos = originPos.add(dx, dy, dz);
                    if (world.getBlockState(checkPos).getBlock() instanceof com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.world.ore.ResourceOreBlock) {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockState getPlacementState(ItemPlacementContext ctx) {
        Direction facing = ctx.getHorizontalPlayerFacing().getOpposite();
        if (ctx.getPlayer() != null && ctx.getPlayer().isSneaking()) {
            facing = facing.getOpposite();
        }
        BlockPos masterPos = ctx.getBlockPos();
        World world = ctx.getWorld();

        for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
            for (int yOff = 0; yOff <= 2; yOff++) {
                BlockPos checkPos = getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, false).up(yOff);
                if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(checkPos) || !world.getBlockState(checkPos).canReplace(ctx)) {
                    return null;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!hasOreInFootprint(world, masterPos, facing)) return null;
        return this.getDefaultState().with(FACING, facing).with(PART, 4).with(UPPER, false);
    }

    @Override
    public void onPlaced(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, @Nullable LivingEntity placer, ItemStack itemStack) {
        super.onPlaced(world, pos, state, placer, itemStack);
        if (!world.isClient && state.get(PART) == 4 && !state.get(UPPER)) {
            Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    if (part == 4 && u == 0) continue;
                    BlockPos p = getPartPos(pos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    world.setBlockState(p, state.with(PART, part).with(UPPER, u == 1), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public BlockState onBreak(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, PlayerEntity player) {
        if (!world.isClient) {
            BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
            Direction facing = state.get(FACING);

            if (world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof ElectricDrillBlockEntity drillBe) {
                ItemStack out = drillBe.getOutputStack();
                if (!out.isEmpty()) {
                    ItemScatterer.spawn(world, masterPos.getX() + 0.5, masterPos.getY() + 0.5, masterPos.getZ() + 0.5, out.copy());
                    drillBe.clearOutput();
                }
            }

            for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (!p.equals(pos) && world.getBlockState(p).isOf(this)) {
                        world.setBlockState(p, Blocks.AIR.getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL | Block.SKIP_DROPS);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return super.onBreak(world, pos, state, player);
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockEntity createBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (state.get(PART) != 4 || state.get(UPPER)) return null;
        return new ElectricDrillBlockEntity(pos, state);
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public <T extends BlockEntity> BlockEntityTicker<T> getTicker(World world, BlockState state, BlockEntityType<T> type) {
        if (state.get(PART) != 4 || state.get(UPPER)) return null;
        return validateTicker(type, ModBlocks.ELECTRIC_DRILL_BLOCK_ENTITY,
                world.isClient ? ElectricDrillBlockEntity::clientTick : ElectricDrillBlockEntity::tick);
    }

    public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, ElectricDrillBlockEntity drill) {
        if (world == null || world.isClient) return;

        Direction facing = state.get(ElectricDrillBlock.FACING);

        // 1. Ð’Ñ‹Ð³Ñ€ÑƒÐ·ÐºÐ° Ð´Ð¾Ð±Ñ‹Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¹ Ñ€ÑƒÐ´Ñ‹ Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´ Ñ†ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ñ€Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ð¼ Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð½Ð¸Ð¼ Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ¾Ð¼ (offset(facing, 2))
        if (!drill.outputStack.isEmpty()) {
            BlockPos frontOutPos = pos.offset(facing, 2);
            if (drill.tryExportToPos(world, frontOutPos, facing)) {
                drill.sync();
            }
            if (drill.outputStack.getCount() >= drill.outputStack.getMaxCount()) {
                return;
            }
        }

        // 2. ÐŸÑ€Ð¾Ð²ÐµÑ€ÐºÐ° Ð¿Ð¸Ñ‚Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ñ 90 kW Ð¾Ñ‚ ÑÐµÑ‚Ð¸ Ð›Ð­ÐŸ
        boolean hasPower = PowerNetworkManager.isMachinePowered(world, pos);
        if (drill.powered != hasPower) {
            drill.powered = hasPower;
            drill.sync();
        }
        if (!hasPower) {
            return;
        }

        // 3. ÐŸÐ¾Ð¸ÑÐº Ñ€ÑƒÐ´Ñ‹ Ð² Ð·Ð¾Ð½Ðµ 5x5 Ð¿Ð¾Ð´ ÑÐ»ÐµÐºÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ð±ÑƒÑ€Ð¾Ð¼
        BlockPos orePos = drill.findOreIn5x5Area(world, pos);
                if (orePos == null) {
            drill.miningProgress = 0;
            if (drill.activelyMining) {
                drill.activelyMining = false;
                drill.sync();
            }
            return;
        }
        if (!drill.activelyMining) {
            drill.activelyMining = true;
            drill.sync();
        }

        Block oreBlock = world.getBlockState(orePos).getBlock();
        if (!(oreBlock instanceof ResourceOreBlock customOre)) {
            return;
        }
        ItemStack product = customOre.createProductStack(1);

        drill.miningProgress++;
        if (drill.miningProgress >= MINING_TIME_TICKS) {
            drill.miningProgress = 0;
            drill.resourceCycleIndex++;

            ResourceOreBlock.consumeOreAt(world, orePos, 1);

            if (drill.outputStack.isEmpty()) {
                drill.outputStack = product.copy();
            } else if (ItemStack.areItemsAndComponentsEqual(drill.outputStack, product)) {
                drill.outputStack.increment(1);
            }

            drill.tryExportToPos(world, pos.offset(facing, 2), facing);
            drill.sync();
        }
    }

    @Nullable
    public BlockPos findOreIn5x5Area(World world, BlockPos masterPos) {
        List<BlockPos> found = new ArrayList<>(25);
        for (int dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -2; dz <= 2; dz++) {
                BlockPos groundPos = masterPos.add(dx, -1, dz);
                if (world.getBlockState(groundPos).getBlock() instanceof ResourceOreBlock) {
                    found.add(groundPos);
                }
            }
        }
        if (found.isEmpty()) return null;
        return found.get(Math.floorMod(this.resourceCycleIndex, found.size()));
    }

    private boolean tryExportToPos(World world, BlockPos targetPos, Direction drillFacing) {
        if (this.outputStack.isEmpty()) return false;
        BlockEntity directBe = world.getBlockEntity(targetPos);

        // 1. Ð’Ñ‹Ð³Ñ€ÑƒÐ·ÐºÐ° Ð½Ð° ÐºÐ¾Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ¹ÐµÑ€ ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ Ð½Ð° Ð‘Ð›Ð˜Ð–ÐÐ®Ð® Ðº Ð±ÑƒÑ€Ñƒ Ð´Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ð¶ÐºÑƒ!
        if (directBe instanceof BeltBlockEntity belt) {
            Direction beltFacing = belt.getCachedState().get(BeltBlock.FACING);
            boolean inserted = false;

            if (beltFacing == drillFacing) {
                // ÐšÐ¾Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ¹ÐµÑ€ ÑƒÑ…Ð¾Ð´Ð¸Ñ‚ Ð¿Ñ€ÑÐ¼Ð¾ Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð±ÑƒÑ€Ð° -> ÐºÐ»Ð°Ð´Ñ‘Ð¼ Ð½Ð° Ð¿Ñ€Ð°Ð²ÑƒÑŽ Ð´Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ð¶ÐºÑƒ
                BeltLane rightLane = belt.getRightLane();
                if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(0) && rightLane.insertAt(0, this.outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                } else if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(1) && rightLane.insertAt(1, this.outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                }
            } else if (beltFacing == drillFacing.getOpposite()) {
                // ÐšÐ¾Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ¹ÐµÑ€ Ð¸Ð´Ñ‘Ñ‚ Ð½Ð°Ð²ÑÑ‚Ñ€ÐµÑ‡Ñƒ Ð±ÑƒÑ€Ñƒ -> Ð¿Ñ€Ð°Ð²Ð°Ñ ÑÑ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ð½Ð° Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð±ÑƒÑ€Ð° ÑÐ¾Ð¾Ñ‚Ð²ÐµÑ‚ÑÑ‚Ð²ÑƒÐµÑ‚ Ð»ÐµÐ²Ð¾Ð¹ Ð´Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ð¶ÐºÐµ Ð»ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ñ‹
                BeltLane lane = belt.getLeftLane();
                if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(3) && lane.insertAt(3, this.outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                }
            } else if (beltFacing == drillFacing.rotateYClockwise()) {
                // ÐšÐ¾Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ¹ÐµÑ€ Ð¸Ð´Ñ‘Ñ‚ ÑÐ»ÐµÐ²Ð° Ð½Ð°Ð¿Ñ€Ð°Ð²Ð¾ Ð¿Ð¾Ð¿ÐµÑ€Ñ‘Ðº Ð±ÑƒÑ€Ð° -> Ð±Ð»Ð¸Ð¶Ð½ÑÑ Ðº Ð±ÑƒÑ€Ñƒ Ð´Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ð¶ÐºÐ° ÐŸÐ ÐÐ’ÐÐ¯ (rightLane)!
                BeltLane nearLane = belt.getRightLane();
                if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(1) && nearLane.insertAt(1, this.outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                } else if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(2) && nearLane.insertAt(2, this.outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                }
            } else if (beltFacing == drillFacing.rotateYCounterclockwise()) {
                // ÐšÐ¾Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ¹ÐµÑ€ Ð¸Ð´Ñ‘Ñ‚ ÑÐ¿Ñ€Ð°Ð²Ð° Ð½Ð°Ð»ÐµÐ²Ð¾ Ð¿Ð¾Ð¿ÐµÑ€Ñ‘Ðº Ð±ÑƒÑ€Ð° -> Ð±Ð»Ð¸Ð¶Ð½ÑÑ Ðº Ð±ÑƒÑ€Ñƒ Ð´Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ð¶ÐºÐ° Ð›Ð•Ð’ÐÐ¯ (leftLane)!
                BeltLane nearLane = belt.getLeftLane();
                if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(1) && nearLane.insertAt(1, this.outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                } else if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(2) && nearLane.insertAt(2, this.outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                }
            }

            if (inserted) {
                this.outputStack.decrement(1);
                if (this.outputStack.isEmpty()) this.outputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
                BeltBlock.syncManualChange(world, targetPos, belt.getCachedState(), belt);
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        BlockState targetState = world.getBlockState(targetPos);
        BlockPos canonicalPos = BlockHealthManager.getCanonicalPos(targetPos, targetState);
        BlockEntity be = world.getBlockEntity(canonicalPos);

        if (be instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity furnace) {
            int slot = AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(this.outputStack) ? 1 : 0;
            ItemStack cur = furnace.getStack(slot);
            if (cur.isEmpty()) {
                furnace.setStack(slot, this.outputStack.split(1));
                if (this.outputStack.isEmpty()) this.outputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
                return true;
            } else if (ItemStack.areItemsAndComponentsEqual(cur, this.outputStack) && cur.getCount() < InserterBlockEntity.FURNACE_INPUT_LIMIT) {
                cur.increment(1);
                this.outputStack.decrement(1);
                if (this.outputStack.isEmpty()) this.outputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
                furnace.syncState();
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        Inventory inv = null;
        if (targetState.getBlock() instanceof ChestBlock chestBlock && be instanceof ChestBlockEntity) {
            inv = ChestBlock.getInventory(chestBlock, targetState, world, canonicalPos, true);
        } else if (be instanceof Inventory genericInv) {
            inv = genericInv;
        }
        if (inv != null) {
            for (int i = 0; i < inv.size(); i++) {
                if (!inv.isValid(i, this.outputStack)) continue;
                ItemStack cur = inv.getStack(i);
                if (cur.isEmpty()) {
                    inv.setStack(i, this.outputStack.split(1));
                    if (this.outputStack.isEmpty()) this.outputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
                    inv.markDirty();
                    return true;
                } else if (ItemStack.areItemsAndComponentsEqual(cur, this.outputStack) && cur.getCount() < cur.getMaxCount()) {
                    cur.increment(1);
                    this.outputStack.decrement(1);
                    if (this.outputStack.isEmpty()) this.outputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
                    inv.markDirty();
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public void sync() {
        markDirty();
        if (this.world != null && !this.world.isClient) {
            this.world.updateListeners(this.pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
        if (!this.outputStack.isEmpty()) nbt.put("OutputStack", this.outputStack.encode(registries));
        nbt.putInt("MiningProgress", this.miningProgress);
        nbt.putBoolean("Powered", this.powered);
        nbt.putBoolean("ActivelyMining", this.activelyMining);
    }

    @Override
    protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
        this.outputStack = nbt.contains("OutputStack")
                ? ItemStack.fromNbtOrEmpty(registries, nbt.getCompound("OutputStack")) : ItemStack.EMPTY;
        this.miningProgress = nbt.getInt("MiningProgress");
        this.powered = nbt.getBoolean("Powered");
        this.activelyMining = nbt.getBoolean("ActivelyMining");
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public Packet<ClientPlayPacketListener> toUpdatePacket() {
        return BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket.create(this);
    }

    @Override
    public NbtCompound toInitialChunkDataNbt(RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        return createNbt(registries);
    }
}

public class FactorioFurnaceBlock extends BlockWithEntity {
    public static final MapCodec<FactorioFurnaceBlock> CODEC = createCodec(s -> new FactorioFurnaceBlock(s, 1));
    public static final DirectionProperty FACING = Properties.HORIZONTAL_FACING;
    public static final IntProperty PART = IntProperty.of("part", 0, 3);
    public static final BooleanProperty UPPER = BooleanProperty.of("upper");

    private static final VoxelShape BOTTOM_SHAPE = Block.createCuboidShape(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 16.0, 16.0);
    private static final VoxelShape TOP_SHAPE = Block.createCuboidShape(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 24.0, 16.0);

    // 1 = ÐšÐ°Ð¼ÐµÐ½Ð½Ð°Ñ Ð¿ÐµÑ‡ÑŒ (0.3125/ÑÐµÐº -> 64 Ñ‚Ð¸ÐºÐ°), 2 = Ð¡Ñ‚Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ð°Ñ Ð¿ÐµÑ‡ÑŒ (0.625/ÑÐµÐº -> 32 Ñ‚Ð¸ÐºÐ°)
    private final int tier;

    public FactorioFurnaceBlock(Settings settings, int tier) {
        super(settings);
        this.tier = tier;
        this.setDefaultState(this.stateManager.getDefaultState()
                .with(FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                .with(PART, 0)
                .with(UPPER, false));
    }

    public int getTier() {
        return this.tier;
    }

    @Override
    protected MapCodec<? extends BlockWithEntity> getCodec() {
        return CODEC;
    }

    @Override
    protected void appendProperties(StateManager.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
        builder.add(FACING, PART, UPPER);
    }

    @Override
    protected VoxelShape getOutlineShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        return state.get(UPPER) ? TOP_SHAPE : BOTTOM_SHAPE;
    }

    @Override
    protected VoxelShape getCollisionShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        return state.get(UPPER) ? TOP_SHAPE : BOTTOM_SHAPE;
    }

    protected BlockRenderType getRenderType(BlockState state) {
        return BlockRenderType.INVISIBLE;
    }

    protected float getAmbientOcclusionLightLevel(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos) {
        return 1.0f;
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean isTransparent(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos) {
        return true;
    }

    public static BlockPos getPartPos(BlockPos masterPos, Direction facing, int part, boolean upper) {
        Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
        BlockPos base = switch (part) {
            case 1 -> masterPos.offset(right);
            case 2 -> masterPos.offset(facing);
            case 3 -> masterPos.offset(facing).offset(right);
            default -> masterPos;
        };
        return upper ? base.up() : base;
    }

    public static BlockPos getMasterPos(BlockPos currentPos, BlockState state) {
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlock)) {
            return currentPos;
        }
        Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
        Direction left = facing.rotateYCounterclockwise();
        Direction back = facing.getOpposite();
        int part = state.get(PART);
        boolean upper = state.get(UPPER);

        BlockPos base = upper ? currentPos.down() : currentPos;
        return switch (part) {
            case 1 -> base.offset(left);
            case 2 -> base.offset(back);
            case 3 -> base.offset(back).offset(left);
            default -> base;
        };
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockState getPlacementState(ItemPlacementContext ctx) {
        Direction facing = ctx.getHorizontalPlayerFacing().getOpposite();
        if (ctx.getPlayer() != null && ctx.getPlayer().isSneaking()) {
            facing = facing.getOpposite();
        }
        BlockPos masterPos = ctx.getBlockPos();
        World world = ctx.getWorld();

        for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
            for (int yOff = 0; yOff <= 2; yOff++) {
                BlockPos checkPos = getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, false).up(yOff);
                if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(checkPos) || !world.getBlockState(checkPos).canReplace(ctx)) {
                    return null;
                }
            }
        }
        return this.getDefaultState().with(FACING, facing).with(PART, 0).with(UPPER, false);
    }

    @Override
    public void onPlaced(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, @Nullable LivingEntity placer, ItemStack itemStack) {
        super.onPlaced(world, pos, state, placer, itemStack);
        if (!world.isClient && state.get(PART) == 0 && !state.get(UPPER)) {
            Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    if (part == 0 && u == 0) continue;
                    boolean isUpper = (u == 1);
                    BlockPos partPos = getPartPos(pos, facing, part, isUpper);
                    world.setBlockState(partPos, state.with(PART, part).with(UPPER, isUpper), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public BlockState onBreak(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, PlayerEntity player) {
        if (!world.isClient) {
            BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
            Direction facing = state.get(FACING);

            if (world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity masterBe) {
                for (int i = 0; i < masterBe.size(); i++) {
                    ItemStack stack = masterBe.getStack(i);
                    if (!stack.isEmpty()) {
                        ItemScatterer.spawn(world, masterPos.getX() + 1.0, masterPos.getY() + 0.5, masterPos.getZ() + 1.0, stack.copy());
                        masterBe.setStack(i, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos partPos = getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (!partPos.equals(pos) && world.getBlockState(partPos).isOf(this)) {
                        world.setBlockState(partPos, Blocks.AIR.getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL | Block.SKIP_DROPS);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return super.onBreak(world, pos, state, player);
    }

    @Override
    protected ActionResult onUse(BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos, PlayerEntity player, BlockHitResult hit) {
        if (!world.isClient) {
            BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
            if (world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity masterBe) {
                player.openHandledScreen(masterBe);
            }
        }
        return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
    }

    @Override
    protected void neighborUpdate(BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos, Block sourceBlock, BlockPos sourcePos, boolean notify) {
        super.neighborUpdate(state, world, pos, sourceBlock, sourcePos, notify);
        if (!world.isClient) {
            BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
            if (world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity masterBe) {
                masterBe.wakeUp();
            }
        }
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockEntity createBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (state.get(PART) != 0 || state.get(UPPER)) { return null; } return new FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity(pos, state);
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public <T extends BlockEntity> BlockEntityTicker<T> getTicker(World world, BlockState state, BlockEntityType<T> type) {
        if (state.get(PART) != 0 || state.get(UPPER)) {
            return null;
        }
        return validateTicker(type, ModBlocks.FACTORIO_FURNACE_BLOCK_ENTITY,
                world.isClient ? null : FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity::tick);
    }

    @Override
    protected float calcBlockBreakingDelta(net.minecraft.block.BlockState state, net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity player, net.minecraft.world.BlockView world, net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos pos) {
        return 0.10f;
    }
}

        }
    };

    public FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.FACTORIO_FURNACE_BLOCK_ENTITY, pos, state);
    }

    public int getTier() {
        BlockState state = getCachedState();
        if (state.getBlock() instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlock furnaceBlock) {
            return furnaceBlock.getTier();
        }
        return 1;
    }

    public int getRequiredCookTime() {
        return (getTier() >= 2) ? STEEL_SMELT_TICKS : STONE_SMELT_TICKS;
    }

    public FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity getMaster() {
        if (this.world == null) return this;
        BlockState state = getCachedState();
        if (state.getBlock() instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlock) {
            if (state.get(FactorioFurnaceBlock.PART) == 0 && !state.get(FactorioFurnaceBlock.UPPER)) {
                return this;
            }
            BlockPos masterPos = FactorioFurnaceBlock.getMasterPos(this.pos, state);
            if (this.world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity master) {
                return master;
            }
        }
        return this;
    }

    public void wakeUp() {
        FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity master = getMaster();
        if (master.sleeping) {
            master.sleeping = false;
        }
    }

    public boolean isBurning() {
        return getMaster().burnTime > 0 && !getMaster().sleeping;
    }

    public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity entity) {
        if (world == null || world.isClient) return;

        if (entity.sleeping) {
            if (world.getTime() % 10 != 0) {
                return;
            }
            entity.sleeping = false;
        }

        if (entity.inputStack.isEmpty()) {
            entity.cookTime = 0;
            entity.sleeping = true;
            entity.syncState();
            return;
        }

        ItemStack recipeResult = getSmeltingResult(world, entity.inputStack);
        if (recipeResult.isEmpty() || !canAcceptOutput(entity.outputStack, recipeResult)) {
            entity.cookTime = 0;
            entity.sleeping = true;
            entity.syncState();
            return;
        }

        if (!entity.ensureFuel()) {
            entity.sleeping = true;
            entity.syncState();
            return;
        }

        // Ð’ Factorio Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¿Ð»Ð¸Ð²Ð¾ Ñ‚Ñ€Ð°Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ‚ÑÑ Ñ‚Ð¾Ð»ÑŒÐºÐ¾ Ð²Ð¾ Ð²Ñ€ÐµÐ¼Ñ Ð°ÐºÑ‚Ð¸Ð²Ð½Ð¾Ð¹ Ð¿Ð»Ð°Ð²ÐºÐ¸ (0.0225 ÑƒÐ³Ð»Ñ/ÑÐµÐº)
        entity.burnTime--;
        entity.cookTime++;

        int requiredTicks = entity.getRequiredCookTime();
        if (entity.cookTime >= requiredTicks) {
            entity.cookTime = 0;
            entity.inputStack.decrement(1);
            if (entity.inputStack.isEmpty()) {
                entity.inputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
            }

            if (entity.outputStack.isEmpty()) {
                entity.outputStack = recipeResult.copy();
            } else {
                entity.outputStack.increment(recipeResult.getCount());
            }

            wakeUpSurroundingInserters(world, pos, state);
            entity.syncState();
        }
    }

    public static void wakeUpSurroundingInserters(World world, BlockPos masterPos, BlockState state) {
        if (world == null || world.isClient) return;
        Direction facing = state.contains(FactorioFurnaceBlock.FACING) ? state.get(FactorioFurnaceBlock.FACING) : Direction.NORTH;
        for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
            BlockPos partPos = FactorioFurnaceBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, false);
            InserterBlockEntity.wakeUpAdjacentInserters(world, partPos);
        }
    }

    private boolean ensureFuel() {
        if (this.burnTime > 0) {
            return true;
        }
        if (!this.fuelStack.isEmpty() && AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(this.fuelStack)) {
            Integer vanillaTicks = FuelRegistry.INSTANCE.get(this.fuelStack.getItem());
            int base = (vanillaTicks != null && vanillaTicks > 0) ? vanillaTicks : 1600;
            // ÐœÐ°ÑÑˆÑ‚Ð°Ð±Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÐ¼ Ð¾Ñ‚Ð½Ð¾ÑÐ¸Ñ‚ÐµÐ»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾ ÑƒÐ³Ð»Ñ (1600 Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ñ… Ñ‚Ð¸ÐºÐ¾Ð² -> 889 Ñ‚Ð¸ÐºÐ¾Ð² = 44.44 ÑÐµÐº = 0.0225/ÑÐµÐº)
            int factorioTicks = Math.max(40, Math.round(base * (COAL_BURN_TICKS / 1600.0f)));
            this.burnTime = factorioTicks;
            this.maxBurnTime = factorioTicks;

            Item remainder = this.fuelStack.getItem().getRecipeRemainder();
            this.fuelStack.decrement(1);
            if (this.fuelStack.isEmpty()) {
                this.fuelStack = (remainder != null) ? new ItemStack(remainder) : ItemStack.EMPTY;
            }
            syncState();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static ItemStack getSmeltingResult(World world, ItemStack input) { if (input.isOf(Items.IRON_INGOT)) { return new ItemStack(com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModItems.STEEL_PLATE, 1); }
        if (world == null || input.isEmpty()) return ItemStack.EMPTY;
        SingleStackRecipeInput recipeInput = new SingleStackRecipeInput(input);
        Optional<RecipeEntry<SmeltingRecipe>> match = world.getRecipeManager()
                .getFirstMatch(RecipeType.SMELTING, recipeInput, world);
        return match.map(entry -> entry.value().getResult(world.getRegistryManager()).copy())
                .orElse(ItemStack.EMPTY);
    }

    private static boolean canAcceptOutput(ItemStack currentOutput, ItemStack result) {
        if (currentOutput.isEmpty()) return true;
        if (!ItemStack.areItemsAndComponentsEqual(currentOutput, result)) return false;
        return currentOutput.getCount() + result.getCount() <= currentOutput.getMaxCount();
    }

    public void syncState() {
        markDirty();
        if (this.world != null) {
            this.world.updateListeners(this.pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
        }
    }

    // --- Ð ÐµÐ°Ð»Ð¸Ð·Ð°Ñ†Ð¸Ñ SidedInventory (Ð´ÐµÐ»ÐµÐ³Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÑ‚ÑÑ Ð³Ð»Ð°Ð²Ð½Ð¾Ð¼Ñƒ Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÑƒ ÑÑ‚Ñ€ÑƒÐºÑ‚ÑƒÑ€Ñ‹ 2x2) ---

    @Override
    public int size() {
        return 3;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isValid(int slot, ItemStack stack) {
        if (slot == OUTPUT_SLOT) {
            return false;
        }
        if (slot == FUEL_SLOT) {
            return AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(stack);
        }
        return !AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(stack);
    }

    @Override
    public int[] getAvailableSlots(Direction side) {
        if (side == Direction.DOWN) return BOTTOM_SLOTS;
        return side == Direction.UP ? TOP_SLOTS : SIDE_SLOTS;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canInsert(int slot, ItemStack stack, @Nullable Direction dir) {
        return isValid(slot, stack);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canExtract(int slot, ItemStack stack, Direction dir) {
        if (slot == FUEL_SLOT) {
            return stack.isOf(Items.BUCKET);
        }
        return slot == OUTPUT_SLOT;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isEmpty() {
        FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity m = getMaster();
        return m.inputStack.isEmpty() && m.fuelStack.isEmpty() && m.outputStack.isEmpty();
    }

    @Override
    public ItemStack getStack(int slot) {
        FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity m = getMaster();
        return switch (slot) {
            case INPUT_SLOT -> m.inputStack;
            case FUEL_SLOT -> m.fuelStack;
            case OUTPUT_SLOT -> m.outputStack;
            default -> ItemStack.EMPTY;
        };
    }

    @Override
    public ItemStack removeStack(int slot, int amount) {
        FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity m = getMaster();
        ItemStack res = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        if (slot == INPUT_SLOT) {
            res = m.inputStack.split(amount);
            if (m.inputStack.isEmpty()) m.inputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        } else if (slot == FUEL_SLOT) {
            res = m.fuelStack.split(amount);
            if (m.fuelStack.isEmpty()) m.fuelStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        } else if (slot == OUTPUT_SLOT) {
            res = m.outputStack.split(amount);
            if (m.outputStack.isEmpty()) m.outputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        }
        if (!res.isEmpty()) {
            m.wakeUp();
            m.syncState();
            if (m.world != null) {
                wakeUpSurroundingInserters(m.world, m.pos, m.getCachedState());
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    @Override
    public ItemStack removeStack(int slot) {
        return removeStack(slot, 64);
    }

    @Override
    public void setStack(int slot, ItemStack stack) {
        FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity m = getMaster();
        switch (slot) {
            case INPUT_SLOT -> m.inputStack = stack;
            case FUEL_SLOT -> m.fuelStack = stack;
            case OUTPUT_SLOT -> m.outputStack = stack;
        }
        m.wakeUp();
        m.syncState();
        if (m.world != null) {
            wakeUpSurroundingInserters(m.world, m.pos, m.getCachedState());
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canPlayerUse(PlayerEntity player) {
        return Inventory.canPlayerUse(getMaster(), player, 10.0F);
    }

    @Override
    public void clear() {
        FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity m = getMaster();
        m.inputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        m.fuelStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        m.outputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        m.wakeUp();
        m.syncState();
    }

    @Override
    public Text getDisplayName() {
        return getMaster().getCachedState().getBlock().getName();
    }

    @Override
    public ScreenHandler createMenu(int syncId, PlayerInventory playerInventory, PlayerEntity player) {
        FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity master = getMaster();
        return new FactorioFurnaceScreenHandler(syncId, playerInventory, master, master.propertyDelegate);
    }

    @Override
    public BlockPos getScreenOpeningData(ServerPlayerEntity player) {
        return getMaster().getPos();
    }

    @Override
    protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
        if (!this.inputStack.isEmpty()) nbt.put("InputStack", this.inputStack.encode(registries));
        if (!this.fuelStack.isEmpty()) nbt.put("FuelStack", this.fuelStack.encode(registries));
        if (!this.outputStack.isEmpty()) nbt.put("OutputStack", this.outputStack.encode(registries));
        nbt.putInt("BurnTime", this.burnTime);
        nbt.putInt("MaxBurnTime", this.maxBurnTime);
        nbt.putInt("CookTime", this.cookTime);
        nbt.putBoolean("Sleeping", this.sleeping);
    }

    @Override
    protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
        this.inputStack = nbt.contains("InputStack")
                ? ItemStack.fromNbtOrEmpty(registries, nbt.getCompound("InputStack")) : ItemStack.EMPTY;
        this.fuelStack = nbt.contains("FuelStack")
                ? ItemStack.fromNbtOrEmpty(registries, nbt.getCompound("FuelStack")) : ItemStack.EMPTY;
        this.outputStack = nbt.contains("OutputStack")
                ? ItemStack.fromNbtOrEmpty(registries, nbt.getCompound("OutputStack")) : ItemStack.EMPTY;
        this.burnTime = nbt.getInt("BurnTime");
        this.maxBurnTime = nbt.getInt("MaxBurnTime");
        this.cookTime = nbt.getInt("CookTime");
        this.sleeping = nbt.getBoolean("Sleeping");
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public Packet<ClientPlayPacketListener> toUpdatePacket() {
        return BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket.create(this);
    }

    @Override
    public NbtCompound toInitialChunkDataNbt(RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        return createNbt(registries);
    }

        return Math.max(1, this.propertyDelegate.get(3));

        return this.propertyDelegate.get(4) != 0;
    }

        return getBurnTime() > 0 || !this.slots.get(1).getStack().isEmpty();
    }

    @Override
    public ItemStack quickMove(PlayerEntity player, int invSlot) {
        ItemStack newStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        Slot slot = this.slots.get(invSlot);
        if (slot != null && slot.hasStack()) {
            ItemStack originalStack = slot.getStack();
            newStack = originalStack.copy();

            if (invSlot < 3) {
                if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, 3, this.slots.size(), true)) {
                    return ItemStack.EMPTY;
                }
            } else {
                if (AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(originalStack)) {
                    if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, 1, 2, false)) {
                        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
                    }
                } else {
                    if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, 0, 1, false)) {
                        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (originalStack.isEmpty()) {
                slot.setStack(ItemStack.EMPTY);
            } else {
                slot.markDirty();
            }
        }
        return newStack;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canUse(PlayerEntity player) {
        return this.inventory.canPlayerUse(player);
    }

    }

    public static BlockPos getPartPos(BlockPos centerPos, Direction facing, int part, boolean upper) {
        int row = part / 3 - 1;
        int col = part % 3 - 1;
        Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
        BlockPos p = centerPos.offset(facing, row).offset(right, col);
        return upper ? p.up() : p;
    }

    public static BlockPos getMasterPos(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof LabBlock)) return pos;
        int part = state.get(PART);
        Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
        boolean upper = state.get(UPPER);
        int row = part / 3 - 1;
        int col = part % 3 - 1;
        Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
        BlockPos base = upper ? pos.down() : pos;
        return base.offset(facing, -row).offset(right, -col);
    }

    @Nullable

    public BlockState getPlacementState(ItemPlacementContext ctx) {
        World world = ctx.getWorld();
        BlockPos center = ctx.getBlockPos();
        Direction facing = ctx.getHorizontalPlayerFacing().getOpposite();
        for (int p = 0; p < 9; p++) {
            for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                BlockPos check = getPartPos(center, facing, p, u == 1);
                if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(check) || !world.getBlockState(check).canReplace(ctx)) {
                    return null;
                }
            }
        }
        return getDefaultState().with(FACING, facing).with(PART, 4).with(UPPER, false);
    }

    @Override
    public void onPlaced(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, @Nullable LivingEntity placer, ItemStack itemStack) {
        super.onPlaced(world, pos, state, placer, itemStack);
        if (world.isClient) return;
        Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
        for (int p = 0; p < 9; p++) {
            for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                if (p == 4 && u == 0) continue;
                BlockPos partPos = getPartPos(pos, facing, p, u == 1);
                world.setBlockState(partPos, getDefaultState().with(FACING, facing).with(PART, p).with(UPPER, u == 1), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
            }
        }
    }

        BlockPos master = getMasterPos(pos, state);
        BlockState masterState = world.getBlockState(master);
        if (masterState.getBlock() instanceof LabBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(FACING);
            if (!world.isClient && world.getBlockEntity(master) instanceof LabBlockEntity labBe) {
                ItemScatterer.spawn(world, master, labBe);

    @Override

    @Override protected VoxelShape getOutlineShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        return state.get(UPPER) ? UPPER_SHAPE : VoxelShapes.fullCube();
    }

    @Override protected VoxelShape getCollisionShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        return state.get(UPPER) ? UPPER_SHAPE : VoxelShapes.fullCube();
    }

    @Override protected BlockRenderType getRenderType(BlockState state) { return BlockRenderType.INVISIBLE; }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockEntity createBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        return (state.get(PART) == 4 && !state.get(UPPER)) ? new LabBlockEntity(pos, state) : null;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public <T extends BlockEntity> BlockEntityTicker<T> getTicker(World world, BlockState state, BlockEntityType<T> type) {
        if (world.isClient || state.get(PART) != 4 || state.get(UPPER)) return null;
        return validateTicker(type, ModBlocks.LAB_BLOCK_ENTITY, LabBlockEntity::tick);
    }
}
