package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.research;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.electricity.PowerNetworkManager;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModBlocks;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModItems;
import net.minecraft.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.block.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity;
import net.minecraft.inventory.Inventories;
import net.minecraft.inventory.SidedInventory;
import net.minecraft.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.nbt.NbtCompound;
import net.minecraft.network.listener.ClientPlayPacketListener;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.Packet;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.s2c.play.BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket;
import net.minecraft.registry.RegistryWrapper;
import net.minecraft.util.collection.DefaultedList;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Direction;
import net.minecraft.world.World;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

public class LabBlockEntity extends BlockEntity implements SidedInventory {

    public static final long POWER_CONSUMPTION_WATTS = 60_000L;
    private static final int[] SLOTS = new int[]{0, 1, 2, 3};

    // 4 ÑÐ»Ð¾Ñ‚Ð° Ð¿Ð¾Ð´ 4 Ð²Ð¸Ð´Ð° Ð½Ð°ÑƒÑ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ñ… ÐºÐ¾Ð»Ð±Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÐº (ÐšÑ€Ð°ÑÐ½Ð°Ñ, Ð—ÐµÐ»Ñ‘Ð½Ð°Ñ, Ð’Ð¾ÐµÐ½Ð½Ð°Ñ, Ð¥Ð¸Ð¼Ð¸Ñ‡ÐµÑÐºÐ°Ñ)
    private final DefaultedList<ItemStack> inventory = DefaultedList.ofSize(4, ItemStack.EMPTY);
    private boolean isPowered = false;
    private boolean isWorking = false;

    public LabBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.LAB_BLOCK_ENTITY, pos, state);
    }

    public boolean isPowered() { return isPowered; }
    public boolean isWorking() { return isWorking; }

    public static int getSlotForPack(Item item) {
        if (item == ModItems.AUTOMATION_SCIENCE_PACK) return 0;
        if (item == ModItems.LOGISTIC_SCIENCE_PACK) return 1;
        if (item == ModItems.MILITARY_SCIENCE_PACK) return 2;
        if (item == ModItems.CHEMICAL_SCIENCE_PACK) return 3;
        return -1;
    }

    public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, LabBlockEntity be) {
        if (world == null || world.isClient) return;
        if (state.get(LabBlock.PART) != 4 || state.get(LabBlock.UPPER)) return;

        boolean hasPower = PowerNetworkManager.isMachinePowered(world, pos);
        ResearchManager.TechNode activeTech = ResearchManager.getActiveTech();
        boolean canResearch = hasPower && activeTech != null && be.hasRequiredPacks(activeTech);

        if (be.isPowered != hasPower || be.isWorking != canResearch) {
            be.isPowered = hasPower;
            be.isWorking = canResearch;
            be.sync();
        }

        if (canResearch) {
            boolean unitFinished = ResearchManager.advanceResearchTickFromLab(activeTech);
            if (unitFinished) {
                be.consumePacks(activeTech);
                be.sync();
            }
        }
    }

    public boolean hasRequiredPacks(ResearchManager.TechNode tech) {
        if (tech == null) return false;
        for (ResearchManager.SciencePack sp : tech.packs) {
            int slot = sp.ordinal();
            ItemStack st = inventory.get(slot);
            if (st.isEmpty() || !st.isOf(sp.getItem())) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    private void consumePacks(ResearchManager.TechNode tech) {
        for (ResearchManager.SciencePack sp : tech.packs) {
            int slot = sp.ordinal();
            ItemStack st = inventory.get(slot);
            if (!st.isEmpty()) {
                st.decrement(1);
            }
        }
    }

    public void sync() {
        markDirty();
        if (world != null && !world.isClient) {
            world.updateListeners(pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isValid(int slot, ItemStack stack) {
        return getSlotForPack(stack.getItem()) == slot;
    }

    @Override public int[] getAvailableSlots(Direction side) { return SLOTS; }
    @Override public boolean canInsert(int slot, ItemStack stack, @Nullable Direction dir) { return isValid(slot, stack); }
    @Override public boolean canExtract(int slot, ItemStack stack, Direction dir) { return false; }

    @Override public int size() { return inventory.size(); }
    @Override public boolean isEmpty() { return inventory.stream().allMatch(ItemStack::isEmpty); }
    @Override public ItemStack getStack(int slot) { return inventory.get(slot); }
    @Override public ItemStack removeStack(int slot, int amount) { ItemStack r = Inventories.splitStack(inventory, slot, amount); if (!r.isEmpty()) sync(); return r; }
    @Override public ItemStack removeStack(int slot) { ItemStack r = Inventories.removeStack(inventory, slot); if (!r.isEmpty()) sync(); return r; }
    @Override public void setStack(int slot, ItemStack stack) { inventory.set(slot, stack); sync(); }
    @Override public boolean canPlayerUse(PlayerEntity player) { return true; }
    @Override public void clear() { inventory.clear(); sync(); }

    @Override
    protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
        Inventories.writeNbt(nbt, inventory, registries);
        nbt.putBoolean("Powered", isPowered);
        nbt.putBoolean("Working", isWorking);
    }

    @Override
    protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
        Inventories.readNbt(nbt, inventory, registries);
        isPowered = nbt.getBoolean("Powered");
        isWorking = nbt.getBoolean("Working");
    }

    @Nullable @Override public Packet<ClientPlayPacketListener> toUpdatePacket() { return BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket.create(this); }
    @Override public NbtCompound toInitialChunkDataNbt(RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) { return createNbt(registries); }
}

    private static void register(TechNode node) {
        TECHS.add(node);
        for (String recId : node.unlockedRecipeIds) {
            RECIPE_TO_TECH.put(recId, node.id);
        }
    }

    public static TechNode getById(String id) {
        init();
        for (TechNode t : TECHS) {
            if (t.id.equals(id)) return t;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static TechNode getActiveTech() {
        init();
        if (RESEARCH_QUEUE.isEmpty()) return null;
        return getById(RESEARCH_QUEUE.get(0));
    }

    public static boolean isTechResearched(String techId) {
        TechNode t = getById(techId);
        return t != null && t.status == TechStatus.RESEARCHED;
    }

    public static boolean isRecipeUnlocked(String recipeId) {
        init();
        String reqTech = RECIPE_TO_TECH.get(recipeId);
        if (reqTech == null) return true;
        return isTechResearched(reqTech);
    }

    public static void recalculateAvailability() {
        init();
        for (TechNode t : TECHS) {
            if (t.status == TechStatus.RESEARCHED) continue;
            boolean allPreMet = true;
            for (String preId : t.prerequisites) {
                TechNode pre = getById(preId);
                if (pre == null || pre.status != TechStatus.RESEARCHED) {
                    allPreMet = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            t.status = allPreMet ? TechStatus.AVAILABLE : TechStatus.LOCKED;
        }
    }

    public static void queueTech(String techId) {
        TechNode t = getById(techId);
        if (t != null && t.status == TechStatus.AVAILABLE && !RESEARCH_QUEUE.contains(techId)) {
            RESEARCH_QUEUE.add(techId);
        }
    }

    public static void removeQueueAt(int index) {
        if (index >= 0 && index < RESEARCH_QUEUE.size()) {
            RESEARCH_QUEUE.remove(index);
            if (index == 0) currentUnitTickProgress = 0;
        }
    }

    public static void completeImmediately(String techId) {
        TechNode t = getById(techId);
        if (t != null) {
            t.status = TechStatus.RESEARCHED;
            t.completedUnits = t.costCount;
            RESEARCH_QUEUE.remove(techId);
            currentUnitTickProgress = 0;
            recalculateAvailability();
        }
    }

    public static int getTicksPerUnit(TechNode tech) {
        int baseTicks = Math.max(20, tech.timeSeconds * 4);
        if (isTechResearched("research_speed_1")) {
            baseTicks = Math.max(15, (int) (baseTicks * 0.75f));
        }
        return baseTicks;
    }

    /**
     * Ð’Ñ‹Ð·Ñ‹Ð²Ð°ÐµÑ‚ÑÑ Ñ€Ð°Ð±Ð¾Ñ‚Ð°ÑŽÑ‰ÐµÐ¹ Ð›Ð°Ð±Ð¾Ñ€Ð°Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ð¸ÐµÐ¹ ÐºÐ°Ð¶Ð´Ñ‹Ð¹ Ñ‚Ð¸Ðº.
     * Ð’Ð¾Ð·Ð²Ñ€Ð°Ñ‰Ð°ÐµÑ‚ true, ÐµÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð·Ð°Ð²ÐµÑ€ÑˆÐ¸Ð»ÑÑ Ñ†Ð¸ÐºÐ» 1 ÐµÐ´Ð¸Ð½Ð¸Ñ†Ñ‹ Ð¸ÑÑÐ»ÐµÐ´Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ñ (Ð½ÑƒÐ¶Ð½Ð¾ ÑÐ¿Ð¸ÑÐ°Ñ‚ÑŒ Ð¿Ð¾ 1 ÐºÐ¾Ð»Ð±Ðµ ÐºÐ°Ð¶Ð´Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ Ñ‚Ð¸Ð¿Ð°).
     */
    public static boolean advanceResearchTickFromLab(TechNode activeTech) {
        if (activeTech == null || activeTech.status == TechStatus.RESEARCHED) return false;
        currentUnitTickProgress++;
        int neededTicks = getTicksPerUnit(activeTech);
        if (currentUnitTickProgress >= neededTicks) {
            currentUnitTickProgress = 0;
            activeTech.completedUnits++;
            if (activeTech.completedUnits >= activeTech.costCount) {
                activeTech.status = TechStatus.RESEARCHED;
                RESEARCH_QUEUE.remove(activeTech.id);
                recalculateAvailability();
            }
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static float getOverallProgressRatio() {
        TechNode active = getActiveTech();
        if (active == null || active.costCount <= 0) return 0.0f;
        float unitPart = currentUnitTickProgress / (float) getTicksPerUnit(active);
        return Math.min(1.0f, (active.completedUnits + unitPart) / (float) active.costCount);
    }
}

public class ResourceOreBlock extends BlockWithEntity {

    private final int oreType;

    public ResourceOreBlock(Settings settings, int oreType) {
        super(settings);
        this.oreType = oreType;
    }

    public int getOreType() {
        return this.oreType;
    }

    public Item getProductItem() {
        return switch (this.oreType) {
            case 0 -> Items.RAW_IRON;
            case 1 -> Items.RAW_COPPER;
            case 2 -> Items.COAL;
            default -> Items.COBBLESTONE;
        };
    }

    }

        return BlockRenderType.MODEL;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockEntity createBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        return new ResourceOreBlockEntity(pos, state);
    }

    @Override
    protected float calcBlockBreakingDelta(BlockState state, PlayerEntity player, BlockView world, BlockPos pos) {
        return 0.10f;
    }

    public static void broadcastOreAmount(World world, BlockPos pos, int amount) {
        if (world instanceof ServerWorld serverWorld) {
            SyncOreAmountPayload payload = new SyncOreAmountPayload(pos.toImmutable(), amount);
            for (ServerPlayerEntity player : PlayerLookup.world(serverWorld)) {
                ServerPlayNetworking.send(player, payload);
            }
        }
    }

    public static int consumeOreAt(World world, BlockPos pos, int amount) {
        BlockState state = world.getBlockState(pos);
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof ResourceOreBlock)) {
            return 0;
        }

        BlockEntity be = world.getBlockEntity(pos);
        ResourceOreBlockEntity oreBe;

        // ÐŸÑ€Ð¾Ð²ÐµÑ€ÑÐµÐ¼: ÐµÑÐ»Ð¸ be â€” ÑÑ‚Ð¾ Ð½ÑƒÐ¶Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð½Ð°Ð¼ ÐºÐ»Ð°ÑÑ, Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾ÑÑ‚Ð¾ Ð¿Ð¾Ð´ÑÐµÐ»ÑÐµÐ¼ ÐµÐ³Ð¾ Ð² oreBe
        if (be instanceof ResourceOreBlockEntity existing) {

            oreBe = new ResourceOreBlockEntity(pos, state);

        int left = oreBe.deplete(amount);
        broadcastOreAmount(world, pos, left);

        if (left <= 0) {
            replaceWithDepletedGround(world, pos, state);
        }
        return left;
    }


    private static void replaceWithDepletedGround(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        boolean rooted = NauvisNoise.rand01(pos.getX(), pos.getZ(), 918273L) < 0.45;
        BlockState depletedGround = rooted ? Blocks.ROOTED_DIRT.getDefaultState() : Blocks.COARSE_DIRT.getDefaultState();
        world.syncWorldEvent(WorldEvents.BLOCK_BROKEN, pos, Block.getRawIdFromState(state));
        world.setBlockState(pos, depletedGround, Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
        world.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.BLOCK_GRAVEL_BREAK, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 0.8f, 0.85f);
    }

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.world.ore;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModBlocks;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.worldgen.NauvisChunkGenerator;
import net.minecraft.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.block.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.nbt.NbtCompound;
import net.minecraft.network.listener.ClientPlayPacketListener;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.Packet;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.s2c.play.BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket;
import net.minecraft.registry.RegistryWrapper;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.World;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

public class ResourceOreBlockEntity extends BlockEntity {

    private static final Map<BlockPos, Integer> CLIENT_ORE_CACHE = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    private int remainingAmount = -1;

    public ResourceOreBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.RESOURCE_ORE_BLOCK_ENTITY, pos, state);
    }

    public static void setClientCachedAmount(BlockPos pos, int amount) {
        if (amount <= 0) {
            CLIENT_ORE_CACHE.remove(pos);
        } else {
            CLIENT_ORE_CACHE.put(pos.toImmutable(), amount);
        }
    }

    public static int getClientDisplayAmount(World world, BlockPos pos, int oreType) {
        Integer cached = CLIENT_ORE_CACHE.get(pos);
        if (cached != null) {
            return cached;
        }
        if (world != null && world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof ResourceOreBlockEntity oreBe && oreBe.remainingAmount > 0) {
            return oreBe.remainingAmount;
        }
        return NauvisChunkGenerator.evaluateOreAmountAt(pos.getX(), pos.getZ(), oreType);
    }

    public int getOrInitAmount() {
        if (this.world != null && this.world.isClient) {
            Integer cached = CLIENT_ORE_CACHE.get(this.pos);
            if (cached != null) {
                return cached;
            }
        }
        if (this.remainingAmount < 0) {
            int oreType = 0;
            if (getCachedState().getBlock() instanceof ResourceOreBlock oreBlock) {
                oreType = oreBlock.getOreType();
            }
            this.remainingAmount = NauvisChunkGenerator.evaluateOreAmountAt(this.pos.getX(), this.pos.getZ(), oreType);
            markDirty();
        }
        return this.remainingAmount;
    }

    public void setRemainingAmount(int amount) {
        this.remainingAmount = Math.max(0, amount);
        sync();
    }

    public int deplete(int count) {
        int current = getOrInitAmount();
        this.remainingAmount = Math.max(0, current - count);
        sync();
        return this.remainingAmount;
    }

    public void sync() {
        markDirty();
        if (this.world != null && !this.world.isClient) {
            this.world.updateListeners(this.pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
        nbt.putInt("RemainingAmount", getOrInitAmount());
    }

    @Override
    protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
        if (nbt.contains("RemainingAmount")) {
            this.remainingAmount = nbt.getInt("RemainingAmount");
            if (this.world != null && this.world.isClient) {
                CLIENT_ORE_CACHE.put(this.pos.toImmutable(), this.remainingAmount);
            }
        }
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public Packet<ClientPlayPacketListener> toUpdatePacket() {
        return BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket.create(this);
    }

    @Override
    public NbtCompound toInitialChunkDataNbt(RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        return createNbt(registries);
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.network;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.FactorioCore;
import net.minecraft.network.RegistryByteBuf;
import net.minecraft.network.codec.PacketCodec;
import net.minecraft.network.codec.PacketCodecs;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.CustomPayload;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;

public record ChangeStackSizePayload(BlockPos pos, int delta) implements CustomPayload {
    public static final CustomPayload.Id<ChangeStackSizePayload> ID =
            new CustomPayload.Id<>(FactorioCore.id("change_stack_size"));

    public static final PacketCodec<RegistryByteBuf, ChangeStackSizePayload> CODEC =
            PacketCodec.tuple(
                    BlockPos.PACKET_CODEC, ChangeStackSizePayload::pos,
                    PacketCodecs.INTEGER, ChangeStackSizePayload::delta,
                    ChangeStackSizePayload::new

=== FILE: C:\Users\fixpl\Desktop\factorio-core-template-1.21.1\src\main\java\com\fixplot\factoriocore\network\ResearchActionPayload.java ===

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.network;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.FactorioCore;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.research.ResearchManager;
import net.fabricmc.fabric.api.networking.v1.ServerPlayNetworking;
import net.minecraft.network.RegistryByteBuf;
import net.minecraft.network.codec.PacketCodec;
import net.minecraft.network.codec.PacketCodecs;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.CustomPayload;
import net.minecraft.util.Identifier;

public record ResearchActionPayload(int actionType, String techId, int queueIndex) implements CustomPayload {

    public static final int ACTION_QUEUE = 0;
    public static final int ACTION_REMOVE_AT = 1;
    public static final int ACTION_COMPLETE_NOW = 2;

    public static final CustomPayload.Id<ResearchActionPayload> ID =
            new CustomPayload.Id<>(Identifier.of(FactorioCore.MOD_ID, "research_action"));

    public static final PacketCodec<RegistryByteBuf, ResearchActionPayload> CODEC = PacketCodec.tuple(
            PacketCodecs.VAR_INT, ResearchActionPayload::actionType,
            PacketCodecs.STRING, ResearchActionPayload::techId,
            PacketCodecs.VAR_INT, ResearchActionPayload::queueIndex,
            ResearchActionPayload::new
    );

    @Override
    public Id<? extends CustomPayload> getId() {
        return ID;
    }

    public static void handleServer(ResearchActionPayload payload, ServerPlayNetworking.Context context) {
        context.server().execute(() -> {
            ResearchManager.init();
            switch (payload.actionType()) {
                case ACTION_QUEUE -> ResearchManager.queueTech(payload.techId());
                case ACTION_REMOVE_AT -> ResearchManager.removeQueueAt(payload.queueIndex());
                case ACTION_COMPLETE_NOW -> {
                    if (context.player().hasPermissionLevel(2) || context.player().isCreative()) {
                        ResearchManager.completeImmediately(payload.techId());
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }
}

=== FILE: C:\Users\fixpl\Desktop\factorio-core-template-1.21.1\src\main\java\com\fixplot\factoriocore\network\SyncPollutionPayload.java ===

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.network;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.FactorioCore;
import net.minecraft.network.RegistryByteBuf;
import net.minecraft.network.codec.PacketCodec;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.CustomPayload;
import net.minecraft.util.Identifier;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public record SyncPollutionPayload(Map<Long, Float> chunkPollution) implements CustomPayload {

    public static final CustomPayload.Id<SyncPollutionPayload> ID =
            new CustomPayload.Id<>(Identifier.of(FactorioCore.MOD_ID, "sync_pollution"));

    public static final PacketCodec<RegistryByteBuf, SyncPollutionPayload> CODEC = PacketCodec.of(
            (value, buf) -> {
                Map<Long, Float> map = value.chunkPollution();
                buf.writeVarInt(map.size());
                for (Map.Entry<Long, Float> entry : map.entrySet()) {
                    buf.writeLong(entry.getKey());
                    buf.writeFloat(entry.getValue());
                }
            },
            buf -> {
                int size = buf.readVarInt();
                Map<Long, Float> map = new HashMap<>(size);
                for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                    long key = buf.readLong();
                    float val = buf.readFloat();
                    map.put(key, val);
                }
                return new SyncPollutionPayload(map);
            }
    );

    @Override
    public Id<? extends CustomPayload> getId() {
        return ID;
    }
}

    private static Block registerBlock(String name, Block block) {
        registerBlockItem(name, block);
        return Registry.register(Registries.BLOCK, Identifier.of(FactorioCore.MOD_ID, name), block);
    }

    private static void registerBlockItem(String name, Block block) {
        Registry.register(Registries.ITEM, Identifier.of(FactorioCore.MOD_ID, name),
                new BlockItem(block, new Item.Settings()));
    }

    private static Block registerLandfillBlock(String name, Block block) {
        Registry.register(Registries.ITEM, Identifier.of(FactorioCore.MOD_ID, name),
                new LandfillItem(block, new Item.Settings()));

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.worldgen;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.FactorioCore;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.world.ore.ResourceOreBlock;
import net.fabricmc.fabric.api.event.lifecycle.v1.ServerLifecycleEvents;
import net.fabricmc.fabric.api.event.player.PlayerBlockBreakEvents;
import net.minecraft.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.registry.Registries;
import net.minecraft.registry.Registry;
import net.minecraft.registry.RegistryKey;
import net.minecraft.registry.RegistryKeys;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundCategory;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundEvents;
import net.minecraft.text.Text;
import net.minecraft.util.Identifier;
import net.minecraft.world.World;

public class ModWorldGen {

    public static boolean newlyCustomizedWorld = false;

    public static final RegistryKey<World> NAUVIS_WORLD_KEY = RegistryKey.of(
            RegistryKeys.WORLD,
            Identifier.of(FactorioCore.MOD_ID, "nauvis")
    );

    public static void registerWorldGen() {
        Registry.register(
                Registries.CHUNK_GENERATOR,
                Identifier.of(FactorioCore.MOD_ID, "nauvis_generator"),
                NauvisChunkGenerator.CODEC
        );

        ServerLifecycleEvents.SERVER_STARTING.register(server -> {
            long mcSeed = server.getSaveProperties().getGeneratorOptions().getSeed();
            NauvisConfig.loadOrSaveForServer(server, newlyCustomizedWorld, mcSeed);
            newlyCustomizedWorld = false;
            FactorioCore.LOGGER.info("Loaded Nauvis World Seed: " + NauvisConfig.ACTIVE.worldSeed);
        });

        PlayerBlockBreakEvents.BEFORE.register((world, player, pos, state, blockEntity) -> {
            if (state.getBlock() instanceof ResourceOreBlock oreBlock) {
                if (player.isCreative() && player.isSneaking()) {
                    return true;
                }
                if (!world.isClient) {
                    ItemStack mined = oreBlock.createProductStack(1);
                    // Ð’ÐÐ–ÐÐž: ÑÐ¾Ñ…Ñ€Ð°Ð½ÑÐµÐ¼ Ð¸Ð¼Ñ Ñ€ÐµÑÑƒÑ€ÑÐ° Ð”Ðž offerOrDrop, Ñ‚Ð°Ðº ÐºÐ°Ðº offerOrDrop Ð¾Ð±Ð½ÑƒÐ»ÑÐµÑ‚ ÑÑ‚ÐµÐº Ð´Ð¾ 0 (Ð’Ð¾Ð·Ð´ÑƒÑ…)!
                    String resourceName = mined.getName().getString();
                    player.getInventory().offerOrDrop(mined);

                    int left = ResourceOreBlock.consumeOreAt(world, pos, 1);
                    world.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.BLOCK_STONE_HIT, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 0.7f, 1.15f);

                    if (left > 0) {
                        player.sendMessage(Text.translatable("hud.factoriocore.mined_ore_feedback", resourceName, left)//
                                , true);
                    } else {
                        
                    }
                }
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        });

        FactorioCore.LOGGER.info("Registered Nauvis World Generation for " + FactorioCore.MOD_ID);
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.worldgen;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModBlocks;
import com.mojang.serialization.MapCodec;
import com.mojang.serialization.codecs.RecordCodecBuilder;
import net.minecraft.block.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.block.LeavesBlock;
import net.minecraft.block.PillarBlock;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.math.ChunkPos;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Direction;
import net.minecraft.util.math.MathHelper;
import net.minecraft.world.ChunkRegion;
import net.minecraft.world.HeightLimitView;
import net.minecraft.world.Heightmap;
import net.minecraft.world.StructureWorldAccess;
import net.minecraft.world.biome.source.BiomeAccess;
import net.minecraft.world.biome.source.BiomeSource;
import net.minecraft.world.chunk.Chunk;
import net.minecraft.world.gen.GenerationStep;
import net.minecraft.world.gen.StructureAccessor;
import net.minecraft.world.gen.chunk.Blender;
import net.minecraft.world.gen.chunk.ChunkGenerator;
import net.minecraft.world.gen.chunk.VerticalBlockSample;
import net.minecraft.world.gen.noise.NoiseConfig;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;

public class NauvisChunkGenerator extends ChunkGenerator {

    public static final MapCodec<NauvisChunkGenerator> CODEC = RecordCodecBuilder.mapCodec(instance ->
            instance.group(
                    BiomeSource.CODEC.fieldOf("biome_source").forGetter(ChunkGenerator::getBiomeSource)
            ).apply(instance, instance.stable(NauvisChunkGenerator::new))
    );

    public static final int SEA_LEVEL = 63;
    public static final int MAIN_PLAIN_Y = 64;

    private static final long ELEV_MACRO_SALT = 104729L;
    private static final long ELEV_RIDGE_SALT = 218357L;
    private static final long CLIFF_ELEV_SALT = 334919L;
    private static final long CLIFF_CONTINUITY_SALT = 449173L;
    private static final long MOISTURE_SALT = 563209L;
    private static final long AUX_SALT = 679423L;
    private static final long FOREST_SALT = 791843L;
    private static final long DETAIL_SALT = 905117L;
    private static final long ORE_SALT = 1234577L;

    public enum NauvisBiome {
        LUSH_GRASS("Ð“ÑƒÑÑ‚Ñ‹Ðµ Ð»ÑƒÐ³Ð° (Grass-1)"),
        DRY_GRASS("Ð¡Ñ‚ÐµÐ¿ÑŒ (Grass-3)"),
        DRY_DIRT("Ð¡ÑƒÑ…Ð°Ñ Ð·ÐµÐ¼Ð»Ñ (Dry Dirt)"),
        SAND_DESERT("ÐŸÐµÑÑ‡Ð°Ð½Ð°Ñ Ð¿ÑƒÑÑ‚Ñ‹Ð½Ñ (Sand)"),
        RED_DESERT("ÐšÑ€Ð°ÑÐ½Ð°Ñ Ð¿ÑƒÑÑ‚Ñ‹Ð½Ñ (Red Desert)");

        public final String displayName;

        NauvisBiome(String displayName) {
            this.displayName = displayName;
        }
    }

    public record OreSample(int oreType, int amount) {
    }

    public NauvisChunkGenerator(BiomeSource biomeSource) {
        super(biomeSource);
    }

    @Override
    protected MapCodec<? extends ChunkGenerator> getCodec() {
        return CODEC;
    }

    public static double evaluateElevation(int x, int z) {
        NauvisConfig cfg = NauvisConfig.ACTIVE;
        if (cfg.waterCoverage <= 0.02f) {
            return 0.35;
        }

        double scaleMul = Math.max(0.35, cfg.waterScale);
        long macroSeed = NauvisConfig.seed(ELEV_MACRO_SALT);
        long ridgeSeed = NauvisConfig.seed(ELEV_RIDGE_SALT);

        double macro = NauvisNoise.warpedFbm(x, z, 4, 320.0 * scaleMul, 65.0 * scaleMul, macroSeed);
        double detail = NauvisNoise.fbm(x, z, 2, 75.0 * scaleMul, macroSeed + 55L) * 0.06;
        double ridgePaths = NauvisNoise.ridgeNoise(x, z, 2, 260.0 * scaleMul, 45.0 * scaleMul, ridgeSeed);

        double waterBias = (1.0 - cfg.waterCoverage) * 0.38;
        double elevation = macro * 0.82 + detail + (ridgePaths * 0.18) + 0.09 + waterBias;

        double spawnLandCone = NauvisNoise.spotCone(x, z, 0.0, 0.0, 64.0, 14.0, macroSeed + 11L);
        if (spawnLandCone > 0.0) {
            elevation = MathHelper.lerp(spawnLandCone, elevation, 0.28);
        }

        double lakeAngle = NauvisNoise.rand01(0, 0, macroSeed + 99L) * Math.PI * 2.0;
        double lakeX = Math.cos(lakeAngle) * 54.0;
        double lakeZ = Math.sin(lakeAngle) * 54.0;

        double startLakeCone = NauvisNoise.spotCone(x, z, lakeX, lakeZ, 24.0, 6.0, macroSeed + 29L);
        if (startLakeCone > 0.0) {
            elevation -= startLakeCone * 0.65;
        }

        return elevation;
    }

    public static int evaluateCliffHeight(int x, int z, double waterElevation) {
        NauvisConfig cfg = NauvisConfig.ACTIVE;
        if (cfg.cliffFreq <= 0.02f || (x * x + z * z) < 56 * 56 || waterElevation < 0.10) {
            return 0;
        }

        double waveScale = 290.0 / Math.max(0.35, cfg.cliffFreq);
        double cliffWave = NauvisNoise.warpedFbm(x, z, 3, waveScale, 44.0, NauvisConfig.seed(CLIFF_ELEV_SALT));
        double distFromIsoline = Math.abs(cliffWave - 0.18);

        double bandHalfWidth = 0.014 * Math.max(0.6, Math.min(1.3, cfg.cliffFreq));
        if (distFromIsoline > bandHalfWidth) {
            return 0;
        }

        double continuity = NauvisNoise.fbm(x, z, 2, 100.0, NauvisConfig.seed(CLIFF_CONTINUITY_SALT));
        double threshold = 0.42 - cfg.cliffContinuity * 0.30;
        if (continuity < threshold) {
            return 0;
        }

        double endTaper = MathHelper.clamp((continuity - threshold) * 4.2, 0.0, 1.0);
        double profile = 1.0 - (distFromIsoline / bandHalfWidth);

        if (endTaper < 0.24 || profile < 0.22) {
            return 2;
        }
        if (profile < 0.45) {
            return 4;
        }
        return (endTaper > 0.62 && profile > 0.68) ? 6 : 5;
    }

    public static double evaluateMoisture(int x, int z) {
        long mSeed = NauvisConfig.seed(MOISTURE_SALT);
        double macro = NauvisNoise.warpedFbm(x, z, 4, 420.0, 75.0, mSeed);
        double detail = NauvisNoise.fbm(x, z, 2, 45.0, mSeed + 77L) * 0.08;
        return MathHelper.clamp((macro + 1.0) * 0.5 + detail + NauvisConfig.ACTIVE.moistureBias, 0.0, 1.0);
    }

    public static double evaluateAux(int x, int z) {
        long aSeed = NauvisConfig.seed(AUX_SALT);
        double macro = NauvisNoise.warpedFbm(x, z, 4, 380.0, 65.0, aSeed);
        double detail = NauvisNoise.fbm(x, z, 2, 45.0, aSeed + 99L) * 0.08;
        return MathHelper.clamp((macro + 1.0) * 0.5 + detail + NauvisConfig.ACTIVE.auxBias, 0.0, 1.0);
    }

    public static NauvisBiome getBiomeAt(int x, int z) {
        long dSeed = NauvisConfig.seed(DETAIL_SALT);
        double jitter = (NauvisNoise.rand01(x, z, dSeed + 123L) - 0.5) * 0.035;
        double m = evaluateMoisture(x, z) + jitter;
        double a = evaluateAux(x, z) + jitter;

        if (m >= 0.36) {
            return (m >= 0.62) ? NauvisBiome.LUSH_GRASS : NauvisBiome.DRY_GRASS;
        } else if (m >= 0.22) {
            return NauvisBiome.DRY_DIRT;
        } else {
            return (a >= 0.50) ? NauvisBiome.RED_DESERT : NauvisBiome.SAND_DESERT;
        }
    }

    public static boolean hasForestAt(int x, int z, double elev) {
        NauvisConfig cfg = NauvisConfig.ACTIVE;
        if (cfg.treeCoverage <= 0.02f || (x * x + z * z) < 16 * 16 || elev < 0.05) {
            return false;
        }
        double moisture = evaluateMoisture(x, z);
        double forestNoise = NauvisNoise.warpedFbm(x, z, 3, 80.0, 18.0, NauvisConfig.seed(FOREST_SALT));
        double threshold = (0.58 - moisture * 0.62) - (cfg.treeCoverage - 1.0) * 0.28;
        return forestNoise > threshold;
    }

    public static BlockState evaluateOrePatch(int x, int z, double elevation) {
        OreSample sample = sampleOreAt(x, z, elevation);
        return (sample != null) ? getOreBlockForType(sample.oreType()) : null;
    }

    public static int evaluateOreAmountAt(int x, int z, int oreType) {
        double elev = evaluateElevation(x, z);
        OreSample sample = sampleOreAt(x, z, elev);
        if (sample != null) {
            return sample.amount();
        }
        return 250;
    }

    /**
     * Ð“ÐµÐ½ÐµÑ€Ð°Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ€ Ñ€ÐµÑÑƒÑ€ÑÐ¾Ð² Factorio Ð¿Ð¾ ÑÑ‚Ð°Ñ‚ÑŒÑÐ¼ FFF-112, FFF-179, FFF-258 Ð¸ FFF-390.
     */
    public static OreSample sampleOreAt(int x, int z, double elevation) {
        if (elevation < 0.03) {
            return null;
        }
        NauvisConfig cfg = NauvisConfig.ACTIVE;
        long baseOreSeed = NauvisConfig.seed(ORE_SALT);

        float[] freqs = { cfg.ironFreq, cfg.copperFreq, cfg.coalFreq, cfg.stoneFreq };
        float[] sizes = { cfg.ironSize, cfg.copperSize, cfg.coalSize, cfg.stoneSize };
        float[] rich  = { cfg.ironRichness, cfg.copperRichness, cfg.coalRichness, cfg.stoneRichness };
        double[] baseRadiusWeights = { 1.08, 1.04, 0.96, 0.82 };

        // 1. Ð¡Ñ‚Ð°Ñ€Ñ‚Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ñ Ð·Ð¾Ð½Ð° Ð²Ð¾ÐºÑ€ÑƒÐ³ (0, 0)
        int distSq = x * x + z * z;
        if (distSq > 9 * 9 && distSq < 78 * 78) {
            double startRot = NauvisNoise.rand01(0, 0, baseOreSeed + 77L) * Math.PI * 2.0;
            double spread = 0.78 + NauvisNoise.rand01(1, 1, baseOreSeed + 88L) * 0.40;

            int bestType = -1;
            double bestSignal = 0.0;

            for (int type = 0; type < 4; type++) {
                if (freqs[type] <= 0.02f || sizes[type] <= 0.02f) continue;

                double angleJitter = (NauvisNoise.rand01(type * 13, 2, baseOreSeed + 99L) - 0.5) * 1.15;
                double angle = startRot + type * (Math.PI * 0.5) + angleJitter;
                double dist = (22.0 + NauvisNoise.rand01(type * 29, 3, baseOreSeed + 111L) * 18.0) * spread;

                double cx = Math.cos(angle) * dist;
                double cz = Math.sin(angle) * dist;
                double radius = 10.5 * baseRadiusWeights[type] * Math.sqrt(sizes[type]);

                double signal = evaluateSpotNoiseCone(x, z, cx, cz, radius, baseOreSeed + type * 53L);
                if (signal > bestSignal) {
                    bestSignal = signal;
                    bestType = type;
                }
            }

            if (bestType >= 0) {
                int amount = computeSpotRichness(bestSignal, rich[bestType], 0.0, true);
                return new OreSample(bestType, amount);
            }
        }

        if (distSq < 72 * 72) {
            return null;
        }

        // 2. Ð ÐµÐ³Ð¸Ð¾Ð½Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ð¹ Spot Noise (FFF-112 + FFF-258)
        final int regionSize = 192;
        int regX = Math.floorDiv(x, regionSize);
        int regZ = Math.floorDiv(z, regionSize);

        int bestType = -1;
        double bestSignal = 0.0;
        double bestDistFromOrigin = 0.0;

        for (int rx = regX - 1; rx <= regX + 1; rx++) {
            for (int rz = regZ - 1; rz <= regZ + 1; rz++) {
                long regionSeed = NauvisNoise.hash2D(rx, rz, baseOreSeed + 40409L);

                double[] placedX = new double[8];
                double[] placedZ = new double[8];
                double[] placedR = new double[8];
                int placedCount = 0;

                for (int type = 0; type < 4; type++) {
                    if (freqs[type] <= 0.02f || sizes[type] <= 0.02f) continue;

                    double expectedSpots = 0.65 * freqs[type];
                    int maxSpots = (expectedSpots >= 1.0) ? 2 : 1;

                    for (int s = 0; s < maxSpots; s++) {
                        long spotSalt = regionSeed + type * 7919L + s * 1301L;
                        double roll = NauvisNoise.rand01(rx + s * 17, rz - type * 23, spotSalt);
                        double prob = (s == 0) ? Math.min(0.92, expectedSpots) : Math.max(0.0, expectedSpots - 0.85);
                        if (roll > prob) {
                            continue;
                        }

                        double radius = MathHelper.clamp(13.5 * baseRadiusWeights[type] * Math.sqrt(sizes[type]), 5.0, 32.0);
                        double margin = radius + 6.0;
                        double span = Math.max(16.0, regionSize - 2.0 * margin);

                        double cx = rx * regionSize + margin + NauvisNoise.rand01(rx, rz, spotSalt + 1L) * span;
                        double cz = rz * regionSize + margin + NauvisNoise.rand01(rx, rz, spotSalt + 2L) * span;

                        if (cx * cx + cz * cz < 82 * 82) {
                            continue;
                        }

                        boolean overlapsOther = false;
                        for (int p = 0; p < placedCount; p++) {
                            double dx = cx - placedX[p];
                            double dz = cz - placedZ[p];
                            double minSep = radius + placedR[p] + 8.0;
                            if (dx * dx + dz * dz < minSep * minSep) {
                                overlapsOther = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (overlapsOther) {
                            continue;
                        }

                        if (placedCount < placedX.length) {
                            placedX[placedCount] = cx;
                            placedZ[placedCount] = cz;
                            placedR[placedCount] = radius;
                            placedCount++;
                        }

                        double signal = evaluateSpotNoiseCone(x, z, cx, cz, radius, spotSalt + 3L);
                        if (signal > bestSignal) {
                            bestSignal = signal;
                            bestType = type;
                            bestDistFromOrigin = Math.sqrt(cx * cx + cz * cz);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (bestType >= 0) {
            int amount = computeSpotRichness(bestSignal, rich[bestType], bestDistFromOrigin, false);
            return new OreSample(bestType, amount);
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static double evaluateSpotNoiseCone(int x, int z, double cx, double cz, double radius, long salt) {
        double maxBound = radius * 1.45;
        if (Math.abs(x - cx) > maxBound || Math.abs(z - cz) > maxBound) {
            return 0.0;
        }

        double warpScale = Math.max(10.0, radius * 0.75);
        double wx = x + NauvisNoise.fbm(x, z, 2, warpScale, salt + 11L) * (radius * 0.24);
        double wz = z + NauvisNoise.fbm(x + 193.0, z - 157.0, 2, warpScale, salt + 23L) * (radius * 0.24);

        double angle = NauvisNoise.rand01((int) cx, (int) cz, salt + 37L) * Math.PI;
        double cos = Math.cos(angle);
        double sin = Math.sin(angle);
        double dx = wx - cx;
        double dz = wz - cz;

        double rotX = (dx * cos - dz * sin) * 0.86;
        double rotZ = (dx * sin + dz * cos) * 1.14;

        double dist = Math.sqrt(rotX * rotX + rotZ * rotZ);
        double cone = 1.0 - (dist / radius);
        if (cone <= -0.25) {
            return 0.0;
        }

        double basisNoise = NauvisNoise.fbm(wx, wz, 2, Math.max(7.0, radius * 0.50), salt + 59L) * 0.22;
        double rawHeight = cone + basisNoise;

        double cutoff = 0.24;
        if (rawHeight <= cutoff) {
            return 0.0;
        }

        return MathHelper.clamp((rawHeight - cutoff) / (1.0 - cutoff), 0.0, 1.25);
    }

    private static int computeSpotRichness(double signal, float richnessSlider, double distFromOrigin, boolean isStarter) {
        double centerGradient = 0.15 + Math.pow(signal, 1.35) * 1.85;
        double distanceBonus = isStarter ? 0.85 : (1.0 + Math.pow(distFromOrigin / 360.0, 1.18));
        double baseAmount = 520.0 * centerGradient * richnessSlider * distanceBonus;
        return Math.max(35, (int) Math.round(baseAmount));
    }

    private static BlockState getOreBlockForType(int type) {
        return switch (type) {
            case 0 -> ModBlocks.IRON_ORE_DEPOSIT.getDefaultState();
            case 1 -> ModBlocks.COPPER_ORE_DEPOSIT.getDefaultState();
            case 2 -> ModBlocks.COAL_DEPOSIT.getDefaultState();
            default -> ModBlocks.STONE_DEPOSIT.getDefaultState();
        };
    }

    public static int getSurfaceY(int x, int z) {
        double elev = evaluateElevation(x, z);

        if (elev < 0.0) {
            if (elev > -0.09) {
                return SEA_LEVEL - 1;
            }
            int depth = MathHelper.clamp(2 + (int) ((-0.09 - elev) * 10.0), 2, 5);
            return SEA_LEVEL - depth;
        }

        int cliffH = evaluateCliffHeight(x, z, elev);
        if (cliffH > 0) {
            return MAIN_PLAIN_Y + cliffH;
        }

        return MAIN_PLAIN_Y;
    }

    @Override
    public CompletableFuture<Chunk> populateNoise(Blender blender, NoiseConfig noiseConfig,
                                                  StructureAccessor structureAccessor, Chunk chunk) {
        ChunkPos chunkPos = chunk.getPos();
        int startX = chunkPos.getStartX();
        int startZ = chunkPos.getStartZ();
        BlockPos.Mutable pos = new BlockPos.Mutable();

        for (int localX = 0; localX < 16; localX++) {
            for (int localZ = 0; localZ < 16; localZ++) {
                int wx = startX + localX;
                int wz = startZ + localZ;

                double elev = evaluateElevation(wx, wz);
                int surfaceY = getSurfaceY(wx, wz);
                int cliffH = evaluateCliffHeight(wx, wz, elev);
                NauvisBiome biome = getBiomeAt(wx, wz);

                chunk.setBlockState(pos.set(localX, -64, localZ), Blocks.BEDROCK.getDefaultState(), false);
                for (int y = -63; y <= 0; y++) {
                    chunk.setBlockState(pos.set(localX, y, localZ), Blocks.DEEPSLATE.getDefaultState(), false);
                }

                for (int y = 1; y <= MAIN_PLAIN_Y - 4; y++) {
                    chunk.setBlockState(pos.set(localX, y, localZ), Blocks.STONE.getDefaultState(), false);
                }

                if (surfaceY < SEA_LEVEL) {
                    BlockState lakeBed = selectLakeBedBlock(biome);
                    for (int y = surfaceY - 3; y <= surfaceY; y++) {
                        chunk.setBlockState(pos.set(localX, y, localZ), lakeBed, false);
                    }
                    for (int y = surfaceY + 1; y <= SEA_LEVEL; y++) {
                        chunk.setBlockState(pos.set(localX, y, localZ), Blocks.WATER.getDefaultState(), false);
                    }
                } else if (cliffH > 0) {
                    for (int y = MAIN_PLAIN_Y - 3; y <= surfaceY; y++) {
                        chunk.setBlockState(pos.set(localX, y, localZ), chooseRockBlock(biome, wx, y, wz), false);
                    }
                } else {
                    boolean isWaterEdge = (elev < 0.025);
                    BlockState oreState = evaluateOrePatch(wx, wz, elev);
                    BlockState topState = (oreState != null) ? oreState : selectSurfaceBlock(biome, isWaterEdge, wx, wz);
                    BlockState underState = selectUnderBlock(biome);

                    for (int y = MAIN_PLAIN_Y - 3; y < MAIN_PLAIN_Y; y++) {
                        chunk.setBlockState(pos.set(localX, y, localZ), underState, false);
                    }
                    chunk.setBlockState(pos.set(localX, MAIN_PLAIN_Y, localZ), topState, false);
                }
            }
        }

        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(chunk);
    }

    @Override
    public void generateFeatures(StructureWorldAccess world, Chunk chunk, StructureAccessor structureAccessor) {
    }

    private static BlockState chooseRockBlock(NauvisBiome biome, int x, int y, int z) {
        double r = NauvisNoise.rand01(x + y * 5, z - y * 11, NauvisConfig.seed(DETAIL_SALT));

        if (y <= MAIN_PLAIN_Y + 1) {
            return (r < 0.55) ? Blocks.TUFF.getDefaultState() : Blocks.DEEPSLATE.getDefaultState();
        }

        if (r < 0.55) return Blocks.DRIPSTONE_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
        if (r < 0.82) return Blocks.GRANITE.getDefaultState();
        return Blocks.TUFF.getDefaultState();
    }

    private static BlockState selectLakeBedBlock(NauvisBiome biome) {
        return switch (biome) {
            case LUSH_GRASS, DRY_GRASS -> Blocks.CLAY.getDefaultState();
            case DRY_DIRT -> Blocks.MUD.getDefaultState();
            case SAND_DESERT -> Blocks.SAND.getDefaultState();
            case RED_DESERT -> Blocks.RED_SAND.getDefaultState();
        };
    }

    private static BlockState selectSurfaceBlock(NauvisBiome biome, boolean isWaterEdge, int x, int z) {
        long dSeed = NauvisConfig.seed(DETAIL_SALT);
        double subZone = NauvisNoise.warpedFbm(x, z, 2, 95.0, 20.0, dSeed + 505L)
                + (NauvisNoise.rand01(x, z, dSeed + 506L) - 0.5) * 0.12;
        double dripRoll = NauvisNoise.rand01(x, z, dSeed + 808L);

        BlockState mudBrickMix = (dripRoll < 0.18)
                ? Blocks.DRIPSTONE_BLOCK.getDefaultState()
                : Blocks.MUD_BRICKS.getDefaultState();

        return switch (biome) {
            case LUSH_GRASS -> (subZone > 0.25) ? Blocks.MOSS_BLOCK.getDefaultState() : Blocks.GRASS_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
            case DRY_GRASS -> Blocks.GRASS_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
            case DRY_DIRT -> (subZone > 0.25) ? mudBrickMix : Blocks.PACKED_MUD.getDefaultState();
            case SAND_DESERT -> (subZone > 0.35) ? Blocks.SAND.getDefaultState() : Blocks.PACKED_MUD.getDefaultState();
            case RED_DESERT -> (subZone > 0.15) ? mudBrickMix : Blocks.PACKED_MUD.getDefaultState();
        };
    }

    private static BlockState selectUnderBlock(NauvisBiome biome) {
        return switch (biome) {
            case LUSH_GRASS, DRY_GRASS, DRY_DIRT -> Blocks.DIRT.getDefaultState();
            case SAND_DESERT -> Blocks.SANDSTONE.getDefaultState();
            case RED_DESERT -> Blocks.RED_SANDSTONE.getDefaultState();
        };
    }

    @Override
    public void buildSurface(ChunkRegion region, StructureAccessor structures, NoiseConfig noiseConfig, Chunk chunk) {
        ChunkPos chunkPos = chunk.getPos();
        int chunkX = chunkPos.x;
        int chunkZ = chunkPos.z;
        int startX = chunkPos.getStartX();
        int startZ = chunkPos.getStartZ();
        long dSeed = NauvisConfig.seed(DETAIL_SALT);

        // 1. Ð’Ð°Ð»ÑƒÐ½Ñ‹ ÐÐ°ÑƒÐ²Ð¸ÑÐ°
        double boulderRoll = NauvisNoise.rand01(chunkX, chunkZ, dSeed + 777L);
        double boulderThreshold = 0.045 * NauvisConfig.ACTIVE.boulderFreq;
        if (boulderRoll < boulderThreshold) {
            int bx = startX + 4 + (int) (NauvisNoise.rand01(chunkX, chunkZ, dSeed + 1L) * 8.0);
            int bz = startZ + 4 + (int) (NauvisNoise.rand01(chunkX, chunkZ, dSeed + 2L) * 8.0);
            double elev = evaluateElevation(bx, bz);

            if (elev > 0.06 && evaluateCliffHeight(bx, bz, elev) == 0 && evaluateOrePatch(bx, bz, elev) == null) {
                int sizeTier = (boulderRoll < boulderThreshold * 0.33) ? 2 : 1;
                generateNauvisBoulder(region, new BlockPos(bx, MAIN_PLAIN_Y + 1, bz), sizeTier, dSeed);
            }
        }

        // 2. Ð›ÐµÑÐ½Ñ‹Ðµ Ð¼Ð°ÑÑÐ¸Ð²Ñ‹ Ð¸ ÑÑƒÑ…Ð¸Ðµ ÐºÐ¾Ñ€ÑÐ³Ð¸
        for (int cellX = 0; cellX < 4; cellX++) {
            for (int cellZ = 0; cellZ < 4; cellZ++) {
                int tx = startX + cellX * 4 + 1 + (int) (NauvisNoise.rand01(startX + cellX, startZ + cellZ, dSeed + 19L) * 2.0);
                int tz = startZ + cellZ * 4 + 1 + (int) (NauvisNoise.rand01(startX + cellX, startZ + cellZ, dSeed + 23L) * 2.0);

                double elev = evaluateElevation(tx, tz);
                if (elev < 0.05 || evaluateCliffHeight(tx, tz, elev) > 0 || evaluateOrePatch(tx, tz, elev) != null) {
                    continue;
                }

                if (hasForestAt(tx, tz, elev)) {
                    double moisture = evaluateMoisture(tx, tz);
                    double treeRoll = NauvisNoise.rand01(tx, tz, dSeed + 333L);
                    NauvisBiome biome = getBiomeAt(tx, tz);

                    if (moisture >= 0.45 && treeRoll < 0.48) {
                        generateLivingNauvisTree(region, new BlockPos(tx, MAIN_PLAIN_Y + 1, tz), tx, tz, dSeed);
                    } else if (moisture < 0.45 && treeRoll < 0.09) {
                        generateDeadTreeTrunk(region, new BlockPos(tx, MAIN_PLAIN_Y + 1, tz), biome, tx, tz, dSeed);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // 3. Ð Ð°ÑÑ‚Ð¸Ñ‚ÐµÐ»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾ÑÑ‚ÑŒ Ð½Ð° ÑÑƒÑˆÐµ Ð¸ Ð² Ð¾Ð·Ñ‘Ñ€Ð°Ñ…
        BlockPos.Mutable decoPos = new BlockPos.Mutable();
        for (int lx = 0; lx < 16; lx++) {
            for (int lz = 0; lz < 16; lz++) {
                int wx = startX + lx;
                int wz = startZ + lz;
                double elev = evaluateElevation(wx, wz);
                int surfaceY = getSurfaceY(wx, wz);
                double r = NauvisNoise.rand01(wx, wz, dSeed + 999L);
                NauvisBiome biome = getBiomeAt(wx, wz);

                if (surfaceY < SEA_LEVEL) {
                    if (r < 0.22) {
                        decoPos.set(wx, surfaceY + 1, wz);
                        if (region.getBlockState(decoPos).isOf(Blocks.WATER)) {
                            region.setBlockState(decoPos, Blocks.SEAGRASS.getDefaultState(), 2);
                        }
                    }
                    if ((biome == NauvisBiome.LUSH_GRASS || biome == NauvisBiome.DRY_GRASS)
                            && surfaceY == SEA_LEVEL - 1 && r > 0.94) {
                        decoPos.set(wx, SEA_LEVEL + 1, wz);
                        if (region.getBlockState(decoPos).isAir()) {
                            region.setBlockState(decoPos, Blocks.LILY_PAD.getDefaultState(), 2);
                        }
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                if (elev < 0.03 || evaluateCliffHeight(wx, wz, elev) > 0 || evaluateOrePatch(wx, wz, elev) != null) {
                    continue;
                }

                decoPos.set(wx, MAIN_PLAIN_Y + 1, wz);
                if (!region.getBlockState(decoPos).isAir()) {
                    continue;
                }

                BlockState ground = region.getBlockState(decoPos.down());
                if ((biome == NauvisBiome.LUSH_GRASS || biome == NauvisBiome.DRY_GRASS) && ground.isOf(Blocks.GRASS_BLOCK)) {
                    if (r < 0.09) {
                        region.setBlockState(decoPos, Blocks.SHORT_GRASS.getDefaultState(), 2);
                    } else if (biome == NauvisBiome.LUSH_GRASS && r < 0.115) {
                        region.setBlockState(decoPos, Blocks.FERN.getDefaultState(), 2);
                    }
                } else if ((biome == NauvisBiome.SAND_DESERT || biome == NauvisBiome.RED_DESERT || biome == NauvisBiome.DRY_DIRT) && r < 0.018) {
                    if (ground.isOf(Blocks.SAND) || ground.isOf(Blocks.PACKED_MUD) || ground.isOf(Blocks.MUD_BRICKS)) {
                        region.setBlockState(decoPos, Blocks.DEAD_BUSH.getDefaultState(), 2);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void generateNauvisBoulder(ChunkRegion region, BlockPos center, int sizeTier, long dSeed) {
        int radiusXZ = sizeTier;
        int height = sizeTier + 1;

        BlockPos.Mutable p = new BlockPos.Mutable();
        for (int dx = -radiusXZ; dx <= radiusXZ; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -radiusXZ; dz <= radiusXZ; dz++) {
                for (int dy = 0; dy < height; dy++) {
                    double normDist = (dx * dx + dz * dz) / (radiusXZ * radiusXZ + 0.5)
                            + (dy * dy) / (height * height + 0.5);
                    double jitter = NauvisNoise.rand01(center.getX() + dx * 3, center.getZ() + dz * 5 + dy, dSeed) * 0.30;

                    if (normDist + jitter <= 0.92) {
                        p.set(center.getX() + dx, center.getY() + dy, center.getZ() + dz);
                        double r = NauvisNoise.rand01(p.getX(), p.getZ(), dSeed + 77L);
                        BlockState boulderBlock = (r < 0.50) ? Blocks.ANDESITE.getDefaultState() : Blocks.COBBLESTONE.getDefaultState();
                        region.setBlockState(p, boulderBlock, 2);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void generateLivingNauvisTree(ChunkRegion region, BlockPos base, int wx, int wz, long dSeed) {
        boolean spruceStyle = NauvisNoise.rand01(wx, wz, dSeed + 12L) < 0.45;
        BlockState log = (spruceStyle ? Blocks.SPRUCE_LOG : Blocks.OAK_LOG).getDefaultState();
        BlockState leaves = (spruceStyle ? Blocks.SPRUCE_LEAVES : Blocks.OAK_LEAVES).getDefaultState()
                .with(LeavesBlock.PERSISTENT, true);

        int height = 5 + (int) (NauvisNoise.rand01(wx, wz, dSeed + 15L) * 3.0);

        for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
            region.setBlockState(base.up(y), log, 2);
        }

        for (int dy = height - 3; dy <= height + 1; dy++) {
            int radius = (dy >= height) ? 1 : 2;
            for (int dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
                for (int dz = -radius; dz <= radius; dz++) {
                    if (Math.abs(dx) == radius && Math.abs(dz) == radius && dy >= height - 1) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    BlockPos leafPos = base.add(dx, dy, dz);
                    if (region.getBlockState(leafPos).isAir()) {
                        region.setBlockState(leafPos, leaves, 2);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void generateDeadTreeTrunk(ChunkRegion region, BlockPos base, NauvisBiome biome, int wx, int wz, long dSeed) {
        BlockState trunk = (biome == NauvisBiome.RED_DESERT
                ? Blocks.STRIPPED_DARK_OAK_LOG
                : Blocks.STRIPPED_OAK_LOG).getDefaultState();

        int height = 3 + (int) (NauvisNoise.rand01(wx, wz, dSeed + 44L) * 3.0);
        for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
            region.setBlockState(base.up(y), trunk, 2);
        }

        Direction branchDir = Direction.Type.HORIZONTAL.random(
                net.minecraft.util.math.random.Random.create(NauvisNoise.hash2D(wx, wz, dSeed + 88L)));
        BlockPos branchPos = base.up(height - 1).offset(branchDir);
        region.setBlockState(branchPos, trunk.with(PillarBlock.AXIS, branchDir.getAxis()), 2);
    }

    @Override
    public void carve(ChunkRegion chunkRegion, long seed, NoiseConfig noiseConfig, BiomeAccess biomeAccess,

    @Override
    public int getHeight(int x, int z, Heightmap.Type heightmap, HeightLimitView world, NoiseConfig noiseConfig) {
        int surfaceY = getSurfaceY(x, z);
        if (heightmap == Heightmap.Type.OCEAN_FLOOR_WG || heightmap == Heightmap.Type.OCEAN_FLOOR) {
            return surfaceY + 1;
        }
        return Math.max(surfaceY, SEA_LEVEL) + 1;
    }

    @Override
    public VerticalBlockSample getColumnSample(int x, int z, HeightLimitView world, NoiseConfig noiseConfig) {
        int minY = getMinimumY();
        int height = getWorldHeight();
        BlockState[] states = new BlockState[height];
        int surfaceY = getSurfaceY(x, z);

        for (int i = 0; i < height; i++) {
            int y = minY + i;
            if (y == minY) {
                states[i] = Blocks.BEDROCK.getDefaultState();
            } else if (y <= surfaceY) {
                states[i] = Blocks.STONE.getDefaultState();
            } else if (y <= SEA_LEVEL) {
                states[i] = Blocks.WATER.getDefaultState();
            } else {
                states[i] = Blocks.AIR.getDefaultState();
            }
        }
        return new VerticalBlockSample(minY, states);
    }

    @Override
    public void getDebugHudText(List<String> text, NoiseConfig noiseConfig, BlockPos pos) {
        NauvisBiome biome = getBiomeAt(pos.getX(), pos.getZ());
        double m = evaluateMoisture(pos.getX(), pos.getZ());
        double a = evaluateAux(pos.getX(), pos.getZ());
        text.add(String.format("[FactorioCore] Seed: %d | Biome: %s (M: %.2f, Aux: %.2f)",
                NauvisConfig.ACTIVE.worldSeed, biome.displayName, m, a));
    }
}

            ACTIVE.worldSeed = fallbackMcSeed;

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.worldgen;

import net.minecraft.util.math.MathHelper;

/**
 * Ð ÐµÐ°Ð»Ð¸Ð·Ð°Ñ†Ð¸Ñ Ð¼Ð°Ñ‚ÐµÐ¼Ð°Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ‡ÐµÑÐºÐ¸Ñ… Ð¿Ñ€Ð¸Ð¼Ð¸Ñ‚Ð¸Ð²Ð¾Ð² Ð¸Ð· Factorio FFF-390 (Noise expressions 2.0):
 * - ÐšÐ¾Ð³ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð³Ñ€Ð°Ð´Ð¸ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÑˆÑƒÐ¼ (Coherent Gradient Noise)
 * - ÐœÐ½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾Ð¾ÐºÑ‚Ð°Ð²Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ñ„Ñ€Ð°ÐºÑ‚Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÑˆÑƒÐ¼ (Multioctave Fractal Noise)
 * - Ð˜Ð½Ð²ÐµÑ€Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ€Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð³Ñ€ÐµÐ±Ð½ÐµÐ²Ð¾Ð¹ ÑˆÑƒÐ¼ (Inverted Ridge Noise: -|n| + offset)
 * - ÐšÐ¾Ð½ÑƒÑÐ½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÑˆÑƒÐ¼ Ñ Ð²Ð¾Ð·Ð¼ÑƒÑ‰ÐµÐ½Ð¸ÐµÐ¼ (Perturbed Spot Noise)
 * - Ð˜ÑÐºÐ°Ð¶ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ðµ Ð²Ñ…Ð¾Ð´Ð½Ñ‹Ñ… ÐºÐ¾Ð¾Ñ€Ð´Ð¸Ð½Ð°Ñ‚ (Domain Warping)
 */
public final class NauvisNoise {

    private NauvisNoise() {
    }

    public static long hash2D(int x, int z, long seedSalt) {
        long h = seedSalt;
        h ^= (long) x * 0x45d9f3b3335b369L;
        h ^= (long) z * 0x119de1f3456789abL;
        h = (h ^ (h >>> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9L;
        h = (h ^ (h >>> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebL;
        return h ^ (h >>> 31);
    }

    public static double rand01(int x, int z, long salt) {
        return ((hash2D(x, z, salt) >>> 11) * 0x1.0p-53);
    }

    /**
     * 2D Ð³Ñ€Ð°Ð´Ð¸ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÑˆÑƒÐ¼ ÐŸÐµÑ€Ð»Ð¸Ð½Ð° Ð² Ð´Ð¸Ð°Ð¿Ð°Ð·Ð¾Ð½Ðµ [-1.0, 1.0] (Ð±ÐµÐ· ÐºÐ²Ð°Ð´Ñ€Ð°Ñ‚Ð½Ñ‹Ñ… Ð°Ñ€Ñ‚ÐµÑ„Ð°ÐºÑ‚Ð¾Ð² ÑÐµÑ‚ÐºÐ¸).
     */
    public static double gradientNoise2D(double x, double z, long salt) {
        int x0 = MathHelper.floor(x);
        int z0 = MathHelper.floor(z);
        double fx = x - x0;
        double fz = z - z0;

        double u = fx * fx * fx * (fx * (fx * 6.0 - 15.0) + 10.0);
        double v = fz * fz * fz * (fz * (fz * 6.0 - 15.0) + 10.0);

        double n00 = gradDot(x0, z0, fx, fz, salt);
        double n10 = gradDot(x0 + 1, z0, fx - 1.0, fz, salt);
        double n01 = gradDot(x0, z0 + 1, fx, fz - 1.0, salt);
        double n11 = gradDot(x0 + 1, z0 + 1, fx - 1.0, fz - 1.0, salt);

        double nx0 = MathHelper.lerp(u, n00, n10);
        double nx1 = MathHelper.lerp(u, n01, n11);
        return MathHelper.clamp(MathHelper.lerp(v, nx0, nx1) * 1.4142, -1.0, 1.0);
    }

    private static double gradDot(int ix, int iz, double dx, double dz, long salt) {
        int h = (int) (hash2D(ix, iz, salt) & 7L);
        return switch (h) {
            case 0 ->  dx + dz;
            case 1 -> -dx + dz;
            case 2 ->  dx - dz;
            case 3 -> -dx - dz;
            case 4 ->  dx;
            case 5 -> -dx;
            case 6 ->  dz;
            default -> -dz;
        };
    }

    /**
     * Ð¤Ñ€Ð°ÐºÑ‚Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÑˆÑƒÐ¼ (Fractal Basis Noise Ð¸Ð· FFF-390): ÑÐºÐ»Ð°Ð´Ñ‹Ð²Ð°ÐµÑ‚ Ð½ÐµÑÐºÐ¾Ð»ÑŒÐºÐ¾ Ð¾ÐºÑ‚Ð°Ð² Ñ€Ð°Ð·Ð½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ Ð¼Ð°ÑÑˆÑ‚Ð°Ð±Ð°.
     */
    public static double fbm(double x, double z, int octaves, double baseScale, long salt) {
        double sum = 0.0;
        double amp = 1.0;
        double freq = 1.0 / baseScale;
        double maxAmp = 0.0;

        for (int i = 0; i < octaves; i++) {
            sum += gradientNoise2D(x * freq, z * freq, salt + i * 1619L) * amp;
            maxAmp += amp;
            amp *= 0.5;
            freq *= 2.03;
        }
        return sum / maxAmp;
    }

    /**
     * Ð¤Ñ€Ð°ÐºÑ‚Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÑˆÑƒÐ¼ Ñ Ð¸ÑÐºÐ°Ð¶ÐµÐ½Ð¸ÐµÐ¼ ÐºÐ¾Ð¾Ñ€Ð´Ð¸Ð½Ð°Ñ‚ (Domain Warping), ÑÐ¾Ð·Ð´Ð°ÑŽÑ‰Ð¸Ð¹ Ð¸Ð·Ð²Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ÑÑ‚Ñ‹Ðµ Ð±ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ³Ð° Ð¸ Ð³Ñ€Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ñ†Ñ‹ Ð±Ð¸Ð¾Ð¼Ð¾Ð².
     */
    public static double warpedFbm(double x, double z, int octaves, double baseScale, double warpStrength, long salt) {
        double wx = x + fbm(x, z, 2, baseScale * 0.65, salt + 7001L) * warpStrength;
        double wz = z + fbm(x + 317.0, z - 193.0, 2, baseScale * 0.65, salt + 9007L) * warpStrength;
        return fbm(wx, wz, octaves, baseScale, salt);
    }

    /**
     * Ð˜Ð½Ð²ÐµÑ€Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ€Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð³Ñ€ÐµÐ±Ð½ÐµÐ²Ð¾Ð¹ ÑˆÑƒÐ¼ (Ridge Noise Ð¸Ð· FFF-390):
     * Ð¤Ð¾Ñ€Ð¼ÑƒÐ»Ð°: -|noise| + offset.
     * Ð¡Ð¾Ð·Ð´Ð°Ñ‘Ñ‚ Ð½ÐµÐ¿Ñ€ÐµÑ€Ñ‹Ð²Ð½ÑƒÑŽ ÑÐµÑ‚ÑŒ ÑÐ²ÑÐ·Ð°Ð½Ð½Ñ‹Ñ… ÑÑƒÑ…Ð¾Ð¿ÑƒÑ‚Ð½Ñ‹Ñ… Ð¼Ð¾ÑÑ‚Ð¾Ð² Ð¸ Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÑˆÐµÐ¹ÐºÐ¾Ð², Ñ€Ð°Ð·Ð´ÐµÐ»ÑÑŽÑ‰Ð¸Ñ… ÐºÐ¾Ñ‚Ð»Ð¾Ð²Ð¸Ð½Ñ‹ Ð¾Ð·Ñ‘Ñ€.
     */
    public static double ridgeNoise(double x, double z, int octaves, double baseScale, double warpStrength, long salt) {
        double n = warpedFbm(x, z, octaves, baseScale, warpStrength, salt);
        return 1.0 - 2.0 * Math.abs(n); // Ð’Ð¾Ð·Ð²Ñ€Ð°Ñ‰Ð°ÐµÑ‚ +1.0 Ð½Ð° Ñ…Ñ€ÐµÐ±Ñ‚Ð°Ñ…/Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÑˆÐµÐ¹ÐºÐ°Ñ… Ð¸ -1.0 Ð² Ñ†ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ñ€Ð°Ñ… Ð²Ð¿Ð°Ð´Ð¸Ð½
    }

    /**
     * Ð¢Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÐºÐ¾Ð½ÑƒÑ Ñ Ð²Ð¾Ð·Ð¼ÑƒÑ‰ÐµÐ½Ð¸ÐµÐ¼ Ð±Ð°Ð·Ð¾Ð²Ñ‹Ð¼ ÑˆÑƒÐ¼Ð¾Ð¼ (Perturbed Spot Cone Ð¸Ð· FFF-390):
     * Ð’Ð¾Ð·Ð²Ñ€Ð°Ñ‰Ð°ÐµÑ‚ 1.0 Ð² Ñ†ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ñ€Ðµ ÐºÐ¾Ð½ÑƒÑÐ° Ð¸ Ð¿Ð»Ð°Ð²Ð½Ð¾ ÑÐ¿Ð°Ð´Ð°ÐµÑ‚ Ðº 0.0 Ð½Ð° Ñ€Ð°Ð´Ð¸ÑƒÑÐµ radius, Ð¸ÑÐºÐ°Ð¶Ð°Ñ ÐºÑ€Ð°Ñ ÑˆÑƒÐ¼Ð¾Ð¼.
     */
    public static double spotCone(double x, double z, double centerX, double centerZ,
                                  double radius, double perturbationAmp, long salt) {
        double dx = x - centerX;
        double dz = z - centerZ;
        double dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
        if (dist > radius * 1.45) {
            return 0.0;
        }
        double perturb = fbm(x, z, 2, radius * 0.45, salt) * perturbationAmp;
        double normalized = (dist + perturb) / radius;
        return MathHelper.clamp(1.0 - normalized, 0.0, 1.0);
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.client;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.belt.BeltBlock;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.belt.BeltBlockEntity;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.belt.BeltLane;
import net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient;
import net.minecraft.client.render.VertexConsumerProvider;
import net.minecraft.client.render.block.entity.BlockEntityRendererFactory;
import net.minecraft.client.render.item.ItemRenderer;
import net.minecraft.client.render.model.json.ModelTransformationMode;
import net.minecraft.client.util.math.MatrixStack;
import net.minecraft.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Direction;
import net.minecraft.util.math.MathHelper;
import net.minecraft.util.math.RotationAxis;
import software.bernie.geckolib.renderer.GeoBlockRenderer;

public class BeltBlockEntityRenderer extends GeoBlockRenderer<BeltBlockEntity> {

    private static final double SLOT_STEP = 0.25;
    private static final double[] BASE_Z = { 0.125, 0.375, 0.625, 0.875 };
    private final ItemRenderer itemRenderer;

    public BeltBlockEntityRenderer(BlockEntityRendererFactory.Context ctx) {
        super(new BeltGeoModel());
        this.itemRenderer = ctx.getItemRenderer();
    }

    @Override
    public int getRenderDistance() {
        return 40;
    }

    @Override
    public void render(BeltBlockEntity entity, float tickDelta, MatrixStack matrices,
                       VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers, int light, int overlay) {
        if (!entity.isSplitter() && !entity.isUnderground()) {
            super.render(entity, tickDelta, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay);
        }

        BeltLane left = entity.getLeftLane();
        BeltLane right = entity.getRightLane();
        // Ð•ÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð½Ð° ÐºÐ¾Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ¹ÐµÑ€Ðµ Ð½ÐµÑ‚ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚Ð¾Ð² â€” Ð²Ð¾Ð¾Ð±Ñ‰Ðµ Ð½Ðµ Ñ‚Ñ€Ð°Ñ‚Ð¸Ð¼ CPU Ð½Ð° Ð¼Ð°Ñ‚Ñ€Ð¸Ñ†Ñ‹ Ð¸ Ñ†Ð¸ÐºÐ»Ñ‹ ÑÐ»Ð¾Ñ‚Ð¾Ð²!
        if (left.isEmpty() && right.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        Direction facing = entity.getCachedState().get(BeltBlock.FACING);
        int delay = entity.getMoveDelay();
        float rawTicks = Math.min((float) delay, entity.getRenderTicks() + tickDelta);
        float progress = MathHelper.clamp(rawTicks / (float) delay, 0.0f, 1.0f);

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(0.5, 0.0, 0.5);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(-facing.asRotation()));
        matrices.translate(-0.5, 0.0, -0.5);

        BeltBlockEntity.UndergroundMode mode = entity.getUndergroundMode();

        if (!left.isEmpty()) {
            renderLane(left, 0.72, progress, mode, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay);
        }
        if (!right.isEmpty()) {
            renderLane(right, 0.28, progress, mode, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay);
        }

        matrices.pop();
    }

    private void renderLane(BeltLane lane, double laneX, float progress, BeltBlockEntity.UndergroundMode mode,
                            MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers, int light, int overlay) {
        ItemRenderer ir = (this.itemRenderer != null) ? this.itemRenderer : MinecraftClient.getInstance().getItemRenderer();

        for (int i = 0; i < BeltLane.CAPACITY; i++) {
            ItemStack stack = lane.getStack(i);
            if (!stack.isEmpty()) {
                double z = BASE_Z[i];
                if (lane.isMoving(i)) {
                    z = MathHelper.lerp(progress, z - SLOT_STEP, z);
                }

                if (mode == BeltBlockEntity.UndergroundMode.INPUT && z > 0.52) continue;
                if (mode == BeltBlockEntity.UndergroundMode.OUTPUT && z < 0.48) continue;

                matrices.push();
                matrices.translate(laneX, 0.38, z);
                matrices.scale(0.35f, 0.35f, 0.35f);
                matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(90.0f));

                ir.renderItem(
                        stack,
                        ModelTransformationMode.FIXED,
                        light,
                        overlay,
                        matrices,
                        vertexConsumers,
                        null,
                        0
                );

                matrices.pop();
            }
        }
    }
}

public class BeltGeoModel extends GeoModel<BeltBlockEntity> {

    public Identifier getModelResource(BeltBlockEntity animatable) {

        return switch (animatable.getBeltTier()) {

    }

    @Override
    public Identifier getTextureResource(BeltBlockEntity animatable) {
        // ÐŸÐ¾Ð´Ð³Ñ€ÑƒÐ¶Ð°ÐµÐ¼ ÑÐ¾Ð¾Ñ‚Ð²ÐµÑ‚ÑÑ‚Ð²ÑƒÑŽÑ‰Ð¸Ðµ Ñ‚ÐµÐºÑÑ‚ÑƒÑ€Ñ‹ ÑÑ‚Ñ€ÐµÐ»Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÐº (Ð¶Ñ‘Ð»Ñ‚Ñ‹Ðµ, ÐºÑ€Ð°ÑÐ½Ñ‹Ðµ, ÑÐ¸Ð½Ð¸Ðµ)
        return switch (animatable.getBeltTier()) {
            case 2 -> Identifier.of(FactorioCore.MOD_ID, "textures/block/fast_belt_texture.png");
            case 3 -> Identifier.of(FactorioCore.MOD_ID, "textures/block/express_belt_texture.png");
            default -> Identifier.of(FactorioCore.MOD_ID, "textures/block/belt_texture.png");
        };
    }

    @Override
    public Identifier getAnimationResource(BeltBlockEntity animatable) {
        return Identifier.of(FactorioCore.MOD_ID, "animations/belt.animation.json");
    }
