public class ElectricNetworkInfoScreen extends Screen {

    private static final String[] TIMEFRAME_LABELS = {
            "gui.factoriocore.time.5s", "gui.factoriocore.time.1m", "gui.factoriocore.time.10m",
            "gui.factoriocore.time.1h", "gui.factoriocore.time.10h", "gui.factoriocore.time.50h",
            "gui.factoriocore.time.250h", "gui.factoriocore.time.1000h", "gui.factoriocore.time.all"
    };
    private static final float[] TIMEFRAME_MAX_NUM = {
            5.0f, 60.0f, 10.0f, 60.0f, 10.0f, 50.0f, 250.0f, 1000.0f, 100.0f
    };
    private static final int[] TICKS_PER_POINT = {
            1, 12, 120, 720, 7200, 36000, 180000, 720000, 240
    };

    public static final int GRAPH_POINTS = 100;
    private static final int RAW_BUFFER_SIZE = 12000;

    private static final Map<Block, long[]> CONSUMER_RAW_TICKS = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private static final Map<Block, long[]> PRODUCER_RAW_TICKS = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private static int rawWriteCursor = 0;
    private static int totalRecordedTicks = 0;
    private static long lastRecordedWorldTick = -1L;
    private static long lastNetworkScanTick = -100L;
    private static BlockPos lastViewedPolePos = null;
    private static ClientWorld lastTrackedWorld = null;
    private static PowerNetworkManager.NetworkSnapshot cachedSnapshot = null;

    private final BlockPos polePos;
    private int selectedTimeframe = 0;
    private Block filteredConsumerBlock = null;
    private Block filteredProducerBlock = null;
    private boolean searchActive = false;
    private String searchQuery = "";

    public ElectricNetworkInfoScreen(BlockPos polePos) {
        super(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.electric_network.title"));
        this.polePos = polePos;
        lastViewedPolePos = polePos;
        lastNetworkScanTick = -100L;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean shouldPause() {
        return false;
    }

    private static void resetHistory() {
        CONSUMER_RAW_TICKS.clear();
        PRODUCER_RAW_TICKS.clear();
        rawWriteCursor = 0;
        totalRecordedTicks = 0;
        lastRecordedWorldTick = -1L;
        lastNetworkScanTick = -100L;
        lastViewedPolePos = null;
        cachedSnapshot = null;
    }

    public static void tickClientHistory(MinecraftClient client) {
        if (client.world == null) {
            if (lastTrackedWorld != null) {
                lastTrackedWorld = null;
                resetHistory();
            }
            return;
        }
        if (client.world != lastTrackedWorld) {
            lastTrackedWorld = client.world;
            resetHistory();
        }
        if (client.isPaused()) return;

        long wt = client.world.getTime();
        if (wt == lastRecordedWorldTick) return;
        lastRecordedWorldTick = wt;

        boolean screenOpen = client.currentScreen instanceof ElectricNetworkInfoScreen;
        BlockPos target = lastViewedPolePos;
        if (screenOpen) {
            target = ((ElectricNetworkInfoScreen) client.currentScreen).polePos;
            lastViewedPolePos = target;
        } else if (target == null && client.player != null && wt % 40 == 0) {
            target = findNearbyPole(client.world, client.player.getBlockPos());
            if (target != null) lastViewedPolePos = target;
        }
        if (target == null) return;

        int scanInterval = screenOpen ? 5 : 20;
        if (cachedSnapshot == null || Math.abs(wt - lastNetworkScanTick) >= scanInterval) {
            cachedSnapshot = PowerNetworkManager.scanNetwork(client.world, target);
            lastNetworkScanTick = wt;
        }

        PowerNetworkManager.NetworkSnapshot snap = cachedSnapshot;
        if (snap == null) return;

        Set<Block> seenConsumers = new HashSet<>();
        for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat stat : snap.consumers()) {
            seenConsumers.add(stat.block());
            long[] buf = CONSUMER_RAW_TICKS.computeIfAbsent(stat.block(), k -> new long[RAW_BUFFER_SIZE]);
            buf[rawWriteCursor] = stat.watts();
        }
        for (Map.Entry<Block, long[]> e : CONSUMER_RAW_TICKS.entrySet()) {
            if (!seenConsumers.contains(e.getKey())) {
                e.getValue()[rawWriteCursor] = 0L;
            }
        }

        Set<Block> seenProducers = new HashSet<>();
        for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat stat : snap.producers()) {
            seenProducers.add(stat.block());
            long[] buf = PRODUCER_RAW_TICKS.computeIfAbsent(stat.block(), k -> new long[RAW_BUFFER_SIZE]);
            buf[rawWriteCursor] = stat.watts();
        }
        for (Map.Entry<Block, long[]> e : PRODUCER_RAW_TICKS.entrySet()) {
            if (!seenProducers.contains(e.getKey())) {
                e.getValue()[rawWriteCursor] = 0L;
            }
        }

        rawWriteCursor = (rawWriteCursor + 1) % RAW_BUFFER_SIZE;
        totalRecordedTicks++;
    }

    private static BlockPos findNearbyPole(World world, BlockPos center) {
        for (int dx = -12; dx <= 12; dx += 2) {
            for (int dz = -12; dz <= 12; dz += 2) {
                for (int dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy++) {
                    BlockPos p = center.add(dx, dy, dz);
                    Block b = world.getBlockState(p).getBlock();
                    if (b instanceof ElectricPoleBlock || b instanceof CreativeEnergySourceBlock) {
                        return p.toImmutable();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private PowerNetworkManager.NetworkSnapshot getOrScanSnapshot(World world) {
        if (cachedSnapshot == null) {
            cachedSnapshot = PowerNetworkManager.scanNetwork(world, this.polePos);
            lastNetworkScanTick = world.getTime();
        }
        return cachedSnapshot;
    }

    private List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> getFilteredStats(
            List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> stats,
            Map<Block, long[]> rawHistoryMap) {
        List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> displayList = new ArrayList<>();
        String queryLower = this.searchQuery.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat st : stats) {
            if (!queryLower.isBlank()) {
                String name = st.block().getName().getString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
                if (!name.contains(queryLower)) continue;
            }
            long avgWatts = computeTimeframeAverageWatts(rawHistoryMap, st.block(), st.watts());
            displayList.add(new PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat(st.block(), st.count(), avgWatts, st.color()));
        }
        return displayList;
    }

    private long[] buildTimeframeSeries(Map<Block, long[]> rawMap, Block block) {
        long[] result = new long[GRAPH_POINTS];
        long[] raw = rawMap.get(block);
        if (raw == null || totalRecordedTicks <= 0) return result;

        int step = TICKS_PER_POINT[this.selectedTimeframe];
        if (this.selectedTimeframe == 8) {
            step = Math.max(1, Math.min(RAW_BUFFER_SIZE / GRAPH_POINTS, (totalRecordedTicks + GRAPH_POINTS - 1) / GRAPH_POINTS));
        }

        int sampleWindow = Math.min(step, 120);
        for (int i = 0; i < GRAPH_POINTS; i++) {
            int pointsAgo = (GRAPH_POINTS - 1) - i;
            long startTicksAgo = (long) pointsAgo * step;
            if (startTicksAgo >= totalRecordedTicks || startTicksAgo >= RAW_BUFFER_SIZE) {
                result[i] = 0L;
                continue;
            }

            long sum = 0L;
            int count = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < sampleWindow; k++) {
                long tAgo = startTicksAgo + k;
                if (tAgo >= totalRecordedTicks || tAgo >= RAW_BUFFER_SIZE) break;
                int idx = Math.floorMod(rawWriteCursor - 1 - (int) tAgo, RAW_BUFFER_SIZE);
                sum += raw[idx];
                count++;
            }
            result[i] = (count > 0) ? (sum / count) : 0L;
        }
        return result;
    }

    private long computeTimeframeAverageWatts(Map<Block, long[]> rawMap, Block block, long fallbackCurrentWatts) {
        if (this.selectedTimeframe == 0) {
            return fallbackCurrentWatts;
        }
        long[] series = buildTimeframeSeries(rawMap, block);
        long sum = 0L;
        for (long v : series) {
            sum += v;
        }
        return sum / GRAPH_POINTS;
    }

    private void drawHeader(DrawContext context, int hx, int hy, int hw, int mouseX, int mouseY) {

    private void drawTopSummaryBox(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw,
                                   String label, float ratio, int barColor, String rightValueText) {
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + bw, by + 28, 0xFF18191B);

        int labelW = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(label) * 0.78f);
        int infoX = bx + 8 + labelW;

        context.fill(infoX, infoY, infoX + 7, infoY + 7, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(infoX + 1, infoY + 1, infoX + 6, infoY + 6, 0xFF3FA9F5);

        if (fillW > 0) {

        }

        int valW = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(rightValueText) * 0.72f);

    }

    private void renderColumnPanel(DrawContext context, int cx, int cy, int cw, int ch,
                                   String title, List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> stats,
                                   Map<Block, long[]> rawHistoryMap, Block activeFilter,
                                   long fallbackMaxScale, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        context.fill(cx, cy, cx + cw, cy + ch, 0xFF161719);
        context.fill(cx + 1, cy + 1, cx + cw - 1, cy + ch - 1, 0xFF242528);

        drawScaledText(context, title, cx + 5, cy + 4, 0.78f, 0xFFE6E6E6, true);

        int resetBtnX = cx + cw - 14;
        int resetBtnY = cy + 2;
        boolean hovReset = mouseX >= resetBtnX && mouseX < resetBtnX + 11 && mouseY >= resetBtnY && mouseY < resetBtnY + 11;
        context.fill(resetBtnX, resetBtnY, resetBtnX + 11, resetBtnY + 11, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(resetBtnX + 1, resetBtnY + 1, resetBtnX + 10, resetBtnY + 10, hovReset ? 0xFFFF5252 : 0xFFE04848);
        drawScaledText(context, "\u21bb", resetBtnX + 3, resetBtnY + 2, 0.70f, 0xFF141414, false);

        int graphLeft = cx + 22;
        int graphTop = cy + 15;
        int graphRight = cx + cw - 4;
        int graphBottom = cy + 78;
        int graphW = graphRight - graphLeft;
        int graphH = graphBottom - graphTop;

        context.fill(cx + 3, graphTop - 1, graphRight + 1, graphBottom + 9, 0xFF0A0B0C);

        Map<Block, long[]> sampledSeriesMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        long maxScale = 10_000L;
        for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat st : stats) {
            if (activeFilter != null && st.block() != activeFilter) continue;
            long[] series = buildTimeframeSeries(rawHistoryMap, st.block());
            sampledSeriesMap.put(st.block(), series);
            for (long val : series) {
                if (val > maxScale) maxScale = val;
            }
        }
        maxScale = Math.max(maxScale, fallbackMaxScale / 2);
        maxScale = (long) (Math.ceil(maxScale / 50_000.0) * 50_000L);
        if (maxScale <= 0) maxScale = 100_000L;

        int hRows = 6;
        for (int r = 0; r <= hRows; r++) {
            int gy = graphTop + Math.round((r / (float) hRows) * graphH);
            context.fill(graphLeft, gy, graphRight, gy + 1, (r == hRows) ? 0xFF333538 : 0xFF181A1C);

            if (!stats.isEmpty() || !rawHistoryMap.isEmpty()) {
                long rowVal = Math.round(((hRows - r) / (double) hRows) * maxScale);
                String yLbl = PowerNetworkManager.formatAxisWatts(rowVal);
                int lblW = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(yLbl) * 0.55f);
                drawScaledText(context, yLbl, graphLeft - lblW - 2, gy - 2, 0.55f, 0xFF888A8E, false);
            }
        }

        int vCols = 10;
        float maxTimeNum = TIMEFRAME_MAX_NUM[this.selectedTimeframe];
        for (int c = 0; c <= vCols; c++) {
            int gx = graphLeft + Math.round((c / (float) vCols) * graphW);
            context.fill(gx, graphTop, gx + 1, graphBottom, 0xFF181A1C);

            float tVal = maxTimeNum * (1.0f - (c / (float) vCols));
            String tStr = (tVal == (int) tVal) ? String.valueOf((int) tVal) : String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.1f", tVal);
            drawScaledTextCentered(context, tStr, gx, graphBottom + 2, 0.50f, 0xFF888A8E, false);
        }

        for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat stat : stats) {
            if (activeFilter != null && stat.block() != activeFilter) continue;
            long[] series = sampledSeriesMap.get(stat.block());
            if (series == null) continue;

            int prevX = -1;
            int prevY = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < GRAPH_POINTS; i++) {
                float xRatio = i / (float) (GRAPH_POINTS - 1);
                float yRatio = MathHelper.clamp(series[i] / (float) maxScale, 0.0f, 1.0f);
                int px = graphLeft + Math.round(xRatio * (graphW - 1));
                int py = graphBottom - 1 - Math.round(yRatio * (graphH - 2));

                if (prevX != -1 && (series[i] > 0 || series[Math.max(0, i - 1)] > 0)) {
                    int minX = Math.min(prevX, px);
                    int maxX = Math.max(prevX, px) + 1;
                    context.fill(minX, prevY, maxX, prevY + 1, stat.color());
                    int minY = Math.min(prevY, py);
                    int maxY = Math.max(prevY, py) + 1;
                    context.fill(px, minY, px + 1, maxY, stat.color());
                }
                prevX = px;
                prevY = py;
            }
        }

        int listTopY = graphBottom + 11;
        int cellGap = 2;
        int subColW = (cw - 8 - cellGap) / 2;
        int rowH = 14;
        int numRows = Math.max(4, (ch - (listTopY - cy) - 3) / (rowH + 1));

        List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> displayList = getFilteredStats(stats, rawHistoryMap);

        long totalGroupWatts = 0L;
        for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat st : displayList) {
            totalGroupWatts += st.watts();
        }

        for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
                int idx = r + c * numRows;
                int cellX = cx + 4 + c * (subColW + cellGap);
                int cellY = listTopY + r * (rowH + 1);

                if (idx < displayList.size()) {
                    PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat st = displayList.get(idx);
                    boolean isSelected = (activeFilter == st.block());
                    boolean hovCell = mouseX >= cellX && mouseX < cellX + subColW && mouseY >= cellY && mouseY < cellY + rowH;

                    int cellBg = isSelected ? 0xFF484B50 : (hovCell ? 0xFF3C3E42 : 0xFF313235);
                    context.fill(cellX, cellY, cellX + subColW, cellY + rowH, 0xFF141414);
                    context.fill(cellX + 1, cellY + 1, cellX + subColW - 1, cellY + rowH - 1, cellBg);

                    context.fill(cellX + 1, cellY + 1, cellX + 13, cellY + rowH - 1, 0xFF1E1F22);
                    context.getMatrices().push();
                    context.getMatrices().translate(cellX + 1.5f, cellY + 1.0f, 100.0f);
                    context.getMatrices().scale(0.68f, 0.68f, 1.0f);
                    context.drawItem(new ItemStack(st.block().asItem()), 0, 0);
                    context.getMatrices().pop();

                    String cntStr = String.valueOf(st.count());
                    int cntW = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(cntStr) * 0.55f);
                    drawScaledText(context, cntStr, cellX + 13 - cntW, cellY + rowH - 5, 0.55f, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);

                    int barStartX = cellX + 15;
                    int barEndX = cellX + subColW - 34;
                    int barW = Math.max(10, barEndX - barStartX);
                    int barY = cellY + 5;
                    context.fill(barStartX, barY, barStartX + barW, barY + 4, 0xFF18191B);

                    float share = (totalGroupWatts > 0) ? MathHelper.clamp(st.watts() / (float) totalGroupWatts, 0.0f, 1.0f) : 0.0f;
                    int fillW = Math.round(share * barW);
                    if (fillW > 0) {
                        context.fill(barStartX, barY, barStartX + fillW, barY + 4, st.color());
                    }

                    String wStr = PowerNetworkManager.formatWatts(st.watts());
                    int wWidth = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(wStr) * 0.60f);
                    drawScaledText(context, wStr, cellX + subColW - wWidth - 2, cellY + 4, 0.60f, 0xFFE6E6E6, true);
                } else {
                    context.fill(cellX, cellY, cellX + subColW, cellY + rowH, 0xFF1B1C1E);
                    context.fill(cellX, cellY + rowH - 1, cellX + subColW, cellY + rowH, 0xFF121314);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void drawSmallMagnifier(DrawContext context, int lx, int ly) {
        int col = 0xFFE6E6E6;
        context.fill(lx + 1, ly, lx + 4, ly + 1, col);
        context.fill(lx, ly + 1, lx + 1, ly + 4, col);
        context.fill(lx + 4, ly + 1, lx + 5, ly + 4, col);
        context.fill(lx + 1, ly + 4, lx + 4, ly + 5, col);
        context.fill(lx + 4, ly + 5, lx + 6, ly + 7, col);
    }

    private void drawScaledText(DrawContext context, String text, int x, int y, float scale, int color, boolean shadow) {
        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(x, y, 200.0f);
        context.getMatrices().scale(scale, scale, 1.0f);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, text, 0, 0, color, shadow);
        context.getMatrices().pop();
    }

    private void drawScaledTextCentered(DrawContext context, String text, int centerX, int y, float scale, int color, boolean shadow) {
        int w = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(text) * scale);
        drawScaledText(context, text, centerX - w / 2, y, scale, color, shadow);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (this.client == null || this.client.world == null) return false;

        int panelW = Math.min(520, this.width - 12);
        int panelH = Math.min(254, this.height - 12);
        int x = (this.width - panelW) / 2;
        int y = (this.height - panelH) / 2;

        int hx = x + 3;
        int hy = y + 3;
        int hw = panelW - 6;
        int closeBtnX = hx + hw - 14;
        int searchBtnX = closeBtnX - 15;

        if (mouseX >= closeBtnX && mouseX < closeBtnX + 13 && mouseY >= hy + 1 && mouseY < hy + 13) {
            this.close();
            return true;
        }

        if (!this.searchActive && mouseX >= searchBtnX && mouseX < searchBtnX + 13 && mouseY >= hy + 1 && mouseY < hy + 13) {
            this.searchActive = true;
            return true;
        } else if (this.searchActive) {
            int boxX = closeBtnX - 81;
            if (mouseX >= boxX && mouseX < closeBtnX - 3 && mouseY >= hy + 1 && mouseY < hy + 13) {
                if (button == 1) this.searchQuery = "";
                return true;
            } else if (this.searchQuery.isEmpty()) {
                this.searchActive = false;
            }
        }

        int innerW = panelW - 10;
        int col1X = x + 5;
        int tabsY = y + 51;
        int tabCount = TIMEFRAME_LABELS.length;
        int tabW = innerW / tabCount;
        for (int i = 0; i < tabCount; i++) {
            int tx = col1X + i * tabW;
            int tw = (i == tabCount - 1) ? (col1X + innerW - tx) : (tabW - 1);
            if (mouseX >= tx && mouseX < tx + tw && mouseY >= tabsY && mouseY < tabsY + 12) {
                this.selectedTimeframe = i;
                if (this.client.player != null) {
                    this.client.player.playSound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), 0.3f, 1.2f);
                }
                return true;
            }
        }

        int colGap = 4;
        int colW = (innerW - colGap * 2) / 3;
        int col2X = col1X + colW + colGap;
        int mainTopY = y + 66;

        if (mouseX >= col1X + colW - 14 && mouseX < col1X + colW - 3 && mouseY >= mainTopY + 2 && mouseY < mainTopY + 13) {
            this.filteredConsumerBlock = null;
            return true;
        }
        if (mouseX >= col2X + colW - 14 && mouseX < col2X + colW - 3 && mouseY >= mainTopY + 2 && mouseY < mainTopY + 13) {
            this.filteredProducerBlock = null;
            return true;
        }

        PowerNetworkManager.NetworkSnapshot snap = getOrScanSnapshot(this.client.world);
        List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> filteredConsumers = getFilteredStats(snap.consumers(), CONSUMER_RAW_TICKS);
        List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> filteredProducers = getFilteredStats(snap.producers(), PRODUCER_RAW_TICKS);

        int mainH = panelH - 71;
        int listTopY = mainTopY + 78 + 11;
        int subColW = (colW - 10) / 2;
        int rowH = 14;
        int numRows = Math.max(4, (mainH - (listTopY - mainTopY) - 3) / (rowH + 1));

        for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
                int idx = r + c * numRows;
                int cellX1 = col1X + 4 + c * (subColW + 2);
                int cellY = listTopY + r * (rowH + 1);
                if (idx < filteredConsumers.size() && mouseX >= cellX1 && mouseX < cellX1 + subColW && mouseY >= cellY && mouseY < cellY + rowH) {
                    Block b = filteredConsumers.get(idx).block();
                    this.filteredConsumerBlock = (this.filteredConsumerBlock == b) ? null : b;
                    return true;
                }

                int cellX2 = col2X + 4 + c * (subColW + 2);
                if (idx < filteredProducers.size() && mouseX >= cellX2 && mouseX < cellX2 + subColW && mouseY >= cellY && mouseY < cellY + rowH) {
                    Block b = filteredProducers.get(idx).block();
                    this.filteredProducerBlock = (this.filteredProducerBlock == b) ? null : b;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean charTyped(char chr, int modifiers) {
        if (this.searchActive && chr >= 32) {
            this.searchQuery += chr;
            return true;
        }
        return super.charTyped(chr, modifiers);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(int keyCode, int scanCode, int modifiers) {
        if (this.searchActive) {
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_BACKSPACE && !this.searchQuery.isEmpty()) {
                this.searchQuery = this.searchQuery.substring(0, this.searchQuery.length() - 1);
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) {
                this.searchActive = false;
                this.searchQuery = "";
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ENTER || keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_KP_ENTER) {
                this.searchActive = false;
                return true;
            }
            return true;
        }
        if (this.client != null && this.client.options.inventoryKey.matchesKey(keyCode, scanCode)) {
            this.close();
            return true;
        }
        return super.keyPressed(keyCode, scanCode, modifiers);
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.client.content.fluids;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.fluids.BoilerScreenHandler;
import net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.DrawContext;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screen.ingame.HandledScreen;
import net.minecraft.client.render.LightmapTextureManager;
import net.minecraft.client.render.OverlayTexture;
import net.minecraft.client.util.math.MatrixStack;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerInventory;
import net.minecraft.text.Text;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Direction;
import net.minecraft.util.math.MathHelper;
import net.minecraft.util.math.RotationAxis;

public class BoilerScreen extends HandledScreen<BoilerScreenHandler> {

    private float previewYaw = -35.0f;
    private float previewPitch = 25.0f;
    private float previewZoom = 18.0f;
    private boolean draggingPreview = false;

    public BoilerScreen(BoilerScreenHandler handler, PlayerInventory inventory, Text title) {
        super(handler, inventory, title);
        this.backgroundWidth = 236;
        this.backgroundHeight = 220;
    }

    @Override
    protected void drawForeground(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, this.title, 8, 6, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);
    }

    @Override
    protected void drawBackground(DrawContext context, float delta, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;

        context.fill(x, y, x + backgroundWidth, y + backgroundHeight, 0xFF161616);
        context.fill(x + 1, y + 1, x + backgroundWidth - 1, y + backgroundHeight - 1, 0xFF313234);

        context.fill(x + 3, y + 3, x + backgroundWidth - 3, y + 16, 0xFF242527);
        int titleEnd = x + 14 + textRenderer.getWidth(this.title);
        for (int gx = titleEnd; gx < x + backgroundWidth - 24; gx += 3) {
            context.fill(gx, y + 5, gx + 1, y + 14, 0xFF1A1B1C);
        }

        boolean hasFuel = handler.getBurnTime() > 0;
        int ledOuter = !hasFuel ? 0xFF661111 : 0xFF115511;
        int ledInner = !hasFuel ? 0xFFFF3333 : 0xFF44FF44;
        int ledX = x + backgroundWidth - 19;
        context.fill(ledX, y + 5, ledX + 10, y + 14, 0xFF111111);
        context.fill(ledX + 1, y + 6, ledX + 9, y + 13, ledOuter);
        context.fill(ledX + 2, y + 7, ledX + 8, y + 12, ledInner);

        int viewLeft = x + 10;
        int viewTop = y + 18;
        int viewRight = x + backgroundWidth - 10;
        int viewBottom = y + 78;
        context.fill(viewLeft - 1, viewTop - 1, viewRight + 1, viewBottom + 1, 0xFF141414);
        drawCheckerboard(context, viewLeft, viewTop, viewRight, viewBottom, 8);

        context.enableScissor(viewLeft, viewTop, viewRight, viewBottom);
        renderBoiler3DPreview(context, (viewLeft + viewRight) / 2, (viewTop + viewBottom) / 2 + 6, delta);
        context.disableScissor();

        drawSlotFrame(context, x + 10, y + 83);
        if (handler.getSlot(0).getStack().isEmpty()) {
            drawFlameSilhouette(context, x + 11, y + 84);
        }

        int redBarX = x + 32;
        int redBarY = y + 87;
        int redBarW = 192;
        int redBarH = 10;
        context.fill(redBarX, redBarY, redBarX + redBarW, redBarY + redBarH, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(redBarX + 1, redBarY + 1, redBarX + redBarW - 1, redBarY + redBarH - 1, 0xFF222325);

        int burnTime = handler.getBurnTime();
        int maxBurnTime = Math.max(1, handler.getMaxBurnTime());
        if (burnTime > 0) {
            int fillW = Math.min(redBarW - 2, Math.round((burnTime / (float) maxBurnTime) * (redBarW - 2)));
            context.fill(redBarX + 1, redBarY + 1, redBarX + 1 + fillW, redBarY + redBarH - 1, 0xFFC82828);
            context.fill(redBarX + 1, redBarY + 1, redBarX + 1 + fillW, redBarY + 4, 0xFFEA4C3B);
        }

        context.fill(x + 8, y + 131, x + backgroundWidth - 8, y + 132, 0xFF202122);
        context.fill(x + 8, y + 132, x + backgroundWidth - 8, y + 133, 0xFF3E4042);

        int invFrameX = x + 37;
        for (int row = 0; row < 3; row++) {
            for (int col = 0; col < 9; col++) {
                drawSlotFrame(context, invFrameX + col * 18, y + 137 + row * 18);
            }
        }
        for (int col = 0; col < 9; col++) {
            drawSlotFrame(context, invFrameX + col * 18, y + 195);
        }
    }

    private void drawCheckerboard(DrawContext context, int left, int top, int right, int bottom, int cellSize) {
        for (int py = top; py < bottom; py += cellSize) {
            for (int px = left; px < right; px += cellSize) {
                int gx = (px - left) / cellSize;
                int gy = (py - top) / cellSize;
                context.fill(px, py, Math.min(px + cellSize, right), Math.min(py + cellSize, bottom), ((gx + gy) % 2 == 0) ? 0xFF262729 : 0xFF2E3032);
            }
        }
    }

    private void drawSlotFrame(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy) {
        context.fill(sx, sy, sx + 18, sy + 18, 0xFF18181A);
        context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 1, sx + 17, sy + 17, 0xFF3A3C3E);
    }

    private void drawFlameSilhouette(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy) {
        int c = 0xFF626466;
        context.fill(sx + 7, sy + 3, sx + 9, sy + 6, c);
        context.fill(sx + 5, sy + 6, sx + 11, sy + 10, c);
        context.fill(sx + 4, sy + 9, sx + 12, sy + 13, c);
        context.fill(sx + 6, sy + 13, sx + 10, sy + 14, c);
    }

    private void renderBoiler3DPreview(DrawContext context, int centerX, int centerY, float delta) {
        MatrixStack matrices = context.getMatrices();
        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(centerX, centerY, 150.0f);
        matrices.scale(this.previewZoom, -this.previewZoom, this.previewZoom);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(this.previewPitch));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(this.previewYaw));
        matrices.translate(0.0f, -0.6f, -1.0f);

        boolean burning = handler.getBurnTime() > 0;
        FluidMachinesRenderer.BoilerRenderer.renderBoilerModel(Direction.NORTH, burning, matrices, context.getVertexConsumers(), LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE, OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV);

        matrices.pop();
        context.draw();
    }

    private boolean isInsideViewport(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        return mouseX >= x + 10 && mouseX <= x + backgroundWidth - 10 && mouseY >= y + 18 && mouseY <= y + 78;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        if (isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.previewZoom = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewZoom + (float) verticalAmount * 1.8f, 10.0f, 40.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mouseX, mouseY, horizontalAmount, verticalAmount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if ((button == 0 || button == 1) && isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.draggingPreview = true;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        this.draggingPreview = false;
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.draggingPreview) {
            this.previewYaw += (float) deltaX * 1.5f;
            this.previewPitch = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewPitch + (float) deltaY * 1.5f, -80.0f, 80.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        super.render(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);
        drawMouseoverTooltip(context, mouseX, mouseY);
    }
}

    public static class BoilerRenderer implements BlockEntityRenderer<BoilerBlockEntity> {

        public static void renderBoilerModel(Direction facing, boolean burning, MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers, int light, int overlay) {

            BlockRenderManager brm = MinecraftClient.getInstance().getBlockRenderManager();
            BlockState darkBase = Blocks.POLISHED_DEEPSLATE.getDefaultState();
            BlockState boilerDrum = Blocks.COPPER_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
            BlockState steelBand = Blocks.NETHERITE_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
            BlockState pipeNozzle = Blocks.IRON_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
            BlockState fireCore = burning ? Blocks.MAGMA_BLOCK.getDefaultState() : Blocks.COAL_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
            int fireLight = burning ? LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE : light;

            matrices.push();
            matrices.translate(0.5, 0.0, 0.5);
            matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(-facing.asRotation()));
            matrices.translate(-0.5, 0.0, -0.5);

    public static class SteamEngineRenderer implements BlockEntityRenderer<SteamEngineBlockEntity> {
        public SteamEngineRenderer(BlockEntityRendererFactory.Context ctx) {}

        @Override
        public void render(SteamEngineBlockEntity entity, float tickDelta, MatrixStack matrices,
                           VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers, int light, int overlay) {
            BlockState state = entity.getCachedState();
            if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof SteamEngineBlock)) return;
            Direction facing = state.get(SteamEngineBlock.FACING);
            float wheelAngle = entity.getClientFlywheelAngle(tickDelta);

            BlockRenderManager brm = MinecraftClient.getInstance().getBlockRenderManager();
            BlockState heavyBase = Blocks.DEEPSLATE_TILES.getDefaultState();
            BlockState steelBody = Blocks.IRON_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
            BlockState darkFrame = Blocks.NETHERITE_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
            BlockState copperCoil = Blocks.COPPER_BLOCK.getDefaultState();

            matrices.push();
            matrices.translate(0.5, 0.0, 0.5);
            matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(-facing.asRotation()));
            matrices.translate(-0.5, 0.0, -0.5);

            drawBox(brm, darkFrame, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.82f, 0.55f, 1.85f, 2.64f, 2.35f, 0.30f);

            drawBox(brm, darkFrame, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay,  0.10f, 2.80f, 0.80f, 0.80f, 0.70f, 0.80f);
            drawBox(brm, darkFrame, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay,  0.10f, 2.80f, 2.10f, 0.80f, 0.70f, 0.80f);

            drawBox(brm, copperCoil, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.60f, 0.55f, 3.20f, 2.20f, 1.95f, 1.45f);

            matrices.push();
            matrices.translate(0.5, 1.65, 3.95);
            matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Z.rotationDegrees(wheelAngle));
            drawBox(brm, steelBody, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.90f, -0.22f, -0.25f, 1.80f, 0.44f, 0.50f);

        }

    private void drawCheckerboard(DrawContext context, int left, int top, int right, int bottom, int cellSize) {
        for (int py = top; py < bottom; py += cellSize) {
            for (int px = left; px < right; px += cellSize) {
                int gx = (px - left) / cellSize;
                int gy = (py - top) / cellSize;
                int color = ((gx + gy) % 2 == 0) ? 0xFF262729 : 0xFF2E3032;
                context.fill(px, py, Math.min(px + cellSize, right), Math.min(py + cellSize, bottom), color);
            }
        }
    }

    private void renderInserter3DPreview(DrawContext context, int centerX, int centerY, float delta) {

        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(this.previewYaw));

        boolean isBurner = handler.blockEntity != null && handler.blockEntity.isBurner();
        BlockState previewState = handler.blockEntity != null
                ? handler.blockEntity.getCachedState()
                : (isBurner ? ModBlocks.BURNER_INSERTER.getDefaultState() : ModBlocks.INSERTER.getDefaultState());

        matrices.translate(-0.5f, -0.4f, -0.5f);
        // 1. Ð Ð¸ÑÑƒÐµÐ¼ ÑÑ‚Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ð½Ñƒ Ð¼Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ð¿ÑƒÐ»ÑÑ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ð°
        client.getBlockRenderManager().renderBlockAsEntity(
                previewState, matrices, context.getVertexConsumers(),
                LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE, OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV);

        // 2. Ð Ð¸ÑÑƒÐµÐ¼ ÑˆÐ°Ñ€Ð½Ð¸Ñ€Ð½ÑƒÑŽ 3D-Ñ€ÑƒÐºÑƒ Ñ ÐºÐ»ÐµÑˆÐ½Ñ‘Ð¹ Ð¸ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚Ð¾Ð¼ Ð² Ñ€ÐµÐ°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾Ð¼ Ð²Ñ€ÐµÐ¼ÐµÐ½Ð¸
        Direction facing = previewState.contains(InserterBlock.FACING)
                ? previewState.get(InserterBlock.FACING) : Direction.NORTH;
        float progress = handler.blockEntity != null ? handler.blockEntity.getArmProgress(delta) : 0.0f;
        ItemStack held = handler.blockEntity != null ? handler.blockEntity.getHeldStack() : ItemStack.EMPTY;

        com.fixplot.factoriocore.client.content.logistics.inserter.InserterRenderer.renderArticulatedArm(
                handler.blockEntity,
                isBurner,
                facing,

    private boolean isInsideViewport(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        return mouseX >= x + 10 && mouseX <= x + backgroundWidth - 10 && mouseY >= y + 18 && mouseY <= y + 70;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        if (isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.previewZoom = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewZoom + (float) verticalAmount * 2.5f, 10.0f, 52.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mouseX, mouseY, horizontalAmount, verticalAmount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if ((button == 0 || button == 1) && isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.draggingPreview = true;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (this.draggingPreview && (button == 0 || button == 1)) {
            this.draggingPreview = false;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.draggingPreview) {
            this.previewYaw += (float) deltaX * 1.5f;
            this.previewPitch = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewPitch + (float) deltaY * 1.5f, -80.0f, 80.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        super.render(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);
        drawMouseoverTooltip(context, mouseX, mouseY);
    }

    private void drawChestSlot(DrawContext context, int slotX, int slotY, boolean lockedByRedX) {
        context.fill(slotX, slotY, slotX + 18, slotY + 18, 0xFF18181A);
        if (lockedByRedX) {

            context.fill(slotX + 1, slotY + 1, slotX + 17, slotY + 17, 0xFF7A2222);
            context.fill(slotX + 2, slotY + 2, slotX + 16, slotY + 16, 0xFF5E1919);
            drawSmallX(context, slotX + 5, slotY + 5, 0xFFCC4444);

    private void drawRedXButton(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        boolean hovered = mouseX >= bx && mouseX <= bx + 18 && mouseY >= by && mouseY <= by + 18;
        boolean hasLimit = handler.getUnlockedSlots() < handler.totalSlots;

        int borderCol = this.limitSelectionMode ? 0xFFFFCC44 : 0xFF141414;
        int bgCol = this.limitSelectionMode ? 0xFFB83227 : (hovered ? 0xFF8F2820 : (hasLimit ? 0xFF752019 : 0xFF3A3C3E));

        context.fill(bx, by, bx + 18, by + 18, borderCol);

    }

    private void drawSmallX(DrawContext context, int ox, int oy, int color) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            context.fill(ox + i, oy + i, ox + i + 2, oy + i + 1, color);
            context.fill(ox + 6 - i, oy + i, ox + 8 - i, oy + i + 1, color);
        }
    }

    private int getHoveredChestSlotIndex(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        int gridX = x + FactorioChestScreenHandler.GRID_START_X - 1;
        int gridY = y + handler.gridStartY - 1;

        if (mouseX < gridX || mouseX >= gridX + FactorioChestScreenHandler.COLUMNS * 18
                || mouseY < gridY || mouseY >= gridY + handler.rows * 18) {
            return -1;
        }
        int col = (int) ((mouseX - gridX) / 18);
        int row = (int) ((mouseY - gridY) / 18);
        return col + row * FactorioChestScreenHandler.COLUMNS;
    }

    private void renderChest3DPreview(DrawContext context, int centerX, int centerY) {
        MinecraftClient client = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        MatrixStack matrices = context.getMatrices();

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(centerX, centerY, 150.0f);
        matrices.scale(this.previewZoom, -this.previewZoom, this.previewZoom);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(this.previewPitch));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(this.previewYaw));

        BlockState previewState = handler.chestEntity != null
                ? handler.chestEntity.getCachedState()
                : ModBlocks.WOODEN_CHEST.getDefaultState();

        matrices.translate(-0.5f, -0.45f, -0.5f);
        client.getBlockRenderManager().renderBlockAsEntity(
                previewState,
                matrices,
                context.getVertexConsumers(),
                LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE,
                OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV
        );

        matrices.pop();
        context.draw();
    }

    private void drawCheckerboard(DrawContext context, int left, int top, int right, int bottom, int cellSize) {
        for (int py = top; py < bottom; py += cellSize) {
            for (int px = left; px < right; px += cellSize) {
                int gx = (px - left) / cellSize;
                int gy = (py - top) / cellSize;
                int color = ((gx + gy) % 2 == 0) ? 0xFF262729 : 0xFF2E3032;
                context.fill(px, py, Math.min(px + cellSize, right), Math.min(py + cellSize, bottom), color);
            }
        }
    }

    private void drawDivider(DrawContext context, int x, int y, int width) {
        context.fill(x, y, x + width, y + 1, 0xFF202122);
        context.fill(x, y + 1, x + width, y + 2, 0xFF3E4042);
    }

    private boolean isInsideViewport(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        return mouseX >= x + 10 && mouseX <= x + 76 && mouseY >= y + 20 && mouseY <= y + 86;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        if (isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.previewZoom = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewZoom + (float) verticalAmount * 2.5f, 12.0f, 42.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mouseX, mouseY, horizontalAmount, verticalAmount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;

        if ((button == 0 || button == 1) && isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.draggingPreview = true;
            return true;
        }

        // ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ ÐºÑ€Ð°ÑÐ½Ð¾Ð¹ ÐºÐ½Ð¾Ð¿ÐºÐµ [X] (X: 34..52, Y: 91..109)
        int redBtnX = x + 34;
        int redBtnY = y + 91;
        if (mouseX >= redBtnX && mouseX <= redBtnX + 18 && mouseY >= redBtnY && mouseY <= redBtnY + 18) {
            if (button == 1 || (this.limitSelectionMode && button == 0)) {
                // ÐŸÐ¾Ð²Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÐºÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ ÐŸÐšÐœ Ð¿Ð¾ ÐºÐ½Ð¾Ð¿ÐºÐµ [X] Ð¿Ð¾Ð»Ð½Ð¾ÑÑ‚ÑŒÑŽ Ñ€Ð°Ð·Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÑ‚ Ð²ÑÐµ ÑÐ»Ð¾Ñ‚Ñ‹ ÑÑƒÐ½Ð´ÑƒÐºÐ°!
                this.limitSelectionMode = false;
                ClientPlayNetworking.send(new ChangeStackSizePayload(handler.targetPos, handler.totalSlots));
            } else if (button == 0) {
                this.limitSelectionMode = true;
            }
            return true;
        }

        // Ð•ÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð°ÐºÑ‚Ð¸Ð²ÐµÐ½ Ñ€ÐµÐ¶Ð¸Ð¼ ÐºÑ€Ð°ÑÐ½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ ÐºÑ€ÐµÑÑ‚Ð¸ÐºÐ° [X] Ð˜Ð›Ð˜ Ð·Ð°Ð¶Ð°Ñ‚ Shift + ÐŸÐšÐœ Ð¿Ð¾ ÑÐ»Ð¾Ñ‚Ñƒ ÑÑƒÐ½Ð´ÑƒÐºÐ°
        int hoveredSlot = getHoveredChestSlotIndex(mouseX, mouseY);
        if (hoveredSlot >= 0) {
            if (this.limitSelectionMode && button == 0) {
                this.limitSelectionMode = false;
                ClientPlayNetworking.send(new ChangeStackSizePayload(handler.targetPos, hoveredSlot));
                return true;
            }
            if (hasShiftDown() && button == 1) {
                int nextLimit = (handler.getUnlockedSlots() == hoveredSlot) ? handler.totalSlots : hoveredSlot;
                ClientPlayNetworking.send(new ChangeStackSizePayload(handler.targetPos, nextLimit));
                return true;
            }
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (this.draggingPreview && (button == 0 || button == 1)) {
            this.draggingPreview = false;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.draggingPreview) {
            this.previewYaw += (float) deltaX * 1.5f;
            this.previewPitch = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewPitch + (float) deltaY * 1.5f, -80.0f, 80.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        super.render(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);

        // Ð•ÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð²ÐºÐ»ÑŽÑ‡Ñ‘Ð½ Ñ€ÐµÐ¶Ð¸Ð¼ Ð²Ñ‹Ð±Ð¾Ñ€Ð° Ð»Ð¸Ð¼Ð¸Ñ‚Ð° [X] â€” Ñ€Ð¸ÑÑƒÐµÐ¼ ÐºÑ€Ð°ÑÐ½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÐºÑ€ÐµÑÑ‚Ð¸Ðº Ñ€ÑÐ´Ð¾Ð¼ Ñ ÐºÑƒÑ€ÑÐ¾Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼ Ð¼Ñ‹ÑˆÐ¸!
        if (this.limitSelectionMode) {
            drawSmallX(context, mouseX + 6, mouseY + 6, 0xFFFF4444);
        }

        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        if (mouseX >= x + 34 && mouseX <= x + 52 && mouseY >= y + 91 && mouseY <= y + 109) {
            context.drawTooltip(this.textRenderer,
                    Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.chest_limit_tooltip"), mouseX, mouseY);
        } else {
            drawMouseoverTooltip(context, mouseX, mouseY);
        }
    }

public class InserterRenderer implements BlockEntityRenderer<InserterBlockEntity> {

    private static final double[] BELT_SLOT_Z = { 0.125, 0.375, 0.625, 0.875 };

    public InserterRenderer(BlockEntityRendererFactory.Context ctx) {}

    @Override
    public int getRenderDistance() {
        return 36;

    private static BlockState resolveMainColor(InserterBlockEntity entity, boolean isBurner) {
        if (isBurner) return Blocks.POLISHED_DEEPSLATE.getDefaultState();
        if (entity != null) {
            Block b = entity.getCachedState().getBlock();
            if (b == ModBlocks.LONG_HANDED_INSERTER) return Blocks.RED_CONCRETE.getDefaultState();
            if (b == ModBlocks.FAST_INSERTER) return Blocks.BLUE_CONCRETE.getDefaultState();
        }
        return Blocks.YELLOW_CONCRETE.getDefaultState();
    }

    private static BlockState resolveJointColor(InserterBlockEntity entity, boolean isBurner) {
        if (isBurner) return Blocks.COPPER_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
        if (entity != null) {
            Block b = entity.getCachedState().getBlock();
            if (b == ModBlocks.LONG_HANDED_INSERTER) return Blocks.SMOOTH_QUARTZ.getDefaultState();
            if (b == ModBlocks.FAST_INSERTER) return Blocks.LIGHT_BLUE_CONCRETE.getDefaultState();
        }
        return Blocks.GOLD_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
    }

    @Override
    public void render(InserterBlockEntity entity, float tickDelta, MatrixStack matrices,
                       VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers, int light, int overlay) {
        MinecraftClient client = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        BlockPos pos = entity.getPos();

        double distSq = 0.0;
        if (client.gameRenderer != null && client.gameRenderer.getCamera() != null) {
            Vec3d cam = client.gameRenderer.getCamera().getPos();
            double dx = (pos.getX() + 0.5) - cam.x;
            double dy = (pos.getY() + 0.5) - cam.y;
            double dz = (pos.getZ() + 0.5) - cam.z;
            distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
        }

        if (distSq > 36.0 * 36.0) return;

        World world = entity.getWorld();
        if (distSq > 5.0 * 5.0 && entity.isClientOccluded(world)) return;

        BlockState state = entity.getCachedState();
        Direction facing = state.contains(InserterBlock.FACING) ? state.get(InserterBlock.FACING) : Direction.NORTH;
        float progress = entity.getArmProgress(tickDelta);

        int brightLight = light;
        if (brightLight == 0 && world != null) {
            brightLight = (distSq < 14.0 * 14.0)
                    ? WorldRenderer.getLightmapCoordinates(world, pos.up())
                    : LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE;
        }

        if (distSq > 12.0 * 12.0) {
            renderFastLodArm(entity, entity.isBurner(), facing, progress, matrices, vertexConsumers, brightLight, overlay);
            return;
        }

        renderArticulatedArm(
                entity,
                entity.isBurner(),
                facing,
                progress,
                tickDelta,
                entity.getHeldStack(),
                matrices,
                vertexConsumers,
                brightLight,
                overlay
        );
    }

    private static void renderFastLodArm(InserterBlockEntity entity, boolean isBurner, Direction facing, float progress,
                                         MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers,
                                         int light, int overlay) {
        BlockRenderManager brm = MinecraftClient.getInstance().getBlockRenderManager();
        BlockState mainColor = resolveMainColor(entity, isBurner);
        boolean isLong = entity != null && entity.isLongHanded();
        float yawDegrees = (1.0f - progress) * 180.0f;

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(0.5, 0.0, 0.5);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(-facing.asRotation()));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(yawDegrees));

        drawCenteredBox(brm, mainColor, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay,
                0.0f, 0.25f, isLong ? 0.35f : 0.20f, 0.22f, 0.42f, isLong ? 1.15f : 0.65f);
        matrices.pop();
    }

    public static void renderArticulatedArm(InserterBlockEntity entity, boolean isBurner, Direction facing,
                                            float progress, float tickDelta, ItemStack held, MatrixStack matrices,
                                            VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers, int light, int overlay) {
        MinecraftClient client = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        BlockRenderManager brm = client.getBlockRenderManager();

        BlockState mainColor = resolveMainColor(entity, isBurner);
        BlockState jointColor = resolveJointColor(entity, isBurner);
        BlockState darkMetal = Blocks.NETHERITE_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
        BlockState steelClaw = Blocks.IRON_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
        BlockState firebox = Blocks.BLAST_FURNACE.getDefaultState();

        boolean isLong = entity != null && entity.isLongHanded();
        float armScaleZ = isLong ? 1.55f : 1.0f;

        ArmTarget pickupTarget = computePickupTarget(entity, facing, tickDelta);
        ArmTarget dropoffTarget = computeDropoffTarget(entity, facing);

        float midArc = MathHelper.sin(progress * (float) Math.PI);
        float trackingYaw = MathHelper.lerp(progress, pickupTarget.yawOffset, dropoffTarget.yawOffset);
        float yawDegrees = (1.0f - progress) * 180.0f + trackingYaw;

        float reachFactor = MathHelper.lerp(progress, pickupTarget.reachFactor, dropoffTarget.reachFactor);
        float dipFactor = MathHelper.lerp(progress, pickupTarget.dipFactor, 1.0f);

        float endShoulderPitch = (isLong ? 36.0f : 28.0f) + reachFactor * 20.0f + dipFactor * 4.0f;
        float endElbowPitch = (isLong ? 54.0f : 62.0f) - reachFactor * 26.0f + dipFactor * 6.0f;

        float shoulderPitch = endShoulderPitch - midArc * 26.0f;
        float elbowPitch = endElbowPitch - midArc * 24.0f;

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(0.5, 0.0, 0.5);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(-facing.asRotation()));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(yawDegrees));

        // 1. ÐŸÐ¾Ð²Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ñ‚Ð½Ð°Ñ Ð±Ð°ÑˆÐ½Ñ

                0.0f, 0.22f, 0.0f, 0.40f, 0.20f, 0.42f);

        if (isBurner) {
            drawCenteredBox(brm, firebox, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay,
                    0.0f, 0.20f, -0.24f, 0.42f, 0.34f, 0.28f);
            drawCenteredBox(brm, darkMetal, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay,
                    0.12f, 0.54f, -0.26f, 0.11f, 0.22f, 0.11f);
        } else {
            drawCenteredBox(brm, darkMetal, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay,
                    0.0f, 0.24f, -0.22f, 0.32f, 0.20f, 0.24f);
        }

        float lowerLen = 0.58f * armScaleZ;
        matrices.translate(0.0, 0.40, 0.06);
        drawCenteredBox(brm, jointColor, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay,
                0.0f, -0.06f, 0.0f, 0.44f, 0.14f, 0.14f);

        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(shoulderPitch));
        drawCenteredBox(brm, mainColor, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay,
                0.0f, 0.0f, -0.04f, 0.16f, lowerLen, 0.16f);
        drawCenteredBox(brm, steelClaw, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay,
                0.0f, 0.05f, 0.06f, 0.07f, lowerLen - 0.12f, 0.07f);

        // 3. Ð›Ð¾ÐºÑ‚ÐµÐ²Ð¾Ð¹ ÑˆÐ°Ñ€Ð½Ð¸Ñ€ Ð¸ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¿Ð»ÐµÑ‡ÑŒÐµ
        float upperLen = 0.56f * armScaleZ;

        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(elbowPitch));
        drawCenteredBox(brm, darkMetal, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay,
                0.0f, 0.0f, -0.02f, 0.12f, upperLen, 0.12f);

        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(-(shoulderPitch + elbowPitch)));

        float fingerSpread = held.isEmpty() ? 0.13f : 0.09f;

                    overlay,

                    vertexConsumers,
                    entity != null ? entity.getWorld() : null,
                    0
            );
            matrices.pop();
        }

        matrices.pop();
    }

    private static ArmTarget computePickupTarget(InserterBlockEntity entity, Direction inserterFacing, float tickDelta) {
        if (entity == null || entity.getWorld() == null) {
            return new ArmTarget(0.0f, 0.45f, 0.5f);
        }
        int reach = entity.getReachDistance();
        BlockPos backPos = entity.getPos().offset(inserterFacing.getOpposite(), reach);
        if (!(entity.getWorld().getBlockState(backPos).getBlock() instanceof BeltBlock)) {
            return new ArmTarget(0.0f, 0.45f, 0.7f);
        }
        if (!(entity.getWorld().getBlockEntity(backPos) instanceof BeltBlockEntity belt)) {
            return new ArmTarget(0.0f, 0.45f, 0.7f);
        }

        Direction beltFacing = belt.getCachedState().get(BeltBlock.FACING);
        float beltProgress = MathHelper.clamp(
                (belt.getRenderTicks() + tickDelta) / (float) belt.getMoveDelay(), 0.0f, 1.0f);

        boolean rightFirst = (beltFacing == inserterFacing.rotateYClockwise());
        BeltLane firstLane = rightFirst ? belt.getRightLane() : belt.getLeftLane();
        BeltLane secondLane = rightFirst ? belt.getLeftLane() : belt.getRightLane();
        double firstLaneLocalX = rightFirst ? 0.28 : 0.72;
        double secondLaneLocalX = rightFirst ? 0.72 : 0.28;

        int[] slotOrder = (beltFacing == inserterFacing)
                ? new int[]{ 3, 2, 1, 0 }
                : new int[]{ 2, 1, 3, 0 };

        ArmTarget tracked = findItemTargetOnLane(firstLane, firstLaneLocalX, beltFacing, inserterFacing, beltProgress, slotOrder);
        if (tracked != null) return tracked;
        tracked = findItemTargetOnLane(secondLane, secondLaneLocalX, beltFacing, inserterFacing, beltProgress, slotOrder);
        if (tracked != null) return tracked;

        return new ArmTarget(0.0f, 0.25f, 0.2f);
    }

    private static ArmTarget findItemTargetOnLane(BeltLane lane, double laneLocalX, Direction beltFacing,
                                                  Direction inserterFacing, float beltProgress, int[] slotOrder) {
        for (int slot : slotOrder) {
            if (lane.hasItemAt(slot)) {
                double localZ = BELT_SLOT_Z[slot];
                if (lane.isMoving(slot)) {
                    localZ -= (1.0f - beltProgress) * 0.25;
                }

                double dx = laneLocalX - 0.5;
                double dz = localZ - 0.5;
                double rotRad = Math.toRadians(beltFacing.asRotation() - inserterFacing.asRotation());
                double relX = dx * Math.cos(rotRad) - dz * Math.sin(rotRad);
                double relZ = dx * Math.sin(rotRad) + dz * Math.cos(rotRad);

                double distFromInserter = 1.0 - relZ;
                float reachFactor = MathHelper.clamp((float) ((distFromInserter - 0.75) / 0.48), 0.0f, 1.0f);
                float yawOffset = MathHelper.clamp((float) Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(-relX, distFromInserter)) * 0.85f, -24.0f, 24.0f);

                return new ArmTarget(yawOffset, reachFactor, 1.0f);
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static ArmTarget computeDropoffTarget(InserterBlockEntity entity, Direction inserterFacing) {
        if (entity == null || entity.getWorld() == null) {
            return new ArmTarget(0.0f, 0.75f, 1.0f);
        }
        int reach = entity.getReachDistance();
        BlockPos frontPos = entity.getPos().offset(inserterFacing, reach);
        BlockState frontState = entity.getWorld().getBlockState(frontPos);
        if (frontState.getBlock() instanceof BeltBlock) {
            Direction beltFacing = frontState.get(BeltBlock.FACING);
            if (beltFacing == inserterFacing.rotateYClockwise() || beltFacing == inserterFacing.rotateYCounterclockwise()) {
                return new ArmTarget(0.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
            } else if (beltFacing == inserterFacing) {
                return new ArmTarget(-11.0f, 0.35f, 1.0f);
            } else {
                return new ArmTarget(11.0f, 0.35f, 1.0f);
            }
        }
        return new ArmTarget(0.0f, 0.55f, 0.8f);
    }

    private record ArmTarget(float yawOffset, float reachFactor, float dipFactor) {}

    private static void drawCenteredBox(BlockRenderManager brm, BlockState state, MatrixStack matrices,
                                        VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers, int light, int overlay,
                                        float cx, float minY, float cz, float sx, float sy, float sz) {
        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(cx - sx * 0.5f, minY, cz - sz * 0.5f);
        matrices.scale(sx, sy, sz);
        brm.renderBlockAsEntity(state, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay);
        matrices.pop();
    }
}

            this.draggingPreview = true;

            if (mouseX >= x + 10 && mouseX <= x + 115 && mouseY >= y + 100 && mouseY <= y + 112) {
                ClientPlayNetworking.send(new ChangeStackSizePayload(
                        handler.targetPos, InserterBlockEntity.ACTION_TOGGLE_FILTER));
                return true;

            if (mouseX >= x + 8 && mouseX <= x + 128 && mouseY >= y + 115 && mouseY <= y + 128) {
                ClientPlayNetworking.send(new ChangeStackSizePayload(
                        handler.targetPos, InserterBlockEntity.ACTION_TOGGLE_BLACKLIST));
                return true;
            }
            if (mouseX >= x + 10 && mouseX <= x + 122 && mouseY >= y + 135 && mouseY <= y + 147) {
                ClientPlayNetworking.send(new ChangeStackSizePayload(
                        handler.targetPos, InserterBlockEntity.ACTION_TOGGLE_OVERRIDE_STACK));
                return true;
            }
            if (mouseX >= x + 126 && mouseX <= x + 192 && mouseY >= y + 134 && mouseY <= y + 148) {
                this.draggingSlider = true;
                updateSliderFromMouse(mouseX, x + 126, 66);
                return true;
            }
            if (mouseX >= x + 198 && mouseX <= x + 224 && mouseY >= y + 133 && mouseY <= y + 149) {
                ClientPlayNetworking.send(new ChangeStackSizePayload(handler.targetPos, 1));
                return true;
            }
        } else if (button == 1 && handler.blockEntity != null) {
            if (mouseX >= x + 198 && mouseX <= x + 224 && mouseY >= y + 133 && mouseY <= y + 149) {
                ClientPlayNetworking.send(new ChangeStackSizePayload(handler.targetPos, -1));
                return true;
            }
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    private void updateSliderFromMouse(double mouseX, int sliderX, int sliderWidth) {
        if (handler.blockEntity == null) return;
        float ratio = MathHelper.clamp((float) (mouseX - sliderX) / (float) sliderWidth, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        int newStack = Math.max(1, Math.min(MAX_STACK_OVERRIDE, Math.round(1 + ratio * (MAX_STACK_OVERRIDE - 1))));
        ClientPlayNetworking.send(new ChangeStackSizePayload(
                handler.targetPos, InserterBlockEntity.ACTION_SET_STACK_BASE + newStack));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (this.draggingPreview && (button == 0 || button == 1)) {
            this.draggingPreview = false;
            return true;
        }
        if (this.draggingSlider && button == 0) {
            this.draggingSlider = false;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.draggingPreview) {
            this.previewYaw += (float) deltaX * 1.5f;
            this.previewPitch = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewPitch + (float) deltaY * 1.5f, -80.0f, 80.0f);
            return true;
        }
        if (this.draggingSlider && button == 0) {
            int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
            updateSliderFromMouse(mouseX, x + 126, 66);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        super.render(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);
        drawMouseoverTooltip(context, mouseX, mouseY);
    }

    private void drawCheckerboard(DrawContext context, int left, int top, int right, int bottom, int cellSize) {
        for (int py = top; py < bottom; py += cellSize) {
            for (int px = left; px < right; px += cellSize) {
                int gx = (px - left) / cellSize;
                int gy = (py - top) / cellSize;
                int color = ((gx + gy) % 2 == 0) ? 0xFF262729 : 0xFF2E3032;
                context.fill(px, py, Math.min(px + cellSize, right), Math.min(py + cellSize, bottom), color);
            }
        }
    }

    private void drawSlotFrame(DrawContext context, int slotX, int slotY) {
        context.fill(slotX, slotY, slotX + 18, slotY + 18, 0xFF18181A);
        context.fill(slotX + 1, slotY + 1, slotX + 17, slotY + 17, 0xFF3A3C3E);
    }

    private void drawDivider(DrawContext context, int x, int y, int width) {
        context.fill(x, y, x + width, y + 1, 0xFF202122);
        context.fill(x, y + 1, x + width, y + 2, 0xFF3E4042);
    }

    private void drawFactorioCheckbox(DrawContext context, int cx, int cy, boolean checked) {
        context.fill(cx, cy, cx + 10, cy + 10, 0xFF151515);
        if (checked) {
            context.fill(cx + 1, cy + 1, cx + 9, cy + 9, 0xFFE59524);
            context.fill(cx + 3, cy + 5, cx + 5, cy + 7, 0xFF1E1E1E);
            context.fill(cx + 5, cy + 3, cx + 7, cy + 6, 0xFF1E1E1E);
        } else {
            context.fill(cx + 1, cy + 1, cx + 9, cy + 9, 0xFF424447);
        }
    }

    private void drawPillSwitch(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy, boolean rightActive) {
        context.fill(sx, sy, sx + 18, sy + 9, 0xFF18181A);
        context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 1, sx + 17, sy + 8, 0xFF2A2B2D);
        int knobX = rightActive ? sx + 10 : sx + 2;
        context.fill(knobX, sy + 1, knobX + 6, sy + 8, 0xFF9A9C9E);
    }

    private void renderSplitter3DPreview(DrawContext context, int centerX, int centerY) {
        MinecraftClient client = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        MatrixStack matrices = context.getMatrices();

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(centerX, centerY, 150.0f);
        matrices.scale(this.previewZoom, -this.previewZoom, this.previewZoom);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(this.previewPitch));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(this.previewYaw));

        net.minecraft.block.Block splitterBlock = (handler.splitterEntity != null)
                ? handler.splitterEntity.getCachedState().getBlock()
                : ModBlocks.SPLITTER;
        BlockState leftState = splitterBlock.getDefaultState()
                .with(BeltBlock.FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                .with(SplitterBlock.PART_RIGHT, false);
        BlockState rightState = leftState.with(SplitterBlock.PART_RIGHT, true);

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(-1.0f, -0.4f, -0.5f);
        client.getBlockRenderManager().renderBlockAsEntity(
                leftState, matrices, context.getVertexConsumers(),
                LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE, OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV);
        matrices.translate(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
        client.getBlockRenderManager().renderBlockAsEntity(
                rightState, matrices, context.getVertexConsumers(),
                LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE, OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV);
        matrices.pop();

        if (handler.splitterEntity != null) {
            renderPreviewBeltItems(client, handler.splitterEntity, -1.0f, matrices, context);
            BeltBlockEntity rightPartner = handler.splitterEntity.getOtherSplitterHalf();
            if (rightPartner != null) {
                renderPreviewBeltItems(client, rightPartner, 0.0f, matrices, context);
            }
        }

        matrices.pop();
        context.draw();
    }

    private void renderPreviewBeltItems(MinecraftClient client, BeltBlockEntity belt, float offsetX,
                                        MatrixStack matrices, DrawContext context) {
        double[] baseZ = { 0.375, 0.125, -0.125, -0.375 };
        BeltLane[] lanes = { belt.getLeftLane(), belt.getRightLane() };
        double[] laneX = { offsetX + 0.28, offsetX + 0.72 };

        for (int l = 0; l < 2; l++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < 4; s++) {
                ItemStack stack = lanes[l].getStack(s);
                if (!stack.isEmpty()) {
                    matrices.push();
                    matrices.translate(laneX[l], -0.02, baseZ[s]);
                    matrices.scale(0.32f, 0.32f, 0.32f);
                    matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(90.0f));
                    client.getItemRenderer().renderItem(
                            stack, ModelTransformationMode.FIXED,
                            LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE, OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV,
                            matrices, context.getVertexConsumers(), belt.getWorld(), 0);
                    matrices.pop();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private boolean isInsideViewport(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        return mouseX >= x + 10 && mouseX <= x + backgroundWidth - 10 && mouseY >= y + 18 && mouseY <= y + 78;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        if (isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.previewZoom = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewZoom + (float) verticalAmount * 2.5f, 10.0f, 52.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mouseX, mouseY, horizontalAmount, verticalAmount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;

        if ((button == 0 || button == 1) && isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.draggingPreview = true;
            return true;
        }

        if (button == 0) {
            if (mouseX >= x + 8 && mouseX <= x + 105 && mouseY >= y + 84 && mouseY <= y + 99) {
                ClientPlayNetworking.send(new ChangeStackSizePayload(
                        handler.targetPos, BeltBlockEntity.ACTION_SPLITTER_TOGGLE_IN_PRIORITY));
                return true;
            }
            if (mouseX >= x + 108 && mouseX <= x + 202 && mouseY >= y + 84 && mouseY <= y + 99) {
                ClientPlayNetworking.send(new ChangeStackSizePayload(
                        handler.targetPos, BeltBlockEntity.ACTION_SPLITTER_TOGGLE_IN_RIGHT));
                return true;
            }
            if (mouseX >= x + 8 && mouseX <= x + 105 && mouseY >= y + 118 && mouseY <= y + 134) {
                ClientPlayNetworking.send(new ChangeStackSizePayload(
                        handler.targetPos, BeltBlockEntity.ACTION_SPLITTER_TOGGLE_OUT_PRIORITY));
                return true;
            }
            if (mouseX >= x + 108 && mouseX <= x + 202 && mouseY >= y + 118 && mouseY <= y + 134) {
                ClientPlayNetworking.send(new ChangeStackSizePayload(
                        handler.targetPos, BeltBlockEntity.ACTION_SPLITTER_TOGGLE_OUT_RIGHT));
                return true;
            }
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (this.draggingPreview && (button == 0 || button == 1)) {
            this.draggingPreview = false;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.draggingPreview) {
            this.previewYaw += (float) deltaX * 1.5f;
            this.previewPitch = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewPitch + (float) deltaY * 1.5f, -80.0f, 80.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        super.render(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);
        drawMouseoverTooltip(context, mouseX, mouseY);
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.client.content.pollution;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.client.hud.AltModeRenderer;
