    public static String buildAndActivateResourcePack(String rawInputPath) {
        if (rawInputPath == null || rawInputPath.isBlank()) {
            return "Â§cÐ£ÐºÐ°Ð¶Ð¸Ñ‚Ðµ Ð¿ÑƒÑ‚ÑŒ Ðº Ð¿Ð°Ð¿ÐºÐµ Factorio/data!";
        }

        Path inputPath = Paths.get(rawInputPath.trim().replace("\"", ""));
        if (Files.isDirectory(inputPath.resolve("data"))) {
            inputPath = inputPath.resolve("data");
        }
        if (!Files.isDirectory(inputPath)) {
            return "Â§cÐŸÐ°Ð¿ÐºÐ° Ð½Ðµ Ð½Ð°Ð¹Ð´ÐµÐ½Ð°: " + inputPath;
        }

        Map<String, Path> foundOggFiles = new HashMap<>();
        try (Stream<Path> walk = Files.walk(inputPath, 6)) {
            walk.filter(Files::isRegularFile)
                    .filter(p -> p.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).endsWith(".ogg"))
                    .forEach(p -> foundOggFiles.putIfAbsent(p.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), p));
        } catch (IOException e) {
            return "Â§cÐžÑˆÐ¸Ð±ÐºÐ° Ñ‡Ñ‚ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ñ Ð¿Ð°Ð¿ÐºÐ¸: " + e.getMessage();
        }

        if (foundOggFiles.isEmpty()) {
            return "Â§cÐ’ ÑƒÐºÐ°Ð·Ð°Ð½Ð½Ð¾Ð¹ Ð¿Ð°Ð¿ÐºÐµ Ð½Ðµ Ð½Ð°Ð¹Ð´ÐµÐ½Ð¾ Ð½Ð¸ Ð¾Ð´Ð½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ .ogg Ñ„Ð°Ð¹Ð»Ð°!";
        }

        Path gameDir = FabricLoader.getInstance().getGameDir();
        Path packRoot = gameDir.resolve("resourcepacks").resolve(PACK_FOLDER_NAME);
        Path soundsDir = packRoot.resolve("assets").resolve(FactorioCore.MOD_ID).resolve("sounds");

        try {
            Files.createDirectories(soundsDir);

            // 1. Ð—Ð°Ð¿Ð¸ÑÑ‹Ð²Ð°ÐµÐ¼ pack.mcmeta (pack_format 34 Ð´Ð»Ñ Minecraft 1.21.1)
            JsonObject packMeta = new JsonObject();
            JsonObject packSection = new JsonObject();
            packSection.addProperty("pack_format", 34);
            packSection.addProperty("description", "Official Factorio Audio (Local User Import)");
            packMeta.add("pack", packSection);
            Files.writeString(packRoot.resolve("pack.mcmeta"), GSON.toJson(packMeta), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

            // 2. ÐšÐ¾Ð¿Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÐ¼ Ð½Ð°Ð¹Ð´ÐµÐ½Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ .ogg Ð¸ Ñ„Ð¾Ñ€Ð¼Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÐ¼ sounds.json
            JsonObject soundsJson = new JsonObject();
            int copiedCount = 0;

            for (Map.Entry<String, List<String>> entry : SOUND_MAPPINGS.entrySet()) {
                String soundEventKey = entry.getKey();
                Path matchedOgg = findBestOggMatch(foundOggFiles, entry.getValue());
                if (matchedOgg == null) continue;

                String targetFileName = soundEventKey + ".ogg";
                Files.copy(matchedOgg, soundsDir.resolve(targetFileName), StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
                copiedCount++;

                JsonObject eventObj = new JsonObject();
                eventObj.addProperty("subtitle", "subtitles.factoriocore." + soundEventKey);
                JsonArray soundsArr = new JsonArray();
                soundsArr.add(FactorioCore.MOD_ID + ":" + soundEventKey);
                eventObj.add("sounds", soundsArr);
                soundsJson.add(soundEventKey, eventObj);
            }

            if (copiedCount == 0) {
                return "Â§cÐÐ°Ð¹Ð´ÐµÐ½Ñ‹ .ogg Ñ„Ð°Ð¹Ð»Ñ‹, Ð½Ð¾ Ð¸Ð¼ÐµÐ½Ð° Ð½Ðµ ÑÐ¾Ð²Ð¿Ð°Ð»Ð¸ Ñ Factorio/data/base/sound!";
            }

            Path soundsJsonPath = packRoot.resolve("assets").resolve(FactorioCore.MOD_ID).resolve("sounds.json");
            Files.writeString(soundsJsonPath, GSON.toJson(soundsJson), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

            // 3. ÐÐ²Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¼Ð°Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ‡ÐµÑÐºÐ¸ Ð°ÐºÑ‚Ð¸Ð²Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÐ¼ Ñ€ÐµÑÑƒÑ€ÑÐ¿Ð°Ðº Ð² ÐºÐ»Ð¸ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ðµ Ð¸ Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ·Ð°Ð³Ñ€ÑƒÐ¶Ð°ÐµÐ¼ Ñ€ÐµÑÑƒÑ€ÑÑ‹!
            MinecraftClient client = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
            ResourcePackManager packManager = client.getResourcePackManager();
            packManager.scanPacks();

            String packProfileId = "file/" + PACK_FOLDER_NAME;
            List<String> enabled = new ArrayList<>(packManager.getEnabledIds());
            if (!enabled.contains(packProfileId)) {
                enabled.add(packProfileId);
                packManager.setEnabledProfiles(enabled);
                client.options.resourcePacks.add(packProfileId);
                client.options.write();
            }
            client.reloadResources();

            return "Â§aÐ£ÑÐ¿ÐµÑ…! Ð˜Ð¼Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ€Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¾ Ð·Ð²ÑƒÐºÐ¾Ð²: " + copiedCount + ". Ð ÐµÑÑƒÑ€ÑÐ¿Ð°Ðº Ð²ÐºÐ»ÑŽÑ‡Ñ‘Ð½!";
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
            return "Â§cÐžÑˆÐ¸Ð±ÐºÐ° ÑÐ±Ð¾Ñ€ÐºÐ¸ Ñ€ÐµÑÑƒÑ€ÑÐ¿Ð°ÐºÐ°: " + e.getMessage();
        }
    }

    private static Path findBestOggMatch(Map<String, Path> index, List<String> candidates) {
        for (String cand : candidates) {
            Path exact = index.get(cand.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
            if (exact != null) return exact;
        }
        for (String cand : candidates) {
            String prefix = cand.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).replace(".ogg", "").replace("-1", "");
            for (Map.Entry<String, Path> e : index.entrySet()) {
                if (e.getKey().startsWith(prefix)) {
                    return e.getValue();
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private void rebuildMapPreview() {
        previewDirty = false;
        int half = MAP_GRID / 2;

        for (int gz = 0; gz < MAP_GRID; gz++) {
            int wz = (int) Math.round(mapCenterZ + (gz - half) * blocksPerCell);
            for (int gx = 0; gx < MAP_GRID; gx++) {
                int wx = (int) Math.round(mapCenterX + (gx - half) * blocksPerCell);
                previewColors[gz * MAP_GRID + gx] = sampleMapColorAt(wx, wz);
            }
        }
    }

    private int sampleMapColorAt(int x, int z) {
        double elev = NauvisChunkGenerator.evaluateElevation(x, z);
        if (elev < 0.0) {
            return (elev > -0.09) ? 0xFF2980B9 : 0xFF1A5276;
        }

        if (NauvisChunkGenerator.evaluateCliffHeight(x, z, elev) > 0) {
            return 0xFF3E444A;
        }

        BlockState ore = NauvisChunkGenerator.evaluateOrePatch(x, z, elev);
        if (ore != null && ore.getBlock() instanceof ResourceOreBlock oreBlock) {
            return switch (oreBlock.getOreType()) {
                case 0 -> 0xFF5B9BD5; // Ð–ÐµÐ»ÐµÐ·Ð¾
                case 1 -> 0xFFED7D31; // ÐœÐµÐ´ÑŒ
                case 2 -> 0xFF161618; // Ð£Ð³Ð¾Ð»ÑŒ
                default -> 0xFFD2C290; // ÐšÐ°Ð¼ÐµÐ½ÑŒ
            };
        }

        if (NauvisChunkGenerator.hasForestAt(x, z, elev)) {
            return 0xFF1E4D20;
        }

        NauvisChunkGenerator.NauvisBiome biome = NauvisChunkGenerator.getBiomeAt(x, z);
        return switch (biome) {
            case LUSH_GRASS -> 0xFF3B6E28;
            case DRY_GRASS -> 0xFF4F772D;
            case DRY_DIRT -> 0xFF6E4E37;
            case SAND_DESERT -> 0xFFC5A878;
            case RED_DESERT -> 0xFF8C4A32;
        };
    }

    private void drawLegendItem(DrawContext context, int lx, int ly, int color, String name) {
        context.fill(lx, ly + 1, lx + 7, ly + 8, 0xFF111111);
        context.fill(lx + 1, ly + 2, lx + 6, ly + 7, color);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, name, lx + 9, ly, 0xFFD0D0D0, false);
    }

    private void drawSliderRow(DrawContext context, SliderRow row, int rx, int ry) {
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, row.label, rx, ry + 1, row.color, false);
        int sliderX = rx + 172;
        int sliderW = 72;
        context.fill(sliderX, ry + 4, sliderX + sliderW, ry + 7, 0xFF141414);

        float val = row.getter.get();
        float ratio = MathHelper.clamp((val - row.min) / (row.max - row.min), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        int knobX = sliderX + Math.round(ratio * (sliderW - 6));
        context.fill(knobX, ry + 1, knobX + 6, ry + 10, 0xFF111111);
        context.fill(knobX + 1, ry + 2, knobX + 5, ry + 9, 0xFFE59524);

        String valStr = row.signedPercent
                ? String.format("%+d%%", Math.round(val * 200.0f))
                : String.format("%d%%", Math.round(val * 100.0f));
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, valStr, sliderX + sliderW + 5, ry + 1, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);
    }

    private void drawFactorioButton(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw, int bh,
                                    String label, int mouseX, int mouseY, boolean highlighted) {
        boolean hovered = mouseX >= bx && mouseX <= bx + bw && mouseY >= by && mouseY <= by + bh;
        int bg = highlighted ? 0xFFD4881E : (hovered ? 0xFF4A4C50 : 0xFF383A3D);
        int textCol = highlighted ? 0xFF141414 : 0xFFEAEAEA;

        context.fill(bx, by, bx + bw, by + bh, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + bw - 1, by + bh - 1, bg);
        int tw = this.textRenderer.getWidth(label);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, label, bx + (bw - tw) / 2, by + (bh - 8) / 2, textCol, false);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        int panelW = 510;
        int panelH = 256;
        int x = (this.width - panelW) / 2;
        int y = (this.height - panelH) / 2;

        int mapX = x + 310;
        int mapY = y + 22;
        int mapSize = MAP_GRID * MAP_PIXEL_SIZE;
        if (mouseX >= mapX && mouseX <= mapX + mapSize && mouseY >= mapY && mouseY <= mapY + mapSize) {
            if (button == 1) {
                this.mapCenterX = 0.0;
                this.mapCenterZ = 0.0;
                this.previewDirty = true;
            } else {
                this.draggingMap = true;
            }
            return true;
        }

        if (button == 0) {
            if (isInside(mouseX, mouseY, x + 208, y + 22, 46, 14)) {
                NauvisConfig.ACTIVE.randomizeSeed();
                pushSeedToParent();
                this.previewDirty = true;
                return true;
            }
            if (isInside(mouseX, mouseY, x + 258, y + 22, 46, 14)) {
                NauvisConfig.ACTIVE.resetDefaults();
                customConfigTouched = true;
                this.previewDirty = true;
                return true;
            }
            if (isInside(mouseX, mouseY, x + 8, y + 40, 144, 15)) {
                this.currentTab = 0;
                return true;
            }
            if (isInside(mouseX, mouseY, x + 156, y + 40, 148, 15)) {
                this.currentTab = 1;
                return true;
            }
            if (isInside(mouseX, mouseY, x + panelW - 126, y + panelH - 23, 118, 17)) {
                pushSeedToParent();
                this.close();
                return true;
            }

            List<SliderRow> activeList = (currentTab == 0) ? resourceSliders : terrainSliders;
            int rowStep = (currentTab == 0) ? 13 : 20;
            int startY = y + 57 + 6;
            int sliderX = x + 8 + 6 + 172;
            int sliderW = 72;

            for (int i = 0; i < activeList.size(); i++) {
                int ry = startY + i * rowStep;
                if (mouseX >= sliderX - 4 && mouseX <= sliderX + sliderW + 4 && mouseY >= ry && mouseY <= ry + 12) {
                    this.activeDraggingSlider = activeList.get(i);
                    updateSliderValueFromMouse(this.activeDraggingSlider, mouseX, sliderX, sliderW);
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    private void updateSliderValueFromMouse(SliderRow row, double mouseX, int sliderX, int sliderW) {
        float ratio = MathHelper.clamp((float) (mouseX - sliderX) / (float) sliderW, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        float rawVal = row.min + ratio * (row.max - row.min);
        float stepped = Math.round(rawVal * 20.0f) / 20.0f;
        row.setter.accept(MathHelper.clamp(stepped, row.min, row.max));
        customConfigTouched = true;
        this.previewDirty = true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.draggingMap) {
            this.mapCenterX -= (deltaX / MAP_PIXEL_SIZE) * blocksPerCell;
            this.mapCenterZ -= (deltaY / MAP_PIXEL_SIZE) * blocksPerCell;
            this.previewDirty = true;
            return true;
        }
        if (this.activeDraggingSlider != null && button == 0) {
            int panelW = 510;
            int x = (this.width - panelW) / 2;
            int sliderX = x + 8 + 6 + 172;
            updateSliderValueFromMouse(this.activeDraggingSlider, mouseX, sliderX, 72);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        this.draggingMap = false;
        this.activeDraggingSlider = null;
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        int panelW = 510;
        int panelH = 256;
        int x = (this.width - panelW) / 2;
        int y = (this.height - panelH) / 2;
        int mapX = x + 310;
        int mapY = y + 22;
        int mapSize = MAP_GRID * MAP_PIXEL_SIZE;

        if (mouseX >= mapX && mouseX <= mapX + mapSize && mouseY >= mapY && mouseY <= mapY + mapSize) {
            if (verticalAmount > 0) {
                this.blocksPerCell = Math.max(1.0, this.blocksPerCell - 1.0);
            } else if (verticalAmount < 0) {
                this.blocksPerCell = Math.min(16.0, this.blocksPerCell + 1.0);
            }
            this.previewDirty = true;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mouseX, mouseY, horizontalAmount, verticalAmount);
    }

    private boolean isInside(double mx, double my, int x, int y, int w, int h) {
        return mx >= x && mx <= x + w && my >= y && my <= y + h;
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        if (this.client != null) {
            this.client.setScreen(this.parent);
        }
    }

    private record SliderRow(String label, int color, float min, float max, boolean signedPercent,
                             Supplier<Float> getter, Consumer<Float> setter) {
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.combat.BlockHealthManager;

inserter.changeMaxPickupCount(payload.delta());
} else if (be instanceof BeltBlockEntity belt && belt.isSplitter()) {
belt.handleSplitterGuiAction(payload.delta());
} else if (be instanceof FactorioChestBlockEntity chest) {
chest.setUnlockedSlots(payload.delta());
}
});

        }
    });

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.config;

import com.google.gson.Gson;
import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder;
import net.fabricmc.loader.api.FabricLoader;

import java.io.IOException;

import java.io.Writer;

import java.nio.file.Path;

public class FactorioConfig {

    private static final Gson GSON = new GsonBuilder().setPrettyPrinting().create();
    private static final Path CONFIG_PATH = FabricLoader.getInstance().getConfigDir().resolve("factoriocore.json");

    public static FactorioConfig INSTANCE = new FactorioConfig();

    public boolean enableMinimap = true;
    public float minimapScale = 1.0f;
    public float infoPanelScale = 1.0f;
    public boolean enableTargetInfoPanel = true;
    public boolean enableCraftingQueueHud = true;
    public boolean replaceVanillaInventory = true;
    public boolean enableInventoryAutoSort = true;
    public boolean enablePavementSpeedBoost = true;
    public boolean showPoleSupplyWhenHoldingElectric = true;
    public boolean showDrillMiningArea = true;
    public boolean enableCopperWiresRender = true;
    public boolean enablePlacementParticles = true;
    public boolean enableMachineSounds = true;
    public float machineSoundVolume = 0.70f;
    public String factorioDataPath = "";
    
    // ÐÐ°ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ð¹ÐºÐ¸ Ð¿Ð°Ð½ÐµÐ»Ð¸ Ð¸Ð½Ñ„Ð¾Ñ€Ð¼Ð°Ñ†Ð¸Ð¸
    public boolean showInfoDescription = true;
    public boolean showInfoHealth = false;
    public boolean showInfoStatus = true;
    public boolean showInfoFluids = true;
    public boolean showInfoElectricity = true;

    public int poleSupplyColor = 0x26B4FF;
    public int drillAreaColor = 0x33E68C;
    public int validPlacementColor = 0x26FF40;
    public int invalidPlacementColor = 0xFF2626;
    public int wireColor = 0xE08538;
    public int altArrowColor = 0xFFE026;

    public void resetDefaults() {
        this.enableMinimap = true;
        this.minimapScale = 1.0f;
        this.infoPanelScale = 1.0f;
        this.enableTargetInfoPanel = true;
        this.enableCraftingQueueHud = true;
        this.replaceVanillaInventory = true;
        this.enableInventoryAutoSort = true;
        this.enablePavementSpeedBoost = true;
        this.showPoleSupplyWhenHoldingElectric = true;
        this.showDrillMiningArea = true;
        this.enableCopperWiresRender = true;
        this.enablePlacementParticles = true;
        
        this.showInfoDescription = true;
        this.showInfoHealth = false;
        this.showInfoStatus = true;
        this.showInfoFluids = true;
        this.showInfoElectricity = true;

        this.poleSupplyColor = 0x26B4FF;
        this.drillAreaColor = 0x33E68C;
        this.validPlacementColor = 0x26FF40;
        this.invalidPlacementColor = 0xFF2626;
        this.wireColor = 0xE08538;
        this.altArrowColor = 0xFFE026;
        this.enableMachineSounds = true; this.machineSoundVolume = 0.70f;
        save();
    }

    public static float getRed(int rgb) { return ((rgb >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255.0f; }
    public static float getGreen(int rgb) { return ((rgb >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255.0f; }
    public static float getBlue(int rgb) { return (rgb & 0xFF) / 255.0f; }

    public static void load() {
        if (Files.exists(CONFIG_PATH)) {
            try (Reader reader = Files.newBufferedReader(CONFIG_PATH, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                FactorioConfig loaded = GSON.fromJson(reader, FactorioConfig.class);
                if (loaded != null) {
                    INSTANCE = loaded;
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
        } else {
            save();
        }
    }

    public static void save() {
        try {
            Files.createDirectories(CONFIG_PATH.getParent());
            try (Writer writer = Files.newBufferedWriter(CONFIG_PATH, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                GSON.toJson(INSTANCE, writer);
            }
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.combat;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.fluids.BoilerBlock;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

import static jdk.javadoc.internal.doclets.formats.html.markup.HtmlStyle.block;

public class BlockHealthManager {

    private static final Map<RegistryKey<World>, Map<BlockPos, Integer>> SERVER_DAMAGE = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final Map<BlockPos, Integer> CLIENT_DAMAGE = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    private static Map<BlockPos, Integer> getServerWorldMap(World world) {
        return SERVER_DAMAGE.computeIfAbsent(world.getRegistryKey(), k -> new ConcurrentHashMap<>());
    }

    public static int getMaxHealth(Block block) {
        if (block == ModBlocks.SMALL_ELECTRIC_POLE) return 100;
        if (block == ModBlocks.MEDIUM_ELECTRIC_POLE) return 100;
        if (block == ModBlocks.ELECTRIC_ENERGY_INTERFACE) return 150;
        if (block == ModBlocks.STONE_WALL) return 350;
        if (block == ModBlocks.GATE) return 350;
        if (block == ModBlocks.LAND_MINE) return 15;
        if (block == ModBlocks.WOODEN_CHEST) return 100;
        if (block == ModBlocks.IRON_CHEST) return 200;
        if (block == ModBlocks.STEEL_CHEST) return 350;

        if (block == ModBlocks.BURNER_INSERTER) return 100;
        if (block == ModBlocks.INSERTER) return 150;
        if (block == ModBlocks.LONG_HANDED_INSERTER) return 160;
        if (block == ModBlocks.FAST_INSERTER) return 160;

        if (block == ModBlocks.PIPE || block == ModBlocks.PIPE_TO_GROUND) return 100;
        if (block == ModBlocks.OFFSHORE_PUMP) return 150;
        if (block == ModBlocks.BOILER) return 200;
        if (block == ModBlocks.STEAM_ENGINE) return 400;
        if (block == ModBlocks.ELECTRIC_MINING_DRILL) return 300;
        if (block == ModBlocks.BURNER_MINING_DRILL) return 150;
        if (block == ModBlocks.STONE_FURNACE) return 200;
        if (block == ModBlocks.STEEL_FURNACE) return 300;
        if (block == ModBlocks.ASSEMBLER) return 300;
        if (block == ModBlocks.LAB) return 150;
        if (block == ModBlocks.PUMPJACK) return 250;
        if (block == ModBlocks.OIL_REFINERY) return 350;
        if (block == ModBlocks.CHEMICAL_PLANT) return 300;

        if (block instanceof SplitterBlock splitter) {
            return switch (splitter.getTier()) {
                case 2 -> 180;
                case 3 -> 190;
                default -> 170;
            };
        }
        if (block instanceof BeltBlock belt) {
            return switch (belt.getTier()) {
                case 2 -> 160;
                case 3 -> 170;
                default -> 150;
            };
        }
        return 0;
    }

    public static BlockPos getCanonicalPos(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        Block block = state.getBlock();
        if (block instanceof OffshorePumpBlock) return OffshorePumpBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof BoilerBlock) return BoilerBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof SteamEngineBlock) return SteamEngineBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof ElectricDrillBlock) return ElectricDrillBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof AssemblerBlock) return AssemblerBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof LabBlock) return LabBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof OilMachines.Base3x3MachineBlock) return OilMachines.Base3x3MachineBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof BurnerDrillBlock) return BurnerDrillBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlock) return FactorioFurnaceBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof SplitterBlock && state.contains(SplitterBlock.PART_RIGHT) && state.get(SplitterBlock.PART_RIGHT)) {
            Direction facing = state.get(BeltBlock.FACING);
            return pos.offset(facing.rotateYCounterclockwise());
        }
        return pos.toImmutable();
    }

    public static int getDamageTaken(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (world == null) return 0;
        BlockPos masterPos = getCanonicalPos(pos, state);
        Map<BlockPos, Integer> map = world.isClient ? CLIENT_DAMAGE : getServerWorldMap(world);
        return map.getOrDefault(masterPos, 0);
    }

    public static int getCurrentHealth(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        int max = getMaxHealth(state.getBlock());
        if (max <= 0) return 0;
        int dmg = getDamageTaken(world, pos, state);
        return Math.max(0, max - dmg);
    }

    public static Map<BlockPos, Integer> getClientDamagedBlocks() {
        return CLIENT_DAMAGE;
    }

    public static void setClientDamage(BlockPos masterPos, int damage) {
        if (damage <= 0) {
            CLIENT_DAMAGE.remove(masterPos);
        } else {
            CLIENT_DAMAGE.put(masterPos.toImmutable(), damage);
        }
    }

    public static void damageBlock(ServerWorld world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, int amount) {
        int maxHp = getMaxHealth(state.getBlock());
        if (maxHp <= 0 || amount <= 0) return;

        BlockPos masterPos = getCanonicalPos(pos, state);
        Map<BlockPos, Integer> map = getServerWorldMap(world);
        int newDamage = map.getOrDefault(masterPos, 0) + amount;

        if (newDamage >= maxHp) {
            map.remove(masterPos);
            syncToClients(world, masterPos, 0);
            destroyFactorioStructure(world, masterPos, world.getBlockState(masterPos));
        } else {
            map.put(masterPos, newDamage);
            syncToClients(world, masterPos, newDamage);
            world.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.BLOCK_ANVIL_LAND, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 0.35f, 1.5f);
            world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.CRIT, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.7, pos.getZ() + 0.5,
                    6, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.05);
        }
    }

    public static boolean repairBlock(ServerWorld world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, int amount) {
        int maxHp = getMaxHealth(state.getBlock());
        if (maxHp <= 0) return false;

        BlockPos masterPos = getCanonicalPos(pos, state);
        Map<BlockPos, Integer> map = getServerWorldMap(world);
        int currentDamage = map.getOrDefault(masterPos, 0);
        if (currentDamage <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        if (block instanceof OilMachines.OilRefineryBlock) return OilMachines.OilRefineryBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);

        int newDamage = Math.max(0, currentDamage - amount);
        if (newDamage == 0) {
            map.remove(masterPos);
        } else {
            map.put(masterPos, newDamage);
        }

        syncToClients(world, masterPos, newDamage);
        world.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.BLOCK_IRON_TRAPDOOR_CLOSE, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 0.6f, 1.8f);
        world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.ELECTRIC_SPARK, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.75, pos.getZ() + 0.5,
                8, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.02);
        return true;
    }

    private static void destroyFactorioStructure(ServerWorld world, BlockPos masterPos, BlockState masterState) {
        Block block = masterState.getBlock();

        if (block instanceof OffshorePumpBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(OffshorePumpBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part <= 1; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = OffshorePumpBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, false);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof BoilerBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(BoilerBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 6; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = BoilerBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, false);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof SteamEngineBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(SteamEngineBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 15; part++) {
                for (int layer = 0; layer <= 2; layer++) {
                    BlockPos p = SteamEngineBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, layer);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, false);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof ElectricDrillBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(ElectricDrillBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = ElectricDrillBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, false);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof AssemblerBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(AssemblerBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = AssemblerBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, false);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof LabBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(LabBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = LabBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, false);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof OilMachines.OilRefineryBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(OilMachines.OilRefineryBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 25; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = OilMachines.OilRefineryBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, false);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof BurnerDrillBlock) {
            Direction f = masterState.get(BurnerDrillBlock.FACING);
            for (int p = 0; p < 4; p++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos bp = BurnerDrillBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, f, p, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(bp).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(bp, false);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(FactorioFurnaceBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = FactorioFurnaceBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, false);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof SplitterBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(BeltBlock.FACING);
            BlockPos rightPos = masterPos.offset(facing.rotateYClockwise());
            if (world.getBlockState(rightPos).isOf(block)) {
                world.breakBlock(rightPos, false);
            }
            world.breakBlock(masterPos, false);
        } else {
            world.breakBlock(masterPos, false);
        }
    }

    private static void syncToClients(ServerWorld world, BlockPos masterPos, int damage) {
        SyncBlockHealthPayload payload = new SyncBlockHealthPayload(masterPos, damage);
        for (ServerPlayerEntity player : PlayerLookup.world(world)) {
            ServerPlayNetworking.send(player, payload);
        }
    }

    public static void registerServer() {
        PlayerBlockBreakEvents.AFTER.register((world, player, pos, state, blockEntity) -> {
            if (!world.isClient && world instanceof ServerWorld serverWorld) {
                Block block = state.getBlock();
                if (getMaxHealth(block) > 0) {
                    BlockPos masterPos = getCanonicalPos(pos, state);
                    getServerWorldMap(serverWorld).remove(masterPos);
                    syncToClients(serverWorld, masterPos, 0);
                }

                if (!player.isCreative() && !(block instanceof ResourceOreBlock) && !(block instanceof OilMachines.CrudeOilDepositBlock)) {
                    Identifier id = Registries.BLOCK.getId(block);
                    Item item = block.asItem();
                    if (id.getNamespace().equals("factoriocore") && item != Items.AIR) {
                        player.getInventory().offerOrDrop(new ItemStack(item, 1));
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        AttackBlockCallback.EVENT.register((player, world, hand, pos, direction) -> {
            BlockState state = world.getBlockState(pos);
            Block block = state.getBlock();
            int maxHp = getMaxHealth(block);
            if (maxHp <= 0) {
                return ActionResult.PASS;
            }

            ItemStack held = player.getStackInHand(hand);
            boolean isWeapon = held.getItem() instanceof SwordItem
                    || held.getItem() instanceof TridentItem
                    || held.getItem() instanceof MaceItem;

            if (isWeapon && player.isSneaking()) {
                if (!world.isClient && world instanceof ServerWorld serverWorld) {
                    damageBlock(serverWorld, pos, state, 25);
                    int left = getCurrentHealth(world, pos, state);
                    player.sendMessage(Text.literal("HP: " + left + " / " + maxHp), true);
                }
                return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
            }

            return ActionResult.PASS;
        });

        UseBlockCallback.EVENT.register((player, world, hand, hitResult) -> {
            ItemStack stack = player.getStackInHand(hand);
            if (!stack.isOf(ModItems.REPAIR_PACK)) {
                return ActionResult.PASS;
            }

            BlockPos pos = hitResult.getBlockPos();
            BlockState state = world.getBlockState(pos);
            int maxHp = getMaxHealth(state.getBlock());
            if (maxHp <= 0) {
                return ActionResult.PASS;
            }

            int currentDamage = getDamageTaken(world, pos, state);
            if (currentDamage <= 0) {
                return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
            }

            if (!world.isClient && world instanceof ServerWorld serverWorld) {
                if (repairBlock(serverWorld, pos, state, 25)) {
                    if (!player.isCreative()) {
                        stack.damage(1, player, hand == Hand.MAIN_HAND
                                ? EquipmentSlot.MAINHAND : EquipmentSlot.OFFHAND);
                    }
                }
            }
            return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
        });
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.combat;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModBlocks;
import net.minecraft.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.block.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundCategory;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundEvents;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Direction;
import net.minecraft.world.World;

public class FactorioGateBlockEntity extends BlockEntity {

    private static final double TRIGGER_RADIUS_SQ = 3.6 * 3.6;

    public FactorioGateBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.FACTORIO_GATE_BLOCK_ENTITY, pos, state);
    }

    public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, FactorioGateBlockEntity entity) {
        if (world.isClient || (world.getTime() & 1L) != 0L) {
            return;
        }

        boolean shouldOpen = isPlayerNearGateLine(world, pos, state);
        boolean currentlyOpen = state.get(FactorioGateBlock.OPEN);

        if (shouldOpen != currentlyOpen) {
            world.setBlockState(pos, state.with(FactorioGateBlock.OPEN, shouldOpen), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
            world.playSound(
                    null,
                    pos,
                    shouldOpen ? SoundEvents.BLOCK_IRON_TRAPDOOR_OPEN : SoundEvents.BLOCK_IRON_TRAPDOOR_CLOSE,
                    SoundCategory.BLOCKS,
                    0.5f,
                    shouldOpen ? 0.9f : 0.75f
            );
        }
    }

    /**
     * ÐŸÑ€Ð¾Ð²ÐµÑ€ÑÐµÑ‚, ÐµÑÑ‚ÑŒ Ð»Ð¸ Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾Ðº Ñ€ÑÐ´Ð¾Ð¼ Ñ ÑÑ‚Ð¸Ð¼ Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ¾Ð¼ Ð²Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð˜Ð›Ð˜ Ñ€ÑÐ´Ð¾Ð¼ Ñ ÑÐ¾ÑÐµÐ´Ð½Ð¸Ð¼Ð¸ Ð²Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ñ‚Ð°Ð¼Ð¸ Ð² Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¼ Ð¶Ðµ Ñ€ÑÐ´Ñƒ
     * (Ñ‡Ñ‚Ð¾Ð±Ñ‹ ÑˆÐ¸Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÐ¸Ðµ Ð²Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ñ‚Ð° Ð¸Ð· 2â€“4 Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ¾Ð² Ð¾Ñ‚ÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ð²Ð°Ð»Ð¸ÑÑŒ Ð¸ Ð·Ð°ÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ð²Ð°Ð»Ð¸ÑÑŒ ÑÐ¸Ð½Ñ…Ñ€Ð¾Ð½Ð½Ð¾!).
     */
    private static boolean isPlayerNearGateLine(World world, BlockPos origin, BlockState state) {
        if (isPlayerNearPos(world, origin)) {
            return true;
        }
        Direction facing = state.get(FactorioGateBlock.FACING);
        Direction left = facing.rotateYCounterclockwise();
        Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();

        for (int step = 1; step <= 4; step++) {
            BlockPos leftPos = origin.offset(left, step);
            if (world.getBlockState(leftPos).getBlock() instanceof FactorioGateBlock) {
                if (isPlayerNearPos(world, leftPos)) return true;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        for (int step = 1; step <= 4; step++) {
            BlockPos rightPos = origin.offset(right, step);
            if (world.getBlockState(rightPos).getBlock() instanceof FactorioGateBlock) {
                if (isPlayerNearPos(world, rightPos)) return true;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static boolean isPlayerNearPos(World world, BlockPos gatePos) {
        double gx = gatePos.getX() + 0.5;
        double gy = gatePos.getY() + 0.5;
        double gz = gatePos.getZ() + 0.5;

        for (PlayerEntity player : world.getPlayers()) {
            if (!player.isSpectator() && player.isAlive()) {
                if (player.squaredDistanceTo(gx, gy, gz) <= TRIGGER_RADIUS_SQ) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}

        this.setDefaultState(this.stateManager.getDefaultState()
                .with(NORTH, false)
                .with(EAST, false)
                .with(SOUTH, false)
                .with(WEST, false));
    }

    @Override
    protected void appendProperties(StateManager.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
        builder.add(NORTH, EAST, SOUTH, WEST);
    }

    public static boolean canConnectTo(BlockState neighborState) {
        Block b = neighborState.getBlock();
        return b instanceof FactorioWallBlock || b instanceof FactorioGateBlock;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockState getPlacementState(ItemPlacementContext ctx) {
        BlockView world = ctx.getWorld();
        BlockPos pos = ctx.getBlockPos();
        return this.getDefaultState()
                .with(NORTH, canConnectTo(world.getBlockState(pos.north())))
                .with(EAST, canConnectTo(world.getBlockState(pos.east())))
                .with(SOUTH, canConnectTo(world.getBlockState(pos.south())))
                .with(WEST, canConnectTo(world.getBlockState(pos.west())));
    }

    @Override
    protected BlockState getStateForNeighborUpdate(BlockState state, Direction direction, BlockState neighborState,
                                                   WorldAccess world, BlockPos pos, BlockPos neighborPos) {
        return switch (direction) {
            case NORTH -> state.with(NORTH, canConnectTo(neighborState));
            case EAST -> state.with(EAST, canConnectTo(neighborState));
            case SOUTH -> state.with(SOUTH, canConnectTo(neighborState));
            case WEST -> state.with(WEST, canConnectTo(neighborState));
            default -> state;
        };
    }

    @Override
    protected VoxelShape getOutlineShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        return OUTLINE_SHAPE;
    }

public class LandMineBlockEntity extends BlockEntity {

    public static final int ARM_DELAY_TICKS = 30;
    private int armedTicks = 0;

    public LandMineBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.LAND_MINE_BLOCK_ENTITY, pos, state);
    }

    public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, LandMineBlockEntity entity) {
        if (world.isClient) return;

        if (entity.armedTicks < ARM_DELAY_TICKS) {
            entity.armedTicks++;
            if (entity.armedTicks == ARM_DELAY_TICKS) {
                world.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.BLOCK_STONE_BUTTON_CLICK_ON, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 0.4f, 1.6f);
            }
            return;
        }

        if ((world.getTime() & 1L) != 0L) {
            return;
        }

        // ÐŸÑ€Ð¾Ð²ÐµÑ€ÑÐµÐ¼ Ñ€Ð°Ð´Ð¸ÑƒÑ ÑÑ€Ð°Ð±Ð°Ñ‚Ñ‹Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ñ Ð¼Ð¸Ð½Ñ‹ (Ð²Ñ€Ð°Ð¶Ð´ÐµÐ±Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ Ð¼Ð¾Ð½ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ñ‹ Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾Ðº, Ð½Ð°ÑÑ‚ÑƒÐ¿Ð¸Ð²ÑˆÐ¸Ð¹ Ð±ÐµÐ· Shift)
        Box triggerBox = new Box(pos).expand(0.85, 0.5, 0.85);
        List<LivingEntity> targets = world.getEntitiesByClass(LivingEntity.class, triggerBox, living -> {
            if (!living.isAlive() || living.isSpectator()) return false;
            if (living instanceof Monster) return true;
            if (living instanceof PlayerEntity player) {
                return !player.isSneaking(); // Ð¡ Ð·Ð°Ð¶Ð°Ñ‚Ñ‹Ð¼ Shift Ð¼Ð¾Ð¶Ð½Ð¾ Ð±ÐµÐ·Ð¾Ð¿Ð°ÑÐ½Ð¾ Ñ…Ð¾Ð´Ð¸Ñ‚ÑŒ Ð¿Ð¾ Ð¼Ð¸Ð½Ð½Ð¾Ð¼Ñƒ Ð¿Ð¾Ð»ÑŽ!
            }
            return false;
        });

        if (!targets.isEmpty() && world instanceof ServerWorld serverWorld) {
            detonate(serverWorld, pos);
        }
    }

    public static void detonate(ServerWorld world, BlockPos pos) {
        world.setBlockState(pos, Blocks.AIR.getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);

        double cx = pos.getX() + 0.5;
        double cy = pos.getY() + 0.2;
        double cz = pos.getZ() + 0.5;

        // Ð­Ñ„Ñ„ÐµÐºÑ‚ Ð²Ð·Ñ€Ñ‹Ð²Ð° Ð¸ ÑƒÐ´Ð°Ñ€Ð½Ð¾Ð¹ Ð²Ð¾Ð»Ð½Ñ‹ Ð±ÐµÐ· Ñ€Ð°Ð·Ñ€ÑƒÑˆÐµÐ½Ð¸Ñ Ð·Ð°Ð²Ð¾Ð´ÑÐºÐ¸Ñ… Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ¾Ð²!
        world.playSound(null, cx, cy, cz, SoundEvents.ENTITY_GENERIC_EXPLODE.value(), SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 1.1f, 0.95f);
        world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.EXPLOSION_EMITTER, cx, cy + 0.3, cz, 1, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
        world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.FLAME, cx, cy + 0.2, cz, 28, 0.6, 0.3, 0.6, 0.08);
        world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.LARGE_SMOKE, cx, cy + 0.3, cz, 18, 0.7, 0.4, 0.7, 0.04);

        Box blastBox = new Box(pos).expand(3.5, 2.5, 3.5);
        List<LivingEntity> victims = world.getEntitiesByClass(LivingEntity.class, blastBox, LivingEntity::isAlive);
        for (LivingEntity victim : victims) {
            double dist = Math.sqrt(victim.squaredDistanceTo(cx, cy, cz));
            if (dist <= 4.0) {
                float factor = (float) Math.max(0.25, 1.0 - (dist / 4.2));
                victim.damage(world.getDamageSources().explosion(null, null), 28.0f * factor);
                // ÐžÐ³Ð»ÑƒÑˆÐµÐ½Ð¸Ðµ / Ð·Ð°Ð¼ÐµÐ´Ð»ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ðµ ÐºÐ°Ðº Ñƒ Ð¼Ð¸Ð½ Ð² Factorio
                victim.addStatusEffect(new StatusEffectInstance(StatusEffects.SLOWNESS, 60, 2));
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
        nbt.putInt("ArmedTicks", this.armedTicks);
    }

    @Override
    protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
        this.armedTicks = nbt.getInt("ArmedTicks");
    }

    private static void register(String id, Category cat, int row, ItemStack out, int ticks, Ingredient... ings) {
        Recipe r = new Recipe(id, cat, row, out, ticks, List.of(ings));
        ALL.add(r);
        BY_ID.put(id, r);
        BY_OUTPUT_ITEM.put(out.getItem(), r);
    }

    public static int getRecipeIndex(String id) {
        if (id == null || id.isEmpty()) return -1;
        init();
        for (int i = 0; i < ALL.size(); i++) {
            if (ALL.get(i).id().equals(id)) return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    public static String getRecipeIdByIndex(int index) {
        init();
        if (index >= 0 && index < ALL.size()) {
            return ALL.get(index).id();
        }
        return "";
    }

    public static Recipe getById(String id) {
        init();
        return BY_ID.get(id);
    }

    public static Recipe getByOutput(Item item) {
        init();
        return BY_OUTPUT_ITEM.get(item);
    }

    public static List<Recipe> getByCategory(Category category) {
        init();
        List<Recipe> list = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Recipe r : ALL) {
            if (r.category() == category && ResearchManager.isRecipeUnlocked(r.id())) {
                list.add(r);
            }
        }
        return list;
    }

    public static Map<Item, Integer> snapshotInventory(PlayerInventory inv) {
        Map<Item, Integer> map = new HashMap<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < inv.main.size(); i++) {
            ItemStack s = inv.main.get(i);
            if (!s.isEmpty()) {
                map.merge(s.getItem(), s.getCount(), Integer::sum);
            }
        }
        return map;
    }

    public static int getCraftableCount(PlayerInventory inv, Recipe recipe) {
        Map<Item, Integer> pool = snapshotInventory(inv);
        int crafts = 0;
        List<QueueStep> dummy = new ArrayList<>();
        while (crafts < 999 && tryConsumeOrSubcraftBatch(pool, recipe, 1, false, dummy, 0)) {
            crafts += recipe.output().getCount();
        }
        return crafts;
    }

    public static List<QueueStep> planAndConsume(PlayerInventory inv, Recipe targetRecipe, int requestedCrafts) {
        Map<Item, Integer> initialSnapshot = snapshotInventory(inv);

        int maxAffordable = 0;
        for (int test = 1; test <= requestedCrafts; test++) {
            Map<Item, Integer> testPool = new HashMap<>(initialSnapshot);
            List<QueueStep> testSteps = new ArrayList<>();
            if (tryConsumeOrSubcraftBatch(testPool, targetRecipe, test, true, testSteps, 0)) {
                maxAffordable = test;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }

        if (maxAffordable <= 0) {
            return Collections.emptyList();
        }

        Map<Item, Integer> simulatedPool = new HashMap<>(initialSnapshot);
        List<QueueStep> rawSteps = new ArrayList<>();
        tryConsumeOrSubcraftBatch(simulatedPool, targetRecipe, maxAffordable, true, rawSteps, 0);

        List<QueueStep> groupedSteps = consolidateStepsByFirstAppearance(rawSteps);

        for (Map.Entry<Item, Integer> entry : initialSnapshot.entrySet()) {
            Item item = entry.getKey();
            int before = entry.getValue();
            int after = simulatedPool.getOrDefault(item, 0);
            int toRemove = before - after;
            if (toRemove > 0) {
                removeFromPlayerInventory(inv, item, toRemove);
            }
        }

        for (Map.Entry<Item, Integer> entry : simulatedPool.entrySet()) {
            Item item = entry.getKey();
            int before = initialSnapshot.getOrDefault(item, 0);
            int after = entry.getValue();
            int surplus = after - before;
            if (surplus > 0) {
                inv.offerOrDrop(new ItemStack(item, surplus));
            }
        }

        return groupedSteps;
    }

    public static List<QueueStep> consolidateStepsByFirstAppearance(List<QueueStep> steps) {
        Map<String, List<QueueStep>> intermediatesById = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        List<QueueStep> finalTargets = new ArrayList<>();

        for (QueueStep step : steps) {
            if (step.deliverToPlayer()) {
                finalTargets.add(step);
            } else {
                intermediatesById.computeIfAbsent(step.recipe().id(), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(step);
            }
        }

        List<QueueStep> result = new ArrayList<>(steps.size());
        for (List<QueueStep> group : intermediatesById.values()) {
            result.addAll(group);
        }
        result.addAll(finalTargets);
        return result;
    }

    private static boolean tryConsumeOrSubcraftBatch(Map<Item, Integer> pool, Recipe recipe, int batchesNeeded,
                                                     boolean isTopLevelTarget, List<QueueStep> outSteps, int depth) {
        if (depth > 8 || batchesNeeded <= 0) return false;

        for (Ingredient ing : recipe.ingredients()) {
            int needed = ing.count() * batchesNeeded;
            int have = pool.getOrDefault(ing.item(), 0);

            if (have >= needed) {
                pool.put(ing.item(), have - needed);
            } else {
                int missing = needed - have;
                pool.put(ing.item(), 0);

                Recipe subRecipe = getByOutput(ing.item());
                if (subRecipe == null) {
                    return false;
                }

                int subOutCount = subRecipe.output().getCount();
                int subBatchesNeeded = (missing + subOutCount - 1) / subOutCount;

                if (!tryConsumeOrSubcraftBatch(pool, subRecipe, subBatchesNeeded, false, outSteps, depth + 1)) {
                    return false;
                }

                int produced = subBatchesNeeded * subOutCount;
                int leftover = produced - missing;
                if (leftover > 0) {
                    pool.merge(ing.item(), leftover, Integer::sum);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < batchesNeeded; i++) {
            outSteps.add(new QueueStep(recipe, isTopLevelTarget));
        }
        return true;
    }

    private static void removeFromPlayerInventory(PlayerInventory inv, Item item, int amount) {
        int remaining = amount;
        for (int i = 0; i < inv.main.size() && remaining > 0; i++) {
            ItemStack s = inv.main.get(i);
            if (!s.isEmpty() && s.isOf(item)) {
                int take = Math.min(remaining, s.getCount());
                s.decrement(take);
                if (s.isEmpty()) {
                    inv.main.set(i, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                }
                remaining -= take;
            }
        }
        inv.markDirty();
    }

    public static Map<Item, Integer> calculateTotalRaw(Recipe recipe) {
        Map<Item, Integer> raw = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        accumulateRaw(recipe, 1.0, raw, 0);
        return raw;
    }

    private static void accumulateRaw(Recipe recipe, double multiplier, Map<Item, Integer> raw, int depth) {
        if (depth > 6) return;
        for (Ingredient ing : recipe.ingredients()) {
            Recipe sub = getByOutput(ing.item());
            if (sub != null) {
                double batches = (ing.count() * multiplier) / sub.output().getCount();
                accumulateRaw(sub, batches, raw, depth + 1);
            } else {
                int add = Math.max(1, (int) Math.ceil(ing.count() * multiplier));
                raw.merge(ing.item(), add, Integer::sum);
            }
        }
    }
}

    public static void tickPlayerInventory(ServerPlayerEntity player) {
        // ÐÐµ ÑÐ¾Ñ€Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÐ¼, Ð¿Ð¾ÐºÐ° Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾Ðº Ð´ÐµÑ€Ð¶Ð¸Ñ‚ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚ Ð½Ð° ÐºÑƒÑ€ÑÐ¾Ñ€Ðµ Ð¼Ñ‹ÑˆÐ¸ Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ Ð¸ÑÐ¿Ð¾Ð»ÑŒÐ·ÑƒÐµÑ‚ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚
        if (!player.currentScreenHandler.getCursorStack().isEmpty() || player.isUsingItem()) {
            return;
        }

        PlayerInventory inv = player.getInventory();
        boolean changed = false;

        // Ð¨Ð°Ð³ 1. ÐžÐ±ÑŠÐµÐ´Ð¸Ð½ÑÐµÐ¼ Ð²ÑÐµ Ð½ÐµÐ¿Ð¾Ð»Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ ÑÑ‚Ð°ÐºÐ¸ Ð¾Ð´Ð¸Ð½Ð°ÐºÐ¾Ð²Ñ‹Ñ… Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚Ð¾Ð² Ð¿Ð¾ Ð²ÑÐµÐ¼Ñƒ Ð¸Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð°Ñ€ÑŽ (0..35)
        for (int i = 0; i < 36; i++) {
            ItemStack target = inv.main.get(i);
            if (target.isEmpty() || target.getCount() >= target.getMaxCount()) {
                continue;
            }
            for (int j = i + 1; j < 36; j++) {
                ItemStack source = inv.main.get(j);
                if (!source.isEmpty() && ItemStack.areItemsAndComponentsEqual(target, source)) {
                    int space = target.getMaxCount() - target.getCount();
                    int move = Math.min(space, source.getCount());
                    if (move > 0) {
                        target.increment(move);
                        source.decrement(move);
                        if (source.isEmpty()) {
                            inv.main.set(j, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                        }
                        changed = true;
                        if (target.getCount() >= target.getMaxCount()) {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Ð¨Ð°Ð³ 2. Ð¡Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÐ¼ Ð¸ ÑƒÐ¿Ð»Ð¾Ñ‚Ð½ÑÐµÐ¼ ÑÐ»Ð¾Ñ‚Ñ‹ Ð¸Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð°Ñ€Ñ (9..35), Ð° ÐµÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð² Ñ…Ð¾Ñ‚Ð±Ð°Ñ€Ðµ (0..8) Ð½ÐµÑ‚ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚Ð¾Ð² Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ Ð¾Ñ‚ÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ñ‚Ð¾ Ð¾ÐºÐ½Ð¾ â€” ÑƒÐ¿Ð»Ð¾Ñ‚Ð½ÑÐµÐ¼ Ð±ÐµÐ· Ð´Ñ‹Ñ€
        if (sortMainRange(inv, 9, 36)) {
            changed = true;
        }

        if (changed) {
            inv.markDirty();
            player.currentScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
            player.playerScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
        }
    }

    private static boolean sortMainRange(PlayerInventory inv, int startInclusive, int endExclusive) {
        List<ItemStack> nonEmpty = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = startInclusive; i < endExclusive; i++) {
            ItemStack s = inv.main.get(i);
            if (!s.isEmpty()) {
                nonEmpty.add(s.copy());
            }
        }

        if (nonEmpty.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }

        nonEmpty.sort(Comparator
                .comparingInt(InventoryAutoSorter::getCategoryOrder)
                .thenComparingInt((ItemStack s) -> getFactorioRecipeOrder(s.getItem())).thenComparing(s -> Registries.ITEM.getId(s.getItem()).toString())
                .thenComparing((ItemStack s) -> -s.getCount()));

        // ÐŸÑ€Ð¾Ð²ÐµÑ€ÑÐµÐ¼, Ð¾Ñ‚Ð»Ð¸Ñ‡Ð°ÐµÑ‚ÑÑ Ð»Ð¸ Ð½Ð¾Ð²Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€ÑÐ´Ð¾Ðº Ð¾Ñ‚ Ñ‚ÐµÐºÑƒÑ‰ÐµÐ³Ð¾ (Ñ‡Ñ‚Ð¾Ð±Ñ‹ Ð½Ðµ ÑÐ»Ð°Ñ‚ÑŒ Ð»Ð¸ÑˆÐ½Ð¸Ðµ Ð¿Ð°ÐºÐµÑ‚Ñ‹, ÐµÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð²ÑÑ‘ ÑƒÐ¶Ðµ Ð¾Ñ‚ÑÐ¾Ñ€Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ€Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¾)
        boolean anyDiff = false;
        for (int i = startInclusive; i < endExclusive; i++) {
            int listIdx = i - startInclusive;
            ItemStack expected = (listIdx < nonEmpty.size()) ? nonEmpty.get(listIdx) : ItemStack.EMPTY;
            ItemStack current = inv.main.get(i);
            if (!ItemStack.areEqual(current, expected)) {
                anyDiff = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!anyDiff) {
            return false;
        }

        for (int i = startInclusive; i < endExclusive; i++) {
            int listIdx = i - startInclusive;
            inv.main.set(i, (listIdx < nonEmpty.size()) ? nonEmpty.get(listIdx) : ItemStack.EMPTY);
        }
        return true;
    }

        public static int getFactorioRecipeOrder(Item item) {
        FactorioRecipes.init();
        for (int i = 0; i < FactorioRecipes.ALL.size(); i++) {
            if (FactorioRecipes.ALL.get(i).output().isOf(item)) {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return 1000;
    }

    public static int getCategoryOrder(ItemStack stack) {
        Item item = stack.getItem();
        FactorioRecipes.Recipe r = FactorioRecipes.getByOutput(item);
        if (r != null) {
            return switch (r.category()) {
                case LOGISTICS -> 1;
                case PRODUCTION -> 2;
                case INTERMEDIATE -> 3;
                case COMBAT -> 4;
            };
        }
        if (item == ModItems.STEEL_PLATE || item == ModItems.IRON_GEAR_WHEEL
                || item == ModItems.COPPER_CABLE || item == ModItems.ELECTRONIC_CIRCUIT || item == ModItems.IRON_STICK) {
            return 3;
        }
        if (item instanceof BlockItem) {
            return 5;
        }
        return 6;
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.crafting;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.research.ResearchManager;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.network.RequestCraftPayload;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.network.SyncCraftQueuePayload;
import net.fabricmc.fabric.api.networking.v1.ServerPlayNetworking;
import net.minecraft.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.server.network.ServerPlayerEntity;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundCategory;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundEvents;

import java.util.*;

public class ServerCraftingQueueManager {

    private static final Map<UUID, List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep>> QUEUES = new HashMap<>();
    private static final Map<UUID, Integer> ACTIVE_PROGRESS = new HashMap<>();

    public static void handleCraftRequest(ServerPlayerEntity player, RequestCraftPayload payload) {
        FactorioRecipes.init();
        UUID uuid = player.getUuid();
        List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> queue = QUEUES.computeIfAbsent(uuid, k -> new ArrayList<>());

        // ÐžÑ‚Ð¼ÐµÐ½Ð° ÑÐ»ÐµÐ¼ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð° Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸ Ð¿Ð¾ ÐºÐ»Ð¸ÐºÑƒ Ð² Ð»ÐµÐ²Ð¾Ð¼ Ð½Ð¸Ð¶Ð½ÐµÐ¼ ÑƒÐ³Ð»Ñƒ
        if (payload.action() < 0) {
            if (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                int targetIndex = findLastMatchingStepIndex(queue, payload.recipeId());
                if (targetIndex >= 0) {
                    cancelStepWithCascade(queue, targetIndex, player);
                }
                if (queue.isEmpty()) {
                    ACTIVE_PROGRESS.put(uuid, 0);
                }
                player.currentScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
                player.playerScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
                syncQueueToClient(player);
            }
            return;
        }

        FactorioRecipes.Recipe recipe = FactorioRecipes.getById(payload.recipeId());
        if (recipe == null) return;

        int requested = payload.action();
        if (requested >= 999) {
            int maxPossible = FactorioRecipes.getCraftableCount(player.getInventory(), recipe);
            requested = Math.max(1, maxPossible / Math.max(1, recipe.output().getCount()));
        }

        if (player.isCreative()) {
            int countToQueue = Math.min(requested, 20);
            for (int i = 0; i < countToQueue; i++) {
                queue.add(new FactorioRecipes.QueueStep(recipe, true));
            }
            syncQueueToClient(player);
            return;
        }

        List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> planned = FactorioRecipes.planAndConsume(player.getInventory(), recipe, requested);
        if (!planned.isEmpty()) {
            queue.addAll(planned);
            player.currentScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
            player.playerScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
            syncQueueToClient(player);
        } else {
            player.playSoundToPlayer(SoundEvents.BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_BASS.value(), SoundCategory.PLAYERS, 0.5f, 0.7f);
        }
    }

    private static int findLastMatchingStepIndex(List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> queue, String recipeId) {
        if (recipeId != null && !recipeId.isEmpty()) {
            for (int i = queue.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                if (queue.get(i).recipe().id().equals(recipeId)) {
                    return i;
                }
            }
        }
        return queue.size() - 1;
    }

    /**
     * ÐšÐ°ÑÐºÐ°Ð´Ð½Ð¾ Ð¾Ñ‚Ð¼ÐµÐ½ÑÐµÑ‚ Ð²Ñ‹Ð±Ñ€Ð°Ð½Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÑˆÐ°Ð³ ÐºÑ€Ð°Ñ„Ñ‚Ð°:
     * - Ð•ÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð¾Ñ‚Ð¼ÐµÐ½ÑÐµÑ‚ÑÑ Ñ„Ð¸Ð½Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚, Ð´Ð»Ñ ÐºÐ¾Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ Ð² Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸ ÐµÑ‰Ñ‘ Ð»ÐµÐ¶Ð°Ñ‚ Ð½ÐµÐ²Ñ‹Ð¿Ð¾Ð»Ð½ÐµÐ½Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼ÐµÐ¶ÑƒÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ ÑˆÐ°Ð³Ð¸ (deliverToPlayer == false),
     *   ÑÑ‚Ð¸ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼ÐµÐ¶ÑƒÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ ÑˆÐ°Ð³Ð¸ Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¶Ðµ ÑÐ½Ð¸Ð¼Ð°ÑŽÑ‚ÑÑ Ñ Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸, Ð° Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÑƒ Ð²Ð¾Ð·Ð²Ñ€Ð°Ñ‰Ð°ÐµÑ‚ÑÑ Ð±Ð°Ð·Ð¾Ð²Ð¾Ðµ ÑÑ‹Ñ€ÑŒÑ‘.
     * - Ð•ÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾Ðº Ð¾Ñ‚Ð¼ÐµÐ½ÑÐµÑ‚ Ð½Ð°Ð¿Ñ€ÑÐ¼ÑƒÑŽ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼ÐµÐ¶ÑƒÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÑˆÐ°Ð³ (deliverToPlayer == false),
     *   Ð°Ð²Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¼Ð°Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ‡ÐµÑÐºÐ¸ Ð¾Ñ‚Ð¼ÐµÐ½ÑÐµÑ‚ÑÑ Ð·Ð°Ð²Ð¸ÑÐ¸Ð¼Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð½ÐµÐ³Ð¾ Ñ„Ð¸Ð½Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚, Ñ‡Ñ‚Ð¾Ð±Ñ‹ Ð¸Ð·Ð±ÐµÐ¶Ð°Ñ‚ÑŒ Ð±ÐµÑÐ¿Ð»Ð°Ñ‚Ð½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ ÐºÑ€Ð°Ñ„Ñ‚Ð°.
     */
    private static void cancelStepWithCascade(List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> queue, int index, ServerPlayerEntity player) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= queue.size()) return;

        FactorioRecipes.QueueStep step = queue.get(index);

        // Ð•ÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾Ðº ÐºÐ»Ð¸ÐºÐ½ÑƒÐ» Ð¿Ð¾ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼ÐµÐ¶ÑƒÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ð¾Ð¼Ñƒ ÑˆÐ°Ð³Ñƒ (deliver == false), Ð¸Ñ‰ÐµÐ¼ Ð·Ð°Ð²Ð¸ÑÑÑ‰Ð¸Ð¹ Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð½ÐµÐ³Ð¾ Ñ€Ð¾Ð´Ð¸Ñ‚ÐµÐ»ÑŒÑÐºÐ¸Ð¹ ÑˆÐ°Ð³ Ð¿Ñ€Ð°Ð²ÐµÐµ Ð² Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸
        if (!step.deliverToPlayer()) {
            Item intermediateOut = step.recipe().output().getItem();
            for (int i = queue.size() - 1; i > index; i--) {
                FactorioRecipes.QueueStep later = queue.get(i);
                for (FactorioRecipes.Ingredient ing : later.recipe().ingredients()) {
                    if (ing.item() == intermediateOut) {
                        cancelStepWithCascade(queue, i, player);
                        return;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        boolean wasFirst = (index == 0);
        queue.remove(index);
        if (wasFirst) {
            ACTIVE_PROGRESS.put(player.getUuid(), 0);
        }

        if (player.isCreative()) {
            return;
        }

        refundIngredientsOrCancelSubsteps(queue, step.recipe(), player);
    }

    private static void refundIngredientsOrCancelSubsteps(List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> queue,
                                                          FactorioRecipes.Recipe cancelledRecipe,
                                                          ServerPlayerEntity player) {
        for (FactorioRecipes.Ingredient ing : cancelledRecipe.ingredients()) {
            int remainingToRefund = ing.count();

            // ÐŸÑ€Ð¾Ð²ÐµÑ€ÑÐµÐ¼ Ñ ÐºÐ¾Ð½Ñ†Ð° Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸, ÐµÑÑ‚ÑŒ Ð»Ð¸ Ð¾Ð¶Ð¸Ð´Ð°ÑŽÑ‰Ð¸Ðµ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼ÐµÐ¶ÑƒÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ ÑˆÐ°Ð³Ð¸ (deliverToPlayer == false), Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¸Ð·Ð²Ð¾Ð´ÑÑ‰Ð¸Ðµ ÑÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð¸Ð½Ð³Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸ÐµÐ½Ñ‚
            for (int i = queue.size() - 1; i >= 0 && remainingToRefund > 0; i--) {
                FactorioRecipes.QueueStep candidate = queue.get(i);
                if (!candidate.deliverToPlayer() && candidate.recipe().output().isOf(ing.item())) {
                    int outCount = candidate.recipe().output().getCount();
                    if (outCount <= remainingToRefund) {
                        boolean removedFirst = (i == 0);
                        queue.remove(i);
                        if (removedFirst) {
                            ACTIVE_PROGRESS.put(player.getUuid(), 0);
                        }
                        remainingToRefund -= outCount;
                        refundIngredientsOrCancelSubsteps(queue, candidate.recipe(), player);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (remainingToRefund > 0) {
                player.getInventory().offerOrDrop(new ItemStack(ing.item(), remainingToRefund));
            }
        }
    }

    public static void tickServer(MinecraftServer server) {
        ResearchManager.tickServer(server);

        for (ServerPlayerEntity player : server.getPlayerManager().getPlayerList()) {
            UUID uuid = player.getUuid();
            List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> queue = QUEUES.get(uuid);
            if (queue == null || queue.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }

            FactorioRecipes.QueueStep current = queue.get(0);
            int progress = ACTIVE_PROGRESS.getOrDefault(uuid, 0) + 1;
            int maxTicks = Math.max(1, current.recipe().timeTicks());

            if (progress >= maxTicks) {
                queue.remove(0);
                ACTIVE_PROGRESS.put(uuid, 0);

                if (current.deliverToPlayer()) {
                    ItemStack result = current.recipe().output().copy();
                    player.getInventory().offerOrDrop(result);
                    player.currentScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
                    player.playerScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
                    player.playSoundToPlayer(SoundEvents.ENTITY_ITEM_PICKUP, SoundCategory.PLAYERS, 0.4f, 1.3f);
                } else {
                    player.playSoundToPlayer(SoundEvents.BLOCK_SMITHING_TABLE_USE, SoundCategory.PLAYERS, 0.2f, 1.6f);
                }
                syncQueueToClient(player);
            } else {
                ACTIVE_PROGRESS.put(uuid, progress);
                if (progress % 2 == 0) {
                    syncQueueToClient(player);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void syncQueueToClient(ServerPlayerEntity player) {
        UUID uuid = player.getUuid();
        List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> queue = QUEUES.get(uuid);
        if (queue == null || queue.isEmpty()) {
            ServerPlayNetworking.send(player, new SyncCraftQueuePayload(List.of(), List.of(), 0, 1));
            return;
        }

        List<String> ids = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> counts = new ArrayList<>();

        for (FactorioRecipes.QueueStep step : queue) {
            String rId = step.recipe().id();
            int outCount = step.recipe().output().getCount();
            if (!ids.isEmpty() && ids.get(ids.size() - 1).equals(rId)) {
                int lastIdx = counts.size() - 1;
                counts.set(lastIdx, counts.get(lastIdx) + outCount);
            } else if (ids.size() < 64) {
                ids.add(rId);
                counts.add(outCount);
            }
        }

        int prog = ACTIVE_PROGRESS.getOrDefault(uuid, 0);
        int max = Math.max(1, queue.get(0).recipe().timeTicks());
        ServerPlayNetworking.send(player, new SyncCraftQueuePayload(ids, counts, prog, max));
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.electricity;
