            if (screen instanceof CreateWorldScreen createWorldScreen) {
                if (!NauvisCustomizeScreen.customConfigTouched) {
                    NauvisConfig.ACTIVE.resetDefaults();
                    NauvisConfig.ACTIVE.randomizeSeed();
                }

                ScreenEvents.beforeRender(screen).register((scr, drawContext, mouseX, mouseY, tickDelta) -> {
                    if (isNauvisPresetSelected(createWorldScreen)) {
                        ButtonWidget customizeBtn = findCustomizeButton(createWorldScreen);
                        if (customizeBtn != null) {
                            customizeBtn.active = true;
                        }
                    }
                });

                ScreenMouseEvents.allowMouseClick(screen).register((scr, mouseX, mouseY, button) -> {
                    if (button == 0 && isNauvisPresetSelected(createWorldScreen)) {
                        ButtonWidget customizeBtn = findCustomizeButton(createWorldScreen);
                        if (customizeBtn != null && customizeBtn.visible && customizeBtn.active
                                && customizeBtn.isMouseOver(mouseX, mouseY)) {
                            ModWorldGen.newlyCustomizedWorld = true;
                            client.setScreen(new NauvisCustomizeScreen(createWorldScreen));
                            return false;
                        }
                    }
                    return true;
                });
            }
        });
    }

    private static void ensureBlockModelAssetsExist() {
        String[] builtin3dBlocks = {
                "pumpjack", "oil_refinery", "chemical_plant", "crude_oil_deposit",
                "lab", "assembler", "big_electric_pole", "substation"
        };
        String itemModelJson = "{\n" +
                "  \"parent\": \"minecraft:builtin/entity\",\n" +
                "  \"gui_light\": \"side\",\n" +
                "  \"display\": {\n" +
                "    \"gui\": { \"rotation\": [ 30, 225, 0 ], \"translation\": [ 0, 0, 0 ], \"scale\": [ 0.625, 0.625, 0.625 ] },\n" +
                "    \"ground\": { \"rotation\": [ 0, 0, 0 ], \"translation\": [ 0, 3, 0 ], \"scale\": [ 0.25, 0.25, 0.25 ] },\n" +
                "    \"fixed\": { \"rotation\": [ 0, 0, 0 ], \"translation\": [ 0, 0, 0 ], \"scale\": [ 0.5, 0.5, 0.5 ] },\n" +
                "    \"thirdperson_righthand\": { \"rotation\": [ 75, 45, 0 ], \"translation\": [ 0, 2.5, 0 ], \"scale\": [ 0.375, 0.375, 0.375 ] },\n" +
                "    \"firstperson_righthand\": { \"rotation\": [ 0, 45, 0 ], \"translation\": [ 0, 0, 0 ], \"scale\": [ 0.40, 0.40, 0.40 ] },\n" +
                "    \"firstperson_lefthand\": { \"rotation\": [ 0, 225, 0 ], \"translation\": [ 0, 0, 0 ], \"scale\": [ 0.40, 0.40, 0.40 ] }\n" +
                "  }\n" +
                "}\n";
        String blockstateJson = "{\n  \"variants\": {\n    \"\": { \"model\": \"minecraft:block/stone\" }\n  }\n}\n";

        Path gameDir = FabricLoader.getInstance().getGameDir();
        Path projectRoot = gameDir.getParent();
        if (projectRoot == null) return;

        Path[] targetAssetRoots = {
                projectRoot.resolve("src/main/resources/assets/" + FactorioCore.MOD_ID),
                projectRoot.resolve("build/resources/main/assets/" + FactorioCore.MOD_ID),
                gameDir.resolve("resourcepacks/FactorioCore_Sounds/assets/" + FactorioCore.MOD_ID)
        };

        for (Path assetRoot : targetAssetRoots) {
            try {
                Path itemModelsDir = assetRoot.resolve("models/item");
                Path blockstatesDir = assetRoot.resolve("blockstates");
                Files.createDirectories(itemModelsDir);
                Files.createDirectories(blockstatesDir);

                for (String blockName : builtin3dBlocks) {
                    Path itemFile = itemModelsDir.resolve(blockName + ".json");
                    if (!Files.exists(itemFile)) {
                        Files.writeString(itemFile, itemModelJson, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                    }
                    Path bsFile = blockstatesDir.resolve(blockName + ".json");
                    if (!Files.exists(bsFile)) {
                        Files.writeString(bsFile, blockstateJson, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }
        }
    }

    private static void updateElectricityRenderCache(MinecraftClient client) {
        if (client.world == null || client.player == null) {
            CACHED_WIRE_LINKS.clear();
            CACHED_POLE_NODES.clear();
            return;
        }

        long worldTime = client.world.getTime();
        BlockPos playerPos = client.player.getBlockPos();
        if (worldTime - lastWireCacheTick < 10 && playerPos.getSquaredDistance(lastWireCacheCenter) < 4.0) {
            return;
        }
        lastWireCacheTick = worldTime;
        lastWireCacheCenter = playerPos;

        CACHED_WIRE_LINKS.clear();
        CACHED_POLE_NODES.clear();

        // Ð Ð°Ð´Ð¸ÑƒÑ 32 Ð´Ð»Ñ Ð¿Ð¾Ð´Ð´ÐµÑ€Ð¶ÐºÐ¸ 30-Ð±Ð»Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ñ… Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð²Ð¾Ð´Ð¾Ð² Ð‘Ð¾Ð»ÑŒÑˆÐ¾Ð¹ Ð¾Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‹ Ð›Ð­ÐŸ!
        for (int dx = -32; dx <= 32; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -32; dz <= 32; dz++) {
                for (int dy = -6; dy <= 6; dy++) {
                    BlockPos p = playerPos.add(dx, dy, dz);
                    BlockState st = client.world.getBlockState(p);
                    Block b = st.getBlock();

                    if (b instanceof ElectricPoleBlock && !ElectricPoleBlock.isMasterPoleNode(st)) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (b instanceof ElectricPoleBlock || b instanceof CreativeEnergySourceBlock) {
                        int supplyRadius = PowerNetworkManager.getSupplyRadius(b);
                        if (supplyRadius > 0 && Math.abs(dy) <= 5) {
                            CACHED_POLE_NODES.add(new PoleSupplyNode(p.toImmutable(), supplyRadius));
                        }

                        List<BlockPos> neighbors = PowerNetworkManager.findConnectedNodes(client.world, p, b);
                        for (BlockPos n : neighbors) {
                            if (p.asLong() < n.asLong()) {
                                CACHED_WIRE_LINKS.add(new WireLink(p.toImmutable(), n.toImmutable()));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static boolean isNauvisPresetSelected(CreateWorldScreen screen) {
        var presetEntry = screen.getWorldCreator().getWorldType().preset();
        if (presetEntry != null && presetEntry.getKey().isPresent()) {
            return presetEntry.getKey().get().getValue().getPath().contains("nauvis");
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Nullable
    private static ButtonWidget findCustomizeButton(ParentElement root) {
        String expected = Text.translatable("selectWorld.customizeType").getString();
        for (Element child : root.children()) {
            if (child instanceof ButtonWidget btn) {
                String msg = btn.getMessage().getString();
                if (msg.equals(expected) || msg.contains("Customize") || msg.contains("ÐÐ°ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ð¸Ñ‚ÑŒ")) {
                    return btn;
                }
            }
            if (child instanceof ParentElement parent) {
                ButtonWidget nested = findCustomizeButton(parent);
                if (nested != null) {
                    return nested;
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static boolean isMultiblockPreviewTarget(@Nullable Block block) {
        return block instanceof SplitterBlock
                || block == ModBlocks.BURNER_MINING_DRILL
                || block == ModBlocks.ELECTRIC_MINING_DRILL
                || block == ModBlocks.STONE_FURNACE
                || block == ModBlocks.STEEL_FURNACE
                || block == ModBlocks.OFFSHORE_PUMP
                || block == ModBlocks.BOILER
                || block == ModBlocks.STEAM_ENGINE
                || block == ModBlocks.LAB
                || block == ModBlocks.ASSEMBLER
                || block == ModBlocks.PUMPJACK
                || block == ModBlocks.OIL_REFINERY
                || block == ModBlocks.CHEMICAL_PLANT
                || block == ModBlocks.BIG_ELECTRIC_POLE
                || block == ModBlocks.SUBSTATION;
    }

    @Nullable
    private static PlacementPreview getMultiblockPlacementPreview(MinecraftClient client) {
        PlayerEntity player = client.player;
        World world = client.world;
        if (player == null || world == null || !(client.crosshairTarget instanceof BlockHitResult hit)) {
            return null;
        }
        if (hit.getType() != HitResult.Type.BLOCK) {
            return null;
        }

        Hand activeHand = Hand.MAIN_HAND;
        ItemStack held = player.getMainHandStack();
        Block targetBlock = (held.getItem() instanceof BlockItem bi) ? bi.getBlock() : null;
        if (!isMultiblockPreviewTarget(targetBlock)) {
            held = player.getOffHandStack();
            activeHand = Hand.OFF_HAND;
            targetBlock = (held.getItem() instanceof BlockItem bi2) ? bi2.getBlock() : null;
            if (!isMultiblockPreviewTarget(targetBlock)) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        ItemPlacementContext ctx = new ItemPlacementContext(player, activeHand, held, hit);
        BlockPos originPos = ctx.getBlockPos();

        Direction facing = (targetBlock instanceof SplitterBlock)
                ? ctx.getHorizontalPlayerFacing()
                : ctx.getHorizontalPlayerFacing().getOpposite();
        if (player.isSneaking()) {
            facing = facing.getOpposite();
        }

        if (targetBlock == ModBlocks.BIG_ELECTRIC_POLE || targetBlock == ModBlocks.SUBSTATION) {
            boolean valid = true;
            Box combined = null;
            List<Box> cells = new ArrayList<>(4);
            double maxH = (targetBlock == ModBlocks.BIG_ELECTRIC_POLE) ? 3.2 : 2.5;
            for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
                BlockPos tile = ElectricPoleBlock.getPartPos(originPos, part, false);
                Box col = new Box(tile).withMaxY(tile.getY() + maxH);
                cells.add(col);
                combined = (combined == null) ? col : combined.union(col);
                for (int yOff = 0; yOff <= 1; yOff++) {
                    BlockPos cp = tile.up(yOff);
                    if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(cp) || !world.getBlockState(cp).canReplace(ctx)) valid = false;
                }
            }
            return new PlacementPreview(combined, cells, null, valid);
        }

        if (targetBlock instanceof SplitterBlock) {
            BlockPos rightPos = originPos.offset(facing.rotateYClockwise());
            boolean canLeft = world.getBlockState(originPos).canReplace(ctx) && world.getWorldBorder().contains(originPos);
            boolean canRight = world.getBlockState(rightPos).canReplace(ctx) && world.getWorldBorder().contains(rightPos);
            Box combined = new Box(originPos).union(new Box(rightPos)).withMaxY(originPos.getY() + 0.6875);
            List<Box> cells = List.of(
                    new Box(originPos).withMaxY(originPos.getY() + 0.6875),
                    new Box(rightPos).withMaxY(rightPos.getY() + 0.6875)
            );
            return new PlacementPreview(combined, cells, null, canLeft && canRight);
        }

        if (targetBlock == ModBlocks.OFFSHORE_PUMP) {
            Direction pumpFacing = player.getHorizontalFacing();
            if (player.isSneaking()) pumpFacing = pumpFacing.getOpposite();
            BlockPos snappedPos = OffshorePumpBlock.resolveShoreMasterPos(world, originPos, pumpFacing);
            boolean validShore = OffshorePumpBlock.isValidShorelinePlacement(world, snappedPos, pumpFacing, ctx);
            Box shoreCol = new Box(snappedPos).withMaxY(snappedPos.getY() + 1.0);
            Box waterCol = new Box(snappedPos.offset(pumpFacing)).withMinY(snappedPos.getY() - 1.25).withMaxY(snappedPos.getY() + 1.0);
            Box outPipe = new Box(snappedPos.offset(pumpFacing.getOpposite())).withMaxY(snappedPos.getY() + 0.35);
            return new PlacementPreview(shoreCol.union(waterCol), List.of(shoreCol, waterCol), outPipe, validShore);
        }

        if (targetBlock == ModBlocks.BOILER) {
            boolean valid = true;
            Box combined = null;
            List<Box> cells = new ArrayList<>(6);
            for (int part = 0; part < 6; part++) {
                BlockPos tile = BoilerBlock.getPartPos(originPos, facing, part, false);
                Box col = new Box(tile).withMaxY(tile.getY() + 2.5);
                cells.add(col);
                combined = (combined == null) ? col : combined.union(col);
                for (int yOff = 0; yOff <= 2; yOff++) {
                    BlockPos cp = tile.up(yOff);
                    if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(cp) || !world.getBlockState(cp).canReplace(ctx)) valid = false;
                }
            }
            BlockPos steamOut = BoilerBlock.getPartPos(originPos, facing, 4, false).offset(facing);
            return new PlacementPreview(combined, cells, new Box(steamOut).withMaxY(steamOut.getY() + 0.35), valid);
        }

        if (targetBlock == ModBlocks.STEAM_ENGINE) {
            Direction engFacing = player.getHorizontalFacing();
            if (player.isSneaking()) engFacing = engFacing.getOpposite();
            boolean valid = true;
            Box combined = null;
            List<Box> cells = new ArrayList<>(15);
            for (int part = 0; part < 15; part++) {
                BlockPos tile = SteamEngineBlock.getPartPos(originPos, engFacing, part, 0);
                Box col = new Box(tile).withMaxY(tile.getY() + 3.5);
                cells.add(col);
                combined = (combined == null) ? col : combined.union(col);
                for (int yOff = 0; yOff <= 3; yOff++) {
                    BlockPos cp = tile.up(yOff);
                    if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(cp) || !world.getBlockState(cp).canReplace(ctx)) valid = false;
                }
            }
            return new PlacementPreview(combined, cells, null, valid);
        }

        if (targetBlock == ModBlocks.OIL_REFINERY) {
            boolean valid = true;
            Box combined = null;
            List<Box> cells = new ArrayList<>(25);
            for (int part = 0; part < 25; part++) {
                BlockPos tile = OilMachines.OilRefineryBlock.getPartPos(originPos, facing, part, false);
                Box col = new Box(tile).withMaxY(tile.getY() + 3.2);
                cells.add(col);
                combined = (combined == null) ? col : combined.union(col);
                for (int yOff = 0; yOff <= 2; yOff++) {
                    BlockPos cp = tile.up(yOff);
                    if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(cp) || !world.getBlockState(cp).canReplace(ctx)) valid = false;
                }
            }
            return new PlacementPreview(combined, cells, null, valid);
        }

        if (targetBlock == ModBlocks.LAB || targetBlock == ModBlocks.ASSEMBLER
                || targetBlock == ModBlocks.PUMPJACK || targetBlock == ModBlocks.CHEMICAL_PLANT) {
            boolean valid = true;
            Box combined = null;
            List<Box> cells = new ArrayList<>(9);
            for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                BlockPos tile = LabBlock.getPartPos(originPos, facing, part, false);
                Box col = new Box(tile).withMaxY(tile.getY() + 2.2);
                cells.add(col);
                combined = (combined == null) ? col : combined.union(col);
                for (int yOff = 0; yOff <= 1; yOff++) {
                    BlockPos cp = tile.up(yOff);
                    if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(cp) || !world.getBlockState(cp).canReplace(ctx)) valid = false;
                }
            }
            if (targetBlock == ModBlocks.PUMPJACK && !OilMachines.PumpjackBlock.hasOilInFootprint(world, originPos)) {
                valid = false;
            }
            return new PlacementPreview(combined, cells, null, valid);
        }

        if (targetBlock == ModBlocks.ELECTRIC_MINING_DRILL) {
            boolean valid = true;
            Box combined = null;
            List<Box> cells = new ArrayList<>(9);
            for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                BlockPos tile = ElectricDrillBlock.getPartPos(originPos, facing, part, false);
                Box col = new Box(tile).withMaxY(tile.getY() + 2.5);
                cells.add(col);
                combined = (combined == null) ? col : combined.union(col);
                for (int yOff = 0; yOff <= 2; yOff++) {
                    BlockPos cp = tile.up(yOff);
                    if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(cp) || !world.getBlockState(cp).canReplace(ctx)) valid = false;
                }
            }
            if (!ElectricDrillBlock.hasOreInFootprint(world, originPos, facing)) valid = false;
            BlockPos outPos = originPos.offset(facing, 2);
            return new PlacementPreview(combined, cells, new Box(outPos).withMaxY(outPos.getY() + 0.35), valid);
        }

        boolean allValid = true;
        Box combined = null;
        List<Box> cells = new ArrayList<>(4);

        for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
            BlockPos groundTile = BurnerDrillBlock.getPartPos(originPos, facing, part, false);
            Box tileColumn = new Box(groundTile).withMaxY(groundTile.getY() + 2.5);
            cells.add(tileColumn);
            combined = (combined == null) ? tileColumn : combined.union(tileColumn);

            for (int yOff = 0; yOff <= 2; yOff++) {
                BlockPos checkPos = groundTile.up(yOff);
                if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(checkPos) || !world.getBlockState(checkPos).canReplace(ctx)) {
                    allValid = false;
                }
            }
        }

        Box outputBox = null;
        if (targetBlock == ModBlocks.BURNER_MINING_DRILL) {
            if (!BurnerDrillBlock.hasOreInFootprint(world, originPos, facing)) allValid = false;
            BlockPos outputPos = BurnerDrillBlock.getPartPos(originPos, facing, 3, false).offset(facing);
            outputBox = new Box(outputPos).withMaxY(outputPos.getY() + 0.35);
        }

        return new PlacementPreview(combined, cells, outputBox, allValid);
    }

    private static void renderMultiblockPlacementOutline(WorldRenderContext context) {
        MinecraftClient client = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        VertexConsumerProvider consumers = context.consumers();
        MatrixStack matrices = context.matrixStack();
        if (client.world == null || client.player == null || consumers == null || matrices == null) {
            return;
        }

        Vec3d cam = context.camera().getPos();
        VertexConsumer lines = consumers.getBuffer(RenderLayer.getLines());

        if (client.crosshairTarget instanceof BlockHitResult hit && hit.getType() == HitResult.Type.BLOCK) {
            BlockPos hitPos = hit.getBlockPos();
            var hitState = client.world.getBlockState(hitPos);
            if (hitState.getBlock() instanceof ElectricDrillBlock) {
                BlockPos master = ElectricDrillBlock.getMasterPos(hitPos, hitState);
                if (FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.showDrillMiningArea) {
                    int dc = FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.drillAreaColor;
                    drawPoleSupplyZone(matrices, lines, cam, master, 2,
                            FactorioConfig.getRed(dc), FactorioConfig.getGreen(dc), FactorioConfig.getBlue(dc), 0.80f);
                }
            }
        }

        PlacementPreview preview = getMultiblockPlacementPreview(client);
        if (preview == null) {
            return;
        }

        ItemStack heldMain = client.player.getMainHandStack();
        ItemStack heldOff = client.player.getOffHandStack();
        boolean mainIsDrill = heldMain.isOf(ModBlocks.ELECTRIC_MINING_DRILL.asItem());
        boolean offIsDrill = !mainIsDrill && heldOff.isOf(ModBlocks.ELECTRIC_MINING_DRILL.asItem());

        if ((mainIsDrill || offIsDrill)
                && client.crosshairTarget instanceof BlockHitResult hit2
                && hit2.getType() == HitResult.Type.BLOCK) {
            Hand drillHand = mainIsDrill ? Hand.MAIN_HAND : Hand.OFF_HAND;
            ItemStack drillStack = mainIsDrill ? heldMain : heldOff;
            ItemPlacementContext ctx = new ItemPlacementContext(client.player, drillHand, drillStack, hit2);
            if (FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.showDrillMiningArea) {
                int dc = FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.drillAreaColor;
                drawPoleSupplyZone(matrices, lines, cam, ctx.getBlockPos(), 2,
                        FactorioConfig.getRed(dc), FactorioConfig.getGreen(dc), FactorioConfig.getBlue(dc), 0.85f);
            }
        }

        int outlineRgb = preview.valid
                ? FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.validPlacementColor
                : FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.invalidPlacementColor;
        float r = FactorioConfig.getRed(outlineRgb);
        float g = FactorioConfig.getGreen(outlineRgb);
        float b = FactorioConfig.getBlue(outlineRgb);

        Box outer = preview.combinedBox.offset(-cam.x, -cam.y, -cam.z).expand(0.004);
        WorldRenderer.drawBox(matrices, lines, outer, r, g, b, 0.95f);

        for (Box cell : preview.cellBoxes) {
            WorldRenderer.drawBox(matrices, lines, cell.offset(-cam.x, -cam.y, -cam.z), r, g, b, 0.45f);
        }

        if (preview.outputIndicatorBox != null) {
            WorldRenderer.drawBox(
                    matrices,
                    lines,
                    preview.outputIndicatorBox.offset(-cam.x, -cam.y, -cam.z).expand(0.003),
                    1.0f, 0.85f, 0.10f, 0.95f
            );
        }
    }

    private static void spawnMultiblockPlacementParticles(MinecraftClient client) {
        if (!FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.enablePlacementParticles
                || client.isPaused()
                || client.world == null
                || client.world.getTime() % 3 != 0) {
            return;
        }
        PlacementPreview preview = getMultiblockPlacementPreview(client);
        if (preview == null) {
            return;
        }

        int pCol = preview.valid
                ? FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.validPlacementColor
                : FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.invalidPlacementColor;
        if (pCol != cachedParticleRgb) {
            cachedParticleRgb = pCol;
            cachedPlacementParticle = new DustParticleEffect(
                    new Vector3f(FactorioConfig.getRed(pCol), FactorioConfig.getGreen(pCol), FactorioConfig.getBlue(pCol)),
                    0.65f
            );
        }

        Box box = preview.combinedBox;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
            double t = i / 4.0;
            double px = MathHelper.lerp(t, box.minX, box.maxX);
            double pz = MathHelper.lerp(t, box.minZ, box.maxZ);

            client.world.addParticle(cachedPlacementParticle, px, box.minY + 0.05, box.minZ, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
            client.world.addParticle(cachedPlacementParticle, px, box.minY + 0.05, box.maxZ, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
            client.world.addParticle(cachedPlacementParticle, box.minX, box.minY + 0.05, pz, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
            client.world.addParticle(cachedPlacementParticle, box.maxX, box.minY + 0.05, pz, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);

            client.world.addParticle(cachedPlacementParticle, px, box.maxY, box.minZ, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
            client.world.addParticle(cachedPlacementParticle, px, box.maxY, box.maxZ, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
        }

        if (preview.outputIndicatorBox != null) {
            Box out = preview.outputIndicatorBox;
            client.world.addParticle(YELLOW_PARTICLE, out.getCenter().x, out.maxY, out.getCenter().z, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
        }
    }

    private static void renderElectricityOverlayAndWires(WorldRenderContext context) {
        MinecraftClient client = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        if (client.player == null || client.world == null || context.consumers() == null || context.matrixStack() == null) {
            return;
        }

        Vec3d cam = context.camera().getPos();
        MatrixStack matrices = context.matrixStack();
        VertexConsumer lines = context.consumers().getBuffer(RenderLayer.getLines());

        if (FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.enableCopperWiresRender && !CACHED_WIRE_LINKS.isEmpty()) {
            int wc = FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.wireColor;
            float wr = FactorioConfig.getRed(wc);
            float wg = FactorioConfig.getGreen(wc);
            float wb = FactorioConfig.getBlue(wc);
            for (WireLink link : CACHED_WIRE_LINKS) {
                drawCopperWire(client.world, matrices, lines, cam, link.a(), link.b(), wr, wg, wb, 0.9f);
            }
        }

        Hand electricHand = Hand.MAIN_HAND;
        ItemStack held = client.player.getMainHandStack();
        Block heldBlock = (held.getItem() instanceof BlockItem bi) ? bi.getBlock() : null;
        if (!isElectricRelatedBlock(heldBlock)) {
            held = client.player.getOffHandStack();
            electricHand = Hand.OFF_HAND;
            heldBlock = (held.getItem() instanceof BlockItem bi2) ? bi2.getBlock() : null;
        }

        if (FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.showPoleSupplyWhenHoldingElectric && isElectricRelatedBlock(heldBlock)) {
            int pc = FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.poleSupplyColor;
            float pr = FactorioConfig.getRed(pc);
            float pg = FactorioConfig.getGreen(pc);
            float pb = FactorioConfig.getBlue(pc);
            for (PoleSupplyNode node : CACHED_POLE_NODES) {
                drawPoleSupplyZone(matrices, lines, cam, node.pos(), node.radius(), pr, pg, pb, 0.65f);
            }
        }

        int supplyRadius = PowerNetworkManager.getSupplyRadius(heldBlock);
        if (supplyRadius > 0 && client.crosshairTarget instanceof BlockHitResult hit && hit.getType() == HitResult.Type.BLOCK) {
            ItemPlacementContext ctx = new ItemPlacementContext(client.player, electricHand, held, hit);
            BlockPos targetPos = ctx.getBlockPos();
            int pc2 = FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.poleSupplyColor;
            drawPoleSupplyZone(matrices, lines, cam, targetPos, supplyRadius,
                    FactorioConfig.getRed(pc2), FactorioConfig.getGreen(pc2), FactorioConfig.getBlue(pc2), 0.90f);

            List<BlockPos> previewLinks = PowerNetworkManager.findConnectedNodes(client.world, targetPos, heldBlock);
            for (BlockPos link : previewLinks) {
                drawCopperWire(client.world, matrices, lines, cam, targetPos, link, 0.2f, 0.9f, 1.0f, 0.95f);
            }
        }
    }

    private static boolean isElectricRelatedBlock(@Nullable Block block) {
        if (block == null) return false;
        return block == ModBlocks.SMALL_ELECTRIC_POLE
                || block == ModBlocks.MEDIUM_ELECTRIC_POLE
                || block == ModBlocks.BIG_ELECTRIC_POLE
                || block == ModBlocks.SUBSTATION
                || block == ModBlocks.ELECTRIC_ENERGY_INTERFACE
                || block == ModBlocks.INSERTER
                || block == ModBlocks.LONG_HANDED_INSERTER
                || block == ModBlocks.FAST_INSERTER
                || block == ModBlocks.ASSEMBLER
                || block == ModBlocks.LAB
                || block == ModBlocks.ELECTRIC_MINING_DRILL
                || block == ModBlocks.STEAM_ENGINE
                || block == ModBlocks.PUMPJACK
                || block == ModBlocks.OIL_REFINERY
                || block == ModBlocks.CHEMICAL_PLANT;
    }

    private static void drawPoleSupplyZone(MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumer lines, Vec3d cam,
                                           BlockPos centerPos, int radius, float r, float g, float b, float alpha) {
        double minX = centerPos.getX() - radius - cam.x;
        double minZ = centerPos.getZ() - radius - cam.z;
        double maxX = centerPos.getX() + radius + 1 - cam.x;
        double maxZ = centerPos.getZ() + radius + 1 - cam.z;
        double y = centerPos.getY() + 0.04 - cam.y;

        Box supplyBox = new Box(minX, y, minZ, maxX, y + 0.06, maxZ);
        WorldRenderer.drawBox(matrices, lines, supplyBox, r, g, b, alpha);

        MatrixStack.Entry entry = matrices.peek();
        for (int step = 1; step < (radius * 2 + 1); step++) {
            float gx = (float) (minX + step);
            float gz = (float) (minZ + step);
            float fy = (float) (y + 0.02);
            lines.vertex(entry, gx, fy, (float) minZ).color(r, g, b, alpha * 0.45f).normal(entry, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
            lines.vertex(entry, gx, fy, (float) maxZ).color(r, g, b, alpha * 0.45f).normal(entry, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
            lines.vertex(entry, (float) minX, fy, gz).color(r, g, b, alpha * 0.45f).normal(entry, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
            lines.vertex(entry, (float) maxX, fy, gz).color(r, g, b, alpha * 0.45f).normal(entry, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
        }
    }

    private static Vec3d getWireAttachmentPoint(World world, BlockPos pos) {
        Block b = world.getBlockState(pos).getBlock();
        if (b == ModBlocks.BIG_ELECTRIC_POLE) {
            return new Vec3d(pos.getX() + 1.0, pos.getY() + 3.15, pos.getZ() + 1.0);
        }
        if (b == ModBlocks.SUBSTATION) {
            return new Vec3d(pos.getX() + 1.0, pos.getY() + 2.45, pos.getZ() + 1.0);
        }
        return new Vec3d(pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.92, pos.getZ() + 0.5);
    }

    private static void drawCopperWire(World world, MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumer lines, Vec3d cam,
                                       BlockPos a, BlockPos b, float r, float g, float bl, float alpha) {
        Vec3d pa = getWireAttachmentPoint(world, a);
        Vec3d pb = getWireAttachmentPoint(world, b);

        float x1 = (float) (pa.x - cam.x);
        float y1 = (float) (pa.y - cam.y);
        float z1 = (float) (pa.z - cam.z);
        float x2 = (float) (pb.x - cam.x);
        float y2 = (float) (pb.y - cam.y);
        float z2 = (float) (pb.z - cam.z);

        MatrixStack.Entry entry = matrices.peek();
        lines.vertex(entry, x1, y1, z1).color(r, g, bl, alpha).normal(entry, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
        lines.vertex(entry, x2, y2, z2).color(r, g, bl, alpha).normal(entry, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
    }

    private record PlacementPreview(Box combinedBox, List<Box> cellBoxes, @Nullable Box outputIndicatorBox, boolean valid) {}
}

    private void drawFloatSlider(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy, int sw, float val, float min, float max, String label) {
        String display = String.format("%s: %.2fx", label, val);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, display, sx, sy, 0xFFBBBBBB, false);
        int trackY = sy + 11;
        context.fill(sx, trackY, sx + sw, trackY + 5, 0xFF141414);
        float ratio = MathHelper.clamp((val - min) / (max - min), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        int fillW = Math.round(ratio * (sw - 2));
        if (fillW > 0) context.fill(sx + 1, trackY + 1, sx + 1 + fillW, trackY + 4, 0xFFE59524);
        int knobX = sx + Math.round(ratio * (sw - 4));
        context.fill(knobX, trackY - 1, knobX + 4, trackY + 6, 0xFFEAEAEA);
    }

    private void drawToggle(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw, String label, boolean checked, int mx, int my) {
        boolean hovered = mx >= bx && mx <= bx + bw && my >= by && my <= by + 30;
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + bw, by + 30, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + bw - 1, by + 29, hovered ? 0xFF36383C : 0xFF2D2E32);

        context.fill(bx + 6, by + 9, bx + 17, by + 20, 0xFF141414);
        if (checked) {
            context.fill(bx + 7, by + 10, bx + 16, by + 19, 0xFFE59524);
            context.fill(bx + 9, by + 14, bx + 11, by + 17, 0xFF141414);
            context.fill(bx + 11, by + 12, bx + 14, by + 15, 0xFF141414);
        } else {
            context.fill(bx + 7, by + 10, bx + 16, by + 19, 0xFF3E4044);
        }
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, label, bx + 22, by + 10, checked ? 0xFFFFE082 : 0xFFCCCCCC, false);
    }

    private void renderColorsTab(DrawContext context, int cx, int cy, int cw, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        for (int i = 0; i < colors.size(); i++) {
            ColorEntry entry = colors.get(i);
            int ry = cy + entry.ry;
            int rgb = entry.getter.get();

            context.fill(cx + 6, ry, cx + cw - 6, ry + 26, 0xFF141414);
            context.fill(cx + 7, ry + 1, cx + cw - 7, ry + 25, 0xFF2D2E32);

            context.fill(cx + 11, ry + 4, cx + 29, ry + 22, 0xFF111111);
            context.fill(cx + 12, ry + 5, cx + 28, ry + 21, 0xFF000000 | rgb);
            context.drawText(this.textRenderer, entry.label, cx + 34, ry + 9, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);

            int slidersStartX = cx + 204;
            drawRgbSlider(context, slidersStartX, ry + 4, 42, (rgb >> 16) & 0xFF, 0xFFE53935, "R");
            drawRgbSlider(context, slidersStartX + 46, ry + 4, 42, (rgb >> 8) & 0xFF, 0xFF43A047, "G");
            drawRgbSlider(context, slidersStartX + 92, ry + 4, 42, rgb & 0xFF, 0xFF1E88E5, "B");

            int presetStartX = cx + 346;
            for (int p = 0; p < COLOR_PRESETS.length; p++) {
                int px = presetStartX + p * 11;
                int pCol = COLOR_PRESETS[p];
                context.fill(px, ry + 8, px + 9, ry + 18, (rgb == pCol) ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFF141414);
                context.fill(px + 1, ry + 9, px + 8, ry + 17, 0xFF000000 | pCol);
            }
        }
    }

    private void drawRgbSlider(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy, int sw, int val255, int barColor, String label) {
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, label + ":" + val255, sx, sy, 0xFFBBBBBB, false);
        context.fill(sx, sy + 11, sx + sw, sy + 16, 0xFF141414);
        int fillW = Math.round((val255 / 255.0f) * (sw - 2));
        if (fillW > 0) context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 12, sx + 1 + fillW, sy + 15, barColor);
        int knobX = sx + Math.round((val255 / 255.0f) * (sw - 4));
        context.fill(knobX, sy + 10, knobX + 4, sy + 17, 0xFFEAEAEA);
    }

    private void renderKeybindsTab(DrawContext context, int cx, int cy, int cw, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        for (KeybindEntry entry : keybinds) {
            int ry = cy + entry.ry;
            context.fill(cx + 6, ry, cx + cw - 6, ry + 24, 0xFF141414);
            context.fill(cx + 7, ry + 1, cx + cw - 7, ry + 23, 0xFF2D2E32);
            context.drawText(this.textRenderer, entry.label, cx + 14, ry + 8, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);

            boolean isListening = (this.listeningKeybind == entry.binding);

            drawFactorioButton(context, cx + cw - 152, ry + 3, 92, 18, keyLabel, mouseX, mouseY, isListening);
            drawFactorioButton(context, cx + cw - 56, ry + 3, 50, 18, Text.translatable("config.factoriocore.keybind.reset").getString(), mouseX, mouseY, !entry.binding.isDefault());
        }
    }

    private void drawTabButton(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw, int bh, String label, int mouseX, int mouseY, boolean active) {
        boolean hovered = mouseX >= bx && mouseX <= bx + bw && mouseY >= by && mouseY <= by + bh;
        int bg = active ? 0xFFE59524 : (hovered ? 0xFF4A4C50 : 0xFF35373B);
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + bw, by + bh, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + bw - 1, by + bh - (active ? 0 : 1), bg);
        int tw = this.textRenderer.getWidth(label);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, label, bx + (bw - tw) / 2, by + 4, active ? 0xFF141414 : 0xFFE6E6E6, false);
    }

    private void drawFactorioButton(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw, int bh, String label, int mouseX, int mouseY, boolean highlighted) {

        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + bw - 1, by + bh - 1, bg);
        int tw = this.textRenderer.getWidth(label);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, label, bx + (bw - tw) / 2, by + (bh - 8) / 2, highlighted ? 0xFF141414 : 0xFFEAEAEA, false);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {

                    }
                    return true;
                }

                    if (!found.isEmpty()) {

                        FactorioConfig.save();

                    return true;

                    playClick();

                        this.activeColorIndex = i;
                        this.draggingRgbChannel = ch;

                        return true;

    private void updateColorChannelFromMouse(ColorEntry entry, int channel, double mouseX, int sliderX, int sliderW) {
        int val = MathHelper.clamp(Math.round(((float) (mouseX - sliderX) / sliderW) * 255.0f), 0, 255);
        int rgb = entry.getter.get();
        int r = (channel == 0) ? val : ((rgb >> 16) & 0xFF);
        int g = (channel == 1) ? val : ((rgb >> 8) & 0xFF);
        int b = (channel == 2) ? val : (rgb & 0xFF);
        entry.setter.accept((r << 16) | (g << 8) | b);
        FactorioConfig.save();
    }

    private void updateFloatSlider(FloatSliderEntry s, double mouseX, int sx, int sw) {
        float ratio = MathHelper.clamp((float) (mouseX - sx) / sw, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        float val = s.min + ratio * (s.max - s.min);
        val = Math.round(val * 20.0f) / 20.0f;
        s.setter.accept(val);
        FactorioConfig.save();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        int x = (this.width - PANEL_W) / 2;
        int cx = x + 8, cw = PANEL_W - 16;
        if (this.activeFloatSlider != null) {
            updateFloatSlider(this.activeFloatSlider, mouseX, cx + this.activeFloatSlider.rx, cw - 20);
            return true;
        }
        if (this.activeColorIndex >= 0 && this.draggingRgbChannel >= 0) {
            updateColorChannelFromMouse(colors.get(this.activeColorIndex), this.draggingRgbChannel, mouseX, cx + 204 + this.draggingRgbChannel * 46, 42);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        this.activeColorIndex = -1;
        this.draggingRgbChannel = -1;
        this.activeFloatSlider = null;
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean charTyped(char chr, int modifiers) {
        if (this.editingPathField && chr >= 32) {
            FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.factorioDataPath += chr;
            return true;
        }
        return super.charTyped(chr, modifiers);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(int keyCode, int scanCode, int modifiers) {
        if (this.editingPathField) {
            if (Screen.isPaste(keyCode) && this.client != null) {
                String clip = this.client.keyboard.getClipboard();
                if (clip != null) {
                    FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.factorioDataPath = clip.trim().replace("\"", "");
                }
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_BACKSPACE && !FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.factorioDataPath.isEmpty()) {
                String cur = FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.factorioDataPath;
                FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.factorioDataPath = cur.substring(0, cur.length() - 1);
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ENTER || keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) {
                this.editingPathField = false;
                FactorioConfig.save();
                return true;
            }
            return true;
        }

        if (this.listeningKeybind != null) {
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) this.listeningKeybind.setBoundKey(InputUtil.UNKNOWN_KEY);
            else this.listeningKeybind.setBoundKey(InputUtil.fromKeyCode(keyCode, scanCode));
            KeyBinding.updateKeysByCode();
            if (this.client != null) this.client.options.write();
            this.listeningKeybind = null;
            playClick();
            return true;
        }
        return super.keyPressed(keyCode, scanCode, modifiers);
    }

    private void playClick() {
        if (this.client != null && this.client.player != null) {
            this.client.player.playSound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), 0.3f, 1.2f);
        }
    }
}

    private static void drawQueueCell(DrawContext context, TextRenderer tr, int index, int bx, int by, int boxSize) {
        FactorioRecipes.Recipe r = FactorioRecipes.getById(recipeIds.get(index));
        if (r == null) return;

        context.fill(bx, by, bx + boxSize, by + boxSize, 0xF0141414);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + boxSize - 1, by + boxSize - 1, (index == 0) ? 0xF04A3B22 : 0xF02C2D30);

        if (index == 0) {
            float ratio = MathHelper.clamp(currentProgress / (float) currentMax, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            int fillH = Math.round(ratio * (boxSize - 2));
            if (fillH > 0) {
                context.fill(bx + 1, by + boxSize - 1 - fillH, bx + boxSize - 1, by + boxSize - 1, 0xCCDF8B1E);
            }
        }

        context.drawItem(r.output(), bx + 3, by + 3);

        int cnt = (index < counts.size()) ? counts.get(index) : 1;
        String cntStr = String.valueOf(cnt);
        int tw = tr.getWidth(cntStr);
        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(0.0f, 0.0f, 200.0f);
        context.drawText(tr, cntStr, bx + boxSize - tw - 1, by + boxSize - 9, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);
        context.getMatrices().pop();
    }

                    ClientPlayNetworking.send(new RequestCraftPayload(recipeIds.get(i), -1));
                    return true;
                }

            // ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ ÐºÐ½Ð¾Ð¿ÐºÐµ ÑÐ²Ð¾Ñ€Ð°Ñ‡Ð¸Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ñ [<<]

            int btnY = baseY - collapseRow * step;

                expandedInInventory = false;
                return true;

            // ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ Ð»ÑŽÐ±Ð¾Ð¹ ÑÑ‡ÐµÐ¹ÐºÐµ Ð² Ñ€Ð°ÑÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¹ ÑÐµÑ‚ÐºÐµ
            for (int i = 0; i < totalItems; i++) {

                int by = baseY - rowFromBottom * step;

                    ClientPlayNetworking.send(new RequestCraftPayload(recipeIds.get(i), -1));
                    return true;

            }

            return 36 + gridIdx;
        }
        if (gridIdx >= 9 && gridIdx < 36) {
            return gridIdx;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    private int mapEquipIndexToPacketSlot(int equipIdx) {
        if (equipIdx >= 0 && equipIdx < 4) {
            return 5 + equipIdx;
        }
        if (equipIdx == 4) {
            return 45;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    private ItemStack getEquipStack(PlayerInventory inv, int equipIdx) {
        if (equipIdx >= 0 && equipIdx < 4) {
            return inv.armor.get(3 - equipIdx);
        }
        if (equipIdx == 4) {
            return inv.offHand.get(0);
        }
        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        this.renderBackground(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);
        if (this.client == null || this.client.player == null) return;

        PlayerEntity player = this.client.player;
        PlayerInventory inv = player.getInventory();

        int x = (this.width - PANEL_W) / 2;
        int y = (this.height - PANEL_H) / 2;
        int midX = x + PANEL_W / 2;

        // 1. Ð’Ð½ÐµÑˆÐ½Ð¸Ð¹ ÐºÐ¾Ñ€Ð¿ÑƒÑ Ð´Ð²ÑƒÑ…Ð¿Ð°Ð½ÐµÐ»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ Ð¾ÐºÐ½Ð° Factorio
        context.fill(x, y, x + PANEL_W, y + PANEL_H, 0xFF121213);
        context.fill(x + 1, y + 1, x + PANEL_W - 1, y + PANEL_H - 1, 0xFF313235);
        context.fill(midX - 1, y + 1, midX + 1, y + PANEL_H - 1, 0xFF18191A);

        // 2. Ð¨Ð°Ð¿ÐºÐ° ÑÐ»ÐµÐ²Ð°: "ÐŸÐµÑ€ÑÐ¾Ð½Ð°Ð¶ â€” ÐÐ¸Ðº"
        Text leftTitle = Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.character")
                .copy()
                .append(Text.literal(" \u2014 " + player.getName().getString()).styled(s -> s.withColor(0xFFFFCC66)));
        drawFactorioHeader(context, x + 3, y + 3, PANEL_W / 2 - 5, leftTitle, 6);

        // 3. Ð¨Ð°Ð¿ÐºÐ° ÑÐ¿Ñ€Ð°Ð²Ð°: "Ð¡Ð¾Ð·Ð´Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ðµ" + Ð¿Ð¾Ð¸ÑÐº Ð¸ Ð½Ð°ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ð¹ÐºÐ¸
        int rightHeaderX = midX + 2;
        int rightHeaderW = PANEL_W / 2 - 5;
        int rightReserved = this.searchActive ? 96 : 38;
        drawFactorioHeader(context, rightHeaderX, y + 3, rightHeaderW, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.crafting"), rightReserved);

        if (this.searchActive) {
            int boxW = 90;
            int boxH = 12;
            int boxX = x + PANEL_W - boxW - 5;
            int boxY = y + 4;
            context.fill(boxX, boxY, boxX + boxW, boxY + boxH, 0xFF111112);
            context.fill(boxX + 1, boxY + 1, boxX + boxW - 1, boxY + boxH - 1, 0xFF1E1F22);
            context.fill(boxX + 1, boxY + boxH - 2, boxX + boxW - 1, boxY + boxH - 1, 0xFFE59524);

            String cursor = ((System.currentTimeMillis() / 500L) % 2L == 0L) ? "_" : "";
            String shown = this.textRenderer.trimToWidth(this.searchQuery, boxW - 12) + cursor;
            context.drawText(this.textRenderer, shown, boxX + 4, boxY + 2, 0xFFFFEAAA, false);
        } else {
            int searchBtnX = x + PANEL_W - 19;
            int searchBtnY = y + 4;
            drawMagnifierButton(context, searchBtnX, searchBtnY, 14, 12, mouseX, mouseY);
            drawGearSettingsButton(context, searchBtnX - 16, searchBtnY, 14, 12, mouseX, mouseY);
        }

        // 4. Ð›ÐµÐ²Ð°Ñ Ð¿Ð°Ð½ÐµÐ»ÑŒ: Ð¡ÐµÑ‚ÐºÐ° Ð¸Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð°Ñ€Ñ (10x6) + ÑÐºÐ¸Ð¿Ð¸Ñ€Ð¾Ð²ÐºÐ°
        int leftGridX = x + 12;
        int leftGridY = y + 22;

        context.fill(leftGridX - 2, leftGridY - 2,
                leftGridX + COLS * SLOT_SIZE + 2, leftGridY + INV_ROWS * SLOT_SIZE + 2, 0xFF18181A);

        ItemStack hoveredInvStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        for (int r = 0; r < INV_ROWS; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
                int idx = c + r * COLS;
                int sx = leftGridX + c * SLOT_SIZE;
                int sy = leftGridY + r * SLOT_SIZE;
                boolean unlocked = (idx < 36);
                boolean hovered = unlocked && isHoveringSlot(mouseX, mouseY, sx, sy);

                drawFactorioSlot(context, sx, sy, !unlocked, hovered);
                if (unlocked) {
                    ItemStack stack = inv.main.get(idx);
                    if (!stack.isEmpty()) {
                        drawStackInSlot(context, stack, sx + 1, sy + 1);
                        if (hovered) {
                            hoveredInvStack = stack;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int divY = leftGridY + INV_ROWS * SLOT_SIZE + 8;
        context.fill(leftGridX - 2, divY, leftGridX + COLS * SLOT_SIZE + 2, divY + 1, 0xFF202123);
        context.fill(leftGridX - 2, divY + 1, leftGridX + COLS * SLOT_SIZE + 2, divY + 2, 0xFF3E4043);

        int equipY = y + PANEL_H - 28;
        context.fill(leftGridX - 2, equipY - 2, leftGridX + 4 * SLOT_SIZE + 2, equipY + SLOT_SIZE + 2, 0xFF18181A);
        int offhandX = leftGridX + 4 * SLOT_SIZE + 8;
        context.fill(offhandX - 2, equipY - 2, offhandX + SLOT_SIZE + 2, equipY + SLOT_SIZE + 2, 0xFF18181A);

        for (int e = 0; e < 5; e++) {
            int ex = (e < 4) ? (leftGridX + e * SLOT_SIZE) : offhandX;
            boolean hovered = isHoveringSlot(mouseX, mouseY, ex, equipY);
            drawFactorioSlot(context, ex, equipY, false, hovered);

            ItemStack eqStack = getEquipStack(inv, e);
            if (!eqStack.isEmpty()) {
                drawStackInSlot(context, eqStack, ex + 1, equipY + 1);
                if (hovered) {
                    hoveredInvStack = eqStack;
                }
            } else {
                drawEquipmentSilhouette(context, ex + 1, equipY + 1, e);
            }
        }

        // 5. ÐŸÑ€Ð°Ð²Ð°Ñ Ð¿Ð°Ð½ÐµÐ»ÑŒ: 4 Ð²ÐºÐ»Ð°Ð´ÐºÐ¸ ÐºÐ°Ñ‚ÐµÐ³Ð¾Ñ€Ð¸Ð¹ Ð¸ ÑÐµÑ‚ÐºÐ° ÐºÑ€Ð°Ñ„Ñ‚Ð° (10x8)
        int rightGridX = midX + 12;
        int tabBarY = y + 22;
        int tabW = (COLS * SLOT_SIZE + 4) / 4;
        int tabH = 30;

        FactorioRecipes.Category[] cats = FactorioRecipes.Category.values();
        ItemStack[] tabIcons = {
                new ItemStack(ModBlocks.BELT),
                new ItemStack(ModBlocks.STONE_FURNACE),
                new ItemStack(ModItems.ELECTRONIC_CIRCUIT),
                new ItemStack(ModItems.REPAIR_PACK)
        };

        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            int tx = rightGridX - 2 + i * tabW;
            boolean selected = (cats[i] == this.activeCategory);
            boolean hovered = mouseX >= tx && mouseX < tx + tabW && mouseY >= tabBarY && mouseY < tabBarY + tabH;

            int tabBg = selected ? 0xFF6B6D70 : (hovered ? 0xFF4A4C50 : 0xFF383A3D);
            context.fill(tx, tabBarY, tx + tabW - 1, tabBarY + tabH, 0xFF18181A);
            context.fill(tx + 1, tabBarY + 1, tx + tabW - 2, tabBarY + tabH - (selected ? 0 : 1), tabBg);

            context.getMatrices().push();
            context.getMatrices().translate(tx + tabW / 2.0f - 10.5f, tabBarY + 4.5f, 100.0f);
            context.getMatrices().scale(1.3f, 1.3f, 1.0f);
            context.drawItem(tabIcons[i], 0, 0);
            context.getMatrices().pop();
        }

        int rightGridY = y + 56;
        context.fill(rightGridX - 2, rightGridY - 2,
                rightGridX + COLS * SLOT_SIZE + 2, rightGridY + CRAFT_ROWS * SLOT_SIZE + 2, 0xFF18181A);

        for (int r = 0; r < CRAFT_ROWS; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
                int sx = rightGridX + c * SLOT_SIZE;
                int sy = rightGridY + r * SLOT_SIZE;
                context.fill(sx, sy, sx + SLOT_SIZE, sy + SLOT_SIZE, 0xFF1A1B1D);
                context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 1, sx + SLOT_SIZE - 1, sy + SLOT_SIZE - 1, 0xFF242528);
            }
        }

        FactorioRecipes.Recipe hoveredRecipe = null;
        int[] colInRow = new int[CRAFT_ROWS];
        List<FactorioRecipes.Recipe> recipes = FactorioRecipes.getByCategory(this.activeCategory);
        String queryLower = this.searchQuery.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

        for (FactorioRecipes.Recipe recipe : recipes) {
            if (!queryLower.isBlank()) {
                String nameLower = recipe.output().getName().getString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
                if (!nameLower.contains(queryLower)) {
                    continue;
                }
            }

            int r = Math.min(CRAFT_ROWS - 1, recipe.row());
            int c = colInRow[r];
            if (c >= COLS) continue;
            colInRow[r]++;

            int sx = rightGridX + c * SLOT_SIZE;
            int sy = rightGridY + r * SLOT_SIZE;

            int craftable = player.isCreative() ? 99 : FactorioRecipes.getCraftableCount(inv, recipe);
            boolean canCraft = craftable > 0;
            boolean hovered = isHoveringSlot(mouseX, mouseY, sx, sy);
            if (hovered) {
                hoveredRecipe = recipe;
            }

            int borderCol = hovered ? 0xFFE59524 : 0xFF141414;
            int innerCol = hovered ? 0xFF525458 : (canCraft ? 0xFF3A3C3F : 0xFF28292C);
            context.fill(sx, sy, sx + SLOT_SIZE, sy + SLOT_SIZE, borderCol);
            context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 1, sx + SLOT_SIZE - 1, sy + SLOT_SIZE - 1, innerCol);

            context.drawItem(recipe.output(), sx + 1, sy + 1);

            if (craftable > 0) {
                String cntStr = (craftable > 99) ? "99+" : String.valueOf(craftable);
                context.getMatrices().push();
                context.getMatrices().translate(0.0f, 0.0f, 200.0f);
                context.getMatrices().scale(0.65f, 0.65f, 1.0f);
                int tw = this.textRenderer.getWidth(cntStr);
                int tx = (int) ((sx + 17) / 0.65f) - tw;
                int ty = (int) ((sy + 12) / 0.65f);
                context.drawText(this.textRenderer, cntStr, tx, ty, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);
                context.getMatrices().pop();
            }
        }

        // 6. ÐŸÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚ Ð½Ð° ÐºÑƒÑ€ÑÐ¾Ñ€Ðµ
        ItemStack cursorStack = player.playerScreenHandler.getCursorStack();
        if (!cursorStack.isEmpty()) {
            context.getMatrices().push();
            context.getMatrices().translate(0.0f, 0.0f, 350.0f);
            context.drawItem(cursorStack, mouseX - 8, mouseY - 8);
            context.drawItemInSlot(this.textRenderer, cursorStack, mouseX - 8, mouseY - 8);
            context.getMatrices().pop();
        }

        // 7. ÐžÑ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´ÑŒ ÐºÑ€Ð°Ñ„Ñ‚Ð° Ð² Ð»ÐµÐ²Ð¾Ð¼ Ð½Ð¸Ð¶Ð½ÐµÐ¼ ÑƒÐ³Ð»Ñƒ ÑÐºÑ€Ð°Ð½Ð°
        ClientCraftingQueueHud.renderBottomLeftQueue(context, true);

        // 8. Ð¢ÑƒÐ»Ñ‚Ð¸Ð¿Ñ‹ Ñ€ÐµÑ†ÐµÐ¿Ñ‚Ð¾Ð² Ð¸ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚Ð¾Ð²
        if (cursorStack.isEmpty()) {
            if (hoveredRecipe != null) {
                renderCustomFactorioRecipeCard(context, hoveredRecipe, inv, mouseX, mouseY);
            } else if (!hoveredInvStack.isEmpty()) {
                context.drawItemTooltip(this.textRenderer, hoveredInvStack, mouseX, mouseY);
            }
        }
    }

    public void renderCustomFactorioRecipeCard(DrawContext context, FactorioRecipes.Recipe recipe,
                                               PlayerInventory inv, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        renderRecipeCard(context, this.textRenderer, this.width, this.height, recipe, inv, mouseX, mouseY, true);
    }

    /**
     * ÐžÐ±Ñ‰Ð¸Ð¹ ÑÑ‚Ð°Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ‡ÐµÑÐºÐ¸Ð¹ Ñ€ÐµÐ½Ð´ÐµÑ€ ÐºÐ°Ñ€Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ‡ÐºÐ¸ Ñ€ÐµÑ†ÐµÐ¿Ñ‚Ð° Ð² ÑÑ‚Ð¸Ð»Ðµ Factorio (Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ¸ÑÐ¿Ð¾Ð»ÑŒÐ·ÑƒÐµÑ‚ÑÑ Ð² CharacterScreen Ð¸ AssemblerScreen).
     */
    public static void renderRecipeCard(DrawContext context, TextRenderer textRenderer,
                                        int screenWidth, int screenHeight,
                                        FactorioRecipes.Recipe recipe, PlayerInventory inv,
                                        int mouseX, int mouseY, boolean allowSubCraftHighlight) {
        Map<Item, Integer> invCounts = FactorioRecipes.snapshotInventory(inv);
        Map<Item, Integer> totalRaw = FactorioRecipes.calculateTotalRaw(recipe);

        String titleStr = recipe.output().getName().getString()
                + (recipe.output().getCount() > 1 ? " \u00d7" + recipe.output().getCount() : "");

        int cardW = Math.max(156, textRenderer.getWidth(titleStr) + 32);
        for (FactorioRecipes.Ingredient ing : recipe.ingredients()) {
            int have = invCounts.getOrDefault(ing.item(), 0);
            String line = ing.count() + " \u00d7 " + ing.item().getName().getString() + " (" + have + ")";
            cardW = Math.max(cardW, textRenderer.getWidth(line) + 28);
        }

        if (!totalRaw.isEmpty()) {
            int rawW = 16 + textRenderer.getWidth(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.total_raw"));
            for (Map.Entry<Item, Integer> entry : totalRaw.entrySet()) {
                rawW += 20 + textRenderer.getWidth(String.valueOf(entry.getValue()));
            }
            cardW = Math.max(cardW, rawW + 8);
        }

        int ingCount = recipe.ingredients().size();
        int rawSectionH = totalRaw.isEmpty() ? 0 : 28;
        int cardH = 24 + 14 + ingCount * 14 + rawSectionH + 6;

        int tx = mouseX + 12;
        int ty = mouseY - 8;
        if (tx + cardW > screenWidth - 6) {
            tx = mouseX - cardW - 12;
        }
        if (ty + cardH > screenHeight - 6) {
            ty = screenHeight - cardH - 6;
        }
        if (ty < 6) ty = 6;

        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(0.0f, 0.0f, 400.0f);

        context.fill(tx, ty, tx + cardW, ty + cardH, 0xF8111214);
        context.fill(tx + 1, ty + 1, tx + cardW - 1, ty + cardH - 1, 0xF426272A);

        context.fill(tx + 2, ty + 2, tx + cardW - 2, ty + 21, 0xFF3E301B);
        context.fill(tx + 2, ty + 20, tx + cardW - 2, ty + 21, 0xFFE59524);
        context.drawItem(recipe.output(), tx + 4, ty + 3);
        context.drawText(textRenderer, titleStr, tx + 24, ty + 7, 0xFFFFD670, true);

        int curY = ty + 25;

        drawClockIconStatic(context, tx + 6, curY + 1);
        context.drawText(textRenderer,
                Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.craft_time", String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.1f", recipe.getSeconds())),
                tx + 18, curY + 1, 0xFFCCCCCC, false);
        curY += 13;

        for (FactorioRecipes.Ingredient ing : recipe.ingredients()) {
            int have = invCounts.getOrDefault(ing.item(), 0);
            int textColor;
            if (have >= ing.count()) {
                textColor = 0xFF66EE66;
            } else if (allowSubCraftHighlight) {
                FactorioRecipes.Recipe sub = FactorioRecipes.getByOutput(ing.item());
                int canSub = (sub != null) ? FactorioRecipes.getCraftableCount(inv, sub) : 0;
                textColor = (have + canSub >= ing.count()) ? 0xFFFFCC44 : 0xFFFF5555;
            } else {
                textColor = 0xFFFF5555;
            }

            context.getMatrices().push();
            context.getMatrices().translate(tx + 5, curY, 0.0f);
            context.getMatrices().scale(0.75f, 0.75f, 1.0f);
            context.drawItem(new ItemStack(ing.item()), 0, 0);
            context.getMatrices().pop();

            String ingLine = ing.count() + " \u00d7 " + ing.item().getName().getString() + " (" + have + ")";
            context.drawText(textRenderer, ingLine, tx + 20, curY + 2, textColor, false);
            curY += 14;
        }

        if (!totalRaw.isEmpty()) {
            curY += 2;
            context.fill(tx + 4, curY, tx + cardW - 4, curY + 1, 0xFF18191B);
            context.fill(tx + 4, curY + 1, tx + cardW - 4, curY + 2, 0xFF3A3C40);
            curY += 5;

            Text rawLabel = Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.total_raw");
            context.drawText(textRenderer, rawLabel, tx + 6, curY + 4, 0xFF999B9F, false);

            int iconX = tx + 10 + textRenderer.getWidth(rawLabel);
            for (Map.Entry<Item, Integer> entry : totalRaw.entrySet()) {
                context.getMatrices().push();
                context.getMatrices().translate(iconX, curY + 1, 0.0f);
                context.getMatrices().scale(0.8f, 0.8f, 1.0f);
                context.drawItem(new ItemStack(entry.getKey()), 0, 0);
                context.getMatrices().pop();

                String countText = String.valueOf(entry.getValue());
                context.drawText(textRenderer, countText, iconX + 14, curY + 4, 0xFFE6E6E6, true);
                iconX += 18 + textRenderer.getWidth(countText);
            }
        }

        context.getMatrices().pop();
    }

    private static void drawClockIconStatic(DrawContext context, int cx, int cy) {
        context.fill(cx + 1, cy, cx + 7, cy + 8, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(cx, cy + 1, cx + 8, cy + 7, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(cx + 1, cy + 1, cx + 7, cy + 7, 0xFFD8D8D8);
        context.fill(cx + 3, cy + 2, cx + 4, cy + 5, 0xFF232426);
        context.fill(cx + 4, cy + 4, cx + 6, cy + 5, 0xFF232426);
    }

    private void drawGearSettingsButton(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw, int bh, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        boolean hovered = mouseX >= bx && mouseX < bx + bw && mouseY >= by && mouseY < by + bh;
        int bg = hovered ? 0xFFE59524 : 0xFF35373A;
        int col = hovered ? 0xFF141414 : 0xFFE6E6E6;
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + bw, by + bh, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + bw - 1, by + bh - 1, bg);
        context.fill(bx + 4, by + 3, bx + 10, by + 9, col);
        context.fill(bx + 6, by + 2, bx + 8, by + 10, col);
        context.fill(bx + 3, by + 5, bx + 11, by + 7, col);
        context.fill(bx + 6, by + 5, bx + 8, by + 7, bg);
    }

    private void drawMagnifierButton(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw, int bh, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        boolean hovered = mouseX >= bx && mouseX < bx + bw && mouseY >= by && mouseY < by + bh;
        int bg = hovered ? 0xFF4C4E52 : 0xFF35373A;
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + bw, by + bh, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + bw - 1, by + bh - 1, bg);

        int lx = bx + 4;
        int ly = by + 2;
        int col = 0xFFE6E6E6;
        context.fill(lx + 1, ly, lx + 4, ly + 1, col);
        context.fill(lx, ly + 1, lx + 1, ly + 4, col);
        context.fill(lx + 4, ly + 1, lx + 5, ly + 4, col);
        context.fill(lx + 1, ly + 4, lx + 4, ly + 5, col);
        context.fill(lx + 4, ly + 5, lx + 6, ly + 7, col);
    }

    private void drawEquipmentSilhouette(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy, int equipIdx) {
        int c = 0xFF525458;
        switch (equipIdx) {
            case 0 -> {
                context.fill(sx + 4, sy + 3, sx + 12, sy + 6, c);
                context.fill(sx + 3, sy + 6, sx + 13, sy + 12, c);
                context.fill(sx + 5, sy + 8, sx + 11, sy + 12, 0xFF333538);
            }
            case 1 -> {
                context.fill(sx + 3, sy + 3, sx + 13, sy + 7, c);
                context.fill(sx + 6, sy + 3, sx + 10, sy + 5, 0xFF333538);
                context.fill(sx + 4, sy + 7, sx + 12, sy + 13, c);
            }
            case 2 -> {
                context.fill(sx + 4, sy + 3, sx + 12, sy + 6, c);
                context.fill(sx + 4, sy + 6, sx + 7, sy + 13, c);
                context.fill(sx + 9, sy + 6, sx + 12, sy + 13, c);
            }
            case 3 -> {
                context.fill(sx + 4, sy + 6, sx + 7, sy + 12, c);
                context.fill(sx + 3, sy + 10, sx + 7, sy + 13, c);
                context.fill(sx + 9, sy + 6, sx + 12, sy + 12, c);
                context.fill(sx + 9, sy + 10, sx + 13, sy + 13, c);
            }
            default -> {
                context.fill(sx + 4, sy + 3, sx + 12, sy + 10, c);
                context.fill(sx + 5, sy + 10, sx + 11, sy + 12, c);
                context.fill(sx + 6, sy + 12, sx + 10, sy + 14, c);
            }
        }
    }

    private void drawFactorioHeader(DrawContext context, int hx, int hy, int hw, Text title, int rightPadding) {
        context.fill(hx, hy, hx + hw, hy + 14, 0xFF232426);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, title, hx + 6, hy + 3, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);

        int startRibs = hx + 12 + this.textRenderer.getWidth(title);
        int endRibs = hx + hw - rightPadding;
        for (int rx = startRibs; rx < endRibs; rx += 3) {
            context.fill(rx, hy + 3, rx + 1, hy + 11, 0xFF18191B);
        }
    }

    private void drawFactorioSlot(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy, boolean locked, boolean hovered) {
        int border = hovered ? 0xFFE59524 : 0xFF141414;
        int inner = locked ? 0xFF202124 : (hovered ? 0xFF4A4C50 : 0xFF333538);
        context.fill(sx, sy, sx + SLOT_SIZE, sy + SLOT_SIZE, border);
        context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 1, sx + SLOT_SIZE - 1, sy + SLOT_SIZE - 1, inner);
    }

    private void drawStackInSlot(DrawContext context, ItemStack stack, int x, int y) {
        context.drawItem(stack, x, y);
        context.drawItemInSlot(this.textRenderer, stack, x, y);
    }

    private boolean isHoveringSlot(double mx, double my, int sx, int sy) {
        return mx >= sx && mx < sx + SLOT_SIZE && my >= sy && my < sy + SLOT_SIZE;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (this.client == null || this.client.player == null || this.client.interactionManager == null) {
            return false;
        }

        if (ClientCraftingQueueHud.handleMouseClick(mouseX, mouseY, button, this.width, this.height)) {
            return true;
        }

        int syncId = this.client.player.playerScreenHandler.syncId;
        int x = (this.width - PANEL_W) / 2;
        int y = (this.height - PANEL_H) / 2;
        int midX = x + PANEL_W / 2;

        // 1. ÐšÐ½Ð¾Ð¿ÐºÐ¸ Ð¿Ð¾Ð¸ÑÐºÐ° Ð¸ Ð½Ð°ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾ÐµÐº Ð² ÑˆÐ°Ð¿ÐºÐµ
        if (!this.searchActive) {
            int searchBtnX = x + PANEL_W - 19;
            int searchBtnY = y + 4;
            int gearBtnX = searchBtnX - 16;
            if (mouseX >= gearBtnX && mouseX < gearBtnX + 14 && mouseY >= searchBtnY && mouseY < searchBtnY + 12) {
                this.client.setScreen(new FactorioConfigScreen(this));
                return true;
            }
            if (mouseX >= searchBtnX && mouseX < searchBtnX + 14 && mouseY >= searchBtnY && mouseY < searchBtnY + 12) {
                this.searchActive = true;
                return true;
            }
        } else {
            int boxX = x + PANEL_W - 95;
            int boxY = y + 4;
            if (mouseX >= boxX && mouseX <= boxX + 90 && mouseY >= boxY && mouseY <= boxY + 12) {
                if (button == 1) {
                    this.searchQuery = "";
                }
                return true;
            } else if (this.searchQuery.isEmpty()) {
                this.searchActive = false;
            }
        }

    @Override
    public boolean charTyped(char chr, int modifiers) {
        if (this.searchActive && chr >= 32) {
            this.searchQuery += chr;
            return true;
        }
        return super.charTyped(chr, modifiers);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(int keyCode, int scanCode, int modifiers) {
        if (this.searchActive) {
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_BACKSPACE && !this.searchQuery.isEmpty()) {
                this.searchQuery = this.searchQuery.substring(0, this.searchQuery.length() - 1);
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) {
                this.searchActive = false;
                this.searchQuery = "";
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ENTER || keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_KP_ENTER) {
                this.searchActive = false;
                return true;
            }
            return true;
        }
        if (this.client != null && this.client.options.inventoryKey.matchesKey(keyCode, scanCode)) {
            this.close();
            return true;
        }
        return super.keyPressed(keyCode, scanCode, modifiers);
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        if (this.client != null && this.client.player != null && this.client.interactionManager != null) {
            if (!this.client.player.playerScreenHandler.getCursorStack().isEmpty()) {
                int syncId = this.client.player.playerScreenHandler.syncId;
                this.client.interactionManager.clickSlot(syncId, -999, 0, SlotActionType.PICKUP, this.client.player);
            }
        }
        super.close();
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.client.content.electricity;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.electricity.CreativeEnergySourceBlock;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.electricity.ElectricPoleBlock;

    private static final String[] TIMEFRAME_LABELS = {
            "gui.factoriocore.time.5s", "gui.factoriocore.time.1m", "gui.factoriocore.time.10m",
            "gui.factoriocore.time.1h", "gui.factoriocore.time.10h", "gui.factoriocore.time.50h",
            "gui.factoriocore.time.250h", "gui.factoriocore.time.1000h", "gui.factoriocore.time.all"
    };
    private static final float[] TIMEFRAME_MAX_NUM = {
            5.0f, 60.0f, 10.0f, 60.0f, 10.0f, 50.0f, 250.0f, 1000.0f, 100.0f
    };
    private static final int[] TICKS_PER_POINT = {
            1, 12, 120, 720, 7200, 36000, 180000, 720000, 240
    };

    public static final int GRAPH_POINTS = 100;
    private static final int RAW_BUFFER_SIZE = 12000;

    private static final Map<Block, long[]> CONSUMER_RAW_TICKS = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private static final Map<Block, long[]> PRODUCER_RAW_TICKS = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private static int rawWriteCursor = 0;
    private static int totalRecordedTicks = 0;
    private static long lastRecordedWorldTick = -1L;
    private static long lastNetworkScanTick = -100L;
    private static BlockPos lastViewedPolePos = null;
    private static ClientWorld lastTrackedWorld = null;
    private static PowerNetworkManager.NetworkSnapshot cachedSnapshot = null;

    private final BlockPos polePos;
    private int selectedTimeframe = 0;
    private Block filteredConsumerBlock = null;
    private Block filteredProducerBlock = null;
    private boolean searchActive = false;
    private String searchQuery = "";

    public ElectricNetworkInfoScreen(BlockPos polePos) {
        super(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.electric_network.title"));
        this.polePos = polePos;
        lastViewedPolePos = polePos;
        lastNetworkScanTick = -100L;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean shouldPause() {
        return false;
    }

    private static void resetHistory() {
        CONSUMER_RAW_TICKS.clear();
        PRODUCER_RAW_TICKS.clear();
        rawWriteCursor = 0;
        totalRecordedTicks = 0;
        lastRecordedWorldTick = -1L;
        lastNetworkScanTick = -100L;
        lastViewedPolePos = null;
        cachedSnapshot = null;
    }

    public static void tickClientHistory(MinecraftClient client) {
        if (client.world == null) {
            if (lastTrackedWorld != null) {
                lastTrackedWorld = null;
                resetHistory();
            }
            return;
        }
        if (client.world != lastTrackedWorld) {
            lastTrackedWorld = client.world;
            resetHistory();
        }
        if (client.isPaused()) return;

        long wt = client.world.getTime();
        if (wt == lastRecordedWorldTick) return;
        lastRecordedWorldTick = wt;

        boolean screenOpen = client.currentScreen instanceof ElectricNetworkInfoScreen;
        BlockPos target = lastViewedPolePos;
        if (screenOpen) {
            target = ((ElectricNetworkInfoScreen) client.currentScreen).polePos;
            lastViewedPolePos = target;
        } else if (target == null && client.player != null && wt % 40 == 0) {
            target = findNearbyPole(client.world, client.player.getBlockPos());
            if (target != null) lastViewedPolePos = target;
        }
        if (target == null) return;

        int scanInterval = screenOpen ? 5 : 20;
        if (cachedSnapshot == null || Math.abs(wt - lastNetworkScanTick) >= scanInterval) {
            cachedSnapshot = PowerNetworkManager.scanNetwork(client.world, target);
            lastNetworkScanTick = wt;
        }

        PowerNetworkManager.NetworkSnapshot snap = cachedSnapshot;
        if (snap == null) return;

        Set<Block> seenConsumers = new HashSet<>();
        for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat stat : snap.consumers()) {
            seenConsumers.add(stat.block());
            long[] buf = CONSUMER_RAW_TICKS.computeIfAbsent(stat.block(), k -> new long[RAW_BUFFER_SIZE]);
            buf[rawWriteCursor] = stat.watts();
        }
        for (Map.Entry<Block, long[]> e : CONSUMER_RAW_TICKS.entrySet()) {
            if (!seenConsumers.contains(e.getKey())) {
                e.getValue()[rawWriteCursor] = 0L;
            }
        }

        Set<Block> seenProducers = new HashSet<>();
        for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat stat : snap.producers()) {
            seenProducers.add(stat.block());
            long[] buf = PRODUCER_RAW_TICKS.computeIfAbsent(stat.block(), k -> new long[RAW_BUFFER_SIZE]);
            buf[rawWriteCursor] = stat.watts();
        }
        for (Map.Entry<Block, long[]> e : PRODUCER_RAW_TICKS.entrySet()) {
            if (!seenProducers.contains(e.getKey())) {
                e.getValue()[rawWriteCursor] = 0L;
            }
        }

        rawWriteCursor = (rawWriteCursor + 1) % RAW_BUFFER_SIZE;
        totalRecordedTicks++;
    }

    private static BlockPos findNearbyPole(World world, BlockPos center) {
        for (int dx = -12; dx <= 12; dx += 2) {
            for (int dz = -12; dz <= 12; dz += 2) {
                for (int dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy++) {
                    BlockPos p = center.add(dx, dy, dz);
                    Block b = world.getBlockState(p).getBlock();
                    if (b instanceof ElectricPoleBlock || b instanceof CreativeEnergySourceBlock) {
                        return p.toImmutable();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private PowerNetworkManager.NetworkSnapshot getOrScanSnapshot(World world) {
        if (cachedSnapshot == null) {
            cachedSnapshot = PowerNetworkManager.scanNetwork(world, this.polePos);
            lastNetworkScanTick = world.getTime();
        }
        return cachedSnapshot;
    }

    private List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> getFilteredStats(
            List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> stats,
            Map<Block, long[]> rawHistoryMap) {
        List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> displayList = new ArrayList<>();
        String queryLower = this.searchQuery.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat st : stats) {
            if (!queryLower.isBlank()) {
                String name = st.block().getName().getString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
                if (!name.contains(queryLower)) continue;
            }
            long avgWatts = computeTimeframeAverageWatts(rawHistoryMap, st.block(), st.watts());
            displayList.add(new PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat(st.block(), st.count(), avgWatts, st.color()));
        }
        return displayList;
    }

    private long[] buildTimeframeSeries(Map<Block, long[]> rawMap, Block block) {
        long[] result = new long[GRAPH_POINTS];
        long[] raw = rawMap.get(block);
        if (raw == null || totalRecordedTicks <= 0) return result;

        int step = TICKS_PER_POINT[this.selectedTimeframe];
        if (this.selectedTimeframe == 8) {
            step = Math.max(1, Math.min(RAW_BUFFER_SIZE / GRAPH_POINTS, (totalRecordedTicks + GRAPH_POINTS - 1) / GRAPH_POINTS));
        }

        int sampleWindow = Math.min(step, 120);
        for (int i = 0; i < GRAPH_POINTS; i++) {
            int pointsAgo = (GRAPH_POINTS - 1) - i;
            long startTicksAgo = (long) pointsAgo * step;
            if (startTicksAgo >= totalRecordedTicks || startTicksAgo >= RAW_BUFFER_SIZE) {
                result[i] = 0L;
                continue;
            }

            long sum = 0L;
            int count = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < sampleWindow; k++) {
                long tAgo = startTicksAgo + k;
                if (tAgo >= totalRecordedTicks || tAgo >= RAW_BUFFER_SIZE) break;
                int idx = Math.floorMod(rawWriteCursor - 1 - (int) tAgo, RAW_BUFFER_SIZE);
                sum += raw[idx];
                count++;
            }
            result[i] = (count > 0) ? (sum / count) : 0L;
        }
        return result;
    }

    private long computeTimeframeAverageWatts(Map<Block, long[]> rawMap, Block block, long fallbackCurrentWatts) {
        if (this.selectedTimeframe == 0) {
            return fallbackCurrentWatts;
        }
        long[] series = buildTimeframeSeries(rawMap, block);
        long sum = 0L;
        for (long v : series) {
            sum += v;
        }
        return sum / GRAPH_POINTS;
    }
