        int viewTop = y + 18;
        int viewRight = x + backgroundWidth - 10;
        int viewBottom = y + 78;
        context.fill(viewLeft - 1, viewTop - 1, viewRight + 1, viewBottom + 1, 0xFF141414);
        drawCheckerboard(context, viewLeft, viewTop, viewRight, viewBottom, 8);

        context.enableScissor(viewLeft, viewTop, viewRight, viewBottom);
        renderFurnace3DPreview(context, (viewLeft + viewRight) / 2, (viewTop + viewBottom) / 2 + 12);
        context.disableScissor();

        // 3. Ð¡Ñ‚Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÐ° Ð¿Ð»Ð°Ð²ÐºÐ¸: [Ð¡Ð»Ð¾Ñ‚ ÑÑ‹Ñ€ÑŒÑ] -> [Ð—ÐµÐ»Ñ‘Ð½Ð°Ñ ÑˆÐºÐ°Ð»Ð° Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð³Ñ€ÐµÑÑÐ° Ñ %] -> [Ð¡Ð»Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð³Ð¾Ñ‚Ð¾Ð²Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ ÑÐ»Ð¸Ñ‚ÐºÐ°]
        drawSlotFrame(context, x + 10, y + 83);

        int greenBarX = x + 32;
        int greenBarY = y + 83;
        int greenBarW = 170;
        int greenBarH = 18;
        context.fill(greenBarX, greenBarY, greenBarX + greenBarW, greenBarY + greenBarH, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(greenBarX + 1, greenBarY + 1, greenBarX + greenBarW - 1, greenBarY + greenBarH - 1, 0xFF222325);

        int cookTime = handler.getCookTime();
        int maxCookTime = handler.getRequiredCookTime();
        int percent = MathHelper.clamp(Math.round((cookTime / (float) maxCookTime) * 100.0f), 0, 100);
        if (cookTime > 0) {
            int fillW = Math.min(greenBarW - 2, Math.round((cookTime / (float) maxCookTime) * (greenBarW - 2)));
            context.fill(greenBarX + 1, greenBarY + 1, greenBarX + 1 + fillW, greenBarY + greenBarH - 1, 0xFF38B828);
            context.fill(greenBarX + 1, greenBarY + 1, greenBarX + 1 + fillW, greenBarY + 5, 0xFF5CE64C);
        }
        String pctStr = percent + "%";
        int pctW = textRenderer.getWidth(pctStr);
        context.drawText(textRenderer, pctStr, greenBarX + greenBarW - pctW - 5, greenBarY + 5, 0xFFE6E6E6, true);

        drawSlotFrame(context, x + 206, y + 83);

        // 4. Ð¡Ñ‚Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÐ° Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¿Ð»Ð¸Ð²Ð°: [Ð¡Ð»Ð¾Ñ‚ Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¿Ð»Ð¸Ð²Ð°] -> [ÐšÑ€Ð°ÑÐ½Ð°Ñ ÑˆÐºÐ°Ð»Ð° ÑÐ³Ð¾Ñ€Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ñ]
        drawSlotFrame(context, x + 10, y + 107);
        if (handler.furnaceEntity == null || handler.furnaceEntity.getStack(1).isEmpty()) {
            drawFlameSilhouette(context, x + 11, y + 108);

        int redBarY = y + 111;
        int redBarW = 192;
        int redBarH = 10;
        context.fill(redBarX, redBarY, redBarX + redBarW, redBarY + redBarH, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(redBarX + 1, redBarY + 1, redBarX + redBarW - 1, redBarY + redBarH - 1, 0xFF222325);

        int burnTime = handler.getBurnTime();
        int maxBurnTime = handler.getMaxBurnTime();
        if (burnTime > 0) {
            int fillW = Math.min(redBarW - 2, Math.round((burnTime / (float) maxBurnTime) * (redBarW - 2)));
            context.fill(redBarX + 1, redBarY + 1, redBarX + 1 + fillW, redBarY + redBarH - 1, 0xFFC82828);
            context.fill(redBarX + 1, redBarY + 1, redBarX + 1 + fillW, redBarY + 4, 0xFFEA4C3B);
        }

        drawDivider(context, x + 8, y + 131, backgroundWidth - 16);

        // 5. Ð¡Ð»Ð¾Ñ‚Ñ‹ Ð¸Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð°Ñ€Ñ Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÐ°
        int invFrameX = x + 37;
        for (int row = 0; row < 3; row++) {
            for (int col = 0; col < 9; col++) {
                drawSlotFrame(context, invFrameX + col * 18, y + 137 + row * 18);
            }
        }
        for (int col = 0; col < 9; col++) {
            drawSlotFrame(context, invFrameX + col * 18, y + 195);
        }
    }

    private void renderFurnace3DPreview(DrawContext context, int centerX, int centerY) {
        MatrixStack matrices = context.getMatrices();
        int tier = handler.furnaceEntity != null ? handler.furnaceEntity.getTier() : 1;
        boolean burning = handler.furnaceEntity != null && handler.furnaceEntity.isBurning();

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(centerX, centerY, 150.0f);
        matrices.scale(this.previewZoom, -this.previewZoom, this.previewZoom);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(this.previewPitch));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(this.previewYaw));

        matrices.translate(0.0f, -1.1f, -1.0f);
        FactorioFurnaceRenderer.renderFurnaceModel(
                tier,
                burning,
                matrices,
                context.getVertexConsumers(),
                LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE,
                OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV
        );

        matrices.pop();
        context.draw();
    }

    private void drawCheckerboard(DrawContext context, int left, int top, int right, int bottom, int cellSize) {
        for (int py = top; py < bottom; py += cellSize) {
            for (int px = left; px < right; px += cellSize) {
                int gx = (px - left) / cellSize;
                int gy = (py - top) / cellSize;
                int color = ((gx + gy) % 2 == 0) ? 0xFF262729 : 0xFF2E3032;
                context.fill(px, py, Math.min(px + cellSize, right), Math.min(py + cellSize, bottom), color);
            }
        }
    }

    private void drawSlotFrame(DrawContext context, int slotX, int slotY) {
        context.fill(slotX, slotY, slotX + 18, slotY + 18, 0xFF18181A);
        context.fill(slotX + 1, slotY + 1, slotX + 17, slotY + 17, 0xFF3A3C3E);
    }

    private void drawFlameSilhouette(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy) {
        int c = 0xFF626466;
        context.fill(sx + 7, sy + 3, sx + 9, sy + 6, c);
        context.fill(sx + 5, sy + 6, sx + 11, sy + 10, c);
        context.fill(sx + 4, sy + 9, sx + 12, sy + 13, c);
        context.fill(sx + 6, sy + 13, sx + 10, sy + 14, c);
    }

    private void drawDivider(DrawContext context, int x, int y, int width) {
        context.fill(x, y, x + width, y + 1, 0xFF202122);
        context.fill(x, y + 1, x + width, y + 2, 0xFF3E4042);
    }

    private boolean isInsideViewport(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        return mouseX >= x + 10 && mouseX <= x + backgroundWidth - 10 && mouseY >= y + 18 && mouseY <= y + 78;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        if (isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.previewZoom = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewZoom + (float) verticalAmount * 1.8f, 7.0f, 32.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mouseX, mouseY, horizontalAmount, verticalAmount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if ((button == 0 || button == 1) && isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.draggingPreview = true;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (this.draggingPreview && (button == 0 || button == 1)) {
            this.draggingPreview = false;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.draggingPreview) {
            this.previewYaw += (float) deltaX * 1.5f;
            this.previewPitch = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewPitch + (float) deltaY * 1.5f, -80.0f, 80.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        super.render(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);
        drawMouseoverTooltip(context, mouseX, mouseY);
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.client.content.research;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.research.LabBlock;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.research.LabBlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.block.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient;
import net.minecraft.client.render.LightmapTextureManager;
import net.minecraft.client.render.VertexConsumerProvider;
import net.minecraft.client.render.block.BlockRenderManager;
import net.minecraft.client.render.block.entity.BlockEntityRenderer;
import net.minecraft.client.render.block.entity.BlockEntityRendererFactory;
import net.minecraft.client.util.math.MatrixStack;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Direction;
import net.minecraft.util.math.RotationAxis;

public class LabRenderer implements BlockEntityRenderer<LabBlockEntity> {

    public LabRenderer(BlockEntityRendererFactory.Context ctx) {}

    @Override
    public int getRenderDistance() {
        return 48;
    }

    @Override
    public void render(LabBlockEntity entity, float tickDelta, MatrixStack matrices,
                       VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers, int light, int overlay) {
        BlockState state = entity.getCachedState();
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof LabBlock)) return;
        if (state.get(LabBlock.PART) != 4 || state.get(LabBlock.UPPER)) return;

        Direction facing = state.contains(LabBlock.FACING) ? state.get(LabBlock.FACING) : Direction.NORTH;
        float angle = (entity.isWorking() && entity.getWorld() != null)
                ? (entity.getWorld().getTime() + tickDelta) * 8.0f : 0.0f;

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(0.5, 0.0, 0.5);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(-facing.asRotation()));
        matrices.translate(-0.5, 0.0, -0.5);

        renderLabModel(matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, angle, entity.isWorking());

        matrices.pop();
    }

    public static void renderLabModel(MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers,
                                      int light, int overlay, float workingAngle, boolean working) {
        BlockRenderManager brm = MinecraftClient.getInstance().getBlockRenderManager();
        BlockState baseFrame = Blocks.POLISHED_DEEPSLATE.getDefaultState();
        BlockState whiteHull = Blocks.IRON_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
        BlockState darkRibs = Blocks.NETHERITE_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
        BlockState glassDome = Blocks.CYAN_STAINED_GLASS.getDefaultState();
        BlockState coreBlock = working ? Blocks.SEA_LANTERN.getDefaultState() : Blocks.PRISMARINE_BRICKS.getDefaultState();
        int coreLight = working ? LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE : light;

        // 1. Ð¢ÑÐ¶Ñ‘Ð»Ð¾Ðµ Ð¾ÑÐ½Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ðµ 3x3 (X: -0.95..1.95, Z: -0.95..1.95)
        drawBox(brm, baseFrame, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.95f, 0.0f, -0.95f, 2.90f, 0.35f, 2.90f);

        // 2. Ð‘ÐµÐ»Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð½Ð°ÑƒÑ‡Ð½Ð¾-Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼Ñ‹ÑˆÐ»ÐµÐ½Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÐºÐ¾Ñ€Ð¿ÑƒÑ Ð¸ ÑƒÐ³Ð»Ð¾Ð²Ñ‹Ðµ Ð´ÑƒÐ³Ð¸ ÐºÑƒÐ¿Ð¾Ð»Ð°
        drawBox(brm, whiteHull, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.80f, 0.35f, -0.80f, 2.60f, 0.65f, 2.60f);
        drawBox(brm, darkRibs,  matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.86f, 0.35f, -0.86f, 0.38f, 1.35f, 0.38f);
        drawBox(brm, darkRibs,  matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay,  1.48f, 0.35f, -0.86f, 0.38f, 1.35f, 0.38f);
        drawBox(brm, darkRibs,  matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.86f, 0.35f,  1.48f, 0.38f, 1.35f, 0.38f);
        drawBox(brm, darkRibs,  matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay,  1.48f, 0.35f,  1.48f, 0.38f, 1.35f, 0.38f);

        // 3. Ð’Ñ€Ð°Ñ‰Ð°ÑŽÑ‰ÐµÐµÑÑ ÑÐ½ÐµÑ€Ð³ÐµÑ‚Ð¸Ñ‡ÐµÑÐºÐ¾Ðµ ÑÐ´Ñ€Ð¾ Ð²Ð½ÑƒÑ‚Ñ€Ð¸ ÐºÑƒÐ¿Ð¾Ð»Ð°
        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(0.5, 1.05, 0.5);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(workingAngle));
        drawBox(brm, coreBlock, matrices, vertexConsumers, coreLight, overlay, -0.45f, 0.0f, -0.45f, 0.90f, 0.70f, 0.90f);
        drawBox(brm, darkRibs,  matrices, vertexConsumers, coreLight, overlay, -0.60f, 0.25f, -0.12f, 1.20f, 0.20f, 0.24f);
        drawBox(brm, darkRibs,  matrices, vertexConsumers, coreLight, overlay, -0.12f, 0.25f, -0.60f, 0.24f, 0.20f, 1.20f);
        matrices.pop();

        // 4. Ð¡Ñ‚ÐµÐºÐ»ÑÐ½Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð³ÐµÐ¾Ð´ÐµÐ·Ð¸Ñ‡ÐµÑÐºÐ¸Ð¹ ÐºÑƒÐ¿Ð¾Ð» Ð›Ð°Ð±Ð¾Ñ€Ð°Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ð¸Ð¸ (Ð´Ð¾ Ð²Ñ‹ÑÐ¾Ñ‚Ñ‹ 2.15 Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ°)
        drawBox(brm, glassDome, matrices, vertexConsumers, coreLight, overlay, -0.62f, 1.00f, -0.62f, 2.24f, 0.85f, 2.24f);
        drawBox(brm, glassDome, matrices, vertexConsumers, coreLight, overlay, -0.35f, 1.85f, -0.35f, 1.70f, 0.30f, 1.70f);
    }

    private static void drawBox(BlockRenderManager brm, BlockState state, MatrixStack matrices,
                                VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers, int light, int overlay,
                                float x, float y, float z, float sx, float sy, float sz) {
        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(x, y, z);
        matrices.scale(sx, sy, sz);
        brm.renderBlockAsEntity(state, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay);
        matrices.pop();
    }
}

    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        if (isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.previewZoom = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewZoom + (float) verticalAmount * 2.0f, 8.0f, 40.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mouseX, mouseY, horizontalAmount, verticalAmount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if ((button == 0 || button == 1) && isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.draggingPreview = true;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (this.draggingPreview && (button == 0 || button == 1)) {
            this.draggingPreview = false;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.draggingPreview) {
            this.previewYaw += (float) deltaX * 1.5f;
            this.previewPitch = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewPitch + (float) deltaY * 1.5f, -80.0f, 80.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        super.render(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);
        drawMouseoverTooltip(context, mouseX, mouseY);
    }
}

    private List<TechNode> getSortedFilteredList() {
        List<TechNode> list = new ArrayList<>();
        String queryLower = this.searchQuery.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        for (TechNode t : ResearchManager.TECHS) {
            if (!queryLower.isBlank() && !t.name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains(queryLower)) {
                continue;
            }
            list.add(t);

        list.sort(Comparator.comparingInt(t -> switch (t.status) {
            case AVAILABLE -> 0;
            case LOCKED -> 1;
            case RESEARCHED -> 2;
        }));
        return list;

    private void drawMiniTechTile(DrawContext context, TechNode tech, int tx, int ty, int tw, int th,

        float iconScale = (tw >= 40) ? 1.35f : 1.0f;

        context.getMatrices().translate(tx + (tw - iconPx) / 2.0f, ty + (bodyH - iconPx) / 2.0f, 100.0f);

    private TechNode renderRightTechGraph(DrawContext context, int canvasX, int canvasY, int canvasW, int canvasH, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        TechNode hovered = null;
        int centerX = canvasX + canvasW / 2 + (int) this.canvasOffsetX;
        int centerY = canvasY + canvasH / 2 + (int) this.canvasOffsetY;

        if (this.showFocusedBranchOnly && this.selectedTech != null) {
            TechNode focus = this.selectedTech;
            List<TechNode> parents = new ArrayList<>();
            for (String pid : focus.prerequisites) {
                TechNode p = ResearchManager.getById(pid);
                if (p != null) parents.add(p);
            }
            List<TechNode> children = new ArrayList<>();
            for (TechNode t : ResearchManager.TECHS) {
                if (t.prerequisites.contains(focus.id)) children.add(t);
            }

            int focusW = Math.round(58 * zoom);
            int focusH = Math.round(74 * zoom);
            int smallW = Math.round(38 * zoom);
            int smallH = Math.round(48 * zoom);
            int gapX = Math.round(50 * zoom);
            int rowGapY = Math.round(82 * zoom);

            int fx = centerX - focusW / 2;
            int fy = centerY - focusH / 2;

            for (int i = 0; i < parents.size(); i++) {
                TechNode p = parents.get(i);
                int px = centerX + (int) ((i - (parents.size() - 1) / 2.0f) * gapX) - smallW / 2;
                int py = fy - rowGapY - smallH / 2;
                drawOrthogonalLink(context, px + smallW / 2, py + smallH, fx + focusW / 2, fy, true);
                drawMiniTechTile(context, p, px, py, smallW, smallH, false, mouseX, mouseY);
                if (mouseX >= px && mouseX < px + smallW && mouseY >= py && mouseY < py + smallH) hovered = p;
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < children.size(); i++) {
                TechNode ch = children.get(i);
                int cx = centerX + (int) ((i - (children.size() - 1) / 2.0f) * gapX) - smallW / 2;
                int cy = fy + focusH + Math.round(34 * zoom);

                if (mouseX >= cx && mouseX < cx + smallW && mouseY >= cy && mouseY < cy + smallH) hovered = ch;
            }

            drawMiniTechTile(context, focus, fx, fy, focusW, focusH, true, mouseX, mouseY);
            if (mouseX >= fx && mouseX < fx + focusW && mouseY >= fy && mouseY < fy + focusH) hovered = focus;

                        drawOrthogonalLink(context, px, py, tx + nodeW / 2, ty, pre.status == TechStatus.RESEARCHED);
                    }
                }

                drawMiniTechTile(context, t, tx, ty, w, h, isSel, mouseX, mouseY);
                if (mouseX >= tx && mouseX < tx + w && mouseY >= ty && mouseY < ty + h) hovered = t;
            }
        }
        return hovered;
    }

    private void drawOrthogonalLink(DrawContext context, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2, boolean activeLine) {
        int col = activeLine ? 0xFFB8BABC : 0xFF686A6E;
        int midY = (y1 + y2) / 2;
        context.fill(x1 - 1, Math.min(y1, midY), x1 + 1, Math.max(y1, midY) + 1, col);
        context.fill(Math.min(x1, x2), midY - 1, Math.max(x1, x2) + 1, midY + 1, col);
        context.fill(x2 - 1, Math.min(midY, y2), x2 + 1, Math.max(midY, y2) + 1, col);
        context.fill(x2 - 2, y2 - 2, x2 + 2, y2, 0xFFFFCC44);
    }

    private void renderFactorioTechTooltip(DrawContext context, TechNode tech, int mouseX, int mouseY) {

    private TechNode getHoveredGridTech(int x, int y, int w, int h, double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        int listY = y + 38 + 3 + 98 + 3;
        int listH = (y + h) - listY;
        int gridStartX = x + 5;
        int gridStartY = listY + 18;
        if (mouseX < gridStartX || mouseX > x + w - 2 || mouseY < gridStartY || mouseY > listY + listH - 2) return null;
        List<TechNode> gridTechs = getSortedFilteredList();
        int cols = 6, tileW = 33, tileH = 42, gap = 2;

        for (int i = 0; i < gridTechs.size(); i++) {
            int col = i % cols;
            int row = (i / cols) - this.gridScrollRow;
            int tx = gridStartX + col * (tileW + gap);
            int ty = gridStartY + row * (tileH + gap);
            if (mouseX >= tx && mouseX < tx + tileW && mouseY >= ty && mouseY < ty + tileH) return gridTechs.get(i);
        }
        return null;
    }

    private TechNode findClickedGraphNode(int canvasX, int canvasY, int canvasW, int canvasH, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        int centerX = canvasX + canvasW / 2 + (int) this.canvasOffsetX;
        int centerY = canvasY + canvasH / 2 + (int) this.canvasOffsetY;

        if (this.showFocusedBranchOnly && this.selectedTech != null) {
            TechNode focus = this.selectedTech;
            int smallW = Math.round(38 * zoom), smallH = Math.round(48 * zoom);
            int focusW = Math.round(58 * zoom), focusH = Math.round(74 * zoom);
            int gapX = Math.round(50 * zoom), rowGapY = Math.round(82 * zoom);
            int fx = centerX - focusW / 2, fy = centerY - focusH / 2;

            if (mouseX >= fx && mouseX < fx + focusW && mouseY >= fy && mouseY < fy + focusH) {
                return focus;
            }

            List<TechNode> parents = new ArrayList<>();
            for (String pid : focus.prerequisites) {
                TechNode p = ResearchManager.getById(pid);
                if (p != null) parents.add(p);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < parents.size(); i++) {
                TechNode p = parents.get(i);
                int px = centerX + (int) ((i - (parents.size() - 1) / 2.0f) * gapX) - smallW / 2;
                int py = fy - rowGapY - smallH / 2;
                if (mouseX >= px && mouseX < px + smallW && mouseY >= py && mouseY < py + smallH) return p;
            }

            List<TechNode> children = new ArrayList<>();
            for (TechNode t : ResearchManager.TECHS) {
                if (t.prerequisites.contains(focus.id)) children.add(t);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < children.size(); i++) {
                TechNode ch = children.get(i);
                int cx = centerX + (int) ((i - (children.size() - 1) / 2.0f) * gapX) - smallW / 2;
                int cy = fy + focusH + Math.round(34 * zoom);
                if (mouseX >= cx && mouseX < cx + smallW && mouseY >= cy && mouseY < cy + smallH) return ch;
            }
            return null;
        } else {
            int stepX = Math.round(54 * zoom), stepY = Math.round(82 * zoom);
            int nodeW = Math.round(38 * zoom), nodeH = Math.round(48 * zoom);
            for (TechNode t : ResearchManager.TECHS) {
                boolean isSel = (t == this.selectedTech);
                int w = isSel ? Math.round(46 * zoom) : nodeW;
                int h = isSel ? Math.round(58 * zoom) : nodeH;
                int tx = centerX + t.treeCol * stepX - w / 2;
                int ty = centerY + (t.treeRow - 2) * stepY - h / 2;
                if (mouseX >= tx && mouseX < tx + w && mouseY >= ty && mouseY < ty + h) return t;
            }
            return null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        this.isDraggingCanvas = false;
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.isDraggingCanvas) {
            this.canvasOffsetX += deltaX;
            this.canvasOffsetY += deltaY;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        if (mouseX < 220) {
            int maxRows = Math.max(0, (getSortedFilteredList().size() + 5) / 6 - 3);
            this.gridScrollRow = MathHelper.clamp(this.gridScrollRow - (int) Math.signum(verticalAmount), 0, maxRows);
            return true;
        } else {
            this.zoom = MathHelper.clamp(this.zoom + (float) verticalAmount * 0.1f, 0.65f, 1.65f);
            return true;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean charTyped(char chr, int modifiers) {
        if (this.searchActive && chr >= 32) {
            this.searchQuery += chr;
            this.gridScrollRow = 0;
            return true;
        }
        return super.charTyped(chr, modifiers);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(int keyCode, int scanCode, int modifiers) {
        if (this.searchActive) {
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_BACKSPACE && !this.searchQuery.isEmpty()) {
                this.searchQuery = this.searchQuery.substring(0, this.searchQuery.length() - 1);
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) {
                this.searchActive = false;
                this.searchQuery = "";
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ENTER || keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_KP_ENTER) {
                this.searchActive = false;
                return true;
            }
            return true;
        }
        if (this.client != null && this.client.options.inventoryKey.matchesKey(keyCode, scanCode)) {
            this.close();
            return true;
        }
        return super.keyPressed(keyCode, scanCode, modifiers);
    }

    private void drawFactorioHeader(DrawContext context, int hx, int hy, int hw, String title, int rightPadding) {
        context.fill(hx, hy, hx + hw, hy + 14, 0xFF232426);
        drawScaledText(context, title, hx + 5, hy + 4, 0.82f, 0xFFFFDCA0, true);
        int titleW = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(title) * 0.82f);
        for (int rx = hx + 10 + titleW; rx < hx + hw - rightPadding; rx += 3) {
            context.fill(rx, hy + 3, rx + 1, hy + 11, 0xFF17181A);
        }
    }

    private void drawFactorioCheckbox(DrawContext context, int cx, int cy, boolean checked) {
        context.fill(cx, cy, cx + 9, cy + 9, 0xFF111111);
        context.fill(cx + 1, cy + 1, cx + 8, cy + 8, checked ? 0xFFE59524 : 0xFF3E4044);
        if (checked) {
            context.fill(cx + 2, cy + 4, cx + 4, cy + 6, 0xFF141414);
            context.fill(cx + 4, cy + 2, cx + 7, cy + 5, 0xFF141414);
        }
    }

    private void drawIconButton(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw, int bh, String sym, int mouseX, int mouseY, boolean active) {
        boolean hov = mouseX >= bx && mouseX < bx + bw && mouseY >= by && mouseY < by + bh;
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + bw, by + bh, 0xFF111111);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + bw - 1, by + bh - 1, active ? 0xFFE59524 : (hov ? 0xFF4C4E52 : 0xFF35373A));
        drawScaledTextCentered(context, sym, bx + bw / 2, by + 3, 0.75f, active ? 0xFF111111 : 0xFFE6E6E6, false);
    }

    private void drawClockIcon(DrawContext context, int cx, int cy) {
        context.fill(cx + 1, cy, cx + 7, cy + 8, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(cx, cy + 1, cx + 8, cy + 7, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(cx + 1, cy + 1, cx + 7, cy + 7, 0xFFD8D8D8);
        context.fill(cx + 3, cy + 2, cx + 4, cy + 5, 0xFF232426);
        context.fill(cx + 4, cy + 4, cx + 6, cy + 5, 0xFF232426);
    }

    private void drawScaledText(DrawContext context, String text, int x, int y, float scale, int color, boolean shadow) {
        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(x, y, 200.0f);
        context.getMatrices().scale(scale, scale, 1.0f);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, text, 0, 0, color, shadow);
        context.getMatrices().pop();
    }

    private void drawScaledTextCentered(DrawContext context, String text, int centerX, int y, float scale, int color, boolean shadow) {
        int w = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(text) * scale);
        drawScaledText(context, text, centerX - w / 2, y, scale, color, shadow);
    }

    private void playClick() {
        if (this.client != null && this.client.player != null) {
            this.client.player.playSound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), 0.35f, 1.15f);
        }
    }
}

                "key.factoriocore.alt_mode",

    private static boolean isHoldingFluidBlock(MinecraftClient client) {
        if (client.player == null) return false;
        ItemStack main = client.player.getMainHandStack();
        ItemStack off = client.player.getOffHandStack();
        return isFluidItem(main) || isFluidItem(off);
    }

    private static boolean isFluidItem(ItemStack stack) {
        if (!(stack.getItem() instanceof BlockItem bi)) return false;
        return PipeBlock.canConnectFluid(bi.getBlock().getDefaultState());
    }

    /**
     * Ð Ð¸ÑÑƒÐµÑ‚ Ñ„Ð¸Ñ€Ð¼ÐµÐ½Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð³Ð¾Ð»ÑƒÐ±Ð¾Ð¹ Ñ‚Ñ€ÐµÑƒÐ³Ð¾Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‚Ð° Ð¶Ð¸Ð´ÐºÐ¾ÑÑ‚Ð¸ (ÐºÐ°Ðº Ð½Ð° ÑÐºÑ€Ð¸Ð½ÑˆÐ¾Ñ‚Ðµ 205524.jpg) Ð½Ð° ÐºÑ€Ð¾Ð¼ÐºÐµ Ñ‚Ð°Ð¹Ð»Ð° Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‚Ð°!
     */
    private static void drawFactorioFluidPortChevron(MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumer lines, Vec3d cam,
                                                     BlockPos portTilePos, Direction flowDir, boolean isInput) {
        // Ð“Ð¾Ð»ÑƒÐ±Ð¾Ð¹ Ñ†Ð²ÐµÑ‚ Ð¶Ð¸Ð´ÐºÐ¾ÑÑ‚Ð½Ñ‹Ñ… ÑÑ‚Ñ€ÐµÐ»Ð¾Ðº Factorio (#29B6F6)
        float r = 0.16f;
        float g = 0.72f;
        float b = 0.98f;

        Direction edgeSide = isInput ? flowDir.getOpposite() : flowDir;
        double cx = portTilePos.getX() + 0.5 + edgeSide.getOffsetX() * 0.42 - cam.x;
        double y = portTilePos.getY() + 0.48 - cam.y;
        double cz = portTilePos.getZ() + 0.5 + edgeSide.getOffsetZ() * 0.42 - cam.z;

        double fx = flowDir.getOffsetX();
        double fz = flowDir.getOffsetZ();
        double px = -fz;
        double pz = fx;

        // Ð—Ð°Ð¿Ð¾Ð»Ð½ÐµÐ½Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÐºÐ¾Ð½Ñ†ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ñ€Ð¸Ñ‡ÐµÑÐºÐ¸Ð¼Ð¸ Ñ€Ñ‘Ð±Ñ€Ð°Ð¼Ð¸ ÑˆÐ¸Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÐ¸Ð¹ Ð³Ð¾Ð»ÑƒÐ±Ð¾Ð¹ Ñ‚Ñ€ÐµÑƒÐ³Ð¾Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ð¸Ðº
        for (int layer = 0; layer < 3; layer++) {
            double scale = 1.0 - layer * 0.25;
            double halfW = 0.28 * scale;
            double len = 0.26 * scale;

            double baseCenterX = cx - fx * (len * 0.45);
            double baseCenterZ = cz - fz * (len * 0.45);
            double tipX = cx + fx * (len * 0.55);
            double tipZ = cz + fz * (len * 0.55);

            double leftX = baseCenterX - px * halfW;
            double leftZ = baseCenterZ - pz * halfW;
            double rightX = baseCenterX + px * halfW;
            double rightZ = baseCenterZ + pz * halfW;

            drawLine(matrices, lines, leftX, y, leftZ, rightX, y, rightZ, r, g, b, 0.98f);
            drawLine(matrices, lines, leftX, y, leftZ, tipX, y, tipZ, r, g, b, 0.98f);
            drawLine(matrices, lines, rightX, y, rightZ, tipX, y, tipZ, r, g, b, 0.98f);
        }
    }

    private static ItemStack findOreUnderElectricDrill(World world, BlockPos centerPos) {
        for (int dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -2; dz <= 2; dz++) {
                Block b = world.getBlockState(centerPos.add(dx, -1, dz)).getBlock();
                if (b instanceof ResourceOreBlock) {
                    return new ItemStack(b.asItem());
                }
            }
        }
        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
    }

    private static void drawInserterOverlay(MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumer lines, Vec3d cam,
                                            BlockPos pos, Direction facing, int reach) {
        int col = FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.altArrowColor;
        float r = FactorioConfig.getRed(col);
        float g = FactorioConfig.getGreen(col);
        float b = FactorioConfig.getBlue(col);

        double y = pos.getY() + 0.22 - cam.y;
        double cx = pos.getX() + 0.5 - cam.x;
        double cz = pos.getZ() + 0.5 - cam.z;

        double fx = facing.getOffsetX();
        double fz = facing.getOffsetZ();
        double px = -fz;
        double pz = fx;

        double backX = cx - fx * (reach - 0.15);
        double backZ = cz - fz * (reach - 0.15);
        drawLine(matrices, lines, backX - px * 0.25, y, backZ - pz * 0.25, backX + px * 0.25, y, backZ + pz * 0.25, r, g, b, 0.95f);

        double frontX = cx + fx * (reach - 0.10);
        double frontZ = cz + fz * (reach - 0.10);
        drawLine(matrices, lines, backX, y, backZ, frontX, y, frontZ, r, g, b, 0.90f);
        drawLine(matrices, lines, frontX, y, frontZ, frontX - fx * 0.22 + px * 0.18, y, frontZ - fz * 0.22 + pz * 0.18, r, g, b, 0.95f);
        drawLine(matrices, lines, frontX, y, frontZ, frontX - fx * 0.22 - px * 0.18, y, frontZ - fz * 0.22 - pz * 0.18, r, g, b, 0.95f);
    }

    private static void drawYellowOutputArrow(MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumer lines, Vec3d cam,
                                              BlockPos outPos, Direction facing) {
        int col = FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.altArrowColor;
        float r = FactorioConfig.getRed(col);
        float g = FactorioConfig.getGreen(col);
        float b = FactorioConfig.getBlue(col);

        double cx = outPos.getX() + 0.5 - cam.x;
        double y = outPos.getY() + 0.25 - cam.y;
        double cz = outPos.getZ() + 0.5 - cam.z;

        double fx = facing.getOffsetX();
        double fz = facing.getOffsetZ();
        double px = -fz;
        double pz = fx;

        double tailX = cx - fx * 0.30;
        double tailZ = cz - fz * 0.30;
        double tipX = cx + fx * 0.25;
        double tipZ = cz + fz * 0.25;

        drawLine(matrices, lines, tailX, y, tailZ, tipX, y, tipZ, r, g, b, 0.95f);
        drawLine(matrices, lines, tipX, y, tipZ, tipX - fx * 0.24 + px * 0.20, y, tipZ - fz * 0.24 + pz * 0.20, r, g, b, 0.95f);
        drawLine(matrices, lines, tipX, y, tipZ, tipX - fx * 0.24 - px * 0.20, y, tipZ - fz * 0.24 - pz * 0.20, r, g, b, 0.95f);
    }

    private static void drawLine(MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumer lines,
                                 double x1, double y1, double z1,
                                 double x2, double y2, double z2,
                                 float r, float g, float b, float a) {
        MatrixStack.Entry entry = matrices.peek();
        float dx = (float) (x2 - x1);
        float dy = (float) (y2 - y1);
        float dz = (float) (z2 - z1);
        float len = (float) Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
        if (len > 1.0e-4f) {
            dx /= len;
            dy /= len;
            dz /= len;
        } else {
            dx = 0.0f;
            dy = 1.0f;
            dz = 0.0f;
        }
        lines.vertex(entry, (float) x1, (float) y1, (float) z1).color(r, g, b, a).normal(entry, dx, dy, dz);
        lines.vertex(entry, (float) x2, (float) y2, (float) z2).color(r, g, b, a).normal(entry, dx, dy, dz);
    }

    private static void renderFactorioAltBadge(MinecraftClient client, WorldRenderContext context,
                                               MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumerProvider consumers,
                                               Vec3d cam, double wx, double wy, double wz,
                                               double pullTowardsCam, ItemStack icon, float scale) {
        if (icon.isEmpty()) return;

        Vec3d toCam = cam.subtract(wx, wy, wz);
        double dist = toCam.length();
        if (dist > 1.0e-3) {
            double shift = Math.min(pullTowardsCam, dist * 0.65);
            Vec3d dir = toCam.normalize().multiply(shift);
            wx += dir.x;
            wy += dir.y;
            wz += dir.z;
        }

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(wx - cam.x, wy - cam.y, wz - cam.z);
        matrices.multiply(context.camera().getRotation());
        matrices.scale(scale, scale, 0.02f);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(180.0f));

        client.getItemRenderer().renderItem(
                icon,
                ModelTransformationMode.GUI,
                LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE,
                OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV,
                matrices,
                consumers,
                client.world,
                0
        );

        matrices.pop();
    }
}

    public static void register() {
        toggleMapKey = KeyBindingHelper.registerKeyBinding(new KeyBinding("key.factoriocore.toggle_minimap", InputUtil.Type.KEYSYM, GLFW.GLFW_KEY_M, "category.factoriocore"));
        zoomInKey = KeyBindingHelper.registerKeyBinding(new KeyBinding("key.factoriocore.minimap_zoom_in", InputUtil.Type.KEYSYM, GLFW.GLFW_KEY_EQUAL, "category.factoriocore"));
        zoomOutKey = KeyBindingHelper.registerKeyBinding(new KeyBinding("key.factoriocore.minimap_zoom_out", InputUtil.Type.KEYSYM, GLFW.GLFW_KEY_MINUS, "category.factoriocore"));

        ClientTickEvents.END_CLIENT_TICK.register(client -> {
            while (toggleMapKey.wasPressed()) minimapVisible = !minimapVisible;
            while (zoomInKey.wasPressed()) if (blocksPerCell > 1) blocksPerCell /= 2;
            while (zoomOutKey.wasPressed()) if (blocksPerCell < 4) blocksPerCell *= 2;

            if (client.world != null && client.player != null && !client.isPaused()) {
                if (minimapVisible && FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.enableMinimap) {
                    updateMapSlice(client.world, client.player, nextSliceRow, nextSliceRow + 11);
                    nextSliceRow = (nextSliceRow + 11) % MAP_CELLS;
                    if ((client.world.getTime() & 7L) == 0L) updateRadarEntities(client.world, client.player);
                }
                tickMiningProgressBar(client);
            }
        });

        HudRenderCallback.EVENT.register(FactorioHudOverlay::renderHud);
    }

    private static void tickMiningProgressBar(MinecraftClient client) {
        if (client.player == null || client.world == null || client.player.isCreative() || client.interactionManager == null) {
            prevMiningProgress = 0.0f;
            miningBarProgress = 0.0f;
            lastMiningPos = null;
            return;
        }

        if (client.options.attackKey.isPressed() && client.interactionManager.isBreakingBlock()
                && client.crosshairTarget instanceof BlockHitResult hit && hit.getType() == HitResult.Type.BLOCK) {
            BlockPos pos = hit.getBlockPos();
            BlockState state = client.world.getBlockState(pos);
            Block block = state.getBlock();

            if (BlockHealthManager.getMaxHealth(block) > 0 || block instanceof ResourceOreBlock || block instanceof PavementBlock) {
                int currentOre = -1;
                if (block instanceof ResourceOreBlock && client.world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof ResourceOreBlockEntity oreBe) {
                    currentOre = oreBe.getOrInitAmount();
                }

                if (!pos.equals(lastMiningPos) || (currentOre != -1 && lastSeenOreAmount != -1 && currentOre != lastSeenOreAmount)) {
                    lastMiningPos = pos.toImmutable();
                    lastSeenOreAmount = currentOre;
                    prevMiningProgress = 0.0f;
                    miningBarProgress = 0.0f;
                }
                lastSeenOreAmount = currentOre;

                prevMiningProgress = miningBarProgress;
                float delta = state.calcBlockBreakingDelta(client.player, client.world, pos);
                miningBarProgress += delta;
                if (miningBarProgress >= 1.0f) {
                    miningBarProgress = (block instanceof ResourceOreBlock) ? 0.0f : 1.0f;
                    prevMiningProgress = miningBarProgress;
                }
                return;
            }
        }

        prevMiningProgress = 0.0f;
        miningBarProgress = 0.0f;
        lastMiningPos = null;
        lastSeenOreAmount = -1;
    }

    private static void updateRadarEntities(World world, PlayerEntity player) {
        cachedRadarBlips.clear();
        int radiusBlocks = (MAP_CELLS / 2) * blocksPerCell;
        Box radarBox = player.getBoundingBox().expand(radiusBlocks, 24.0, radiusBlocks);
        List<Entity> entities = world.getOtherEntities(player, radarBox);

        for (Entity ent : entities) {
            int color = 0;
            if (ent instanceof Monster) color = 0xFFFF2222;
            else if (ent instanceof PlayerEntity) color = 0xFF44FF44;

            if (color != 0) {
                double dx = (ent.getX() - player.getX()) / blocksPerCell;
                double dz = (ent.getZ() - player.getZ()) / blocksPerCell;
                int ox = MathHelper.floor(dx * PIXEL_SCALE);
                int oz = MathHelper.floor(dz * PIXEL_SCALE);
                cachedRadarBlips.add(new RadarBlip(ox, oz, color));
            }
        }
    }

    private static void renderHud(DrawContext context, RenderTickCounter tickCounter) {
        MinecraftClient client = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        if (client.player == null || client.world == null || client.options.hudHidden || client.getDebugHud().shouldShowDebugHud()) {
            return;
        }

        int screenW = context.getScaledWindowWidth();
        int nextPanelY = 6;

        float mapScale = MathHelper.clamp(FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.minimapScale, 0.5f, 2.0f);
        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(screenW, 0, 0);
        context.getMatrices().scale(mapScale, mapScale, 1.0f);
        context.getMatrices().translate(-screenW, 0, 0);

        int frameSize = MAP_SIZE_PX + 6;
        int x = screenW - frameSize - 6;
        int curTopY = 6;

        // 1. ÐŸÐÐÐ•Ð›Ð¬ ÐŸÐ ÐžÐ“Ð Ð•Ð¡Ð¡Ð Ð¢Ð•Ð¥ÐÐžÐ›ÐžÐ“Ð˜Ð˜ ÐÐÐ” ÐœÐ˜ÐÐ˜ÐšÐÐ Ð¢ÐžÐ™ (ÐºÐ°Ðº Ð½Ð° ÑÐºÑ€Ð¸Ð½ÑˆÐ¾Ñ‚Ðµ 205535.png!)
        int researchBarH = 22;
        renderTopRightResearchWidget(context, client.textRenderer, x, curTopY, frameSize, researchBarH);
        curTopY += researchBarH + 2;

        // 2. ÐœÐ˜ÐÐ˜ÐšÐÐ Ð¢Ð ÐŸÐžÐ” ÐŸÐÐÐ•Ð›Ð¬Ð® Ð˜Ð¡Ð¡Ð›Ð•Ð”ÐžÐ’ÐÐÐ˜Ð™
        if (minimapVisible && FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.enableMinimap) {
            int y = curTopY;

            context.fill(x, y, x + frameSize, y + frameSize, 0xFF141414);
            context.fill(x + 1, y + 1, x + frameSize - 1, y + frameSize - 1, 0xFF313234);

            int mapX = x + 3;
            int mapY = y + 3;
            context.fill(mapX - 1, mapY - 1, mapX + MAP_SIZE_PX + 1, mapY + MAP_SIZE_PX + 1, 0xFF141414);

            for (int gz = 0; gz < MAP_CELLS; gz++) {
                int drawY = mapY + gz * PIXEL_SCALE;
                int rowOffset = gz * MAP_CELLS;
                for (int gx = 0; gx < MAP_CELLS; gx++) {
                    int drawX = mapX + gx * PIXEL_SCALE;
                    context.fill(drawX, drawY, drawX + PIXEL_SCALE, drawY + PIXEL_SCALE, colorBuffer[rowOffset + gx]);
                }
            }

            int centerPxX = mapX + MAP_SIZE_PX / 2;
            int centerPxY = mapY + MAP_SIZE_PX / 2;

            PollutionClientRenderer.renderMinimapPollutionOverlay(context, centerPxX, centerPxY, MAP_SIZE_PX / 2, (float) blocksPerCell / PIXEL_SCALE);

            for (RadarBlip blip : cachedRadarBlips) {
                int ex = centerPxX + blip.offsetX();
                int ez = centerPxY + blip.offsetZ();
                if (ex >= mapX + 2 && ex < mapX + MAP_SIZE_PX - 2 && ez >= mapY + 2 && ez < mapY + MAP_SIZE_PX - 2) {
                    context.fill(ex - 1, ez - 1, ex + 2, ez + 2, blip.color());
                }
            }

            drawPlayerMarker(context, centerPxX, centerPxY, client.player.getYaw());
            if (AltModeRenderer.isAltModeActive()) {
                context.fill(x - 28, y, x - 2, y + 14, 0xEE141414);
                context.fill(x - 27, y + 1, x - 3, y + 13, 0xEEAC6E14);
                context.drawText(client.textRenderer, "ALT", x - 23, y + 3, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);
            }
            curTopY += frameSize + 4;
        }

        context.getMatrices().pop();
        nextPanelY = (int) (6 + (curTopY - 6) * mapScale);

        // 3. ÐŸÐ ÐÐ’ÐÐ¯ Ð˜ÐÐ¤ÐžÐ ÐœÐÐ¦Ð˜ÐžÐÐÐÐ¯ ÐŸÐÐÐ•Ð›Ð¬ Ðž Ð¦Ð•Ð›Ð˜ ÐŸÐžÐ” ÐŸÐ Ð˜Ð¦Ð•Ð›ÐžÐœ
        if (FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.enableTargetInfoPanel) {
            float infoScale = MathHelper.clamp(FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.infoPanelScale, 0.5f, 2.0f);
            context.getMatrices().push();
            context.getMatrices().translate(screenW, nextPanelY, 0);
            context.getMatrices().scale(infoScale, infoScale, 1.0f);
            context.getMatrices().translate(-screenW, -nextPanelY, 0);

            renderTargetInfoPanel(context, client, screenW, nextPanelY);

            context.getMatrices().pop();
        }

        if (FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.enableCraftingQueueHud) {
            ClientCraftingQueueHud.renderBottomLeftQueue(context, false);
        }
        renderMiningProgressBar(context, tickCounter.getTickDelta(false));
    }

    /**
     * ÐžÑ‚Ñ€Ð¸ÑÐ¾Ð²Ñ‹Ð²Ð°ÐµÑ‚ Ð±Ð»Ð¾Ðº Ð°ÐºÑ‚Ð¸Ð²Ð½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ Ð¸ÑÑÐ»ÐµÐ´Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ñ Ð¿Ñ€ÑÐ¼Ð¾ Ð½Ð°Ð´ Ð¼Ð¸Ð½Ð¸ÐºÐ°Ñ€Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¹ (ÐºÐ°Ðº Ð½Ð° ÑÐºÑ€Ð¸Ð½ÑˆÐ¾Ñ‚Ðµ 205535.png).
     */
    private static void renderTopRightResearchWidget(DrawContext context, TextRenderer tr, int x, int y, int width, int height) {
        ResearchManager.init();
        ResearchManager.TechNode activeTech = ResearchManager.getActiveTech();

        context.fill(x, y, x + width, y + height, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(x + 1, y + 1, x + width - 1, y + height - 1, 0xFF28292C);
        context.fill(x + 2, y + 2, x + width - 2, y + height - 2, 0xFF1F2023);

        if (activeTech == null) {
            String idleStr = "ÐÐ°Ð¶Ð¼Ð¸Ñ‚Ðµ [T] â€” Ð˜ÑÑÐ»ÐµÐ´Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ñ";
            context.getMatrices().push();
            context.getMatrices().translate(x + 5, y + 8, 100.0f);
            context.getMatrices().scale(0.62f, 0.62f, 1.0f);
            context.drawText(tr, idleStr, 0, 0, 0xFF999B9F, true);
            context.getMatrices().pop();
            return;
        }

        // Ð˜ÐºÐ¾Ð½ÐºÐ° Ð¸ÑÑÐ»ÐµÐ´ÑƒÐµÐ¼Ð¾Ð¹ Ñ‚ÐµÑ…Ð½Ð¾Ð»Ð¾Ð³Ð¸Ð¸ ÑÐ»ÐµÐ²Ð° (16x16)
        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(x + 3.0f, y + 3.0f, 100.0f);
        context.drawItem(activeTech.icon, 0, 0);
        context.getMatrices().pop();

        // ÐÐ°Ð·Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ðµ Ñ‚ÐµÑ…Ð½Ð¾Ð»Ð¾Ð³Ð¸Ð¸ ÑÐ²ÐµÑ€Ñ…Ñƒ ÑÐ¿Ñ€Ð°Ð²Ð° Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð¸ÐºÐ¾Ð½ÐºÐ¸
        float titleScale = 0.65f;
        int maxTitlePx = Math.round((width - 24) / titleScale);
        String trimmedTitle = tr.trimToWidth(activeTech.name, maxTitlePx);
        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(x + 21.0f, y + 4.0f, 100.0f);
        context.getMatrices().scale(titleScale, titleScale, 1.0f);
        context.drawText(tr, trimmedTitle, 0, 0, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);
        context.getMatrices().pop();

        // ÐŸÑ€Ð¾Ð³Ñ€ÐµÑÑ-Ð±Ð°Ñ€ ÑÐ½Ð¸Ð·Ñƒ + Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ñ†ÐµÐ½Ñ‚ ÑÐ¿Ñ€Ð°Ð²Ð° (ÐºÐ°Ðº Ð½Ð° ÑÐºÑ€Ð¸Ð½ÑˆÐ¾Ñ‚Ðµ 205535.png)
        float ratio = ResearchManager.getOverallProgressRatio();
        int pct = MathHelper.clamp(Math.round(ratio * 100.0f), 0, 100);
        String pctText = pct + "%";

        float pctScale = 0.62f;
        int pctW = Math.round(tr.getWidth(pctText) * pctScale);
        int pctX = x + width - pctW - 3;

        int barX = x + 21;
        int barY = y + 13;
        int barW = Math.max(16, (pctX - 3) - barX);
        int barH = 5;

        context.fill(barX, barY, barX + barW, barY + barH, 0xFF111213);
        context.fill(barX + 1, barY + 1, barX + barW - 1, barY + barH - 1, 0xFF2D2E32);

        int fillW = Math.round(ratio * (barW - 2));
        if (fillW > 0) {
            context.fill(barX + 1, barY + 1, barX + 1 + fillW, barY + barH - 1, 0xFF43A047);
            context.fill(barX + 1, barY + 1, barX + 1 + fillW, barY + 2, 0xFF66BB6A);
        }

        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(pctX, y + 12.0f, 100.0f);
        context.getMatrices().scale(pctScale, pctScale, 1.0f);
        context.drawText(tr, pctText, 0, 0, 0xFFE6E6E6, true);
        context.getMatrices().pop();
    }

    private static class InfoSection {

    private static String localizeFluidKind(FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind kind) {
        return switch (kind) {
            case WATER -> "Ð’Ð¾Ð´Ð°";
            case STEAM -> "ÐŸÐ°Ñ€";
            case CRUDE_OIL -> "Ð¡Ñ‹Ñ€Ð°Ñ Ð½ÐµÑ„Ñ‚ÑŒ";
            case PETROLEUM_GAS -> "ÐŸÐ¾Ð¿ÑƒÑ‚Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð½ÐµÑ„Ñ‚ÑÐ½Ð¾Ð¹ Ð³Ð°Ð·";
            default -> "ÐŸÑƒÑÑ‚Ð¾";
        };
    }

    private static void renderTargetInfoPanel(DrawContext context, MinecraftClient client, int screenW, int topY) {
        if (!(client.crosshairTarget instanceof BlockHitResult hit) || hit.getType() != HitResult.Type.BLOCK) {
            return;
        }
        World world = client.world;
        if (world == null) return;

        BlockPos rawPos = hit.getBlockPos();
        BlockState rawState = world.getBlockState(rawPos);
        if (rawState.isAir()) return;

        BlockPos pos = BlockHealthManager.getCanonicalPos(rawPos, rawState);
        BlockState state = world.getBlockState(pos);
        Block block = state.getBlock();

        int maxHp = BlockHealthManager.getMaxHealth(block);
        boolean isFactorioOre = block instanceof ResourceOreBlock || block instanceof OilMachines.CrudeOilDepositBlock;

        if (maxHp <= 0 && !isFactorioOre) {
            return;
        }

        Text title = block.getName();
        TextRenderer tr = client.textRenderer;
        FactorioConfig cfg = FactorioConfig.INSTANCE;

        List<InfoSection> sections = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Text> headerLines = new ArrayList<>();
        BlockEntity be = world.getBlockEntity(pos);

        // --- 1. ÐžÐ¿Ð¸ÑÐ°Ð½Ð¸Ðµ ---
        if (cfg.showInfoDescription) {
            String descKey = block.getTranslationKey() + ".desc";
            String desc = Text.translatable(descKey).getString();
            if (!desc.equals(descKey)) {
                String[] words = desc.split(" ");
                StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
                for (String word : words) {
                    if (tr.getWidth(sb.toString() + word) > 180) {
                        headerLines.add(Text.literal(sb.toString()).formatted(Formatting.GRAY));
                        sb = new StringBuilder();
                    }
                    sb.append(word).append(" ");
                }
                if (sb.length() > 0) {
                    headerLines.add(Text.literal(sb.toString()).formatted(Formatting.GRAY));
                }
            }
        }

        // --- 2. Ð¡Ñ‚Ð°Ñ‚ÑƒÑ (Ð¸ Ð·Ð°Ð»ÐµÐ¶Ð¸ Ñ€ÑƒÐ´Ñ‹/Ð½ÐµÑ„Ñ‚Ð¸) ---
        if (cfg.showInfoStatus) {
            if (block instanceof ResourceOreBlock oreBlock) {
                int amount = ResourceOreBlockEntity.getClientDisplayAmount(world, pos, oreBlock.getOreType());
                headerLines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.expected_resources",
                                Text.literal(String.valueOf(amount)).formatted(Formatting.YELLOW))
                        .formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
            } else if (block instanceof OilMachines.CrudeOilDepositBlock) {
                headerLines.add(Text.literal("Ð”ÐµÐ±Ð¸Ñ‚ ÑÐºÐ²Ð°Ð¶Ð¸Ð½Ñ‹: ").formatted(Formatting.WHITE)
                        .append(Text.literal("100% (ÐÐµÐ¸ÑÑÑÐºÐ°ÐµÐ¼Ð°Ñ)").formatted(Formatting.GREEN)));
            } else if (be != null && !(be instanceof PipeBlockEntity)) {
                boolean isWorking = false;
                boolean noFuel = false;
                boolean noPower = false;

                if (be instanceof ElectricDrillBlockEntity eDrill) {
                    isWorking = eDrill.isActivelyMining();
                    noPower = !eDrill.isPowered();
                } else if (be instanceof BoilerBlockEntity boiler) {
                    isWorking = boiler.isBurning();
                    noFuel = !isWorking && boiler.getStack(0).isEmpty();
                } else if (be instanceof BurnerDrillBlockEntity drill) {
                    isWorking = drill.getClientDrillRotation(0.0f) > 0.0f || !drill.getFuelStack().isEmpty();
                    noFuel = !isWorking;
                } else if (be instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity furnace) {
                    isWorking = furnace.isBurning();
                    noFuel = !isWorking && furnace.getStack(1).isEmpty();
                } else if (be instanceof InserterBlockEntity ins) {
                    boolean isBurner = block instanceof BurnerInserterBlock;
                    isWorking = !ins.getHeldStack().isEmpty() || ins.getArmProgress(0.0f) > 0.01f;
                    boolean powered = isBurner || PowerNetworkManager.isMachinePowered(world, pos);
                    noPower = !isBurner && !powered;
                    noFuel = isBurner && ins.getFuelStack().isEmpty();
                } else if (be instanceof com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.research.LabBlockEntity lab) {
                    isWorking = lab.isWorking();
                    noPower = !lab.isPowered();
                } else if (be instanceof AssemblerBlockEntity asm) {
                    isWorking = asm.isWorking();
                    noPower = !asm.isPowered();
                } else if (be instanceof OilMachines.PumpjackBlockEntity pj) {
                    isWorking = pj.isWorking();
                    noPower = !pj.isPowered();
                } else if (be instanceof OilMachines.OilRefineryBlockEntity ref) {
                    isWorking = ref.isWorking();
                    noPower = !ref.isPowered();
                } else if (be instanceof OilMachines.ChemicalPlantBlockEntity cp) {
                    isWorking = cp.isWorking();
                    noPower = !cp.isPowered();
                } else if (block instanceof com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.electricity.ElectricPoleBlock) {
                    isWorking = PowerNetworkManager.isPoleEnergized(world, pos);
                    noPower = !isWorking;
                }

                if (noPower) {
                    headerLines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.status_no_power").formatted(Formatting.RED));
                } else if (noFuel) {
                    headerLines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.status_no_fuel").formatted(Formatting.RED));
                } else if (isWorking) {
                    headerLines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.status_working").formatted(Formatting.GREEN));
                } else {
                    headerLines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.status_waiting").formatted(Formatting.YELLOW));
                }
            }
        }

        // --- 3. Ð¡ÐžÐ”Ð•Ð Ð–Ð˜ÐœÐžÐ• Ð¢Ð Ð£Ð‘ Ð˜ Ð–Ð˜Ð”ÐšÐžÐ¡Ð¢ÐÐ«Ð¥ ÐœÐÐ¨Ð˜Ð ---
        if (cfg.showInfoFluids) {
            if (be instanceof PipeBlockEntity pipe) {
                FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind kind = pipe.getFluidKind();
                int amt = pipe.getFluidAmount();
                int cap = pipe.getFluidCapacity();
                InfoSection pipeSec = new InfoSection("Ð¡Ð¾Ð´ÐµÑ€Ð¶Ð¸Ð¼Ð¾Ðµ Ñ‚Ñ€ÑƒÐ±Ð¾Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð²Ð¾Ð´Ð°", kind.color);

    private static String formatCompactCount(int count) {
        if (count >= 1000) return String.format("%.1fk", count / 1000.0f);
        return String.valueOf(count);
    }

    private static void renderMiningProgressBar(DrawContext context, float tickDelta) {
        if (miningBarProgress <= 0.0f && prevMiningProgress <= 0.0f) return;

        float smoothProgress = MathHelper.clamp(MathHelper.lerp(tickDelta, prevMiningProgress, miningBarProgress), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        int screenW = context.getScaledWindowWidth();
        int screenH = context.getScaledWindowHeight();
        int barW = 182;
        int barH = 5;
        int bx = (screenW - barW) / 2;
        int by = screenH - 54;

        context.fill(bx - 1, by - 1, bx + barW + 1, by + barH + 1, 0xEE141414);
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + barW, by + barH, 0xEE26272A);
        int fillW = Math.round(smoothProgress * barW);
        if (fillW > 0) {
            context.fill(bx, by, bx + fillW, by + barH, 0xFFE59524);
            context.fill(bx, by, bx + fillW, by + 2, 0xFFFFCC66);
        }
    }

    private static void drawPlayerMarker(DrawContext context, int cx, int cy, float yaw) {
        context.fill(cx - 2, cy - 2, cx + 3, cy + 3, 0xFF111111);
        context.fill(cx - 1, cy - 1, cx + 2, cy + 2, 0xFFFFCC00);

        double rad = Math.toRadians(yaw + 90.0f);
        int tipX = cx + (int) Math.round(Math.cos(rad) * 3.0);
        int tipY = cy + (int) Math.round(Math.sin(rad) * 3.0);
        context.fill(tipX - 1, tipY - 1, tipX + 1, tipY + 1, 0xFFFFFFFF);
    }

    private static void updateMapSlice(World world, PlayerEntity player, int startRow, int endRow) {
        int centerX = MathHelper.floor(player.getX());
        int centerZ = MathHelper.floor(player.getZ());
        int half = MAP_CELLS / 2;
        BlockPos.Mutable pos = new BlockPos.Mutable();

        int maxRow = Math.min(MAP_CELLS, endRow);
        for (int gz = startRow; gz < maxRow; gz++) {
            int wz = centerZ + (gz - half) * blocksPerCell;
            int rowOffset = gz * MAP_CELLS;

            for (int gx = 0; gx < MAP_CELLS; gx++) {
                int wx = centerX + (gx - half) * blocksPerCell;

                if (!world.isChunkLoaded(wx >> 4, wz >> 4)) {
                    colorBuffer[rowOffset + gx] = 0xFF18191B;
                    continue;
                }

                int topY = world.getTopY(Heightmap.Type.WORLD_SURFACE, wx, wz) - 1;
                if (topY < world.getBottomY()) {
                    colorBuffer[rowOffset + gx] = 0xFF18191B;
                    continue;
                }

                pos.set(wx, topY, wz);
                BlockState state = world.getBlockState(pos);
                if (state.isAir() && topY > world.getBottomY()) {
                    pos.set(wx, topY - 1, wz);
                    state = world.getBlockState(pos);
                }

                colorBuffer[rowOffset + gx] = resolveFactorioMapColor(world, pos, state);
            }
        }
    }

    private static int resolveFactorioMapColor(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        Block block = state.getBlock();

        if (state.isOf(Blocks.WATER) || state.isOf(Blocks.SEAGRASS) || state.isOf(Blocks.LILY_PAD)) {
            float factor = com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.pollution.PollutionManager.getClientWaterTintFactor(pos.getX(), pos.getZ());
            if (factor <= 0.01f) return 0xFF2471A3;
            int r = MathHelper.lerp(factor, 0x24, 0x46);
            int g = MathHelper.lerp(factor, 0x71, 0x6E);
            int b = MathHelper.lerp(factor, 0xA3, 0x24);
            return 0xFF000000 | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
        }

        if (block instanceof BeltBlock belt) {
            return switch (belt.getTier()) {
                case 2 -> 0xFFE53935;
                case 3 -> 0xFF29B6F6;
                default -> 0xFFFDD835;
            };
        }
        if (block instanceof com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.production.burner_drill.BurnerDrillBlock || block instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlock) return 0xFF42A5F5;
        if (block instanceof InserterBlock || block instanceof FactorioChestBlock) return 0xFFFFB300;
        if (block instanceof OilMachines.CrudeOilDepositBlock) return 0xFFD81B60; // ÐŸÑƒÑ€Ð¿ÑƒÑ€Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ‡ÐºÐ¸ Ð½ÐµÑ„Ñ‚Ð¸ Ð½Ð° Ð¼Ð¸Ð½Ð¸ÐºÐ°Ñ€Ñ‚Ðµ ÐºÐ°Ðº Ð² Factorio!

        if (block instanceof ResourceOreBlock ore) {
            return switch (ore.getOreType()) {
                case 0 -> 0xFF5B9BD5;
                case 1 -> 0xFFED7D31;
                case 2 -> 0xFF1A1A1D;
                default -> 0xFFD2C290;
            };
        }

        Block below = world.getBlockState(pos.down()).getBlock();
        if (below instanceof ResourceOreBlock oreBelow) {
            return switch (oreBelow.getOreType()) {
                case 0 -> 0xFF5B9BD5;
                case 1 -> 0xFFED7D31;
                case 2 -> 0xFF1A1A1D;
                default -> 0xFFD2C290;
            };
        }

        if (block instanceof PavementBlock) return 0xFF70757A;
        if (pos.getY() >= 66 && (state.isOf(Blocks.DRIPSTONE_BLOCK) || state.isOf(Blocks.GRANITE) || state.isOf(Blocks.TUFF))) return 0xFF424949;

        MapColor mapColor = state.getMapColor(world, pos);
        if (mapColor == MapColor.CLEAR) {
            BlockState groundState = world.getBlockState(pos.down());
            mapColor = groundState.getMapColor(world, pos.down());
        }
        int rgb = mapColor.color;
        int r = (rgb >> 16) & 0xFF;
        int g = (rgb >> 8) & 0xFF;
        int b = rgb & 0xFF;
        return 0xFF000000 | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.client.mixin;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.pollution.PollutionManager;
import net.minecraft.client.color.world.BiomeColors;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.math.MathHelper;
import net.minecraft.world.BlockRenderView;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfoReturnable;

@Mixin(BiomeColors.class)
public class ExampleClientMixin {

	@Inject(method = "getWaterColor", at = @At("RETURN"), cancellable = true)
	private static void factoriocore$tintPollutedWater(BlockRenderView world, BlockPos pos, CallbackInfoReturnable<Integer> cir) {
		if (pos == null) return;
		float factor = PollutionManager.getClientWaterTintFactor(pos.getX(), pos.getZ());
		if (factor <= 0.01f) return;

		int baseColor = cir.getReturnValueI();
		int r1 = (baseColor >> 16) & 0xFF;
		int g1 = (baseColor >> 8) & 0xFF;
		int b1 = baseColor & 0xFF;

		// ÐšÐ°Ð½Ð¾Ð½Ð¸Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð±Ð¾Ð»Ð¾Ñ‚Ð½Ð¾-Ð·ÐµÐ»Ñ‘Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ñ†Ð²ÐµÑ‚ Ð·Ð°Ð³Ñ€ÑÐ·Ð½Ñ‘Ð½Ð½Ð¾Ð¹ Ð²Ð¾Ð´Ñ‹ Ð¸Ð· Factorio (#4E7A27)
		int r = MathHelper.lerp(factor, r1, 0x4E);
		int g = MathHelper.lerp(factor, g1, 0x7A);
		int b = MathHelper.lerp(factor, b1, 0x27);

		cir.setReturnValue((r << 16) | (g << 8) | b);
	}
}

    private void drawRecipeBadgeIcon(DrawContext context, int machineType, int mode, int ix, int iy) {
        if (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_REFINERY) {
            if (mode == 0) {
                drawFluidDropIcon(context, ix, iy - 2, 0xFF141418, 0xFF555560);
                drawSmallMolecule(context, ix + 8, iy + 11);
            } else if (mode == 1) {
                drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 3, iy + 1, 0xFF29B6F6);
                drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 9, iy + 1, 0xFF222228);
                drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 1, iy + 9, 0xFFB03A2E);
                drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 6, iy + 9, 0xFF8E44AD);
                drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 11, iy + 9, 0xFFD68910);
            } else {
                context.drawItem(new ItemStack(Items.COAL), ix, iy - 1);
                drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 6, iy + 8, 0xFFB03A2E);
            }
        } else if (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_CHEM_PLANT) {
            switch (mode) {
                case 0 -> {
                    drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 6, iy + 1, 0xFFB03A2E);
                    drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 2, iy + 9, 0xFFD68910);
                    drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 10, iy + 9, 0xFFD68910);
                }
                case 1 -> {
                    drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 6, iy + 1, 0xFFD68910);
                    drawSmallMolecule(context, ix + 1, iy + 10);
                    drawSmallMolecule(context, ix + 8, iy + 10);
                }
                case 2 -> {
                    context.drawItem(new ItemStack(ModItems.SOLID_FUEL), ix, iy);
                    drawSmallMolecule(context, ix + 1, iy + 1);
                }
                case 3 -> {
                    context.drawItem(new ItemStack(ModItems.SOLID_FUEL), ix, iy);
                    drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 1, iy + 1, 0xFFD68910);
                }
                case 4 -> {
                    context.drawItem(new ItemStack(ModItems.SOLID_FUEL), ix, iy);
                    drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 1, iy + 1, 0xFFB03A2E);
                }
                case 5 -> drawFluidDropIcon(context, ix, iy, 0xFF27AE60, 0xFF82E0AA);
                case 6 -> drawFluidDropIcon(context, ix, iy, 0xFFD4AC0D, 0xFFFFF176);
                case 7 -> context.drawItem(new ItemStack(ModItems.PLASTIC_BAR), ix, iy);
                case 8 -> context.drawItem(new ItemStack(ModItems.SULFUR), ix, iy);
                case 9 -> context.drawItem(new ItemStack(ModItems.BATTERY), ix, iy);
                default -> context.drawItem(new ItemStack(ModItems.EXPLOSIVES), ix, iy);
            }
        } else {
            drawFluidDropIcon(context, ix, iy, 0xFF141418, 0xFF555560);
        }
    }

    private void drawFluidDropIcon(DrawContext context, int x, int y, int bodyCol, int highlightCol) {
        context.fill(x + 7, y + 2, x + 9, y + 4, bodyCol);
        context.fill(x + 6, y + 4, x + 10, y + 6, bodyCol);
        context.fill(x + 5, y + 6, x + 11, y + 8, bodyCol);
        context.fill(x + 4, y + 8, x + 12, y + 12, bodyCol);
        context.fill(x + 5, y + 12, x + 11, y + 14, bodyCol);
        context.fill(x + 6, y + 7, x + 7, y + 11, highlightCol);
    }

    private void drawMiniDrop(DrawContext context, int x, int y, int col) {
        context.fill(x + 1, y, x + 3, y + 2, col);
        context.fill(x, y + 2, x + 4, y + 5, col);
        context.fill(x + 1, y + 5, x + 3, y + 6, col);
    }

    private void drawGasMoleculeIcon(DrawContext context, int x, int y) {

        context.fill(x + 9, y + 7, x + 14, y + 13, 0xFF8E24AA);

        context.fill(x + 10, y + 8, x + 12, y + 10, 0xFFE1BEE7);
    }

    private void drawSmallMolecule(DrawContext context, int x, int y) {
        context.fill(x, y, x + 3, y + 3, 0xFFE0E0E0);
        context.fill(x + 3, y - 1, x + 6, y + 2, 0xFF555555);
        context.fill(x + 5, y + 1, x + 8, y + 4, 0xFFE0E0E0);
    }

    private void renderMachine3DPreview(DrawContext context, int centerX, int centerY, float delta, int machineType) {
        MinecraftClient client = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        MatrixStack matrices = context.getMatrices();

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(centerX, centerY + 8, 150.0f);
        float scale = (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_REFINERY) ? (this.previewZoom * 0.65f) : this.previewZoom;
        matrices.scale(scale, -scale, scale);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(this.previewPitch));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(this.previewYaw));
        matrices.translate(-0.5f, -1.1f, -0.5f);

        if (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_REFINERY) {
            OilMachinesRenderer.RefineryRenderer.renderRefineryModel(
                    matrices, context.getVertexConsumers(),
                    LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE, OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV, handler.isWorking());
        } else if (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_CHEM_PLANT) {
            OilMachinesRenderer.ChemicalPlantRenderer.renderChemicalPlantModel(
                    matrices, context.getVertexConsumers(),
                    LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE, OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV);
        } else {
            float angle = (handler.isWorking() && client.world != null)
                    ? (float) Math.sin((client.world.getTime() + delta) * 0.2f) * 22.0f : 0.0f;
            OilMachinesRenderer.PumpjackRenderer.renderPumpjackModel(
                    matrices, context.getVertexConsumers(),
                    LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE, OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV, angle);
        }

        matrices.pop();
        context.draw();
    }

    private void drawSlotFrame(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy) {
        context.fill(sx, sy, sx + 18, sy + 18, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 1, sx + 17, sy + 17, 0xFF3A3C3E);
    }

    private void drawGhostSlot(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy) {
        context.fill(sx, sy, sx + 18, sy + 18, 0xFF1A1B1C);
        context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 1, sx + 17, sy + 17, 0xFF222325);
    }

    private void drawCheckerboard(DrawContext context, int left, int top, int right, int bottom, int cellSize) {
        for (int py = top; py < bottom; py += cellSize) {
            for (int px = left; px < right; px += cellSize) {
                int gx = (px - left) / cellSize;
                int gy = (py - top) / cellSize;
                int color = ((gx + gy) % 2 == 0) ? 0xFF262729 : 0xFF2E3032;
                context.fill(px, py, Math.min(px + cellSize, right), Math.min(py + cellSize, bottom), color);
            }
        }
    }

    private void drawGearIcon(DrawContext context, int gx, int gy, int col) {
        context.fill(gx + 4, gy + 2, gx + 12, gy + 14, col);
        context.fill(gx + 2, gy + 4, gx + 14, gy + 12, col);
        context.fill(gx + 6, gy + 6, gx + 10, gy + 10, 0xFF141414);
    }

    private boolean isInsidePreviewViewport(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        int rightX = x + 192;
        return mouseX >= rightX + 6 && mouseX <= rightX + 226 && mouseY >= y + 34 && mouseY <= y + 110;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        if (!recipeSelectionMode && isInsidePreviewViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.previewZoom = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewZoom + (float) verticalAmount * 1.5f, 6.0f, 26.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mouseX, mouseY, horizontalAmount, verticalAmount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;

        if (mouseX >= x + backgroundWidth - 17 && mouseX <= x + backgroundWidth - 4 && mouseY >= y + 4 && mouseY <= y + 16) {
            if (recipeSelectionMode) {
                setRecipeSelectionMode(false);
            } else {
                this.close();
            }
            return true;
        }

        if (recipeSelectionMode) {
            int gridX = x + 14;
            int gridY = y + 26;
            int slotSize = 26;
            int machineType = handler.getMachineType();
            int totalRecipes = (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_CHEM_PLANT) ? 11 : 3;

            for (int m = 0; m < totalRecipes; m++) {
                int col = (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_CHEM_PLANT && m >= 7) ? (m - 7) : m;
                int row = (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_CHEM_PLANT && m >= 7) ? 1 : 0;
                int sx = gridX + col * slotSize;
                int sy = gridY + row * slotSize;

                if (mouseX >= sx && mouseX < sx + slotSize - 2 && mouseY >= sy && mouseY < sy + slotSize - 2) {
                    if (this.client != null && this.client.interactionManager != null) {
                        this.client.interactionManager.clickButton(this.handler.syncId, m);
                    }
                    if (this.client != null && this.client.player != null) {
                        this.client.player.playSound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), 0.4f, 1.2f);
                    }
                    setRecipeSelectionMode(false);
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        if ((button == 0 || button == 1) && isInsidePreviewViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.draggingPreview = true;
            return true;
        }

        if (handler.getMachineType() != OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_PUMPJACK) {
            int rightX = x + 192;
            int rightW = 232;
            int recBtnX = rightX + 6;
            int gearX = rightX + rightW - 28;
            if ((mouseX >= recBtnX && mouseX <= recBtnX + 22 && mouseY >= y + 116 && mouseY <= y + 138)
                    || (mouseX >= gearX && mouseX <= gearX + 22 && mouseY >= y + 116 && mouseY <= y + 138)) {
                setRecipeSelectionMode(true);
                if (this.client != null && this.client.player != null) {
                    this.client.player.playSound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), 0.4f, 1.15f);
                }
                return true;
            }
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        this.draggingPreview = false;
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.draggingPreview) {
            this.previewYaw += (float) deltaX * 1.5f;
            this.previewPitch = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewPitch + (float) deltaY * 1.5f, -80.0f, 80.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        this.handler.setSlotsVisible(!this.recipeSelectionMode);
        super.render(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);

        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        int machineType = handler.getMachineType();
        int recipeMode = handler.getRecipeMode();

        if (recipeSelectionMode) {
            int gridX = x + 14;
            int gridY = y + 26;
            int slotSize = 26;
            int totalRecipes = (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_CHEM_PLANT) ? 11 : 3;

            for (int m = 0; m < totalRecipes; m++) {
                int col = (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_CHEM_PLANT && m >= 7) ? (m - 7) : m;
                int row = (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_CHEM_PLANT && m >= 7) ? 1 : 0;
                int sx = gridX + col * slotSize;
                int sy = gridY + row * slotSize;

                if (mouseX >= sx && mouseX < sx + slotSize - 2 && mouseY >= sy && mouseY < sy + slotSize - 2) {
                    context.drawTooltip(this.textRenderer, List.of(
                            Text.literal(getRecipeDisplayName(machineType, m)).formatted(Formatting.GOLD),
                            Text.literal("ÐÐ°Ð¶Ð¼Ð¸Ñ‚Ðµ Ð›ÐšÐœ Ð´Ð»Ñ Ð²Ñ‹Ð±Ð¾Ñ€Ð° Ñ€ÐµÑ†ÐµÐ¿Ñ‚Ð°").formatted(Formatting.GRAY)
                    ), mouseX, mouseY);
                }
            }
            return;
        }

        int rightX = x + 192;
        int slotRowY = y + 143;
        int outX = rightX + 232 - 24;

        if (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_REFINERY && recipeMode >= 1) {
            if (mouseX >= outX - 38 && mouseX < outX - 20 && mouseY >= slotRowY && mouseY < slotRowY + 18) {
                context.drawTooltip(this.textRenderer, List.of(
                        Text.literal("ÐœÐ°Ð·ÑƒÑ‚ (Ð›ÐµÐ²Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð²Ñ‹Ñ…Ð¾Ð´Ð½Ð¾Ð¹ Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‚)").formatted(Formatting.RED),

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.client.sound;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.config.FactorioConfig;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.fluids.BoilerBlock;
