    public static void wakeUpAdjacentInserters(World world, BlockPos sourcePos) {
        if (world == null || world.isClient()) return;

        wakeAroundPos(world, sourcePos);

        BlockState state = world.getBlockState(sourcePos);
        if (state.getBlock() instanceof ChestBlock && state.contains(ChestBlock.CHEST_TYPE)) {
            switch (state.get(ChestBlock.CHEST_TYPE)) {
                case LEFT, RIGHT -> {
                    Direction chestConnectedDir = ChestBlock.getFacing(state);
                    wakeAroundPos(world, sourcePos.offset(chestConnectedDir));
                }
                default -> {}
            }
        }
    }

    private static void wakeAroundPos(World world, BlockPos center) {
        for (Direction dir : Direction.Type.HORIZONTAL) {
            // ÐŸÑ€Ð¾Ð²ÐµÑ€ÑÐµÐ¼ Ð´Ð¸ÑÑ‚Ð°Ð½Ñ†Ð¸ÑŽ 1 (Ð¾Ð±Ñ‹Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ/Ð±Ñ‹ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ñ‹Ðµ/ÑƒÐ³Ð¾Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ðµ) Ð¸ Ð´Ð¸ÑÑ‚Ð°Ð½Ñ†Ð¸ÑŽ 2 (Ð´Ð»Ð¸Ð½Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ ÐºÑ€Ð°ÑÐ½Ñ‹Ðµ Ð¼Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ð¿ÑƒÐ»ÑÑ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‹)
            for (int dist = 1; dist <= 2; dist++) {
                BlockPos neighborPos = center.offset(dir, dist);
                if (world.getBlockState(neighborPos).getBlock() instanceof InserterBlock) {
                    if (world.getBlockEntity(neighborPos) instanceof InserterBlockEntity inserter) {
                        if (inserter.getReachDistance() == dist) {
                            inserter.wakeUp();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public void changeMaxPickupCount(int delta) {
        if (isBurner()) return;

        if (delta == ACTION_TOGGLE_FILTER) {
            this.filterEnabled = !this.filterEnabled;
        } else if (delta == ACTION_TOGGLE_BLACKLIST) {
            this.blacklistMode = !this.blacklistMode;
        } else if (delta == ACTION_TOGGLE_OVERRIDE_STACK) {
            this.overrideStackSize = !this.overrideStackSize;
        } else if (delta > ACTION_SET_STACK_BASE && delta <= ACTION_SET_STACK_BASE + MAX_STACK_CAPACITY) {
            this.maxPickupCount = Math.max(1, Math.min(MAX_STACK_CAPACITY, delta - ACTION_SET_STACK_BASE));
            this.overrideStackSize = true;
        } else {
            this.maxPickupCount = Math.max(1, Math.min(MAX_STACK_CAPACITY, this.maxPickupCount + delta));
            this.overrideStackSize = true;
        }
        this.wakeUp();
        syncState();
    }

    public boolean isClientOccluded(World world) {
        if (world == null) return false;
        long now = world.getTime();
        if (now - this.lastOcclusionCheckTime >= 40L) {
            this.lastOcclusionCheckTime = now + (this.pos.asLong() & 15L);
            this.clientOccluded = !world.getBlockState(this.pos.up()).isAir()
                    && !world.getBlockState(this.pos.north()).isAir()
                    && !world.getBlockState(this.pos.south()).isAir()
                    && !world.getBlockState(this.pos.west()).isAir()
                    && !world.getBlockState(this.pos.east()).isAir();
        }
        return this.clientOccluded;
    }

    public static void clientTick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, InserterBlockEntity entity) {
        int duration = entity.getSwingDuration();
        if (!entity.heldStack.isEmpty()) {
            if (entity.clientSwingTicks < duration) {
                entity.clientSwingTicks++;
            }
        } else if (entity.clientReturnTicks > 0) {
            entity.clientReturnTicks--;
        }
    }

    public float getArmProgress(float tickDelta) {
        int duration = Math.max(1, getSwingDuration());
        if (!this.heldStack.isEmpty()) {
            if (this.clientSwingTicks >= duration) {
                return 1.0f;
            }
            return Math.min(1.0f, (this.clientSwingTicks + tickDelta) / (float) duration);
        } else {
            if (this.clientReturnTicks <= 0) {
                return 0.0f;
            }
            return Math.max(0.0f, (this.clientReturnTicks - tickDelta) / (float) duration);
        }
    }

    public boolean hasElectricity() {
        if (isBurner()) return true;
        if (this.world == null) return false;
        long now = this.world.getTime();
        if (now - this.lastPowerCheckTick >= 10L) {
            this.lastPowerCheckTick = now + (this.pos.asLong() & 7L);
            this.cachedPowered = PowerNetworkManager.isMachinePowered(this.world, this.pos);
        }
        return this.cachedPowered;
    }

    private static boolean hasItemOnGroundAt(World world, BlockPos targetPos) {
        Box checkBox = new Box(targetPos).expand(0.25, 0.4, 0.25);
        return !world.getEntitiesByClass(
                ItemEntity.class,
                checkBox,
                item -> item.isAlive() && !item.getStack().isEmpty()
        ).isEmpty();
    }

    private int getEffectivePickupCount() {
        if (isBurner()) {
            return 1;
        }
        return this.overrideStackSize ? Math.min(MAX_STACK_CAPACITY, this.maxPickupCount) : 1;
    }

    private boolean ensureBurnerFuel() {
        if (!isBurner()) {
            return true;
        }
        if (this.burnTime > 0) {
            return true;
        }
        if (!this.fuelStack.isEmpty() && AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(this.fuelStack)) {
            Integer fuelTicks = FuelRegistry.INSTANCE.get(this.fuelStack.getItem());
            int ticks = (fuelTicks != null && fuelTicks > 0) ? fuelTicks : 200;
            this.burnTime = ticks;
            this.maxBurnTime = ticks;

            Item remainder = this.fuelStack.getItem().getRecipeRemainder();
            this.fuelStack.decrement(1);
            if (this.fuelStack.isEmpty() && remainder != null) {
                this.fuelStack = new ItemStack(remainder);
            }
            syncState();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private boolean trySelfRefuelFromSource(World world, BlockPos backPos) {
        if (!isBurner() || !this.fuelStack.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (world.getBlockState(backPos).isAir() && ((world.getTime() + this.pos.asLong()) & 7L) == 0L) {
            Box groundBox = new Box(backPos).expand(0.35, 0.5, 0.35);
            var groundItems = world.getEntitiesByClass(
                    ItemEntity.class, groundBox,
                    item -> item.isAlive() && !item.getStack().isEmpty() && AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(item.getStack()));

            for (ItemEntity itemEntity : groundItems) {
                ItemStack groundStack = itemEntity.getStack();
                this.fuelStack = groundStack.split(1);
                if (groundStack.isEmpty()) {
                    itemEntity.discard();
                } else {
                    itemEntity.setStack(groundStack);
                }
                ensureBurnerFuel();
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
        BlockEntity backBe = world.getBlockEntity(backPos);
        if (backBe instanceof BeltBlockEntity backBelt) {
            BeltLane[] lanes = { backBelt.getLeftLane(), backBelt.getRightLane() };
            for (BeltLane lane : lanes) {
                for (int slot = 3; slot >= 0; slot--) {
                    if (lane.hasItemAt(slot) && AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(lane.getStack(slot))) {
                        this.fuelStack = lane.extractAt(slot);
                        BeltBlock.syncManualChange(world, backPos, backBelt.getCachedState(), backBelt);
                        ensureBurnerFuel();
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            Inventory backInv = getInventoryAt(world, backPos, false);
            if (backInv != null) {
                for (int i = 0; i < backInv.size(); i++) {
                    ItemStack stack = backInv.getStack(i);
                    if (!stack.isEmpty() && AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(stack)) {
                        if (backInv instanceof SidedInventory sided && !sided.canExtract(i, stack, Direction.DOWN)) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        this.fuelStack = backInv.removeStack(i, 1);
                        backInv.markDirty();
                        ensureBurnerFuel();
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (world == null || world.isClient()) return;

        if (this.sleeping) {
            // Ð‘Ñ‹ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¾Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ñ Ñ€Ð°Ð· Ð² 8 Ñ‚Ð¸ÐºÐ¾Ð² (0.4 ÑÐµÐº) Ð½Ð° ÑÐ»ÑƒÑ‡Ð°Ð¹ Ð¿Ð¾ÑÐ²Ð»ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ñ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚Ð¾Ð² Ð½Ð° Ð·ÐµÐ¼Ð»Ðµ
            if (((world.getTime() + pos.asLong()) & 7L) != 0L) {
                return;
            }
            this.sleeping = false;
        }

        Direction facing = state.get(InserterBlock.FACING);
        int reach = getReachDistance();
        BlockPos backPos = pos.offset(facing.getOpposite(), reach);
        BlockPos frontPos = pos.offset(facing, reach);

        if (isBurner() && this.fuelStack.isEmpty() && this.heldStack.isEmpty()) {
            trySelfRefuelFromSource(world, backPos);
        }

        if (isBurner() && !ensureBurnerFuel()) {
            this.sleeping = true;
            return;
        }
        if (!isBurner() && !hasElectricity()) {
            this.sleeping = true;
            return;
        }

        if (this.ticksUntilDelivery > 0) {
            if (isBurner() && this.burnTime > 0) this.burnTime--;
            this.ticksUntilDelivery--;
            return;
        }

        if (this.returnTicks > 0) {
            if (isBurner() && this.burnTime > 0) this.burnTime--;
            this.returnTicks--;
            return;
        }

        if (this.heldStack.isEmpty() && world.getBlockState(backPos).isAir() && ((world.getTime() + pos.asLong()) & 7L) == 0L) {
            Box groundBox = new Box(backPos).expand(0.35, 0.5, 0.35);
            var groundItems = world.getEntitiesByClass(
                    ItemEntity.class, groundBox, item -> item.isAlive() && !item.getStack().isEmpty());

            for (ItemEntity itemEntity : groundItems) {
                ItemStack groundStack = itemEntity.getStack();
                int allowed = getAllowedCountForTarget(world, frontPos, groundStack, getEffectivePickupCount());
                if (matchesFilter(groundStack) && allowed > 0) {
                    int takeCount = Math.min(allowed, groundStack.getCount());
                    this.heldStack = groundStack.split(takeCount);
                    if (groundStack.isEmpty()) {
                        itemEntity.discard();
                    } else {
                        itemEntity.setStack(groundStack);
                    }
                    if (isBurner() && this.burnTime > 0) this.burnTime--;
                    this.ticksUntilDelivery = getSwingDuration();
                    syncState();
                    return;
                }
            }
        }

        if (this.heldStack.isEmpty()) {
            BlockEntity backBe = world.getBlockEntity(backPos);

            if (backBe instanceof BeltBlockEntity backBelt) {
                ItemStack extracted = extractFromBelt(world, backPos, backBelt, frontPos, facing);
                if (!extracted.isEmpty()) {
                    if (isBurner() && this.burnTime > 0) this.burnTime--;
                    this.heldStack = extracted;
                    this.ticksUntilDelivery = getSwingDuration();
                    syncState();
                    return;
                }
            } else {
                Inventory backInv = getInventoryAt(world, backPos, false);
                if (backInv != null) {
                    ItemStack extracted = extractFromInventory(world, backInv, frontPos, getEffectivePickupCount());
                    if (!extracted.isEmpty()) {
                        if (isBurner() && this.burnTime > 0) this.burnTime--;
                        this.heldStack = extracted;
                        this.ticksUntilDelivery = getSwingDuration();
                        syncState();
                        return;
                    }
                }
            }

            this.sleeping = true;
        } else {
            BlockEntity frontBe = world.getBlockEntity(frontPos);

            if (frontBe instanceof BeltBlockEntity frontBelt) {
                if (insertOntoBelt(world, frontPos, frontBelt, facing, this.heldStack)) {
                    this.heldStack.decrement(1);
                    if (this.heldStack.isEmpty()) {
                        this.heldStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
                        this.returnTicks = getSwingDuration();
                    } else {
                        this.ticksUntilDelivery = isFastInserter() ? 1 : 2;
                    }
                    syncState();
                    return;
                }
            } else {
                Inventory frontInv = getInventoryAt(world, frontPos, true);
                if (frontInv != null) {
                    int before = this.heldStack.getCount();
                    this.heldStack = insertIntoInventory(frontInv, this.heldStack);
                    if (this.heldStack.isEmpty()) {
                        this.returnTicks = getSwingDuration();
                        syncState();
                        return;
                    } else if (this.heldStack.getCount() != before) {
                        syncState();
                    }
                } else if (world.getBlockState(frontPos).getCollisionShape(world, frontPos).isEmpty() && !hasItemOnGroundAt(world, frontPos)) {
                    ItemStack toDrop = this.heldStack.split(1);
                    if (this.heldStack.isEmpty()) {
                        this.heldStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
                    }

                    ItemEntity dropped = new ItemEntity(
                            world,
                            frontPos.getX() + 0.5,
                            frontPos.getY() + 0.15,
                            frontPos.getZ() + 0.5,
                            toDrop
                    );
                    dropped.setVelocity(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
                    dropped.setToDefaultPickupDelay();
                    world.spawnEntity(dropped);

                    if (this.heldStack.isEmpty()) {
                        this.returnTicks = getSwingDuration();
                    } else {
                        this.ticksUntilDelivery = isFastInserter() ? 2 : 4;
                    }
                    wakeUpAdjacentInserters(world, frontPos);
                    syncState();
                    return;
                }
            }

            this.sleeping = true;
        }
    }

    private int getAllowedCountForTarget(World world, BlockPos frontPos, ItemStack candidate, int maxRequested) {
        if (candidate.isEmpty()) return 0;

        BlockEntity frontBe = world.getBlockEntity(frontPos);
        if (frontBe instanceof BeltBlockEntity) {
            return 1;
        }

        Inventory frontInv = getInventoryAt(world, frontPos, true);
        if (frontInv == null) {
            if (world.getBlockState(frontPos).getCollisionShape(world, frontPos).isEmpty()) {
                return hasItemOnGroundAt(world, frontPos) ? 0 : 1;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        if (frontInv instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity factorioFurnace) {
            if (AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(candidate)) {
                return getRemainingSpaceInSlot(factorioFurnace, 1, candidate, BURNER_FUEL_LIMIT, maxRequested);
            } else {
                return getRemainingSpaceInSlot(factorioFurnace, 0, candidate, FURNACE_INPUT_LIMIT, maxRequested);
            }
        }

        if (frontInv instanceof InserterBlockEntity burnerTarget && burnerTarget.isBurner()) {
            if (!AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(candidate)) {
                return 0;
            }
            return getRemainingSpaceInSlot(burnerTarget, FUEL_SLOT_INDEX, candidate, BURNER_FUEL_LIMIT, maxRequested);
        }

        if (frontInv instanceof BurnerDrillBlockEntity drillTarget) {
            if (!AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(candidate)) {
                return 0;
            }
            return getRemainingSpaceInSlot(drillTarget.getMaster(), 0, candidate, BURNER_FUEL_LIMIT, maxRequested);
        }

        if (frontInv instanceof AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity furnace) {
            if (AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(candidate)) {
                return getRemainingSpaceInSlot(furnace, 1, candidate, BURNER_FUEL_LIMIT, maxRequested);
            } else {
                return getRemainingSpaceInSlot(furnace, 0, candidate, FURNACE_INPUT_LIMIT, maxRequested);
            }
        }

        int totalSpace = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < frontInv.size(); i++) {
            if (!frontInv.isValid(i, candidate)) continue;
            ItemStack current = frontInv.getStack(i);
            if (current.isEmpty()) {
                return maxRequested;
            } else if (ItemStack.areItemsAndComponentsEqual(current, candidate)) {
                int maxSlot = Math.min(frontInv.getMaxCount(candidate), current.getMaxCount());
                totalSpace += Math.max(0, maxSlot - current.getCount());
                if (totalSpace >= maxRequested) {
                    return maxRequested;
                }
            }
        }
        return Math.min(totalSpace, maxRequested);
    }

    private int getRemainingSpaceInSlot(Inventory inv, int slot, ItemStack candidate, int factorioLimit, int maxRequested) {
        if (!inv.isValid(slot, candidate)) {
            return 0;
        }
        ItemStack current = inv.getStack(slot);
        int cap = Math.min(factorioLimit, Math.min(inv.getMaxCount(candidate), candidate.getMaxCount()));
        if (current.isEmpty()) {
            return Math.min(cap, maxRequested);
        }
        if (ItemStack.areItemsAndComponentsEqual(current, candidate)) {
            int space = cap - current.getCount();
            return space > 0 ? Math.min(space, maxRequested) : 0;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    private boolean matchesFilter(ItemStack candidate) {
        if (isBurner() || !this.filterEnabled) {
            return true;
        }
        boolean anyFilterConfigured = false;
        boolean matched = false;

        for (int i = 0; i < FILTER_SLOTS_COUNT; i++) {
            ItemStack filter = this.filterSlots.get(i);
            if (!filter.isEmpty()) {
                anyFilterConfigured = true;
                if (ItemStack.areItemsEqual(candidate, filter)) {
                    matched = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        if (!anyFilterConfigured) {
            return true;
        }
        return this.blacklistMode ? !matched : matched;
    }

    private ItemStack extractFromBelt(World world, BlockPos beltPos, BeltBlockEntity belt,
                                      BlockPos frontPos, Direction inserterFacing) {
        Direction beltFacing = belt.getCachedState().get(BeltBlock.FACING);

        BeltLane firstLane;
        BeltLane secondLane;

        if (beltFacing == inserterFacing.rotateYClockwise()) {
            firstLane = belt.getRightLane();
            secondLane = belt.getLeftLane();
        } else if (beltFacing == inserterFacing.rotateYCounterclockwise()) {
            firstLane = belt.getLeftLane();
            secondLane = belt.getRightLane();
        } else {
            firstLane = belt.getLeftLane();
            secondLane = belt.getRightLane();
        }

        int[] slotOrder = (beltFacing == inserterFacing)
                ? new int[]{ 3, 2, 1, 0 }
                : new int[]{ 2, 1, 3, 0 };

        ItemStack extracted = tryExtractFromLane(world, firstLane, slotOrder, frontPos);
        if (extracted.isEmpty()) {
            extracted = tryExtractFromLane(world, secondLane, slotOrder, frontPos);
        }

        if (!extracted.isEmpty()) {
            BeltBlock.syncManualChange(world, beltPos, belt.getCachedState(), belt);
        }
        return extracted;
    }

    private ItemStack tryExtractFromLane(World world, BeltLane lane, int[] slotOrder, BlockPos frontPos) {
        for (int slot : slotOrder) {
            if (lane.hasItemAt(slot)) {
                ItemStack candidate = lane.getStack(slot);
                if (matchesFilter(candidate) && getAllowedCountForTarget(world, frontPos, candidate, 1) > 0) {
                    return lane.extractAt(slot);
                }
            }
        }
        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
    }

    private boolean insertOntoBelt(World world, BlockPos beltPos, BeltBlockEntity belt,
                                   Direction inserterFacing, ItemStack stackToInsert) {
        Direction beltFacing = belt.getCachedState().get(BeltBlock.FACING);
        boolean inserted = false;

        if (beltFacing == inserterFacing.rotateYClockwise()) {
            BeltLane farLane = belt.getLeftLane();
            inserted = farLane.insertAt(2, stackToInsert) || farLane.insertAt(1, stackToInsert);
        } else if (beltFacing == inserterFacing.rotateYCounterclockwise()) {
            BeltLane farLane = belt.getRightLane();
            inserted = farLane.insertAt(2, stackToInsert) || farLane.insertAt(1, stackToInsert);
        } else if (beltFacing == inserterFacing) {
            BeltLane right = belt.getRightLane();
            inserted = right.insertAt(0, stackToInsert) || right.insertAt(1, stackToInsert);
        } else if (beltFacing == inserterFacing.getOpposite()) {
            BeltLane left = belt.getLeftLane();
            inserted = left.insertAt(3, stackToInsert) || left.insertAt(2, stackToInsert);
        }

        if (inserted) {
            BeltBlock.syncManualChange(world, beltPos, belt.getCachedState(), belt);
        }
        return inserted;
    }

    @Nullable
    private Inventory getInventoryAt(World world, BlockPos targetPos, boolean forInsertion) {
        BlockState state = world.getBlockState(targetPos);
        Block block = state.getBlock();

        BlockPos canonicalPos = BlockHealthManager.getCanonicalPos(targetPos, state);
        if (block instanceof ChestBlock chestBlock && world.getBlockEntity(canonicalPos) instanceof ChestBlockEntity) {
            Inventory chestInv = ChestBlock.getInventory(chestBlock, state, world, targetPos, true);
            if (chestInv != null) {
                return chestInv;
            }
        }

        BlockEntity be = world.getBlockEntity(canonicalPos);
        if (be instanceof BeltBlockEntity) {
            return null;
        }
        if (be instanceof InserterBlockEntity targetInserter) {
            return (forInsertion && targetInserter.isBurner()) ? targetInserter : null;
        }
        return (be instanceof Inventory inv) ? inv : null;
    }

    private ItemStack extractFromInventory(World world, Inventory inv, BlockPos frontPos, int amount) {
        if (inv instanceof InserterBlockEntity) {
            return ItemStack.EMPTY;
        }
        if (inv instanceof AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity furnace) {
            ItemStack output = furnace.getStack(2);
            if (!output.isEmpty() && matchesFilter(output)) {
                int allowed = getAllowedCountForTarget(world, frontPos, output, amount);
                if (allowed > 0) {
                    int toTake = Math.min(allowed, output.getMaxCount());
                    ItemStack extracted = furnace.removeStack(2, toTake);
                    furnace.markDirty();
                    return extracted;
                }
            }
            ItemStack fuel = furnace.getStack(1);
            if (fuel.isOf(Items.BUCKET) && matchesFilter(fuel)) {
                if (getAllowedCountForTarget(world, frontPos, fuel, 1) > 0) {
                    ItemStack extracted = furnace.removeStack(1, 1);
                    furnace.markDirty();
                    return extracted;
                }
            }
            return ItemStack.EMPTY;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < inv.size(); i++) {
            ItemStack stack = inv.getStack(i);
            if (!stack.isEmpty() && matchesFilter(stack)) {
                if (inv instanceof SidedInventory sidedInv && !sidedInv.canExtract(i, stack, Direction.DOWN)) {
                    continue;
                }
                int allowed = getAllowedCountForTarget(world, frontPos, stack, amount);
                if (allowed <= 0) {
                    continue;
                }
                int toTake = Math.min(allowed, stack.getMaxCount());
                ItemStack extracted = inv.removeStack(i, toTake);
                inv.markDirty();
                return extracted;
            }
        }
        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
    }

    private ItemStack insertIntoInventory(Inventory inv, ItemStack stack) {
        ItemStack remaining = stack.copy();

        if (inv instanceof BurnerDrillBlockEntity drillTarget) {
            if (AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(remaining)) {
                return tryInsertIntoSlotWithLimit(drillTarget.getMaster(), 0, remaining, BURNER_FUEL_LIMIT);
            }
            return remaining;
        }

        if (inv instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity factorioFurnace) {
            if (AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(remaining)) {
                return tryInsertIntoSlotWithLimit(factorioFurnace, 1, remaining, BURNER_FUEL_LIMIT);
            } else {
                return tryInsertIntoSlotWithLimit(factorioFurnace, 0, remaining, FURNACE_INPUT_LIMIT);
            }
        }

        if (inv instanceof InserterBlockEntity burnerTarget && burnerTarget.isBurner()) {
            if (AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(remaining)) {
                return tryInsertIntoSlotWithLimit(burnerTarget, FUEL_SLOT_INDEX, remaining, BURNER_FUEL_LIMIT);
            }
            return remaining;
        }

        if (inv instanceof AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity furnace) {
            if (AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(remaining)) {
                remaining = tryInsertIntoSlotWithLimit(furnace, 1, remaining, BURNER_FUEL_LIMIT);
            } else {
                remaining = tryInsertIntoSlotWithLimit(furnace, 0, remaining, FURNACE_INPUT_LIMIT);
            }
            return remaining;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < inv.size(); i++) {
            if (!inv.isValid(i, remaining)) {
                continue;
            }
            remaining = tryInsertIntoSlotWithLimit(inv, i, remaining, remaining.getMaxCount());
            if (remaining.isEmpty()) {
                return ItemStack.EMPTY;
            }
        }
        return remaining;
    }

    private ItemStack tryInsertIntoSlotWithLimit(Inventory inv, int slot, ItemStack remaining, int customLimit) {
        if (remaining.isEmpty() || !inv.isValid(slot, remaining)) {
            return remaining;
        }
        ItemStack current = inv.getStack(slot);
        int maxAllowed = Math.min(customLimit, Math.min(inv.getMaxCount(remaining), remaining.getMaxCount()));

        if (current.isEmpty()) {
            int toMove = Math.min(remaining.getCount(), maxAllowed);
            if (toMove > 0) {
                inv.setStack(slot, remaining.split(toMove));
                inv.markDirty();
            }
        } else if (ItemStack.areItemsAndComponentsEqual(current, remaining)) {
            int space = maxAllowed - current.getCount();
            int toMove = Math.min(space, remaining.getCount());
            if (toMove > 0) {
                current.increment(toMove);
                remaining.decrement(toMove);
                inv.markDirty();
            }
        }
        return remaining;
    }

    private void syncState() {
        markDirty();
        if (this.world != null) {
            this.world.updateListeners(this.pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int size() {
        return FILTER_SLOTS_COUNT + 2;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isValid(int slot, ItemStack stack) {
        if (slot == FUEL_SLOT_INDEX) {
            return isBurner() && AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(stack);
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isEmpty() {
        for (ItemStack s : this.filterSlots) {
            if (!s.isEmpty()) return false;
        }
        return this.heldStack.isEmpty() && this.fuelStack.isEmpty();
    }

    @Override
    public ItemStack getStack(int slot) {
        if (slot >= 0 && slot < FILTER_SLOTS_COUNT) {
            return this.filterSlots.get(slot);
        } else if (slot == HAND_SLOT_INDEX) {
            return this.heldStack;
        } else if (slot == FUEL_SLOT_INDEX) {
            return this.fuelStack;
        }
        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
    }

    @Override
    public ItemStack removeStack(int slot, int amount) {
        if (slot >= 0 && slot < FILTER_SLOTS_COUNT) {
            ItemStack result = this.filterSlots.get(slot).split(amount);
            this.wakeUp();
            syncState();
            return result;
        } else if (slot == HAND_SLOT_INDEX) {
            ItemStack result = this.heldStack.split(amount);
            if (this.heldStack.isEmpty()) {
                this.heldStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
                this.ticksUntilDelivery = 0;
            }
            this.wakeUp();
            syncState();
            return result;
        } else if (slot == FUEL_SLOT_INDEX) {
            ItemStack result = this.fuelStack.split(amount);
            if (this.fuelStack.isEmpty()) {
                this.fuelStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
            }
            this.wakeUp();
            syncState();
            return result;
        }
        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
    }

    @Override
    public ItemStack removeStack(int slot) {
        if (slot >= 0 && slot < FILTER_SLOTS_COUNT) {
            ItemStack result = this.filterSlots.set(slot, ItemStack.EMPTY);
            this.wakeUp();
            syncState();
            return result;
        } else if (slot == HAND_SLOT_INDEX) {
            ItemStack result = this.heldStack;
            this.heldStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
            this.ticksUntilDelivery = 0;
            this.wakeUp();
            syncState();
            return result;
        } else if (slot == FUEL_SLOT_INDEX) {
            ItemStack result = this.fuelStack;
            this.fuelStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
            this.wakeUp();
            syncState();
            return result;
        }
        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
    }

    @Override
    public void setStack(int slot, ItemStack stack) {
        if (slot >= 0 && slot < FILTER_SLOTS_COUNT) {
            this.filterSlots.set(slot, stack);
            if (!stack.isEmpty()) {
                this.filterEnabled = true;
            }
        } else if (slot == HAND_SLOT_INDEX) {
            this.heldStack = stack;
            if (stack.isEmpty()) {
                this.ticksUntilDelivery = 0;
            }
        } else if (slot == FUEL_SLOT_INDEX) {
            this.fuelStack = stack;
        }
        this.wakeUp();
        syncState();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canPlayerUse(PlayerEntity player) {
        return Inventory.canPlayerUse(this, player);
    }

    @Override
    public void clear() {
        this.filterSlots.clear();
        this.heldStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        this.fuelStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        this.wakeUp();
        syncState();
    }

    @Override
    public Text getDisplayName() {
        return getCachedState().getBlock().getName();
    }

    @Override
    public ScreenHandler createMenu(int syncId, PlayerInventory playerInventory, PlayerEntity player) {
        if (isBurner()) {
            return new BurnerInserterScreenHandler(syncId, playerInventory, this, this.burnerPropertyDelegate);
        }
        return new InserterScreenHandler(syncId, playerInventory, this, this.propertyDelegate);
    }

    @Override
    public BlockPos getScreenOpeningData(ServerPlayerEntity player) {
        return this.pos;
    }

    @Override
    protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registryLookup) {
        super.writeNbt(nbt, registryLookup);
        if (!heldStack.isEmpty()) {
            nbt.put("HeldStack", heldStack.encode(registryLookup));
        }
        if (!fuelStack.isEmpty()) {
            nbt.put("FuelStack", fuelStack.encode(registryLookup));
        }
        nbt.putInt("BurnTime", burnTime);
        nbt.putInt("MaxBurnTime", maxBurnTime);

        NbtList filterList = new NbtList();
        for (int i = 0; i < FILTER_SLOTS_COUNT; i++) {
            ItemStack s = this.filterSlots.get(i);
            if (!s.isEmpty()) {
                NbtCompound entry = new NbtCompound();
                entry.putByte("Slot", (byte) i);
                entry.put("Stack", s.encode(registryLookup));
                filterList.add(entry);
            }
        }
        nbt.put("Filters", filterList);

        nbt.putInt("MaxPickupCount", maxPickupCount);
        nbt.putBoolean("FilterEnabled", filterEnabled);
        nbt.putBoolean("BlacklistMode", blacklistMode);
        nbt.putBoolean("OverrideStackSize", overrideStackSize);
        nbt.putInt("TicksUntilDelivery", ticksUntilDelivery);
        nbt.putInt("ReturnTicks", returnTicks);
        nbt.putBoolean("Sleeping", sleeping);
    }

    @Override
    protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registryLookup) {
        super.readNbt(nbt, registryLookup);
        boolean wasEmpty = this.heldStack.isEmpty();

        if (nbt.contains("HeldStack")) {
            this.heldStack = ItemStack.fromNbtOrEmpty(registryLookup, nbt.getCompound("HeldStack"));
        } else {
            this.heldStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        }
        if (nbt.contains("FuelStack")) {
            this.fuelStack = ItemStack.fromNbtOrEmpty(registryLookup, nbt.getCompound("FuelStack"));
        } else {
            this.fuelStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        }
        this.burnTime = nbt.getInt("BurnTime");
        this.maxBurnTime = nbt.getInt("MaxBurnTime");

        this.filterSlots.clear();
        if (nbt.contains("Filters", NbtElement.LIST_TYPE)) {
            NbtList filterList = nbt.getList("Filters", NbtElement.COMPOUND_TYPE);
            for (int i = 0; i < filterList.size(); i++) {
                NbtCompound entry = filterList.getCompound(i);
                int slot = entry.getByte("Slot");
                if (slot >= 0 && slot < FILTER_SLOTS_COUNT && entry.contains("Stack")) {
                    this.filterSlots.set(slot, ItemStack.fromNbtOrEmpty(registryLookup, entry.getCompound("Stack")));
                }
            }
        }

        this.maxPickupCount = Math.max(1, Math.min(MAX_STACK_CAPACITY, nbt.getInt("MaxPickupCount")));
        this.filterEnabled = nbt.getBoolean("FilterEnabled");
        this.blacklistMode = nbt.getBoolean("BlacklistMode");
        this.overrideStackSize = nbt.getBoolean("OverrideStackSize");
        this.ticksUntilDelivery = nbt.getInt("TicksUntilDelivery");
        this.returnTicks = nbt.getInt("ReturnTicks");
        this.sleeping = nbt.getBoolean("Sleeping");

        if (this.world != null && this.world.isClient()) {
            int duration = getSwingDuration();
            if (!this.heldStack.isEmpty() && wasEmpty) {
                this.clientSwingTicks = Math.max(0, duration - this.ticksUntilDelivery);
                this.clientReturnTicks = 0;
            } else if (this.heldStack.isEmpty() && !wasEmpty) {
                this.clientSwingTicks = 0;
                this.clientReturnTicks = this.returnTicks > 0 ? this.returnTicks : duration;
            }
        }
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public Packet<ClientPlayPacketListener> toUpdatePacket() {
        return BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket.create(this);
    }

    @Override
    public NbtCompound toInitialChunkDataNbt(RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        return createNbt(registries);
    }

    public ItemStack getHeldStack() {
        return heldStack;
    }

    public ItemStack getFuelStack() {
        return fuelStack;
    }

    public boolean isSleeping() {
        return sleeping;
    }
}

    public ItemStack quickMove(PlayerEntity player, int invSlot) {
        Slot slot = this.slots.get(invSlot);
        if (slot == null || !slot.hasStack()) {
            return ItemStack.EMPTY;
        }

        if (invSlot == 0) {
            ItemStack originalStack = slot.getStack();
            ItemStack newStack = originalStack.copy();
            if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, 6, this.slots.size(), true)) {
                return ItemStack.EMPTY;
            }
            if (originalStack.isEmpty()) {
                slot.setStack(ItemStack.EMPTY);
            } else {
                slot.markDirty();
            }
            return newStack;
        }

        if (invSlot >= 1 && invSlot <= InserterBlockEntity.FILTER_SLOTS_COUNT) {
            slot.setStack(ItemStack.EMPTY);
            slot.markDirty();
            return ItemStack.EMPTY;
        }

        ItemStack clickedStack = slot.getStack();
        for (int i = 1; i <= InserterBlockEntity.FILTER_SLOTS_COUNT; i++) {
            Slot filterSlot = this.slots.get(i);
            if (filterSlot.hasStack() && ItemStack.areItemsEqual(filterSlot.getStack(), clickedStack)) {
                return ItemStack.EMPTY;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= InserterBlockEntity.FILTER_SLOTS_COUNT; i++) {
            Slot filterSlot = this.slots.get(i);
            if (!filterSlot.hasStack()) {
                filterSlot.setStack(clickedStack.copyWithCount(1));
                filterSlot.markDirty();
                break;
            }
        }
        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canUse(PlayerEntity player) {
        return this.inventory.canPlayerUse(player);
    }

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.pavement;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.worldgen.NauvisChunkGenerator;
import net.minecraft.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.block.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity;
import net.minecraft.item.BlockItem;
import net.minecraft.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.item.ItemUsageContext;
import net.minecraft.item.tooltip.TooltipType;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundCategory;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundEvents;
import net.minecraft.text.Text;
import net.minecraft.util.ActionResult;
import net.minecraft.util.Hand;
import net.minecraft.util.TypedActionResult;
import net.minecraft.util.hit.BlockHitResult;
import net.minecraft.util.hit.HitResult;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.RaycastContext;
import net.minecraft.world.World;

import java.util.List;

public class LandfillItem extends BlockItem {

    public LandfillItem(Block block, Settings settings) {
        super(block, settings);
    }

    @Override
    public ActionResult useOnBlock(ItemUsageContext context) {
        PlayerEntity player = context.getPlayer();
        if (player != null) {
            TypedActionResult<ItemStack> res = use(context.getWorld(), player, context.getHand());
            if (res.getResult().isAccepted()) {
                return res.getResult();
            }
        }
        return ActionResult.PASS;
    }

    @Override
    public TypedActionResult<ItemStack> use(World world, PlayerEntity user, Hand hand) {
        ItemStack stack = user.getStackInHand(hand);
        BlockHitResult hit = raycast(world, user, RaycastContext.FluidHandling.SOURCE_ONLY);
        if (hit.getType() != HitResult.Type.BLOCK) {
            return TypedActionResult.pass(stack);
        }

        BlockPos hitPos = hit.getBlockPos();
        if (!isWaterOrAquaticPlant(world.getBlockState(hitPos)) && !isWaterOrAquaticPlant(world.getBlockState(hitPos.down()))) {
            BlockPos sidePos = hitPos.offset(hit.getSide());
            if (isWaterOrAquaticPlant(world.getBlockState(sidePos)) || isWaterOrAquaticPlant(world.getBlockState(sidePos.down()))) {
                hitPos = sidePos;
            }
        }

        int radius = user.isSneaking() ? 1 : 0;
        int placedCount = 0;

        for (int dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -radius; dz <= radius; dz++) {
                if (!user.isCreative() && stack.getCount() <= 0) {
                    break;
                }
                if (tryFillWaterAtXZ(world, hitPos.getX() + dx, hitPos.getZ() + dz, hitPos.getY())) {
                    placedCount++;
                    if (!user.isCreative()) {
                        stack.decrement(1);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (placedCount > 0) {
            world.playSound(null, hitPos, SoundEvents.BLOCK_GRAVEL_PLACE, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 0.9f, 0.95f);
            return TypedActionResult.success(stack, world.isClient());
        }
        return TypedActionResult.pass(stack);
    }

    private static boolean isWaterOrAquaticPlant(BlockState state) {
        return state.isOf(Blocks.WATER)
                || state.isOf(Blocks.SEAGRASS)
                || state.isOf(Blocks.TALL_SEAGRASS)
                || state.isOf(Blocks.KELP)
                || state.isOf(Blocks.KELP_PLANT)
                || state.isOf(Blocks.LILY_PAD);
    }

    private boolean tryFillWaterAtXZ(World world, int x, int z, int hintY) {
        int waterTopY = -999;
        int startSearchY = Math.max(hintY + 2, NauvisChunkGenerator.MAIN_PLAIN_Y);
        int endSearchY = Math.min(hintY - 6, NauvisChunkGenerator.SEA_LEVEL - 6);

        for (int y = startSearchY; y >= endSearchY; y--) {
            BlockState st = world.getBlockState(new BlockPos(x, y, z));
            if (st.isOf(Blocks.WATER) || st.isOf(Blocks.SEAGRASS) || st.isOf(Blocks.TALL_SEAGRASS) || st.isOf(Blocks.KELP)) {
                waterTopY = y;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (waterTopY == -999) {
            return false;
        }

        int targetSurfaceY = (waterTopY == NauvisChunkGenerator.SEA_LEVEL)
                ? NauvisChunkGenerator.MAIN_PLAIN_Y
                : waterTopY;

        BlockPos surfacePos = new BlockPos(x, targetSurfaceY, z);
        BlockState currentSurface = world.getBlockState(surfacePos);
        if (currentSurface.isOf(this.getBlock())) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!world.isClient) {
            BlockPos abovePos = surfacePos.up();
            if (world.getBlockState(abovePos).isOf(Blocks.LILY_PAD)) {
                world.setBlockState(abovePos, Blocks.AIR.getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
            }
            if (currentSurface.isOf(Blocks.LILY_PAD)) {
                world.setBlockState(surfacePos, Blocks.AIR.getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
            }

            for (int y = targetSurfaceY - 1; y >= targetSurfaceY - 8; y--) {
                BlockPos belowPos = new BlockPos(x, y, z);
                if (isWaterOrAquaticPlant(world.getBlockState(belowPos))) {
                    world.setBlockState(belowPos, Blocks.DIRT.getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }

            world.setBlockState(surfacePos, this.getBlock().getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
        }
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void appendTooltip(ItemStack stack, TooltipContext context, List<Text> tooltip, TooltipType type) {
        tooltip.add(Text.translatable("block.factoriocore.landfill.desc"));
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.pavement;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.FactorioCore;
import net.minecraft.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.block.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.entity.attribute.EntityAttributeInstance;
import net.minecraft.entity.attribute.EntityAttributeModifier;
import net.minecraft.entity.attribute.EntityAttributes;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity;
import net.minecraft.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.item.tooltip.TooltipType;
import net.minecraft.text.Text;
import net.minecraft.util.Identifier;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;

import java.util.List;

public class PavementBlock extends Block {

    public static final Identifier PAVEMENT_SPEED_ID = Identifier.of(FactorioCore.MOD_ID, "pavement_speed_bonus");

    private final int speedBonusPercent;

    public PavementBlock(Settings settings, int speedBonusPercent) {
        super(settings);
        this.speedBonusPercent = speedBonusPercent;
    }

    public int getSpeedBonusPercent() {
        return this.speedBonusPercent;
    }

    public double getAttributeMultiplier() {
        return (this.speedBonusPercent - 100) / 100.0; // +0.30, +0.40 Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ +0.50
    }

    /**
     * ÐžÐ±Ð½Ð¾Ð²Ð»ÑÐµÑ‚ Ð¼Ð¾Ð´Ð¸Ñ„Ð¸ÐºÐ°Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ€ ÑÐºÐ¾Ñ€Ð¾ÑÑ‚Ð¸ Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÐ° ÐºÐ°Ð¶Ð´Ñ‹Ð¹ Ñ‚Ð¸Ðº:
     * Ð”Ð°Ñ‘Ñ‚ +30% / +40% / +50% Ðº ÑÐºÐ¾Ñ€Ð¾ÑÑ‚Ð¸ Ð±ÐµÐ³Ð° Ð¿Ñ€Ð¸ 100% ÑÑ‚Ð°Ð½Ð´Ð°Ñ€Ñ‚Ð½Ð¾Ð¼ ÑÑ†ÐµÐ¿Ð»ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ð¸ Ñ Ð·ÐµÐ¼Ð»Ñ‘Ð¹ (Ð½Ð¸ÐºÐ°ÐºÐ¾Ð³Ð¾ ÑÐºÐ¾Ð»ÑŒÐ¶ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ñ!).
     */
    public static void updatePlayerPavementSpeed(PlayerEntity player) {
        EntityAttributeInstance attr = player.getAttributeInstance(EntityAttributes.GENERIC_MOVEMENT_SPEED);
        if (attr == null) return;

        BlockPos underPos = player.getSteppingPos();
        BlockState underState = player.getWorld().getBlockState(underPos);
        if (!(underState.getBlock() instanceof PavementBlock)) {
            underState = player.getWorld().getBlockState(player.getBlockPos().down());
        }

        if (underState.getBlock() instanceof PavementBlock pavement) {
            double targetBonus = pavement.getAttributeMultiplier();
            EntityAttributeModifier existing = attr.getModifier(PAVEMENT_SPEED_ID);
            if (existing == null || Math.abs(existing.value() - targetBonus) > 0.001) {
                attr.removeModifier(PAVEMENT_SPEED_ID);
                attr.addTemporaryModifier(new EntityAttributeModifier(
                        PAVEMENT_SPEED_ID,
                        targetBonus,
                        EntityAttributeModifier.Operation.ADD_MULTIPLIED_BASE
                ));
            }
        } else if (attr.hasModifier(PAVEMENT_SPEED_ID)) {
            attr.removeModifier(PAVEMENT_SPEED_ID);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void appendTooltip(ItemStack stack, Item.TooltipContext context, List<Text> tooltip, TooltipType options) {
        tooltip.add(Text.translatable("tooltip.factoriocore.pavement_speed", speedBonusPercent));
    }

    @Override
    protected float calcBlockBreakingDelta(net.minecraft.block.BlockState state, net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity player, net.minecraft.world.BlockView world, net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos pos) {
        return 0.15f;
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.pavement;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModBlocks;
import net.minecraft.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.block.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity;
import net.minecraft.item.BlockItem;
import net.minecraft.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.item.ItemUsageContext;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundCategory;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundEvents;
import net.minecraft.util.ActionResult;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.World;

public class PavementItem extends BlockItem {

    public PavementItem(Block block, Settings settings) {
        super(block, settings);
    }

    @Override
    public ActionResult useOnBlock(ItemUsageContext context) {
        World world = context.getWorld();
        BlockPos clickedPos = context.getBlockPos();
        PlayerEntity player = context.getPlayer();
        ItemStack stack = context.getStack();

        // Ð•ÑÐ»Ð¸ ÐºÐ»Ð¸ÐºÐ½ÑƒÐ»Ð¸ Ð¿Ð¾ Ñ‚Ñ€Ð°Ð²Ðµ/Ð¿Ð°Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ñ‚Ð½Ð¸ÐºÑƒ â€” Ð±ÐµÑ€Ñ‘Ð¼ ÑÐ°Ð¼ Ð±Ð»Ð¾Ðº Ð·ÐµÐ¼Ð»Ð¸ Ð¿Ð¾Ð´ Ð½Ð¸Ð¼Ð¸
        if (!isReplaceableGround(world.getBlockState(clickedPos)) && isReplaceableGround(world.getBlockState(clickedPos.down()))) {
            clickedPos = clickedPos.down();
        }

        if (isReplaceableGround(world.getBlockState(clickedPos))) {
            int radius = (player != null && player.isSneaking()) ? 1 : 0; // Shift = ÐºÐ¸ÑÑ‚ÑŒ 3x3
            int placed = 0;

            for (int dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
                for (int dz = -radius; dz <= radius; dz++) {
                    if (player != null && !player.isCreative() && stack.getCount() <= 0) {
                        break;
                    }
                    BlockPos targetPos = clickedPos.add(dx, 0, dz);
                    BlockState current = world.getBlockState(targetPos);

                    if (isReplaceableGround(current) && !current.isOf(this.getBlock())) {
                        if (!world.isClient) {
                            // Ð¡Ñ€ÐµÐ·Ð°ÐµÐ¼ Ð¼ÐµÐ»ÐºÑƒÑŽ Ñ‚Ñ€Ð°Ð²Ñƒ Ð½Ð°Ð´ Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ¾Ð¼ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¸ ÑƒÐºÐ»Ð°Ð´ÐºÐµ Ð±ÐµÑ‚Ð¾Ð½Ð°
                            BlockState above = world.getBlockState(targetPos.up());
                            if (above.isOf(Blocks.SHORT_GRASS) || above.isOf(Blocks.FERN) || above.isOf(Blocks.DEAD_BUSH)) {
                                world.setBlockState(targetPos.up(), Blocks.AIR.getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
                            }
                            world.setBlockState(targetPos, this.getBlock().getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
                        }
                        placed++;
                        if (player != null && !player.isCreative()) {
                            stack.decrement(1);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (placed > 0) {
                world.playSound(null, clickedPos, SoundEvents.BLOCK_STONE_PLACE, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 0.9f, 1.15f);
                return ActionResult.success(world.isClient);
            }
        }

        return super.useOnBlock(context);
    }

    public static boolean isReplaceableGround(BlockState state) {
        Block b = state.getBlock();
        return b == Blocks.GRASS_BLOCK
                || b == Blocks.DIRT
                || b == Blocks.COARSE_DIRT
                || b == Blocks.ROOTED_DIRT
                || b == Blocks.PODZOL
                || b == Blocks.MOSS_BLOCK
                || b == Blocks.MUD
                || b == Blocks.PACKED_MUD
                || b == Blocks.MUD_BRICKS
                || b == Blocks.DRIPSTONE_BLOCK
                || b == Blocks.SAND
                || b == Blocks.RED_SAND
                || b == Blocks.SANDSTONE
                || b == Blocks.RED_SANDSTONE
                || b == ModBlocks.LANDFILL
                || b instanceof PavementBlock;
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.splitter;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.belt.BeltBlock;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.belt.BeltBlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.block.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.block.ShapeContext;
import net.minecraft.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity;
import net.minecraft.item.ItemPlacementContext;
import net.minecraft.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.state.StateManager;
import net.minecraft.state.property.BooleanProperty;
import net.minecraft.util.ActionResult;
import net.minecraft.util.hit.BlockHitResult;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Direction;
import net.minecraft.util.shape.VoxelShape;
import net.minecraft.world.BlockView;
import net.minecraft.world.World;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

public class SplitterBlock extends BeltBlock {
    public static final BooleanProperty PART_RIGHT = BooleanProperty.of("part_right");
    private static final VoxelShape SPLITTER_SHAPE = Block.createCuboidShape(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 11.0, 16.0);

    public SplitterBlock(Settings settings, int tier) {
        super(settings, tier, false);
        this.setDefaultState(this.stateManager.getDefaultState()
                .with(FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                .with(PART_RIGHT, false));
    }

    @Override
    protected void appendProperties(StateManager.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
        builder.add(FACING, PART_RIGHT);
    }

    @Override
    protected VoxelShape getOutlineShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        return SPLITTER_SHAPE;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockState getPlacementState(ItemPlacementContext ctx) {
        Direction facing = ctx.getHorizontalPlayerFacing(); if (ctx.getPlayer() != null && ctx.getPlayer().isSneaking()) { facing = facing.getOpposite(); }
        BlockPos rightPos = ctx.getBlockPos().offset(facing.rotateYClockwise());
        World world = ctx.getWorld();

        if (world.getBlockState(rightPos).canReplace(ctx) && world.getWorldBorder().contains(rightPos)) {
            return this.getDefaultState().with(FACING, facing).with(PART_RIGHT, false);
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public void onPlaced(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, @Nullable LivingEntity placer, ItemStack itemStack) {
        super.onPlaced(world, pos, state, placer, itemStack);
        if (!world.isClient && !state.get(PART_RIGHT)) {
            Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
            BlockPos rightPos = pos.offset(facing.rotateYClockwise());
            world.setBlockState(rightPos, state.with(PART_RIGHT, true), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public BlockState onBreak(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, PlayerEntity player) {
        if (!world.isClient) {
            Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
            boolean isRight = state.get(PART_RIGHT);
            BlockPos otherPos = isRight
                    ? pos.offset(facing.rotateYCounterclockwise())
                    : pos.offset(facing.rotateYClockwise());
            BlockState otherState = world.getBlockState(otherPos);
            if (otherState.isOf(this) && otherState.get(PART_RIGHT) != isRight) {
                world.setBlockState(otherPos, Blocks.AIR.getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL | Block.SKIP_DROPS);
            }
        }
        return super.onBreak(world, pos, state, player);
    }

    @Override
    protected ActionResult onUse(BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos, PlayerEntity player, BlockHitResult hit) {
        if (!player.isSneaking() && world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof BeltBlockEntity beltEntity) {
            if (!world.isClient) {
                player.openHandledScreen(beltEntity.getMasterSplitter());
            }
            return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
        }
        return super.onUse(state, world, pos, player, hit);
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.splitter;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.belt.BeltBlockEntity;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModScreenHandlers;

        filterSlot.setStack(slot.getStack().copyWithCount(1));
        filterSlot.markDirty();
        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
    }

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.underground;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.belt.BeltBlock;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.belt.BeltBlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.block.BlockState;

import net.minecraft.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity;

import net.minecraft.state.property.BooleanProperty;

import net.minecraft.util.ActionResult;
import net.minecraft.util.hit.BlockHitResult;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Direction;
import net.minecraft.util.shape.VoxelShape;
import net.minecraft.world.BlockView;
import net.minecraft.world.World;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

public class UndergroundBeltBlock extends BeltBlock {
    public static final BooleanProperty OUTPUT = BooleanProperty.of("output");
    private static final VoxelShape UNDERGROUND_SHAPE = Block.createCuboidShape(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 14.0, 16.0);

    public UndergroundBeltBlock(Settings settings, int tier) {
        super(settings, tier, true);
        this.setDefaultState(this.stateManager.getDefaultState()
                .with(FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                .with(OUTPUT, false));
    }

    @Override
    protected void appendProperties(StateManager.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
        builder.add(FACING, OUTPUT);
    }

    @Override
    protected VoxelShape getOutlineShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        return UNDERGROUND_SHAPE;
    }

    @Override
    public void onPlaced(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, @Nullable LivingEntity placer, ItemStack itemStack) {
        super.onPlaced(world, pos, state, placer, itemStack);
        if (!world.isClient && world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof BeltBlockEntity beltEntity) {
            beltEntity.setBeltTier(this.getTier());
            Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
            boolean shouldBeOutput = hasUnpairedInputBehind(world, pos, facing, beltEntity.getMaxUndergroundOffset());
            beltEntity.setUndergroundMode(shouldBeOutput
                    ? BeltBlockEntity.UndergroundMode.OUTPUT
                    : BeltBlockEntity.UndergroundMode.INPUT);

            BlockState newState = state.with(OUTPUT, shouldBeOutput);
            world.setBlockState(pos, newState, Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
            syncManualChange(world, pos, newState, beltEntity);
        }
    }

    private boolean hasUnpairedInputBehind(World world, BlockPos pos, Direction facing, int maxOffset) {
        for (int d = 1; d <= maxOffset; d++) {
            BlockPos backPos = pos.offset(facing.getOpposite(), d);
            if (world.getBlockEntity(backPos) instanceof BeltBlockEntity other) {
                if (other.isUnderground() && other.getBeltTier() == this.getTier()) {
                    Direction otherFacing = other.getCachedState().get(FACING);
                    if (otherFacing == facing) {
                        return other.getUndergroundMode() == BeltBlockEntity.UndergroundMode.INPUT;
                    } else if (otherFacing == facing.getOpposite()) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    protected ActionResult onUse(BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos, PlayerEntity player, BlockHitResult hit) {
        if (player.isSneaking() && world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof BeltBlockEntity beltEntity) {
            if (world.isClient) return ActionResult.SUCCESS;

            boolean nextIsOutput = beltEntity.getUndergroundMode() == BeltBlockEntity.UndergroundMode.INPUT;
            beltEntity.setUndergroundMode(nextIsOutput
                    ? BeltBlockEntity.UndergroundMode.OUTPUT
                    : BeltBlockEntity.UndergroundMode.INPUT);

            BlockState updatedState = state.with(OUTPUT, nextIsOutput);
            world.setBlockState(pos, updatedState, Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
            syncManualChange(world, pos, updatedState, beltEntity);

            
            return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
        }
        return super.onUse(state, world, pos, player, hit);
    }
}

    public abstract static class Base3x3MachineBlock extends BlockWithEntity {
        public static final DirectionProperty FACING = Properties.HORIZONTAL_FACING;
        public static final IntProperty PART = IntProperty.of("part", 0, 8);
        public static final BooleanProperty UPPER = BooleanProperty.of("upper");

        private static final VoxelShape BOTTOM_SHAPE = Block.createCuboidShape(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 16.0, 16.0);
        private static final VoxelShape TOP_SHAPE = Block.createCuboidShape(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 20.0, 16.0);

        protected Base3x3MachineBlock(Settings settings) {
            super(settings);
            this.setDefaultState(this.stateManager.getDefaultState()
                    .with(FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                    .with(PART, 4)
                    .with(UPPER, false));
        }

        @Override
        protected void appendProperties(StateManager.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
            builder.add(FACING, PART, UPPER);
        }

        @Override
        protected VoxelShape getOutlineShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
            return state.get(UPPER) ? TOP_SHAPE : BOTTOM_SHAPE;
        }

        @Override
        protected VoxelShape getCollisionShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
            return state.get(UPPER) ? TOP_SHAPE : BOTTOM_SHAPE;
        }

        @Override
        protected BlockRenderType getRenderType(BlockState state) {
            return BlockRenderType.INVISIBLE;
        }

        @Override
        protected float getAmbientOcclusionLightLevel(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos) {
            return 1.0f;
        }

        @Override
        protected boolean isTransparent(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos) {
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        protected float calcBlockBreakingDelta(BlockState state, PlayerEntity player, BlockView world, BlockPos pos) {
            return 0.10f;
        }

        public static BlockPos getPartPos(BlockPos masterPos, Direction facing, int part, boolean upper) {
            int wOff = (part % 3) - 1;
            int dOff = (part / 3) - 1;
            Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
            BlockPos base = masterPos.offset(right, wOff).offset(facing, dOff);
            return upper ? base.up() : base;
        }

        public static BlockPos getMasterPos(BlockPos currentPos, BlockState state) {
            if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof Base3x3MachineBlock)) return currentPos;
            Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
            int part = state.get(PART);
            boolean upper = state.get(UPPER);
            int wOff = (part % 3) - 1;
            int dOff = (part / 3) - 1;
            Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
            BlockPos base = upper ? currentPos.down() : currentPos;
            return base.offset(right, -wOff).offset(facing, -dOff);
        }

        @Override
        public void onPlaced(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, @Nullable LivingEntity placer, ItemStack itemStack) {
            super.onPlaced(world, pos, state, placer, itemStack);
            if (!world.isClient && state.get(PART) == 4 && !state.get(UPPER)) {
                Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
                for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                    for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                        if (part == 4 && u == 0) continue;
                        BlockPos p = getPartPos(pos, facing, part, u == 1);
                        world.setBlockState(p, state.with(PART, part).with(UPPER, u == 1), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        @Override
        public BlockState onBreak(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, PlayerEntity player) {
            if (!world.isClient) {
                BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
                Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
                if (world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof Inventory invBe) {
                    ItemScatterer.spawn(world, masterPos, invBe);
                }
                for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                    for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                        BlockPos p = getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                        if (!p.equals(pos) && world.getBlockState(p).isOf(this)) {
                            world.setBlockState(p, Blocks.AIR.getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL | Block.SKIP_DROPS);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return super.onBreak(world, pos, state, player);
        }
    }

    public static class PumpjackBlock extends Base3x3MachineBlock {
        public static final MapCodec<PumpjackBlock> CODEC = createCodec(PumpjackBlock::new);

        public PumpjackBlock(Settings settings) {
            super(settings);
        }

        @Override
        protected MapCodec<? extends BlockWithEntity> getCodec() {
            return CODEC;
        }

        public static boolean hasOilInFootprint(World world, BlockPos originPos) {
            for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
                for (int dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) {
                    for (int dy = -2; dy <= 0; dy++) {
                        if (world.getBlockState(originPos.add(dx, dy, dz)).getBlock() instanceof CrudeOilDepositBlock) {
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        @Nullable
        @Override
        public BlockState getPlacementState(ItemPlacementContext ctx) {
            Direction facing = ctx.getHorizontalPlayerFacing().getOpposite();
            if (ctx.getPlayer() != null && ctx.getPlayer().isSneaking()) {
                facing = facing.getOpposite();
            }
            BlockPos masterPos = ctx.getBlockPos();
            World world = ctx.getWorld();

            for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                for (int yOff = 0; yOff <= 1; yOff++) {
                    BlockPos checkPos = getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, yOff == 1);
                    if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(checkPos) || !world.getBlockState(checkPos).canReplace(ctx)) {
                        return null;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!hasOilInFootprint(world, masterPos)) return null;
            return this.getDefaultState().with(FACING, facing).with(PART, 4).with(UPPER, false);
        }

        @Override
        protected ActionResult onUse(BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos, PlayerEntity player, BlockHitResult hit) {
            if (!world.isClient) {
                BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
                if (world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof PumpjackBlockEntity pj) {
                    player.openHandledScreen(pj);
                }
            }
            return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
        }

        @Nullable
        @Override
        public BlockEntity createBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
            return (state.get(PART) == 4 && !state.get(UPPER)) ? new PumpjackBlockEntity(pos, state) : null;
        }

        @Nullable
        @Override
        public <T extends BlockEntity> BlockEntityTicker<T> getTicker(World world, BlockState state, BlockEntityType<T> type) {
            if (state.get(PART) != 4 || state.get(UPPER)) return null;
            return validateTicker(type, ModBlocks.PUMPJACK_BLOCK_ENTITY,
                    world.isClient ? PumpjackBlockEntity::clientTick : PumpjackBlockEntity::tick);
        }
    }

    public static class PumpjackBlockEntity extends BlockEntity implements FactorioFluidContainer, NamedScreenHandlerFactory {
        public static final long POWER_CONSUMPTION_WATTS = 90_000L;
        public static final int CAPACITY_MB = 2000;
        public static final int OIL_PER_CYCLE_MB = 100;

        private int crudeOilMb = 0;
        private int progress = 0;
        private boolean powered = false;
        private boolean working = false;
        private float clientPhase = 0.0f;

        protected final PropertyDelegate propertyDelegate = new PropertyDelegate() {
            @Override
            public int get(int index) {
                return switch (index) {
                    case 0 -> OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_PUMPJACK;
                    case 1 -> 0;
                    case 2 -> progress;
                    case 3 -> 20;
                    case 4 -> powered ? 1 : 0;
                    case 5 -> working ? 1 : 0;
                    case 6 -> crudeOilMb;
                    default -> 0;
                };
            }
            @Override public void set(int index, int value) {}
            @Override public int size() { return 11; }
        };

        public PumpjackBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
            super(ModBlocks.PUMPJACK_BLOCK_ENTITY, pos, state);
        }

        public boolean isPowered() { return this.powered; }
        public boolean isWorking() { return this.working; }

        public float getClientBeamAngle(float tickDelta) {
            float p = this.working ? (this.clientPhase + tickDelta * 0.15f) : this.clientPhase;
            return (float) Math.sin(p) * 22.0f;
        }

        public static void clientTick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, PumpjackBlockEntity pj) {
            if (pj.working) {
                pj.clientPhase = (pj.clientPhase + 0.15f) % ((float) Math.PI * 2.0f);
            }
        }

        public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, PumpjackBlockEntity pj) {
            if (world == null || world.isClient) return;

            boolean hasPower = PowerNetworkManager.isMachinePowered(world, pos);
            boolean canPump = hasPower && pj.crudeOilMb + OIL_PER_CYCLE_MB <= CAPACITY_MB
                    && PumpjackBlock.hasOilInFootprint(world, pos);
            boolean dirty = false;

            if (canPump) {
                pj.progress++;
                if (pj.progress >= 20) {
                    pj.progress = 0;
                    pj.crudeOilMb = Math.min(CAPACITY_MB, pj.crudeOilMb + OIL_PER_CYCLE_MB);
                    dirty = true;
                }
            } else {
                pj.progress = 0;
            }

            if (pj.crudeOilMb > 0) {
                Direction facing = state.get(PumpjackBlock.FACING);
                Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
                BlockPos portOutPos = pos.offset(right, 1).offset(facing, 2);
                int pushed = FactorioFluidContainer.pushFluidToNeighbor(
                        world, portOutPos, facing.getOpposite(), FluidKind.CRUDE_OIL, Math.min(pj.crudeOilMb, 120), 25);
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    pj.crudeOilMb -= pushed;
                    dirty = true;
                }
            }

            if (pj.powered != hasPower || pj.working != canPump) {
                pj.powered = hasPower;
                pj.working = canPump;
                pj.sync();
            } else if (dirty && (world.getTime() & 3L) == 0L) {
                pj.sync();
            } else if (dirty) {
                pj.markDirty();
            }
        }

        public void sync() {
            markDirty();
            if (this.world != null && !this.world.isClient) {
                this.world.updateListeners(this.pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_LISTENERS);
            }
        }

        @Override public FluidKind getFluidKind() { return FluidKind.CRUDE_OIL; }
        @Override public int getFluidAmount() { return this.crudeOilMb; }
        @Override public int getFluidCapacity() { return CAPACITY_MB; }
        @Override public int getTemperatureC() { return 25; }
        @Override public boolean canAcceptFluid(FluidKind kind, Direction fromSide) { return false; }
        @Override public int insertFluid(FluidKind kind, int maxAmount, int tempC, Direction fromSide) { return 0; }

        @Override
        public Text getDisplayName() {
            return Text.translatable("block.factoriocore.pumpjack");
        }

        @Nullable
        @Override
        public ScreenHandler createMenu(int syncId, PlayerInventory playerInventory, PlayerEntity player) {
            return new OilMachineScreenHandler(syncId, playerInventory, new SimpleInventory(3), this.propertyDelegate);
        }

        @Override
        protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
            super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
            nbt.putInt("CrudeOilMb", this.crudeOilMb);
            nbt.putInt("Progress", this.progress);
            nbt.putBoolean("Powered", this.powered);
            nbt.putBoolean("Working", this.working);
        }

        @Override
        protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
            super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
            this.crudeOilMb = nbt.getInt("CrudeOilMb");
            this.progress = nbt.getInt("Progress");
            this.powered = nbt.getBoolean("Powered");
            this.working = nbt.getBoolean("Working");
        }

        @Nullable @Override public Packet<ClientPlayPacketListener> toUpdatePacket() { return BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket.create(this); }
        @Override public NbtCompound toInitialChunkDataNbt(RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) { return createNbt(registries); }
    }
