    private static void register(String id, Category cat, int row, ItemStack out, int ticks, Ingredient... ings) {
        Recipe r = new Recipe(id, cat, row, out, ticks, List.of(ings));
        ALL.add(r);
        BY_ID.put(id, r);
        BY_OUTPUT_ITEM.put(out.getItem(), r);
    }

    public static int getRecipeIndex(String id) {
        if (id == null || id.isEmpty()) return -1;
        init();
        for (int i = 0; i < ALL.size(); i++) {
            if (ALL.get(i).id().equals(id)) return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    public static String getRecipeIdByIndex(int index) {
        init();
        if (index >= 0 && index < ALL.size()) {
            return ALL.get(index).id();
        }
        return "";
    }

    public static Recipe getById(String id) {
        init();
        return BY_ID.get(id);
    }

    public static Recipe getByOutput(Item item) {
        init();
        return BY_OUTPUT_ITEM.get(item);
    }

    public static List<Recipe> getByCategory(Category category) {
        init();
        List<Recipe> list = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Recipe r : ALL) {
            if (r.category() == category && ResearchManager.isRecipeUnlocked(r.id())) {
                list.add(r);
            }
        }
        return list;
    }

    public static Map<Item, Integer> snapshotInventory(PlayerInventory inv) {
        Map<Item, Integer> map = new HashMap<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < inv.main.size(); i++) {
            ItemStack s = inv.main.get(i);
            if (!s.isEmpty()) {
                map.merge(s.getItem(), s.getCount(), Integer::sum);
            }
        }
        return map;
    }

    public static int getCraftableCount(PlayerInventory inv, Recipe recipe) {
        Map<Item, Integer> pool = snapshotInventory(inv);
        int crafts = 0;
        List<QueueStep> dummy = new ArrayList<>();
        while (crafts < 999 && tryConsumeOrSubcraftBatch(pool, recipe, 1, false, dummy, 0)) {
            crafts += recipe.output().getCount();
        }
        return crafts;
    }

    public static List<QueueStep> planAndConsume(PlayerInventory inv, Recipe targetRecipe, int requestedCrafts) {
        Map<Item, Integer> initialSnapshot = snapshotInventory(inv);

        int maxAffordable = 0;
        for (int test = 1; test <= requestedCrafts; test++) {
            Map<Item, Integer> testPool = new HashMap<>(initialSnapshot);
            List<QueueStep> testSteps = new ArrayList<>();
            if (tryConsumeOrSubcraftBatch(testPool, targetRecipe, test, true, testSteps, 0)) {
                maxAffordable = test;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }

        if (maxAffordable <= 0) {
            return Collections.emptyList();
        }

        Map<Item, Integer> simulatedPool = new HashMap<>(initialSnapshot);
        List<QueueStep> rawSteps = new ArrayList<>();
        tryConsumeOrSubcraftBatch(simulatedPool, targetRecipe, maxAffordable, true, rawSteps, 0);

        List<QueueStep> groupedSteps = consolidateStepsByFirstAppearance(rawSteps);

        for (Map.Entry<Item, Integer> entry : initialSnapshot.entrySet()) {
            Item item = entry.getKey();
            int before = entry.getValue();
            int after = simulatedPool.getOrDefault(item, 0);
            int toRemove = before - after;
            if (toRemove > 0) {
                removeFromPlayerInventory(inv, item, toRemove);
            }
        }

        for (Map.Entry<Item, Integer> entry : simulatedPool.entrySet()) {
            Item item = entry.getKey();
            int before = initialSnapshot.getOrDefault(item, 0);
            int after = entry.getValue();
            int surplus = after - before;
            if (surplus > 0) {
                inv.offerOrDrop(new ItemStack(item, surplus));
            }
        }

        return groupedSteps;
    }

    public static List<QueueStep> consolidateStepsByFirstAppearance(List<QueueStep> steps) {
        Map<String, List<QueueStep>> intermediatesById = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        List<QueueStep> finalTargets = new ArrayList<>();

        for (QueueStep step : steps) {
            if (step.deliverToPlayer()) {
                finalTargets.add(step);
            } else {
                intermediatesById.computeIfAbsent(step.recipe().id(), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(step);
            }
        }

        List<QueueStep> result = new ArrayList<>(steps.size());
        for (List<QueueStep> group : intermediatesById.values()) {
            result.addAll(group);
        }
        result.addAll(finalTargets);
        return result;
    }

    private static boolean tryConsumeOrSubcraftBatch(Map<Item, Integer> pool, Recipe recipe, int batchesNeeded,
                                                     boolean isTopLevelTarget, List<QueueStep> outSteps, int depth) {
        if (depth > 8 || batchesNeeded <= 0) return false;

        for (Ingredient ing : recipe.ingredients()) {
            int needed = ing.count() * batchesNeeded;
            int have = pool.getOrDefault(ing.item(), 0);

            if (have >= needed) {
                pool.put(ing.item(), have - needed);
            } else {
                int missing = needed - have;
                pool.put(ing.item(), 0);

                Recipe subRecipe = getByOutput(ing.item());
                if (subRecipe == null) {
                    return false;
                }

                int subOutCount = subRecipe.output().getCount();
                int subBatchesNeeded = (missing + subOutCount - 1) / subOutCount;

                if (!tryConsumeOrSubcraftBatch(pool, subRecipe, subBatchesNeeded, false, outSteps, depth + 1)) {
                    return false;
                }

                int produced = subBatchesNeeded * subOutCount;
                int leftover = produced - missing;
                if (leftover > 0) {
                    pool.merge(ing.item(), leftover, Integer::sum);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < batchesNeeded; i++) {
            outSteps.add(new QueueStep(recipe, isTopLevelTarget));
        }
        return true;
    }

    private static void removeFromPlayerInventory(PlayerInventory inv, Item item, int amount) {
        int remaining = amount;
        for (int i = 0; i < inv.main.size() && remaining > 0; i++) {
            ItemStack s = inv.main.get(i);
            if (!s.isEmpty() && s.isOf(item)) {
                int take = Math.min(remaining, s.getCount());
                s.decrement(take);
                if (s.isEmpty()) {
                    inv.main.set(i, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                }
                remaining -= take;
            }
        }
        inv.markDirty();
    }

    public static Map<Item, Integer> calculateTotalRaw(Recipe recipe) {
        Map<Item, Integer> raw = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        accumulateRaw(recipe, 1.0, raw, 0);
        return raw;
    }

    private static void accumulateRaw(Recipe recipe, double multiplier, Map<Item, Integer> raw, int depth) {
        if (depth > 6) return;
        for (Ingredient ing : recipe.ingredients()) {
            Recipe sub = getByOutput(ing.item());
            if (sub != null) {
                double batches = (ing.count() * multiplier) / sub.output().getCount();
                accumulateRaw(sub, batches, raw, depth + 1);
            } else {
                int add = Math.max(1, (int) Math.ceil(ing.count() * multiplier));
                raw.merge(ing.item(), add, Integer::sum);
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.crafting;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModBlocks;

import java.util.ArrayList;

public class InventoryAutoSorter {

    public static void tickPlayerInventory(ServerPlayerEntity player) {
        // ÐÐµ ÑÐ¾Ñ€Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÐ¼, Ð¿Ð¾ÐºÐ° Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾Ðº Ð´ÐµÑ€Ð¶Ð¸Ñ‚ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚ Ð½Ð° ÐºÑƒÑ€ÑÐ¾Ñ€Ðµ Ð¼Ñ‹ÑˆÐ¸ Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ Ð¸ÑÐ¿Ð¾Ð»ÑŒÐ·ÑƒÐµÑ‚ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚
        if (!player.currentScreenHandler.getCursorStack().isEmpty() || player.isUsingItem()) {
            return;
        }

        PlayerInventory inv = player.getInventory();
        boolean changed = false;

        // Ð¨Ð°Ð³ 1. ÐžÐ±ÑŠÐµÐ´Ð¸Ð½ÑÐµÐ¼ Ð²ÑÐµ Ð½ÐµÐ¿Ð¾Ð»Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ ÑÑ‚Ð°ÐºÐ¸ Ð¾Ð´Ð¸Ð½Ð°ÐºÐ¾Ð²Ñ‹Ñ… Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚Ð¾Ð² Ð¿Ð¾ Ð²ÑÐµÐ¼Ñƒ Ð¸Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð°Ñ€ÑŽ (0..35)
        for (int i = 0; i < 36; i++) {
            ItemStack target = inv.main.get(i);
            if (target.isEmpty() || target.getCount() >= target.getMaxCount()) {
                continue;
            }
            for (int j = i + 1; j < 36; j++) {
                ItemStack source = inv.main.get(j);
                if (!source.isEmpty() && ItemStack.areItemsAndComponentsEqual(target, source)) {
                    int space = target.getMaxCount() - target.getCount();
                    int move = Math.min(space, source.getCount());
                    if (move > 0) {
                        target.increment(move);
                        source.decrement(move);
                        if (source.isEmpty()) {
                            inv.main.set(j, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                        }
                        changed = true;
                        if (target.getCount() >= target.getMaxCount()) {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Ð¨Ð°Ð³ 2. Ð¡Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÐ¼ Ð¸ ÑƒÐ¿Ð»Ð¾Ñ‚Ð½ÑÐµÐ¼ ÑÐ»Ð¾Ñ‚Ñ‹ Ð¸Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð°Ñ€Ñ (9..35), Ð° ÐµÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð² Ñ…Ð¾Ñ‚Ð±Ð°Ñ€Ðµ (0..8) Ð½ÐµÑ‚ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚Ð¾Ð² Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ Ð¾Ñ‚ÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ñ‚Ð¾ Ð¾ÐºÐ½Ð¾ â€” ÑƒÐ¿Ð»Ð¾Ñ‚Ð½ÑÐµÐ¼ Ð±ÐµÐ· Ð´Ñ‹Ñ€
        if (sortMainRange(inv, 9, 36)) {
            changed = true;
        }

        if (changed) {
            inv.markDirty();
            player.currentScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
            player.playerScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
        }
    }

    private static boolean sortMainRange(PlayerInventory inv, int startInclusive, int endExclusive) {
        List<ItemStack> nonEmpty = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = startInclusive; i < endExclusive; i++) {
            ItemStack s = inv.main.get(i);
            if (!s.isEmpty()) {
                nonEmpty.add(s.copy());
            }
        }

        if (nonEmpty.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }

        nonEmpty.sort(Comparator
                .comparingInt(InventoryAutoSorter::getCategoryOrder)
                .thenComparingInt((ItemStack s) -> getFactorioRecipeOrder(s.getItem())).thenComparing(s -> Registries.ITEM.getId(s.getItem()).toString())
                .thenComparing((ItemStack s) -> -s.getCount()));

        // ÐŸÑ€Ð¾Ð²ÐµÑ€ÑÐµÐ¼, Ð¾Ñ‚Ð»Ð¸Ñ‡Ð°ÐµÑ‚ÑÑ Ð»Ð¸ Ð½Ð¾Ð²Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€ÑÐ´Ð¾Ðº Ð¾Ñ‚ Ñ‚ÐµÐºÑƒÑ‰ÐµÐ³Ð¾ (Ñ‡Ñ‚Ð¾Ð±Ñ‹ Ð½Ðµ ÑÐ»Ð°Ñ‚ÑŒ Ð»Ð¸ÑˆÐ½Ð¸Ðµ Ð¿Ð°ÐºÐµÑ‚Ñ‹, ÐµÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð²ÑÑ‘ ÑƒÐ¶Ðµ Ð¾Ñ‚ÑÐ¾Ñ€Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ€Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¾)
        boolean anyDiff = false;
        for (int i = startInclusive; i < endExclusive; i++) {
            int listIdx = i - startInclusive;
            ItemStack expected = (listIdx < nonEmpty.size()) ? nonEmpty.get(listIdx) : ItemStack.EMPTY;
            ItemStack current = inv.main.get(i);
            if (!ItemStack.areEqual(current, expected)) {
                anyDiff = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!anyDiff) {
            return false;
        }

        for (int i = startInclusive; i < endExclusive; i++) {
            int listIdx = i - startInclusive;
            inv.main.set(i, (listIdx < nonEmpty.size()) ? nonEmpty.get(listIdx) : ItemStack.EMPTY);
        }
        return true;
    }

        public static int getFactorioRecipeOrder(Item item) {
        FactorioRecipes.init();
        for (int i = 0; i < FactorioRecipes.ALL.size(); i++) {
            if (FactorioRecipes.ALL.get(i).output().isOf(item)) {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return 1000;
    }

    public static int getCategoryOrder(ItemStack stack) {
        Item item = stack.getItem();
        FactorioRecipes.Recipe r = FactorioRecipes.getByOutput(item);
        if (r != null) {
            return switch (r.category()) {
                case LOGISTICS -> 1;
                case PRODUCTION -> 2;
                case INTERMEDIATE -> 3;
                case COMBAT -> 4;
            };
        }
        if (item == ModItems.STEEL_PLATE || item == ModItems.IRON_GEAR_WHEEL
                || item == ModItems.COPPER_CABLE || item == ModItems.ELECTRONIC_CIRCUIT || item == ModItems.IRON_STICK) {
            return 3;
        }
        if (item instanceof BlockItem) {
            return 5;
        }
        return 6;
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.crafting;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.research.ResearchManager;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.network.RequestCraftPayload;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.network.SyncCraftQueuePayload;
import net.fabricmc.fabric.api.networking.v1.ServerPlayNetworking;
import net.minecraft.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.server.network.ServerPlayerEntity;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundCategory;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundEvents;

import java.util.*;

public class ServerCraftingQueueManager {

    private static final Map<UUID, List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep>> QUEUES = new HashMap<>();
    private static final Map<UUID, Integer> ACTIVE_PROGRESS = new HashMap<>();

    public static void handleCraftRequest(ServerPlayerEntity player, RequestCraftPayload payload) {
        FactorioRecipes.init();
        UUID uuid = player.getUuid();
        List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> queue = QUEUES.computeIfAbsent(uuid, k -> new ArrayList<>());

        // ÐžÑ‚Ð¼ÐµÐ½Ð° ÑÐ»ÐµÐ¼ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð° Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸ Ð¿Ð¾ ÐºÐ»Ð¸ÐºÑƒ Ð² Ð»ÐµÐ²Ð¾Ð¼ Ð½Ð¸Ð¶Ð½ÐµÐ¼ ÑƒÐ³Ð»Ñƒ
        if (payload.action() < 0) {
            if (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                int targetIndex = findLastMatchingStepIndex(queue, payload.recipeId());
                if (targetIndex >= 0) {
                    cancelStepWithCascade(queue, targetIndex, player);
                }
                if (queue.isEmpty()) {
                    ACTIVE_PROGRESS.put(uuid, 0);
                }
                player.currentScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
                player.playerScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
                syncQueueToClient(player);
            }
            return;
        }

        FactorioRecipes.Recipe recipe = FactorioRecipes.getById(payload.recipeId());
        if (recipe == null) return;

        int requested = payload.action();
        if (requested >= 999) {
            int maxPossible = FactorioRecipes.getCraftableCount(player.getInventory(), recipe);
            requested = Math.max(1, maxPossible / Math.max(1, recipe.output().getCount()));
        }

        if (player.isCreative()) {
            int countToQueue = Math.min(requested, 20);
            for (int i = 0; i < countToQueue; i++) {
                queue.add(new FactorioRecipes.QueueStep(recipe, true));
            }
            syncQueueToClient(player);
            return;
        }

        List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> planned = FactorioRecipes.planAndConsume(player.getInventory(), recipe, requested);
        if (!planned.isEmpty()) {
            queue.addAll(planned);
            player.currentScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
            player.playerScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
            syncQueueToClient(player);
        } else {
            player.playSoundToPlayer(SoundEvents.BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_BASS.value(), SoundCategory.PLAYERS, 0.5f, 0.7f);
        }
    }

    private static int findLastMatchingStepIndex(List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> queue, String recipeId) {
        if (recipeId != null && !recipeId.isEmpty()) {
            for (int i = queue.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                if (queue.get(i).recipe().id().equals(recipeId)) {
                    return i;
                }
            }
        }
        return queue.size() - 1;
    }

     *   ÑÑ‚Ð¸ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼ÐµÐ¶ÑƒÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ ÑˆÐ°Ð³Ð¸ Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¶Ðµ ÑÐ½Ð¸Ð¼Ð°ÑŽÑ‚ÑÑ Ñ Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸, Ð° Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÑƒ Ð²Ð¾Ð·Ð²Ñ€Ð°Ñ‰Ð°ÐµÑ‚ÑÑ Ð±Ð°Ð·Ð¾Ð²Ð¾Ðµ ÑÑ‹Ñ€ÑŒÑ‘.
     * - Ð•ÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾Ðº Ð¾Ñ‚Ð¼ÐµÐ½ÑÐµÑ‚ Ð½Ð°Ð¿Ñ€ÑÐ¼ÑƒÑŽ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼ÐµÐ¶ÑƒÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÑˆÐ°Ð³ (deliverToPlayer == false),
     *   Ð°Ð²Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¼Ð°Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ‡ÐµÑÐºÐ¸ Ð¾Ñ‚Ð¼ÐµÐ½ÑÐµÑ‚ÑÑ Ð·Ð°Ð²Ð¸ÑÐ¸Ð¼Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð½ÐµÐ³Ð¾ Ñ„Ð¸Ð½Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚, Ñ‡Ñ‚Ð¾Ð±Ñ‹ Ð¸Ð·Ð±ÐµÐ¶Ð°Ñ‚ÑŒ Ð±ÐµÑÐ¿Ð»Ð°Ñ‚Ð½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ ÐºÑ€Ð°Ñ„Ñ‚Ð°.
     */
    private static void cancelStepWithCascade(List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> queue, int index, ServerPlayerEntity player) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= queue.size()) return;

        FactorioRecipes.QueueStep step = queue.get(index);

        // Ð•ÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾Ðº ÐºÐ»Ð¸ÐºÐ½ÑƒÐ» Ð¿Ð¾ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼ÐµÐ¶ÑƒÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ð¾Ð¼Ñƒ ÑˆÐ°Ð³Ñƒ (deliver == false), Ð¸Ñ‰ÐµÐ¼ Ð·Ð°Ð²Ð¸ÑÑÑ‰Ð¸Ð¹ Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð½ÐµÐ³Ð¾ Ñ€Ð¾Ð´Ð¸Ñ‚ÐµÐ»ÑŒÑÐºÐ¸Ð¹ ÑˆÐ°Ð³ Ð¿Ñ€Ð°Ð²ÐµÐµ Ð² Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸
        if (!step.deliverToPlayer()) {
            Item intermediateOut = step.recipe().output().getItem();
            for (int i = queue.size() - 1; i > index; i--) {
                FactorioRecipes.QueueStep later = queue.get(i);
                for (FactorioRecipes.Ingredient ing : later.recipe().ingredients()) {
                    if (ing.item() == intermediateOut) {
                        cancelStepWithCascade(queue, i, player);
                        return;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        boolean wasFirst = (index == 0);
        queue.remove(index);
        if (wasFirst) {
            ACTIVE_PROGRESS.put(player.getUuid(), 0);
        }

        if (player.isCreative()) {
            return;
        }

        refundIngredientsOrCancelSubsteps(queue, step.recipe(), player);
    }

    private static void refundIngredientsOrCancelSubsteps(List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> queue,
                                                          FactorioRecipes.Recipe cancelledRecipe,
                                                          ServerPlayerEntity player) {
        for (FactorioRecipes.Ingredient ing : cancelledRecipe.ingredients()) {
            int remainingToRefund = ing.count();

            // ÐŸÑ€Ð¾Ð²ÐµÑ€ÑÐµÐ¼ Ñ ÐºÐ¾Ð½Ñ†Ð° Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸, ÐµÑÑ‚ÑŒ Ð»Ð¸ Ð¾Ð¶Ð¸Ð´Ð°ÑŽÑ‰Ð¸Ðµ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼ÐµÐ¶ÑƒÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ ÑˆÐ°Ð³Ð¸ (deliverToPlayer == false), Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¸Ð·Ð²Ð¾Ð´ÑÑ‰Ð¸Ðµ ÑÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð¸Ð½Ð³Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸ÐµÐ½Ñ‚
            for (int i = queue.size() - 1; i >= 0 && remainingToRefund > 0; i--) {
                FactorioRecipes.QueueStep candidate = queue.get(i);
                if (!candidate.deliverToPlayer() && candidate.recipe().output().isOf(ing.item())) {
                    int outCount = candidate.recipe().output().getCount();
                    if (outCount <= remainingToRefund) {
                        boolean removedFirst = (i == 0);
                        queue.remove(i);
                        if (removedFirst) {
                            ACTIVE_PROGRESS.put(player.getUuid(), 0);
                        }
                        remainingToRefund -= outCount;
                        refundIngredientsOrCancelSubsteps(queue, candidate.recipe(), player);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (remainingToRefund > 0) {
                player.getInventory().offerOrDrop(new ItemStack(ing.item(), remainingToRefund));
            }
        }
    }

    public static void tickServer(MinecraftServer server) {
        ResearchManager.tickServer(server);

        for (ServerPlayerEntity player : server.getPlayerManager().getPlayerList()) {
            UUID uuid = player.getUuid();
            List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> queue = QUEUES.get(uuid);
            if (queue == null || queue.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }

            FactorioRecipes.QueueStep current = queue.get(0);
            int progress = ACTIVE_PROGRESS.getOrDefault(uuid, 0) + 1;
            int maxTicks = Math.max(1, current.recipe().timeTicks());

            if (progress >= maxTicks) {
                queue.remove(0);
                ACTIVE_PROGRESS.put(uuid, 0);

                if (current.deliverToPlayer()) {
                    ItemStack result = current.recipe().output().copy();
                    player.getInventory().offerOrDrop(result);
                    player.currentScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
                    player.playerScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
                    player.playSoundToPlayer(SoundEvents.ENTITY_ITEM_PICKUP, SoundCategory.PLAYERS, 0.4f, 1.3f);
                } else {
                    player.playSoundToPlayer(SoundEvents.BLOCK_SMITHING_TABLE_USE, SoundCategory.PLAYERS, 0.2f, 1.6f);
                }
                syncQueueToClient(player);
            } else {
                ACTIVE_PROGRESS.put(uuid, progress);
                if (progress % 2 == 0) {
                    syncQueueToClient(player);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void syncQueueToClient(ServerPlayerEntity player) {
        UUID uuid = player.getUuid();
        List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> queue = QUEUES.get(uuid);
        if (queue == null || queue.isEmpty()) {
            ServerPlayNetworking.send(player, new SyncCraftQueuePayload(List.of(), List.of(), 0, 1));
            return;
        }

        List<String> ids = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> counts = new ArrayList<>();

        for (FactorioRecipes.QueueStep step : queue) {
            String rId = step.recipe().id();
            int outCount = step.recipe().output().getCount();
            if (!ids.isEmpty() && ids.get(ids.size() - 1).equals(rId)) {
                int lastIdx = counts.size() - 1;
                counts.set(lastIdx, counts.get(lastIdx) + outCount);
            } else if (ids.size() < 64) {
                ids.add(rId);
                counts.add(outCount);
            }
        }

        int prog = ACTIVE_PROGRESS.getOrDefault(uuid, 0);
        int max = Math.max(1, queue.get(0).recipe().timeTicks());
        ServerPlayNetworking.send(player, new SyncCraftQueuePayload(ids, counts, prog, max));
    }
}

public class ElectricPoleBlock extends Block implements BlockEntityProvider {

    public static final IntProperty PART = IntProperty.of("part", 0, 3);
    public static final BooleanProperty UPPER = BooleanProperty.of("upper");

    private static final VoxelShape POLE_1X1_SHAPE = Block.createCuboidShape(5.0, 0.0, 5.0, 11.0, 16.0, 11.0);
    private static final VoxelShape POLE_2X2_BOTTOM = Block.createCuboidShape(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 16.0, 16.0);
    private static final VoxelShape POLE_2X2_TOP = Block.createCuboidShape(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 24.0, 16.0);

    private final int supplyRadius;
    private final double wireReach;
    private final boolean footprint2x2;
    private final int poleTier; // 1 = Small, 2 = Medium, 3 = Big (2x2), 4 = Substation (2x2)

    public ElectricPoleBlock(Settings settings, int supplyRadius, double wireReach) {
        this(settings, supplyRadius, wireReach, false, 1);
    }

    public ElectricPoleBlock(Settings settings, int supplyRadius, double wireReach, boolean footprint2x2, int poleTier) {
        super(settings);
        this.supplyRadius = supplyRadius;
        this.wireReach = wireReach;
        this.footprint2x2 = footprint2x2;
        this.poleTier = poleTier;
        this.setDefaultState(this.stateManager.getDefaultState().with(PART, 0).with(UPPER, false));
    }

    @Override
    protected void appendProperties(StateManager.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
        builder.add(PART, UPPER);
    }

    public boolean isFootprint2x2() {
        return this.footprint2x2;
    }

    public int getPoleTier() {
        return this.poleTier;
    }

    public int getSupplyRadius() {
        return this.supplyRadius;
    }

    public int getSupplyAreaSize() {
        return this.footprint2x2 ? (this.supplyRadius * 2) : (this.supplyRadius * 2 + 1);
    }

    public double getWireReach() {
        return this.wireReach;
    }

    public static boolean isMasterPoleNode(BlockState state) {
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof ElectricPoleBlock pole)) return false;
        if (!pole.footprint2x2) return true;
        return state.get(PART) == 0 && !state.get(UPPER);
    }

    public static BlockPos getPartPos(BlockPos masterPos, int part, boolean upper) {
        int dx = part % 2;
        int dz = part / 2;
        return masterPos.add(dx, upper ? 1 : 0, dz);
    }

    public static BlockPos getMasterPos(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof ElectricPoleBlock pole) || !pole.footprint2x2) {
            return pos;
        }
        int part = state.get(PART);
        boolean upper = state.get(UPPER);
        return pos.add(-(part % 2), upper ? -1 : 0, -(part / 2));
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockState getPlacementState(ItemPlacementContext ctx) {
        if (!this.footprint2x2) {
            return this.getDefaultState();
        }
        World world = ctx.getWorld();
        BlockPos masterPos = ctx.getBlockPos();
        for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
            for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                BlockPos check = getPartPos(masterPos, part, u == 1);
                if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(check) || !world.getBlockState(check).canReplace(ctx)) {
                    return null;
                }
            }
        }
        return this.getDefaultState().with(PART, 0).with(UPPER, false);
    }

    @Override
    public void onPlaced(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, @Nullable LivingEntity placer, ItemStack itemStack) {
        super.onPlaced(world, pos, state, placer, itemStack);
        if (!world.isClient && this.footprint2x2 && state.get(PART) == 0 && !state.get(UPPER)) {
            for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    if (part == 0 && u == 0) continue;
                    BlockPos p = getPartPos(pos, part, u == 1);
                    world.setBlockState(p, state.with(PART, part).with(UPPER, u == 1), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public BlockState onBreak(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, PlayerEntity player) {
        if (!world.isClient && this.footprint2x2) {
            BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
            for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = getPartPos(masterPos, part, u == 1);
                    if (!p.equals(pos) && world.getBlockState(p).isOf(this)) {
                        world.setBlockState(p, Blocks.AIR.getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL | Block.SKIP_DROPS);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return super.onBreak(world, pos, state, player);
    }

    @Override
    protected ActionResult onUse(BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos, PlayerEntity player, BlockHitResult hit) {
        if (player.isSneaking()) {
            return ActionResult.PASS;
        }
        BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (world.isClient && PowerNetworkManager.clientGuiOpener != null) {
            PowerNetworkManager.clientGuiOpener.accept(masterPos.toImmutable());
        }
        return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
    }

    @Override
    protected BlockRenderType getRenderType(BlockState state) {
        return this.footprint2x2 ? BlockRenderType.INVISIBLE : BlockRenderType.MODEL;
    }

    @Override
    protected VoxelShape getOutlineShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        if (!this.footprint2x2) return POLE_1X1_SHAPE;
        return state.get(UPPER) ? POLE_2X2_TOP : POLE_2X2_BOTTOM;
    }

    @Override
    protected VoxelShape getCollisionShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        if (!this.footprint2x2) return POLE_1X1_SHAPE;
        return state.get(UPPER) ? POLE_2X2_TOP : POLE_2X2_BOTTOM;
    }

    @Override
    protected float getAmbientOcclusionLightLevel(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos) {
        return 1.0f;
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean isTransparent(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos) {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    protected float calcBlockBreakingDelta(BlockState state, PlayerEntity player, BlockView world, BlockPos pos) {
        return 0.125f;
    }

    @Override
    public void appendTooltip(ItemStack stack, Item.TooltipContext context, List<Text> tooltip, TooltipType options) {
        int area = getSupplyAreaSize();
        tooltip.add(Text.translatable("hud.factoriocore.supply_area", area + "Ã—" + area).formatted(Formatting.GRAY));
        tooltip.add(Text.literal("Ð”Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾ÑÑ‚ÑŒ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð²Ð¾Ð´Ð°: " + this.wireReach + " Ð±Ð».").formatted(Formatting.AQUA));
    }

    @Nullable

    public BlockEntity createBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (!this.footprint2x2 || state.get(PART) != 0 || state.get(UPPER)) return null;

public class PowerNetworkManager {

    public static Consumer<BlockPos> clientGuiOpener = null;

    public record MachineGroupStat(Block block, int count, long watts, int color) {}

    public record NetworkSnapshot(
            long totalDemandWatts,
            long totalProductionWatts,
            long maxProductionCapacityWatts,
            long accumulatorStoredJoules,
            long accumulatorCapacityJoules,
            List<MachineGroupStat> consumers,
            List<MachineGroupStat> producers

    public static String formatWatts(long watts) {
        if (watts >= 1_000_000_000L) {
            return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.1f %s", watts / 1_000_000_000.0, Text.translatable("unit.factoriocore.gw").getString());
        }
        if (watts >= 1_000_000L) {
            return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.1f %s", watts / 1_000_000.0, Text.translatable("unit.factoriocore.mw").getString());
        }
        if (watts >= 1_000L) {
            return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.1f %s", watts / 1_000.0, Text.translatable("unit.factoriocore.kw").getString());
        }
        return watts + " " + Text.translatable("unit.factoriocore.w").getString();
    }

    public static String formatAxisWatts(long watts) {
        if (watts >= 1_000_000_000L) {
            return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.0f %s", watts / 1_000_000_000.0, Text.translatable("unit.factoriocore.gw").getString());
        }
        if (watts >= 1_000_000L) {
            return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.0f %s", watts / 1_000_000.0, Text.translatable("unit.factoriocore.mw").getString());
        }
        if (watts >= 1_000L) {
            return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.0f %s", watts / 1_000.0, Text.translatable("unit.factoriocore.kw").getString());
        }
        return watts + " " + Text.translatable("unit.factoriocore.w").getString();
    }

    public static NetworkSnapshot scanNetwork(World world, BlockPos startPolePos) {
        if (world == null) {
            return new NetworkSnapshot(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, List.of(), List.of());
        }

        BlockState rawStartState = world.getBlockState(startPolePos);
        BlockPos masterStartPos = (rawStartState.getBlock() instanceof ElectricPoleBlock)
                ? ElectricPoleBlock.getMasterPos(startPolePos, rawStartState)
                : startPolePos.toImmutable();

        Set<BlockPos> poles = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        Deque<BlockPos> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();

        Block startBlock = world.getBlockState(masterStartPos).getBlock();
        if (startBlock instanceof ElectricPoleBlock || startBlock instanceof CreativeEnergySourceBlock) {
            poles.add(masterStartPos);
            queue.add(masterStartPos);
        }

        while (!queue.isEmpty() && poles.size() < 256) {
            BlockPos current = queue.pollFirst();
            Block currentBlock = world.getBlockState(current).getBlock();
            for (BlockPos neighbor : findConnectedNodes(world, current, currentBlock)) {
                if (poles.add(neighbor)) {
                    queue.addLast(neighbor);
                }
            }
        }

        Set<BlockPos> visitedMachines = new HashSet<>();
        int drillCount = 0; long drillDemandWatts = 0L;
        int asmCount = 0; long asmDemandWatts = 0L;
        int labCount = 0; long labDemandWatts = 0L;
        int pumpjackCount = 0; long pumpjackDemandWatts = 0L;
        int refineryCount = 0; long refineryDemandWatts = 0L;
        int chemPlantCount = 0; long chemPlantDemandWatts = 0L;
        int basicInserterCount = 0; long basicInserterWatts = 0L;
        int longInserterCount = 0; long longInserterWatts = 0L;
        int fastInserterCount = 0; long fastInserterWatts = 0L;

        int steamEngineCount = 0; long steamEngineMaxWatts = 0L;
        int solarPanelCount = 0; long solarPanelMaxWatts = 0L;
        int accumulatorCount = 0; long accumulatorMaxWatts = 0L;
        long totalAccStoredJoules = 0L; long totalAccCapacityJoules = 0L;
        int creativeSourceCount = 0; long creativeSourceMaxWatts = 0L;

        long singleSolarOutput = SolarAndAccumulatorMachines.SolarPanelBlockEntity.getCurrentOutputWatts(world);

        BlockPos.Mutable check = new BlockPos.Mutable();
        for (BlockPos polePos : poles) {
            Block poleBlock = world.getBlockState(polePos).getBlock();
            if (poleBlock instanceof CreativeEnergySourceBlock) {
                if (visitedMachines.add(polePos)) {
                    creativeSourceCount++;
                    creativeSourceMaxWatts += CreativeEnergySourceBlock.OUTPUT_WATTS;
                }
            }

            int r = getSupplyRadius(poleBlock);
            if (r <= 0) continue;

            for (int dx = -r; dx <= r; dx++) {
                for (int dz = -r; dz <= r; dz++) {
                    for (int dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy++) {
                        check.set(polePos.getX() + dx, polePos.getY() + dy, polePos.getZ() + dz);
                        BlockState st = world.getBlockState(check);
                        if (st.isAir()) continue;
                        Block b = st.getBlock();

                        if (b instanceof ElectricDrillBlock) {
                            BlockPos master = ElectricDrillBlock.getMasterPos(check, st);
                            if (visitedMachines.add(master)) {
                                drillCount++;
                                if (world.getBlockEntity(master) instanceof ElectricDrillBlockEntity drill && drill.isActivelyMining()) {
                                    drillDemandWatts += ElectricDrillBlockEntity.POWER_CONSUMPTION_WATTS;
                                }
                            }
                        } else if (b instanceof AssemblerBlock) {
                            BlockPos master = AssemblerBlock.getMasterPos(check, st);
                            if (visitedMachines.add(master)) {
                                asmCount++;
                                if (world.getBlockEntity(master) instanceof AssemblerBlockEntity asm && asm.isWorking()) {
                                    asmDemandWatts += AssemblerBlockEntity.POWER_CONSUMPTION_WATTS;
                                }
                            }
                        } else if (b instanceof LabBlock) {
                            BlockPos master = LabBlock.getMasterPos(check, st);
                            if (visitedMachines.add(master)) {
                                labCount++;
                                if (world.getBlockEntity(master) instanceof LabBlockEntity lab && lab.isWorking()) {
                                    labDemandWatts += LabBlockEntity.POWER_CONSUMPTION_WATTS;
                                }
                            }
                        } else if (b instanceof OilMachines.PumpjackBlock) {
                            BlockPos master = OilMachines.Base3x3MachineBlock.getMasterPos(check, st);
                            if (visitedMachines.add(master)) {
                                pumpjackCount++;
                                if (world.getBlockEntity(master) instanceof OilMachines.PumpjackBlockEntity pj && pj.isWorking()) {
                                    pumpjackDemandWatts += OilMachines.PumpjackBlockEntity.POWER_CONSUMPTION_WATTS;
                                }
                            }
                        } else if (b instanceof OilMachines.OilRefineryBlock) {
                            BlockPos master = OilMachines.OilRefineryBlock.getMasterPos(check, st);
                            if (visitedMachines.add(master)) {
                                refineryCount++;
                                if (world.getBlockEntity(master) instanceof OilMachines.OilRefineryBlockEntity ref && ref.isWorking()) {
                                    refineryDemandWatts += OilMachines.OilRefineryBlockEntity.POWER_CONSUMPTION_WATTS;
                                }
                            }
                        } else if (b instanceof OilMachines.ChemicalPlantBlock) {
                            BlockPos master = OilMachines.Base3x3MachineBlock.getMasterPos(check, st);
                            if (visitedMachines.add(master)) {
                                chemPlantCount++;
                                if (world.getBlockEntity(master) instanceof OilMachines.ChemicalPlantBlockEntity cp && cp.isWorking()) {
                                    chemPlantDemandWatts += OilMachines.ChemicalPlantBlockEntity.POWER_CONSUMPTION_WATTS;
                                }
                            }
                        } else if (b instanceof InserterBlock && !(b instanceof BurnerInserterBlock)) {
                            BlockPos master = check.toImmutable();
                            if (visitedMachines.add(master)) {
                                BlockEntity be = world.getBlockEntity(master);
                                long usage = InserterBlockEntity.ELECTRIC_IDLE_WATTS;
                                if (be instanceof InserterBlockEntity ins) {
                                    boolean active = !ins.getHeldStack().isEmpty() || ins.getArmProgress(0.0f) > 0.01f;
                                    usage = active ? ins.getActiveConsumptionWatts() : InserterBlockEntity.ELECTRIC_IDLE_WATTS;
                                }
                                if (b == ModBlocks.LONG_HANDED_INSERTER) {
                                    longInserterCount++;
                                    longInserterWatts += usage;
                                } else if (b == ModBlocks.FAST_INSERTER) {
                                    fastInserterCount++;
                                    fastInserterWatts += usage;
                                } else {
                                    basicInserterCount++;
                                    basicInserterWatts += usage;
                                }
                            }
                        } else if (b instanceof SteamEngineBlock) {
                            BlockPos master = SteamEngineBlock.getMasterPos(check, st);
                            if (visitedMachines.add(master)) {
                                steamEngineCount++;
                                if (world.getBlockEntity(master) instanceof SteamEngineBlockEntity engine && engine.isGeneratingPower()) {

                                }
                            }

                                    totalAccStoredJoules += acc.getStoredJoules();
                                    if (acc.canProvidePower()) {
                                        accumulatorMaxWatts += SolarAndAccumulatorMachines.AccumulatorBlockEntity.MAX_TRANSFER_WATTS;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        } else if (b instanceof CreativeEnergySourceBlock) {
                            BlockPos master = check.toImmutable();
                            if (visitedMachines.add(master)) {
                                creativeSourceCount++;
                                creativeSourceMaxWatts += CreativeEnergySourceBlock.OUTPUT_WATTS;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long totalDemand = drillDemandWatts + asmDemandWatts + labDemandWatts
                + pumpjackDemandWatts + refineryDemandWatts + chemPlantDemandWatts
                + basicInserterWatts + longInserterWatts + fastInserterWatts;
        long maxProduction = steamEngineMaxWatts + solarPanelMaxWatts + accumulatorMaxWatts + creativeSourceMaxWatts;
        long actualProduction = Math.min(totalDemand, maxProduction);
        float satisfactionRatio = (totalDemand > 0) ? Math.min(1.0f, maxProduction / (float) totalDemand) : 1.0f;

        List<MachineGroupStat> consumerList = new ArrayList<>();
        if (asmCount > 0) consumerList.add(new MachineGroupStat(ModBlocks.ASSEMBLER, asmCount, Math.round(asmDemandWatts * satisfactionRatio), 0xFFD4AC0D));
        if (labCount > 0) consumerList.add(new MachineGroupStat(ModBlocks.LAB, labCount, Math.round(labDemandWatts * satisfactionRatio), 0xFFAB47BC));
        if (drillCount > 0) consumerList.add(new MachineGroupStat(ModBlocks.ELECTRIC_MINING_DRILL, drillCount, Math.round(drillDemandWatts * satisfactionRatio), 0xFF1E88E5));
        if (pumpjackCount > 0) consumerList.add(new MachineGroupStat(ModBlocks.PUMPJACK, pumpjackCount, Math.round(pumpjackDemandWatts * satisfactionRatio), 0xFF2E7D32));
        if (refineryCount > 0) consumerList.add(new MachineGroupStat(ModBlocks.OIL_REFINERY, refineryCount, Math.round(refineryDemandWatts * satisfactionRatio), 0xFFF57F17));
        if (chemPlantCount > 0) consumerList.add(new MachineGroupStat(ModBlocks.CHEMICAL_PLANT, chemPlantCount, Math.round(chemPlantDemandWatts * satisfactionRatio), 0xFF00ACC1));
        if (basicInserterCount > 0) consumerList.add(new MachineGroupStat(ModBlocks.INSERTER, basicInserterCount, Math.round(basicInserterWatts * satisfactionRatio), 0xFFE67E22));
        if (longInserterCount > 0) consumerList.add(new MachineGroupStat(ModBlocks.LONG_HANDED_INSERTER, longInserterCount, Math.round(longInserterWatts * satisfactionRatio), 0xFFE53935));
        if (fastInserterCount > 0) consumerList.add(new MachineGroupStat(ModBlocks.FAST_INSERTER, fastInserterCount, Math.round(fastInserterWatts * satisfactionRatio), 0xFF29B6F6));
        consumerList.sort(Comparator.comparingLong(MachineGroupStat::watts).reversed());

        List<MachineGroupStat> producerList = new ArrayList<>();
        if (steamEngineCount > 0) {
            long share = (maxProduction > 0) ? Math.round(actualProduction * (steamEngineMaxWatts / (double) maxProduction)) : 0L;
            producerList.add(new MachineGroupStat(ModBlocks.STEAM_ENGINE, steamEngineCount, share, 0xFF1E88E5));
        }
        if (solarPanelCount > 0) {
            long share = (maxProduction > 0) ? Math.round(actualProduction * (solarPanelMaxWatts / (double) maxProduction)) : 0L;
            producerList.add(new MachineGroupStat(ModBlocks.SOLAR_PANEL, solarPanelCount, share, 0xFFFDD835));
        }
        if (accumulatorCount > 0) {
            long share = (maxProduction > 0) ? Math.round(actualProduction * (accumulatorMaxWatts / (double) maxProduction)) : 0L;
            producerList.add(new MachineGroupStat(ModBlocks.ACCUMULATOR, accumulatorCount, share, 0xFF00E5FF));
        }
        if (creativeSourceCount > 0) {
            long share = (maxProduction > 0) ? Math.round(actualProduction * (creativeSourceMaxWatts / (double) maxProduction)) : 0L;
            producerList.add(new MachineGroupStat(ModBlocks.ELECTRIC_ENERGY_INTERFACE, creativeSourceCount, share, 0xFF26C6DA));
        }

        return new NetworkSnapshot(totalDemand, actualProduction, maxProduction, totalAccStoredJoules, totalAccCapacityJoules, consumerList, producerList);
    }

    public static boolean hasAnyConnectedPole(World world, BlockPos machinePos) {
        if (world == null) return false;
        int maxRadius = 10;
        BlockPos.Mutable checkPos = new BlockPos.Mutable();
        for (int dx = -maxRadius; dx <= maxRadius; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -maxRadius; dz <= maxRadius; dz++) {
                for (int dy = -2; dy <= 3; dy++) {
                    checkPos.set(machinePos.getX() + dx, machinePos.getY() + dy, machinePos.getZ() + dz);
                    BlockState st = world.getBlockState(checkPos);
                    if (st.getBlock() instanceof ElectricPoleBlock pole && ElectricPoleBlock.isMasterPoleNode(st)) {
                        int r = pole.getSupplyRadius() + 1;
                        if (Math.abs(dx) <= r && Math.abs(dz) <= r) return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static boolean isMachinePoweredByPrimaryGenerators(World world, BlockPos machinePos) {
        return isMachinePoweredInternal(world, machinePos, false);
    }

    public static boolean isMachinePowered(World world, BlockPos machinePos) {
        return isMachinePoweredInternal(world, machinePos, true);
    }

    private static boolean isMachinePoweredInternal(World world, BlockPos machinePos, boolean allowAccumulators) {
        if (world == null) return false;

        Block machineBlock = world.getBlockState(machinePos).getBlock();
        int machineFootprintRadius = (machineBlock instanceof OilMachines.OilRefineryBlock) ? 2
                : ((machineBlock instanceof ElectricDrillBlock
                || machineBlock instanceof AssemblerBlock
                || machineBlock instanceof LabBlock
                || machineBlock instanceof OilMachines.Base3x3MachineBlock
                || machineBlock instanceof SolarAndAccumulatorMachines.SolarPanelBlock
                || machineBlock instanceof SolarAndAccumulatorMachines.AccumulatorBlock) ? 1 : 0);

        int maxRadius = 9 + machineFootprintRadius;
        BlockPos.Mutable checkPos = new BlockPos.Mutable();

        for (int dx = -maxRadius; dx <= maxRadius; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -maxRadius; dz <= maxRadius; dz++) {
                for (int dy = -2; dy <= 3; dy++) {
                    checkPos.set(machinePos.getX() + dx, machinePos.getY() + dy, machinePos.getZ() + dz);
                    BlockState st = world.getBlockState(checkPos);
                    Block b = st.getBlock();

                    if (b instanceof CreativeEnergySourceBlock source) {
                        int r = source.getSupplyRadius() + machineFootprintRadius;
                        if (Math.abs(dx) <= r && Math.abs(dz) <= r) {
                            return true;
                        }
                    } else if (b instanceof ElectricPoleBlock pole) {
                        if (!ElectricPoleBlock.isMasterPoleNode(st)) continue;
                        int r = pole.getSupplyRadius() + machineFootprintRadius;
                        if (Math.abs(dx) <= r && Math.abs(dz) <= r) {
                            if (isPoleEnergizedInternal(world, checkPos.toImmutable(), allowAccumulators)) {
                                return true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static boolean isPoleEnergized(World world, BlockPos startPolePos) {
        return isPoleEnergizedInternal(world, startPolePos, true);
    }

    private static boolean isPoleEnergizedInternal(World world, BlockPos startPolePos, boolean allowAccumulators) {
        if (world == null) return false;

        BlockState startState = world.getBlockState(startPolePos);
        if (startState.getBlock() instanceof ElectricPoleBlock) {
            startPolePos = ElectricPoleBlock.getMasterPos(startPolePos, startState);
        }

        Set<BlockPos> visited = new HashSet<>();
        Deque<BlockPos> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
        queue.add(startPolePos);
        visited.add(startPolePos);

        int steps = 0;
        while (!queue.isEmpty() && steps < 64) {
            steps++;
            BlockPos current = queue.pollFirst();
            Block currentBlock = world.getBlockState(current).getBlock();

            if (currentBlock instanceof CreativeEnergySourceBlock) {
                return true;
            }
            if (hasActiveGeneratorNearPole(world, current, getSupplyRadius(currentBlock), allowAccumulators)) {
                return true;
            }

            double reach = getWireReach(currentBlock);
            int searchR = (int) Math.ceil(reach);

            for (int dx = -searchR; dx <= searchR; dx++) {
                for (int dz = -searchR; dz <= searchR; dz++) {
                    for (int dy = -4; dy <= 4; dy++) {
                        if (dx == 0 && dy == 0 && dz == 0) continue;
                        BlockPos nextPos = current.add(dx, dy, dz);
                        if (visited.contains(nextPos)) continue;

                        BlockState nextState = world.getBlockState(nextPos);
                        Block nextBlock = nextState.getBlock();
                        if (nextBlock instanceof ElectricPoleBlock && !ElectricPoleBlock.isMasterPoleNode(nextState)) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        if (nextBlock instanceof ElectricPoleBlock || nextBlock instanceof CreativeEnergySourceBlock) {
                            double maxWire = Math.min(reach, getWireReach(nextBlock));
                            if (current.getSquaredDistance(nextPos) <= maxWire * maxWire) {
                                if (nextBlock instanceof CreativeEnergySourceBlock) {
                                    return true;
                                }
                                visited.add(nextPos.toImmutable());
                                queue.addLast(nextPos.toImmutable());
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static boolean hasActiveGeneratorNearPole(World world, BlockPos polePos, int radius, boolean allowAccumulators) {
        int r = Math.max(2, radius);
        boolean solarActiveNow = SolarAndAccumulatorMachines.SolarPanelBlockEntity.getCurrentOutputWatts(world) > 0;

        for (int dx = -r; dx <= r; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -r; dz <= r; dz++) {
                for (int dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy++) {
                    BlockPos p = polePos.add(dx, dy, dz);
                    BlockState st = world.getBlockState(p);
                    Block b = st.getBlock();

                    if (b instanceof SteamEngineBlock) {
                        BlockPos master = SteamEngineBlock.getMasterPos(p, st);
                        if (world.getBlockEntity(master) instanceof SteamEngineBlockEntity engine && engine.isGeneratingPower()) {
                            return true;
                        }
                    } else if (solarActiveNow && b instanceof SolarAndAccumulatorMachines.SolarPanelBlock) {
                        return true;
                    } else if (allowAccumulators && b instanceof SolarAndAccumulatorMachines.AccumulatorBlock) {
                        BlockPos master = SolarAndAccumulatorMachines.AccumulatorBlock.getMasterPos(p, st);
                        if (world.getBlockEntity(master) instanceof SolarAndAccumulatorMachines.AccumulatorBlockEntity acc && acc.canProvidePower()) {
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static double getWireReach(Block block) {
        if (block instanceof ElectricPoleBlock pole) return pole.getWireReach();
        if (block instanceof CreativeEnergySourceBlock) return 10.5;
        return 0.0;
    }

    public static int getSupplyRadius(Block block) {
        if (block instanceof ElectricPoleBlock pole) return pole.getSupplyRadius();
        if (block instanceof CreativeEnergySourceBlock source) return source.getSupplyRadius();
        return 0;
    }

    public static List<BlockPos> findConnectedNodes(World world, BlockPos origin, Block originBlock) {
        List<BlockPos> result = new ArrayList<>();
        double reach = getWireReach(originBlock);
        if (reach <= 0.0) return result;

        int r = (int) Math.ceil(reach);
        for (int dx = -r; dx <= r; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -r; dz <= r; dz++) {
                for (int dy = -4; dy <= 4; dy++) {
                    if (dx == 0 && dy == 0 && dz == 0) continue;
                    BlockPos check = origin.add(dx, dy, dz);
                    BlockState st = world.getBlockState(check);
                    Block b = st.getBlock();
                    if (b instanceof ElectricPoleBlock && !ElectricPoleBlock.isMasterPoleNode(st)) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (b instanceof ElectricPoleBlock || b instanceof CreativeEnergySourceBlock) {
                        double maxDist = Math.min(reach, getWireReach(b));
                        if (origin.getSquaredDistance(check) <= maxDist * maxDist) {
                            result.add(check.toImmutable());
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
}

    public static class SolarPanelBlockEntity extends BlockEntity {
        public static final long MAX_OUTPUT_WATTS = 60_000L; // 60 ÐºÐ’Ñ‚ Ð¿Ð¾ ÐºÐ°Ð½Ð¾Ð½Ñƒ Factorio

        public SolarPanelBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
            super(ModBlocks.SOLAR_PANEL_BLOCK_ENTITY, pos, state);
        }

        /**
         * Ð’Ñ‹Ñ‡Ð¸ÑÐ»ÑÐµÑ‚ Ñ‚ÐµÐºÑƒÑ‰ÑƒÑŽ Ð¼Ð¾Ñ‰Ð½Ð¾ÑÑ‚ÑŒ ÑÐ¾Ð»Ð½ÐµÑ‡Ð½Ð¾Ð¹ Ð¿Ð°Ð½ÐµÐ»Ð¸ Ð¿Ð¾ Ð²Ñ€ÐµÐ¼ÐµÐ½Ð¸ ÑÑƒÑ‚Ð¾Ðº:
         * - 0..12000 (Ð´ÐµÐ½ÑŒ) -> 100% (60 ÐºÐ’Ñ‚)
         * - 12000..13500 (Ð·Ð°ÐºÐ°Ñ‚) -> Ð¿Ð»Ð°Ð²Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÑÐ¿Ð°Ð´ 100% -> 0%
         * - 13500..22500 (Ð½Ð¾Ñ‡ÑŒ) -> 0 ÐºÐ’Ñ‚
         * - 22500..24000 (Ñ€Ð°ÑÑÐ²ÐµÑ‚) -> Ð¿Ð»Ð°Ð²Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ñ€Ð¾ÑÑ‚ 0% -> 100%
         */
        public static float getDaylightFactor(World world) {
            if (world == null || !world.getDimension().hasSkyLight()) return 0.0f;
            long tod = world.getTimeOfDay() % 24000L;
            if (tod < 0) tod += 24000L;

            float factor;
            if (tod <= 12000L) {
                factor = 1.0f;
            } else if (tod < 13500L) {
                factor = 1.0f - ((tod - 12000L) / 1500.0f);
            } else if (tod < 22500L) {
                factor = 0.0f;
            } else {
                factor = (tod - 22500L) / 1500.0f;
            }

            if (world.isThundering()) factor *= 0.45f;
            else if (world.isRaining()) factor *= 0.70f;
            return MathHelper.clamp(factor, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        }

        public static long getCurrentOutputWatts(World world) {
            return Math.round(MAX_OUTPUT_WATTS * getDaylightFactor(world));
        }
    }

    public static class AccumulatorBlockEntity extends BlockEntity {
        public static final long MAX_CAPACITY_JOULES = 5_000_000L; // 5 ÐœÐ”Ð¶
        public static final long MAX_TRANSFER_WATTS = 300_000L;    // 300 ÐºÐ’Ñ‚

        private long storedJoules = 0L;

        }

        public long getCapacityJoules() { return MAX_CAPACITY_JOULES; }
        public int getChargeState() { return this.chargeState; }

        public float getChargeRatio() {
            return MathHelper.clamp((float) this.storedJoules / (float) MAX_CAPACITY_JOULES, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        }

        public boolean canProvidePower() {
            return this.storedJoules >= 15_000L;
        }

        public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, AccumulatorBlockEntity acc) {
            if (world == null || world.isClient) return;
            if ((world.getTime() & 3L) != 0L) return; // ÐžÐ±Ð½Ð¾Ð²Ð»ÑÐµÐ¼ ÐºÐ°Ð¶Ð´Ñ‹Ðµ 4 Ñ‚Ð¸ÐºÐ° (0.2 ÑÐµÐº)

            boolean hasPrimaryGeneration = PowerNetworkManager.isMachinePoweredByPrimaryGenerators(world, pos);
            int prevState = acc.chargeState;
            long prevBucket = acc.storedJoules / 250_000L;

            if (hasPrimaryGeneration) {
                if (acc.storedJoules < MAX_CAPACITY_JOULES) {
                    // 300 ÐºÐ’Ñ‚ * 0.2 ÑÐµÐº = 60 000 Ð”Ð¶ Ð·Ð° 4 Ñ‚Ð¸ÐºÐ°
                    acc.storedJoules = Math.min(MAX_CAPACITY_JOULES, acc.storedJoules + 60_000L);
                    acc.chargeState = 1;
                } else {
                    acc.chargeState = 0;
                }
            } else if (acc.storedJoules > 0L && PowerNetworkManager.hasAnyConnectedPole(world, pos)) {
                // ÐÐ¾Ñ‡ÑŒÑŽ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¸ Ð¾Ñ‚ÑÑƒÑ‚ÑÑ‚Ð²Ð¸Ð¸ Ð³ÐµÐ½ÐµÑ€Ð°Ñ†Ð¸Ð¸ Ð¾Ñ‚Ð´Ð°Ñ‘Ð¼ ÑÐ½ÐµÑ€Ð³Ð¸ÑŽ Ð¿Ð¾Ð´ÐºÐ»ÑŽÑ‡Ñ‘Ð½Ð½Ð¾Ð¹ Ð±Ð°Ð·Ðµ
                acc.storedJoules = Math.max(0L, acc.storedJoules - 30_000L);
                acc.chargeState = -1;
            } else {
                acc.chargeState = 0;
            }

            long newBucket = acc.storedJoules / 250_000L;
            if (prevState != acc.chargeState || prevBucket != newBucket) {
                acc.sync();
            } else {
                acc.markDirty();
            }
        }

        public void sync() {
            markDirty();
            if (this.world != null && !this.world.isClient) {
                this.world.updateListeners(this.pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_LISTENERS);
            }
        }

        @Override
        protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
            super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
            nbt.putLong("StoredJoules", this.storedJoules);
            nbt.putInt("ChargeState", this.chargeState);
        }

            super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
            this.storedJoules = nbt.getLong("StoredJoules");
            this.chargeState = nbt.getInt("ChargeState");
        }

        @Override public NbtCompound toInitialChunkDataNbt(RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) { return createNbt(registries); }
    }

    public static BlockPos getPartPos(BlockPos masterPos, Direction facing, int part, boolean upper) {
        int wOff = (part % 3) - 1;
        int dOff = part / 3;
        Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
        BlockPos base = masterPos.offset(right, wOff).offset(facing, dOff);
        return upper ? base.up() : base;
    }

    public static BlockPos getMasterPos(BlockPos currentPos, BlockState state) {
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof BoilerBlock)) return currentPos;
        Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
        int part = state.get(PART);
        boolean upper = state.get(UPPER);
        int wOff = (part % 3) - 1;
        int dOff = part / 3;
        Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
        BlockPos base = upper ? currentPos.down() : currentPos;
        return base.offset(right, -wOff).offset(facing, -dOff);
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockState getPlacementState(ItemPlacementContext ctx) {
        Direction facing = ctx.getHorizontalPlayerFacing().getOpposite();
        if (ctx.getPlayer() != null && ctx.getPlayer().isSneaking()) {
            facing = facing.getOpposite();
        }
        BlockPos masterPos = ctx.getBlockPos();
        World world = ctx.getWorld();

        for (int part = 0; part < 6; part++) {
            for (int yOff = 0; yOff <= 2; yOff++) {
                BlockPos checkPos = getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, false).up(yOff);
                if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(checkPos) || !world.getBlockState(checkPos).canReplace(ctx)) {
                    return null;
                }
            }
        }
        return this.getDefaultState().with(FACING, facing).with(PART, 1).with(UPPER, false);
    }

    public void onPlaced(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, @Nullable LivingEntity placer, ItemStack itemStack) {
        super.onPlaced(world, pos, state, placer, itemStack);
        if (!world.isClient && state.get(PART) == 1 && !state.get(UPPER)) {
            Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 6; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    if (part == 1 && u == 0) continue;
                    BlockPos p = getPartPos(pos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    world.setBlockState(p, state.with(PART, part).with(UPPER, u == 1), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public BlockState onBreak(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, PlayerEntity player) {
        if (!world.isClient) {
            BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
            Direction facing = state.get(FACING);

            if (world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof BoilerBlockEntity boilerBe) {
                ItemStack fuel = boilerBe.getStack(0);
                if (!fuel.isEmpty()) {
                    ItemScatterer.spawn(world, masterPos.getX() + 0.5, masterPos.getY() + 0.5, masterPos.getZ() + 0.5, fuel.copy());
                    boilerBe.setStack(0, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                }
            }

            for (int part = 0; part < 6; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (!p.equals(pos) && world.getBlockState(p).isOf(this)) {
                        world.setBlockState(p, Blocks.AIR.getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL | Block.SKIP_DROPS);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return super.onBreak(world, pos, state, player);
    }

    @Override
    protected ActionResult onUse(BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos, PlayerEntity player, BlockHitResult hit) {
        if (!world.isClient) {
            BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
            if (world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof BoilerBlockEntity boilerBe) {
                player.openHandledScreen(boilerBe);
            }
        }
        return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockEntity createBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (state.get(PART) != 1 || state.get(UPPER)) return null;
        return new BoilerBlockEntity(pos, state);
    }

        if (state.get(PART) != 1 || state.get(UPPER)) return null;

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.fluids;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.combat.BlockHealthManager;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModBlocks;
import net.fabricmc.fabric.api.registry.FuelRegistry;
import net.minecraft.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.block.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.block.entity.AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerInventory;
import net.minecraft.inventory.Inventory;
import net.minecraft.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.nbt.NbtCompound;
import net.minecraft.network.listener.ClientPlayPacketListener;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.Packet;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.s2c.play.BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket;
import net.minecraft.particle.ParticleTypes;
import net.minecraft.registry.RegistryWrapper;
import net.minecraft.screen.NamedScreenHandlerFactory;
import net.minecraft.screen.PropertyDelegate;
import net.minecraft.screen.ScreenHandler;
import net.minecraft.server.world.ServerWorld;
import net.minecraft.text.Text;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Direction;
import net.minecraft.world.World;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

public class BoilerBlockEntity extends BlockEntity implements FactorioFluidContainer, Inventory, NamedScreenHandlerFactory {

    public static final int CAPACITY_MB = 2000;
    public static final int STEAM_PER_TICK_MB = 60;

    private ItemStack fuelStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
    private int burnTime = 0;
    private int maxBurnTime = 0;
    private int waterMb = 0;
    private int steamMb = 0;

    protected final PropertyDelegate propertyDelegate = new PropertyDelegate() {
        @Override
        public int get(int index) {
            return switch (index) {
                case 0 -> burnTime;
                case 1 -> Math.max(1, maxBurnTime);
                default -> 0;
            };
        }

        @Override
        public void set(int index, int value) {
            if (index == 0) burnTime = value;
            else if (index == 1) maxBurnTime = value;
        }

        @Override
        public int size() {
            return 2;
        }
    };

    public BoilerBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.BOILER_BLOCK_ENTITY, pos, state);
    }

    public boolean isBurning() {
        return this.burnTime > 0 && this.waterMb > 0;
    }

    public int getWaterMb() {
        return this.waterMb;
    }

    public int getSteamMb() {
        return this.steamMb;
    }

    public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, BoilerBlockEntity boiler) {
        if (world == null || world.isClient) return;

        boolean wasBurning = boiler.isBurning();
        boolean dirty = false;

        if (boiler.waterMb >= STEAM_PER_TICK_MB && boiler.steamMb + STEAM_PER_TICK_MB <= CAPACITY_MB) {
            if (boiler.ensureFuel()) {
                boiler.burnTime--;
                boiler.waterMb -= STEAM_PER_TICK_MB;
                boiler.steamMb += STEAM_PER_TICK_MB;
                dirty = true;

                if ((world.getTime() & 7L) == 0L && world instanceof ServerWorld sw) {
                    sw.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.CAMPFIRE_COSY_SMOKE,
                            pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 2.55, pos.getZ() + 0.5,
                            1, 0.1, 0.05, 0.1, 0.015);
                }
            }
        }

        Direction facing = state.get(BoilerBlock.FACING);

        if (boiler.steamMb > 0) {
            BlockPos frontSteamOut = BoilerBlock.getPartPos(pos, facing, 4, false).offset(facing);
            int pushed = FactorioFluidContainer.pushFluidToNeighbor(
                    world, frontSteamOut, facing.getOpposite(), FluidKind.STEAM, Math.min(boiler.steamMb, 120), 165);
            if (pushed > 0) {
                boiler.steamMb -= pushed;
                dirty = true;
            }
            if (boiler.steamMb > 0) {
                BlockPos backSteamOut = pos.offset(facing.getOpposite());
                int pushedBack = FactorioFluidContainer.pushFluidToNeighbor(
                        world, backSteamOut, facing, FluidKind.STEAM, Math.min(boiler.steamMb, 120), 165);
                if (pushedBack > 0) {
                    boiler.steamMb -= pushedBack;
                    dirty = true;
                }
            }
        }

        if (boiler.waterMb > 0) {
            Direction left = facing.rotateYCounterclockwise();
            Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();

            BlockPos[] sideChecks = new BlockPos[]{
                    BoilerBlock.getPartPos(pos, facing, 0, false).offset(left),
                    BoilerBlock.getPartPos(pos, facing, 3, false).offset(left),
                    BoilerBlock.getPartPos(pos, facing, 2, false).offset(right),
                    BoilerBlock.getPartPos(pos, facing, 5, false).offset(right)
            };
            Direction[] fromDirs = new Direction[]{ right, right, left, left };

            for (int i = 0; i < sideChecks.length; i++) {
                if (boiler.waterMb <= 0) break;
                BlockPos targetPos = sideChecks[i];
                BlockState targetState = world.getBlockState(targetPos);
                BlockPos canonical = BlockHealthManager.getCanonicalPos(targetPos, targetState);
                BlockEntity be = world.getBlockEntity(canonical);

                if (be instanceof BoilerBlockEntity otherBoiler && otherBoiler != boiler) {
                    int diff = boiler.waterMb - otherBoiler.waterMb;
                    if (diff > 4) {
                        int transfer = diff / 2;
                        otherBoiler.waterMb += transfer;
                        boiler.waterMb -= transfer;
                        otherBoiler.markDirty();
                        dirty = true;
                    }
                } else if (be instanceof PipeBlockEntity pipe) {
                    int diff = boiler.waterMb - pipe.getFluidAmount();
                    if (diff > 20 && pipe.canAcceptFluid(FluidKind.WATER, fromDirs[i])) {
                        int offer = Math.min(80, diff / 2);
                        int accepted = pipe.insertFluid(FluidKind.WATER, offer, 15, fromDirs[i]);
                        if (accepted > 0) {
                            boiler.waterMb -= accepted;
                            dirty = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        boolean nowBurning = boiler.isBurning();
        if (wasBurning != nowBurning) {
            boiler.sync();
        } else if (dirty) {
            boiler.markDirty();
            if ((world.getTime() % 10) == 0) {
                world.updateListeners(pos, state, state, Block.NOTIFY_LISTENERS);
            }
        }
    }

    private boolean ensureFuel() {
        if (this.burnTime > 0) return true;
        if (!this.fuelStack.isEmpty() && AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(this.fuelStack)) {
            Integer vanilla = FuelRegistry.INSTANCE.get(this.fuelStack.getItem());
            int ticks = (vanilla != null && vanilla > 0) ? Math.max(40, vanilla / 3) : 400;
            this.burnTime = ticks;
            this.maxBurnTime = ticks;

            Item rem = this.fuelStack.getItem().getRecipeRemainder();
            this.fuelStack.decrement(1);
            if (this.fuelStack.isEmpty()) {
                this.fuelStack = (rem != null) ? new ItemStack(rem) : ItemStack.EMPTY;
            }
            sync();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public void sync() {
        markDirty();
        if (this.world != null && !this.world.isClient) {
            this.world.updateListeners(this.pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_LISTENERS);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public FluidKind getFluidKind() {
        return this.steamMb > 0 ? FluidKind.STEAM : (this.waterMb > 0 ? FluidKind.WATER : FluidKind.NONE);
    }

    @Override
    public int getFluidAmount() {
        return this.steamMb > 0 ? this.steamMb : this.waterMb;
    }

    @Override
    public int getFluidCapacity() {
        return CAPACITY_MB;
    }

    @Override
    public int getTemperatureC() {
        return this.steamMb > 0 ? 165 : 15;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canAcceptFluid(FluidKind kind, Direction fromSide) {
        return kind == FluidKind.WATER && this.waterMb < CAPACITY_MB;
    }

    @Override
    public int insertFluid(FluidKind kind, int maxAmount, int tempC, Direction fromSide) {
        if (kind != FluidKind.WATER || maxAmount <= 0) return 0;
        int space = CAPACITY_MB - this.waterMb;
        int add = Math.min(space, maxAmount);
        if (add > 0) {
            boolean wasEmpty = (this.waterMb == 0);
            this.waterMb += add;
            markDirty();
            if (wasEmpty && this.world != null && !this.world.isClient) {
                this.world.updateListeners(this.pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_LISTENERS);
            }
        }
        return add;
    }

    @Override public int size() { return 1; }
    @Override public boolean isValid(int slot, ItemStack stack) { return slot == 0 && AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(stack); }
    @Override public boolean isEmpty() { return this.fuelStack.isEmpty(); }
    @Override public ItemStack getStack(int slot) { return slot == 0 ? this.fuelStack : ItemStack.EMPTY; }

    @Override
    public ItemStack removeStack(int slot, int amount) {
        if (slot == 0) {
            ItemStack res = this.fuelStack.split(amount);
            if (this.fuelStack.isEmpty()) this.fuelStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
            sync();
            return res;
        }
        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
    }

    @Override public ItemStack removeStack(int slot) { return removeStack(slot, 64); }

    @Override
    public void setStack(int slot, ItemStack stack) {
        if (slot == 0) {
            this.fuelStack = stack;
            sync();
        }
    }

    @Override public boolean canPlayerUse(PlayerEntity player) { return true; }
    @Override public void clear() { this.fuelStack = ItemStack.EMPTY; sync(); }

    @Override
    public Text getDisplayName() {
        return Text.translatable("block.factoriocore.boiler");
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public ScreenHandler createMenu(int syncId, PlayerInventory playerInventory, PlayerEntity player) {
        return new BoilerScreenHandler(syncId, playerInventory, this, this.propertyDelegate);
    }

    @Override
    protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
        if (!this.fuelStack.isEmpty()) nbt.put("FuelStack", this.fuelStack.encode(registries));
        nbt.putInt("BurnTime", this.burnTime);
        nbt.putInt("MaxBurnTime", this.maxBurnTime);
        nbt.putInt("WaterMb", this.waterMb);
        nbt.putInt("SteamMb", this.steamMb);
    }

    @Override
    protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
        this.fuelStack = nbt.contains("FuelStack")
                ? ItemStack.fromNbtOrEmpty(registries, nbt.getCompound("FuelStack")) : ItemStack.EMPTY;
        this.burnTime = nbt.getInt("BurnTime");
        this.maxBurnTime = nbt.getInt("MaxBurnTime");
        this.waterMb = nbt.getInt("WaterMb");
        this.steamMb = nbt.getInt("SteamMb");
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public Packet<ClientPlayPacketListener> toUpdatePacket() {
        return BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket.create(this);
    }

        return createNbt(registries);
    }

public class BoilerScreenHandler extends ScreenHandler {
    private final Inventory inventory;
    private final PropertyDelegate propertyDelegate;

    public BoilerScreenHandler(int syncId, PlayerInventory playerInventory) {
        this(syncId, playerInventory, new SimpleInventory(1), new ArrayPropertyDelegate(2));
    }

    public BoilerScreenHandler(int syncId, PlayerInventory playerInventory, Inventory inventory, PropertyDelegate delegate) {
        super(ModScreenHandlers.BOILER_SCREEN_HANDLER, syncId);
        this.inventory = inventory;
        this.propertyDelegate = delegate;
        this.addProperties(delegate);

        this.addSlot(new Slot(inventory, 0, 10, 83) {
            @Override
            public boolean canInsert(ItemStack stack) {
                return AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(stack);
            }
        });

        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 9; ++j) {
                this.addSlot(new Slot(playerInventory, j + i * 9 + 9, 37 + j * 18, 137 + i * 18));
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 9; ++i) {
            this.addSlot(new Slot(playerInventory, i, 37 + i * 18, 195));
        }
    }

    public int getBurnTime() { return this.propertyDelegate.get(0); }
    public int getMaxBurnTime() { return Math.max(1, this.propertyDelegate.get(1)); }

    @Override
    public ItemStack quickMove(PlayerEntity player, int invSlot) {
        ItemStack newStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        Slot slot = this.slots.get(invSlot);
        if (slot != null && slot.hasStack()) {
            ItemStack originalStack = slot.getStack();
            newStack = originalStack.copy();

            if (invSlot == 0) {
                if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, 1, this.slots.size(), true)) {
                    return ItemStack.EMPTY;
                }
            } else {
                if (AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(originalStack)) {
                    if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, 0, 1, false)) {
                        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
                    }
                } else {
                    return ItemStack.EMPTY;
                }
            }

            if (originalStack.isEmpty()) {
                slot.setStack(ItemStack.EMPTY);
            } else {
                slot.markDirty();
            }
        }
        return newStack;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canUse(PlayerEntity player) {
        return this.inventory.canPlayerUse(player);
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.fluids;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.combat.BlockHealthManager;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Direction;
import net.minecraft.world.World;

public interface FactorioFluidContainer {

    enum FluidKind {
        NONE("Empty", 0xFF555555),
        WATER("Water", 0xFF2980B9),
        STEAM("Steam", 0xFFD5DBDB),
        CRUDE_OIL("Crude Oil", 0xFF1C1C22),
        HEAVY_OIL("Heavy Oil", 0xFFA93226),
        LIGHT_OIL("Light Oil", 0xFFD68910),
        PETROLEUM_GAS("Petroleum Gas", 0xFF8E44AD),
        LUBRICANT("Lubricant", 0xFF27AE60),
        SULFURIC_ACID("Sulfuric Acid", 0xFFD4AC0D);

        public final String displayName;
        public final int color;

        FluidKind(String displayName, int color) {
            this.displayName = displayName;
            this.color = color;
        }
    }

    FluidKind getFluidKind();
    int getFluidAmount();
    int getFluidCapacity();
    int getTemperatureC();
    boolean canAcceptFluid(FluidKind kind, Direction fromSide);
    int insertFluid(FluidKind kind, int maxAmount, int tempC, Direction fromSide);

    static int pushFluidToNeighbor(World world, BlockPos targetPos, Direction fromSide,
                                   FluidKind kind, int maxOffer, int tempC) {
        if (world == null || maxOffer <= 0 || kind == FluidKind.NONE) return 0;
        var state = world.getBlockState(targetPos);
        BlockPos canonical = BlockHealthManager.getCanonicalPos(targetPos, state);
        if (world.getBlockEntity(canonical) instanceof FactorioFluidContainer container) {
            if (container.canAcceptFluid(kind, fromSide)) {
                return container.insertFluid(kind, maxOffer, tempC, fromSide);
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
}

    public static BlockPos getPartPos(BlockPos masterPos, Direction facing, int part, boolean upper) {
        BlockPos base = (part == 1) ? masterPos.offset(facing) : masterPos;
        return upper ? base.up() : base;
    }

    public static BlockPos getMasterPos(BlockPos currentPos, BlockState state) {
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof OffshorePumpBlock)) return currentPos;
        Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
        int part = state.get(PART);
        boolean upper = state.get(UPPER);
        BlockPos base = upper ? currentPos.down() : currentPos;

    }

    private static boolean isWaterBlock(BlockState st) {
        return st.isOf(Blocks.WATER)
                || st.isOf(Blocks.SEAGRASS)
                || st.isOf(Blocks.TALL_SEAGRASS)
                || st.isOf(Blocks.KELP)
                || st.isOf(Blocks.KELP_PLANT);
    }
