                        BlockPos p = getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                        if (!p.equals(pos) && world.getBlockState(p).isOf(this)) {
                            world.setBlockState(p, Blocks.AIR.getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL | Block.SKIP_DROPS);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return super.onBreak(world, pos, state, player);
        }

        @Override
        protected ActionResult onUse(BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos, PlayerEntity player, BlockHitResult hit) {
            if (!world.isClient) {
                BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
                if (world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof OilRefineryBlockEntity ref) {
                    player.openHandledScreen(ref);
                }
            }
            return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
        }

        @Nullable
        @Override
        public BlockEntity createBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
            return (state.get(PART) == 12 && !state.get(UPPER)) ? new OilRefineryBlockEntity(pos, state) : null;
        }

        @Nullable
        @Override
        public <T extends BlockEntity> BlockEntityTicker<T> getTicker(World world, BlockState state, BlockEntityType<T> type) {
            if (state.get(PART) != 12 || state.get(UPPER)) return null;
            return world.isClient ? null : validateTicker(type, ModBlocks.OIL_REFINERY_BLOCK_ENTITY, OilRefineryBlockEntity::tick);
        }
    }

    public static class OilRefineryBlockEntity extends BlockEntity implements FactorioFluidContainer, SidedInventory, NamedScreenHandlerFactory {
        public static final long POWER_CONSUMPTION_WATTS = 420_000L;
        public static final int CAPACITY_MB = 4000;
        private static final int[] SLOTS = new int[]{0, 1, 2};

        private final DefaultedList<ItemStack> inventory = DefaultedList.ofSize(3, ItemStack.EMPTY);
        // 0 = Ð‘Ð°Ð·Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ñ Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÑ€Ð°Ð±Ð¾Ñ‚ÐºÐ° Ð½ÐµÑ„Ñ‚Ð¸, 1 = ÐŸÑ€Ð¾Ð´Ð²Ð¸Ð½ÑƒÑ‚Ð°Ñ Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÑ€Ð°Ð±Ð¾Ñ‚ÐºÐ° Ð½ÐµÑ„Ñ‚Ð¸, 2 = Ð¡Ð¶Ð¸Ð¶ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ðµ ÑƒÐ³Ð»Ñ
        private int recipeMode = 0;
        private int progress = 0;

        // Ð’Ñ…Ð¾Ð´Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ Ð±ÑƒÑ„ÐµÑ€Ñ‹ (Ð¡Ñ‹Ñ€Ð°Ñ Ð½ÐµÑ„Ñ‚ÑŒ / ÐœÐ°Ð·ÑƒÑ‚ Ð´Ð»Ñ ÑÐ¶Ð¸Ð¶ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ñ + Ð’Ð¾Ð´Ð°/ÐŸÐ°Ñ€)
        private int crudeOilMb = 0;
        private int waterMb = 0;

        // 3 Ð²Ñ‹Ñ…Ð¾Ð´Ð½Ñ‹Ñ… Ð±ÑƒÑ„ÐµÑ€Ð° (ÐœÐ°Ð·ÑƒÑ‚ -> Ð»ÐµÐ²Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‚ part 20, Ð”Ð¸Ð·ÐµÐ»ÑŒ -> Ñ†ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ñ€Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‚ part 22, ÐŸÐ¾Ð¿ÑƒÑ‚Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð³Ð°Ð· -> Ð¿Ñ€Ð°Ð²Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‚ part 24)
        private int heavyOilMb = 0;
        private int lightOilMb = 0;
        private int petroleumGasMb = 0;

        private boolean powered = false;
        private boolean working = false;

        protected final PropertyDelegate propertyDelegate = new PropertyDelegate() {
            @Override
            public int get(int index) {
                return switch (index) {
                    case 0 -> OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_REFINERY;
                    case 1 -> recipeMode;
                    case 2 -> progress;
                    case 3 -> 100;
                    case 4 -> powered ? 1 : 0;
                    case 5 -> working ? 1 : 0;
                    case 6 -> crudeOilMb;
                    case 7 -> waterMb;
                    case 8 -> heavyOilMb;
                    case 9 -> lightOilMb;
                    case 10 -> petroleumGasMb;
                    default -> 0;
                };
            }

            @Override
            public void set(int index, int value) {
                if (index == 1) {
                    recipeMode = Math.max(0, Math.min(2, value));
                    progress = 0;
                    sync();
                }
            }

            @Override
            public int size() {
                return 11;
            }
        };

        public OilRefineryBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
            super(ModBlocks.OIL_REFINERY_BLOCK_ENTITY, pos, state);
        }

        public int getRecipeMode() { return this.recipeMode; }
        public boolean isPowered() { return this.powered; }
        public boolean isWorking() { return this.working; }
        public int getCrudeOilMb() { return this.crudeOilMb; }
        public int getWaterMb() { return this.waterMb; }
        public int getHeavyOilMb() { return this.heavyOilMb; }
        public int getLightOilMb() { return this.lightOilMb; }
        public int getPetroleumGasMb() { return this.petroleumGasMb; }

        public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, OilRefineryBlockEntity ref) {
            if (world == null || world.isClient) return;

            boolean hasPower = PowerNetworkManager.isMachinePowered(world, pos);
            boolean canRefine = hasPower && ref.canRunRefineryCycle();
            boolean dirty = false;

            if (canRefine) {
                ref.progress += 2;
                if (ref.progress >= 100) {
                    ref.progress = 0;
                    ref.completeRefineryCycle();
                    dirty = true;
                }
                if ((world.getTime() & 7L) == 0L && world instanceof ServerWorld sw) {
                    sw.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.FLAME,
                            pos.getX() - 1.2, pos.getY() + 3.45, pos.getZ() - 1.2,
                            3, 0.12, 0.10, 0.12, 0.01);
                }
            } else {
                ref.progress = 0;
            }

            Direction facing = state.get(OilRefineryBlock.FACING);
            Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();

            if (ref.recipeMode == 0) {
                // Ð’ Ð±Ð°Ð·Ð¾Ð²Ð¾Ð¹ Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÑ€Ð°Ð±Ð¾Ñ‚ÐºÐµ Ð¿Ð¾Ð¿ÑƒÑ‚Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð³Ð°Ð· Ð²Ñ‹Ñ…Ð¾Ð´Ð¸Ñ‚ Ð¸Ð· Ð¿Ñ€Ð°Ð²Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‚Ð° (+2), Ð° Ñ‚Ð°ÐºÐ¶Ðµ Ñ†ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ñ€Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ Ð¸ Ð»ÐµÐ²Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ Ð´Ð»Ñ ÑƒÐ´Ð¾Ð±ÑÑ‚Ð²Ð°
                int[] outOffsets = { 2, 0, -2 };
                for (int wOff : outOffsets) {
                    if (ref.petroleumGasMb <= 0) break;
                    BlockPos outPos = pos.offset(right, wOff).offset(facing, 3);
                    int pushed = FactorioFluidContainer.pushFluidToNeighbor(
                            world, outPos, facing.getOpposite(), FluidKind.PETROLEUM_GAS, Math.min(ref.petroleumGasMb, 120), 25);
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        ref.petroleumGasMb -= pushed;
                        dirty = true;
                    }
                }
            } else {
                // Ð’ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð´Ð²Ð¸Ð½ÑƒÑ‚Ð¾Ð¹ Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÑ€Ð°Ð±Ð¾Ñ‚ÐºÐµ Ð¸ ÑÐ¶Ð¸Ð¶ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ð¸ ÑƒÐ³Ð»Ñ:
                // Ð›ÐµÐ²Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð½Ð¸Ð¹ Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‚ (wOff = -2, part = 20) -> ÐœÐÐ—Ð£Ð¢ (HEAVY_OIL)
                if (ref.heavyOilMb > 0) {
                    BlockPos leftPort = pos.offset(right, -2).offset(facing, 3);
                    int pushed = FactorioFluidContainer.pushFluidToNeighbor(
                            world, leftPort, facing.getOpposite(), FluidKind.HEAVY_OIL, Math.min(ref.heavyOilMb, 120), 25);
                    if (pushed > 0) { ref.heavyOilMb -= pushed; dirty = true; }
                }
                // Ð¦ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ñ€Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð½Ð¸Ð¹ Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‚ (wOff = 0, part = 22) -> Ð”Ð˜Ð—Ð•Ð›Ð¬ÐÐžÐ• Ð¢ÐžÐŸÐ›Ð˜Ð’Ðž (LIGHT_OIL)
                if (ref.lightOilMb > 0) {
                    BlockPos midPort = pos.offset(facing, 3);
                    int pushed = FactorioFluidContainer.pushFluidToNeighbor(
                            world, midPort, facing.getOpposite(), FluidKind.LIGHT_OIL, Math.min(ref.lightOilMb, 120), 25);
                    if (pushed > 0) { ref.lightOilMb -= pushed; dirty = true; }
                }
                // ÐŸÑ€Ð°Ð²Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð½Ð¸Ð¹ Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‚ (wOff = +2, part = 24) -> ÐŸÐžÐŸÐ£Ð¢ÐÐ«Ð™ ÐÐ•Ð¤Ð¢Ð¯ÐÐžÐ™ Ð“ÐÐ— (PETROLEUM_GAS)
                if (ref.petroleumGasMb > 0) {
                    BlockPos rightPort = pos.offset(right, 2).offset(facing, 3);
                    int pushed = FactorioFluidContainer.pushFluidToNeighbor(
                            world, rightPort, facing.getOpposite(), FluidKind.PETROLEUM_GAS, Math.min(ref.petroleumGasMb, 120), 25);
                    if (pushed > 0) { ref.petroleumGasMb -= pushed; dirty = true; }
                }
            }

            if (ref.powered != hasPower || ref.working != canRefine) {
                ref.powered = hasPower;
                ref.working = canRefine;
                ref.sync();
            } else if (dirty && (world.getTime() & 3L) == 0L) {
                ref.sync();
            } else if (dirty) {
                ref.markDirty();
            }
        }

        private boolean canRunRefineryCycle() {
            return switch (this.recipeMode) {
                case 0 -> this.crudeOilMb >= 200 && this.petroleumGasMb + 250 <= CAPACITY_MB;
                case 1 -> this.crudeOilMb >= 200 && this.waterMb >= 100
                        && this.heavyOilMb + 100 <= CAPACITY_MB
                        && this.lightOilMb + 180 <= CAPACITY_MB
                        && this.petroleumGasMb + 220 <= CAPACITY_MB;
                default -> this.inventory.get(0).isOf(Items.COAL) && this.inventory.get(0).getCount() >= 2
                        && this.waterMb >= 100
                        && this.heavyOilMb + 260 <= CAPACITY_MB
                        && this.lightOilMb + 80 <= CAPACITY_MB
                        && this.petroleumGasMb + 40 <= CAPACITY_MB;
            };
        }

        private void completeRefineryCycle() {
            switch (this.recipeMode) {
                case 0 -> {
                    this.crudeOilMb -= 200;
                    this.petroleumGasMb = Math.min(CAPACITY_MB, this.petroleumGasMb + 250);
                }
                case 1 -> {
                    this.crudeOilMb -= 200;
                    this.waterMb -= 100;
                    this.heavyOilMb = Math.min(CAPACITY_MB, this.heavyOilMb + 100);
                    this.lightOilMb = Math.min(CAPACITY_MB, this.lightOilMb + 180);
                    this.petroleumGasMb = Math.min(CAPACITY_MB, this.petroleumGasMb + 220);
                }
                default -> {
                    this.inventory.get(0).decrement(2);
                    this.waterMb -= 100;
                    this.heavyOilMb = Math.min(CAPACITY_MB, this.heavyOilMb + 260);
                    this.lightOilMb = Math.min(CAPACITY_MB, this.lightOilMb + 80);
                    this.petroleumGasMb = Math.min(CAPACITY_MB, this.petroleumGasMb + 40);
                }
            }
            sync();
        }

        public void sync() {
            markDirty();
            if (this.world != null && !this.world.isClient) {
                this.world.updateListeners(this.pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_LISTENERS);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public FluidKind getFluidKind() {
            if (this.petroleumGasMb > 0) return FluidKind.PETROLEUM_GAS;
            if (this.lightOilMb > 0) return FluidKind.LIGHT_OIL;
            if (this.heavyOilMb > 0) return FluidKind.HEAVY_OIL;
            return this.crudeOilMb > 0 ? FluidKind.CRUDE_OIL : FluidKind.NONE;
        }

        @Override public int getFluidAmount() { return Math.max(this.petroleumGasMb, Math.max(this.lightOilMb, Math.max(this.heavyOilMb, this.crudeOilMb))); }
        @Override public int getFluidCapacity() { return CAPACITY_MB; }
        @Override public int getTemperatureC() { return 25; }

        @Override
        public boolean canAcceptFluid(FluidKind kind, Direction fromSide) {
            if (kind == FluidKind.CRUDE_OIL) return this.crudeOilMb < CAPACITY_MB;
            if (kind == FluidKind.WATER || kind == FluidKind.STEAM) return this.waterMb < CAPACITY_MB;
            if (kind == FluidKind.HEAVY_OIL && this.recipeMode == 2) return this.crudeOilMb < CAPACITY_MB;
            return false;
        }

        @Override
        public int insertFluid(FluidKind kind, int maxAmount, int tempC, Direction fromSide) {
            if (maxAmount <= 0) return 0;
            if (kind == FluidKind.CRUDE_OIL || (kind == FluidKind.HEAVY_OIL && this.recipeMode == 2)) {
                int add = Math.min(CAPACITY_MB - this.crudeOilMb, maxAmount);
                if (add > 0) {
                    boolean wasEmpty = (this.crudeOilMb == 0);
                    this.crudeOilMb += add;
                    if (wasEmpty || (this.world != null && (this.world.getTime() & 3L) == 0L)) sync();
                    else markDirty();
                }
                return add;
            }
            if (kind == FluidKind.WATER || kind == FluidKind.STEAM) {
                int add = Math.min(CAPACITY_MB - this.waterMb, maxAmount);
                if (add > 0) {
                    boolean wasEmpty = (this.waterMb == 0);
                    this.waterMb += add;
                    if (wasEmpty || (this.world != null && (this.world.getTime() & 3L) == 0L)) sync();
                    else markDirty();
                }
                return add;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        @Override public int[] getAvailableSlots(Direction side) { return SLOTS; }
        @Override public boolean isValid(int slot, ItemStack stack) { return slot == 0 && stack.isOf(Items.COAL); }
        @Override public boolean canInsert(int slot, ItemStack stack, @Nullable Direction dir) { return isValid(slot, stack); }
        @Override public boolean canExtract(int slot, ItemStack stack, Direction dir) { return false; }
        @Override public int size() { return 3; }
        @Override public boolean isEmpty() { return inventory.stream().allMatch(ItemStack::isEmpty); }
        @Override public ItemStack getStack(int slot) { return (slot >= 0 && slot < 3) ? inventory.get(slot) : ItemStack.EMPTY; }
        @Override public ItemStack removeStack(int slot, int amount) { ItemStack r = Inventories.splitStack(inventory, slot, amount); if (!r.isEmpty()) sync(); return r; }
        @Override public ItemStack removeStack(int slot) { ItemStack r = Inventories.removeStack(inventory, slot); if (!r.isEmpty()) sync(); return r; }
        @Override public void setStack(int slot, ItemStack stack) { if (slot >= 0 && slot < 3) { inventory.set(slot, stack); sync(); } }
        @Override public boolean canPlayerUse(PlayerEntity player) { return true; }
        @Override public void clear() { inventory.clear(); sync(); }

        @Override
        public Text getDisplayName() {
            return Text.translatable("block.factoriocore.oil_refinery");
        }

        @Nullable
        @Override
        public ScreenHandler createMenu(int syncId, PlayerInventory playerInventory, PlayerEntity player) {
            return new OilMachineScreenHandler(syncId, playerInventory, this, this.propertyDelegate);
        }

        @Override
        protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
            super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
            Inventories.writeNbt(nbt, this.inventory, registries);
            nbt.putInt("RecipeMode", this.recipeMode);
            nbt.putInt("Progress", this.progress);
            nbt.putInt("CrudeOilMb", this.crudeOilMb);
            nbt.putInt("WaterMb", this.waterMb);
            nbt.putInt("HeavyOilMb", this.heavyOilMb);
            nbt.putInt("LightOilMb", this.lightOilMb);
            nbt.putInt("PetroleumGasMb", this.petroleumGasMb);
            nbt.putBoolean("Powered", this.powered);
            nbt.putBoolean("Working", this.working);
        }

        @Override
        protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
            super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
            this.inventory.clear();
            Inventories.readNbt(nbt, this.inventory, registries);
            this.recipeMode = nbt.getInt("RecipeMode");
            this.progress = nbt.getInt("Progress");
            this.crudeOilMb = nbt.getInt("CrudeOilMb");
            this.waterMb = nbt.getInt("WaterMb");
            this.heavyOilMb = nbt.getInt("HeavyOilMb");
            this.lightOilMb = nbt.getInt("LightOilMb");
            this.petroleumGasMb = nbt.getInt("PetroleumGasMb");
            this.powered = nbt.getBoolean("Powered");
            this.working = nbt.getBoolean("Working");
        }

        @Nullable @Override public Packet<ClientPlayPacketListener> toUpdatePacket() { return BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket.create(this); }
        @Override public NbtCompound toInitialChunkDataNbt(RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) { return createNbt(registries); }
    }

    public static class ChemicalPlantBlock extends Base3x3MachineBlock {
        public static final MapCodec<ChemicalPlantBlock> CODEC = createCodec(ChemicalPlantBlock::new);

        public ChemicalPlantBlock(Settings settings) {
            super(settings);
        }

        @Override protected MapCodec<? extends BlockWithEntity> getCodec() { return CODEC; }

        @Nullable
        @Override
        public BlockState getPlacementState(ItemPlacementContext ctx) {
            Direction facing = ctx.getHorizontalPlayerFacing().getOpposite();
            if (ctx.getPlayer() != null && ctx.getPlayer().isSneaking()) {
                facing = facing.getOpposite();
            }
            BlockPos masterPos = ctx.getBlockPos();
            World world = ctx.getWorld();

            for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                for (int yOff = 0; yOff <= 1; yOff++) {
                    BlockPos checkPos = getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, yOff == 1);
                    if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(checkPos) || !world.getBlockState(checkPos).canReplace(ctx)) {
                        return null;
                    }
                }
            }
            return this.getDefaultState().with(FACING, facing).with(PART, 4).with(UPPER, false);
        }

        @Override
        protected ActionResult onUse(BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos, PlayerEntity player, BlockHitResult hit) {
            if (!world.isClient) {
                BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
                if (world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof ChemicalPlantBlockEntity chem) {
                    player.openHandledScreen(chem);
                }
            }
            return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
        }

        @Nullable
        @Override
        public BlockEntity createBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
            return (state.get(PART) == 4 && !state.get(UPPER)) ? new ChemicalPlantBlockEntity(pos, state) : null;
        }

        @Nullable
        @Override
        public <T extends BlockEntity> BlockEntityTicker<T> getTicker(World world, BlockState state, BlockEntityType<T> type) {
            if (state.get(PART) != 4 || state.get(UPPER)) return null;
            return world.isClient ? null : validateTicker(type, ModBlocks.CHEMICAL_PLANT_BLOCK_ENTITY, ChemicalPlantBlockEntity::tick);
        }
    }

                case 0, 4, 5 -> FluidKind.HEAVY_OIL;
                case 1, 3 -> FluidKind.LIGHT_OIL;
                case 2, 7, 8 -> FluidKind.PETROLEUM_GAS;
                case 9 -> FluidKind.SULFURIC_ACID;
                default -> FluidKind.NONE;
            };
        }

        public boolean requiresWater() {
            return this.recipeMode == 0 || this.recipeMode == 1 || this.recipeMode == 6 || this.recipeMode == 8 || this.recipeMode == 10;
        }

        public FluidKind getProducedFluidKind() {
            return switch (this.recipeMode) {
                case 0 -> FluidKind.LIGHT_OIL;
                case 1 -> FluidKind.PETROLEUM_GAS;
                case 5 -> FluidKind.LUBRICANT;
                case 6 -> FluidKind.SULFURIC_ACID;
                default -> FluidKind.NONE;
            };
        }

        public ItemStack getProducedItemStack() {
            return switch (this.recipeMode) {
                case 2, 3, 4 -> new ItemStack(ModItems.SOLID_FUEL, 1);
                case 7 -> new ItemStack(ModItems.PLASTIC_BAR, 2);
                case 8 -> new ItemStack(ModItems.SULFUR, 2);
                case 9 -> new ItemStack(ModItems.BATTERY, 1);
                case 10 -> new ItemStack(ModItems.EXPLOSIVES, 2);
                default -> ItemStack.EMPTY;
            };
        }

        public ItemStack getRecipeIcon() {
            ItemStack itemOut = getProducedItemStack();
            if (!itemOut.isEmpty()) return itemOut;
            return new ItemStack(ModBlocks.PIPE);
        }

        public static boolean isSlotValidForMode(int mode, int slot, ItemStack stack) {
            if (slot == 0) {
                return switch (mode) {
                    case 6, 10 -> stack.isOf(ModItems.SULFUR);
                    case 7 -> stack.isOf(Items.COAL);
                    case 9 -> stack.isOf(Items.IRON_INGOT);
                    default -> false;
                };
            }
            if (slot == 1) {
                return switch (mode) {
                    case 6 -> stack.isOf(Items.IRON_INGOT);
                    case 9 -> stack.isOf(Items.COPPER_INGOT);
                    case 10 -> stack.isOf(Items.COAL);
                    default -> false;
                };
            }
            return false;
        }

        public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, ChemicalPlantBlockEntity chem) {
            if (world == null || world.isClient) return;

            boolean hasPower = PowerNetworkManager.isMachinePowered(world, pos);
            boolean canCraft = hasPower && chem.canRunCycle();
            boolean dirty = false;

            if (canCraft) {
                chem.progress++;
                if (chem.progress >= 40) {
                    chem.progress = 0;
                    chem.completeCycle(world, pos, state);
                    dirty = true;
                }
            } else {
                chem.progress = 0;
            }

            // Ð’Ñ‹Ð³Ñ€ÑƒÐ¶Ð°ÐµÐ¼ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¸Ð·Ð²ÐµÐ´Ñ‘Ð½Ð½ÑƒÑŽ Ð¶Ð¸Ð´ÐºÐ¾ÑÑ‚ÑŒ (Ð”Ð¸Ð·ÐµÐ»ÑŒ / Ð“Ð°Ð· / Ð¡Ð¼Ð°Ð·ÐºÐ° / Ð¡ÐµÑ€Ð½Ð°Ñ ÐºÐ¸ÑÐ»Ð¾Ñ‚Ð°) Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ· 2 Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð½Ð¸Ñ… Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‚Ð° (part 6 Ð¸ 8)
            FluidKind outKind = chem.getProducedFluidKind();
            if (outKind != FluidKind.NONE && chem.outFluidMb > 0) {
                Direction facing = state.get(Base3x3MachineBlock.FACING);
                Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
                int[] portOffsets = { -1, 1 };
                for (int wOff : portOffsets) {
                    if (chem.outFluidMb <= 0) break;
                    BlockPos outPos = pos.offset(right, wOff).offset(facing, 2);
                    int pushed = FactorioFluidContainer.pushFluidToNeighbor(
                            world, outPos, facing.getOpposite(), outKind, Math.min(chem.outFluidMb, 120), 25);
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        chem.outFluidMb -= pushed;
                        dirty = true;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (chem.powered != hasPower || chem.working != canCraft) {
                chem.powered = hasPower;
                chem.working = canCraft;
                chem.sync();
            } else if (dirty && (world.getTime() & 3L) == 0L) {
                chem.sync();
            } else if (dirty) {
                chem.markDirty();
            }
        }

        private boolean canRunCycle() {
            ItemStack prodItem = getProducedItemStack();
            if (!prodItem.isEmpty()) {
                ItemStack curOut = this.inventory.get(2);
                if (!curOut.isEmpty() && (!ItemStack.areItemsAndComponentsEqual(curOut, prodItem)
                        || curOut.getCount() + prodItem.getCount() > curOut.getMaxCount())) {
                    return false;
                }
            } else if (this.outFluidMb + 250 > CAPACITY_MB) {
                return false;
            }

            ItemStack s0 = this.inventory.get(0);
            ItemStack s1 = this.inventory.get(1);

            return switch (this.recipeMode) {
                case 0 -> this.mainFluidMb >= 200 && this.waterMb >= 150;
                case 1 -> this.mainFluidMb >= 150 && this.waterMb >= 150;
                case 2, 4 -> this.mainFluidMb >= 200;
                case 3, 5 -> this.mainFluidMb >= 100;
                case 6 -> this.waterMb >= 200 && s0.isOf(ModItems.SULFUR) && s0.getCount() >= 5 && s1.isOf(Items.IRON_INGOT) && s1.getCount() >= 1;
                case 7 -> this.mainFluidMb >= 200 && s0.isOf(Items.COAL) && s0.getCount() >= 1;
                case 8 -> this.mainFluidMb >= 150 && this.waterMb >= 150;
                case 9 -> this.mainFluidMb >= 100 && s0.isOf(Items.IRON_INGOT) && s0.getCount() >= 1 && s1.isOf(Items.COPPER_INGOT) && s1.getCount() >= 1;
                case 10 -> this.waterMb >= 100 && s0.isOf(ModItems.SULFUR) && s0.getCount() >= 1 && s1.isOf(Items.COAL) && s1.getCount() >= 1;
                default -> false;
            };
        }

        private void completeCycle(World world, BlockPos masterPos, BlockState state) {
            switch (this.recipeMode) {
                case 0 -> { this.mainFluidMb -= 200; this.waterMb -= 150; this.outFluidMb = Math.min(CAPACITY_MB, this.outFluidMb + 150); }
                case 1 -> { this.mainFluidMb -= 150; this.waterMb -= 150; this.outFluidMb = Math.min(CAPACITY_MB, this.outFluidMb + 100); }
                case 2, 4 -> this.mainFluidMb -= 200;
                case 3 -> this.mainFluidMb -= 100;
                case 5 -> { this.mainFluidMb -= 100; this.outFluidMb = Math.min(CAPACITY_MB, this.outFluidMb + 100); }
                case 6 -> { this.waterMb -= 200; this.inventory.get(0).decrement(5); this.inventory.get(1).decrement(1); this.outFluidMb = Math.min(CAPACITY_MB, this.outFluidMb + 250); }
                case 7 -> { this.mainFluidMb -= 200; this.inventory.get(0).decrement(1); }
                case 8 -> { this.mainFluidMb -= 150; this.waterMb -= 150; }
                case 9 -> { this.mainFluidMb -= 100; this.inventory.get(0).decrement(1); this.inventory.get(1).decrement(1); }
                case 10 -> { this.waterMb -= 100; this.inventory.get(0).decrement(1); this.inventory.get(1).decrement(1); }
            }

            ItemStack prodItem = getProducedItemStack();
            if (!prodItem.isEmpty()) {
                ItemStack out = this.inventory.get(2);
                if (out.isEmpty()) {
                    this.inventory.set(2, prodItem.copy());
                } else {
                    out.increment(prodItem.getCount());
                }
                wakeSurroundingInserters(world, masterPos, state);
            }
            sync();
        }

        private static void wakeSurroundingInserters(World world, BlockPos masterPos, BlockState state) {
            if (world == null || world.isClient) return;
            Direction facing = state.contains(Base3x3MachineBlock.FACING) ? state.get(Base3x3MachineBlock.FACING) : Direction.NORTH;
            for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                InserterBlockEntity.wakeUpAdjacentInserters(world, Base3x3MachineBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, false));
            }
        }

        public void sync() {
            markDirty();
            if (this.world != null && !this.world.isClient) {
                this.world.updateListeners(this.pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_LISTENERS);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public FluidKind getFluidKind() {
            if (this.outFluidMb > 0) return getProducedFluidKind();
            if (this.mainFluidMb > 0) return getRequiredMainFluid();
            return this.waterMb > 0 ? FluidKind.WATER : FluidKind.NONE;
        }

        @Override public int getFluidAmount() { return Math.max(this.outFluidMb, Math.max(this.mainFluidMb, this.waterMb)); }
        @Override public int getFluidCapacity() { return CAPACITY_MB; }
        @Override public int getTemperatureC() { return 25; }

        @Override
        public boolean canAcceptFluid(FluidKind kind, Direction fromSide) {
            FluidKind req = getRequiredMainFluid();
            if (req != FluidKind.NONE && kind == req) return this.mainFluidMb < CAPACITY_MB;
            if (requiresWater() && kind == FluidKind.WATER) return this.waterMb < CAPACITY_MB;
            return false;
        }

        @Override
        public int insertFluid(FluidKind kind, int maxAmount, int tempC, Direction fromSide) {
            if (maxAmount <= 0) return 0;
            FluidKind req = getRequiredMainFluid();
            if (req != FluidKind.NONE && kind == req) {
                int add = Math.min(CAPACITY_MB - this.mainFluidMb, maxAmount);
                if (add > 0) {
                    boolean wasEmpty = (this.mainFluidMb == 0);
                    this.mainFluidMb += add;
                    if (wasEmpty || (this.world != null && (this.world.getTime() & 3L) == 0L)) sync();
                    else markDirty();
                }
                return add;
            }
            if (requiresWater() && kind == FluidKind.WATER) {
                int add = Math.min(CAPACITY_MB - this.waterMb, maxAmount);
                if (add > 0) {
                    boolean wasEmpty = (this.waterMb == 0);
                    this.waterMb += add;
                    if (wasEmpty || (this.world != null && (this.world.getTime() & 3L) == 0L)) sync();
                    else markDirty();
                }
                return add;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        @Override public int[] getAvailableSlots(Direction side) { return SLOTS; }

public class PollutionManager {

    public static final float MAX_CHUNK_POLLUTION = 500.0f;
    private static final float DIFFUSION_RATE = 0.06f;
    private static final float BASE_DISSIPATION = 0.05f;

    private static final Map<RegistryKey<World>, Map<Long, Float>> WORLD_POLLUTION = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final Map<Long, Float> CLIENT_POLLUTION_CACHE = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public static Map<Long, Float> getWorldMap(World world) {
        return WORLD_POLLUTION.computeIfAbsent(world.getRegistryKey(), k -> new ConcurrentHashMap<>());
    }

    public static void emitPollution(World world, BlockPos pos, float amount) {
        if (world == null || world.isClient() || amount <= 0.0f) return;
        long chunkKey = ChunkPos.toLong(pos.getX() >> 4, pos.getZ() >> 4);
        Map<Long, Float> map = getWorldMap(world);
        float current = map.getOrDefault(chunkKey, 0.0f);
        map.put(chunkKey, Math.min(MAX_CHUNK_POLLUTION, current + amount));
    }

    public static float getPollutionAt(World world, BlockPos pos) {
        long key = ChunkPos.toLong(pos.getX() >> 4, pos.getZ() >> 4);
        if (world.isClient()) {
            return CLIENT_POLLUTION_CACHE.getOrDefault(key, 0.0f);
        }
        return getWorldMap(world).getOrDefault(key, 0.0f);
    }

    public static float getClientChunkPollution(int chunkX, int chunkZ) {
        return CLIENT_POLLUTION_CACHE.getOrDefault(ChunkPos.toLong(chunkX, chunkZ), 0.0f);
    }

    /**
     * Ð’Ñ‹Ñ‡Ð¸ÑÐ»ÑÐµÑ‚ Ð¿Ð»Ð°Ð²Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÐºÐ¾ÑÑ„Ñ„Ð¸Ñ†Ð¸ÐµÐ½Ñ‚ Ð¿Ð¾Ð·ÐµÐ»ÐµÐ½ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ñ Ð²Ð¾Ð´Ñ‹ (0.0 .. 1.0)
     * Ñ ÑƒÑ‡Ñ‘Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¼ Ð´Ð¸Ñ„Ñ„ÑƒÐ·Ð¸Ð¸ Ð·Ð°Ð³Ñ€ÑÐ·Ð½ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ñ Ñ Ð±ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ³Ð° Ð½Ð° Ð²Ð¾Ð´Ð½ÑƒÑŽ Ð³Ð»Ð°Ð´ÑŒ Ð¾Ð·ÐµÑ€Ð°.
     */
    public static float getClientWaterTintFactor(int blockX, int blockZ) {
        float fx = (blockX / 16.0f) - 0.5f;
        float fz = (blockZ / 16.0f) - 0.5f;
        int cx0 = MathHelper.floor(fx);
        int cz0 = MathHelper.floor(fz);
        float tx = fx - cx0;
        float tz = fz - cz0;

        float p00 = getEffectiveWaterPollution(cx0, cz0);
        float p10 = getEffectiveWaterPollution(cx0 + 1, cz0);
        float p01 = getEffectiveWaterPollution(cx0, cz0 + 1);
        float p11 = getEffectiveWaterPollution(cx0 + 1, cz0 + 1);

        float px0 = MathHelper.lerp(tx, p00, p10);
        float px1 = MathHelper.lerp(tx, p01, p11);
        float poll = MathHelper.lerp(tz, px0, px1);

        if (poll < 0.8f) return 0.0f;
        return MathHelper.clamp((poll - 0.8f) / 18.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    }

    private static float getEffectiveWaterPollution(int cx, int cz) {
        float direct = getClientChunkPollution(cx, cz);
        float maxNeighbor = 0.0f;
        for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) {
                if (dx == 0 && dz == 0) continue;
                float np = getClientChunkPollution(cx + dx, cz + dz);
                float weight = (dx == 0 || dz == 0) ? 0.55f : 0.35f;
                maxNeighbor = Math.max(maxNeighbor, np * weight);
            }
        }
        return Math.max(direct, maxNeighbor);
    }

    public static Map<Long, Float> getClientCache() {
        return CLIENT_POLLUTION_CACHE;
    }

    public static void updateClientCache(Map<Long, Float> syncedMap) {
        CLIENT_POLLUTION_CACHE.clear();
        CLIENT_POLLUTION_CACHE.putAll(syncedMap);
    }

    public static void clearClientCache() {
        CLIENT_POLLUTION_CACHE.clear();
    }

    public static void tickServerWorld(ServerWorld world) {
        long time = world.getTime();

        if (time % 20 == 0) {
            for (ServerPlayerEntity player : world.getPlayers()) {
                scanAndEmitAroundPlayer(world, player.getBlockPos(), 36);
            }
        }

        if (time % 40 == 0) {
            stepDiffusionAndAbsorption(world);
        }

        if (time % 20 == 0) {
            Map<Long, Float> fullMap = getWorldMap(world);
            for (ServerPlayerEntity player : world.getPlayers()) {
                int pcx = player.getChunkPos().x;
                int pcz = player.getChunkPos().z;
                Map<Long, Float> nearby = new HashMap<>();

                for (int dx = -12; dx <= 12; dx++) {
                    for (int dz = -12; dz <= 12; dz++) {
                        long k = ChunkPos.toLong(pcx + dx, pcz + dz);
                        float val = fullMap.getOrDefault(k, 0.0f);
                        if (val >= 0.25f) {
                            nearby.put(k, val);
                        }
                    }
                }
                ServerPlayNetworking.send(player, new SyncPollutionPayload(nearby));
            }
        }
    }

    private static void scanAndEmitAroundPlayer(ServerWorld world, BlockPos center, int radius) {
        for (int dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -radius; dz <= radius; dz++) {
                for (int dy = -6; dy <= 6; dy++) {
                    BlockPos pos = center.add(dx, dy, dz);
                    BlockState state = world.getBlockState(pos);
                    if (state.isAir()) continue;
                    Block block = state.getBlock();

                    if (block instanceof BurnerDrillBlock
                            && state.get(BurnerDrillBlock.PART) == 0
                            && !state.get(BurnerDrillBlock.UPPER)) {
                        if (world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof BurnerDrillBlockEntity drill && drill.isWorking()) {
                            emitPollution(world, pos, 0.70f);
                            spawnChimneySmoke(world, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 2.55, pos.getZ() + 0.5, 1);
                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof ElectricDrillBlock
                            && state.get(ElectricDrillBlock.PART) == 4
                            && !state.get(ElectricDrillBlock.UPPER)) {
                        if (world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof ElectricDrillBlockEntity edrill && edrill.isActivelyMining()) {
                            emitPollution(world, pos, 0.55f);
                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlock furnaceBlock
                            && state.get(FactorioFurnaceBlock.PART) == 0
                            && !state.get(FactorioFurnaceBlock.UPPER)) {
                        if (world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity furnace && furnace.isBurning()) {
                            float emission = (furnaceBlock.getTier() == 1) ? 0.40f : 0.75f;
                            emitPollution(world, pos, emission);
                            spawnChimneySmoke(world, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 2.6, pos.getZ() + 0.5, 1);
                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof BoilerBlock
                            && state.get(BoilerBlock.PART) == 1
                            && !state.get(BoilerBlock.UPPER)) {
                        if (world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof BoilerBlockEntity boiler && boiler.isBurning()) {
                            emitPollution(world, pos, 1.10f);
                            spawnChimneySmoke(world, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 2.6, pos.getZ() + 0.5, 2);
                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof AssemblerBlock
                            && state.get(AssemblerBlock.PART) == 4
                            && !state.get(AssemblerBlock.UPPER)) {
                        if (world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof AssemblerBlockEntity asm && asm.isWorking()) {
                            emitPollution(world, pos, 0.30f);
                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof OilMachines.PumpjackBlock
                            && state.get(OilMachines.PumpjackBlock.PART) == 4
                            && !state.get(OilMachines.PumpjackBlock.UPPER)) {
                        if (world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof OilMachines.PumpjackBlockEntity pj && pj.isWorking()) {
                            emitPollution(world, pos, 0.65f);
                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof OilMachines.OilRefineryBlock
                            && state.get(OilMachines.OilRefineryBlock.PART) == 12
                            && !state.get(OilMachines.OilRefineryBlock.UPPER)) {
                        if (world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof OilMachines.OilRefineryBlockEntity ref && ref.isWorking()) {
                            emitPollution(world, pos, 0.90f);
                            spawnChimneySmoke(world, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 2.75, pos.getZ() + 0.5, 2);
                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof OilMachines.ChemicalPlantBlock
                            && state.get(OilMachines.ChemicalPlantBlock.PART) == 4
                            && !state.get(OilMachines.ChemicalPlantBlock.UPPER)) {
                        if (world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof OilMachines.ChemicalPlantBlockEntity cp && cp.isWorking()) {
                            emitPollution(world, pos, 0.60f);
                            spawnChimneySmoke(world, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 2.25, pos.getZ() + 0.5, 1);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static void spawnChimneySmoke(ServerWorld world, double x, double y, double z, int count) {
        world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.CAMPFIRE_COSY_SMOKE, x, y, z, count, 0.08, 0.10, 0.08, 0.012);
    }

    private static void stepDiffusionAndAbsorption(ServerWorld world) {
        Map<Long, Float> map = getWorldMap(world);
        if (map.isEmpty()) return;

        Map<Long, Float> nextMap = new HashMap<>(map.size());

        for (Map.Entry<Long, Float> entry : map.entrySet()) {
            long key = entry.getKey();
            float val = entry.getValue();
            if (val < 0.15f) continue;

            int cx = ChunkPos.getPackedX(key);
            int cz = ChunkPos.getPackedZ(key);

            float absorbed = BASE_DISSIPATION;
            if (world.isChunkLoaded(cx, cz)) {
                absorbed += sampleChunkNatureAbsorption(world, cx, cz, val);
            }

            float remaining = Math.max(0.0f, val - absorbed);
            if (remaining <= 0.1f) continue;

            // Ð£Ð¶Ðµ Ñ 3.0 PU Ð·Ð°Ð³Ñ€ÑÐ·Ð½ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ðµ Ð½Ð°Ñ‡Ð¸Ð½Ð°ÐµÑ‚ Ñ€Ð°ÑÐ¿Ð¾Ð»Ð·Ð°Ñ‚ÑŒÑÑ Ð½Ð° ÑÐ¾ÑÐµÐ´Ð½Ð¸Ðµ Ñ‡Ð°Ð½ÐºÐ¸ (Ð¸ Ð¾ÐºÑ€Ð°ÑˆÐ¸Ð²Ð°Ñ‚ÑŒ Ð²Ð¾Ð´Ñƒ Ð¾Ð·Ñ‘Ñ€!)
            if (remaining > 3.0f) {
                float spreadEach = remaining * DIFFUSION_RATE;
                float stayed = remaining - (spreadEach * 4.0f);
                nextMap.merge(key, stayed, Float::sum);

                long[] neighbors = {
                        ChunkPos.toLong(cx + 1, cz),
                        ChunkPos.toLong(cx - 1, cz),
                        ChunkPos.toLong(cx, cz + 1),
                        ChunkPos.toLong(cx, cz - 1)
                };
                for (long nk : neighbors) {
                    nextMap.merge(nk, spreadEach, (a, b) -> Math.min(MAX_CHUNK_POLLUTION, a + b));
                }
            } else {
                nextMap.merge(key, remaining, Float::sum);
            }
        }

        map.clear();
        for (Map.Entry<Long, Float> e : nextMap.entrySet()) {
            if (e.getValue() >= 0.15f) {
                map.put(e.getKey(), MathHelper.clamp(e.getValue(), 0.0f, MAX_CHUNK_POLLUTION));
            }
        }
    }

    private static float sampleChunkNatureAbsorption(ServerWorld world, int cx, int cz, float chunkPollution) {
        float bonusAbsorption = 0.0f;
        int startX = cx << 4;
        int startZ = cz << 4;

        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            int rx = startX + world.random.nextInt(16);
            int rz = startZ + world.random.nextInt(16);
            int topY = world.getTopY(Heightmap.Type.MOTION_BLOCKING, rx, rz) - 1;
            if (topY <= world.getBottomY()) continue;

            BlockPos surfacePos = new BlockPos(rx, topY, rz);
            BlockState state = world.getBlockState(surfacePos);

            if (state.isIn(BlockTags.LEAVES)) {
                bonusAbsorption += 0.12f;
                if (chunkPollution > 160.0f && world.random.nextFloat() < 0.02f) {
                    world.breakBlock(surfacePos, false);
                }
            } else if (state.isOf(Blocks.GRASS_BLOCK)) {
                bonusAbsorption += 0.03f;
                if (chunkPollution > 200.0f && world.random.nextFloat() < 0.015f) {
                    BlockState withered = world.random.nextBoolean()
                            ? Blocks.COARSE_DIRT.getDefaultState()
                            : Blocks.PODZOL.getDefaultState();
                    world.setBlockState(surfacePos, withered, Block.NOTIFY_LISTENERS);
                }
            }
        }
        return bonusAbsorption;
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.production.assembler;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModBlocks;

public class AssemblerBlock extends BlockWithEntity {
    public static final MapCodec<AssemblerBlock> CODEC = createCodec(AssemblerBlock::new);
    public static final DirectionProperty FACING = Properties.HORIZONTAL_FACING;
    public static final IntProperty PART = IntProperty.of("part", 0, 8);
    public static final BooleanProperty UPPER = BooleanProperty.of("upper");
    private static final net.minecraft.util.shape.VoxelShape UPPER_SHAPE = Block.createCuboidShape(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 12.0, 16.0);

    public AssemblerBlock(Settings settings) {
        super(settings);
        this.setDefaultState(this.stateManager.getDefaultState()
                .with(FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                .with(PART, 4)
                .with(UPPER, false));
    }

    @Override
    protected MapCodec<? extends BlockWithEntity> getCodec() {
        return CODEC;
    }

    @Override
    protected void appendProperties(StateManager.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
        builder.add(FACING, PART, UPPER);
    }

    public static BlockPos getPartPos(BlockPos masterPos, Direction facing, int part, boolean upper) {
        int localX = (part % 3) - 1;
        int localZ = (part / 3) - 1;
        Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
        BlockPos p = masterPos.offset(right, localX).offset(facing, localZ);
        return upper ? p.up() : p;
    }

    public static BlockPos getMasterPos(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof AssemblerBlock)) return pos;
        int part = state.get(PART);
        boolean upper = state.get(UPPER);
        Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
        int localX = (part % 3) - 1;
        int localZ = (part / 3) - 1;
        Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
        BlockPos base = upper ? pos.down() : pos;
        return base.offset(right, -localX).offset(facing, -localZ);
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockState getPlacementState(ItemPlacementContext ctx) {
        World world = ctx.getWorld();
        BlockPos masterPos = ctx.getBlockPos();
        Direction facing = ctx.getHorizontalPlayerFacing().getOpposite();
        if (ctx.getPlayer() != null && ctx.getPlayer().isSneaking()) {
            facing = facing.getOpposite();
        }

        for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
            for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                BlockPos p = getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(p) || !world.getBlockState(p).canReplace(ctx)) {
                    return null;
                }
            }
        }
        return this.getDefaultState().with(FACING, facing).with(PART, 4).with(UPPER, false);
    }

    @Override
    public void onPlaced(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, @Nullable LivingEntity placer, ItemStack itemStack) {
        super.onPlaced(world, pos, state, placer, itemStack);
        if (world.isClient) return;
        Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
        for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
            for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                if (part == 4 && u == 0) continue;
                BlockPos p = getPartPos(pos, facing, part, u == 1);
                world.setBlockState(p, this.getDefaultState()
                        .with(FACING, facing)
                        .with(PART, part)
                        .with(UPPER, u == 1), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public BlockState onBreak(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, PlayerEntity player) {
        if (!world.isClient) {
            BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
            Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
            if (world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof AssemblerBlockEntity asm) {
                ItemScatterer.spawn(world, masterPos, asm);
            }
            for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (!p.equals(pos) && world.getBlockState(p).isOf(this)) {
                        world.setBlockState(p, Blocks.AIR.getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL | Block.SKIP_DROPS);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return super.onBreak(world, pos, state, player);
    }

    @Override
    protected ActionResult onUse(BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos, PlayerEntity player, BlockHitResult hit) {
        if (!world.isClient) {
            BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
            BlockEntity be = world.getBlockEntity(masterPos);
            if (be instanceof NamedScreenHandlerFactory factory) {
                player.openHandledScreen(factory);
            }
        }
        return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
    }

    @Override
    protected net.minecraft.util.shape.VoxelShape getOutlineShape(BlockState state, net.minecraft.world.BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        return state.get(UPPER) ? UPPER_SHAPE : net.minecraft.util.shape.VoxelShapes.fullCube();
    }

    @Override
    protected net.minecraft.util.shape.VoxelShape getCollisionShape(BlockState state, net.minecraft.world.BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        return state.get(UPPER) ? UPPER_SHAPE : net.minecraft.util.shape.VoxelShapes.fullCube();
    }

    protected BlockRenderType getRenderType(BlockState state) {
        return BlockRenderType.INVISIBLE;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockEntity createBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (state.get(PART) == 4 && !state.get(UPPER)) {
            return new AssemblerBlockEntity(pos, state);
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public <T extends BlockEntity> BlockEntityTicker<T> getTicker(World world, BlockState state, BlockEntityType<T> type) {
        if (world.isClient || state.get(PART) != 4 || state.get(UPPER)) {
            return null;
        }
        return validateTicker(type, ModBlocks.ASSEMBLER_BLOCK_ENTITY, AssemblerBlockEntity::tick);
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.production.assembler;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.crafting.FactorioRecipes;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.electricity.PowerNetworkManager;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModBlocks;
import net.minecraft.block.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerInventory;
import net.minecraft.inventory.Inventories;

import net.minecraft.nbt.NbtCompound;

public class AssemblerBlockEntity extends BlockEntity implements SidedInventory, NamedScreenHandlerFactory {

    public static final long POWER_CONSUMPTION_WATTS = 75_000L;
    private final DefaultedList<ItemStack> inventory = DefaultedList.ofSize(5, ItemStack.EMPTY);

    private String recipeId = "";
    private int progress = 0;
    private int maxProgress = 100;
    private boolean isWorking = false;
    private boolean isPowered = false;

    private static final int[] ALL_SLOTS = new int[]{0, 1, 2, 3, 4};

    protected final PropertyDelegate propertyDelegate = new PropertyDelegate() {
        @Override public int get(int index) {
            return switch (index) {
                case 0 -> progress;
                case 1 -> Math.max(1, maxProgress);
                case 2 -> isWorking ? 1 : 0;
                case 3 -> isPowered ? 1 : 0;
                case 4 -> pos.getX();
                case 5 -> pos.getY();
                case 6 -> pos.getZ();
                case 7 -> FactorioRecipes.getRecipeIndex(recipeId) + 1;
                default -> 0;
            };
        }
        @Override public void set(int index, int value) {
            switch (index) {
                case 0 -> progress = value;
                case 1 -> maxProgress = value;
                case 2 -> isWorking = value == 1;
                case 3 -> isPowered = value == 1;
            }
        }
        @Override public int size() { return 8; }
    };

    public AssemblerBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.ASSEMBLER_BLOCK_ENTITY, pos, state);
    }

    public String getRecipeId() { return this.recipeId; }

    public void setRecipeId(String newRecipeId) {
        setRecipeId(newRecipeId, null);
    }

    public void setRecipeId(String newRecipeId, @Nullable ServerPlayerEntity player) {
        String normalized = newRecipeId != null ? newRecipeId : "";
        if (!this.recipeId.equals(normalized)) {
            if (world != null && !world.isClient) {
                for (int i = 0; i < inventory.size(); i++) {
                    ItemStack st = inventory.get(i);
                    if (!st.isEmpty()) {
                        if (player != null) {
                            player.getInventory().offerOrDrop(st.copy());
                        } else {
                            ItemScatterer.spawn(world, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 1.0, pos.getZ() + 0.5, st.copy());
                        }
                        inventory.set(i, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        this.recipeId = normalized;
        this.progress = 0;
        this.isWorking = false;
        FactorioRecipes.Recipe r = FactorioRecipes.getById(this.recipeId);
        this.maxProgress = r != null ? Math.max(1, r.timeTicks()) : 100;
        sync();
    }

    public boolean isPowered() { return isPowered; }
    public boolean isWorking() { return isWorking; }

    public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, AssemblerBlockEntity be) {
        if (world == null || world.isClient) return;

        boolean hasPower = PowerNetworkManager.isMachinePowered(world, pos);
        if (be.isPowered != hasPower) {
            be.isPowered = hasPower;
            be.sync();
        }

        if (!hasPower || be.recipeId.isEmpty()) {
            if (be.isWorking) {
                be.isWorking = false;
                be.sync();
            }
            return;
        }

        FactorioRecipes.Recipe r = FactorioRecipes.getById(be.recipeId);
        if (r == null) {
            if (be.isWorking) {
                be.isWorking = false;
                be.sync();
            }
            return;
        }

        if (be.canCraft(r)) {
            if (!be.isWorking) {
                be.isWorking = true;
                be.sync();
            }
            be.progress++;
            if (be.progress >= be.maxProgress) {
                be.consumeIngredients(r);
                be.produceResult(r);
                be.progress = 0;
                be.sync();
            }
        } else {
            if (be.isWorking) {
                be.isWorking = false;
                be.sync();
            }
        }
    }

    private boolean canCraft(FactorioRecipes.Recipe recipe) {
        if (recipe == null) return false;
        for (int i = 0; i < recipe.ingredients().size() && i < 4; i++) {
            FactorioRecipes.Ingredient ing = recipe.ingredients().get(i);
            ItemStack slot = inventory.get(i);
            if (slot.isEmpty() || !slot.isOf(ing.item()) || slot.getCount() < ing.count()) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        ItemStack outSlot = inventory.get(4);
        if (outSlot.isEmpty()) return true;
        if (!ItemStack.areItemsAndComponentsEqual(outSlot, recipe.output())) return false;
        return outSlot.getCount() + recipe.output().getCount() <= outSlot.getMaxCount();
    }

    private void consumeIngredients(FactorioRecipes.Recipe recipe) {
        for (int i = 0; i < recipe.ingredients().size() && i < 4; i++) {
            FactorioRecipes.Ingredient ing = recipe.ingredients().get(i);
            ItemStack slot = inventory.get(i);
            if (!slot.isEmpty() && slot.isOf(ing.item())) {
                slot.decrement(ing.count());
            }
        }
    }

    private void produceResult(FactorioRecipes.Recipe recipe) {
        ItemStack outSlot = inventory.get(4);
        if (outSlot.isEmpty()) {
            inventory.set(4, recipe.output().copy());
        } else {
            outSlot.increment(recipe.output().getCount());
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isValid(int slot, ItemStack stack) {
        if (slot < 0 || slot >= 4) return false;
        if (this.recipeId.isEmpty()) return false;
        FactorioRecipes.Recipe r = FactorioRecipes.getById(this.recipeId);
        if (r == null || slot >= r.ingredients().size()) return false;
        return stack.isOf(r.ingredients().get(slot).item());
    }

    @Override public int[] getAvailableSlots(Direction side) { return ALL_SLOTS; }
    @Override public boolean canInsert(int slot, ItemStack stack, @Nullable Direction dir) { return isValid(slot, stack); }
    @Override public boolean canExtract(int slot, ItemStack stack, Direction dir) { return slot == 4; }

    public void sync() {
        markDirty();
        if (world != null && !world.isClient) {
            world.updateListeners(pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), net.minecraft.block.Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
        }
    }

    @Override public int size() { return inventory.size(); }
    @Override public boolean isEmpty() { return inventory.stream().allMatch(ItemStack::isEmpty); }
    @Override public ItemStack getStack(int slot) { return inventory.get(slot); }
    @Override public ItemStack removeStack(int slot, int amount) { ItemStack res = Inventories.splitStack(inventory, slot, amount); if (!res.isEmpty()) sync(); return res; }
    @Override public ItemStack removeStack(int slot) { ItemStack res = Inventories.removeStack(inventory, slot); if (!res.isEmpty()) sync(); return res; }
    @Override public void setStack(int slot, ItemStack stack) { inventory.set(slot, stack); sync(); }
    @Override public boolean canPlayerUse(PlayerEntity player) { return true; }
    @Override public void clear() { inventory.clear(); sync(); }

    @Override
    protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
        Inventories.writeNbt(nbt, inventory, registries);
        nbt.putString("RecipeId", recipeId);
        nbt.putInt("Progress", progress);
        nbt.putInt("MaxProgress", maxProgress);
        nbt.putBoolean("Powered", isPowered);
    }

    public ItemStack quickMove(PlayerEntity player, int index) {
        ItemStack newStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        Slot slot = this.slots.get(index);
        if (slot != null && slot.hasStack()) {
            ItemStack originalStack = slot.getStack();
            newStack = originalStack.copy();
            if (index < 5) {
                if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, 5, 41, true)) return ItemStack.EMPTY;
            } else {
                if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, 0, 4, false)) return ItemStack.EMPTY;
            }
            if (originalStack.isEmpty()) slot.setStack(ItemStack.EMPTY);
            else slot.markDirty();
        }
        return newStack;
    }

            this.ingIndex = index;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isEnabled() {
            if (!AssemblerScreenHandler.this.slotsVisible) return false;
            FactorioRecipes.Recipe r = FactorioRecipes.getById(getRecipeId());
            return r != null && this.ingIndex < r.ingredients().size();
        }

        @Override
        public boolean canInsert(ItemStack stack) {
            FactorioRecipes.Recipe r = FactorioRecipes.getById(getRecipeId());
            if (r == null || this.ingIndex >= r.ingredients().size()) return false;
            return stack.isOf(r.ingredients().get(this.ingIndex).item());
        }
    }

    public static BlockPos getPartPos(BlockPos masterPos, Direction facing, int part, boolean upper) {
        Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
        BlockPos base = switch (part) {
            case 1 -> masterPos.offset(right);
            case 2 -> masterPos.offset(facing);
            case 3 -> masterPos.offset(facing).offset(right);
            default -> masterPos;
        };
        return upper ? base.up() : base;
    }

    /**
     * ÐÐ°Ñ…Ð¾Ð´Ð¸Ñ‚ Ð³Ð»Ð°Ð²Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð±Ð»Ð¾Ðº (part=0, upper=false) Ð¸Ð· Ð»ÑŽÐ±Ð¾Ð¹ Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ‡ÐºÐ¸ ÑÑ‚Ñ€ÑƒÐºÑ‚ÑƒÑ€Ñ‹ 2x2x2.5 Ð·Ð° O(1).
     */
    public static BlockPos getMasterPos(BlockPos currentPos, BlockState state) {
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof BurnerDrillBlock)) {
            return currentPos;
        }
        Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
        Direction left = facing.rotateYCounterclockwise();
        Direction back = facing.getOpposite();
        int part = state.get(PART);
        boolean upper = state.get(UPPER);

        BlockPos base = upper ? currentPos.down() : currentPos;
        return switch (part) {
            case 1 -> base.offset(left);
            case 2 -> base.offset(back);
            case 3 -> base.offset(back).offset(left);
            default -> base;
        };
    }

        public static boolean hasOreInFootprint(World world, BlockPos originPos, Direction facing) {
        for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
            BlockPos tile = getPartPos(originPos, facing, part, false);
            for (int dy = -2; dy <= 0; dy++) {
                if (world.getBlockState(tile.add(0, dy, 0)).getBlock() instanceof com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.world.ore.ResourceOreBlock) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockState getPlacementState(ItemPlacementContext ctx) {
        Direction facing = ctx.getHorizontalPlayerFacing().getOpposite();
        if (ctx.getPlayer() != null && ctx.getPlayer().isSneaking()) {
            facing = facing.getOpposite();
        }
        BlockPos masterPos = ctx.getBlockPos();
        World world = ctx.getWorld();

        for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
            for (int yOff = 0; yOff <= 2; yOff++) {
                BlockPos checkPos = getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, false).up(yOff);
                if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(checkPos) || !world.getBlockState(checkPos).canReplace(ctx)) {
                    return null;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!hasOreInFootprint(world, masterPos, facing)) return null;
        return this.getDefaultState().with(FACING, facing).with(PART, 0).with(UPPER, false);
    }

                    world.setBlockState(partPos, state.with(PART, part).with(UPPER, isUpper), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
                }
            }
        }
    }
