    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        this.renderBackground(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);
        int x = (this.width - PANEL_W) / 2;
        int y = (this.height - PANEL_H) / 2;

        context.fill(x, y, x + PANEL_W, y + PANEL_H, 0xFF111214);
        context.fill(x + 1, y + 1, x + PANEL_W - 1, y + PANEL_H - 1, 0xFF2E3033);
        context.fill(x + 3, y + 3, x + PANEL_W - 3, y + 17, 0xFF222325);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, this.title, x + 8, y + 6, 0xFFFFCC66, true);

        int closeX = x + PANEL_W - 17;
        boolean hovClose = mouseX >= closeX && mouseX <= closeX + 13 && mouseY >= y + 4 && mouseY <= y + 16;
        context.fill(closeX, y + 4, closeX + 13, y + 16, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(closeX + 1, y + 5, closeX + 12, y + 15, hovClose ? 0xFFB83227 : 0xFF3A3C3F);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, "x", closeX + 4, y + 6, 0xFFFFFFFF, false);

        int tabY = y + 21;
        int tabW = (PANEL_W - 16) / 6;
        String[] tabNames = {
                Text.translatable("config.factoriocore.tab.hud").getString(),
                Text.translatable("config.factoriocore.tab.info").getString(),
                Text.translatable("config.factoriocore.tab.graphics").getString(),
                Text.translatable("config.factoriocore.tab.colors").getString(),
                Text.translatable("config.factoriocore.tab.keys").getString(),
                "Ð—Ð²ÑƒÐºÐ¸"
        };
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            drawTabButton(context, x + 8 + i * tabW, tabY, tabW - (i == 5 ? 0 : 2), 16, tabNames[i], mouseX, mouseY, currentTab == i);
        }

        int cx = x + 8, cy = y + 39, cw = PANEL_W - 16, ch = PANEL_H - 68;
        context.fill(cx, cy, cx + cw, cy + ch, 0xFF18191B);
        context.fill(cx + 1, cy + 1, cx + cw - 1, cy + ch - 1, 0xFF242528);

        if (currentTab < 3) {
            for (FloatSliderEntry s : sliders) if (s.tab == currentTab) drawFloatSlider(context, cx + s.rx, cy + s.ry, cw - 20, s.getter.get(), s.min, s.max, s.label);
            for (ToggleEntry t : toggles) if (t.tab == currentTab) drawToggle(context, cx + t.rx, cy + t.ry, (cw / 2) - 14, t.label, t.getter.get(), mouseX, mouseY);
        } else if (currentTab == 3) {
            renderColorsTab(context, cx, cy, cw, mouseX, mouseY);
        } else if (currentTab == 4) {
            renderKeybindsTab(context, cx, cy, cw, mouseX, mouseY);
        } else {
            renderAudioPackTab(context, cx, cy, cw, mouseX, mouseY);
        }

        int bottomY = y + PANEL_H - 24;
        drawFactorioButton(context, x + 8, bottomY, 156, 18, Text.translatable("config.factoriocore.reset").getString(), mouseX, mouseY, false);
        drawFactorioButton(context, x + PANEL_W - 134, bottomY, 126, 18, Text.translatable("config.factoriocore.save").getString(), mouseX, mouseY, true);
    }

    private void renderAudioPackTab(DrawContext context, int cx, int cy, int cw, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        for (FloatSliderEntry s : sliders) if (s.tab == 5) drawFloatSlider(context, cx + s.rx, cy + s.ry, cw - 20, s.getter.get(), s.min, s.max, s.label);
        for (ToggleEntry t : toggles) if (t.tab == 5) drawToggle(context, cx + t.rx, cy + t.ry, cw - 20, t.label, t.getter.get(), mouseX, mouseY);

        int boxY = cy + 74;
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, "Ð˜Ð¼Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‚ Ð¾Ñ€Ð¸Ð³Ð¸Ð½Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ñ… Ð·Ð²ÑƒÐºÐ¾Ð² (.ogg) Ð¸Ð· ÑƒÑÑ‚Ð°Ð½Ð¾Ð²Ð»ÐµÐ½Ð½Ð¾Ð¹ Factorio:", cx + 10, boxY, 0xFFFFCC66, false);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, "Ð£ÐºÐ°Ð¶Ð¸Ñ‚Ðµ Ð¿ÑƒÑ‚ÑŒ Ðº Ð¿Ð°Ð¿ÐºÐµ Factorio/data (Ð¿Ð¾Ð´Ð´ÐµÑ€Ð¶Ð¸Ð²Ð°ÐµÑ‚ÑÑ Ctrl+V):", cx + 10, boxY + 12, 0xFFAAAAAA, false);

        int fieldX = cx + 10;
        int fieldY = boxY + 24;
        int fieldW = cw - 20;
        int fieldH = 18;
        context.fill(fieldX, fieldY, fieldX + fieldW, fieldY + fieldH, this.editingPathField ? 0xFFE59524 : 0xFF111111);
        context.fill(fieldX + 1, fieldY + 1, fieldX + fieldW - 1, fieldY + fieldH - 1, 0xFF141517);

        String pathText = FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.factorioDataPath != null ? FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.factorioDataPath : "";
        String cursor = (this.editingPathField && (System.currentTimeMillis() / 500L) % 2L == 0L) ? "_" : "";
        String trimmed = this.textRenderer.trimToWidth(pathText, fieldW - 14) + cursor;
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, trimmed, fieldX + 5, fieldY + 5, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);

        int btnY = fieldY + 24;
        drawFactorioButton(context, cx + 10, btnY, 165, 20, "ÐÐ²Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¿Ð¾Ð¸ÑÐº Steam Factorio", mouseX, mouseY, false);
        drawFactorioButton(context, cx + 185, btnY, cw - 195, 20, "Ð¡Ð¾Ð±Ñ€Ð°Ñ‚ÑŒ Ð¸ Ð²ÐºÐ»ÑŽÑ‡Ð¸Ñ‚ÑŒ Ñ€ÐµÑÑƒÑ€ÑÐ¿Ð°Ðº (.ogg)", mouseX, mouseY, true);

        if (!this.soundPackStatusMessage.isEmpty()) {
            context.drawText(this.textRenderer, Text.literal(this.soundPackStatusMessage), cx + 10, btnY + 26, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);
        } else {
            context.drawText(this.textRenderer, "Ð ÐµÑÑƒÑ€ÑÐ¿Ð°Ðº ÑÐ¾Ð·Ð´Ð°Ñ‘Ñ‚ÑÑ Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾ Ð² Ð¿Ð°Ð¿ÐºÐµ resourcepacks/FactorioCore_Sounds", cx + 10, btnY + 26, 0xFF888A8E, false);
        }
    }

    private void drawFloatSlider(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy, int sw, float val, float min, float max, String label) {
        String display = String.format("%s: %.2fx", label, val);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, display, sx, sy, 0xFFBBBBBB, false);
        int trackY = sy + 11;
        context.fill(sx, trackY, sx + sw, trackY + 5, 0xFF141414);
        float ratio = MathHelper.clamp((val - min) / (max - min), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        int fillW = Math.round(ratio * (sw - 2));
        if (fillW > 0) context.fill(sx + 1, trackY + 1, sx + 1 + fillW, trackY + 4, 0xFFE59524);
        int knobX = sx + Math.round(ratio * (sw - 4));
        context.fill(knobX, trackY - 1, knobX + 4, trackY + 6, 0xFFEAEAEA);
    }

    private void drawToggle(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw, String label, boolean checked, int mx, int my) {
        boolean hovered = mx >= bx && mx <= bx + bw && my >= by && my <= by + 30;
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + bw, by + 30, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + bw - 1, by + 29, hovered ? 0xFF36383C : 0xFF2D2E32);

        context.fill(bx + 6, by + 9, bx + 17, by + 20, 0xFF141414);
        if (checked) {
            context.fill(bx + 7, by + 10, bx + 16, by + 19, 0xFFE59524);
            context.fill(bx + 9, by + 14, bx + 11, by + 17, 0xFF141414);
            context.fill(bx + 11, by + 12, bx + 14, by + 15, 0xFF141414);
        } else {
            context.fill(bx + 7, by + 10, bx + 16, by + 19, 0xFF3E4044);
        }
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, label, bx + 22, by + 10, checked ? 0xFFFFE082 : 0xFFCCCCCC, false);
    }

    private void renderColorsTab(DrawContext context, int cx, int cy, int cw, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        for (int i = 0; i < colors.size(); i++) {
            ColorEntry entry = colors.get(i);
            int ry = cy + entry.ry;
            int rgb = entry.getter.get();

            context.fill(cx + 6, ry, cx + cw - 6, ry + 26, 0xFF141414);
            context.fill(cx + 7, ry + 1, cx + cw - 7, ry + 25, 0xFF2D2E32);

            context.fill(cx + 11, ry + 4, cx + 29, ry + 22, 0xFF111111);
            context.fill(cx + 12, ry + 5, cx + 28, ry + 21, 0xFF000000 | rgb);
            context.drawText(this.textRenderer, entry.label, cx + 34, ry + 9, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);

            int slidersStartX = cx + 204;
            drawRgbSlider(context, slidersStartX, ry + 4, 42, (rgb >> 16) & 0xFF, 0xFFE53935, "R");
            drawRgbSlider(context, slidersStartX + 46, ry + 4, 42, (rgb >> 8) & 0xFF, 0xFF43A047, "G");
            drawRgbSlider(context, slidersStartX + 92, ry + 4, 42, rgb & 0xFF, 0xFF1E88E5, "B");

            int presetStartX = cx + 346;
            for (int p = 0; p < COLOR_PRESETS.length; p++) {
                int px = presetStartX + p * 11;
                int pCol = COLOR_PRESETS[p];
                context.fill(px, ry + 8, px + 9, ry + 18, (rgb == pCol) ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFF141414);
                context.fill(px + 1, ry + 9, px + 8, ry + 17, 0xFF000000 | pCol);
            }
        }
    }

    private void drawRgbSlider(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy, int sw, int val255, int barColor, String label) {
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, label + ":" + val255, sx, sy, 0xFFBBBBBB, false);
        context.fill(sx, sy + 11, sx + sw, sy + 16, 0xFF141414);
        int fillW = Math.round((val255 / 255.0f) * (sw - 2));
        if (fillW > 0) context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 12, sx + 1 + fillW, sy + 15, barColor);
        int knobX = sx + Math.round((val255 / 255.0f) * (sw - 4));
        context.fill(knobX, sy + 10, knobX + 4, sy + 17, 0xFFEAEAEA);
    }

    private void renderKeybindsTab(DrawContext context, int cx, int cy, int cw, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        for (KeybindEntry entry : keybinds) {
            int ry = cy + entry.ry;
            context.fill(cx + 6, ry, cx + cw - 6, ry + 24, 0xFF141414);
            context.fill(cx + 7, ry + 1, cx + cw - 7, ry + 23, 0xFF2D2E32);
            context.drawText(this.textRenderer, entry.label, cx + 14, ry + 8, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);

            boolean isListening = (this.listeningKeybind == entry.binding);
            String keyLabel = isListening ? Text.translatable("config.factoriocore.keybind.listen").getString() : entry.binding.getBoundKeyLocalizedText().getString();
            drawFactorioButton(context, cx + cw - 152, ry + 3, 92, 18, keyLabel, mouseX, mouseY, isListening);
            drawFactorioButton(context, cx + cw - 56, ry + 3, 50, 18, Text.translatable("config.factoriocore.keybind.reset").getString(), mouseX, mouseY, !entry.binding.isDefault());
        }
    }

    private void drawTabButton(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw, int bh, String label, int mouseX, int mouseY, boolean active) {
        boolean hovered = mouseX >= bx && mouseX <= bx + bw && mouseY >= by && mouseY <= by + bh;
        int bg = active ? 0xFFE59524 : (hovered ? 0xFF4A4C50 : 0xFF35373B);
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + bw, by + bh, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + bw - 1, by + bh - (active ? 0 : 1), bg);
        int tw = this.textRenderer.getWidth(label);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, label, bx + (bw - tw) / 2, by + 4, active ? 0xFF141414 : 0xFFE6E6E6, false);
    }

    private void drawFactorioButton(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw, int bh, String label, int mouseX, int mouseY, boolean highlighted) {
        boolean hovered = mouseX >= bx && mouseX <= bx + bw && mouseY >= by && mouseY <= by + bh;
        int bg = highlighted ? 0xFFD4881E : (hovered ? 0xFF4A4C50 : 0xFF383A3D);
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + bw, by + bh, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + bw - 1, by + bh - 1, bg);
        int tw = this.textRenderer.getWidth(label);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, label, bx + (bw - tw) / 2, by + (bh - 8) / 2, highlighted ? 0xFF141414 : 0xFFEAEAEA, false);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (this.listeningKeybind != null && button > 1) {
            this.listeningKeybind.setBoundKey(InputUtil.Type.MOUSE.createFromCode(button));
            KeyBinding.updateKeysByCode();
            if (this.client != null) this.client.options.write();
            this.listeningKeybind = null;
            return true;
        }
        this.listeningKeybind = null;
        this.editingPathField = false;

        int x = (this.width - PANEL_W) / 2;
        int y = (this.height - PANEL_H) / 2;

        if (mouseX >= x + PANEL_W - 17 && mouseX <= x + PANEL_W - 4 && mouseY >= y + 4 && mouseY <= y + 16
                || mouseX >= x + PANEL_W - 134 && mouseX <= x + PANEL_W - 8 && mouseY >= y + PANEL_H - 24 && mouseY <= y + PANEL_H - 6) {
            FactorioConfig.save();
            this.close();
            return true;
        }

        if (mouseX >= x + 8 && mouseX <= x + 164 && mouseY >= y + PANEL_H - 24 && mouseY <= y + PANEL_H - 6) {
            FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.resetDefaults();
            for (KeybindEntry ke : keybinds) ke.binding.setBoundKey(ke.binding.getDefaultKey());
            KeyBinding.updateKeysByCode();
            if (this.client != null) this.client.options.write();
            playClick();
            return true;
        }

        int tabY = y + 21;
        int tabW = (PANEL_W - 16) / 6;
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            if (mouseX >= x + 8 + i * tabW && mouseX <= x + 8 + i * tabW + tabW && mouseY >= tabY && mouseY <= tabY + 16) {
                this.currentTab = i;
                playClick();
                return true;
            }
        }

        int cx = x + 8, cy = y + 39, cw = PANEL_W - 16;
        if (currentTab < 3 || currentTab == 5) {
            for (FloatSliderEntry s : sliders) {
                if (s.tab == currentTab && mouseX >= cx + s.rx && mouseX <= cx + s.rx + cw - 20 && mouseY >= cy + s.ry + 10 && mouseY <= cy + s.ry + 17) {
                    this.activeFloatSlider = s;
                    updateFloatSlider(s, mouseX, cx + s.rx, cw - 20);
                    return true;
                }
            }
            for (ToggleEntry t : toggles) {
                int toggleW = (currentTab == 5) ? (cw - 20) : ((cw / 2) - 14);
                if (t.tab == currentTab && mouseX >= cx + t.rx && mouseX <= cx + t.rx + toggleW && mouseY >= cy + t.ry && mouseY <= cy + t.ry + 30) {
                    t.setter.accept(!t.getter.get());
                    FactorioConfig.save();
                    playClick();
                    return true;
                }
            }

            if (currentTab == 5) {
                int fieldX = cx + 10;
                int fieldY = cy + 98;
                int fieldW = cw - 20;
                if (mouseX >= fieldX && mouseX <= fieldX + fieldW && mouseY >= fieldY && mouseY <= fieldY + 18) {
                    this.editingPathField = true;
                    if (button == 1) {
                        FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.factorioDataPath = "";
                    }
                    return true;
                }

                int btnY = fieldY + 24;
                if (mouseX >= cx + 10 && mouseX <= cx + 175 && mouseY >= btnY && mouseY <= btnY + 20) {
                    String found = FactorioSoundPackGenerator.autoDetectFactorioDataPath();
                    if (!found.isEmpty()) {
                        FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.factorioDataPath = found;
                        FactorioConfig.save();
                        this.soundPackStatusMessage = "Â§aÐÐ°Ð¹Ð´ÐµÐ½Ð° Ð¿Ð°Ð¿ÐºÐ°: " + found;
                    } else {
                        this.soundPackStatusMessage = "Â§eÐŸÐ°Ð¿ÐºÐ° Steam Ð½Ðµ Ð½Ð°Ð¹Ð´ÐµÐ½Ð° Ð°Ð²Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¼Ð°Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ‡ÐµÑÐºÐ¸. Ð’ÑÑ‚Ð°Ð²ÑŒÑ‚Ðµ Ð¿ÑƒÑ‚ÑŒ Ð²Ñ€ÑƒÑ‡Ð½ÑƒÑŽ (Ctrl+V).";
                    }
                    playClick();
                    return true;
                }
                if (mouseX >= cx + 185 && mouseX <= cx + cw - 10 && mouseY >= btnY && mouseY <= btnY + 20) {
                    FactorioConfig.save();
                    this.soundPackStatusMessage = FactorioSoundPackGenerator.buildAndActivateResourcePack(FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.factorioDataPath);
                    playClick();
                    return true;
                }
            }
        } else if (currentTab == 3) {
            for (int i = 0; i < colors.size(); i++) {
                ColorEntry entry = colors.get(i);
                int ry = cy + entry.ry;
                for (int ch = 0; ch < 3; ch++) {
                    int sx = cx + 204 + ch * 46;
                    if (mouseX >= sx - 2 && mouseX <= sx + 44 && mouseY >= ry + 14 && mouseY <= ry + 21) {
                        this.activeColorIndex = i;
                        this.draggingRgbChannel = ch;
                        updateColorChannelFromMouse(entry, ch, mouseX, sx, 42);
                        return true;
                    }
                }
                for (int p = 0; p < COLOR_PRESETS.length; p++) {
                    int px = cx + 346 + p * 11;
                    if (mouseX >= px && mouseX <= px + 10 && mouseY >= ry + 8 && mouseY <= ry + 18) {
                        entry.setter.accept(COLOR_PRESETS[p]);
                        FactorioConfig.save();
                        playClick();
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (currentTab == 4) {
            for (KeybindEntry entry : keybinds) {
                int ry = cy + entry.ry;
                if (mouseX >= cx + cw - 152 && mouseX <= cx + cw - 60 && mouseY >= ry + 3 && mouseY <= ry + 21) {
                    this.listeningKeybind = entry.binding;
                    playClick();
                    return true;
                }
                if (mouseX >= cx + cw - 56 && mouseX <= cx + cw - 6 && mouseY >= ry + 3 && mouseY <= ry + 21) {
                    entry.binding.setBoundKey(entry.binding.getDefaultKey());
                    KeyBinding.updateKeysByCode();
                    if (this.client != null) this.client.options.write();
                    playClick();
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    private void updateColorChannelFromMouse(ColorEntry entry, int channel, double mouseX, int sliderX, int sliderW) {
        int val = MathHelper.clamp(Math.round(((float) (mouseX - sliderX) / sliderW) * 255.0f), 0, 255);
        int rgb = entry.getter.get();
        int r = (channel == 0) ? val : ((rgb >> 16) & 0xFF);
        int g = (channel == 1) ? val : ((rgb >> 8) & 0xFF);
        int b = (channel == 2) ? val : (rgb & 0xFF);
        entry.setter.accept((r << 16) | (g << 8) | b);
        FactorioConfig.save();
    }

    private void updateFloatSlider(FloatSliderEntry s, double mouseX, int sx, int sw) {
        float ratio = MathHelper.clamp((float) (mouseX - sx) / sw, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        float val = s.min + ratio * (s.max - s.min);
        val = Math.round(val * 20.0f) / 20.0f;
        s.setter.accept(val);
        FactorioConfig.save();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        int x = (this.width - PANEL_W) / 2;
        int cx = x + 8, cw = PANEL_W - 16;
        if (this.activeFloatSlider != null) {
            updateFloatSlider(this.activeFloatSlider, mouseX, cx + this.activeFloatSlider.rx, cw - 20);
            return true;
        }
        if (this.activeColorIndex >= 0 && this.draggingRgbChannel >= 0) {
            updateColorChannelFromMouse(colors.get(this.activeColorIndex), this.draggingRgbChannel, mouseX, cx + 204 + this.draggingRgbChannel * 46, 42);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        this.activeColorIndex = -1;
        this.draggingRgbChannel = -1;
        this.activeFloatSlider = null;
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean charTyped(char chr, int modifiers) {
        if (this.editingPathField && chr >= 32) {
            FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.factorioDataPath += chr;
            return true;
        }
        return super.charTyped(chr, modifiers);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(int keyCode, int scanCode, int modifiers) {
        if (this.editingPathField) {
            if (Screen.isPaste(keyCode) && this.client != null) {
                String clip = this.client.keyboard.getClipboard();
                if (clip != null) {
                    FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.factorioDataPath = clip.trim().replace("\"", "");
                }
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_BACKSPACE && !FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.factorioDataPath.isEmpty()) {
                String cur = FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.factorioDataPath;
                FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.factorioDataPath = cur.substring(0, cur.length() - 1);
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ENTER || keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) {
                this.editingPathField = false;
                FactorioConfig.save();
                return true;
            }
            return true;
        }

        if (this.listeningKeybind != null) {
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) this.listeningKeybind.setBoundKey(InputUtil.UNKNOWN_KEY);
            else this.listeningKeybind.setBoundKey(InputUtil.fromKeyCode(keyCode, scanCode));
            KeyBinding.updateKeysByCode();
            if (this.client != null) this.client.options.write();
            this.listeningKeybind = null;
            playClick();
            return true;
        }
        return super.keyPressed(keyCode, scanCode, modifiers);
    }

    private void playClick() {
        if (this.client != null && this.client.player != null) {
            this.client.player.playSound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), 0.3f, 1.2f);
        }
    }
}

    private static void drawBox(BlockRenderManager brm, BlockState state, MatrixStack matrices,
                                VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers, int light, int overlay,
                                float x, float y, float z, float sx, float sy, float sz) {
        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(x, y, z);
        matrices.scale(sx, sy, sz);
        brm.renderBlockAsEntity(state, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay);
        matrices.pop();
    }

    @Override
    public void render(TurretBlockEntity entity, float tickDelta, MatrixStack matrices,
                       VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers, int light, int overlay) {
        BlockState state = entity.getCachedState();
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof TurretBlock tb)) return;
        if (state.get(TurretBlock.PART) != 0 || state.get(TurretBlock.UPPER)) return;

        int kind = tb.getTurretKind();
        renderTurretModel(kind, entity.getTurretYaw(), entity.getTurretPitch(), entity.isFiring(),
                matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay);

        // ÐžÑ‚Ñ€Ð¸ÑÐ¾Ð²ÐºÐ° 3D-Ð»ÑƒÑ‡Ð° Ð›Ð°Ð·ÐµÑ€Ð½Ð¾Ð¹ Ñ‚ÑƒÑ€ÐµÐ»Ð¸ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¸ Ð²Ñ‹ÑÑ‚Ñ€ÐµÐ»Ðµ
        if (kind == 1 && entity.isFiring()) {
            Vec3d target = entity.getTargetVec();
            if (target.lengthSquared() > 1.0) {
                drawLaserBeam(entity, target, matrices, vertexConsumers);
            }
        }
    }

    private static void drawLaserBeam(TurretBlockEntity entity, Vec3d targetWorld,
                                      MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers) {
        float sx = 1.0f;
        float sy = 1.68f;
        float sz = 1.0f;
        float ex = (float) (targetWorld.x - entity.getPos().getX());
        float ey = (float) (targetWorld.y - entity.getPos().getY());
        float ez = (float) (targetWorld.z - entity.getPos().getZ());

        VertexConsumer lines = vertexConsumers.getBuffer(RenderLayer.getLines());
        MatrixStack.Entry entry = matrices.peek();

        float dx = ex - sx;
        float dy = ey - sy;
        float dz = ez - sz;
        float len = (float) Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
        if (len > 1.0e-4f) {
            dx /= len; dy /= len; dz /= len;
        }

        // Ð¢Ñ€Ð¾Ð¹Ð½Ð¾Ð¹ ÑÑ€ÐºÐ¾-ÐºÑ€Ð°ÑÐ½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð»Ð°Ð·ÐµÑ€Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð»ÑƒÑ‡
        for (int i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
            float off = i * 0.03f;
            lines.vertex(entry, sx + off, sy, sz).color(1.0f, 0.15f, 0.15f, 1.0f).normal(entry, dx, dy, dz);
            lines.vertex(entry, ex + off, ey, ez).color(1.0f, 0.35f, 0.25f, 1.0f).normal(entry, dx, dy, dz);
        }
    }

    public static void renderTurretModel(int kind, float yaw, float pitch, boolean firing,
                                         MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers,
                                         int light, int overlay) {
        BlockRenderManager brm = MinecraftClient.getInstance().getBlockRenderManager();
        BlockState base = Blocks.DEEPSLATE_TILES.getDefaultState();

        BlockState orangeTank = Blocks.ORANGE_TERRACOTTA.getDefaultState();

        drawBox(brm, base, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, 0.08f, 0.0f, 0.08f, 1.84f, 0.38f, 1.84f);
        drawBox(brm, dark, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, 0.32f, 0.38f, 0.32f, 1.36f, 0.52f, 1.36f);

        // 2. ÐŸÐ¾Ð²Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ñ‚Ð½Ð°Ñ Ð³Ð¾Ð»Ð¾Ð²Ð° Ñ‚ÑƒÑ€ÐµÐ»Ð¸ Ð² Ñ†ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ñ€Ðµ 2x2 (X = 1.0, Y = 1.15, Z = 1.0)
        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(1.0, 1.15, 1.0);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(-yaw));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(pitch));

        if (kind == 0) {

    private void renderTurret3DPreview(DrawContext context, int centerX, int centerY, int kind) {
        MatrixStack matrices = context.getMatrices();
        float yaw = (handler.turretEntity != null) ? handler.turretEntity.getTurretYaw() : 0.0f;
        float pitch = (handler.turretEntity != null) ? handler.turretEntity.getTurretPitch() : 0.0f;

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(centerX, centerY, 150.0f);
        matrices.scale(this.previewZoom, -this.previewZoom, this.previewZoom);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(this.previewPitch));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(this.previewYaw));
        matrices.translate(-1.0f, -0.9f, -1.0f);

        TurretRenderer.renderTurretModel(
                kind, yaw, pitch, false, matrices,
                context.getVertexConsumers(),
                LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE,
                OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV
        );

        matrices.pop();
        context.draw();
    }

    private void drawCheckerboard(DrawContext context, int left, int top, int right, int bottom, int cellSize) {
        for (int py = top; py < bottom; py += cellSize) {
            for (int px = left; px < right; px += cellSize) {
                int gx = (px - left) / cellSize;
                int gy = (py - top) / cellSize;
                context.fill(px, py, Math.min(px + cellSize, right), Math.min(py + cellSize, bottom),
                        ((gx + gy) % 2 == 0) ? 0xFF262729 : 0xFF2E3032);
            }
        }
    }

    private void drawSlotFrame(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy) {
        context.fill(sx, sy, sx + 18, sy + 18, 0xFF18181A);
        context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 1, sx + 17, sy + 17, 0xFF3A3C3E);
    }

    private boolean isInsideViewport(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        return mouseX >= x + 10 && mouseX <= x + backgroundWidth - 10 && mouseY >= y + 18 && mouseY <= y + 78;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        if (isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.previewZoom = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewZoom + (float) verticalAmount * 1.8f, 8.0f, 32.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mouseX, mouseY, horizontalAmount, verticalAmount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if ((button == 0 || button == 1) && isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.draggingPreview = true;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        this.draggingPreview = false;
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.draggingPreview) {
            this.previewYaw += (float) deltaX * 1.5f;
            this.previewPitch = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewPitch + (float) deltaY * 1.5f, -80.0f, 80.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        super.render(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);
        drawMouseoverTooltip(context, mouseX, mouseY);
    }
}

    private static boolean expandedInInventory = false;

    public static void updateFromPacket(SyncCraftQueuePayload payload) {
        recipeIds = payload.recipeIds();
        counts = payload.counts();
        currentProgress = payload.currentProgressTicks();
        currentMax = Math.max(1, payload.currentMaxTicks());
        if (recipeIds.size() <= 1) {
            expandedInInventory = false;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Ð¡Ñ‡Ð¸Ñ‚Ð°ÐµÑ‚, ÑÐºÐ¾Ð»ÑŒÐºÐ¾ ÑÐ»Ð¾Ñ‚Ð¾Ð² Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸ Ð¿Ð¾Ð¼ÐµÑ‰Ð°ÐµÑ‚ÑÑ ÑÐ»ÐµÐ²Ð° Ð¾Ñ‚ Ñ…Ð¾Ñ‚Ð±Ð°Ñ€Ð° ÐœÐ°Ð¹Ð½ÐºÑ€Ð°Ñ„Ñ‚Ð°,

    private static int getMaxColsLeftOfHotbar(int screenW) {
        int hotbarLeft = (screenW / 2) - 95;
        int availPx = Math.max(48, hotbarLeft - 8);
        return MathHelper.clamp(availPx / 24, 2, 7);
    }

    public static void renderBottomLeftQueue(DrawContext context, boolean isInventoryScreen) {
        if (recipeIds.isEmpty()) return;
        MinecraftClient client = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        if (client.player == null) return;

        FactorioRecipes.init();
        TextRenderer tr = client.textRenderer;
        int screenW = context.getScaledWindowWidth();
        int screenH = context.getScaledWindowHeight();

        int boxSize = 22;
        int step = boxSize + 2; // 24px
        int startX = 6;
        int baseY = screenH - boxSize - 6;

        int maxCols = getMaxColsLeftOfHotbar(screenW);
        int totalItems = recipeIds.size();

        // Ð’ Ð¸Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð°Ñ€Ðµ Ð¾ÑÑ‚Ð°Ð²Ð»ÑÐµÐ¼ Ð¼ÐµÑÑ‚Ð¾ Ð¿Ð¾Ð´ ÐºÐ½Ð¾Ð¿ÐºÑƒ-ÑÑ‚Ñ€ÐµÐ»Ð¾Ñ‡ÐºÑƒ [>>], ÐµÑÐ»Ð¸ ÑÐ»ÐµÐ¼ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð¾Ð² Ð±Ð¾Ð»ÑŒÑˆÐµ, Ñ‡ÐµÐ¼ Ð¿Ð¾Ð¼ÐµÑ‰Ð°ÐµÑ‚ÑÑ Ð² 1 Ñ€ÑÐ´
        boolean canExpand = totalItems > (maxCols - 1);
        boolean showExpanded = isInventoryScreen && expandedInInventory && canExpand;

        if (!showExpanded) {
            // Ð¡Ð²Ñ‘Ñ€Ð½ÑƒÑ‚Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¾Ð´Ð½Ð¾ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ñ€ÐµÐ¶Ð¸Ð¼ (ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ ÑÐ»ÐµÐ²Ð° Ð¾Ñ‚ Ñ…Ð¾Ñ‚Ð±Ð°Ñ€Ð°!)
            int visibleSlots = canExpand ? (maxCols - 1) : Math.min(totalItems, maxCols);

            for (int i = 0; i < visibleSlots && i < totalItems; i++) {
                int bx = startX + i * step;
                drawQueueCell(context, tr, i, bx, baseY, boxSize);
            }

            if (canExpand) {
                int btnX = startX + visibleSlots * step;
                if (isInventoryScreen) {
                    // Ð’ Ð¸Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð°Ñ€Ðµ Ñ€Ð¸ÑÑƒÐµÐ¼ Ð¸Ð½Ñ‚ÐµÑ€Ð°ÐºÑ‚Ð¸Ð²Ð½ÑƒÑŽ ÐºÐ½Ð¾Ð¿ÐºÑƒ ÑÐ¾ ÑÑ‚Ñ€ÐµÐ»Ð¾Ñ‡ÐºÐ¾Ð¹ [>>] ÐºÐ°Ðº Ð² Factorio
                    drawExpandArrowButton(context, tr, btnX, baseY, boxSize, ">>", totalItems - visibleSlots);
                } else {
                    // Ð’ Ð¾Ð±Ñ‹Ñ‡Ð½Ð¾Ð¼ HUD Ñ€Ð¸ÑÑƒÐµÐ¼ ÐºÐ¾Ð¼Ð¿Ð°ÐºÑ‚Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¸Ð½Ð´Ð¸ÐºÐ°Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ€ "+N" Ð¾ÑÑ‚Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ñ… ÑÐ»ÐµÐ¼ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð¾Ð² Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸
                    int hiddenCount = totalItems - visibleSlots;
                    drawHiddenCountBadge(context, tr, btnX, baseY, boxSize, "+" + hiddenCount);
                }
            }
        } else {
            // Ð Ð°ÑÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ñ‚Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¼Ð½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ñ€ÐµÐ¶Ð¸Ð¼ Ð² Ð¸Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð°Ñ€Ðµ: Ñ€ÑÐ´Ñ‹ Ð¿Ð¾Ð´Ð½Ð¸Ð¼Ð°ÑŽÑ‚ÑÑ ÑÐ½Ð¸Ð·Ñƒ Ð²Ð²ÐµÑ€Ñ…!
            for (int i = 0; i < totalItems; i++) {

                int bx = startX + col * step;
                int by = baseY - rowFromBottom * step;
                drawQueueCell(context, tr, i, bx, by, boxSize);

        }
    }

    private static void drawQueueCell(DrawContext context, TextRenderer tr, int index, int bx, int by, int boxSize) {
        FactorioRecipes.Recipe r = FactorioRecipes.getById(recipeIds.get(index));
        if (r == null) return;

        context.fill(bx, by, bx + boxSize, by + boxSize, 0xF0141414);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + boxSize - 1, by + boxSize - 1, (index == 0) ? 0xF04A3B22 : 0xF02C2D30);

        if (index == 0) {
            float ratio = MathHelper.clamp(currentProgress / (float) currentMax, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            int fillH = Math.round(ratio * (boxSize - 2));
            if (fillH > 0) {
                context.fill(bx + 1, by + boxSize - 1 - fillH, bx + boxSize - 1, by + boxSize - 1, 0xCCDF8B1E);
            }
        }

        context.drawItem(r.output(), bx + 3, by + 3);

        int cnt = (index < counts.size()) ? counts.get(index) : 1;
        String cntStr = String.valueOf(cnt);
        int tw = tr.getWidth(cntStr);
        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(0.0f, 0.0f, 200.0f);
        context.drawText(tr, cntStr, bx + boxSize - tw - 1, by + boxSize - 9, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);
        context.getMatrices().pop();
    }

    private static void drawExpandArrowButton(DrawContext context, TextRenderer tr, int bx, int by,
                                              int boxSize, String arrow, int extraCount) {
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + boxSize, by + boxSize, 0xF0141414);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + boxSize - 1, by + boxSize - 1, 0xF03B3D42);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + boxSize - 1, by + 3, 0xFFE59524);

        int aw = tr.getWidth(arrow);
        context.drawText(tr, arrow, bx + (boxSize - aw) / 2, by + (extraCount > 0 ? 4 : 7), 0xFFFFCC66, true);

        if (extraCount > 0) {
            String plusStr = "+" + extraCount;
            int pw = tr.getWidth(plusStr);
            context.drawText(tr, plusStr, bx + (boxSize - pw) / 2, by + 13, 0xFFCCCCCC, false);
        }
    }

    private static void drawHiddenCountBadge(DrawContext context, TextRenderer tr, int bx, int by,
                                             int boxSize, String label) {
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + boxSize, by + boxSize, 0xD0141414);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + boxSize - 1, by + boxSize - 1, 0xD0252629);
        int lw = tr.getWidth(label);
        context.drawText(tr, label, bx + (boxSize - lw) / 2, by + 7, 0xFFAAAAAA, true);
    }

    public static boolean handleMouseClick(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, int screenW, int screenH) {
        if (recipeIds.isEmpty()) return false;

        int boxSize = 22;
        int step = boxSize + 2;
        int startX = 6;
        int baseY = screenH - boxSize - 6;

        int maxCols = getMaxColsLeftOfHotbar(screenW);
        int totalItems = recipeIds.size();
        boolean canExpand = totalItems > (maxCols - 1);
        boolean showExpanded = expandedInInventory && canExpand;

        if (!showExpanded) {
            int visibleSlots = canExpand ? (maxCols - 1) : Math.min(totalItems, maxCols);

            // ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ ÐºÐ½Ð¾Ð¿ÐºÐµ Ñ€Ð°ÑÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸ [>>]
            if (canExpand) {
                int btnX = startX + visibleSlots * step;
                if (mouseX >= btnX && mouseX <= btnX + boxSize && mouseY >= baseY && mouseY <= baseY + boxSize) {
                    expandedInInventory = true;
                    return true;
                }
            }

            // ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ Ð²Ð¸Ð´Ð¸Ð¼Ð¾Ð¹ ÑÑ‡ÐµÐ¹ÐºÐµ Ð´Ð»Ñ Ð¾Ñ‚Ð¼ÐµÐ½Ñ‹
            for (int i = 0; i < visibleSlots && i < totalItems; i++) {
                int bx = startX + i * step;
                if (mouseX >= bx && mouseX <= bx + boxSize && mouseY >= baseY && mouseY <= baseY + boxSize) {
                    ClientPlayNetworking.send(new RequestCraftPayload(recipeIds.get(i), -1));
                    return true;
                }
            }
        } else {
            // ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ ÐºÐ½Ð¾Ð¿ÐºÐµ ÑÐ²Ð¾Ñ€Ð°Ñ‡Ð¸Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ñ [<<]
            int collapseCol = totalItems % maxCols;
            int collapseRow = totalItems / maxCols;
            int btnX = startX + collapseCol * step;
            int btnY = baseY - collapseRow * step;
            if (mouseX >= btnX && mouseX <= btnX + boxSize && mouseY >= btnY && mouseY <= btnY + boxSize) {
                expandedInInventory = false;
                return true;
            }

            // ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ Ð»ÑŽÐ±Ð¾Ð¹ ÑÑ‡ÐµÐ¹ÐºÐµ Ð² Ñ€Ð°ÑÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¹ ÑÐµÑ‚ÐºÐµ
            for (int i = 0; i < totalItems; i++) {
                int col = i % maxCols;
                int rowFromBottom = i / maxCols;
                int bx = startX + col * step;
                int by = baseY - rowFromBottom * step;
                if (mouseX >= bx && mouseX <= bx + boxSize && mouseY >= by && mouseY <= by + boxSize) {
                    ClientPlayNetworking.send(new RequestCraftPayload(recipeIds.get(i), -1));
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

        if (gridIdx >= 9 && gridIdx < 36) {

        if (equipIdx >= 0 && equipIdx < 4) {

    private ItemStack getEquipStack(PlayerInventory inv, int equipIdx) {
        if (equipIdx >= 0 && equipIdx < 4) {

            return inv.offHand.get(0);

        return ItemStack.EMPTY;

    /**
     * ÐžÐ±Ñ‰Ð¸Ð¹ ÑÑ‚Ð°Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ‡ÐµÑÐºÐ¸Ð¹ Ñ€ÐµÐ½Ð´ÐµÑ€ ÐºÐ°Ñ€Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ‡ÐºÐ¸ Ñ€ÐµÑ†ÐµÐ¿Ñ‚Ð° Ð² ÑÑ‚Ð¸Ð»Ðµ Factorio (Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ¸ÑÐ¿Ð¾Ð»ÑŒÐ·ÑƒÐµÑ‚ÑÑ Ð² CharacterScreen Ð¸ AssemblerScreen).
     */
    public static void renderRecipeCard(DrawContext context, TextRenderer textRenderer,
                                        int screenWidth, int screenHeight,
                                        FactorioRecipes.Recipe recipe, PlayerInventory inv,
                                        int mouseX, int mouseY, boolean allowSubCraftHighlight) {
        Map<Item, Integer> invCounts = FactorioRecipes.snapshotInventory(inv);
        Map<Item, Integer> totalRaw = FactorioRecipes.calculateTotalRaw(recipe);

        String titleStr = recipe.output().getName().getString()
                + (recipe.output().getCount() > 1 ? " \u00d7" + recipe.output().getCount() : "");

        int cardW = Math.max(156, textRenderer.getWidth(titleStr) + 32);
        for (FactorioRecipes.Ingredient ing : recipe.ingredients()) {
            int have = invCounts.getOrDefault(ing.item(), 0);
            String line = ing.count() + " \u00d7 " + ing.item().getName().getString() + " (" + have + ")";
            cardW = Math.max(cardW, textRenderer.getWidth(line) + 28);
        }

        if (!totalRaw.isEmpty()) {
            int rawW = 16 + textRenderer.getWidth(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.total_raw"));
            for (Map.Entry<Item, Integer> entry : totalRaw.entrySet()) {
                rawW += 20 + textRenderer.getWidth(String.valueOf(entry.getValue()));
            }
            cardW = Math.max(cardW, rawW + 8);
        }

        int ingCount = recipe.ingredients().size();
        int rawSectionH = totalRaw.isEmpty() ? 0 : 28;
        int cardH = 24 + 14 + ingCount * 14 + rawSectionH + 6;

        int tx = mouseX + 12;
        int ty = mouseY - 8;
        if (tx + cardW > screenWidth - 6) {
            tx = mouseX - cardW - 12;
        }
        if (ty + cardH > screenHeight - 6) {
            ty = screenHeight - cardH - 6;
        }
        if (ty < 6) ty = 6;

        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(0.0f, 0.0f, 400.0f);

        context.fill(tx, ty, tx + cardW, ty + cardH, 0xF8111214);
        context.fill(tx + 1, ty + 1, tx + cardW - 1, ty + cardH - 1, 0xF426272A);

        context.fill(tx + 2, ty + 2, tx + cardW - 2, ty + 21, 0xFF3E301B);
        context.fill(tx + 2, ty + 20, tx + cardW - 2, ty + 21, 0xFFE59524);
        context.drawItem(recipe.output(), tx + 4, ty + 3);
        context.drawText(textRenderer, titleStr, tx + 24, ty + 7, 0xFFFFD670, true);

        int curY = ty + 25;

        drawClockIconStatic(context, tx + 6, curY + 1);
        context.drawText(textRenderer,
                Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.craft_time", String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.1f", recipe.getSeconds())),
                tx + 18, curY + 1, 0xFFCCCCCC, false);
        curY += 13;

        for (FactorioRecipes.Ingredient ing : recipe.ingredients()) {
            int have = invCounts.getOrDefault(ing.item(), 0);
            int textColor;
            if (have >= ing.count()) {
                textColor = 0xFF66EE66;
            } else if (allowSubCraftHighlight) {
                FactorioRecipes.Recipe sub = FactorioRecipes.getByOutput(ing.item());
                int canSub = (sub != null) ? FactorioRecipes.getCraftableCount(inv, sub) : 0;
                textColor = (have + canSub >= ing.count()) ? 0xFFFFCC44 : 0xFFFF5555;
            } else {
                textColor = 0xFFFF5555;
            }

            context.getMatrices().push();
            context.getMatrices().translate(tx + 5, curY, 0.0f);
            context.getMatrices().scale(0.75f, 0.75f, 1.0f);
            context.drawItem(new ItemStack(ing.item()), 0, 0);
            context.getMatrices().pop();

            String ingLine = ing.count() + " \u00d7 " + ing.item().getName().getString() + " (" + have + ")";
            context.drawText(textRenderer, ingLine, tx + 20, curY + 2, textColor, false);
            curY += 14;
        }

        if (!totalRaw.isEmpty()) {
            curY += 2;
            context.fill(tx + 4, curY, tx + cardW - 4, curY + 1, 0xFF18191B);
            context.fill(tx + 4, curY + 1, tx + cardW - 4, curY + 2, 0xFF3A3C40);
            curY += 5;

            Text rawLabel = Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.total_raw");
            context.drawText(textRenderer, rawLabel, tx + 6, curY + 4, 0xFF999B9F, false);

            int iconX = tx + 10 + textRenderer.getWidth(rawLabel);
            for (Map.Entry<Item, Integer> entry : totalRaw.entrySet()) {
                context.getMatrices().push();
                context.getMatrices().translate(iconX, curY + 1, 0.0f);
                context.getMatrices().scale(0.8f, 0.8f, 1.0f);
                context.drawItem(new ItemStack(entry.getKey()), 0, 0);
                context.getMatrices().pop();

                String countText = String.valueOf(entry.getValue());
                context.drawText(textRenderer, countText, iconX + 14, curY + 4, 0xFFE6E6E6, true);
                iconX += 18 + textRenderer.getWidth(countText);
            }
        }

        context.getMatrices().pop();
    }

    private boolean isHoveringSlot(double mx, double my, int sx, int sy) {

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {

            return false;
        }

        int leftGridX = x + 12;
        int leftGridY = y + 22;

        int equipY = y + PANEL_H - 28;

            int ex = (e < 4) ? (leftGridX + e * SLOT_SIZE) : offhandX;
            if (isHoveringSlot(mouseX, mouseY, ex, equipY)) {
                int packetSlot = mapEquipIndexToPacketSlot(e);
                if (packetSlot >= 0) {
                    SlotActionType action = hasShiftDown() ? SlotActionType.QUICK_MOVE : SlotActionType.PICKUP;
                    this.client.interactionManager.clickSlot(syncId, packetSlot, button, action, this.client.player);

                this.activeCategory = cats[i];

        int rightGridY = y + 56;

        List<List<FactorioRecipes.Recipe>> compactedRows = FactorioRecipes.getCompactedRows(this.activeCategory, queryLower, COLS);
        for (int r = 0; r < Math.min(CRAFT_ROWS, compactedRows.size()); r++) {
            List<FactorioRecipes.Recipe> rowRecipes = compactedRows.get(r);
            for (int c = 0; c < Math.min(COLS, rowRecipes.size()); c++) {
                FactorioRecipes.Recipe recipe = rowRecipes.get(c);
                int sx = rightGridX + c * SLOT_SIZE;
                int sy = rightGridY + r * SLOT_SIZE;
                if (isHoveringSlot(mouseX, mouseY, sx, sy)) {
                    int craftAction = hasShiftDown() ? 999 : (button == 1 ? 5 : 1);
                    ClientPlayNetworking.send(new RequestCraftPayload(recipe.id(), craftAction));
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        if (mouseX < x || mouseX > x + PANEL_W || mouseY < y || mouseY > y + PANEL_H) {
            if (!this.client.player.playerScreenHandler.getCursorStack().isEmpty()) {
                this.client.interactionManager.clickSlot(syncId, -999, button, SlotActionType.PICKUP, this.client.player);
                return true;
            }
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean charTyped(char chr, int modifiers) {
        if (this.searchActive && chr >= 32) {
            this.searchQuery += chr;
            return true;
        }
        return super.charTyped(chr, modifiers);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(int keyCode, int scanCode, int modifiers) {
        if (this.searchActive) {
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_BACKSPACE && !this.searchQuery.isEmpty()) {
                this.searchQuery = this.searchQuery.substring(0, this.searchQuery.length() - 1);
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) {
                this.searchActive = false;
                this.searchQuery = "";
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ENTER || keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_KP_ENTER) {
                this.searchActive = false;
                return true;
            }
            return true;
        }
        if (this.client != null && this.client.options.inventoryKey.matchesKey(keyCode, scanCode)) {
            this.close();
            return true;
        }
        return super.keyPressed(keyCode, scanCode, modifiers);
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        if (this.client != null && this.client.player != null && this.client.interactionManager != null) {
            if (!this.client.player.playerScreenHandler.getCursorStack().isEmpty()) {
                int syncId = this.client.player.playerScreenHandler.syncId;
                this.client.interactionManager.clickSlot(syncId, -999, 0, SlotActionType.PICKUP, this.client.player);
            }
        }
        super.close();
    }
}

    public static void tickClientHistory(MinecraftClient client) {
        if (client.world == null) {
            if (lastTrackedWorld != null) {
                lastTrackedWorld = null;
                resetHistory();
            }
            return;
        }
        if (client.world != lastTrackedWorld) {
            lastTrackedWorld = client.world;
            resetHistory();
        }
        if (client.isPaused()) return;

        long wt = client.world.getTime();
        if (wt == lastRecordedWorldTick) return;
        lastRecordedWorldTick = wt;

        boolean screenOpen = client.currentScreen instanceof ElectricNetworkInfoScreen;
        BlockPos target = lastViewedPolePos;
        if (screenOpen) {
            target = ((ElectricNetworkInfoScreen) client.currentScreen).polePos;
            lastViewedPolePos = target;
        } else if (target == null && client.player != null && wt % 40 == 0) {
            target = findNearbyPole(client.world, client.player.getBlockPos());
            if (target != null) lastViewedPolePos = target;
        }
        if (target == null) return;

        int scanInterval = screenOpen ? 5 : 20;
        if (cachedSnapshot == null || Math.abs(wt - lastNetworkScanTick) >= scanInterval) {
            cachedSnapshot = PowerNetworkManager.scanNetwork(client.world, target);
            lastNetworkScanTick = wt;
        }

        PowerNetworkManager.NetworkSnapshot snap = cachedSnapshot;
        if (snap == null) return;

        Set<Block> seenConsumers = new HashSet<>();
        for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat stat : snap.consumers()) {
            seenConsumers.add(stat.block());
            long[] buf = CONSUMER_RAW_TICKS.computeIfAbsent(stat.block(), k -> new long[RAW_BUFFER_SIZE]);
            buf[rawWriteCursor] = stat.watts();
        }
        for (Map.Entry<Block, long[]> e : CONSUMER_RAW_TICKS.entrySet()) {
            if (!seenConsumers.contains(e.getKey())) {
                e.getValue()[rawWriteCursor] = 0L;
            }
        }

        Set<Block> seenProducers = new HashSet<>();
        for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat stat : snap.producers()) {
            seenProducers.add(stat.block());
            long[] buf = PRODUCER_RAW_TICKS.computeIfAbsent(stat.block(), k -> new long[RAW_BUFFER_SIZE]);
            buf[rawWriteCursor] = stat.watts();
        }
        for (Map.Entry<Block, long[]> e : PRODUCER_RAW_TICKS.entrySet()) {
            if (!seenProducers.contains(e.getKey())) {
                e.getValue()[rawWriteCursor] = 0L;
            }

        // Ð—Ð°Ð¿Ð¸ÑÑ‹Ð²Ð°ÐµÐ¼ Ð¸ÑÑ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ð¸ÑŽ Ð·Ð°Ñ€ÑÐ´Ð° Ð°ÐºÐºÑƒÐ¼ÑƒÐ»ÑÑ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ð² (Ð² Ð”Ð¶Ð¾ÑƒÐ»ÑÑ…) Ð´Ð»Ñ 3-Ð¹ ÐºÐ¾Ð»Ð¾Ð½ÐºÐ¸
        long[] accBuf = ACCUMULATOR_RAW_TICKS.computeIfAbsent(ModBlocks.ACCUMULATOR, k -> new long[RAW_BUFFER_SIZE]);
        accBuf[rawWriteCursor] = snap.accumulatorStoredJoules();

        rawWriteCursor = (rawWriteCursor + 1) % RAW_BUFFER_SIZE;
        totalRecordedTicks++;
    }

    private static BlockPos findNearbyPole(World world, BlockPos center) {
        for (int dx = -12; dx <= 12; dx += 2) {
            for (int dz = -12; dz <= 12; dz += 2) {
                for (int dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy++) {
                    BlockPos p = center.add(dx, dy, dz);
                    Block b = world.getBlockState(p).getBlock();
                    if (b instanceof ElectricPoleBlock || b instanceof CreativeEnergySourceBlock) {
                        return p.toImmutable();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private PowerNetworkManager.NetworkSnapshot getOrScanSnapshot(World world) {
        if (cachedSnapshot == null) {
            cachedSnapshot = PowerNetworkManager.scanNetwork(world, this.polePos);
            lastNetworkScanTick = world.getTime();
        }
        return cachedSnapshot;
    }

    private List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> getFilteredStats(
            List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> stats,
            Map<Block, long[]> rawHistoryMap) {
        List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> displayList = new ArrayList<>();
        String queryLower = this.searchQuery.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat st : stats) {
            if (!queryLower.isBlank()) {
                String name = st.block().getName().getString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
                if (!name.contains(queryLower)) continue;
            }
            long avgWatts = computeTimeframeAverageWatts(rawHistoryMap, st.block(), st.watts());
            displayList.add(new PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat(st.block(), st.count(), avgWatts, st.color()));
        }
        displayList.sort(Comparator.comparingLong(PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat::watts).reversed());
        return displayList;
    }

    private long[] buildTimeframeSeries(Map<Block, long[]> rawMap, Block block) {
        long[] result = new long[GRAPH_POINTS];
        long[] raw = rawMap.get(block);
        if (raw == null || totalRecordedTicks <= 0) return result;

        int step = TICKS_PER_POINT[this.selectedTimeframe];
        if (this.selectedTimeframe == 8) {
            step = Math.max(1, Math.min(RAW_BUFFER_SIZE / GRAPH_POINTS, (totalRecordedTicks + GRAPH_POINTS - 1) / GRAPH_POINTS));
        }

        int sampleWindow = Math.min(step, 120);
        for (int i = 0; i < GRAPH_POINTS; i++) {
            int pointsAgo = (GRAPH_POINTS - 1) - i;
            long startTicksAgo = (long) pointsAgo * step;
            if (startTicksAgo >= totalRecordedTicks || startTicksAgo >= RAW_BUFFER_SIZE) {
                result[i] = 0L;
                continue;
            }

            long sum = 0L;
            int count = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < sampleWindow; k++) {
                long tAgo = startTicksAgo + k;
                if (tAgo >= totalRecordedTicks || tAgo >= RAW_BUFFER_SIZE) break;
                int idx = Math.floorMod(rawWriteCursor - 1 - (int) tAgo, RAW_BUFFER_SIZE);
                sum += raw[idx];
                count++;
            }
            result[i] = (count > 0) ? (sum / count) : 0L;
        }
        return result;
    }

    private long computeTimeframeAverageWatts(Map<Block, long[]> rawMap, Block block, long fallbackCurrentWatts) {
        if (this.selectedTimeframe == 0) {
            return fallbackCurrentWatts;
        }
        long[] series = buildTimeframeSeries(rawMap, block);
        long sum = 0L;
        for (long v : series) {
            sum += v;
        }
        return sum / GRAPH_POINTS;
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        this.renderBackground(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);
        if (this.client == null || this.client.world == null) return;

        PowerNetworkManager.NetworkSnapshot snap = getOrScanSnapshot(this.client.world);

        int panelW = Math.min(520, this.width - 12);
        int panelH = Math.min(254, this.height - 12);
        int x = (this.width - panelW) / 2;
        int y = (this.height - panelH) / 2;

        context.fill(x, y, x + panelW, y + panelH, 0xFF111213);
        context.fill(x + 1, y + 1, x + panelW - 1, y + panelH - 1, 0xFF2D2E30);

        drawHeader(context, x + 3, y + 3, panelW - 6, mouseX, mouseY);

        int topBarY = y + 20;
        int innerW = panelW - 10;
        int colGap = 4;
        int colW = (innerW - colGap * 2) / 3;

        int col1X = x + 5;
        int col2X = col1X + colW + colGap;
        int col3X = col2X + colW + colGap;

        float satRatio = (snap.totalDemandWatts() > 0)
                ? MathHelper.clamp(snap.totalProductionWatts() / (float) snap.totalDemandWatts(), 0.0f, 1.0f)
                : (snap.maxProductionCapacityWatts() > 0 ? 1.0f : 0.0f);
        int satColor = (satRatio >= 0.99f) ? 0xFF33CC24 : (satRatio >= 0.5f ? 0xFFE59524 : 0xFFD93025);
        String satText = PowerNetworkManager.formatWatts(snap.totalProductionWatts())
                + " / " + PowerNetworkManager.formatWatts(snap.totalDemandWatts());
        drawTopSummaryBox(context, col1X, topBarY, colW,
                Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.electric_network.satisfaction").getString(),
                satRatio, satColor, satText);

        float prodRatio = (snap.maxProductionCapacityWatts() > 0)
                ? MathHelper.clamp(snap.totalProductionWatts() / (float) snap.maxProductionCapacityWatts(), 0.0f, 1.0f)
                : 0.0f;
        String prodText = PowerNetworkManager.formatWatts(snap.totalProductionWatts())
                + " / " + PowerNetworkManager.formatWatts(snap.maxProductionCapacityWatts());
        drawTopSummaryBox(context, col2X, topBarY, colW,
                Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.electric_network.production").getString(),
                prodRatio, 0xFF33CC24, prodText);

        float accRatio = (snap.accumulatorCapacityJoules() > 0L)
                ? MathHelper.clamp(snap.accumulatorStoredJoules() / (float) snap.accumulatorCapacityJoules(), 0.0f, 1.0f)
                : 0.0f;
        String accText = PowerNetworkManager.formatJoules(snap.accumulatorStoredJoules())
                + " / " + PowerNetworkManager.formatJoules(snap.accumulatorCapacityJoules());
        drawTopSummaryBox(context, col3X, topBarY, colW,
                Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.electric_network.accumulator").getString(),
                accRatio, 0xFF33CC24, accText);

        int tabsY = y + 51;
        int tabCount = TIMEFRAME_LABELS.length;
        int tabW = innerW / tabCount;
        for (int i = 0; i < tabCount; i++) {
            int tx = col1X + i * tabW;
            int tw = (i == tabCount - 1) ? (col1X + innerW - tx) : (tabW - 1);
            boolean selected = (i == this.selectedTimeframe);
            boolean hovered = mouseX >= tx && mouseX < tx + tw && mouseY >= tabsY && mouseY < tabsY + 12;

            int bg = selected ? 0xFFF2B653 : (hovered ? 0xFF9EA0A3 : 0xFF7D7F82);
            context.fill(tx, tabsY, tx + tw, tabsY + 12, 0xFF141414);
            context.fill(tx + 1, tabsY + 1, tx + tw - 1, tabsY + 11, bg);

            drawScaledTextCentered(context, Text.translatable(TIMEFRAME_LABELS[i]).getString(),
                    tx + tw / 2, tabsY + 3, 0.75f, 0xFF141414, false);
        }

        int mainTopY = y + 66;
        int mainH = panelH - 71;

        renderColumnPanel(
                context, col1X, mainTopY, colW, mainH,
                Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.electric_network.consumption").getString(),
                snap.consumers(), CONSUMER_RAW_TICKS, this.filteredConsumerBlock,
                Math.max(100_000L, snap.totalDemandWatts()), false, mouseX, mouseY
        );

        renderColumnPanel(
                context, col2X, mainTopY, colW, mainH,
                Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.electric_network.production").getString(),
                snap.producers(), PRODUCER_RAW_TICKS, this.filteredProducerBlock,
                Math.max(900_000L, snap.totalProductionWatts()), false, mouseX, mouseY
        );

        // 3-Ñ ÐºÐ¾Ð»Ð¾Ð½ÐºÐ°: Ð“Ñ€Ð°Ñ„Ð¸Ðº Ð¸ ÑÐ¿Ð¸ÑÐ¾Ðº Ð¿Ð¾Ð´ÐºÐ»ÑŽÑ‡Ñ‘Ð½Ð½Ñ‹Ñ… Ðº ÑÐµÑ‚Ð¸ ÐÐºÐºÑƒÐ¼ÑƒÐ»ÑÑ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ð² (Ð² Ð”Ð¶Ð¾ÑƒÐ»ÑÑ…: ÐºÐ”Ð¶ / ÐœÐ”Ð¶)
        int accCount = snap.getAccumulatorCount();
        List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> accStats = (accCount > 0)
                ? List.of(new PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat(
                ModBlocks.ACCUMULATOR, accCount, snap.accumulatorStoredJoules(), 0xFF29B6F6))
                : List.of();
        renderColumnPanel(
                context, col3X, mainTopY, colW, mainH,
                Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.electric_network.accumulator").getString(),
                accStats, ACCUMULATOR_RAW_TICKS, null,
                Math.max(5_000_000L, snap.accumulatorCapacityJoules()), true, mouseX, mouseY
        );
    }

    private void drawHeader(DrawContext context, int hx, int hy, int hw, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        context.fill(hx, hy, hx + hw, hy + 14, 0xFF222325);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, this.title, hx + 5, hy + 3, 0xFFFFDCA0, true);

        int closeBtnX = hx + hw - 14;
        int searchBtnX = closeBtnX - 15;
        int rightReserve = this.searchActive ? 98 : 34;

        int startRibs = hx + 10 + this.textRenderer.getWidth(this.title);
        int endRibs = hx + hw - rightReserve;
        for (int rx = startRibs; rx < endRibs; rx += 3) {
            context.fill(rx, hy + 3, rx + 1, hy + 11, 0xFF17181A);
        }

        if (this.searchActive) {
            int boxW = 78;
            int boxX = closeBtnX - boxW - 3;
            context.fill(boxX, hy + 1, boxX + boxW, hy + 13, 0xFF111112);
            context.fill(boxX + 1, hy + 2, boxX + boxW - 1, hy + 12, 0xFF1E1F22);
            context.fill(boxX + 1, hy + 11, boxX + boxW - 1, hy + 12, 0xFFE59524);
            String shown = this.textRenderer.trimToWidth(this.searchQuery, boxW - 10) + "_";
            context.drawText(this.textRenderer, shown, boxX + 3, hy + 3, 0xFFFFEAAA, false);
        } else {
            boolean hovSearch = mouseX >= searchBtnX && mouseX < searchBtnX + 13 && mouseY >= hy + 1 && mouseY < hy + 13;
            context.fill(searchBtnX, hy + 1, searchBtnX + 13, hy + 13, 0xFF141414);
            context.fill(searchBtnX + 1, hy + 2, searchBtnX + 12, hy + 12, hovSearch ? 0xFF4C4E52 : 0xFF35373A);
            drawSmallMagnifier(context, searchBtnX + 3, hy + 3);
        }

        boolean hovClose = mouseX >= closeBtnX && mouseX < closeBtnX + 13 && mouseY >= hy + 1 && mouseY < hy + 13;
        context.fill(closeBtnX, hy + 1, closeBtnX + 13, hy + 13, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(closeBtnX + 1, hy + 2, closeBtnX + 12, hy + 12, hovClose ? 0xFFB83227 : 0xFF35373A);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, "x", closeBtnX + 4, hy + 2, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);
    }

    private void drawTopSummaryBox(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw,
                                   String label, float ratio, int barColor, String rightValueText) {
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + bw, by + 28, 0xFF18191B);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + bw - 1, by + 27, 0xFF28292C);

        drawScaledText(context, label, bx + 5, by + 4, 0.78f, 0xFFE6E6E6, true);

        int labelW = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(label) * 0.78f);
        int infoX = bx + 8 + labelW;
        int infoY = by + 3;
        context.fill(infoX, infoY, infoX + 7, infoY + 7, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(infoX + 1, infoY + 1, infoX + 6, infoY + 6, 0xFF3FA9F5);
        drawScaledText(context, "i", infoX + 2, infoY + 1, 0.65f, 0xFF111111, false);

        int barX = bx + 3;
        int barY = by + 14;
        int barW = bw - 6;
        int barH = 11;
        context.fill(barX, barY, barX + barW, barY + barH, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(barX + 1, barY + 1, barX + barW - 1, barY + barH - 1, 0xFF3E4044);

        int fillW = Math.round(MathHelper.clamp(ratio, 0.0f, 1.0f) * (barW - 2));
        if (fillW > 0) {
            context.fill(barX + 1, barY + 1, barX + 1 + fillW, barY + barH - 1, barColor);
        }

        int valW = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(rightValueText) * 0.72f);
        drawScaledText(context, rightValueText, barX + barW - valW - 4, barY + 3, 0.72f, 0xFFEAEAEA, true);
    }

    private void renderColumnPanel(DrawContext context, int cx, int cy, int cw, int ch,
                                   String title, List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> stats,
                                   Map<Block, long[]> rawHistoryMap, Block activeFilter,
                                   long fallbackMaxScale, boolean isJoulesColumn, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        context.fill(cx, cy, cx + cw, cy + ch, 0xFF161719);
        context.fill(cx + 1, cy + 1, cx + cw - 1, cy + ch - 1, 0xFF242528);

        drawScaledText(context, title, cx + 5, cy + 4, 0.78f, 0xFFE6E6E6, true);

        int resetBtnX = cx + cw - 14;
        int resetBtnY = cy + 2;
        boolean hovReset = mouseX >= resetBtnX && mouseX < resetBtnX + 11 && mouseY >= resetBtnY && mouseY < resetBtnY + 11;
        context.fill(resetBtnX, resetBtnY, resetBtnX + 11, resetBtnY + 11, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(resetBtnX + 1, resetBtnY + 1, resetBtnX + 10, resetBtnY + 10, hovReset ? 0xFFFF5252 : 0xFFE04848);
        drawScaledText(context, "\u21bb", resetBtnX + 3, resetBtnY + 2, 0.70f, 0xFF141414, false);

        int graphLeft = cx + 22;
        int graphTop = cy + 15;
        int graphRight = cx + cw - 4;
        int graphBottom = cy + 78;
        int graphW = graphRight - graphLeft;
        int graphH = graphBottom - graphTop;

        context.fill(cx + 3, graphTop - 1, graphRight + 1, graphBottom + 9, 0xFF0A0B0C);

        Map<Block, long[]> sampledSeriesMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        long maxScale = isJoulesColumn ? fallbackMaxScale : 10_000L;
        for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat st : stats) {
            if (activeFilter != null && st.block() != activeFilter) continue;
            long[] series = buildTimeframeSeries(rawHistoryMap, st.block());
            sampledSeriesMap.put(st.block(), series);
            for (long val : series) {
                if (val > maxScale) maxScale = val;
            }
        }
        if (!isJoulesColumn) {
            maxScale = Math.max(maxScale, fallbackMaxScale / 2);
            maxScale = (long) (Math.ceil(maxScale / 50_000.0) * 50_000L);
        }
        if (maxScale <= 0) maxScale = 100_000L;

        int hRows = 6;
        for (int r = 0; r <= hRows; r++) {
            int gy = graphTop + Math.round((r / (float) hRows) * graphH);
            context.fill(graphLeft, gy, graphRight, gy + 1, (r == hRows) ? 0xFF333538 : 0xFF181A1C);

            if (!stats.isEmpty()) {
                long rowVal = Math.round(((hRows - r) / (double) hRows) * maxScale);
                String yLbl = isJoulesColumn
                        ? PowerNetworkManager.formatAxisJoules(rowVal)
                        : PowerNetworkManager.formatAxisWatts(rowVal);
                int lblW = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(yLbl) * 0.55f);
                drawScaledText(context, yLbl, graphLeft - lblW - 2, gy - 2, 0.55f, 0xFF888A8E, false);
            }
        }

        int vCols = 10;
        float maxTimeNum = TIMEFRAME_MAX_NUM[this.selectedTimeframe];
        for (int c = 0; c <= vCols; c++) {
            int gx = graphLeft + Math.round((c / (float) vCols) * graphW);
            context.fill(gx, graphTop, gx + 1, graphBottom, 0xFF181A1C);

            float tVal = maxTimeNum * (1.0f - (c / (float) vCols));
            String tStr = (tVal == (int) tVal) ? String.valueOf((int) tVal) : String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.1f", tVal);
            drawScaledTextCentered(context, tStr, gx, graphBottom + 2, 0.50f, 0xFF888A8E, false);
        }

        for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat stat : stats) {
            if (activeFilter != null && stat.block() != activeFilter) continue;
            long[] series = sampledSeriesMap.get(stat.block());
            if (series == null) continue;

            int prevX = -1;
            int prevY = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < GRAPH_POINTS; i++) {
                float xRatio = i / (float) (GRAPH_POINTS - 1);
                float yRatio = MathHelper.clamp(series[i] / (float) maxScale, 0.0f, 1.0f);
                int px = graphLeft + Math.round(xRatio * (graphW - 1));
                int py = graphBottom - 1 - Math.round(yRatio * (graphH - 2));

                if (prevX != -1 && (series[i] > 0 || series[Math.max(0, i - 1)] > 0)) {
                    int minX = Math.min(prevX, px);
                    int maxX = Math.max(prevX, px) + 1;
                    context.fill(minX, prevY, maxX, prevY + 1, stat.color());
                    int minY = Math.min(prevY, py);
                    int maxY = Math.max(prevY, py) + 1;
                    context.fill(px, minY, px + 1, maxY, stat.color());
                }
                prevX = px;
                prevY = py;
            }
        }

        int listTopY = graphBottom + 11;
        int cellGap = 2;
        int subColW = (cw - 8 - cellGap) / 2;
        int rowH = 14;
        int numRows = Math.max(4, (ch - (listTopY - cy) - 3) / (rowH + 1));

        List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> displayList = isJoulesColumn
                ? stats
                : getFilteredStats(stats, rawHistoryMap);

        long totalGroupValue = isJoulesColumn ? Math.max(1L, fallbackMaxScale) : 0L;
        if (!isJoulesColumn) {
            for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat st : displayList) {
                totalGroupValue += st.watts();
            }
        }

        for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
                int idx = r + c * numRows;
                int cellX = cx + 4 + c * (subColW + cellGap);
                int cellY = listTopY + r * (rowH + 1);

                if (idx < displayList.size()) {
                    PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat st = displayList.get(idx);
                    boolean isSelected = (activeFilter == st.block());
                    boolean hovCell = mouseX >= cellX && mouseX < cellX + subColW && mouseY >= cellY && mouseY < cellY + rowH;

                    int cellBg = isSelected ? 0xFF484B50 : (hovCell ? 0xFF3C3E42 : 0xFF313235);
                    context.fill(cellX, cellY, cellX + subColW, cellY + rowH, 0xFF141414);
                    context.fill(cellX + 1, cellY + 1, cellX + subColW - 1, cellY + rowH - 1, cellBg);

                    context.fill(cellX + 1, cellY + 1, cellX + 13, cellY + rowH - 1, 0xFF1E1F22);
                    context.getMatrices().push();
                    context.getMatrices().translate(cellX + 1.5f, cellY + 1.0f, 100.0f);
                    context.getMatrices().scale(0.68f, 0.68f, 1.0f);
                    context.drawItem(new ItemStack(st.block().asItem()), 0, 0);
                    context.getMatrices().pop();

                    String cntStr = String.valueOf(st.count());
                    int cntW = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(cntStr) * 0.55f);
                    drawScaledText(context, cntStr, cellX + 13 - cntW, cellY + rowH - 5, 0.55f, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);

                    int barStartX = cellX + 15;
                    int barEndX = cellX + subColW - 34;
                    int barW = Math.max(10, barEndX - barStartX);
                    int barY = cellY + 5;
                    context.fill(barStartX, barY, barStartX + barW, barY + 4, 0xFF18191B);

                    float share = (totalGroupValue > 0) ? MathHelper.clamp(st.watts() / (float) totalGroupValue, 0.0f, 1.0f) : 0.0f;
                    int fillW = Math.round(share * barW);
                    if (fillW > 0) {
                        context.fill(barStartX, barY, barStartX + fillW, barY + 4, st.color());
                    }

                    String wStr = isJoulesColumn
                            ? PowerNetworkManager.formatJoules(st.watts())
                            : PowerNetworkManager.formatWatts(st.watts());
                    int wWidth = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(wStr) * 0.60f);
                    drawScaledText(context, wStr, cellX + subColW - wWidth - 2, cellY + 4, 0.60f, 0xFFE6E6E6, true);
                } else {
                    context.fill(cellX, cellY, cellX + subColW, cellY + rowH, 0xFF1B1C1E);
                    context.fill(cellX, cellY + rowH - 1, cellX + subColW, cellY + rowH, 0xFF121314);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void drawSmallMagnifier(DrawContext context, int lx, int ly) {
        int col = 0xFFE6E6E6;
        context.fill(lx + 1, ly, lx + 4, ly + 1, col);
        context.fill(lx, ly + 1, lx + 1, ly + 4, col);
        context.fill(lx + 4, ly + 1, lx + 5, ly + 4, col);
        context.fill(lx + 1, ly + 4, lx + 4, ly + 5, col);
        context.fill(lx + 4, ly + 5, lx + 6, ly + 7, col);
    }

    private void drawScaledText(DrawContext context, String text, int x, int y, float scale, int color, boolean shadow) {
        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(x, y, 200.0f);
        context.getMatrices().scale(scale, scale, 1.0f);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, text, 0, 0, color, shadow);
        context.getMatrices().pop();
    }

    private void drawScaledTextCentered(DrawContext context, String text, int centerX, int y, float scale, int color, boolean shadow) {
        int w = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(text) * scale);
        drawScaledText(context, text, centerX - w / 2, y, scale, color, shadow);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (this.client == null || this.client.world == null) return false;

        int panelW = Math.min(520, this.width - 12);
        int panelH = Math.min(254, this.height - 12);
        int x = (this.width - panelW) / 2;
        int y = (this.height - panelH) / 2;

        int hx = x + 3;
        int hy = y + 3;
        int hw = panelW - 6;
        int closeBtnX = hx + hw - 14;
        int searchBtnX = closeBtnX - 15;

        if (mouseX >= closeBtnX && mouseX < closeBtnX + 13 && mouseY >= hy + 1 && mouseY < hy + 13) {
            this.close();
            return true;
        }

        if (!this.searchActive && mouseX >= searchBtnX && mouseX < searchBtnX + 13 && mouseY >= hy + 1 && mouseY < hy + 13) {
            this.searchActive = true;
            return true;
        } else if (this.searchActive) {
            int boxX = closeBtnX - 81;
            if (mouseX >= boxX && mouseX < closeBtnX - 3 && mouseY >= hy + 1 && mouseY < hy + 13) {
                if (button == 1) this.searchQuery = "";
                return true;
            } else if (this.searchQuery.isEmpty()) {
                this.searchActive = false;
            }
        }

        int innerW = panelW - 10;
        int col1X = x + 5;
        int tabsY = y + 51;
        int tabCount = TIMEFRAME_LABELS.length;
        int tabW = innerW / tabCount;
        for (int i = 0; i < tabCount; i++) {
            int tx = col1X + i * tabW;
            int tw = (i == tabCount - 1) ? (col1X + innerW - tx) : (tabW - 1);
            if (mouseX >= tx && mouseX < tx + tw && mouseY >= tabsY && mouseY < tabsY + 12) {
                this.selectedTimeframe = i;
                if (this.client.player != null) {
                    this.client.player.playSound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), 0.3f, 1.2f);
                }
                return true;
            }
        }

        int colGap = 4;
        int colW = (innerW - colGap * 2) / 3;
        int col2X = col1X + colW + colGap;
        int mainTopY = y + 66;

        if (mouseX >= col1X + colW - 14 && mouseX < col1X + colW - 3 && mouseY >= mainTopY + 2 && mouseY < mainTopY + 13) {
            this.filteredConsumerBlock = null;
            return true;
        }
        if (mouseX >= col2X + colW - 14 && mouseX < col2X + colW - 3 && mouseY >= mainTopY + 2 && mouseY < mainTopY + 13) {
            this.filteredProducerBlock = null;
            return true;
        }

        PowerNetworkManager.NetworkSnapshot snap = getOrScanSnapshot(this.client.world);
        List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> filteredConsumers = getFilteredStats(snap.consumers(), CONSUMER_RAW_TICKS);
        List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> filteredProducers = getFilteredStats(snap.producers(), PRODUCER_RAW_TICKS);

        int mainH = panelH - 71;
        int listTopY = mainTopY + 78 + 11;
        int subColW = (colW - 10) / 2;
        int rowH = 14;
        int numRows = Math.max(4, (mainH - (listTopY - mainTopY) - 3) / (rowH + 1));

        for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
                int idx = r + c * numRows;
                int cellX1 = col1X + 4 + c * (subColW + 2);
                int cellY = listTopY + r * (rowH + 1);
                if (idx < filteredConsumers.size() && mouseX >= cellX1 && mouseX < cellX1 + subColW && mouseY >= cellY && mouseY < cellY + rowH) {
                    Block b = filteredConsumers.get(idx).block();
                    this.filteredConsumerBlock = (this.filteredConsumerBlock == b) ? null : b;
                    return true;
                }

                int cellX2 = col2X + 4 + c * (subColW + 2);
                if (idx < filteredProducers.size() && mouseX >= cellX2 && mouseX < cellX2 + subColW && mouseY >= cellY && mouseY < cellY + rowH) {
                    Block b = filteredProducers.get(idx).block();
                    this.filteredProducerBlock = (this.filteredProducerBlock == b) ? null : b;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean charTyped(char chr, int modifiers) {
        if (this.searchActive && chr >= 32) {
            this.searchQuery += chr;
            return true;
        }
        return super.charTyped(chr, modifiers);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(int keyCode, int scanCode, int modifiers) {
        if (this.searchActive) {
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_BACKSPACE && !this.searchQuery.isEmpty()) {
                this.searchQuery = this.searchQuery.substring(0, this.searchQuery.length() - 1);
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) {
                this.searchActive = false;
                this.searchQuery = "";
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ENTER || keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_KP_ENTER) {
                this.searchActive = false;
                return true;
            }
            return true;
        }
        if (this.client != null && this.client.options.inventoryKey.matchesKey(keyCode, scanCode)) {
            this.close();
            return true;
        }
        return super.keyPressed(keyCode, scanCode, modifiers);
    }
}
