        zoomInKey = KeyBindingHelper.registerKeyBinding(new KeyBinding("key.factoriocore.minimap_zoom_in", InputUtil.Type.KEYSYM, GLFW.GLFW_KEY_EQUAL, "category.factoriocore"));
        zoomOutKey = KeyBindingHelper.registerKeyBinding(new KeyBinding("key.factoriocore.minimap_zoom_out", InputUtil.Type.KEYSYM, GLFW.GLFW_KEY_MINUS, "category.factoriocore"));

        ClientTickEvents.END_CLIENT_TICK.register(client -> {
            while (toggleMapKey.wasPressed()) minimapVisible = !minimapVisible;
            while (zoomInKey.wasPressed()) if (blocksPerCell > 1) blocksPerCell /= 2;
            while (zoomOutKey.wasPressed()) if (blocksPerCell < 4) blocksPerCell *= 2;

            if (client.world != null && client.player != null && !client.isPaused()) {
                if (minimapVisible && FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.enableMinimap) {
                    updateMapSlice(client.world, client.player, nextSliceRow, nextSliceRow + 11);
                    nextSliceRow = (nextSliceRow + 11) % MAP_CELLS;
                    if ((client.world.getTime() & 7L) == 0L) updateRadarEntities(client.world, client.player);
                }
                tickMiningProgressBar(client);
            }
        });

        HudRenderCallback.EVENT.register(FactorioHudOverlay::renderHud);
    }

    private static void tickMiningProgressBar(MinecraftClient client) {
        if (client.player == null || client.world == null || client.player.isCreative() || client.interactionManager == null) {
            prevMiningProgress = 0.0f;
            miningBarProgress = 0.0f;
            lastMiningPos = null;
            return;
        }

        if (client.options.attackKey.isPressed() && client.interactionManager.isBreakingBlock()
                && client.crosshairTarget instanceof BlockHitResult hit && hit.getType() == HitResult.Type.BLOCK) {
            BlockPos pos = hit.getBlockPos();
            BlockState state = client.world.getBlockState(pos);
            Block block = state.getBlock();

            if (BlockHealthManager.getMaxHealth(block) > 0 || block instanceof ResourceOreBlock || block instanceof PavementBlock) {
                int currentOre = -1;
                if (block instanceof ResourceOreBlock && client.world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof ResourceOreBlockEntity oreBe) {
                    currentOre = oreBe.getOrInitAmount();
                }

                if (!pos.equals(lastMiningPos) || (currentOre != -1 && lastSeenOreAmount != -1 && currentOre != lastSeenOreAmount)) {
                    lastMiningPos = pos.toImmutable();
                    lastSeenOreAmount = currentOre;
                    prevMiningProgress = 0.0f;
                    miningBarProgress = 0.0f;
                }
                lastSeenOreAmount = currentOre;

                prevMiningProgress = miningBarProgress;
                float delta = state.calcBlockBreakingDelta(client.player, client.world, pos);
                miningBarProgress += delta;
                if (miningBarProgress >= 1.0f) {
                    miningBarProgress = (block instanceof ResourceOreBlock) ? 0.0f : 1.0f;
                    prevMiningProgress = miningBarProgress;
                }
                return;
            }
        }

        prevMiningProgress = 0.0f;
        miningBarProgress = 0.0f;
        lastMiningPos = null;
        lastSeenOreAmount = -1;
    }

    private static void updateRadarEntities(World world, PlayerEntity player) {
        cachedRadarBlips.clear();
        int radiusBlocks = (MAP_CELLS / 2) * blocksPerCell;
        Box radarBox = player.getBoundingBox().expand(radiusBlocks, 24.0, radiusBlocks);
        List<Entity> entities = world.getOtherEntities(player, radarBox);

        for (Entity ent : entities) {
            int color = 0;
            if (ent instanceof Monster) color = 0xFFFF2222;
            else if (ent instanceof PlayerEntity) color = 0xFF44FF44;

            if (color != 0) {
                double dx = (ent.getX() - player.getX()) / blocksPerCell;
                double dz = (ent.getZ() - player.getZ()) / blocksPerCell;
                int ox = MathHelper.floor(dx * PIXEL_SCALE);
                int oz = MathHelper.floor(dz * PIXEL_SCALE);
                cachedRadarBlips.add(new RadarBlip(ox, oz, color));
            }
        }
    }

    private static void renderHud(DrawContext context, RenderTickCounter tickCounter) {
        MinecraftClient client = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        if (client.player == null || client.world == null || client.options.hudHidden || client.getDebugHud().shouldShowDebugHud()) {
            return;
        }

        int screenW = context.getScaledWindowWidth();
        int nextPanelY = 6;

        float mapScale = MathHelper.clamp(FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.minimapScale, 0.5f, 2.0f);
        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(screenW, 0, 0);
        context.getMatrices().scale(mapScale, mapScale, 1.0f);
        context.getMatrices().translate(-screenW, 0, 0);

        int frameSize = MAP_SIZE_PX + 6;
        int x = screenW - frameSize - 6;
        int curTopY = 6;

        int researchBarH = 22;
        renderTopRightResearchWidget(context, client.textRenderer, x, curTopY, frameSize, researchBarH);
        curTopY += researchBarH + 2;

        if (minimapVisible && FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.enableMinimap) {
            int y = curTopY;

            context.fill(x, y, x + frameSize, y + frameSize, 0xFF141414);
            context.fill(x + 1, y + 1, x + frameSize - 1, y + frameSize - 1, 0xFF313234);

            int mapX = x + 3;
            int mapY = y + 3;
            context.fill(mapX - 1, mapY - 1, mapX + MAP_SIZE_PX + 1, mapY + MAP_SIZE_PX + 1, 0xFF141414);

            for (int gz = 0; gz < MAP_CELLS; gz++) {
                int drawY = mapY + gz * PIXEL_SCALE;
                int rowOffset = gz * MAP_CELLS;
                for (int gx = 0; gx < MAP_CELLS; gx++) {
                    int drawX = mapX + gx * PIXEL_SCALE;
                    context.fill(drawX, drawY, drawX + PIXEL_SCALE, drawY + PIXEL_SCALE, colorBuffer[rowOffset + gx]);
                }
            }

            int centerPxX = mapX + MAP_SIZE_PX / 2;
            int centerPxY = mapY + MAP_SIZE_PX / 2;

            PollutionClientRenderer.renderMinimapPollutionOverlay(context, centerPxX, centerPxY, MAP_SIZE_PX / 2, (float) blocksPerCell / PIXEL_SCALE);

            for (RadarBlip blip : cachedRadarBlips) {
                int ex = centerPxX + blip.offsetX();
                int ez = centerPxY + blip.offsetZ();
                if (ex >= mapX + 2 && ex < mapX + MAP_SIZE_PX - 2 && ez >= mapY + 2 && ez < mapY + MAP_SIZE_PX - 2) {
                    context.fill(ex - 1, ez - 1, ex + 2, ez + 2, blip.color());
                }
            }

            drawPlayerMarker(context, centerPxX, centerPxY, client.player.getYaw());
            if (AltModeRenderer.isAltModeActive()) {
                context.fill(x - 28, y, x - 2, y + 14, 0xEE141414);
                context.fill(x - 27, y + 1, x - 3, y + 13, 0xEEAC6E14);
                context.drawText(client.textRenderer, "ALT", x - 23, y + 3, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);
            }
            curTopY += frameSize + 4;
        }

        context.getMatrices().pop();
        nextPanelY = (int) (6 + (curTopY - 6) * mapScale);

        if (FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.enableTargetInfoPanel) {
            float infoScale = MathHelper.clamp(FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.infoPanelScale, 0.5f, 2.0f);
            context.getMatrices().push();
            context.getMatrices().translate(screenW, nextPanelY, 0);
            context.getMatrices().scale(infoScale, infoScale, 1.0f);
            context.getMatrices().translate(-screenW, -nextPanelY, 0);

            renderTargetInfoPanel(context, client, screenW, nextPanelY);

            context.getMatrices().pop();
        }

        if (FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.enableCraftingQueueHud) {
            ClientCraftingQueueHud.renderBottomLeftQueue(context, false);
        }
        renderMiningProgressBar(context, tickCounter.getTickDelta(false));
    }

    private static void renderTopRightResearchWidget(DrawContext context, TextRenderer tr, int x, int y, int width, int height) {
        ResearchManager.init();
        ResearchManager.TechNode activeTech = ResearchManager.getActiveTech();

        context.fill(x, y, x + width, y + height, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(x + 1, y + 1, x + width - 1, y + height - 1, 0xFF28292C);
        context.fill(x + 2, y + 2, x + width - 2, y + height - 2, 0xFF1F2023);

        if (activeTech == null) {
            String idleStr = Text.translatable("hud.factoriocore.press_t_research").getString();
            context.getMatrices().push();
            context.getMatrices().translate(x + 5, y + 8, 100.0f);
            context.getMatrices().scale(0.62f, 0.62f, 1.0f);
            context.drawText(tr, idleStr, 0, 0, 0xFF999B9F, true);
            context.getMatrices().pop();
            return;
        }

        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(x + 3.0f, y + 3.0f, 100.0f);
        context.drawItem(activeTech.icon, 0, 0);
        context.getMatrices().pop();

        float titleScale = 0.65f;
        int maxTitlePx = Math.round((width - 24) / titleScale);
        String trimmedTitle = tr.trimToWidth(activeTech.getLocalizedName(), maxTitlePx);
        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(x + 21.0f, y + 4.0f, 100.0f);
        context.getMatrices().scale(titleScale, titleScale, 1.0f);
        context.drawText(tr, trimmedTitle, 0, 0, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);
        context.getMatrices().pop();

        float ratio = ResearchManager.getOverallProgressRatio();
        int pct = MathHelper.clamp(Math.round(ratio * 100.0f), 0, 100);
        String pctText = pct + "%";

        float pctScale = 0.62f;
        int pctW = Math.round(tr.getWidth(pctText) * pctScale);
        int pctX = x + width - pctW - 3;

        int barX = x + 21;
        int barY = y + 13;
        int barW = Math.max(16, (pctX - 3) - barX);
        int barH = 5;

        context.fill(barX, barY, barX + barW, barY + barH, 0xFF111213);
        context.fill(barX + 1, barY + 1, barX + barW - 1, barY + barH - 1, 0xFF2D2E32);

        int fillW = Math.round(ratio * (barW - 2));
        if (fillW > 0) {
            context.fill(barX + 1, barY + 1, barX + 1 + fillW, barY + barH - 1, 0xFF43A047);
            context.fill(barX + 1, barY + 1, barX + 1 + fillW, barY + 2, 0xFF66BB6A);
        }

        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(pctX, y + 12.0f, 100.0f);
        context.getMatrices().scale(pctScale, pctScale, 1.0f);
        context.drawText(tr, pctText, 0, 0, 0xFFE6E6E6, true);
        context.getMatrices().pop();
    }

    private static class InfoSection {
        String title;
        int iconColor;
        List<Text> lines = new ArrayList<>();
        InfoSection(String t, int c) { title = t; iconColor = c; }
    }

    private static Formatting formattingForFluid(FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind kind) {
        return switch (kind) {
            case WATER -> Formatting.AQUA;
            case STEAM -> Formatting.WHITE;
            case CRUDE_OIL -> Formatting.GRAY;
            case HEAVY_OIL -> Formatting.RED;
            case LIGHT_OIL -> Formatting.GOLD;
            case PETROLEUM_GAS -> Formatting.LIGHT_PURPLE;
            case LUBRICANT -> Formatting.GREEN;
            case SULFURIC_ACID -> Formatting.YELLOW;
            default -> Formatting.GRAY;
        };
    }

    private static String mbUnit() {
        return Text.translatableWithFallback("unit.factoriocore.mb", "mB").getString();
    }

    private static void renderTargetInfoPanel(DrawContext context, MinecraftClient client, int screenW, int topY) {
        if (!(client.crosshairTarget instanceof BlockHitResult hit) || hit.getType() != HitResult.Type.BLOCK) {
            return;
        }
        World world = client.world;
        if (world == null) return;

        BlockPos rawPos = hit.getBlockPos();
        BlockState rawState = world.getBlockState(rawPos);
        if (rawState.isAir()) return;

        BlockPos pos = BlockHealthManager.getCanonicalPos(rawPos, rawState);
        BlockState state = world.getBlockState(pos);
        Block block = state.getBlock();

        int maxHp = BlockHealthManager.getMaxHealth(block);
        boolean isFactorioOre = block instanceof ResourceOreBlock || block instanceof OilMachines.CrudeOilDepositBlock;

        if (maxHp <= 0 && !isFactorioOre) {
            return;
        }

        Text title = block.getName();
        TextRenderer tr = client.textRenderer;
        FactorioConfig cfg = FactorioConfig.INSTANCE;

        List<InfoSection> sections = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Text> headerLines = new ArrayList<>();
        BlockEntity be = world.getBlockEntity(pos);

        // --- 1. ÐžÐ¿Ð¸ÑÐ°Ð½Ð¸Ðµ ---
        if (cfg.showInfoDescription) {
            String descKey = block.getTranslationKey() + ".desc";
            String desc = Text.translatable(descKey).getString();
            if (!desc.equals(descKey)) {
                String[] words = desc.split(" ");
                StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
                for (String word : words) {
                    if (tr.getWidth(sb.toString() + word) > 180) {
                        headerLines.add(Text.literal(sb.toString()).formatted(Formatting.GRAY));
                        sb = new StringBuilder();
                    }
                    sb.append(word).append(" ");
                }
                if (sb.length() > 0) {
                    headerLines.add(Text.literal(sb.toString()).formatted(Formatting.GRAY));
                }
            }
        }

        // --- 2. Ð¡Ñ‚Ð°Ñ‚ÑƒÑ ---
        if (cfg.showInfoStatus) {
            if (block instanceof ResourceOreBlock oreBlock) {
                int amount = ResourceOreBlockEntity.getClientDisplayAmount(world, pos, oreBlock.getOreType());
                headerLines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.expected_resources",
                                Text.literal(String.valueOf(amount)).formatted(Formatting.YELLOW))
                        .formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
            } else if (block instanceof OilMachines.CrudeOilDepositBlock) {
                int yieldPct = com.fixplot.factoriocore.worldgen.NauvisChunkGenerator.evaluateOilYieldPercentAt(pos.getX(), pos.getZ());
                headerLines.add(Text.translatable("hud.factoriocore.oil_yield").formatted(Formatting.WHITE)
                        .append(Text.literal(yieldPct + "%").formatted(Formatting.LIGHT_PURPLE)));
            } else if (be != null && !(be instanceof PipeBlockEntity) && !(be instanceof StorageTankBlock.StorageTankBlockEntity)) {
                boolean isWorking = false;
                boolean noFuel = false;
                boolean noPower = false;

                if (be instanceof ElectricDrillBlockEntity eDrill) {
                    isWorking = eDrill.isActivelyMining();
                    noPower = !eDrill.isPowered();
                } else if (be instanceof BoilerBlockEntity boiler) {
                    isWorking = boiler.isBurning();
                    noFuel = !isWorking && boiler.getStack(0).isEmpty();
                } else if (be instanceof BurnerDrillBlockEntity drill) {
                    isWorking = drill.getClientDrillRotation(0.0f) > 0.0f || !drill.getFuelStack().isEmpty();
                    noFuel = !isWorking;
                } else if (be instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity furnace) {
                    isWorking = furnace.isBurning();
                    noFuel = !isWorking && furnace.getStack(1).isEmpty();
                } else if (be instanceof InserterBlockEntity ins) {
                    boolean isBurner = block instanceof BurnerInserterBlock;
                    isWorking = !ins.getHeldStack().isEmpty() || ins.getArmProgress(0.0f) > 0.01f;
                    boolean powered = isBurner || PowerNetworkManager.isMachinePowered(world, pos);
                    noPower = !isBurner && !powered;
                    noFuel = isBurner && ins.getFuelStack().isEmpty();
                } else if (be instanceof com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.research.LabBlockEntity lab) {
                    isWorking = lab.isWorking();
                    noPower = !lab.isPowered();
                } else if (be instanceof AssemblerBlockEntity asm) {
                    isWorking = asm.isWorking();
                    noPower = !asm.isPowered();
                } else if (be instanceof OilMachines.PumpjackBlockEntity pj) {
                    isWorking = pj.isWorking();
                    noPower = !pj.isPowered();
                } else if (be instanceof OilMachines.OilRefineryBlockEntity ref) {
                    isWorking = ref.isWorking();
                    noPower = !ref.isPowered();
                } else if (be instanceof OilMachines.ChemicalPlantBlockEntity cp) {
                    isWorking = cp.isWorking();
                    noPower = !cp.isPowered();
                } else if (be instanceof SolarAndAccumulatorMachines.SolarPanelBlockEntity) {
                    isWorking = SolarAndAccumulatorMachines.SolarPanelBlockEntity.getCurrentOutputWatts(world) > 0;
                } else if (be instanceof SolarAndAccumulatorMachines.AccumulatorBlockEntity acc) {
                    isWorking = acc.getChargeState() != 0 || acc.getStoredJoules() > 0;
                } else if (be instanceof TurretBlockEntity turret) {
                    isWorking = turret.isFiring() || (turret.getTurretKind() == 1 && turret.isPowered())
                            || (turret.getTurretKind() == 0 && !turret.isEmpty())
                            || (turret.getTurretKind() == 2 && turret.getFluidAmount() > 0);
                    noPower = (turret.getTurretKind() == 1 && !turret.isPowered());
                } else if (block instanceof com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.electricity.ElectricPoleBlock) {
                    isWorking = PowerNetworkManager.isPoleEnergized(world, pos);
                    noPower = !isWorking;
                }

                if (noPower) {
                    headerLines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.status_no_power").formatted(Formatting.RED));
                } else if (noFuel) {
                    headerLines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.status_no_fuel").formatted(Formatting.RED));
                } else if (isWorking) {
                    headerLines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.status_working").formatted(Formatting.GREEN));
                } else {
                    headerLines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.status_waiting").formatted(Formatting.YELLOW));
                }
            }
        }

        // --- 3. Ð¡ÐžÐ”Ð•Ð Ð–Ð˜ÐœÐžÐ• Ð¢Ð Ð£Ð‘, Ð Ð•Ð—Ð•Ð Ð’Ð£ÐÐ ÐžÐ’ Ð˜ Ð–Ð˜Ð”ÐšÐžÐ¡Ð¢ÐÐ«Ð¥ ÐœÐÐ¨Ð˜Ð (Ð¡Ð¢Ð ÐžÐ“Ðž ÐŸÐž Ð Ð•Ð¦Ð•ÐŸÐ¢Ð£ Ð˜ Ð¡ ÐŸÐ•Ð Ð•Ð’ÐžÐ”ÐžÐœ!) ---
        if (cfg.showInfoFluids) {
            String inTag = Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.input_tag").getString();
            String outTag = Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.output_tag").getString();
            String mb = mbUnit();

            if (be instanceof PipeBlockEntity pipe) {
                FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind kind = pipe.getFluidKind();
                int amt = pipe.getFluidAmount();
                int cap = pipe.getFluidCapacity();
                InfoSection pipeSec = new InfoSection(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.pipe_contents").getString(), kind.color);
                if (amt <= 0 || kind == FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind.NONE) {
                    pipeSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.fluid_empty", cap).formatted(Formatting.GRAY));
                } else {
                    pipeSec.lines.add(Text.literal(kind.getLocalizedName() + ": ").formatted(Formatting.WHITE)
                            .append(Text.literal(amt + " / " + cap + " " + mb).formatted(formattingForFluid(kind))));
                    pipeSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.temperature", pipe.getTemperatureC() + " Â°C").formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
                }
                sections.add(pipeSec);
            } else if (be instanceof StorageTankBlock.StorageTankBlockEntity tank) {
                FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind kind = tank.getFluidKind();
                int amt = tank.getFluidAmount();
                int cap = tank.getFluidCapacity();
                InfoSection tankSec = new InfoSection(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.tank_contents").getString(), kind.color);
                if (amt <= 0 || kind == FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind.NONE) {
                    tankSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.fluid_empty", cap).formatted(Formatting.GRAY));
                } else {
                    tankSec.lines.add(Text.literal(kind.getLocalizedName() + ": ").formatted(Formatting.WHITE)
                            .append(Text.literal(amt + " / " + cap + " " + mb).formatted(formattingForFluid(kind))));
                }
                sections.add(tankSec);
            } else if (be instanceof OffshorePumpBlockEntity) {
                InfoSection pumpSec = new InfoSection(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.fluid_output").getString(), 0x2980B9);
                pumpSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.water_rate").formatted(Formatting.AQUA));
                sections.add(pumpSec);
            } else if (be instanceof BoilerBlockEntity boiler) {
                InfoSection waterSec = new InfoSection(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.consumes_water").getString(), 0x33CCFF);
                waterSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.water_line", boiler.getWaterMb()).formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
                waterSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.temperature", "15 Â°C").formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
                sections.add(waterSec);

                InfoSection steamSec = new InfoSection(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.produces_steam").getString(), 0xDDDDDD);
                steamSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.steam_boiler_line", boiler.getSteamMb()).formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
                sections.add(steamSec);
            } else if (be instanceof SteamEngineBlockEntity engine) {
                InfoSection steamSec = new InfoSection(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.consumes_steam").getString(), 0xDDDDDD);
                steamSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.steam_line", engine.getFluidAmount()).formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
                steamSec.lines.add(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.max_temperature", "165 Â°C").formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
                sections.add(steamSec);
            } else if (be instanceof OilMachines.PumpjackBlockEntity pj) {
                InfoSection oilSec = new InfoSection(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.oil_extraction").getString(), 0x33333A);
                oilSec.lines.add(Text.literal(FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind.CRUDE_OIL.getLocalizedName() + ": "
                        + pj.getFluidAmount() + " / 2000 " + mb).formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
                sections.add(oilSec);
            } else if (be instanceof OilMachines.OilRefineryBlockEntity ref) {
                int mode = ref.getRecipeMode();
                InfoSection refSec = new InfoSection(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.refinery_fluids").getString(), 0xF57F17);
                if (mode == 2) {
                    refSec.lines.add(Text.literal(FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind.HEAVY_OIL.getLocalizedName() + inTag + ": " + ref.getCrudeOilMb() + " / 4000 " + mb).formatted(Formatting.RED));
                    refSec.lines.add(Text.literal(FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind.STEAM.getLocalizedName() + inTag + ": " + ref.getWaterMb() + " / 4000 " + mb).formatted(Formatting.AQUA));
                } else {
                    refSec.lines.add(Text.literal(FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind.CRUDE_OIL.getLocalizedName() + inTag + ": " + ref.getCrudeOilMb() + " / 4000 " + mb).formatted(Formatting.WHITE));
                    if (mode == 1) {
                        refSec.lines.add(Text.literal(FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind.WATER.getLocalizedName() + inTag + ": " + ref.getWaterMb() + " / 4000 " + mb).formatted(Formatting.AQUA));
                    }
                }
                if (mode == 0) {
                    refSec.lines.add(Text.literal(FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind.PETROLEUM_GAS.getLocalizedName() + outTag + ": " + ref.getPetroleumGasMb() + " / 4000 " + mb).formatted(Formatting.LIGHT_PURPLE));
                } else {
                    refSec.lines.add(Text.literal(FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind.HEAVY_OIL.getLocalizedName() + outTag + ": " + ref.getHeavyOilMb() + " / 4000 " + mb).formatted(Formatting.RED));
                    refSec.lines.add(Text.literal(FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind.LIGHT_OIL.getLocalizedName() + outTag + ": " + ref.getLightOilMb() + " / 4000 " + mb).formatted(Formatting.GOLD));
                    refSec.lines.add(Text.literal(FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind.PETROLEUM_GAS.getLocalizedName() + outTag + ": " + ref.getPetroleumGasMb() + " / 4000 " + mb).formatted(Formatting.LIGHT_PURPLE));
                }
                sections.add(refSec);
            } else if (be instanceof OilMachines.ChemicalPlantBlockEntity cp) {
                FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind reqMain = cp.getRequiredMainFluid();
                FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind prodFluid = cp.getProducedFluidKind();
                int secColor = (prodFluid != FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind.NONE) ? prodFluid.color
                        : (reqMain != FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind.NONE ? reqMain.color : 0x2980B9);

                InfoSection cpSec = new InfoSection(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.chem_fluids").getString(), secColor);
                if (reqMain != FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind.NONE) {
                    cpSec.lines.add(Text.literal(reqMain.getLocalizedName() + inTag + ": " + cp.getMainFluidMb() + " / 4000 " + mb)
                            .formatted(formattingForFluid(reqMain)));
                }

    private static String formatCompactCount(int count) {
        if (count >= 1000) return String.format("%.1fk", count / 1000.0f);
        return String.valueOf(count);
    }

    private static void renderMiningProgressBar(DrawContext context, float tickDelta) {
        if (miningBarProgress <= 0.0f && prevMiningProgress <= 0.0f) return;

        float smoothProgress = MathHelper.clamp(MathHelper.lerp(tickDelta, prevMiningProgress, miningBarProgress), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        int screenW = context.getScaledWindowWidth();
        int screenH = context.getScaledWindowHeight();
        int barW = 182;
        int barH = 5;
        int bx = (screenW - barW) / 2;
        int by = screenH - 54;

        context.fill(bx - 1, by - 1, bx + barW + 1, by + barH + 1, 0xEE141414);
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + barW, by + barH, 0xEE26272A);
        int fillW = Math.round(smoothProgress * barW);
        if (fillW > 0) {
            context.fill(bx, by, bx + fillW, by + barH, 0xFFE59524);
            context.fill(bx, by, bx + fillW, by + 2, 0xFFFFCC66);
        }
    }

    private static void drawPlayerMarker(DrawContext context, int cx, int cy, float yaw) {
        context.fill(cx - 2, cy - 2, cx + 3, cy + 3, 0xFF111111);
        context.fill(cx - 1, cy - 1, cx + 2, cy + 2, 0xFFFFCC00);

        double rad = Math.toRadians(yaw + 90.0f);
        int tipX = cx + (int) Math.round(Math.cos(rad) * 3.0);
        int tipY = cy + (int) Math.round(Math.sin(rad) * 3.0);
        context.fill(tipX - 1, tipY - 1, tipX + 1, tipY + 1, 0xFFFFFFFF);
    }

    private static void updateMapSlice(World world, PlayerEntity player, int startRow, int endRow) {
        int centerX = MathHelper.floor(player.getX());
        int centerZ = MathHelper.floor(player.getZ());
        int half = MAP_CELLS / 2;
        BlockPos.Mutable pos = new BlockPos.Mutable();

        int maxRow = Math.min(MAP_CELLS, endRow);
        for (int gz = startRow; gz < maxRow; gz++) {
            int wz = centerZ + (gz - half) * blocksPerCell;
            int rowOffset = gz * MAP_CELLS;

            for (int gx = 0; gx < MAP_CELLS; gx++) {
                int wx = centerX + (gx - half) * blocksPerCell;

                if (!world.isChunkLoaded(wx >> 4, wz >> 4)) {
                    colorBuffer[rowOffset + gx] = 0xFF18191B;
                    continue;
                }

                int topY = world.getTopY(Heightmap.Type.WORLD_SURFACE, wx, wz) - 1;
                if (topY < world.getBottomY()) {
                    colorBuffer[rowOffset + gx] = 0xFF18191B;
                    continue;
                }

                pos.set(wx, topY, wz);
                BlockState state = world.getBlockState(pos);
                if (state.isAir() && topY > world.getBottomY()) {
                    pos.set(wx, topY - 1, wz);
                    state = world.getBlockState(pos);
                }

                colorBuffer[rowOffset + gx] = resolveFactorioMapColor(world, pos, state);
            }
        }
    }

    private static int resolveFactorioMapColor(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        Block block = state.getBlock();

        if (block instanceof OilMachines.CrudeOilDepositBlock
                || com.fixplot.factoriocore.worldgen.NauvisChunkGenerator.hasCrudeOilSpotAt(pos.getX(), pos.getZ(), 0.25)) {
            return 0xFFD81B60;
        }

        if (state.isOf(Blocks.WATER) || state.isOf(Blocks.SEAGRASS) || state.isOf(Blocks.LILY_PAD)) {
            float factor = com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.pollution.PollutionManager.getClientWaterTintFactor(pos.getX(), pos.getZ());
            if (factor <= 0.01f) return 0xFF2471A3;
            int r = MathHelper.lerp(factor, 0x24, 0x46);
            int g = MathHelper.lerp(factor, 0x71, 0x6E);
            int b = MathHelper.lerp(factor, 0xA3, 0x24);
            return 0xFF000000 | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
        }

        if (block instanceof BeltBlock belt) {
            return switch (belt.getTier()) {
                case 2 -> 0xFFE53935;
                case 3 -> 0xFF29B6F6;
                default -> 0xFFFDD835;
            };
        }
        if (block instanceof com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.production.burner_drill.BurnerDrillBlock || block instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlock) return 0xFF42A5F5;
        if (block instanceof InserterBlock || block instanceof FactorioChestBlock || block instanceof TurretBlock) return 0xFFFFB300;
        if (block instanceof OilMachines.CrudeOilDepositBlock) return 0xFFD81B60;

        if (block instanceof ResourceOreBlock ore) {
            return switch (ore.getOreType()) {
                case 0 -> 0xFF5B9BD5;
                case 1 -> 0xFFED7D31;
                case 2 -> 0xFF1A1A1D;
                default -> 0xFFD2C290;
            };
        }

        Block below = world.getBlockState(pos.down()).getBlock();
        if (below instanceof ResourceOreBlock oreBelow) {
            return switch (oreBelow.getOreType()) {
                case 0 -> 0xFF5B9BD5;
                case 1 -> 0xFFED7D31;
                case 2 -> 0xFF1A1A1D;
                default -> 0xFFD2C290;
            };
        }

        if (block instanceof PavementBlock) return 0xFF70757A;
        if (pos.getY() >= 66 && (state.isOf(Blocks.DRIPSTONE_BLOCK) || state.isOf(Blocks.GRANITE) || state.isOf(Blocks.TUFF))) return 0xFF424949;

        MapColor mapColor = state.getMapColor(world, pos);
        if (mapColor == MapColor.CLEAR) {
            BlockState groundState = world.getBlockState(pos.down());
            mapColor = groundState.getMapColor(world, pos.down());
        }
        int rgb = mapColor.color;
        int r = (rgb >> 16) & 0xFF;
        int g = (rgb >> 8) & 0xFF;
        int b = rgb & 0xFF;
        return 0xFF000000 | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.client.mixin;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.pollution.PollutionManager;
import net.minecraft.client.color.world.BiomeColors;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.math.MathHelper;
import net.minecraft.world.BlockRenderView;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfoReturnable;

@Mixin(BiomeColors.class)
public class ExampleClientMixin {

	@Inject(method = "getWaterColor", at = @At("RETURN"), cancellable = true)
	private static void factoriocore$tintPollutedWater(BlockRenderView world, BlockPos pos, CallbackInfoReturnable<Integer> cir) {
		if (pos == null) return;
		float factor = PollutionManager.getClientWaterTintFactor(pos.getX(), pos.getZ());
		if (factor <= 0.01f) return;

		int baseColor = cir.getReturnValueI();
		int r1 = (baseColor >> 16) & 0xFF;
		int g1 = (baseColor >> 8) & 0xFF;
		int b1 = baseColor & 0xFF;

		// ÐšÐ°Ð½Ð¾Ð½Ð¸Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð±Ð¾Ð»Ð¾Ñ‚Ð½Ð¾-Ð·ÐµÐ»Ñ‘Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ñ†Ð²ÐµÑ‚ Ð·Ð°Ð³Ñ€ÑÐ·Ð½Ñ‘Ð½Ð½Ð¾Ð¹ Ð²Ð¾Ð´Ñ‹ Ð¸Ð· Factorio (#4E7A27)
		int r = MathHelper.lerp(factor, r1, 0x4E);
		int g = MathHelper.lerp(factor, g1, 0x7A);
		int b = MathHelper.lerp(factor, b1, 0x27);

		cir.setReturnValue((r << 16) | (g << 8) | b);
	}
}

                int border = hov ? 0xFFE59524 : (selected ? 0xFFFFCC66 : 0xFF141414);
                int bg = hov ? 0xFF525458 : (selected ? 0xFF44464A : 0xFF35373A);

                context.fill(sx, sy, sx + slotSize - 2, sy + slotSize - 2, border);
                context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 1, sx + slotSize - 3, sy + slotSize - 3, bg);
                drawRecipeBadgeIcon(context, machineType, m, sx + 4, sy + 4);
            }
            return;
        }

        int leftX = x + 6;
        int leftW = 180;
        int panelH = backgroundHeight - 26;
        context.fill(leftX, y + 20, leftX + leftW, y + 20 + panelH, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(leftX + 1, y + 21, leftX + leftW - 1, y + 19 + panelH, 0xFF242527);

        context.fill(leftX + 2, y + 22, leftX + leftW - 2, y + 34, 0xFF1C1D1E);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.character"), leftX + 6, y + 24, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);

        int invStartX = x + 12;
        int invStartY = y + 36;
        for (int r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < 9; c++) {
                drawSlotFrame(context, invStartX + c * 18, invStartY + r * 18);
            }
        }

        context.fill(leftX + 4, y + 92, leftX + leftW - 4, y + 93, 0xFF1A1B1C);
        context.fill(leftX + 4, y + 93, leftX + leftW - 4, y + 94, 0xFF3A3C3F);

        for (int c = 0; c < 9; c++) {
            drawSlotFrame(context, invStartX + c * 18, y + 96);
        }

        for (int r = 0; r < 5; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < 9; c++) {
                drawGhostSlot(context, invStartX + c * 18, y + 118 + r * 18);
            }
        }

        int rightX = x + 192;
        int rightW = 232;
        context.fill(rightX, y + 20, rightX + rightW, y + 20 + panelH, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(rightX + 1, y + 21, rightX + rightW - 1, y + 19 + panelH, 0xFF28292C);

        Text statusText;
        int ledOuter, ledInner;
        if (!handler.isPowered()) {
            statusText = Text.translatableWithFallback("gui.factoriocore.status.no_power", "No power");
            ledOuter = 0xFF661111;
            ledInner = 0xFFFF3333;
        } else if (handler.isWorking()) {
            statusText = Text.translatableWithFallback("gui.factoriocore.status.working", "Working");
            ledOuter = 0xFF115511;
            ledInner = 0xFF44FF44;
        } else {
            statusText = Text.translatableWithFallback("gui.factoriocore.status.missing_ingredients", "Item ingredient shortage");
            ledOuter = 0xFF664400;
            ledInner = 0xFFFFAA00;
        }

        int ledX = rightX + 6;
        int ledY = y + 25;
        context.fill(ledX, ledY, ledX + 6, ledY + 6, 0xFF111111);
        context.fill(ledX + 1, ledY + 1, ledX + 5, ledY + 5, ledOuter);
        context.fill(ledX + 2, ledY + 2, ledX + 4, ledY + 4, ledInner);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, statusText, rightX + 16, y + 24, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);

        int viewLeft = rightX + 6;
        int viewTop = y + 34;
        int viewRight = rightX + rightW - 6;
        int viewBottom = y + 110;
        context.fill(viewLeft - 1, viewTop - 1, viewRight + 1, viewBottom + 1, 0xFF141414);
        drawCheckerboard(context, viewLeft, viewTop, viewRight, viewBottom, 8);

        context.enableScissor(viewLeft, viewTop, viewRight, viewBottom);
        renderMachine3DPreview(context, (viewLeft + viewRight) / 2, (viewTop + viewBottom) / 2 + 10, delta, machineType);
        context.disableScissor();

        int recBtnX = rightX + 6;
        int recBtnY = y + 116;
        context.fill(recBtnX, recBtnY, recBtnX + 22, recBtnY + 22, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(recBtnX + 1, recBtnY + 1, recBtnX + 21, recBtnY + 21, 0xFF35373A);
        drawRecipeBadgeIcon(context, machineType, recipeMode, recBtnX + 3, recBtnY + 3);

        String recipeTitle = this.textRenderer.trimToWidth(getRecipeDisplayName(machineType, recipeMode), 160);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, recipeTitle, rightX + 34, y + 123, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);

        if (machineType != OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_PUMPJACK) {
            int gearX = rightX + rightW - 28;
            int gearY = y + 116;
            boolean hovGear = mouseX >= gearX && mouseX <= gearX + 22 && mouseY >= gearY && mouseY <= gearY + 22;
            context.fill(gearX, gearY, gearX + 22, gearY + 22, 0xFF141414);
            context.fill(gearX + 1, gearY + 1, gearX + 21, gearY + 21, hovGear ? 0xFFE59524 : 0xFF383A3D);
            drawGearIcon(context, gearX + 3, gearY + 3, hovGear ? 0xFF141414 : 0xFFE6E6E6);
        }

        int slotRowY = y + 143;

        if (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_REFINERY) {
            drawSlotFrame(context, rightX + 6, slotRowY);
            drawFluidDropIcon(context, rightX + 7, slotRowY + 1, 0xFF18181E, 0xFF484852);
            if (recipeMode >= 1) {
                drawSlotFrame(context, rightX + 25, slotRowY);
                drawFluidDropIcon(context, rightX + 26, slotRowY + 1, 0xFF1E88E5, 0xFF80D8FF);
            }
            if (recipeMode == 2) {
                drawSlotFrame(context, x + 216, slotRowY);
                if (handler.getSlot(0).getStack().isEmpty()) {
                    context.drawItem(new ItemStack(Items.COAL), x + 217, slotRowY + 1);
                    context.fill(x + 217, slotRowY + 1, x + 233, slotRowY + 17, 0x883A1818);
                }
            }
        } else if (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_CHEM_PLANT) {
            drawSlotFrame(context, rightX + 6, slotRowY);
            if (recipeMode == 0 || recipeMode == 4 || recipeMode == 5) {
                drawFluidDropIcon(context, rightX + 7, slotRowY + 1, 0xFFB03A2E, 0xFFF1948A);
            } else if (recipeMode == 1 || recipeMode == 3) {
                drawFluidDropIcon(context, rightX + 7, slotRowY + 1, 0xFFD68910, 0xFFF8C471);
            } else if (recipeMode == 2 || recipeMode == 7 || recipeMode == 8) {
                drawGasMoleculeIcon(context, rightX + 7, slotRowY + 1);
            } else if (recipeMode == 9) {
                drawFluidDropIcon(context, rightX + 7, slotRowY + 1, 0xFFD4AC0D, 0xFFFFF176);
            } else {
                drawFluidDropIcon(context, rightX + 7, slotRowY + 1, 0xFF1E88E5, 0xFF80D8FF);
            }

            if (recipeMode == 0 || recipeMode == 1 || recipeMode == 8) {
                drawSlotFrame(context, rightX + 25, slotRowY);
                drawFluidDropIcon(context, rightX + 26, slotRowY + 1, 0xFF1E88E5, 0xFF80D8FF);
            }

            if (recipeMode == 6 || recipeMode == 7 || recipeMode == 9 || recipeMode == 10) {
                drawSlotFrame(context, x + 216, slotRowY);
                if (handler.getSlot(0).getStack().isEmpty()) {
                    ItemStack g0 = switch (recipeMode) {
                        case 6, 10 -> new ItemStack(ModItems.SULFUR);
                        case 7 -> new ItemStack(Items.COAL);
                        default -> new ItemStack(Items.IRON_INGOT);
                    };
                    context.drawItem(g0, x + 217, slotRowY + 1);
                    context.fill(x + 217, slotRowY + 1, x + 233, slotRowY + 17, 0x883A1818);
                }
            }
            if (recipeMode == 6 || recipeMode == 9 || recipeMode == 10) {
                drawSlotFrame(context, x + 235, slotRowY);
                if (handler.getSlot(1).getStack().isEmpty()) {
                    ItemStack g1 = switch (recipeMode) {
                        case 6 -> new ItemStack(Items.IRON_INGOT);
                        case 9 -> new ItemStack(Items.COPPER_INGOT);
                        default -> new ItemStack(Items.COAL);
                    };
                    context.drawItem(g1, x + 236, slotRowY + 1);
                    context.fill(x + 236, slotRowY + 1, x + 252, slotRowY + 17, 0x883A1818);
                }
            }
        } else {
            drawSlotFrame(context, rightX + 6, slotRowY);
            drawFluidDropIcon(context, rightX + 7, slotRowY + 1, 0xFF18181E, 0xFF484852);
        }

        int barX = rightX + 66;
        int barY = y + 146;
        int barW = (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_REFINERY && recipeMode >= 1) ? 94 : 132;
        int barH = 12;
        context.fill(barX, barY, barX + barW, barY + barH, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(barX + 1, barY + 1, barX + barW - 1, barY + barH - 1, 0xFF222325);

        float ratio = MathHelper.clamp(handler.getProgress() / (float) handler.getMaxProgress(), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        int fillW = Math.round(ratio * (barW - 2));
        if (fillW > 0) {
            context.fill(barX + 1, barY + 1, barX + 1 + fillW, barY + barH - 1, 0xFF38B828);
            context.fill(barX + 1, barY + 1, barX + 1 + fillW, barY + 4, 0xFF5CE64C);
        }
        String pctStr = Math.round(ratio * 100.0f) + "%";
        int pctW = this.textRenderer.getWidth(pctStr);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, pctStr, barX + barW - pctW - 4, barY + 2, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);

        int outX = rightX + rightW - 24;
        if (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_REFINERY && recipeMode >= 1) {
            drawSlotFrame(context, outX - 38, slotRowY);
            drawFluidDropIcon(context, outX - 37, slotRowY + 1, 0xFFB03A2E, 0xFFF1948A);
            drawSlotFrame(context, outX - 19, slotRowY);
            drawFluidDropIcon(context, outX - 18, slotRowY + 1, 0xFFD68910, 0xFFF8C471);
            drawSlotFrame(context, outX, slotRowY);
            drawGasMoleculeIcon(context, outX + 1, slotRowY + 1);
        } else {
            drawSlotFrame(context, outX, slotRowY);
            if (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_REFINERY) {
                drawGasMoleculeIcon(context, outX + 1, slotRowY + 1);
            } else if (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_PUMPJACK) {
                drawFluidDropIcon(context, outX + 1, slotRowY + 1, 0xFF18181E, 0xFF484852);
            } else if (recipeMode == 0) {
                drawFluidDropIcon(context, outX + 1, slotRowY + 1, 0xFFD68910, 0xFFF8C471);
            } else if (recipeMode == 1) {
                drawGasMoleculeIcon(context, outX + 1, slotRowY + 1);
            } else if (recipeMode == 5) {
                drawFluidDropIcon(context, outX + 1, slotRowY + 1, 0xFF27AE60, 0xFF82E0AA);
            } else if (recipeMode == 6) {
                drawFluidDropIcon(context, outX + 1, slotRowY + 1, 0xFFD4AC0D, 0xFFFFF176);
            } else if (handler.getSlot(2).getStack().isEmpty()) {
                ItemStack ghostOut = switch (recipeMode) {
                    case 2, 3, 4 -> new ItemStack(ModItems.SOLID_FUEL);
                    case 7 -> new ItemStack(ModItems.PLASTIC_BAR);
                    case 8 -> new ItemStack(ModItems.SULFUR);
                    case 9 -> new ItemStack(ModItems.BATTERY);
                    default -> new ItemStack(ModItems.EXPLOSIVES);
                };
                context.drawItem(ghostOut, outX + 1, slotRowY + 1);
                context.fill(outX + 1, slotRowY + 1, outX + 17, slotRowY + 17, 0x8828292C);
            }
        }

        context.fill(rightX + 4, y + 168, rightX + rightW - 4, y + 169, 0xFF1A1B1C);
        context.fill(rightX + 4, y + 169, rightX + rightW - 4, y + 170, 0xFF3A3C3F);
        for (int m = 0; m < 3; m++) {
            drawGhostSlot(context, rightX + 6 + m * 19, y + 174);
        }
        for (int gy = y + 198; gy <= y + 210; gy += 4) {
            context.fill(rightX + 6, gy, rightX + rightW - 6, gy + 1, 0xFF202123);
        }
    }

    private String getRecipeDisplayName(int machineType, int recipeMode) {
        if (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_REFINERY) {
            return Text.translatable("recipe.factoriocore.refinery." + recipeMode).getString();
        } else if (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_CHEM_PLANT) {
            return Text.translatable("recipe.factoriocore.chem." + recipeMode).getString();
        }
        return Text.translatable("recipe.factoriocore.pumpjack").getString();
    }

    private void drawRecipeBadgeIcon(DrawContext context, int machineType, int mode, int ix, int iy) {
        if (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_REFINERY) {
            if (mode == 0) {
                drawFluidDropIcon(context, ix, iy - 2, 0xFF141418, 0xFF555560);
                drawSmallMolecule(context, ix + 8, iy + 11);
            } else if (mode == 1) {
                drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 3, iy + 1, 0xFF29B6F6);
                drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 9, iy + 1, 0xFF222228);
                drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 1, iy + 9, 0xFFB03A2E);
                drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 6, iy + 9, 0xFF8E44AD);
                drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 11, iy + 9, 0xFFD68910);
            } else {
                context.drawItem(new ItemStack(Items.COAL), ix, iy - 1);
                drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 6, iy + 8, 0xFFB03A2E);
            }
        } else if (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_CHEM_PLANT) {
            switch (mode) {
                case 0 -> {
                    drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 6, iy + 1, 0xFFB03A2E);
                    drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 2, iy + 9, 0xFFD68910);
                    drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 10, iy + 9, 0xFFD68910);
                }
                case 1 -> {
                    drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 6, iy + 1, 0xFFD68910);
                    drawSmallMolecule(context, ix + 1, iy + 10);
                    drawSmallMolecule(context, ix + 8, iy + 10);
                }
                case 2 -> {
                    context.drawItem(new ItemStack(ModItems.SOLID_FUEL), ix, iy);
                    drawSmallMolecule(context, ix + 1, iy + 1);
                }
                case 3 -> {
                    context.drawItem(new ItemStack(ModItems.SOLID_FUEL), ix, iy);
                    drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 1, iy + 1, 0xFFD68910);
                }
                case 4 -> {
                    context.drawItem(new ItemStack(ModItems.SOLID_FUEL), ix, iy);
                    drawMiniDrop(context, ix + 1, iy + 1, 0xFFB03A2E);
                }
                case 5 -> drawFluidDropIcon(context, ix, iy, 0xFF27AE60, 0xFF82E0AA);
                case 6 -> drawFluidDropIcon(context, ix, iy, 0xFFD4AC0D, 0xFFFFF176);
                case 7 -> context.drawItem(new ItemStack(ModItems.PLASTIC_BAR), ix, iy);
                case 8 -> context.drawItem(new ItemStack(ModItems.SULFUR), ix, iy);
                case 9 -> context.drawItem(new ItemStack(ModItems.BATTERY), ix, iy);
                default -> context.drawItem(new ItemStack(ModItems.EXPLOSIVES), ix, iy);
            }
        } else {
            drawFluidDropIcon(context, ix, iy, 0xFF141418, 0xFF555560);
        }
    }

    private void drawFluidDropIcon(DrawContext context, int x, int y, int bodyCol, int highlightCol) {
        context.fill(x + 7, y + 2, x + 9, y + 4, bodyCol);
        context.fill(x + 6, y + 4, x + 10, y + 6, bodyCol);
        context.fill(x + 5, y + 6, x + 11, y + 8, bodyCol);
        context.fill(x + 4, y + 8, x + 12, y + 12, bodyCol);
        context.fill(x + 5, y + 12, x + 11, y + 14, bodyCol);
        context.fill(x + 6, y + 7, x + 7, y + 11, highlightCol);
    }

    private void drawMiniDrop(DrawContext context, int x, int y, int col) {
        context.fill(x + 1, y, x + 3, y + 2, col);
        context.fill(x, y + 2, x + 4, y + 5, col);
        context.fill(x + 1, y + 5, x + 3, y + 6, col);
    }

    private void drawGasMoleculeIcon(DrawContext context, int x, int y) {
        context.fill(x + 5, y + 3, x + 11, y + 8, 0xFF424248);
        context.fill(x + 2, y + 7, x + 7, y + 13, 0xFF8E24AA);
        context.fill(x + 9, y + 7, x + 14, y + 13, 0xFF8E24AA);
        context.fill(x + 3, y + 8, x + 5, y + 10, 0xFFE1BEE7);
        context.fill(x + 10, y + 8, x + 12, y + 10, 0xFFE1BEE7);
    }

    private void drawSmallMolecule(DrawContext context, int x, int y) {
        context.fill(x, y, x + 3, y + 3, 0xFFE0E0E0);
        context.fill(x + 3, y - 1, x + 6, y + 2, 0xFF555555);
        context.fill(x + 5, y + 1, x + 8, y + 4, 0xFFE0E0E0);
    }

    private void renderMachine3DPreview(DrawContext context, int centerX, int centerY, float delta, int machineType) {
        MinecraftClient client = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        MatrixStack matrices = context.getMatrices();

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(centerX, centerY + 8, 150.0f);
        float scale = (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_REFINERY) ? (this.previewZoom * 0.65f) : this.previewZoom;
        matrices.scale(scale, -scale, scale);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(this.previewPitch));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(this.previewYaw));
        matrices.translate(-0.5f, -1.1f, -0.5f);

        if (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_REFINERY) {
            OilMachinesRenderer.RefineryRenderer.renderRefineryModel(
                    matrices, context.getVertexConsumers(),
                    LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE, OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV, handler.isWorking());
        } else if (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_CHEM_PLANT) {
            OilMachinesRenderer.ChemicalPlantRenderer.renderChemicalPlantModel(
                    matrices, context.getVertexConsumers(),
                    LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE, OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV);
        } else {
            float angle = (handler.isWorking() && client.world != null)
                    ? (float) Math.sin((client.world.getTime() + delta) * 0.2f) * 22.0f : 0.0f;
            OilMachinesRenderer.PumpjackRenderer.renderPumpjackModel(
                    matrices, context.getVertexConsumers(),
                    LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE, OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV, angle);
        }

        matrices.pop();
        context.draw();
    }

    private void drawSlotFrame(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy) {
        context.fill(sx, sy, sx + 18, sy + 18, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 1, sx + 17, sy + 17, 0xFF3A3C3E);
    }

    private void drawGhostSlot(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy) {
        context.fill(sx, sy, sx + 18, sy + 18, 0xFF1A1B1C);
        context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 1, sx + 17, sy + 17, 0xFF222325);
    }

    private void drawCheckerboard(DrawContext context, int left, int top, int right, int bottom, int cellSize) {
        for (int py = top; py < bottom; py += cellSize) {
            for (int px = left; px < right; px += cellSize) {
                int gx = (px - left) / cellSize;
                int gy = (py - top) / cellSize;
                int color = ((gx + gy) % 2 == 0) ? 0xFF262729 : 0xFF2E3032;
                context.fill(px, py, Math.min(px + cellSize, right), Math.min(py + cellSize, bottom), color);
            }
        }
    }

    private void drawGearIcon(DrawContext context, int gx, int gy, int col) {
        context.fill(gx + 4, gy + 2, gx + 12, gy + 14, col);
        context.fill(gx + 2, gy + 4, gx + 14, gy + 12, col);
        context.fill(gx + 6, gy + 6, gx + 10, gy + 10, 0xFF141414);
    }

    private boolean isInsidePreviewViewport(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        int rightX = x + 192;
        return mouseX >= rightX + 6 && mouseX <= rightX + 226 && mouseY >= y + 34 && mouseY <= y + 110;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        if (!recipeSelectionMode && isInsidePreviewViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.previewZoom = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewZoom + (float) verticalAmount * 1.5f, 6.0f, 26.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mouseX, mouseY, horizontalAmount, verticalAmount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;

        if (mouseX >= x + backgroundWidth - 17 && mouseX <= x + backgroundWidth - 4 && mouseY >= y + 4 && mouseY <= y + 16) {
            if (recipeSelectionMode) {
                setRecipeSelectionMode(false);
            } else {
                this.close();
            }
            return true;
        }

        if (recipeSelectionMode) {
            int gridX = x + 14;
            int gridY = y + 26;
            int slotSize = 26;
            int machineType = handler.getMachineType();
            int totalRecipes = (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_CHEM_PLANT) ? 11 : 3;

            for (int m = 0; m < totalRecipes; m++) {
                int col = (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_CHEM_PLANT && m >= 7) ? (m - 7) : m;
                int row = (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_CHEM_PLANT && m >= 7) ? 1 : 0;
                int sx = gridX + col * slotSize;
                int sy = gridY + row * slotSize;

                if (mouseX >= sx && mouseX < sx + slotSize - 2 && mouseY >= sy && mouseY < sy + slotSize - 2) {
                    if (this.client != null && this.client.interactionManager != null) {
                        this.client.interactionManager.clickButton(this.handler.syncId, m);
                    }
                    if (this.client != null && this.client.player != null) {
                        this.client.player.playSound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), 0.4f, 1.2f);
                    }
                    setRecipeSelectionMode(false);
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        if ((button == 0 || button == 1) && isInsidePreviewViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.draggingPreview = true;
            return true;
        }

        if (handler.getMachineType() != OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_PUMPJACK) {
            int rightX = x + 192;
            int rightW = 232;
            int recBtnX = rightX + 6;
            int gearX = rightX + rightW - 28;
            if ((mouseX >= recBtnX && mouseX <= recBtnX + 22 && mouseY >= y + 116 && mouseY <= y + 138)
                    || (mouseX >= gearX && mouseX <= gearX + 22 && mouseY >= y + 116 && mouseY <= y + 138)) {
                setRecipeSelectionMode(true);
                if (this.client != null && this.client.player != null) {
                    this.client.player.playSound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), 0.4f, 1.15f);
                }
                return true;
            }
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        this.draggingPreview = false;
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.draggingPreview) {
            this.previewYaw += (float) deltaX * 1.5f;
            this.previewPitch = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewPitch + (float) deltaY * 1.5f, -80.0f, 80.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        this.handler.setSlotsVisible(!this.recipeSelectionMode);
        super.render(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);

        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        int machineType = handler.getMachineType();
        int recipeMode = handler.getRecipeMode();

        if (recipeSelectionMode) {
            int gridX = x + 14;
            int gridY = y + 26;
            int slotSize = 26;
            int totalRecipes = (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_CHEM_PLANT) ? 11 : 3;

            for (int m = 0; m < totalRecipes; m++) {
                int col = (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_CHEM_PLANT && m >= 7) ? (m - 7) : m;
                int row = (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_CHEM_PLANT && m >= 7) ? 1 : 0;
                int sx = gridX + col * slotSize;
                int sy = gridY + row * slotSize;

                if (mouseX >= sx && mouseX < sx + slotSize - 2 && mouseY >= sy && mouseY < sy + slotSize - 2) {
                    context.drawTooltip(this.textRenderer, List.of(
                            Text.literal(getRecipeDisplayName(machineType, m)).formatted(Formatting.GOLD),
                            Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.click_to_select_recipe").formatted(Formatting.GRAY)
                    ), mouseX, mouseY);
                }
            }
            return;
        }

        int rightX = x + 192;
        int slotRowY = y + 143;
        int outX = rightX + 232 - 24;
        String mb = Text.translatableWithFallback("unit.factoriocore.mb", "mB").getString();
        String outTag = Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.info.output_tag").getString();

        if (machineType == OilMachineScreenHandler.TYPE_REFINERY && recipeMode >= 1) {
            if (mouseX >= outX - 38 && mouseX < outX - 20 && mouseY >= slotRowY && mouseY < slotRowY + 18) {
                context.drawTooltip(this.textRenderer, List.of(
                        Text.literal(FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind.HEAVY_OIL.getLocalizedName() + outTag).formatted(Formatting.RED),
                        Text.literal(handler.getFluid3Mb() + " / 4000 " + mb).formatted(Formatting.WHITE)
                ), mouseX, mouseY);
                return;
            }
            if (mouseX >= outX - 19 && mouseX < outX - 1 && mouseY >= slotRowY && mouseY < slotRowY + 18) {
                context.drawTooltip(this.textRenderer, List.of(
                        Text.literal(FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind.LIGHT_OIL.getLocalizedName() + outTag).formatted(Formatting.GOLD),
                        Text.literal(handler.getFluid4Mb() + " / 4000 " + mb).formatted(Formatting.WHITE)
                ), mouseX, mouseY);
                return;
            }
            if (mouseX >= outX && mouseX < outX + 18 && mouseY >= slotRowY && mouseY < slotRowY + 18) {
                context.drawTooltip(this.textRenderer, List.of(
                        Text.literal(FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind.PETROLEUM_GAS.getLocalizedName() + outTag).formatted(Formatting.LIGHT_PURPLE),
                        Text.literal(handler.getFluid5Mb() + " / 4000 " + mb).formatted(Formatting.WHITE)
                ), mouseX, mouseY);
                return;
            }
        }

        drawMouseoverTooltip(context, mouseX, mouseY);
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.client.sound;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.config.FactorioConfig;

import net.minecraft.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.block.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundCategory;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundEvent;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundEvents;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class FactorioSoundController {

    private static final Map<Long, Long> LAST_PLAYED_TICK = new HashMap<>();

    public static boolean hasCustomSoundLoaded(MinecraftClient client, SoundEvent customEvent) {
        return client.getSoundManager().get(customEvent.getId()) != null;
    }

    public static void playUiClick(MinecraftClient client) {
        if (client.player == null) return;
        if (hasCustomSoundLoaded(client, ModSounds.GUI_CLICK)) {
            client.player.playSound(ModSounds.GUI_CLICK, 0.5f, 1.0f);
        } else {
            client.player.playSound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), 0.35f, 1.15f);
        }
    }

    public static void tickClient(MinecraftClient client) {
        if (client.world == null || client.player == null || client.isPaused()) return;
        if (!FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.enableMachineSounds || FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.machineSoundVolume <= 0.01f) {
            return;
        }

        long now = client.world.getTime();
        if ((now & 3L) != 0L) return; // Ð¡ÐºÐ°Ð½Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÐ¼ Ñ€Ð°Ð· Ð² 4 Ñ‚Ð¸ÐºÐ° (0.2 ÑÐµÐº) Ð´Ð»Ñ Ð¸Ð´ÐµÐ°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ FPS

        BlockPos playerPos = client.player.getBlockPos();
        float masterVol = FactorioConfig.INSTANCE.machineSoundVolume;
        int radius = 14;

        for (int dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -radius; dz <= radius; dz++) {
                for (int dy = -3; dy <= 3; dy++) {
                    BlockPos pos = playerPos.add(dx, dy, dz);
                    BlockState state = client.world.getBlockState(pos);
                    if (state.isAir()) continue;
                    Block block = state.getBlock();

                    if (block instanceof AssemblerBlock && state.get(AssemblerBlock.PART) == 4 && !state.get(AssemblerBlock.UPPER)) {
                        if (client.world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof AssemblerBlockEntity asm && asm.isWorking()) {
                            tryPlayLoop(client, pos, now, 32, ModSounds.ASSEMBLER, SoundEvents.BLOCK_PISTON_EXTEND, 0.35f * masterVol, 1.25f);
                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof BurnerDrillBlock && state.get(BurnerDrillBlock.PART) == 0 && !state.get(BurnerDrillBlock.UPPER)) {
                        if (client.world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof BurnerDrillBlockEntity drill && drill.isWorking()) {
                            tryPlayLoop(client, pos, now, 28, ModSounds.BURNER_DRILL, SoundEvents.BLOCK_GRINDSTONE_USE, 0.40f * masterVol, 0.75f);
                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof ElectricDrillBlock && state.get(ElectricDrillBlock.PART) == 4 && !state.get(ElectricDrillBlock.UPPER)) {
                        if (client.world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof ElectricDrillBlockEntity edrill && edrill.isActivelyMining()) {
                            tryPlayLoop(client, pos, now, 28, ModSounds.ELECTRIC_DRILL, SoundEvents.BLOCK_GRINDSTONE_USE, 0.35f * masterVol, 1.15f);
                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlock && state.get(FactorioFurnaceBlock.PART) == 0 && !state.get(FactorioFurnaceBlock.UPPER)) {
                        if (client.world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity furnace && furnace.isBurning()) {
                            tryPlayLoop(client, pos, now, 36, ModSounds.FURNACE, SoundEvents.BLOCK_BLASTFURNACE_FIRE_CRACKLE, 0.65f * masterVol, 0.95f);
                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof BoilerBlock && state.get(BoilerBlock.PART) == 1 && !state.get(BoilerBlock.UPPER)) {
                        if (client.world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof BoilerBlockEntity boiler && boiler.isBurning()) {
                            tryPlayLoop(client, pos, now, 36, ModSounds.BOILER, SoundEvents.BLOCK_FURNACE_FIRE_CRACKLE, 0.60f * masterVol, 0.85f);
                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof SteamEngineBlock && state.get(SteamEngineBlock.PART) == 1 && state.get(SteamEngineBlock.LAYER) == 0) {
                        if (client.world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof SteamEngineBlockEntity eng && eng.isGeneratingPower()) {
                            tryPlayLoop(client, pos, now, 24, ModSounds.STEAM_ENGINE, SoundEvents.BLOCK_CAMPFIRE_CRACKLE, 0.45f * masterVol, 1.35f);
                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof OilMachines.PumpjackBlock && state.get(OilMachines.PumpjackBlock.PART) == 4 && !state.get(OilMachines.PumpjackBlock.UPPER)) {
                        if (client.world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof OilMachines.PumpjackBlockEntity pj && pj.isWorking()) {
                            tryPlayLoop(client, pos, now, 32, ModSounds.PUMPJACK, SoundEvents.BLOCK_PISTON_CONTRACT, 0.40f * masterVol, 0.70f);
                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof OilMachines.OilRefineryBlock && state.get(OilMachines.OilRefineryBlock.PART) == 4 && !state.get(OilMachines.OilRefineryBlock.UPPER)) {
                        if (client.world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof OilMachines.OilRefineryBlockEntity ref && ref.isWorking()) {
                            tryPlayLoop(client, pos, now, 36, ModSounds.OIL_REFINERY, SoundEvents.BLOCK_BLASTFURNACE_FIRE_CRACKLE, 0.55f * masterVol, 0.80f);
                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof OilMachines.ChemicalPlantBlock && state.get(OilMachines.ChemicalPlantBlock.PART) == 4 && !state.get(OilMachines.ChemicalPlantBlock.UPPER)) {
                        if (client.world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof OilMachines.ChemicalPlantBlockEntity cp && cp.isWorking()) {
                            tryPlayLoop(client, pos, now, 32, ModSounds.CHEMICAL_PLANT, SoundEvents.BLOCK_BREWING_STAND_BREW, 0.45f * masterVol, 1.05f);
                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof LabBlock && state.get(LabBlock.PART) == 4 && !state.get(LabBlock.UPPER)) {
                        if (client.world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof LabBlockEntity lab && lab.isWorking()) {
                            tryPlayLoop(client, pos, now, 36, ModSounds.LAB, SoundEvents.BLOCK_BEACON_AMBIENT, 0.45f * masterVol, 1.40f);
                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof InserterBlock) {
                        if (client.world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof InserterBlockEntity ins && !ins.getHeldStack().isEmpty()) {
                            tryPlayLoop(client, pos, now, 16, ModSounds.INSERTER, SoundEvents.BLOCK_DISPENSER_DISPENSE, 0.22f * masterVol, 1.45f);
                        }
                    } else if (block instanceof BeltBlock) {
                        if (client.world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof BeltBlockEntity belt
                                && (!belt.getLeftLane().isEmpty() || !belt.getRightLane().isEmpty())) {
                            tryPlayLoop(client, pos, now, 40, ModSounds.BELT, SoundEvents.BLOCK_WOOL_STEP, 0.14f * masterVol, 0.65f);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (LAST_PLAYED_TICK.size() > 512) {
            LAST_PLAYED_TICK.entrySet().removeIf(e -> now - e.getValue() > 100L);
        }
    }

    private static void tryPlayLoop(MinecraftClient client, BlockPos pos, long now, int cooldownTicks,
                                    SoundEvent factorioSound, SoundEvent vanillaFallback,
                                    float volume, float fallbackPitch) {
        long key = pos.asLong();
        long last = LAST_PLAYED_TICK.getOrDefault(key, -1000L);
        if (now - last < cooldownTicks) return;

        LAST_PLAYED_TICK.put(key, now);
        boolean useCustom = hasCustomSoundLoaded(client, factorioSound);
        SoundEvent toPlay = useCustom ? factorioSound : vanillaFallback;
        float pitch = useCustom ? 1.0f : fallbackPitch;

        client.world.playSound(
                pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.5, pos.getZ() + 0.5,
                toPlay, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, volume, pitch, false
        );
    }
}

    public static String autoDetectFactorioDataPath() {
        List<String> candidates = new ArrayList<>(List.of(
                "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Steam\\steamapps\\common\\Factorio\\data",
                "C:\\Program Files\\Steam\\steamapps\\common\\Factorio\\data",
                "D:\\SteamLibrary\\steamapps\\common\\Factorio\\data",

                "D:\\Games\\Factorio\\data",
                "C:\\Program Files\\Factorio\\data",
                "C:\\GOG Games\\Factorio\\data"
        ));

        for (String pathStr : candidates) {
            Path p = Paths.get(pathStr);
            if (Files.isDirectory(p) && (Files.isDirectory(p.resolve("base")) || Files.isDirectory(p.resolve("core")))) {
                return p.toAbsolutePath().toString();

        }
        return "";
    }

    public static String buildAndActivateResourcePack(String rawInputPath) {
        if (rawInputPath == null || rawInputPath.isBlank()) {
            return "Â§cÐ£ÐºÐ°Ð¶Ð¸Ñ‚Ðµ Ð¿ÑƒÑ‚ÑŒ Ðº Ð¿Ð°Ð¿ÐºÐµ Factorio/data!";
        }

        Path inputPath = Paths.get(rawInputPath.trim().replace("\"", ""));
        if (Files.isDirectory(inputPath.resolve("data"))) {
            inputPath = inputPath.resolve("data");
        }
        if (!Files.isDirectory(inputPath)) {
            return "Â§cÐŸÐ°Ð¿ÐºÐ° Ð½Ðµ Ð½Ð°Ð¹Ð´ÐµÐ½Ð°: " + inputPath;
        }

        Map<String, Path> foundOggFiles = new HashMap<>();
        try (Stream<Path> walk = Files.walk(inputPath, 6)) {
            walk.filter(Files::isRegularFile)
                    .filter(p -> p.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).endsWith(".ogg"))
                    .forEach(p -> foundOggFiles.putIfAbsent(p.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), p));
        } catch (IOException e) {
            return "Â§cÐžÑˆÐ¸Ð±ÐºÐ° Ñ‡Ñ‚ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ñ Ð¿Ð°Ð¿ÐºÐ¸: " + e.getMessage();
        }

        if (foundOggFiles.isEmpty()) {
            return "Â§cÐ’ ÑƒÐºÐ°Ð·Ð°Ð½Ð½Ð¾Ð¹ Ð¿Ð°Ð¿ÐºÐµ Ð½Ðµ Ð½Ð°Ð¹Ð´ÐµÐ½Ð¾ Ð½Ð¸ Ð¾Ð´Ð½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ .ogg Ñ„Ð°Ð¹Ð»Ð°!";
        }

        Path gameDir = FabricLoader.getInstance().getGameDir();
        Path packRoot = gameDir.resolve("resourcepacks").resolve(PACK_FOLDER_NAME);
        Path soundsDir = packRoot.resolve("assets").resolve(FactorioCore.MOD_ID).resolve("sounds");

        try {
            Files.createDirectories(soundsDir);

            // 1. Ð—Ð°Ð¿Ð¸ÑÑ‹Ð²Ð°ÐµÐ¼ pack.mcmeta (pack_format 34 Ð´Ð»Ñ Minecraft 1.21.1)
            JsonObject packMeta = new JsonObject();
            JsonObject packSection = new JsonObject();
            packSection.addProperty("pack_format", 34);
            packSection.addProperty("description", "Official Factorio Audio (Local User Import)");
            packMeta.add("pack", packSection);
            Files.writeString(packRoot.resolve("pack.mcmeta"), GSON.toJson(packMeta), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

            // 2. ÐšÐ¾Ð¿Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÐ¼ Ð½Ð°Ð¹Ð´ÐµÐ½Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ .ogg Ð¸ Ñ„Ð¾Ñ€Ð¼Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÐ¼ sounds.json
            JsonObject soundsJson = new JsonObject();
            int copiedCount = 0;

            for (Map.Entry<String, List<String>> entry : SOUND_MAPPINGS.entrySet()) {
                String soundEventKey = entry.getKey();
                Path matchedOgg = findBestOggMatch(foundOggFiles, entry.getValue());
                if (matchedOgg == null) continue;

                String targetFileName = soundEventKey + ".ogg";
                Files.copy(matchedOgg, soundsDir.resolve(targetFileName), StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
                copiedCount++;

                JsonObject eventObj = new JsonObject();
                eventObj.addProperty("subtitle", "subtitles.factoriocore." + soundEventKey);
                JsonArray soundsArr = new JsonArray();
                soundsArr.add(FactorioCore.MOD_ID + ":" + soundEventKey);
                eventObj.add("sounds", soundsArr);
                soundsJson.add(soundEventKey, eventObj);
            }

            if (copiedCount == 0) {
                return "Â§cÐÐ°Ð¹Ð´ÐµÐ½Ñ‹ .ogg Ñ„Ð°Ð¹Ð»Ñ‹, Ð½Ð¾ Ð¸Ð¼ÐµÐ½Ð° Ð½Ðµ ÑÐ¾Ð²Ð¿Ð°Ð»Ð¸ Ñ Factorio/data/base/sound!";
            }

            Path soundsJsonPath = packRoot.resolve("assets").resolve(FactorioCore.MOD_ID).resolve("sounds.json");
            Files.writeString(soundsJsonPath, GSON.toJson(soundsJson), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

            // 3. ÐÐ²Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¼Ð°Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ‡ÐµÑÐºÐ¸ Ð°ÐºÑ‚Ð¸Ð²Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÐ¼ Ñ€ÐµÑÑƒÑ€ÑÐ¿Ð°Ðº Ð² ÐºÐ»Ð¸ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ðµ Ð¸ Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ·Ð°Ð³Ñ€ÑƒÐ¶Ð°ÐµÐ¼ Ñ€ÐµÑÑƒÑ€ÑÑ‹!
            MinecraftClient client = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
            ResourcePackManager packManager = client.getResourcePackManager();
            packManager.scanPacks();

            String packProfileId = "file/" + PACK_FOLDER_NAME;
            List<String> enabled = new ArrayList<>(packManager.getEnabledIds());
            if (!enabled.contains(packProfileId)) {
                enabled.add(packProfileId);
                packManager.setEnabledProfiles(enabled);
                client.options.resourcePacks.add(packProfileId);
                client.options.write();
            }
            client.reloadResources();

            return "Â§aÐ£ÑÐ¿ÐµÑ…! Ð˜Ð¼Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ€Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¾ Ð·Ð²ÑƒÐºÐ¾Ð²: " + copiedCount + ". Ð ÐµÑÑƒÑ€ÑÐ¿Ð°Ðº Ð²ÐºÐ»ÑŽÑ‡Ñ‘Ð½!";
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
            return "Â§cÐžÑˆÐ¸Ð±ÐºÐ° ÑÐ±Ð¾Ñ€ÐºÐ¸ Ñ€ÐµÑÑƒÑ€ÑÐ¿Ð°ÐºÐ°: " + e.getMessage();
        }
    }

    private static Path findBestOggMatch(Map<String, Path> index, List<String> candidates) {
        for (String cand : candidates) {
            Path exact = index.get(cand.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
            if (exact != null) return exact;
        }
        for (String cand : candidates) {
            String prefix = cand.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).replace(".ogg", "").replace("-1", "");
            for (Map.Entry<String, Path> e : index.entrySet()) {
                if (e.getKey().startsWith(prefix)) {
                    return e.getValue();
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private void rebuildMapPreview() {
        int half = MAP_RES / 2;
        int centerBlockX = (int) Math.round(this.mapPanX);
        int centerBlockZ = (int) Math.round(this.mapPanZ);

        for (int gz = 0; gz < MAP_RES; gz++) {
            int wz = centerBlockZ + (gz - half) * this.mapZoom;
            int rowOff = gz * MAP_RES;
            for (int gx = 0; gx < MAP_RES; gx++) {
                int wx = centerBlockX + (gx - half) * this.mapZoom;
                previewPixels[rowOff + gx] = samplePreviewColorAt(wx, wz, this.mapZoom);
            }
        }
        this.mapDirty = false;
    }
