        int lblW = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(seedLbl) * 0.68f);
        int seedBoxW = 64;
        int randBtnX = x + LEFT_W - 20;
        int seedBoxX = randBtnX - seedBoxW - 2;
        drawScaledText(context, seedLbl, seedBoxX - lblW - 4, topRowY + 4, 0.68f, 0xFFCCCCCC, false);

        context.fill(seedBoxX, topRowY, seedBoxX + seedBoxW, topRowY + 14, this.editingSeed ? 0xFFE59524 : 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(seedBoxX + 1, topRowY + 1, seedBoxX + seedBoxW - 1, topRowY + 13, 0xFF8C8E92);
        String shownSeed = this.editingSeed ? (this.seedText + "_") : String.valueOf(Math.abs(cfg.worldSeed));
        drawScaledText(context, this.textRenderer.trimToWidth(shownSeed, 78), seedBoxX + 4, topRowY + 4, 0.72f, 0xFF111111, false);

        boolean hovRand = isHovering(mouseX, mouseY, randBtnX, topRowY, 14, 14);
        context.fill(randBtnX, topRowY, randBtnX + 14, topRowY + 14, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(randBtnX + 1, topRowY + 1, randBtnX + 13, topRowY + 13, hovRand ? 0xFFE59524 : 0xFF9EA0A4);
        drawScaledTextCentered(context, "\u2928", randBtnX + 7, topRowY + 3, 0.80f, 0xFF141414, false);

        // ÐŸÐ»Ð°ÑˆÐºÐ° Ð¾Ð¿Ð¸ÑÐ°Ð½Ð¸Ñ Ð²Ñ‹Ð±Ñ€Ð°Ð½Ð½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÑÐµÑ‚Ð°
        int descBoxY = y + 36;
        context.fill(x + 6, descBoxY, x + LEFT_W - 6, descBoxY + 16, 0xFF1D1E21);
        String presetDesc = Text.translatable(PRESET_DESC_KEYS[cfg.presetIndex % PRESET_DESC_KEYS.length]).getString();
        drawScaledText(context, presetDesc, x + 10, descBoxY + 5, 0.68f, 0xFFCCCCCC, false);

        // 4 Ð’ÐºÐ»Ð°Ð´ÐºÐ¸: [Ð ÐµÑÑƒÑ€ÑÑ‹] [Ð›Ð°Ð½Ð´ÑˆÐ°Ñ„Ñ‚] [Ð’Ñ€Ð°Ð³] [ÐŸÑ€Ð¾Ð´Ð²Ð¸Ð½ÑƒÑ‚Ñ‹Ðµ]
        int tabY = y + 55;
        String[] tabKeys = {
                "gui.factoriocore.nauvis.tab.resources",
                "gui.factoriocore.nauvis.tab.terrain",
                "gui.factoriocore.nauvis.tab.enemy",
                "gui.factoriocore.nauvis.tab.advanced"
        };
        int tabX = x + 6;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            String tName = Text.translatable(tabKeys[i]).getString();
            int tw = Math.max(54, Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(tName) * 0.75f) + 14);
            drawFactorioTab(context, tabX, tabY, tw, 15, tName, mouseX, mouseY, this.currentTab == i);
            tabX += tw + 1;
        }

        // Ð’Ð½ÑƒÑ‚Ñ€ÐµÐ½Ð½ÑÑ Ð¾Ð±Ð»Ð°ÑÑ‚ÑŒ Ð½Ð°ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾ÐµÐº Ð²ÐºÐ»Ð°Ð´ÐºÐ¸
        int bodyX = x + 6;
        int bodyY = y + 70;
        int bodyW = LEFT_W - 12;
        int bodyH = PANEL_H - 98;
        context.fill(bodyX, bodyY, bodyX + bodyW, bodyY + bodyH, 0xFF161719);
        context.fill(bodyX + 1, bodyY + 1, bodyX + bodyW - 1, bodyY + bodyH - 1, 0xFF28292D);

        if (this.currentTab == 0) {
            renderResourcesTab(context, bodyX, bodyY, bodyW, cfg);
        } else if (this.currentTab == 1) {
            renderTerrainTab(context, bodyX, bodyY, bodyW, cfg, mouseX, mouseY);
        } else if (this.currentTab == 2) {
            renderEnemyTab(context, bodyX, bodyY, bodyW, cfg);
        } else {
            renderAdvancedTab(context, bodyX, bodyY, bodyW, cfg, mouseX, mouseY);
        }

        // ÐÐ¸Ð¶Ð½ÑÑ Ð¿Ð°Ð½ÐµÐ»ÑŒ ÐºÐ½Ð¾Ð¿Ð¾Ðº: [ÐÐ°Ð·Ð°Ð´]  [ÐŸÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾ÑÐ¼Ð¾Ñ‚Ñ€]  [Ð˜Ð³Ñ€Ð°Ñ‚ÑŒ (Ð—ÐµÐ»Ñ‘Ð½Ð°Ñ)] (Ð‘Ð•Ð— "ÐÐ°ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ð¹ÐºÐ¸ Ð¼Ð¾Ð´Ð¾Ð²"!)
        int botY = y + PANEL_H - 23;
        drawGrayButton(context, x + 6, botY, 64, 18, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.back").getString(), mouseX, mouseY, false);
        drawGrayButton(context, x + 114, botY, 88, 18, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.preview_btn").getString(), mouseX, mouseY, this.showPreview);
        drawGreenPlayButton(context, x + 206, botY, 92, 18, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.play").getString(), mouseX, mouseY);

        // ÐŸÐ ÐÐ’ÐÐ¯ ÐŸÐÐÐ•Ð›Ð¬: Ð˜Ð½Ñ‚ÐµÑ€Ð°ÐºÑ‚Ð¸Ð²Ð½Ð°Ñ ÐºÐ°Ñ€Ñ‚Ð° Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾ÑÐ¼Ð¾Ñ‚Ñ€Ð° (ÐŸÐšÐœ/Ð›ÐšÐœ â€” Ð¾ÑÐ¼Ð¾Ñ‚Ñ€, ÐšÐ¾Ð»Ñ‘ÑÐ¸ÐºÐ¾ â€” Ð¼Ð°ÑÑˆÑ‚Ð°Ð±)
        if (this.showPreview) {
            int mapBoxX = x + LEFT_W + 4;
            int mapBoxY = y + 21;
            context.fill(x + LEFT_W, y + 18, x + LEFT_W + 1, y + PANEL_H - 2, 0xFF141414);
            context.fill(mapBoxX - 2, mapBoxY - 2, mapBoxX + MAP_SIZE_PX + 2, mapBoxY + MAP_SIZE_PX + 2, 0xFF111214);

            for (int gz = 0; gz < MAP_RES; gz++) {
                int py = mapBoxY + gz * MAP_PX_SCALE;
                int rowOff = gz * MAP_RES;
                for (int gx = 0; gx < MAP_RES; gx++) {
                    int px = mapBoxX + gx * MAP_PX_SCALE;
                    context.fill(px, py, px + MAP_PX_SCALE, py + MAP_PX_SCALE, previewPixels[rowOff + gx]);
                }
            }

            // ÐŸÐµÑ€ÐµÐºÑ€ÐµÑÑ‚Ð¸Ðµ Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ‡ÐºÐ¸ ÑÐ¿Ð°Ð²Ð½Ð° (0, 0) Ñ ÑƒÑ‡Ñ‘Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¼ ÑÐ¼ÐµÑ‰ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ñ ÐºÐ°Ð¼ÐµÑ€Ñ‹ mapPanX / mapPanZ
            int spawnPxX = mapBoxX + MAP_SIZE_PX / 2 - (int) Math.round((this.mapPanX / this.mapZoom) * MAP_PX_SCALE);
            int spawnPxY = mapBoxY + MAP_SIZE_PX / 2 - (int) Math.round((this.mapPanZ / this.mapZoom) * MAP_PX_SCALE);
            if (spawnPxX >= mapBoxX + 3 && spawnPxX <= mapBoxX + MAP_SIZE_PX - 4
                    && spawnPxY >= mapBoxY + 3 && spawnPxY <= mapBoxY + MAP_SIZE_PX - 4) {
                context.fill(spawnPxX - 3, spawnPxY, spawnPxX + 4, spawnPxY + 1, 0xFFFFFFFF);
                context.fill(spawnPxX, spawnPxY - 3, spawnPxX + 1, spawnPxY + 4, 0xFFFFFFFF);
            }

            // Ð’ÐµÑ€Ñ…Ð½Ð¸Ð¹ Ð¾Ð²ÐµÑ€Ð»ÐµÐ¹ Ð¼Ð°ÑÑˆÑ‚Ð°Ð±Ð°: [- ] Zoom 1:4 [ +] [âŒ–]
            context.fill(mapBoxX + 3, mapBoxY + 3, mapBoxX + 96, mapBoxY + 15, 0xD0141414);
            drawScaledTextCentered(context, "-", mapBoxX + 9, mapBoxY + 5, 0.80f, 0xFFFFCC66, false);
            String zoomStr = Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.zoom", String.valueOf(this.mapZoom)).getString();
            drawScaledTextCentered(context, zoomStr, mapBoxX + 43, mapBoxY + 5, 0.70f, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);
            drawScaledTextCentered(context, "+", mapBoxX + 76, mapBoxY + 5, 0.80f, 0xFFFFCC66, false);
            drawScaledTextCentered(context, "\u2316", mapBoxX + 89, mapBoxY + 5, 0.75f, 0xFF80D8FF, false);

            // ÐŸÐ¾Ð´ÑÐºÐ°Ð·ÐºÐ° ÑƒÐ¿Ñ€Ð°Ð²Ð»ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ñ ÐºÐ°Ñ€Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¹ Ð¸ Ð»ÐµÐ³ÐµÐ½Ð´Ð° Ð¿Ð¾Ð´ ÐºÐ°Ñ€Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¹
            int legY = mapBoxY + MAP_SIZE_PX + 4;
            int lx = mapBoxX;
            lx = drawLegendItem(context, lx, legY, 0xFF5B9BD5, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.iron_short").getString());
            lx = drawLegendItem(context, lx, legY, 0xFFED7D31, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.copper_short").getString());
            lx = drawLegendItem(context, lx, legY, 0xFF18181A, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.coal_short").getString());
            lx = drawLegendItem(context, lx, legY, 0xFFD2C290, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.stone_short").getString());
            lx = drawLegendItem(context, lx, legY, 0xFFD81B60, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.oil_short").getString());
            drawLegendItem(context, lx, legY, 0xFFE52424, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.enemy_short").getString());

            String panHint = Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.pan_hint").getString();
            drawScaledTextCentered(context, panHint, mapBoxX + MAP_SIZE_PX / 2, legY + 11, 0.65f, 0xFF999B9F, false);
        }
    }

    private void renderResourcesTab(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw, NauvisConfig cfg) {
        // Ð¨Ð°Ð¿ÐºÐ° ÐºÐ¾Ð»Ð¾Ð½Ð¾Ðº Ñ‚Ð°Ð±Ð»Ð¸Ñ†Ñ‹
        context.fill(bx + 2, by + 2, bx + bw - 2, by + 16, 0xFF202124);
        int col1X = bx + 118;
        int col2X = bx + 176;
        int col3X = bx + 234;
        int sliderW = 52;

        drawColumnHeaderWithInfo(context, col1X + sliderW / 2, by + 5, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.col.freq").getString());
        drawColumnHeaderWithInfo(context, col2X + sliderW / 2, by + 5, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.col.size").getString());
        drawColumnHeaderWithInfo(context, col3X + sliderW / 2, by + 5, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.col.rich").getString());

        int ry = by + 18;
        int rowH = 26;

        drawResourceRow(context, bx, ry, bw, new ItemStack(ModBlocks.IRON_ORE_DEPOSIT),
                Text.translatable("block.factoriocore.iron_ore_deposit").getString(),
                () -> cfg.ironEnabled, v -> cfg.ironEnabled = v,
                () -> cfg.ironFreq, v -> cfg.ironFreq = v,
                () -> cfg.ironSize, v -> cfg.ironSize = v,
                () -> cfg.ironRichness, v -> cfg.ironRichness = v);
        ry += rowH;

        drawResourceRow(context, bx, ry, bw, new ItemStack(ModBlocks.COPPER_ORE_DEPOSIT),
                Text.translatable("block.factoriocore.copper_ore_deposit").getString(),
                () -> cfg.copperEnabled, v -> cfg.copperEnabled = v,
                () -> cfg.copperFreq, v -> cfg.copperFreq = v,
                () -> cfg.copperSize, v -> cfg.copperSize = v,
                () -> cfg.copperRichness, v -> cfg.copperRichness = v);
        ry += rowH;

        drawResourceRow(context, bx, ry, bw, new ItemStack(ModBlocks.STONE_DEPOSIT),
                Text.translatable("block.factoriocore.stone_deposit").getString(),
                () -> cfg.stoneEnabled, v -> cfg.stoneEnabled = v,
                () -> cfg.stoneFreq, v -> cfg.stoneFreq = v,
                () -> cfg.stoneSize, v -> cfg.stoneSize = v,
                () -> cfg.stoneRichness, v -> cfg.stoneRichness = v);
        ry += rowH;

        drawResourceRow(context, bx, ry, bw, new ItemStack(ModBlocks.COAL_DEPOSIT),
                Text.translatable("block.factoriocore.coal_deposit").getString(),
                () -> cfg.coalEnabled, v -> cfg.coalEnabled = v,
                () -> cfg.coalFreq, v -> cfg.coalFreq = v,
                () -> cfg.coalSize, v -> cfg.coalSize = v,
                () -> cfg.coalRichness, v -> cfg.coalRichness = v);
        ry += rowH;

        drawResourceRow(context, bx, ry, bw, new ItemStack(ModBlocks.CRUDE_OIL_DEPOSIT),
                Text.translatable("block.factoriocore.crude_oil_deposit").getString(),
                () -> cfg.oilEnabled, v -> cfg.oilEnabled = v,
                () -> cfg.oilFreq, v -> cfg.oilFreq = v,
                () -> cfg.oilSize, v -> cfg.oilSize = v,
                () -> cfg.oilRichness, v -> cfg.oilRichness = v);
    }

    private void drawResourceRow(DrawContext context, int bx, int ry, int bw, ItemStack icon, String name,
                                 Supplier<Boolean> enGet, Consumer<Boolean> enSet,
                                 Supplier<Float> fGet, Consumer<Float> fSet,
                                 Supplier<Float> sGet, Consumer<Float> sSet,
                                 Supplier<Float> rGet, Consumer<Float> rSet) {
        context.fill(bx + 2, ry, bx + bw - 2, ry + 25, 0xFF232428);
        context.fill(bx + 2, ry + 24, bx + bw - 2, ry + 25, 0xFF18191B);

        // Ð’ÐµÑ€Ñ‚Ð¸ÐºÐ°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ðµ Ñ€Ð°Ð·Ð´ÐµÐ»Ð¸Ñ‚ÐµÐ»Ð¸ ÐºÐ¾Ð»Ð¾Ð½Ð¾Ðº (ÐºÐ°Ðº Ð½Ð° ÑÐºÑ€Ð¸Ð½Ðµ 022049)
        context.fill(bx + 114, ry, bx + 115, ry + 24, 0xFF18191B);
        context.fill(bx + 172, ry, bx + 173, ry + 24, 0xFF18191B);
        context.fill(bx + 230, ry, bx + 231, ry + 24, 0xFF18191B);

        registerAndDrawCheckbox(context, 0, bx + 6, ry + 8, enGet, enSet);

        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(bx + 18, ry + 5, 100.0f);
        context.getMatrices().scale(0.85f, 0.85f, 1.0f);
        context.drawItem(icon, 0, 0);
        context.getMatrices().pop();

        String shortName = this.textRenderer.trimToWidth(name, 110);
        drawScaledText(context, shortName, bx + 34, ry + 9, 0.70f, enGet.get() ? 0xFFE6E6E6 : 0xFF777777, false);

        registerAndDrawNotchedSlider(context, 0, bx + 118, ry + 8, 50, 0.1f, 2.5f, 0.1f, fGet, fSet);
        registerAndDrawNotchedSlider(context, 0, bx + 176, ry + 8, 50, 0.1f, 2.5f, 0.1f, sGet, sSet);
        registerAndDrawNotchedSlider(context, 0, bx + 234, ry + 8, 50, 0.1f, 2.5f, 0.1f, rGet, rSet);
    }

    // Ð’ÐšÐ›ÐÐ”ÐšÐ 1: Ð›ÐÐÐ”Ð¨ÐÐ¤Ð¢ (ÐºÐ°Ðº Ð½Ð° ÑÐºÑ€Ð¸Ð½Ðµ 022052.jpg)
    // =========================================================================
    private void renderTerrainTab(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw, NauvisConfig cfg, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        int ry = by + 3;
        // Ð¡Ñ‚Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÐ° "Ð¢Ð¸Ð¿ ÐºÐ°Ñ€Ñ‚Ñ‹": [Ð£Ñ€Ð¾Ð²ÐµÐ½ÑŒ Ð¼Ð¾Ñ€Ñ ÐºÐ°Ðº Ð½Ð° ÐÐ°ÑƒÐ²Ð¸ÑÐµ / ÐžÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ð² â–¼]
        context.fill(bx + 2, ry, bx + bw - 2, ry + 18, 0xFF232428);
        drawScaledText(context, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.map_type").getString(), bx + 6, ry + 6, 0.72f, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);

        int ddX = bx + 132;
        int ddW = bw - 138;
        boolean hovMapType = isHovering(mouseX, mouseY, ddX, ry + 2, ddW, 14);
        context.fill(ddX, ry + 2, ddX + ddW, ry + 16, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(ddX + 1, ry + 3, ddX + ddW - 1, ry + 15, hovMapType ? 0xFFE59524 : 0xFFD4D6D8);
        String mapTypeStr = Text.translatable(cfg.mapType == 0
                ? "gui.factoriocore.nauvis.map_type.nauvis"
                : "gui.factoriocore.nauvis.map_type.island").getString();
        drawScaledText(context, this.textRenderer.trimToWidth(mapTypeStr, 200), ddX + 5, ry + 6, 0.68f, 0xFF141414, false);
        ry += 20;

        int col1X = bx + 174;
        int col2X = bx + 234;
        int sw = 50;

        // Ð—Ð°Ð³Ð¾Ð»Ð¾Ð²Ð¾Ðº ÑÐµÐºÑ†Ð¸Ð¸ 1: ÐœÐ°ÑÑˆÑ‚Ð°Ð± | ÐŸÐ¾ÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ñ‚Ð¸Ðµ
        context.fill(bx + 2, ry, bx + bw - 2, ry + 12, 0xFF1E1F22);
        drawColumnHeaderWithInfo(context, col1X + sw / 2, ry + 3, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.col.scale").getString());
        drawColumnHeaderWithInfo(context, col2X + sw / 2, ry + 3, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.col.coverage").getString());
        ry += 13;

        drawTwoColTerrainRow(context, bx, ry, bw, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.row.water").getString(),
                () -> cfg.waterEnabled, v -> cfg.waterEnabled = v,
                () -> cfg.waterScale, v -> cfg.waterScale = v, 0.25f, 2.0f,
                () -> cfg.waterCoverage, v -> cfg.waterCoverage = v, 0.0f, 2.0f);
        ry += 19;

        drawTwoColTerrainRow(context, bx, ry, bw, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.row.trees").getString(),
                () -> cfg.treesEnabled, v -> cfg.treesEnabled = v,
                () -> cfg.treeScale, v -> cfg.treeScale = v, 0.25f, 2.0f,
                () -> cfg.treeCoverage, v -> cfg.treeCoverage = v, 0.0f, 2.0f);
        ry += 19;

        drawTwoColTerrainRow(context, bx, ry, bw, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.row.rocks").getString(),
                () -> cfg.rocksEnabled, v -> cfg.rocksEnabled = v,
                () -> cfg.boulderFreq, v -> cfg.boulderFreq = v, 0.0f, 2.0f,
                () -> cfg.boulderSize, v -> cfg.boulderSize = v, 0.25f, 2.0f);
        ry += 20;

        // Ð—Ð°Ð³Ð¾Ð»Ð¾Ð²Ð¾Ðº ÑÐµÐºÑ†Ð¸Ð¸ 2: Ð¡ÐºÐ°Ð»Ñ‹ (Ð§Ð°ÑÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‚Ð° | ÐÐµÐ¿Ñ€ÐµÑ€Ñ‹Ð²Ð½Ð¾ÑÑ‚ÑŒ)
        context.fill(bx + 2, ry, bx + bw - 2, ry + 12, 0xFF1E1F22);
        drawColumnHeaderWithInfo(context, col1X + sw / 2, ry + 3, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.col.freq").getString());
        drawColumnHeaderWithInfo(context, col2X + sw / 2, ry + 3, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.col.continuity").getString());
        ry += 13;

        drawTwoColTerrainRow(context, bx, ry, bw, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.row.cliffs").getString(),
                () -> cfg.cliffsEnabled, v -> cfg.cliffsEnabled = v,
                () -> cfg.cliffFreq, v -> cfg.cliffFreq = v, 0.0f, 2.0f,
                () -> cfg.cliffContinuity, v -> cfg.cliffContinuity = v, 0.25f, 2.0f);
        ry += 20;

        // Ð—Ð°Ð³Ð¾Ð»Ð¾Ð²Ð¾Ðº ÑÐµÐºÑ†Ð¸Ð¸ 3: ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ð¼Ð°Ñ‚ (ÐœÐ°ÑÑˆÑ‚Ð°Ð± | Ð—Ð½Ð°Ñ‡ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ðµ)
        context.fill(bx + 2, ry, bx + bw - 2, ry + 12, 0xFF1E1F22);
        drawColumnHeaderWithInfo(context, col1X + sw / 2, ry + 3, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.col.scale").getString());
        drawColumnHeaderWithInfo(context, col2X + sw / 2, ry + 3, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.col.bias").getString());
        ry += 13;

        drawTwoColTerrainRow(context, bx, ry, bw, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.row.moisture").getString(),
                null, null,
                () -> cfg.moistureScale, v -> cfg.moistureScale = v, 0.5f, 2.0f,
                () -> cfg.moistureBias, v -> cfg.moistureBias = v, -0.5f, 0.5f);
        ry += 19;

        drawTwoColTerrainRow(context, bx, ry, bw, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.row.aux").getString(),
                null, null,
                () -> cfg.auxScale, v -> cfg.auxScale = v, 0.5f, 2.0f,
                () -> cfg.auxBias, v -> cfg.auxBias = v, -0.5f, 0.5f);
    }

    private void drawTwoColTerrainRow(DrawContext context, int bx, int ry, int bw, String label,
                                      Supplier<Boolean> cbGet, Consumer<Boolean> cbSet,
                                      Supplier<Float> s1Get, Consumer<Float> s1Set, float min1, float max1,
                                      Supplier<Float> s2Get, Consumer<Float> s2Set, float min2, float max2) {
        context.fill(bx + 2, ry, bx + bw - 2, ry + 18, 0xFF232428);
        context.fill(bx + 170, ry, bx + 171, ry + 18, 0xFF18191B);
        context.fill(bx + 230, ry, bx + 231, ry + 18, 0xFF18191B);

        int textX = bx + 6;
        if (cbGet != null && cbSet != null) {
            registerAndDrawCheckbox(context, 1, bx + 6, ry + 5, cbGet, cbSet);
            textX = bx + 18;
        }
        drawScaledText(context, label, textX, ry + 6, 0.70f, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);

        registerAndDrawNotchedSlider(context, 1, bx + 174, ry + 5, 50, min1, max1, 0.05f, s1Get, s1Set);
        registerAndDrawNotchedSlider(context, 1, bx + 234, ry + 5, 50, min2, max2, 0.05f, s2Get, s2Set);
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // Ð’ÐšÐ›ÐÐ”ÐšÐ 2: Ð’Ð ÐÐ“ (ÐºÐ°Ðº Ð½Ð° ÑÐºÑ€Ð¸Ð½Ðµ 022055.jpg)
    // =========================================================================
    private void renderEnemyTab(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw, NauvisConfig cfg) {
        int ry = by + 3;
        int col1X = bx + 174;
        int col2X = bx + 234;

        context.fill(bx + 2, ry, bx + bw - 2, ry + 12, 0xFF1E1F22);
        drawColumnHeaderWithInfo(context, col1X + 25, ry + 3, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.col.freq").getString());
        drawColumnHeaderWithInfo(context, col2X + 25, ry + 3, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.col.size").getString());
        ry += 13;

        drawTwoColTerrainRow(context, bx, ry, bw, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.nauvis.enemy_bases").getString(),
                () -> cfg.enemyBasesEnabled, v -> cfg.enemyBasesEnabled = v,
                () -> cfg.enemyBaseFreq, v -> cfg.enemyBaseFreq = v, 0.0f, 2.5f,
                () -> cfg.enemyBaseSize, v -> cfg.enemyBaseSize = v, 0.0f, 2.5f);
        ry += 20;

        // Ð§ÐµÐºÐ±Ð¾ÐºÑÑ‹ "Ð‘ÐµÐ· Ð²Ñ€Ð°Ð³Ð¾Ð²" Ð¸ "ÐœÐ¸Ñ€Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ñ€ÐµÐ¶Ð¸Ð¼" + Ð¿Ð¾Ð»Ð·ÑƒÐ½Ð¾Ðº "Ð Ð°Ð·Ð¼ÐµÑ€ Ð½Ð°Ñ‡Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾Ð¹ Ð¾Ð±Ð»Ð°ÑÑ‚Ð¸"

    private void drawValueSliderRow(DrawContext context, int tab, int bx, int ry, int bw, String label,
                                    float min, float max, float step,
                                    Supplier<Float> getter, Consumer<Float> setter, String boxValueText) {
        drawScaledText(context, label, bx + 6, ry + 3, 0.68f, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);
        registerAndDrawNotchedSlider(context, tab, bx + 174, ry + 2, 68, min, max, step, getter, setter);

        // Ð¡Ð²ÐµÑ‚Ð»Ð¾-ÑÐµÑ€Ð°Ñ Ð¿Ð»Ð°ÑˆÐºÐ° ÑÐ¾ Ð·Ð½Ð°Ñ‡ÐµÐ½Ð¸ÐµÐ¼ ÑÐ¿Ñ€Ð°Ð²Ð° (ÐºÐ°Ðº Ð½Ð° ÑÐºÑ€Ð¸Ð½Ð°Ñ… 022055 Ð¸ 022057)
        int valBoxX = bx + 248;
        int valBoxW = 38;
        context.fill(valBoxX, ry, valBoxX + valBoxW, ry + 11, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(valBoxX + 1, ry + 1, valBoxX + valBoxW - 1, ry + 10, 0xFF888A8E);
        drawScaledTextCentered(context, boxValueText, valBoxX + valBoxW / 2, ry + 3, 0.65f, 0xFF111111, false);
    }

    private void registerAndDrawNotchedSlider(DrawContext context, int tab, int sx, int sy, int sw,
                                              float min, float max, float step,
                                              Supplier<Float> getter, Consumer<Float> setter) {
        activeSliders.add(new SliderBox(tab, sx, sy, sw, min, max, step, getter, setter));

        // Ð Ð¸ÑÐºÐ¸ Ð´ÐµÐ»ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ð¹ Ð½Ð°Ð´ Ð´Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ð¶ÐºÐ¾Ð¹ Ð¿Ð¾Ð»Ð·ÑƒÐ½ÐºÐ° (ÐºÐ°Ðº Ð² Ð¾Ñ€Ð¸Ð³Ð¸Ð½Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾Ð¹ Factorio!)
        for (int i = 0; i <= 8; i++) {
            int tx = sx + 2 + Math.round((i / 8.0f) * (sw - 5));
            context.fill(tx, sy - 2, tx + 1, sy, 0xFF111111);
        }

        // Ð¢Ñ‘Ð¼Ð½Ð°Ñ Ð´Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ð¶ÐºÐ° + Ð¾Ñ€Ð°Ð½Ð¶ÐµÐ²Ð¾Ðµ Ð·Ð°Ð¿Ð¾Ð»Ð½ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ðµ ÑÐ»ÐµÐ²Ð° Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð±ÐµÐ³ÑƒÐ½ÐºÐ°
        context.fill(sx, sy + 1, sx + sw, sy + 5, 0xFF111214);
        float val = getter.get();
        float ratio = MathHelper.clamp((val - min) / (max - min), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        int knobX = sx + Math.round(ratio * (sw - 6));
        if (knobX > sx + 1) {
            context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 2, knobX, sy + 4, 0xFFE59524);
        }

        // Ð¡Ð²ÐµÑ‚Ð»Ð¾-ÑÐµÑ€Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¼ÐµÑ‚Ð°Ð»Ð»Ð¸Ñ‡ÐµÑÐºÐ¸Ð¹ Ð±ÐµÐ³ÑƒÐ½Ð¾Ðº Factorio
        context.fill(knobX, sy - 1, knobX + 6, sy + 7, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(knobX + 1, sy, knobX + 5, sy + 6, 0xFFC2C4C8);
    }

    private void registerAndDrawCheckbox(DrawContext context, int tab, int cx, int cy,
                                         Supplier<Boolean> getter, Consumer<Boolean> setter) {
        activeCheckboxes.add(new CheckboxBox(tab, cx, cy, getter, setter));
        boolean checked = getter.get();
        context.fill(cx, cy, cx + 9, cy + 9, 0xFF111111);
        context.fill(cx + 1, cy + 1, cx + 8, cy + 8, checked ? 0xFFE59524 : 0xFF424448);
        if (checked) {
            context.fill(cx + 2, cy + 4, cx + 4, cy + 6, 0xFF141414);
            context.fill(cx + 4, cy + 2, cx + 7, cy + 5, 0xFF141414);
        }
    }

    private void drawColumnHeaderWithInfo(DrawContext context, int centerX, int y, String title) {
        int tw = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(title) * 0.68f);
        int startX = centerX - (tw + 8) / 2;
        drawScaledText(context, title, startX, y, 0.68f, 0xFFE6E6E6, true);
        int ix = startX + tw + 2;
        context.fill(ix, y, ix + 6, y + 6, 0xFF3FA9F5);
        drawScaledText(context, "i", ix + 2, y + 1, 0.55f, 0xFF111111, false);
    }

    private int drawLegendItem(DrawContext context, int lx, int ly, int color, String name) {
        context.fill(lx, ly + 1, lx + 6, ly + 7, 0xFF111111);
        context.fill(lx + 1, ly + 2, lx + 5, ly + 6, color);
        drawScaledText(context, name, lx + 8, ly + 1, 0.68f, 0xFFDDDDDD, false);
        return lx + 11 + Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(name) * 0.68f);
    }

    private void drawFactorioTab(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw, int bh, String label, int mx, int my, boolean active) {
        boolean hov = isHovering(mx, my, bx, by, bw, bh);
        int bg = active ? 0xFF4A4C52 : (hov ? 0xFF3A3C40 : 0xFF222326);
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + bw, by + bh, 0xFF111214);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + bw - 1, by + bh - (active ? 0 : 1), bg);
        drawScaledTextCentered(context, label, bx + bw / 2, by + 4, 0.72f, active ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFFBBBBBB, true);
    }

    private void drawGrayButton(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw, int bh, String label, int mx, int my, boolean active) {
        boolean hov = isHovering(mx, my, bx, by, bw, bh);
        int bg = active ? 0xFFB8BABC : (hov ? 0xFFD4D6D8 : 0xFF9EA0A4);
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + bw, by + bh, 0xFF111214);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + bw - 1, by + bh - 1, bg);
        drawScaledTextCentered(context, label, bx + bw / 2, by + 6, 0.75f, 0xFF141414, false);
    }

    private void drawGreenPlayButton(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw, int bh, String label, int mx, int my) {
        boolean hov = isHovering(mx, my, bx, by, bw, bh);
        int bg = hov ? 0xFF66BB6A : 0xFF4CAF50;
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + bw, by + bh, 0xFF111214);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + bw - 1, by + bh - 1, bg);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + bw - 1, by + 3, 0xFF81C784);
        drawScaledTextCentered(context, label, bx + bw / 2, by + 6, 0.80f, 0xFF111214, false);
    }

    private boolean isHovering(double mx, double my, int rx, int ry, int rw, int rh) {
        return mx >= rx && mx <= rx + rw && my >= ry && my <= ry + rh;
    }

    private void drawScaledText(DrawContext context, String text, int x, int y, float scale, int color, boolean shadow) {
        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(x, y, 200.0f);
        context.getMatrices().scale(scale, scale, 1.0f);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, text, 0, 0, color, shadow);
        context.getMatrices().pop();
    }

    private void drawScaledTextCentered(DrawContext context, String text, int centerX, int y, float scale, int color, boolean shadow) {
        int w = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(text) * scale);
        drawScaledText(context, text, centerX - w / 2, y, scale, color, shadow);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        int totalW = getTotalPanelWidth();
        int x = (this.width - totalW) / 2;
        int y = (this.height - PANEL_H) / 2;
        this.editingSeed = false;

        int topRowY = y + 20;
        // 1. ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ Ð²Ñ‹Ð¿Ð°Ð´Ð°ÑŽÑ‰ÐµÐ¼Ñƒ ÑÐ¿Ð¸ÑÐºÑƒ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÑÐµÑ‚Ð¾Ð²
        if (isHovering(mouseX, mouseY, x + 6, topRowY, 112, 14)) {
            int nextPreset = (NauvisConfig.ACTIVE.presetIndex + (button == 1 ? PRESET_KEYS.length - 1 : 1)) % PRESET_KEYS.length;
            NauvisConfig.ACTIVE.applyPreset(nextPreset);
            this.mapDirty = true;
            playClick();
            return true;
        }
        // Ð¡Ð±Ñ€Ð¾Ñ Ðº "ÐŸÐ¾ ÑƒÐ¼Ð¾Ð»Ñ‡Ð°Ð½Ð¸ÑŽ"
        if (isHovering(mouseX, mouseY, x + 120, topRowY, 14, 14)) {
            NauvisConfig.ACTIVE.resetDefaults();
            this.mapDirty = true;
            playClick();
            return true;
        }
        // ÐŸÐ¾Ð»Ðµ Ð²Ð²Ð¾Ð´Ð° Seed
        int randBtnX = x + LEFT_W - 20;
        int seedBoxX = randBtnX - 66;
        if (isHovering(mouseX, mouseY, seedBoxX, topRowY, 64, 14)) {
            this.editingSeed = true;
            if (button == 1) {
                this.seedText = "";
            }
            return true;
        }
        // ÐšÐ½Ð¾Ð¿ÐºÐ° ÑÐ»ÑƒÑ‡Ð°Ð¹Ð½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ Seed [ðŸ”€]
        if (isHovering(mouseX, mouseY, randBtnX, topRowY, 14, 14)) {
            NauvisConfig.ACTIVE.randomizeSeed();
            this.seedText = String.valueOf(Math.abs(NauvisConfig.ACTIVE.worldSeed));
            this.mapDirty = true;
            playClick();
            return true;
        }

        // 2. ÐŸÐµÑ€ÐµÐºÐ»ÑŽÑ‡ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ðµ 4 Ð²ÐºÐ»Ð°Ð´Ð¾Ðº
        int tabY = y + 55;
        String[] tabKeys = {
                "gui.factoriocore.nauvis.tab.resources",
                "gui.factoriocore.nauvis.tab.terrain",
                "gui.factoriocore.nauvis.tab.enemy",
                "gui.factoriocore.nauvis.tab.advanced"
        };
        int tabX = x + 6;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            String tName = Text.translatable(tabKeys[i]).getString();
            int tw = Math.max(54, Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(tName) * 0.75f) + 14);
            if (isHovering(mouseX, mouseY, tabX, tabY, tw, 15)) {
                this.currentTab = i;
                playClick();
                return true;
            }
            tabX += tw + 1;
        }

        // 3. ÐŸÐµÑ€ÐµÐºÐ»ÑŽÑ‡ÐµÐ½Ð¸Ðµ Ñ‚Ð¸Ð¿Ð° ÐºÐ°Ñ€Ñ‚Ñ‹ (ÐÐ°ÑƒÐ²Ð¸Ñ / ÐžÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ð²) Ð²Ð¾ Ð²ÐºÐ»Ð°Ð´ÐºÐµ Ð›Ð°Ð½Ð´ÑˆÐ°Ñ„Ñ‚
        if (this.currentTab == 1 && isHovering(mouseX, mouseY, x + 138, y + 75, LEFT_W - 150, 14)) {
            NauvisConfig.ACTIVE.mapType = (NauvisConfig.ACTIVE.mapType == 0) ? 1 : 0;
            this.mapDirty = true;
            playClick();
            return true;
        }

        // 4. ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ Ñ‡ÐµÐºÐ±Ð¾ÐºÑÐ°Ð¼ Ñ‚ÐµÐºÑƒÑ‰ÐµÐ¹ Ð²ÐºÐ»Ð°Ð´ÐºÐ¸
        for (CheckboxBox cb : activeCheckboxes) {
            if (cb.tab == this.currentTab && isHovering(mouseX, mouseY, cb.x - 1, cb.y - 1, 11, 11)) {
                cb.setter.accept(!cb.getter.get());
                this.mapDirty = true;
                playClick();
                return true;
            }
        }

        // 5. ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ Ð¿Ð¾Ð»Ð·ÑƒÐ½ÐºÐ°Ð¼ Ñ‚ÐµÐºÑƒÑ‰ÐµÐ¹ Ð²ÐºÐ»Ð°Ð´ÐºÐ¸
        for (SliderBox s : activeSliders) {
            if (s.tab == this.currentTab && isHovering(mouseX, mouseY, s.x - 3, s.y - 3, s.w + 6, 12)) {
                this.draggingSlider = s;
                updateSliderFromMouse(s, mouseX);
                return true;
            }
        }

        // 6. ÐšÐ½Ð¾Ð¿ÐºÐ¸ Ð½Ð¸Ð¶Ð½ÐµÐ¹ Ð¿Ð°Ð½ÐµÐ»Ð¸: [ÐÐ°Ð·Ð°Ð´]  [ÐŸÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾ÑÐ¼Ð¾Ñ‚Ñ€]  [Ð˜Ð³Ñ€Ð°Ñ‚ÑŒ]
        int botY = y + PANEL_H - 23;
        if (isHovering(mouseX, mouseY, x + 6, botY, 64, 18) || isHovering(mouseX, mouseY, x + 206, botY, 92, 18)) {
            playClick();
            if (this.client != null) {
                this.client.setScreen(this.parent);
            }
            return true;
        }
        if (isHovering(mouseX, mouseY, x + 114, botY, 88, 18)) {
            this.showPreview = !this.showPreview;
            playClick();
            return true;
        }

        // 7. ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ ÐºÐ°Ñ€Ñ‚Ðµ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾ÑÐ¼Ð¾Ñ‚Ñ€Ð°: ÐºÐ½Ð¾Ð¿ÐºÐ¸ [-], [+], [âŒ–] Ð˜Ð›Ð˜ Ð·Ð°Ð¶Ð°Ñ‚Ð¸Ðµ ÐŸÐšÐœ/Ð›ÐšÐœ Ð´Ð»Ñ Ð¿Ð°Ð½Ð¾Ñ€Ð°Ð¼Ð¸Ñ€Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ñ!
        if (this.showPreview) {
            int mapBoxX = x + LEFT_W + 4;
            int mapBoxY = y + 21;
            if (isHovering(mouseX, mouseY, mapBoxX + 3, mapBoxY + 3, 16, 12)) {
                if (this.mapZoom < 16) {
                    this.mapZoom *= 2;
                    this.mapDirty = true;
                    playClick();
                }
                return true;
            }
            if (isHovering(mouseX, mouseY, mapBoxX + 68, mapBoxY + 3, 14, 12)) {
                if (this.mapZoom > 1) {
                    this.mapZoom /= 2;
                    this.mapDirty = true;
                    playClick();
                }
                return true;
            }
            if (isHovering(mouseX, mouseY, mapBoxX + 82, mapBoxY + 3, 14, 12)) {
                this.mapPanX = 0.0;
                this.mapPanZ = 0.0;
                this.mapDirty = true;
                playClick();
                return true;
            }
            if (isHovering(mouseX, mouseY, mapBoxX, mapBoxY, MAP_SIZE_PX, MAP_SIZE_PX)) {
                this.draggingMap = true;
                return true;
            }
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    private void updateSliderFromMouse(SliderBox s, double mouseX) {
        float ratio = MathHelper.clamp((float) (mouseX - s.x) / (float) s.w, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        float raw = s.min + ratio * (s.max - s.min);
        float stepped = Math.round(raw / s.step) * s.step;
        s.setter.accept(MathHelper.clamp(stepped, s.min, s.max));
        this.mapDirty = true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.draggingSlider != null) {
            updateSliderFromMouse(this.draggingSlider, mouseX);
            return true;
        }
        if (this.draggingMap) {
            // ÐŸÐ»Ð°Ð²Ð½Ð¾ Ð´Ð²Ð¸Ð³Ð°ÐµÐ¼ ÐºÐ°Ñ€Ñ‚Ñƒ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾ÑÐ¼Ð¾Ñ‚Ñ€Ð° Ð¼Ñ‹ÑˆÑŒÑŽ (ÐŸÐšÐœ Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ Ð›ÐšÐœ)
            double blocksPerPixel = (double) this.mapZoom / MAP_PX_SCALE;
            this.mapPanX -= deltaX * blocksPerPixel;
            this.mapPanZ -= deltaY * blocksPerPixel;
            this.mapDirty = true;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        this.draggingSlider = null;
        this.draggingMap = false;
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        if (this.showPreview) {
            int totalW = getTotalPanelWidth();
            int x = (this.width - totalW) / 2;
            int y = (this.height - PANEL_H) / 2;
            int mapBoxX = x + LEFT_W + 4;
            int mapBoxY = y + 21;
            if (isHovering(mouseX, mouseY, mapBoxX, mapBoxY, MAP_SIZE_PX, MAP_SIZE_PX)) {
                if (verticalAmount > 0 && this.mapZoom > 1) {
                    this.mapZoom /= 2;
                    this.mapDirty = true;
                } else if (verticalAmount < 0 && this.mapZoom < 16) {
                    this.mapZoom *= 2;
                    this.mapDirty = true;
                }
                return true;
            }
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mouseX, mouseY, horizontalAmount, verticalAmount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean charTyped(char chr, int modifiers) {
        if (this.editingSeed && (Character.isDigit(chr) || (chr == '-' && this.seedText.isEmpty()))) {
            if (this.seedText.length() < 18) {
                this.seedText += chr;
                applyTypedSeed();
            }
            return true;
        }
        return super.charTyped(chr, modifiers);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(int keyCode, int scanCode, int modifiers) {
        if (this.editingSeed) {
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_BACKSPACE && !this.seedText.isEmpty()) {
                this.seedText = this.seedText.substring(0, this.seedText.length() - 1);
                applyTypedSeed();
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ENTER || keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_KP_ENTER || keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) {
                this.editingSeed = false;
                return true;
            }
            return true;
        }
        return super.keyPressed(keyCode, scanCode, modifiers);
    }

    private void applyTypedSeed() {
        try {
            if (!this.seedText.isBlank() && !this.seedText.equals("-")) {
                NauvisConfig.ACTIVE.worldSeed = Long.parseLong(this.seedText);
                this.mapDirty = true;
            }
        } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
        }
    }

    private void playClick() {
        if (this.client != null && this.client.player != null) {
            this.client.player.playSound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), 0.35f, 1.2f);
        }
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.config;

import com.google.gson.Gson;

public class FactorioConfig {

    private static final Gson GSON = new GsonBuilder().setPrettyPrinting().create();
    private static final Path CONFIG_PATH = FabricLoader.getInstance().getConfigDir().resolve("factoriocore.json");

    public static FactorioConfig INSTANCE = new FactorioConfig();

    public boolean enableMinimap = true;
    public float minimapScale = 1.0f;
    public float infoPanelScale = 1.0f;
    public boolean enableTargetInfoPanel = true;
    public boolean enableCraftingQueueHud = true;
    public boolean replaceVanillaInventory = true;
    public boolean enableInventoryAutoSort = true;
    public boolean enablePavementSpeedBoost = true;
    public boolean showPoleSupplyWhenHoldingElectric = true;
    public boolean showDrillMiningArea = true;
    public boolean enableCopperWiresRender = true;
    public boolean enablePlacementParticles = true;
    public boolean enableMachineSounds = true;
    public float machineSoundVolume = 0.70f;
    public String factorioDataPath = "";
    
    // ÐÐ°ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ð¹ÐºÐ¸ Ð¿Ð°Ð½ÐµÐ»Ð¸ Ð¸Ð½Ñ„Ð¾Ñ€Ð¼Ð°Ñ†Ð¸Ð¸
    public boolean showInfoDescription = true;
    public boolean showInfoHealth = false;
    public boolean showInfoStatus = true;
    public boolean showInfoFluids = true;
    public boolean showInfoElectricity = true;

    public int poleSupplyColor = 0x26B4FF;
    public int drillAreaColor = 0x33E68C;
    public int validPlacementColor = 0x26FF40;
    public int invalidPlacementColor = 0xFF2626;
    public int wireColor = 0xE08538;
    public int altArrowColor = 0xFFE026;

    public void resetDefaults() {
        this.enableMinimap = true;
        this.minimapScale = 1.0f;
        this.infoPanelScale = 1.0f;
        this.enableTargetInfoPanel = true;
        this.enableCraftingQueueHud = true;
        this.replaceVanillaInventory = true;
        this.enableInventoryAutoSort = true;
        this.enablePavementSpeedBoost = true;
        this.showPoleSupplyWhenHoldingElectric = true;
        this.showDrillMiningArea = true;
        this.enableCopperWiresRender = true;
        this.enablePlacementParticles = true;
        
        this.showInfoDescription = true;
        this.showInfoHealth = false;
        this.showInfoStatus = true;
        this.showInfoFluids = true;
        this.showInfoElectricity = true;

        this.poleSupplyColor = 0x26B4FF;
        this.drillAreaColor = 0x33E68C;
        this.validPlacementColor = 0x26FF40;
        this.invalidPlacementColor = 0xFF2626;
        this.wireColor = 0xE08538;
        this.altArrowColor = 0xFFE026;
        this.enableMachineSounds = true; this.machineSoundVolume = 0.70f;
        save();
    }

    public static float getRed(int rgb) { return ((rgb >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255.0f; }
    public static float getGreen(int rgb) { return ((rgb >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255.0f; }
    public static float getBlue(int rgb) { return (rgb & 0xFF) / 255.0f; }

    public static void load() {
        if (Files.exists(CONFIG_PATH)) {
            try (Reader reader = Files.newBufferedReader(CONFIG_PATH, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                FactorioConfig loaded = GSON.fromJson(reader, FactorioConfig.class);
                if (loaded != null) {
                    INSTANCE = loaded;
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
        } else {
            save();
        }
    }

    public static void save() {
        try {
            Files.createDirectories(CONFIG_PATH.getParent());
            try (Writer writer = Files.newBufferedWriter(CONFIG_PATH, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                GSON.toJson(INSTANCE, writer);
            }
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}

public class BlockHealthManager {

    private static final Map<RegistryKey<World>, Map<BlockPos, Integer>> SERVER_DAMAGE = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final Map<BlockPos, Integer> CLIENT_DAMAGE = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    private static Map<BlockPos, Integer> getServerWorldMap(World world) {
        return SERVER_DAMAGE.computeIfAbsent(world.getRegistryKey(), k -> new ConcurrentHashMap<>());
    }

    public static int getMaxHealth(Block block) {
        if (block == ModBlocks.SMALL_ELECTRIC_POLE) return 100;
        if (block == ModBlocks.MEDIUM_ELECTRIC_POLE) return 100;
        if (block == ModBlocks.BIG_ELECTRIC_POLE) return 150;
        if (block == ModBlocks.SUBSTATION) return 200;
        if (block == ModBlocks.ELECTRIC_ENERGY_INTERFACE) return 150;
        if (block == ModBlocks.STONE_WALL) return 350;
        if (block == ModBlocks.GATE) return 350;
        if (block == ModBlocks.LAND_MINE) return 15;
        if (block == ModBlocks.WOODEN_CHEST) return 100;
        if (block == ModBlocks.IRON_CHEST) return 200;
        if (block == ModBlocks.STEEL_CHEST) return 350;
        if (block == ModBlocks.STORAGE_TANK) return 500;
        if (block == ModBlocks.SOLAR_PANEL) return 200;
        if (block == ModBlocks.ACCUMULATOR) return 150;
        if (block == ModBlocks.GUN_TURRET) return 400;
        if (block == ModBlocks.LASER_TURRET) return 1000;
        if (block == ModBlocks.FLAMETHROWER_TURRET) return 1400;

        if (block == ModBlocks.BURNER_INSERTER) return 100;
        if (block == ModBlocks.INSERTER) return 150;
        if (block == ModBlocks.LONG_HANDED_INSERTER) return 160;
        if (block == ModBlocks.FAST_INSERTER) return 160;

        if (block == ModBlocks.PIPE || block == ModBlocks.PIPE_TO_GROUND) return 100;
        if (block == ModBlocks.OFFSHORE_PUMP) return 150;
        if (block == ModBlocks.BOILER) return 200;
        if (block == ModBlocks.STEAM_ENGINE) return 400;
        if (block == ModBlocks.ELECTRIC_MINING_DRILL) return 300;
        if (block == ModBlocks.BURNER_MINING_DRILL) return 150;
        if (block == ModBlocks.STONE_FURNACE) return 200;
        if (block == ModBlocks.STEEL_FURNACE) return 300;
        if (block == ModBlocks.ASSEMBLER) return 300;
        if (block == ModBlocks.LAB) return 150;
        if (block == ModBlocks.PUMPJACK) return 250;
        if (block == ModBlocks.OIL_REFINERY) return 350;
        if (block == ModBlocks.CHEMICAL_PLANT) return 300;

        if (block instanceof SplitterBlock splitter) {
            return switch (splitter.getTier()) {
                case 2 -> 180;
                case 3 -> 190;
                default -> 170;
            };
        }
        if (block instanceof BeltBlock belt) {
            return switch (belt.getTier()) {
                case 2 -> 160;
                case 3 -> 170;
                default -> 150;
            };
        }
        return 0;
    }

    public static BlockPos getCanonicalPos(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        Block block = state.getBlock();
        if (block instanceof ElectricPoleBlock) return ElectricPoleBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof OffshorePumpBlock) return OffshorePumpBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof BoilerBlock) return BoilerBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof SteamEngineBlock) return SteamEngineBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof ElectricDrillBlock) return ElectricDrillBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof AssemblerBlock) return AssemblerBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof LabBlock) return LabBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof OilMachines.OilRefineryBlock) return OilMachines.OilRefineryBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof OilMachines.Base3x3MachineBlock) return OilMachines.Base3x3MachineBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof BurnerDrillBlock) return BurnerDrillBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlock) return FactorioFurnaceBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.combat.turret.TurretBlock) return com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.combat.turret.TurretBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.fluids.StorageTankBlock) return com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.fluids.StorageTankBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.electricity.SolarAndAccumulatorMachines.SolarPanelBlock) return com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.electricity.SolarAndAccumulatorMachines.SolarPanelBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.electricity.SolarAndAccumulatorMachines.AccumulatorBlock) return com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.electricity.SolarAndAccumulatorMachines.AccumulatorBlock.getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (block instanceof SplitterBlock && state.contains(SplitterBlock.PART_RIGHT) && state.get(SplitterBlock.PART_RIGHT)) {
            Direction facing = state.get(BeltBlock.FACING);
            return pos.offset(facing.rotateYCounterclockwise());
        }
        return pos.toImmutable();
    }

    public static int getDamageTaken(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (world == null) return 0;
        BlockPos masterPos = getCanonicalPos(pos, state);
        Map<BlockPos, Integer> map = world.isClient ? CLIENT_DAMAGE : getServerWorldMap(world);
        return map.getOrDefault(masterPos, 0);
    }

    public static int getCurrentHealth(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        int max = getMaxHealth(state.getBlock());
        if (max <= 0) return 0;
        int dmg = getDamageTaken(world, pos, state);
        return Math.max(0, max - dmg);
    }

    public static Map<BlockPos, Integer> getClientDamagedBlocks() {
        return CLIENT_DAMAGE;
    }

    public static void setClientDamage(BlockPos masterPos, int damage) {
        if (damage <= 0) {
            CLIENT_DAMAGE.remove(masterPos);
        } else {
            CLIENT_DAMAGE.put(masterPos.toImmutable(), damage);
        }
    }

    public static void damageBlock(ServerWorld world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, int amount) {
        int maxHp = getMaxHealth(state.getBlock());
        if (maxHp <= 0 || amount <= 0) return;

        BlockPos masterPos = getCanonicalPos(pos, state);
        Map<BlockPos, Integer> map = getServerWorldMap(world);
        int newDamage = map.getOrDefault(masterPos, 0) + amount;

        if (newDamage >= maxHp) {
            map.remove(masterPos);
            syncToClients(world, masterPos, 0);
            destroyFactorioStructure(world, masterPos, world.getBlockState(masterPos));
        } else {
            map.put(masterPos, newDamage);
            syncToClients(world, masterPos, newDamage);
            world.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.BLOCK_ANVIL_LAND, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 0.35f, 1.5f);
            world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.CRIT, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.7, pos.getZ() + 0.5,
                    6, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.05);
        }
    }

    public static boolean repairBlock(ServerWorld world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, int amount) {
        int maxHp = getMaxHealth(state.getBlock());
        if (maxHp <= 0) return false;

        BlockPos masterPos = getCanonicalPos(pos, state);
        Map<BlockPos, Integer> map = getServerWorldMap(world);
        int currentDamage = map.getOrDefault(masterPos, 0);
        if (currentDamage <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        int newDamage = Math.max(0, currentDamage - amount);
        if (newDamage == 0) {
            map.remove(masterPos);
        } else {
            map.put(masterPos, newDamage);
        }

        syncToClients(world, masterPos, newDamage);
        world.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.BLOCK_IRON_TRAPDOOR_CLOSE, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 0.6f, 1.8f);
        world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.ELECTRIC_SPARK, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.75, pos.getZ() + 0.5,
                8, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.02);
        return true;
    }

    private static void destroyFactorioStructure(ServerWorld world, BlockPos masterPos, BlockState masterState) {
        Block block = masterState.getBlock();

        if (block instanceof ElectricPoleBlock pole && pole.isFootprint2x2()) {
            for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = ElectricPoleBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, part, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, false);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof OffshorePumpBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(OffshorePumpBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part <= 1; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = OffshorePumpBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, false);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof BoilerBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(BoilerBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 6; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = BoilerBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, false);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof SteamEngineBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(SteamEngineBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 15; part++) {
                for (int layer = 0; layer <= 2; layer++) {
                    BlockPos p = SteamEngineBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, layer);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, false);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof ElectricDrillBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(ElectricDrillBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = ElectricDrillBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, false);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof AssemblerBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(AssemblerBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = AssemblerBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, false);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (block instanceof LabBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(LabBlock.FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = LabBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (world.getBlockState(p).isOf(block)) {

        } else {
            world.breakBlock(masterPos, false);
        }

    private static void syncToClients(ServerWorld world, BlockPos masterPos, int damage) {
        SyncBlockHealthPayload payload = new SyncBlockHealthPayload(masterPos, damage);
        for (ServerPlayerEntity player : PlayerLookup.world(world)) {
            ServerPlayNetworking.send(player, payload);
        }
    }

    public static void registerServer() {
        PlayerBlockBreakEvents.AFTER.register((world, player, pos, state, blockEntity) -> {
            if (!world.isClient && world instanceof ServerWorld serverWorld) {
                Block block = state.getBlock();
                if (getMaxHealth(block) > 0) {
                    BlockPos masterPos = getCanonicalPos(pos, state);
                    getServerWorldMap(serverWorld).remove(masterPos);
                    syncToClients(serverWorld, masterPos, 0);
                }

                if (!player.isCreative() && !(block instanceof ResourceOreBlock) && !(block instanceof OilMachines.CrudeOilDepositBlock)) {
                    Identifier id = Registries.BLOCK.getId(block);
                    Item item = block.asItem();
                    if (id.getNamespace().equals("factoriocore") && item != Items.AIR) {
                        player.getInventory().offerOrDrop(new ItemStack(item, 1));
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        AttackBlockCallback.EVENT.register((player, world, hand, pos, direction) -> {
            BlockState state = world.getBlockState(pos);
            Block block = state.getBlock();
            int maxHp = getMaxHealth(block);
            if (maxHp <= 0) {
                return ActionResult.PASS;
            }

            ItemStack held = player.getStackInHand(hand);
            boolean isWeapon = held.getItem() instanceof SwordItem
                    || held.getItem() instanceof TridentItem
                    || held.getItem() instanceof MaceItem;

            if (isWeapon && player.isSneaking()) {
                if (!world.isClient && world instanceof ServerWorld serverWorld) {
                    damageBlock(serverWorld, pos, state, 25);
                    int left = getCurrentHealth(world, pos, state);
                    player.sendMessage(Text.literal("HP: " + left + " / " + maxHp), true);
                }
                return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
            }

            return ActionResult.PASS;
        });

        UseBlockCallback.EVENT.register((player, world, hand, hitResult) -> {
            ItemStack stack = player.getStackInHand(hand);
            if (!stack.isOf(ModItems.REPAIR_PACK)) {
                return ActionResult.PASS;
            }

            BlockPos pos = hitResult.getBlockPos();
            BlockState state = world.getBlockState(pos);
            int maxHp = getMaxHealth(state.getBlock());
            if (maxHp <= 0) {
                return ActionResult.PASS;
            }

            int currentDamage = getDamageTaken(world, pos, state);
            if (currentDamage <= 0) {
                return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
            }

            if (!world.isClient && world instanceof ServerWorld serverWorld) {
                if (repairBlock(serverWorld, pos, state, 25)) {
                    if (!player.isCreative()) {
                        stack.damage(1, player, hand == Hand.MAIN_HAND
                                ? EquipmentSlot.MAINHAND : EquipmentSlot.OFFHAND);
                    }
                }
            }
            return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
        });
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.combat;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModBlocks;
import net.minecraft.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.block.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundCategory;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundEvents;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Direction;
import net.minecraft.world.World;

public class FactorioGateBlockEntity extends BlockEntity {

    private static final double TRIGGER_RADIUS_SQ = 3.6 * 3.6;

    public FactorioGateBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.FACTORIO_GATE_BLOCK_ENTITY, pos, state);
    }

    public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, FactorioGateBlockEntity entity) {
        if (world.isClient || (world.getTime() & 1L) != 0L) {
            return;
        }

        boolean shouldOpen = isPlayerNearGateLine(world, pos, state);
        boolean currentlyOpen = state.get(FactorioGateBlock.OPEN);

        if (shouldOpen != currentlyOpen) {
            world.setBlockState(pos, state.with(FactorioGateBlock.OPEN, shouldOpen), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
            world.playSound(
                    null,
                    pos,
                    shouldOpen ? SoundEvents.BLOCK_IRON_TRAPDOOR_OPEN : SoundEvents.BLOCK_IRON_TRAPDOOR_CLOSE,
                    SoundCategory.BLOCKS,
                    0.5f,
                    shouldOpen ? 0.9f : 0.75f
            );
        }
    }

    /**
     * ÐŸÑ€Ð¾Ð²ÐµÑ€ÑÐµÑ‚, ÐµÑÑ‚ÑŒ Ð»Ð¸ Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾Ðº Ñ€ÑÐ´Ð¾Ð¼ Ñ ÑÑ‚Ð¸Ð¼ Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ¾Ð¼ Ð²Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð˜Ð›Ð˜ Ñ€ÑÐ´Ð¾Ð¼ Ñ ÑÐ¾ÑÐµÐ´Ð½Ð¸Ð¼Ð¸ Ð²Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ñ‚Ð°Ð¼Ð¸ Ð² Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¼ Ð¶Ðµ Ñ€ÑÐ´Ñƒ
     * (Ñ‡Ñ‚Ð¾Ð±Ñ‹ ÑˆÐ¸Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÐ¸Ðµ Ð²Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ñ‚Ð° Ð¸Ð· 2â€“4 Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ¾Ð² Ð¾Ñ‚ÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ð²Ð°Ð»Ð¸ÑÑŒ Ð¸ Ð·Ð°ÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ð²Ð°Ð»Ð¸ÑÑŒ ÑÐ¸Ð½Ñ…Ñ€Ð¾Ð½Ð½Ð¾!).
     */
    private static boolean isPlayerNearGateLine(World world, BlockPos origin, BlockState state) {
        if (isPlayerNearPos(world, origin)) {
            return true;
        }
        Direction facing = state.get(FactorioGateBlock.FACING);
        Direction left = facing.rotateYCounterclockwise();
        Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();

        for (int step = 1; step <= 4; step++) {
            BlockPos leftPos = origin.offset(left, step);
            if (world.getBlockState(leftPos).getBlock() instanceof FactorioGateBlock) {
                if (isPlayerNearPos(world, leftPos)) return true;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        for (int step = 1; step <= 4; step++) {
            BlockPos rightPos = origin.offset(right, step);
            if (world.getBlockState(rightPos).getBlock() instanceof FactorioGateBlock) {
                if (isPlayerNearPos(world, rightPos)) return true;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static boolean isPlayerNearPos(World world, BlockPos gatePos) {
        double gx = gatePos.getX() + 0.5;
        double gy = gatePos.getY() + 0.5;
        double gz = gatePos.getZ() + 0.5;

        for (PlayerEntity player : world.getPlayers()) {
            if (!player.isSpectator() && player.isAlive()) {
                if (player.squaredDistanceTo(gx, gy, gz) <= TRIGGER_RADIUS_SQ) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}

                .with(NORTH, false)
                .with(EAST, false)
                .with(SOUTH, false)
                .with(WEST, false));
    }

    @Override
    protected void appendProperties(StateManager.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
        builder.add(NORTH, EAST, SOUTH, WEST);
    }

    public static boolean canConnectTo(BlockState neighborState) {
        Block b = neighborState.getBlock();
        return b instanceof FactorioWallBlock || b instanceof FactorioGateBlock;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockState getPlacementState(ItemPlacementContext ctx) {
        BlockView world = ctx.getWorld();
        BlockPos pos = ctx.getBlockPos();
        return this.getDefaultState()
                .with(NORTH, canConnectTo(world.getBlockState(pos.north())))
                .with(EAST, canConnectTo(world.getBlockState(pos.east())))
                .with(SOUTH, canConnectTo(world.getBlockState(pos.south())))
                .with(WEST, canConnectTo(world.getBlockState(pos.west())));
    }

    @Override
    protected BlockState getStateForNeighborUpdate(BlockState state, Direction direction, BlockState neighborState,
                                                   WorldAccess world, BlockPos pos, BlockPos neighborPos) {
        return switch (direction) {
            case NORTH -> state.with(NORTH, canConnectTo(neighborState));
            case EAST -> state.with(EAST, canConnectTo(neighborState));
            case SOUTH -> state.with(SOUTH, canConnectTo(neighborState));
            case WEST -> state.with(WEST, canConnectTo(neighborState));
            default -> state;
        };
    }

    @Override
    protected VoxelShape getOutlineShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        return OUTLINE_SHAPE;

        for (LivingEntity victim : victims) {
            double dist = Math.sqrt(victim.squaredDistanceTo(cx, cy, cz));
            if (dist <= 4.0) {
                float factor = (float) Math.max(0.25, 1.0 - (dist / 4.2));
                victim.timeUntilRegen = 0;
                victim.damage(world.getDamageSources().explosion(null, null), 28.0f * factor);
                victim.addStatusEffect(new StatusEffectInstance(StatusEffects.SLOWNESS, 60, 2));
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
        nbt.putInt("ArmedTicks", this.armedTicks);
    }

    @Override
    protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
        this.armedTicks = nbt.getInt("ArmedTicks");
    }

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.combat.turret;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModBlocks;
import com.mojang.serialization.MapCodec;
import net.minecraft.block.*;
import net.minecraft.block.entity.BlockEntity;

public class TurretBlock extends BlockWithEntity {
    public static final MapCodec<TurretBlock> CODEC = createCodec(s -> new TurretBlock(s, 0));
    public static final DirectionProperty FACING = Properties.HORIZONTAL_FACING;
    public static final IntProperty PART = IntProperty.of("part", 0, 3);
    public static final BooleanProperty UPPER = BooleanProperty.of("upper");

    private static final VoxelShape BOTTOM_SHAPE = Block.createCuboidShape(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 16.0, 16.0);
    private static final VoxelShape TOP_SHAPE = Block.createCuboidShape(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 14.0, 16.0);

    // 0 = ÐŸÑƒÐ»ÐµÐ¼Ñ‘Ñ‚Ð½Ð°Ñ Ñ‚ÑƒÑ€ÐµÐ»ÑŒ (Gun Turret), 1 = Ð›Ð°Ð·ÐµÑ€Ð½Ð°Ñ Ñ‚ÑƒÑ€ÐµÐ»ÑŒ (Laser Turret), 2 = ÐžÐ³Ð½ÐµÐ¼Ñ‘Ñ‚Ð½Ð°Ñ Ñ‚ÑƒÑ€ÐµÐ»ÑŒ (Flamethrower Turret)
    private final int turretKind;

    public TurretBlock(Settings settings, int turretKind) {
        super(settings);
        this.turretKind = turretKind;
        this.setDefaultState(this.stateManager.getDefaultState()
                .with(FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                .with(PART, 0)
                .with(UPPER, false));
    }

    public int getTurretKind() {
        return this.turretKind;
    }

    public int getAttackRangeBlocks() {
        return switch (this.turretKind) {
            case 1 -> 24; // Ð›Ð°Ð·ÐµÑ€Ð½Ð°Ñ Ñ‚ÑƒÑ€ÐµÐ»ÑŒ
            case 2 -> 26; // ÐžÐ³Ð½ÐµÐ¼Ñ‘Ñ‚Ð½Ð°Ñ Ñ‚ÑƒÑ€ÐµÐ»ÑŒ
            default -> 18; // ÐŸÑƒÐ»ÐµÐ¼Ñ‘Ñ‚Ð½Ð°Ñ Ñ‚ÑƒÑ€ÐµÐ»ÑŒ
        };
    }

    @Override
    protected MapCodec<? extends BlockWithEntity> getCodec() {
        return CODEC;
    }

    @Override
    protected void appendProperties(StateManager.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
        builder.add(FACING, PART, UPPER);
    }

    public static BlockPos getPartPos(BlockPos masterPos, int part, boolean upper) {
        int dx = part % 2;
        int dz = part / 2;
        return masterPos.add(dx, upper ? 1 : 0, dz);
    }

    public static BlockPos getMasterPos(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof TurretBlock)) return pos;
        int part = state.get(PART);
        boolean upper = state.get(UPPER);
        return pos.add(-(part % 2), upper ? -1 : 0, -(part / 2));
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockState getPlacementState(ItemPlacementContext ctx) {
        Direction facing = ctx.getHorizontalPlayerFacing().getOpposite();
        if (ctx.getPlayer() != null && ctx.getPlayer().isSneaking()) {
            facing = facing.getOpposite();
        }
        World world = ctx.getWorld();
        BlockPos masterPos = ctx.getBlockPos();

        for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
            for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                BlockPos check = getPartPos(masterPos, part, u == 1);
                if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(check) || !world.getBlockState(check).canReplace(ctx)) {
                    return null;
                }
            }
        }
        return this.getDefaultState().with(FACING, facing).with(PART, 0).with(UPPER, false);
    }

    @Override
    public void onPlaced(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, @Nullable LivingEntity placer, ItemStack itemStack) {
        super.onPlaced(world, pos, state, placer, itemStack);
        if (!world.isClient && state.get(PART) == 0 && !state.get(UPPER)) {
            for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    if (part == 0 && u == 0) continue;
                    BlockPos p = getPartPos(pos, part, u == 1);
                    world.setBlockState(p, state.with(PART, part).with(UPPER, u == 1), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public BlockState onBreak(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, PlayerEntity player) {
        if (!world.isClient) {
            BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
            if (world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof TurretBlockEntity turretBe) {
                ItemScatterer.spawn(world, masterPos, turretBe);
            }
            for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = getPartPos(masterPos, part, u == 1);
                    if (!p.equals(pos) && world.getBlockState(p).isOf(this)) {
                        world.setBlockState(p, Blocks.AIR.getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL | Block.SKIP_DROPS);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return super.onBreak(world, pos, state, player);
    }

    @Override
    protected ActionResult onUse(BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos, PlayerEntity player, BlockHitResult hit) {
        if (!world.isClient) {
            BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
            if (world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof TurretBlockEntity turretBe) {
                player.openHandledScreen(turretBe);
            }
        }
        return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
    }

    @Override
    protected VoxelShape getOutlineShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        return state.get(UPPER) ? TOP_SHAPE : BOTTOM_SHAPE;
    }

    @Override
    protected VoxelShape getCollisionShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        return state.get(UPPER) ? TOP_SHAPE : BOTTOM_SHAPE;
    }

    @Override
    protected BlockRenderType getRenderType(BlockState state) {
        return BlockRenderType.INVISIBLE;
    }

    @Override
    protected float getAmbientOcclusionLightLevel(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos) {
        return 1.0f;
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean isTransparent(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos) {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    protected float calcBlockBreakingDelta(BlockState state, PlayerEntity player, BlockView world, BlockPos pos) {
        return 0.12f;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockEntity createBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        return (state.get(PART) == 0 && !state.get(UPPER)) ? new TurretBlockEntity(pos, state) : null;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public <T extends BlockEntity> BlockEntityTicker<T> getTicker(World world, BlockState state, BlockEntityType<T> type) {
        if (state.get(PART) != 0 || state.get(UPPER)) return null;
        return validateTicker(type, ModBlocks.TURRET_BLOCK_ENTITY,
                world.isClient ? TurretBlockEntity::clientTick : TurretBlockEntity::tick);
    }
}

            turret.activeFiringTicks--;
        }
    }

    public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, TurretBlockEntity turret) {
        if (world == null || world.isClient) return;

        int kind = turret.getTurretKind();
        boolean dirty = false;

        if (kind == 1) {
            boolean hasPower = PowerNetworkManager.isMachinePowered(world, pos);
            if (turret.powered != hasPower) {
                turret.powered = hasPower;
                dirty = true;
            }
        } else {
            turret.powered = true;
        }

        if (turret.fireCooldown > 0) {
            turret.fireCooldown--;
        }
        if (turret.activeFiringTicks > 0) {
            turret.activeFiringTicks--;
            if (turret.activeFiringTicks == 0) dirty = true;
        }

        boolean canAttack = switch (kind) {
            case 0 -> turret.ensureBulletLoaded();
            case 1 -> turret.powered;
            case 2 -> turret.fuelFluidMb >= 10;
            default -> false;
        };

        if (!canAttack) {
            if (dirty) turret.sync();
            return;
        }

        int range = (state.getBlock() instanceof TurretBlock tb) ? tb.getAttackRangeBlocks() : 18;
        Vec3d muzzlePos = new Vec3d(pos.getX() + 1.0, pos.getY() + 1.65, pos.getZ() + 1.0);
        LivingEntity target = findNearestHostileTarget(world, muzzlePos, range);

        if (target != null) {
            Vec3d targetCenter = target.getBoundingBox().getCenter();
            double dx = targetCenter.x - muzzlePos.x;
            double dy = targetCenter.y - muzzlePos.y;
            double dz = targetCenter.z - muzzlePos.z;
            double horizDist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);

            float desiredYaw = (float) (MathHelper.atan2(dz, dx) * (180.0 / Math.PI)) - 90.0f;
            float desiredPitch = (float) -(MathHelper.atan2(dy, horizDist) * (180.0 / Math.PI));

            turret.turretYaw = desiredYaw;
            turret.turretPitch = MathHelper.clamp(desiredPitch, -45.0f, 45.0f);
            turret.targetX = (float) targetCenter.x;
            turret.targetY = (float) targetCenter.y;
            turret.targetZ = (float) targetCenter.z;

            if (turret.fireCooldown <= 0 && world instanceof ServerWorld serverWorld) {
                turret.fireAtTarget(serverWorld, kind, muzzlePos, target);
                dirty = true;
            }
        }

        if (dirty) {
            turret.sync();
        }
    }

    @Nullable
    private static LivingEntity findNearestHostileTarget(World world, Vec3d center, int range) {
        Box searchBox = Box.of(center, range * 2.0, 18.0, range * 2.0);
        double maxDistSq = range * range;
        List<LivingEntity> hostiles = world.getEntitiesByClass(LivingEntity.class, searchBox, e ->
                e instanceof Monster && e.isAlive() && !e.isSpectator() && e.squaredDistanceTo(center) <= maxDistSq);
        if (hostiles.isEmpty()) return null;
        hostiles.sort(Comparator.comparingDouble(e -> e.squaredDistanceTo(center)));
        return hostiles.get(0);
    }

    private boolean ensureBulletLoaded() {
        if (this.currentMagazineRounds > 0) return true;
        ItemStack magStack = this.inventory.get(0);
        if (!magStack.isEmpty() && magStack.getItem() instanceof FactorioWeapons.AmmoMagazineItem mag) {
            this.currentMagazineRounds = mag.getRoundsPerMagazine();
            this.maxMagazineRounds = mag.getRoundsPerMagazine();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private void fireAtTarget(ServerWorld world, int kind, Vec3d muzzlePos, LivingEntity target) {
        float healthBefore = target.getHealth();
        target.timeUntilRegen = 0;

        if (kind == 0) {
            // 1. ÐŸÑƒÐ»ÐµÐ¼Ñ‘Ñ‚Ð½Ð°Ñ Ñ‚ÑƒÑ€ÐµÐ»ÑŒ (ÑÐºÐ¾Ñ€Ð¾ÑÑ‚Ñ€ÐµÐ»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾ÑÑ‚ÑŒ 5 Ð²Ñ‹ÑÑ‚Ñ€./ÑÐµÐº = ÐºÐ°Ð¶Ð´Ñ‹Ðµ 4 Ñ‚Ð¸ÐºÐ°)
            ItemStack magStack = this.inventory.get(0);
            float dmg = 5.0f;
            if (!magStack.isEmpty() && magStack.getItem() instanceof FactorioWeapons.AmmoMagazineItem mag) {
                dmg = mag.getDamagePerShot();
            }

            target.damage(world.getDamageSources().mobProjectile(null, null), dmg);
            this.currentMagazineRounds--;
            if (this.currentMagazineRounds <= 0 && !magStack.isEmpty()) {
                magStack.decrement(1);
                if (magStack.isEmpty()) {
                    this.inventory.set(0, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                } else if (magStack.getItem() instanceof FactorioWeapons.AmmoMagazineItem nextMag) {
                    this.currentMagazineRounds = nextMag.getRoundsPerMagazine();
                }
            }

            this.fireCooldown = 4;
            this.activeFiringTicks = 3;
            world.playSound(null, this.pos, SoundEvents.ENTITY_FIREWORK_ROCKET_BLAST, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 0.55f, 1.45f);
            world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.FLAME, muzzlePos.x, muzzlePos.y, muzzlePos.z, 3, 0.08, 0.08, 0.08, 0.02);
            world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.CRIT, target.getX(), target.getBodyY(0.5), target.getZ(), 4, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.05);
        } else if (kind == 1) {

            target.damage(world.getDamageSources().magic(), 10.0f);
            this.fireCooldown = 8;
            this.activeFiringTicks = 6;
            world.playSound(null, this.pos, SoundEvents.BLOCK_BEACON_DEACTIVATE, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 0.45f, 1.95f);
            world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.END_ROD, target.getX(), target.getBodyY(0.5), target.getZ(), 4, 0.12, 0.12, 0.12, 0.03);
        } else if (kind == 2) {
            // 3. ÐžÐ³Ð½ÐµÐ¼Ñ‘Ñ‚Ð½Ð°Ñ Ñ‚ÑƒÑ€ÐµÐ»ÑŒ (Ð±Ð¾Ð½ÑƒÑ ÑƒÑ€Ð¾Ð½Ð°: ÐÐµÑ„Ñ‚ÑŒ 100%, ÐœÐ°Ð·ÑƒÑ‚ 105%, Ð”Ð¸Ð·ÐµÐ»ÑŒ 110%)
            float fuelMul = (this.fuelFluidKind == FluidKind.LIGHT_OIL) ? 1.10f
                    : (this.fuelFluidKind == FluidKind.HEAVY_OIL ? 1.05f : 1.00f);
            this.fuelFluidMb = Math.max(0, this.fuelFluidMb - 12);
            if (this.fuelFluidMb == 0) this.fuelFluidKind = FluidKind.NONE;

            Vec3d targetPos = target.getBoundingBox().getCenter();
            Vec3d dir = targetPos.subtract(muzzlePos).normalize();
            double dist = muzzlePos.distanceTo(targetPos);

            for (double d = 0.8; d <= dist; d += 1.2) {
                Vec3d p = muzzlePos.add(dir.multiply(d));
                world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.FLAME, p.x, p.y, p.z, 3, 0.18, 0.12, 0.18, 0.02);
                if (d > 3.0) {
                    world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.LARGE_SMOKE, p.x, p.y + 0.1, p.z, 1, 0.15, 0.1, 0.15, 0.01);
                }
            }

            Box fireSplash = Box.of(targetPos, 4.5, 3.0, 4.5);
            for (LivingEntity victim : world.getEntitiesByClass(LivingEntity.class, fireSplash, e -> e instanceof Monster && e.isAlive())) {
                victim.timeUntilRegen = 0;
                victim.setOnFireFor(5);
                victim.damage(world.getDamageSources().onFire(), 8.0f * fuelMul);
            }

            this.fireCooldown = 5;
            this.activeFiringTicks = 5;
            world.playSound(null, this.pos, SoundEvents.ITEM_FIRECHARGE_USE, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 0.65f, 0.90f);
        }

        float dealt = Math.max(0.0f, healthBefore - Math.max(0.0f, target.getHealth()));
        this.totalDamageDealt += dealt;
        if (!target.isAlive()) {
            this.killsCount++;
        }
    }

    public void sync() {
        markDirty();
        if (this.world != null && !this.world.isClient) {
            this.world.updateListeners(this.pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
        }
    }

    // === Ð–Ð˜Ð”ÐšÐžÐ¡Ð¢ÐÐ«Ð™ Ð˜ÐÐ¢Ð•Ð Ð¤Ð•Ð™Ð¡ Ð”Ð›Ð¯ ÐžÐ“ÐÐ•ÐœÐÐ¢ÐÐžÐ™ Ð¢Ð£Ð Ð•Ð›Ð˜ ===
    @Override public FluidKind getFluidKind() { return this.fuelFluidMb > 0 ? this.fuelFluidKind : FluidKind.NONE; }
    @Override public int getFluidAmount() { return this.fuelFluidMb; }
    @Override public int getFluidCapacity() { return getTurretKind() == 2 ? FLAME_CAPACITY_MB : 0; }
    @Override public int getTemperatureC() { return 25; }

    @Override
    public boolean canAcceptFluid(FluidKind kind, Direction fromSide) {
        if (getTurretKind() != 2) return false;
        boolean validFuel = (kind == FluidKind.CRUDE_OIL || kind == FluidKind.HEAVY_OIL || kind == FluidKind.LIGHT_OIL);
        return validFuel && (this.fuelFluidMb == 0 || (this.fuelFluidKind == kind && this.fuelFluidMb < FLAME_CAPACITY_MB));
    }

    @Override
    public int insertFluid(FluidKind kind, int maxAmount, int tempC, Direction fromSide) {
        if (!canAcceptFluid(kind, fromSide) || maxAmount <= 0) return 0;
        int space = FLAME_CAPACITY_MB - this.fuelFluidMb;
        int add = Math.min(space, maxAmount);
        if (add > 0) {
            boolean wasEmpty = (this.fuelFluidMb == 0);
            this.fuelFluidKind = kind;
            this.fuelFluidMb += add;
            if (wasEmpty || (this.world != null && (this.world.getTime() & 3L) == 0L)) sync();
            else markDirty();
        }
        return add;
    }

    public TurretScreenHandler(int syncId, PlayerInventory playerInventory, TurretBlockEntity turretEntity, PropertyDelegate delegate) {

        this.turretEntity = turretEntity;
        this.inventory = turretEntity != null ? turretEntity : new SimpleInventory(1);
        this.propertyDelegate = delegate;
        this.addProperties(delegate);

        // Ð¡Ð»Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð¼Ð°Ð³Ð°Ð·Ð¸Ð½Ð° Ð¿Ð°Ñ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ð½Ð¾Ð² (Ð°ÐºÑ‚Ð¸Ð²ÐµÐ½ Ð´Ð»Ñ ÐŸÑƒÐ»ÐµÐ¼Ñ‘Ñ‚Ð½Ð¾Ð¹ Ñ‚ÑƒÑ€ÐµÐ»Ð¸)
        this.addSlot(new Slot(this.inventory, 0, 11, 88) {
            @Override
            public boolean canInsert(ItemStack stack) {
                return getTurretKind() == 0 && stack.getItem() instanceof FactorioWeapons.AmmoMagazineItem;
            }

            @Override
            public boolean isEnabled() {
                return getTurretKind() == 0;
            }
        });

        int invStartX = 38;
        for (int row = 0; row < 3; row++) {
            for (int col = 0; col < 9; col++) {
                this.addSlot(new Slot(playerInventory, col + row * 9 + 9, invStartX + col * 18, 138 + row * 18));
            }
        }
        for (int col = 0; col < 9; col++) {
            this.addSlot(new Slot(playerInventory, col, invStartX + col * 18, 196));
        }
    }

    public int getTurretKind() { return this.propertyDelegate.get(0); }

    public int getMaxRounds() { return Math.max(1, this.propertyDelegate.get(2)); }
    public int getFuelFluidMb() { return this.propertyDelegate.get(3); }
    public boolean isPowered() { return this.propertyDelegate.get(4) != 0; }
    public int getKillsCount() { return this.propertyDelegate.get(5); }
    public int getTotalDamage() { return this.propertyDelegate.get(6); }

    @Override
    public ItemStack quickMove(PlayerEntity player, int invSlot) {
        ItemStack newStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        Slot slot = this.slots.get(invSlot);
        if (slot != null && slot.hasStack()) {
            ItemStack originalStack = slot.getStack();
            newStack = originalStack.copy();
            if (invSlot == 0) {
                if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, 1, this.slots.size(), true)) {
                    return ItemStack.EMPTY;
                }
            } else if (getTurretKind() == 0 && originalStack.getItem() instanceof FactorioWeapons.AmmoMagazineItem) {
                if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, 0, 1, false)) {
                    return ItemStack.EMPTY;
                }
            } else {
                return ItemStack.EMPTY;
            }
            if (originalStack.isEmpty()) slot.setStack(ItemStack.EMPTY);
            else slot.markDirty();
        }
        return newStack;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canUse(PlayerEntity player) {
        return this.inventory.canPlayerUse(player);
    }
}

    public static class FactorioGunItem extends Item {
        public enum GunKind {
            PISTOL(18.0, 8, 1, 1.0f),
            SUBMACHINE_GUN(20.0, 3, 1, 2.2f),
            SHOTGUN(15.0, 14, 12, 7.5f);

            public final float spreadDegrees;

            GunKind(double range, int fireIntervalTicks, int pellets, float spreadDegrees) {

                this.pellets = pellets;
                this.spreadDegrees = spreadDegrees;

        @Override
