    private static int getMaxColsLeftOfHotbar(int screenW) {
        int hotbarLeft = (screenW / 2) - 95;
        int availPx = Math.max(48, hotbarLeft - 8);
        return MathHelper.clamp(availPx / 24, 2, 7);
    }

    public static void renderBottomLeftQueue(DrawContext context, boolean isInventoryScreen) {
        if (recipeIds.isEmpty()) return;
        MinecraftClient client = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        if (client.player == null) return;

        int screenH = context.getScaledWindowHeight();

        int boxSize = 22;

        int startX = 6;
        int baseY = screenH - boxSize - 6;

        int maxCols = getMaxColsLeftOfHotbar(screenW);
        int totalItems = recipeIds.size();

        boolean canExpand = totalItems > (maxCols - 1);

        if (!showExpanded) {
            // Ð¡Ð²Ñ‘Ñ€Ð½ÑƒÑ‚Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¾Ð´Ð½Ð¾ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ñ€ÐµÐ¶Ð¸Ð¼ (ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ ÑÐ»ÐµÐ²Ð° Ð¾Ñ‚ Ñ…Ð¾Ñ‚Ð±Ð°Ñ€Ð°!)
            int visibleSlots = canExpand ? (maxCols - 1) : Math.min(totalItems, maxCols);

                drawQueueCell(context, tr, i, bx, baseY, boxSize);
            }

                    drawExpandArrowButton(context, tr, btnX, baseY, boxSize, ">>", totalItems - visibleSlots);

        }

    private static void drawQueueCell(DrawContext context, TextRenderer tr, int index, int bx, int by, int boxSize) {
        FactorioRecipes.Recipe r = FactorioRecipes.getById(recipeIds.get(index));
        if (r == null) return;

        context.fill(bx, by, bx + boxSize, by + boxSize, 0xF0141414);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + boxSize - 1, by + boxSize - 1, (index == 0) ? 0xF04A3B22 : 0xF02C2D30);

        if (index == 0) {
            float ratio = MathHelper.clamp(currentProgress / (float) currentMax, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            int fillH = Math.round(ratio * (boxSize - 2));
            if (fillH > 0) {
                context.fill(bx + 1, by + boxSize - 1 - fillH, bx + boxSize - 1, by + boxSize - 1, 0xCCDF8B1E);
            }
        }

        context.drawItem(r.output(), bx + 3, by + 3);

        int cnt = (index < counts.size()) ? counts.get(index) : 1;
        String cntStr = String.valueOf(cnt);
        int tw = tr.getWidth(cntStr);
        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(0.0f, 0.0f, 200.0f);
        context.drawText(tr, cntStr, bx + boxSize - tw - 1, by + boxSize - 9, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);
        context.getMatrices().pop();
    }

    private static void drawExpandArrowButton(DrawContext context, TextRenderer tr, int bx, int by,
                                              int boxSize, String arrow, int extraCount) {
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + boxSize, by + boxSize, 0xF0141414);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + boxSize - 1, by + boxSize - 1, 0xF03B3D42);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + boxSize - 1, by + 3, 0xFFE59524);

        int aw = tr.getWidth(arrow);
        context.drawText(tr, arrow, bx + (boxSize - aw) / 2, by + (extraCount > 0 ? 4 : 7), 0xFFFFCC66, true);

        if (extraCount > 0) {
            String plusStr = "+" + extraCount;
            int pw = tr.getWidth(plusStr);
            context.drawText(tr, plusStr, bx + (boxSize - pw) / 2, by + 13, 0xFFCCCCCC, false);
        }
    }

    private static void drawHiddenCountBadge(DrawContext context, TextRenderer tr, int bx, int by,
                                             int boxSize, String label) {
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + boxSize, by + boxSize, 0xD0141414);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + boxSize - 1, by + boxSize - 1, 0xD0252629);
        int lw = tr.getWidth(label);
        context.drawText(tr, label, bx + (boxSize - lw) / 2, by + 7, 0xFFAAAAAA, true);
    }

    public static boolean handleMouseClick(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, int screenW, int screenH) {
        if (recipeIds.isEmpty()) return false;

        int boxSize = 22;
        int step = boxSize + 2;
        int startX = 6;
        int baseY = screenH - boxSize - 6;

        int maxCols = getMaxColsLeftOfHotbar(screenW);
        int totalItems = recipeIds.size();
        boolean canExpand = totalItems > (maxCols - 1);
        boolean showExpanded = expandedInInventory && canExpand;

        if (!showExpanded) {
            int visibleSlots = canExpand ? (maxCols - 1) : Math.min(totalItems, maxCols);

            // ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ ÐºÐ½Ð¾Ð¿ÐºÐµ Ñ€Ð°ÑÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸ [>>]
            if (canExpand) {
                int btnX = startX + visibleSlots * step;
                if (mouseX >= btnX && mouseX <= btnX + boxSize && mouseY >= baseY && mouseY <= baseY + boxSize) {
                    expandedInInventory = true;
                    return true;
                }
            }

            // ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ Ð²Ð¸Ð´Ð¸Ð¼Ð¾Ð¹ ÑÑ‡ÐµÐ¹ÐºÐµ Ð´Ð»Ñ Ð¾Ñ‚Ð¼ÐµÐ½Ñ‹
            for (int i = 0; i < visibleSlots && i < totalItems; i++) {
                int bx = startX + i * step;
                if (mouseX >= bx && mouseX <= bx + boxSize && mouseY >= baseY && mouseY <= baseY + boxSize) {
                    ClientPlayNetworking.send(new RequestCraftPayload(recipeIds.get(i), -1));
                    return true;
                }
            }
        } else {
            // ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ ÐºÐ½Ð¾Ð¿ÐºÐµ ÑÐ²Ð¾Ñ€Ð°Ñ‡Ð¸Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ñ [<<]
            int collapseCol = totalItems % maxCols;
            int collapseRow = totalItems / maxCols;
            int btnX = startX + collapseCol * step;
            int btnY = baseY - collapseRow * step;
            if (mouseX >= btnX && mouseX <= btnX + boxSize && mouseY >= btnY && mouseY <= btnY + boxSize) {
                expandedInInventory = false;
                return true;
            }

            // ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ Ð»ÑŽÐ±Ð¾Ð¹ ÑÑ‡ÐµÐ¹ÐºÐµ Ð² Ñ€Ð°ÑÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¹ ÑÐµÑ‚ÐºÐµ
            for (int i = 0; i < totalItems; i++) {
                int col = i % maxCols;
                int rowFromBottom = i / maxCols;
                int bx = startX + col * step;
                int by = baseY - rowFromBottom * step;
                if (mouseX >= bx && mouseX <= bx + boxSize && mouseY >= by && mouseY <= by + boxSize) {
                    ClientPlayNetworking.send(new RequestCraftPayload(recipeIds.get(i), -1));
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public FactorioCharacterScreen() {
        super(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.character"));
        FactorioRecipes.init();
    }

    public boolean shouldPause() {
        return false;
    }

    private int mapMainGridToPacketSlot(int gridIdx) {
        if (gridIdx >= 0 && gridIdx < 9) {
            return 36 + gridIdx;
        }
        if (gridIdx >= 9 && gridIdx < 36) {
            return gridIdx;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    private int mapEquipIndexToPacketSlot(int equipIdx) {
        if (equipIdx >= 0 && equipIdx < 4) {
            return 5 + equipIdx;
        }
        if (equipIdx == 4) {
            return 45;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    private ItemStack getEquipStack(PlayerInventory inv, int equipIdx) {
        if (equipIdx >= 0 && equipIdx < 4) {
            return inv.armor.get(3 - equipIdx);
        }
        if (equipIdx == 4) {
            return inv.offHand.get(0);
        }
        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        this.renderBackground(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);
        if (this.client == null || this.client.player == null) return;

        PlayerEntity player = this.client.player;
        PlayerInventory inv = player.getInventory();

        int x = (this.width - PANEL_W) / 2;
        int y = (this.height - PANEL_H) / 2;
        int midX = x + PANEL_W / 2;

        // 1. Ð’Ð½ÐµÑˆÐ½Ð¸Ð¹ ÐºÐ¾Ñ€Ð¿ÑƒÑ Ð´Ð²ÑƒÑ…Ð¿Ð°Ð½ÐµÐ»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ Ð¾ÐºÐ½Ð° Factorio
        context.fill(x, y, x + PANEL_W, y + PANEL_H, 0xFF121213);
        context.fill(x + 1, y + 1, x + PANEL_W - 1, y + PANEL_H - 1, 0xFF313235);
        context.fill(midX - 1, y + 1, midX + 1, y + PANEL_H - 1, 0xFF18191A);

        // 2. Ð¨Ð°Ð¿ÐºÐ° ÑÐ»ÐµÐ²Ð°: "ÐŸÐµÑ€ÑÐ¾Ð½Ð°Ð¶ â€” ÐÐ¸Ðº"
        Text leftTitle = Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.character")
                .copy()
                .append(Text.literal(" \u2014 " + player.getName().getString()).styled(s -> s.withColor(0xFFFFCC66)));
        drawFactorioHeader(context, x + 3, y + 3, PANEL_W / 2 - 5, leftTitle, 6);

        // 3. Ð¨Ð°Ð¿ÐºÐ° ÑÐ¿Ñ€Ð°Ð²Ð°: "Ð¡Ð¾Ð·Ð´Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ðµ" + Ð¿Ð¾Ð¸ÑÐº Ð¸ Ð½Ð°ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ð¹ÐºÐ¸
        int rightHeaderX = midX + 2;
        int rightHeaderW = PANEL_W / 2 - 5;
        int rightReserved = this.searchActive ? 96 : 38;
        drawFactorioHeader(context, rightHeaderX, y + 3, rightHeaderW, Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.crafting"), rightReserved);

        if (this.searchActive) {
            int boxW = 90;
            int boxH = 12;
            int boxX = x + PANEL_W - boxW - 5;
            int boxY = y + 4;
            context.fill(boxX, boxY, boxX + boxW, boxY + boxH, 0xFF111112);
            context.fill(boxX + 1, boxY + 1, boxX + boxW - 1, boxY + boxH - 1, 0xFF1E1F22);
            context.fill(boxX + 1, boxY + boxH - 2, boxX + boxW - 1, boxY + boxH - 1, 0xFFE59524);

            String cursor = ((System.currentTimeMillis() / 500L) % 2L == 0L) ? "_" : "";
            String shown = this.textRenderer.trimToWidth(this.searchQuery, boxW - 12) + cursor;
            context.drawText(this.textRenderer, shown, boxX + 4, boxY + 2, 0xFFFFEAAA, false);
        } else {
            int searchBtnX = x + PANEL_W - 19;
            int searchBtnY = y + 4;
            drawMagnifierButton(context, searchBtnX, searchBtnY, 14, 12, mouseX, mouseY);
            drawGearSettingsButton(context, searchBtnX - 16, searchBtnY, 14, 12, mouseX, mouseY);
        }

        // 4. Ð›ÐµÐ²Ð°Ñ Ð¿Ð°Ð½ÐµÐ»ÑŒ: Ð¡ÐµÑ‚ÐºÐ° Ð¸Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð°Ñ€Ñ (10x6) + ÑÐºÐ¸Ð¿Ð¸Ñ€Ð¾Ð²ÐºÐ°
        int leftGridX = x + 12;
        int leftGridY = y + 22;

        context.fill(leftGridX - 2, leftGridY - 2,
                leftGridX + COLS * SLOT_SIZE + 2, leftGridY + INV_ROWS * SLOT_SIZE + 2, 0xFF18181A);

        ItemStack hoveredInvStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        for (int r = 0; r < INV_ROWS; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
                int idx = c + r * COLS;
                int sx = leftGridX + c * SLOT_SIZE;
                int sy = leftGridY + r * SLOT_SIZE;
                boolean unlocked = (idx < 36);
                boolean hovered = unlocked && isHoveringSlot(mouseX, mouseY, sx, sy);

                drawFactorioSlot(context, sx, sy, !unlocked, hovered);
                if (unlocked) {
                    ItemStack stack = inv.main.get(idx);
                    if (!stack.isEmpty()) {
                        drawStackInSlot(context, stack, sx + 1, sy + 1);
                        if (hovered) {
                            hoveredInvStack = stack;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int divY = leftGridY + INV_ROWS * SLOT_SIZE + 8;
        context.fill(leftGridX - 2, divY, leftGridX + COLS * SLOT_SIZE + 2, divY + 1, 0xFF202123);
        context.fill(leftGridX - 2, divY + 1, leftGridX + COLS * SLOT_SIZE + 2, divY + 2, 0xFF3E4043);

        int equipY = y + PANEL_H - 28;
        context.fill(leftGridX - 2, equipY - 2, leftGridX + 4 * SLOT_SIZE + 2, equipY + SLOT_SIZE + 2, 0xFF18181A);
        int offhandX = leftGridX + 4 * SLOT_SIZE + 8;
        context.fill(offhandX - 2, equipY - 2, offhandX + SLOT_SIZE + 2, equipY + SLOT_SIZE + 2, 0xFF18181A);

        for (int e = 0; e < 5; e++) {
            int ex = (e < 4) ? (leftGridX + e * SLOT_SIZE) : offhandX;
            boolean hovered = isHoveringSlot(mouseX, mouseY, ex, equipY);
            drawFactorioSlot(context, ex, equipY, false, hovered);

            ItemStack eqStack = getEquipStack(inv, e);
            if (!eqStack.isEmpty()) {
                drawStackInSlot(context, eqStack, ex + 1, equipY + 1);
                if (hovered) {
                    hoveredInvStack = eqStack;
                }
            } else {
                drawEquipmentSilhouette(context, ex + 1, equipY + 1, e);
            }
        }

        // 5. ÐŸÑ€Ð°Ð²Ð°Ñ Ð¿Ð°Ð½ÐµÐ»ÑŒ: 4 Ð²ÐºÐ»Ð°Ð´ÐºÐ¸ ÐºÐ°Ñ‚ÐµÐ³Ð¾Ñ€Ð¸Ð¹ Ð¸ ÑÐµÑ‚ÐºÐ° ÐºÑ€Ð°Ñ„Ñ‚Ð° (10x8)
        int rightGridX = midX + 12;
        int tabBarY = y + 22;
        int tabW = (COLS * SLOT_SIZE + 4) / 4;
        int tabH = 30;

        FactorioRecipes.Category[] cats = FactorioRecipes.Category.values();
        ItemStack[] tabIcons = {
                new ItemStack(ModBlocks.BELT),
                new ItemStack(ModBlocks.STONE_FURNACE),
                new ItemStack(ModItems.ELECTRONIC_CIRCUIT),
                new ItemStack(ModItems.REPAIR_PACK)
        };

        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            int tx = rightGridX - 2 + i * tabW;
            boolean selected = (cats[i] == this.activeCategory);
            boolean hovered = mouseX >= tx && mouseX < tx + tabW && mouseY >= tabBarY && mouseY < tabBarY + tabH;

            int tabBg = selected ? 0xFF6B6D70 : (hovered ? 0xFF4A4C50 : 0xFF383A3D);
            context.fill(tx, tabBarY, tx + tabW - 1, tabBarY + tabH, 0xFF18181A);
            context.fill(tx + 1, tabBarY + 1, tx + tabW - 2, tabBarY + tabH - (selected ? 0 : 1), tabBg);

            context.getMatrices().push();
            context.getMatrices().translate(tx + tabW / 2.0f - 10.5f, tabBarY + 4.5f, 100.0f);
            context.getMatrices().scale(1.3f, 1.3f, 1.0f);
            context.drawItem(tabIcons[i], 0, 0);
            context.getMatrices().pop();
        }

        int rightGridY = y + 56;
        context.fill(rightGridX - 2, rightGridY - 2,
                rightGridX + COLS * SLOT_SIZE + 2, rightGridY + CRAFT_ROWS * SLOT_SIZE + 2, 0xFF18181A);

        for (int r = 0; r < CRAFT_ROWS; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
                int sx = rightGridX + c * SLOT_SIZE;
                int sy = rightGridY + r * SLOT_SIZE;
                context.fill(sx, sy, sx + SLOT_SIZE, sy + SLOT_SIZE, 0xFF1A1B1D);
                context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 1, sx + SLOT_SIZE - 1, sy + SLOT_SIZE - 1, 0xFF242528);
            }
        }

        FactorioRecipes.Recipe hoveredRecipe = null;
        String queryLower = this.searchQuery.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        List<List<FactorioRecipes.Recipe>> compactedRows = FactorioRecipes.getCompactedRows(this.activeCategory, queryLower, COLS);

        for (int r = 0; r < Math.min(CRAFT_ROWS, compactedRows.size()); r++) {
            List<FactorioRecipes.Recipe> rowRecipes = compactedRows.get(r);
            for (int c = 0; c < Math.min(COLS, rowRecipes.size()); c++) {
                FactorioRecipes.Recipe recipe = rowRecipes.get(c);
                int sx = rightGridX + c * SLOT_SIZE;
                int sy = rightGridY + r * SLOT_SIZE;

                int craftable = player.isCreative() ? 99 : FactorioRecipes.getCraftableCount(inv, recipe);
                boolean canCraft = craftable > 0;
                boolean hovered = isHoveringSlot(mouseX, mouseY, sx, sy);
                if (hovered) {
                    hoveredRecipe = recipe;
                }

                int borderCol = hovered ? 0xFFE59524 : 0xFF141414;
                int innerCol = hovered ? 0xFF525458 : (canCraft ? 0xFF3A3C3F : 0xFF28292C);
                context.fill(sx, sy, sx + SLOT_SIZE, sy + SLOT_SIZE, borderCol);
                context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 1, sx + SLOT_SIZE - 1, sy + SLOT_SIZE - 1, innerCol);

                context.drawItem(recipe.output(), sx + 1, sy + 1);

                if (craftable > 0) {
                    String cntStr = (craftable > 99) ? "99+" : String.valueOf(craftable);
                    context.getMatrices().push();
                    context.getMatrices().translate(0.0f, 0.0f, 200.0f);
                    context.getMatrices().scale(0.65f, 0.65f, 1.0f);
                    int tw = this.textRenderer.getWidth(cntStr);
                    int tx = (int) ((sx + 17) / 0.65f) - tw;
                    int ty = (int) ((sy + 12) / 0.65f);
                    context.drawText(this.textRenderer, cntStr, tx, ty, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);
                    context.getMatrices().pop();
                }
            }
        }

        // 6. ÐŸÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚ Ð½Ð° ÐºÑƒÑ€ÑÐ¾Ñ€Ðµ
        ItemStack cursorStack = player.playerScreenHandler.getCursorStack();
        if (!cursorStack.isEmpty()) {
            context.getMatrices().push();
            context.getMatrices().translate(0.0f, 0.0f, 350.0f);
            context.drawItem(cursorStack, mouseX - 8, mouseY - 8);
            context.drawItemInSlot(this.textRenderer, cursorStack, mouseX - 8, mouseY - 8);
            context.getMatrices().pop();
        }

        // 7. ÐžÑ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´ÑŒ ÐºÑ€Ð°Ñ„Ñ‚Ð° Ð² Ð»ÐµÐ²Ð¾Ð¼ Ð½Ð¸Ð¶Ð½ÐµÐ¼ ÑƒÐ³Ð»Ñƒ ÑÐºÑ€Ð°Ð½Ð°
        ClientCraftingQueueHud.renderBottomLeftQueue(context, true);

        // 8. Ð¢ÑƒÐ»Ñ‚Ð¸Ð¿Ñ‹ Ñ€ÐµÑ†ÐµÐ¿Ñ‚Ð¾Ð² Ð¸ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚Ð¾Ð²
        if (cursorStack.isEmpty()) {
            if (hoveredRecipe != null) {
                renderCustomFactorioRecipeCard(context, hoveredRecipe, inv, mouseX, mouseY);
            } else if (!hoveredInvStack.isEmpty()) {
                context.drawItemTooltip(this.textRenderer, hoveredInvStack, mouseX, mouseY);
            }
        }
    }

    public void renderCustomFactorioRecipeCard(DrawContext context, FactorioRecipes.Recipe recipe,
                                               PlayerInventory inv, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        renderRecipeCard(context, this.textRenderer, this.width, this.height, recipe, inv, mouseX, mouseY, true);
    }

    /**
     * ÐžÐ±Ñ‰Ð¸Ð¹ ÑÑ‚Ð°Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ‡ÐµÑÐºÐ¸Ð¹ Ñ€ÐµÐ½Ð´ÐµÑ€ ÐºÐ°Ñ€Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ‡ÐºÐ¸ Ñ€ÐµÑ†ÐµÐ¿Ñ‚Ð° Ð² ÑÑ‚Ð¸Ð»Ðµ Factorio (Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ¸ÑÐ¿Ð¾Ð»ÑŒÐ·ÑƒÐµÑ‚ÑÑ Ð² CharacterScreen Ð¸ AssemblerScreen).
     */
    public static void renderRecipeCard(DrawContext context, TextRenderer textRenderer,
                                        int screenWidth, int screenHeight,
                                        FactorioRecipes.Recipe recipe, PlayerInventory inv,
                                        int mouseX, int mouseY, boolean allowSubCraftHighlight) {
        Map<Item, Integer> invCounts = FactorioRecipes.snapshotInventory(inv);
        Map<Item, Integer> totalRaw = FactorioRecipes.calculateTotalRaw(recipe);

        String titleStr = recipe.output().getName().getString()
                + (recipe.output().getCount() > 1 ? " \u00d7" + recipe.output().getCount() : "");

        int cardW = Math.max(156, textRenderer.getWidth(titleStr) + 32);
        for (FactorioRecipes.Ingredient ing : recipe.ingredients()) {
            int have = invCounts.getOrDefault(ing.item(), 0);
            String line = ing.count() + " \u00d7 " + ing.item().getName().getString() + " (" + have + ")";
            cardW = Math.max(cardW, textRenderer.getWidth(line) + 28);
        }

        if (!totalRaw.isEmpty()) {
            int rawW = 16 + textRenderer.getWidth(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.total_raw"));
            for (Map.Entry<Item, Integer> entry : totalRaw.entrySet()) {
                rawW += 20 + textRenderer.getWidth(String.valueOf(entry.getValue()));
            }
            cardW = Math.max(cardW, rawW + 8);
        }

        int ingCount = recipe.ingredients().size();
        int rawSectionH = totalRaw.isEmpty() ? 0 : 28;
        int cardH = 24 + 14 + ingCount * 14 + rawSectionH + 6;

        int tx = mouseX + 12;
        int ty = mouseY - 8;
        if (tx + cardW > screenWidth - 6) {
            tx = mouseX - cardW - 12;
        }
        if (ty + cardH > screenHeight - 6) {
            ty = screenHeight - cardH - 6;
        }
        if (ty < 6) ty = 6;

        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(0.0f, 0.0f, 400.0f);

        context.fill(tx, ty, tx + cardW, ty + cardH, 0xF8111214);
        context.fill(tx + 1, ty + 1, tx + cardW - 1, ty + cardH - 1, 0xF426272A);

        context.fill(tx + 2, ty + 2, tx + cardW - 2, ty + 21, 0xFF3E301B);
        context.fill(tx + 2, ty + 20, tx + cardW - 2, ty + 21, 0xFFE59524);
        context.drawItem(recipe.output(), tx + 4, ty + 3);
        context.drawText(textRenderer, titleStr, tx + 24, ty + 7, 0xFFFFD670, true);

        int curY = ty + 25;

        drawClockIconStatic(context, tx + 6, curY + 1);
        context.drawText(textRenderer,
                Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.craft_time", String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.1f", recipe.getSeconds())),
                tx + 18, curY + 1, 0xFFCCCCCC, false);
        curY += 13;

        for (FactorioRecipes.Ingredient ing : recipe.ingredients()) {
            int have = invCounts.getOrDefault(ing.item(), 0);
            int textColor;
            if (have >= ing.count()) {
                textColor = 0xFF66EE66;
            } else if (allowSubCraftHighlight) {
                FactorioRecipes.Recipe sub = FactorioRecipes.getByOutput(ing.item());
                int canSub = (sub != null) ? FactorioRecipes.getCraftableCount(inv, sub) : 0;
                textColor = (have + canSub >= ing.count()) ? 0xFFFFCC44 : 0xFFFF5555;
            } else {
                textColor = 0xFFFF5555;
            }

            context.getMatrices().push();
            context.getMatrices().translate(tx + 5, curY, 0.0f);
            context.getMatrices().scale(0.75f, 0.75f, 1.0f);
            context.drawItem(new ItemStack(ing.item()), 0, 0);
            context.getMatrices().pop();

            String ingLine = ing.count() + " \u00d7 " + ing.item().getName().getString() + " (" + have + ")";
            context.drawText(textRenderer, ingLine, tx + 20, curY + 2, textColor, false);
            curY += 14;
        }

        if (!totalRaw.isEmpty()) {
            curY += 2;
            context.fill(tx + 4, curY, tx + cardW - 4, curY + 1, 0xFF18191B);
            context.fill(tx + 4, curY + 1, tx + cardW - 4, curY + 2, 0xFF3A3C40);
            curY += 5;

            Text rawLabel = Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.total_raw");
            context.drawText(textRenderer, rawLabel, tx + 6, curY + 4, 0xFF999B9F, false);

            int iconX = tx + 10 + textRenderer.getWidth(rawLabel);
            for (Map.Entry<Item, Integer> entry : totalRaw.entrySet()) {
                context.getMatrices().push();
                context.getMatrices().translate(iconX, curY + 1, 0.0f);
                context.getMatrices().scale(0.8f, 0.8f, 1.0f);
                context.drawItem(new ItemStack(entry.getKey()), 0, 0);
                context.getMatrices().pop();

                String countText = String.valueOf(entry.getValue());
                context.drawText(textRenderer, countText, iconX + 14, curY + 4, 0xFFE6E6E6, true);
                iconX += 18 + textRenderer.getWidth(countText);
            }
        }

        context.getMatrices().pop();
    }

    private static void drawClockIconStatic(DrawContext context, int cx, int cy) {
        context.fill(cx + 1, cy, cx + 7, cy + 8, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(cx, cy + 1, cx + 8, cy + 7, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(cx + 1, cy + 1, cx + 7, cy + 7, 0xFFD8D8D8);
        context.fill(cx + 3, cy + 2, cx + 4, cy + 5, 0xFF232426);
        context.fill(cx + 4, cy + 4, cx + 6, cy + 5, 0xFF232426);
    }

    private void drawGearSettingsButton(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw, int bh, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        boolean hovered = mouseX >= bx && mouseX < bx + bw && mouseY >= by && mouseY < by + bh;
        int bg = hovered ? 0xFFE59524 : 0xFF35373A;
        int col = hovered ? 0xFF141414 : 0xFFE6E6E6;
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + bw, by + bh, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + bw - 1, by + bh - 1, bg);
        context.fill(bx + 4, by + 3, bx + 10, by + 9, col);
        context.fill(bx + 6, by + 2, bx + 8, by + 10, col);
        context.fill(bx + 3, by + 5, bx + 11, by + 7, col);
        context.fill(bx + 6, by + 5, bx + 8, by + 7, bg);
    }

    private void drawMagnifierButton(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw, int bh, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        boolean hovered = mouseX >= bx && mouseX < bx + bw && mouseY >= by && mouseY < by + bh;
        int bg = hovered ? 0xFF4C4E52 : 0xFF35373A;
        context.fill(bx, by, bx + bw, by + bh, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(bx + 1, by + 1, bx + bw - 1, by + bh - 1, bg);

        int lx = bx + 4;
        int ly = by + 2;
        int col = 0xFFE6E6E6;
        context.fill(lx + 1, ly, lx + 4, ly + 1, col);
        context.fill(lx, ly + 1, lx + 1, ly + 4, col);
        context.fill(lx + 4, ly + 1, lx + 5, ly + 4, col);
        context.fill(lx + 1, ly + 4, lx + 4, ly + 5, col);
        context.fill(lx + 4, ly + 5, lx + 6, ly + 7, col);
    }

    private void drawEquipmentSilhouette(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy, int equipIdx) {
        int c = 0xFF525458;
        switch (equipIdx) {
            case 0 -> {
                context.fill(sx + 4, sy + 3, sx + 12, sy + 6, c);
                context.fill(sx + 3, sy + 6, sx + 13, sy + 12, c);
                context.fill(sx + 5, sy + 8, sx + 11, sy + 12, 0xFF333538);
            }
            case 1 -> {
                context.fill(sx + 3, sy + 3, sx + 13, sy + 7, c);
                context.fill(sx + 6, sy + 3, sx + 10, sy + 5, 0xFF333538);
                context.fill(sx + 4, sy + 7, sx + 12, sy + 13, c);
            }
            case 2 -> {
                context.fill(sx + 4, sy + 3, sx + 12, sy + 6, c);
                context.fill(sx + 4, sy + 6, sx + 7, sy + 13, c);
                context.fill(sx + 9, sy + 6, sx + 12, sy + 13, c);
            }
            case 3 -> {
                context.fill(sx + 4, sy + 6, sx + 7, sy + 12, c);
                context.fill(sx + 3, sy + 10, sx + 7, sy + 13, c);
                context.fill(sx + 9, sy + 6, sx + 12, sy + 12, c);
                context.fill(sx + 9, sy + 10, sx + 13, sy + 13, c);
            }
            default -> {
                context.fill(sx + 4, sy + 3, sx + 12, sy + 10, c);
                context.fill(sx + 5, sy + 10, sx + 11, sy + 12, c);
                context.fill(sx + 6, sy + 12, sx + 10, sy + 14, c);
            }
        }
    }

    private void drawFactorioHeader(DrawContext context, int hx, int hy, int hw, Text title, int rightPadding) {
        context.fill(hx, hy, hx + hw, hy + 14, 0xFF232426);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, title, hx + 6, hy + 3, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);

        int startRibs = hx + 12 + this.textRenderer.getWidth(title);
        int endRibs = hx + hw - rightPadding;
        for (int rx = startRibs; rx < endRibs; rx += 3) {
            context.fill(rx, hy + 3, rx + 1, hy + 11, 0xFF18191B);
        }
    }

    private void drawFactorioSlot(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy, boolean locked, boolean hovered) {
        int border = hovered ? 0xFFE59524 : 0xFF141414;
        int inner = locked ? 0xFF202124 : (hovered ? 0xFF4A4C50 : 0xFF333538);
        context.fill(sx, sy, sx + SLOT_SIZE, sy + SLOT_SIZE, border);
        context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 1, sx + SLOT_SIZE - 1, sy + SLOT_SIZE - 1, inner);
    }

    private void drawStackInSlot(DrawContext context, ItemStack stack, int x, int y) {
        context.drawItem(stack, x, y);
        context.drawItemInSlot(this.textRenderer, stack, x, y);
    }

    private boolean isHoveringSlot(double mx, double my, int sx, int sy) {
        return mx >= sx && mx < sx + SLOT_SIZE && my >= sy && my < sy + SLOT_SIZE;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (this.client == null || this.client.player == null || this.client.interactionManager == null) {
            return false;
        }

        if (ClientCraftingQueueHud.handleMouseClick(mouseX, mouseY, button, this.width, this.height)) {
            return true;
        }

        int syncId = this.client.player.playerScreenHandler.syncId;
        int x = (this.width - PANEL_W) / 2;
        int y = (this.height - PANEL_H) / 2;
        int midX = x + PANEL_W / 2;

        // 1. ÐšÐ½Ð¾Ð¿ÐºÐ¸ Ð¿Ð¾Ð¸ÑÐºÐ° Ð¸ Ð½Ð°ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾ÐµÐº Ð² ÑˆÐ°Ð¿ÐºÐµ
        if (!this.searchActive) {
            int searchBtnX = x + PANEL_W - 19;
            int searchBtnY = y + 4;
            int gearBtnX = searchBtnX - 16;
            if (mouseX >= gearBtnX && mouseX < gearBtnX + 14 && mouseY >= searchBtnY && mouseY < searchBtnY + 12) {
                this.client.setScreen(new FactorioConfigScreen(this));
                return true;
            }
            if (mouseX >= searchBtnX && mouseX < searchBtnX + 14 && mouseY >= searchBtnY && mouseY < searchBtnY + 12) {
                this.searchActive = true;
                return true;
            }
        } else {
            int boxX = x + PANEL_W - 95;
            int boxY = y + 4;
            if (mouseX >= boxX && mouseX <= boxX + 90 && mouseY >= boxY && mouseY <= boxY + 12) {
                if (button == 1) {
                    this.searchQuery = "";
                }
                return true;
            } else if (this.searchQuery.isEmpty()) {
                this.searchActive = false;
            }
        }

        // 2. ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ Ð¾ÑÐ½Ð¾Ð²Ð½Ð¾Ð¹ ÑÐµÑ‚ÐºÐµ Ð¸Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð°Ñ€Ñ (36 Ð¾Ñ‚ÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ñ‚Ñ‹Ñ… ÑÐ»Ð¾Ñ‚Ð¾Ð² Ð² ÑÐµÑ‚ÐºÐµ INV_ROWS x COLS)
        int leftGridX = x + 12;
        int leftGridY = y + 22;
        for (int r = 0; r < INV_ROWS; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
                int idx = c + r * COLS;
                if (idx >= 36) break;
                int sx = leftGridX + c * SLOT_SIZE;
                int sy = leftGridY + r * SLOT_SIZE;
                if (isHoveringSlot(mouseX, mouseY, sx, sy)) {
                    int packetSlot = mapMainGridToPacketSlot(idx);
                    if (packetSlot >= 0) {
                        SlotActionType action = hasShiftDown() ? SlotActionType.QUICK_MOVE : SlotActionType.PICKUP;

    @Override
    public boolean charTyped(char chr, int modifiers) {
        if (this.searchActive && chr >= 32) {
            this.searchQuery += chr;
            return true;
        }
        return super.charTyped(chr, modifiers);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(int keyCode, int scanCode, int modifiers) {
        if (this.searchActive) {
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_BACKSPACE && !this.searchQuery.isEmpty()) {
                this.searchQuery = this.searchQuery.substring(0, this.searchQuery.length() - 1);
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) {
                this.searchActive = false;
                this.searchQuery = "";
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ENTER || keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_KP_ENTER) {
                this.searchActive = false;
                return true;
            }
            return true;
        }
        if (this.client != null && this.client.options.inventoryKey.matchesKey(keyCode, scanCode)) {
            this.close();
            return true;
        }
        return super.keyPressed(keyCode, scanCode, modifiers);
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        if (this.client != null && this.client.player != null && this.client.interactionManager != null) {
            if (!this.client.player.playerScreenHandler.getCursorStack().isEmpty()) {
                int syncId = this.client.player.playerScreenHandler.syncId;
                this.client.interactionManager.clickSlot(syncId, -999, 0, SlotActionType.PICKUP, this.client.player);
            }
        }
        super.close();
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.client.content.electricity;

    public static final int GRAPH_POINTS = 100;

    private static final Map<Block, long[]> ACCUMULATOR_RAW_TICKS = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    public ElectricNetworkInfoScreen(BlockPos polePos) {
        super(Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.electric_network.title"));
        this.polePos = polePos;
        lastViewedPolePos = polePos;
        lastNetworkScanTick = -100L;

    private static void resetHistory() {
        CONSUMER_RAW_TICKS.clear();
        PRODUCER_RAW_TICKS.clear();
        ACCUMULATOR_RAW_TICKS.clear();
        rawWriteCursor = 0;
        totalRecordedTicks = 0;
        lastRecordedWorldTick = -1L;
        lastNetworkScanTick = -100L;
        lastViewedPolePos = null;
        cachedSnapshot = null;
    }

    public static void tickClientHistory(MinecraftClient client) {
        if (client.world == null) {
            if (lastTrackedWorld != null) {
                lastTrackedWorld = null;
                resetHistory();
            }
            return;
        }
        if (client.world != lastTrackedWorld) {
            lastTrackedWorld = client.world;
            resetHistory();
        }
        if (client.isPaused()) return;

        long wt = client.world.getTime();
        if (wt == lastRecordedWorldTick) return;
        lastRecordedWorldTick = wt;

        boolean screenOpen = client.currentScreen instanceof ElectricNetworkInfoScreen;
        BlockPos target = lastViewedPolePos;
        if (screenOpen) {
            target = ((ElectricNetworkInfoScreen) client.currentScreen).polePos;
            lastViewedPolePos = target;
        } else if (target == null && client.player != null && wt % 40 == 0) {
            target = findNearbyPole(client.world, client.player.getBlockPos());
            if (target != null) lastViewedPolePos = target;
        }
        if (target == null) return;

        int scanInterval = screenOpen ? 5 : 20;
        if (cachedSnapshot == null || Math.abs(wt - lastNetworkScanTick) >= scanInterval) {
            cachedSnapshot = PowerNetworkManager.scanNetwork(client.world, target);
            lastNetworkScanTick = wt;
        }

        PowerNetworkManager.NetworkSnapshot snap = cachedSnapshot;
        if (snap == null) return;

        Set<Block> seenConsumers = new HashSet<>();
        for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat stat : snap.consumers()) {
            seenConsumers.add(stat.block());
            long[] buf = CONSUMER_RAW_TICKS.computeIfAbsent(stat.block(), k -> new long[RAW_BUFFER_SIZE]);
            buf[rawWriteCursor] = stat.watts();
        }
        for (Map.Entry<Block, long[]> e : CONSUMER_RAW_TICKS.entrySet()) {
            if (!seenConsumers.contains(e.getKey())) {
                e.getValue()[rawWriteCursor] = 0L;
            }
        }

        Set<Block> seenProducers = new HashSet<>();
        for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat stat : snap.producers()) {
            seenProducers.add(stat.block());
            long[] buf = PRODUCER_RAW_TICKS.computeIfAbsent(stat.block(), k -> new long[RAW_BUFFER_SIZE]);
            buf[rawWriteCursor] = stat.watts();
        }
        for (Map.Entry<Block, long[]> e : PRODUCER_RAW_TICKS.entrySet()) {
            if (!seenProducers.contains(e.getKey())) {
                e.getValue()[rawWriteCursor] = 0L;
            }
        }

        // Ð—Ð°Ð¿Ð¸ÑÑ‹Ð²Ð°ÐµÐ¼ Ð¸ÑÑ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ð¸ÑŽ Ð·Ð°Ñ€ÑÐ´Ð° Ð°ÐºÐºÑƒÐ¼ÑƒÐ»ÑÑ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ð² (Ð² Ð”Ð¶Ð¾ÑƒÐ»ÑÑ…) Ð´Ð»Ñ 3-Ð¹ ÐºÐ¾Ð»Ð¾Ð½ÐºÐ¸
        long[] accBuf = ACCUMULATOR_RAW_TICKS.computeIfAbsent(ModBlocks.ACCUMULATOR, k -> new long[RAW_BUFFER_SIZE]);
        accBuf[rawWriteCursor] = snap.accumulatorStoredJoules();

        rawWriteCursor = (rawWriteCursor + 1) % RAW_BUFFER_SIZE;
        totalRecordedTicks++;
    }

    private static BlockPos findNearbyPole(World world, BlockPos center) {
        for (int dx = -12; dx <= 12; dx += 2) {
            for (int dz = -12; dz <= 12; dz += 2) {
                for (int dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy++) {
                    BlockPos p = center.add(dx, dy, dz);
                    Block b = world.getBlockState(p).getBlock();
                    if (b instanceof ElectricPoleBlock || b instanceof CreativeEnergySourceBlock) {
                        return p.toImmutable();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private PowerNetworkManager.NetworkSnapshot getOrScanSnapshot(World world) {
        if (cachedSnapshot == null) {
            cachedSnapshot = PowerNetworkManager.scanNetwork(world, this.polePos);
            lastNetworkScanTick = world.getTime();
        }
        return cachedSnapshot;
    }

    private List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> getFilteredStats(
            List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> stats,
            Map<Block, long[]> rawHistoryMap) {
        List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> displayList = new ArrayList<>();
        String queryLower = this.searchQuery.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat st : stats) {
            if (!queryLower.isBlank()) {
                String name = st.block().getName().getString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
                if (!name.contains(queryLower)) continue;
            }
            long avgWatts = computeTimeframeAverageWatts(rawHistoryMap, st.block(), st.watts());
            displayList.add(new PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat(st.block(), st.count(), avgWatts, st.color()));
        }
        displayList.sort(Comparator.comparingLong(PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat::watts).reversed());
        return displayList;
    }

    private long[] buildTimeframeSeries(Map<Block, long[]> rawMap, Block block) {
        long[] result = new long[GRAPH_POINTS];
        long[] raw = rawMap.get(block);
        if (raw == null || totalRecordedTicks <= 0) return result;

        int step = TICKS_PER_POINT[this.selectedTimeframe];
        if (this.selectedTimeframe == 8) {
            step = Math.max(1, Math.min(RAW_BUFFER_SIZE / GRAPH_POINTS, (totalRecordedTicks + GRAPH_POINTS - 1) / GRAPH_POINTS));
        }

        int sampleWindow = Math.min(step, 120);
        for (int i = 0; i < GRAPH_POINTS; i++) {
            int pointsAgo = (GRAPH_POINTS - 1) - i;
            long startTicksAgo = (long) pointsAgo * step;
            if (startTicksAgo >= totalRecordedTicks || startTicksAgo >= RAW_BUFFER_SIZE) {
                result[i] = 0L;
                continue;
            }

            long sum = 0L;
            int count = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < sampleWindow; k++) {
                long tAgo = startTicksAgo + k;
                if (tAgo >= totalRecordedTicks || tAgo >= RAW_BUFFER_SIZE) break;
                int idx = Math.floorMod(rawWriteCursor - 1 - (int) tAgo, RAW_BUFFER_SIZE);
                sum += raw[idx];
                count++;
            }
            result[i] = (count > 0) ? (sum / count) : 0L;
        }
        return result;
    }

    private long computeTimeframeAverageWatts(Map<Block, long[]> rawMap, Block block, long fallbackCurrentWatts) {
        if (this.selectedTimeframe == 0) {
            return fallbackCurrentWatts;
        }
        long[] series = buildTimeframeSeries(rawMap, block);
        long sum = 0L;
        for (long v : series) {
            sum += v;
        }
        return sum / GRAPH_POINTS;
    }

    private void drawTopSummaryBox(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int bw,

        context.fill(cx, cy, cx + cw, cy + ch, 0xFF161719);
        context.fill(cx + 1, cy + 1, cx + cw - 1, cy + ch - 1, 0xFF242528);

        drawScaledText(context, title, cx + 5, cy + 4, 0.78f, 0xFFE6E6E6, true);

        int resetBtnX = cx + cw - 14;
        int resetBtnY = cy + 2;
        boolean hovReset = mouseX >= resetBtnX && mouseX < resetBtnX + 11 && mouseY >= resetBtnY && mouseY < resetBtnY + 11;
        context.fill(resetBtnX, resetBtnY, resetBtnX + 11, resetBtnY + 11, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(resetBtnX + 1, resetBtnY + 1, resetBtnX + 10, resetBtnY + 10, hovReset ? 0xFFFF5252 : 0xFFE04848);
        drawScaledText(context, "\u21bb", resetBtnX + 3, resetBtnY + 2, 0.70f, 0xFF141414, false);

        int graphLeft = cx + 22;
        int graphTop = cy + 15;
        int graphRight = cx + cw - 4;
        int graphBottom = cy + 78;
        int graphW = graphRight - graphLeft;
        int graphH = graphBottom - graphTop;

        context.fill(cx + 3, graphTop - 1, graphRight + 1, graphBottom + 9, 0xFF0A0B0C);

        Map<Block, long[]> sampledSeriesMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        long maxScale = isJoulesColumn ? fallbackMaxScale : 10_000L;
        for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat st : stats) {
            if (activeFilter != null && st.block() != activeFilter) continue;
            long[] series = buildTimeframeSeries(rawHistoryMap, st.block());
            sampledSeriesMap.put(st.block(), series);
            for (long val : series) {
                if (val > maxScale) maxScale = val;
            }
        }
        if (!isJoulesColumn) {
            maxScale = Math.max(maxScale, fallbackMaxScale / 2);
            maxScale = (long) (Math.ceil(maxScale / 50_000.0) * 50_000L);
        }
        if (maxScale <= 0) maxScale = 100_000L;

        int hRows = 6;
        for (int r = 0; r <= hRows; r++) {
            int gy = graphTop + Math.round((r / (float) hRows) * graphH);
            context.fill(graphLeft, gy, graphRight, gy + 1, (r == hRows) ? 0xFF333538 : 0xFF181A1C);

            if (!stats.isEmpty()) {
                long rowVal = Math.round(((hRows - r) / (double) hRows) * maxScale);
                String yLbl = isJoulesColumn
                        ? PowerNetworkManager.formatAxisJoules(rowVal)
                        : PowerNetworkManager.formatAxisWatts(rowVal);
                int lblW = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(yLbl) * 0.55f);
                drawScaledText(context, yLbl, graphLeft - lblW - 2, gy - 2, 0.55f, 0xFF888A8E, false);
            }
        }

        int vCols = 10;
        float maxTimeNum = TIMEFRAME_MAX_NUM[this.selectedTimeframe];
        for (int c = 0; c <= vCols; c++) {
            int gx = graphLeft + Math.round((c / (float) vCols) * graphW);
            context.fill(gx, graphTop, gx + 1, graphBottom, 0xFF181A1C);

            float tVal = maxTimeNum * (1.0f - (c / (float) vCols));
            String tStr = (tVal == (int) tVal) ? String.valueOf((int) tVal) : String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.1f", tVal);
            drawScaledTextCentered(context, tStr, gx, graphBottom + 2, 0.50f, 0xFF888A8E, false);
        }

        for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat stat : stats) {
            if (activeFilter != null && stat.block() != activeFilter) continue;
            long[] series = sampledSeriesMap.get(stat.block());
            if (series == null) continue;

            int prevX = -1;
            int prevY = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < GRAPH_POINTS; i++) {
                float xRatio = i / (float) (GRAPH_POINTS - 1);
                float yRatio = MathHelper.clamp(series[i] / (float) maxScale, 0.0f, 1.0f);
                int px = graphLeft + Math.round(xRatio * (graphW - 1));
                int py = graphBottom - 1 - Math.round(yRatio * (graphH - 2));

                if (prevX != -1 && (series[i] > 0 || series[Math.max(0, i - 1)] > 0)) {
                    int minX = Math.min(prevX, px);
                    int maxX = Math.max(prevX, px) + 1;
                    context.fill(minX, prevY, maxX, prevY + 1, stat.color());
                    int minY = Math.min(prevY, py);
                    int maxY = Math.max(prevY, py) + 1;
                    context.fill(px, minY, px + 1, maxY, stat.color());
                }
                prevX = px;
                prevY = py;
            }
        }

        int listTopY = graphBottom + 11;
        int cellGap = 2;
        int subColW = (cw - 8 - cellGap) / 2;
        int rowH = 14;
        int numRows = Math.max(4, (ch - (listTopY - cy) - 3) / (rowH + 1));

        List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> displayList = isJoulesColumn
                ? stats
                : getFilteredStats(stats, rawHistoryMap);

        long totalGroupValue = isJoulesColumn ? Math.max(1L, fallbackMaxScale) : 0L;
        if (!isJoulesColumn) {
            for (PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat st : displayList) {
                totalGroupValue += st.watts();
            }
        }

        for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
                int idx = r + c * numRows;
                int cellX = cx + 4 + c * (subColW + cellGap);
                int cellY = listTopY + r * (rowH + 1);

                if (idx < displayList.size()) {
                    PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat st = displayList.get(idx);
                    boolean isSelected = (activeFilter == st.block());
                    boolean hovCell = mouseX >= cellX && mouseX < cellX + subColW && mouseY >= cellY && mouseY < cellY + rowH;

                    int cellBg = isSelected ? 0xFF484B50 : (hovCell ? 0xFF3C3E42 : 0xFF313235);
                    context.fill(cellX, cellY, cellX + subColW, cellY + rowH, 0xFF141414);
                    context.fill(cellX + 1, cellY + 1, cellX + subColW - 1, cellY + rowH - 1, cellBg);

                    context.fill(cellX + 1, cellY + 1, cellX + 13, cellY + rowH - 1, 0xFF1E1F22);
                    context.getMatrices().push();
                    context.getMatrices().translate(cellX + 1.5f, cellY + 1.0f, 100.0f);
                    context.getMatrices().scale(0.68f, 0.68f, 1.0f);
                    context.drawItem(new ItemStack(st.block().asItem()), 0, 0);
                    context.getMatrices().pop();

                    String cntStr = String.valueOf(st.count());
                    int cntW = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(cntStr) * 0.55f);
                    drawScaledText(context, cntStr, cellX + 13 - cntW, cellY + rowH - 5, 0.55f, 0xFFFFFFFF, true);

                    int barStartX = cellX + 15;
                    int barEndX = cellX + subColW - 34;
                    int barW = Math.max(10, barEndX - barStartX);
                    int barY = cellY + 5;
                    context.fill(barStartX, barY, barStartX + barW, barY + 4, 0xFF18191B);

                    float share = (totalGroupValue > 0) ? MathHelper.clamp(st.watts() / (float) totalGroupValue, 0.0f, 1.0f) : 0.0f;
                    int fillW = Math.round(share * barW);
                    if (fillW > 0) {
                        context.fill(barStartX, barY, barStartX + fillW, barY + 4, st.color());
                    }

                    String wStr = isJoulesColumn
                            ? PowerNetworkManager.formatJoules(st.watts())
                            : PowerNetworkManager.formatWatts(st.watts());
                    int wWidth = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(wStr) * 0.60f);
                    drawScaledText(context, wStr, cellX + subColW - wWidth - 2, cellY + 4, 0.60f, 0xFFE6E6E6, true);
                } else {
                    context.fill(cellX, cellY, cellX + subColW, cellY + rowH, 0xFF1B1C1E);
                    context.fill(cellX, cellY + rowH - 1, cellX + subColW, cellY + rowH, 0xFF121314);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void drawSmallMagnifier(DrawContext context, int lx, int ly) {
        int col = 0xFFE6E6E6;
        context.fill(lx + 1, ly, lx + 4, ly + 1, col);
        context.fill(lx, ly + 1, lx + 1, ly + 4, col);
        context.fill(lx + 4, ly + 1, lx + 5, ly + 4, col);
        context.fill(lx + 1, ly + 4, lx + 4, ly + 5, col);
        context.fill(lx + 4, ly + 5, lx + 6, ly + 7, col);
    }

    private void drawScaledText(DrawContext context, String text, int x, int y, float scale, int color, boolean shadow) {
        context.getMatrices().push();
        context.getMatrices().translate(x, y, 200.0f);
        context.getMatrices().scale(scale, scale, 1.0f);
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, text, 0, 0, color, shadow);
        context.getMatrices().pop();
    }

    private void drawScaledTextCentered(DrawContext context, String text, int centerX, int y, float scale, int color, boolean shadow) {
        int w = Math.round(this.textRenderer.getWidth(text) * scale);
        drawScaledText(context, text, centerX - w / 2, y, scale, color, shadow);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (this.client == null || this.client.world == null) return false;

        int panelW = Math.min(520, this.width - 12);
        int panelH = Math.min(254, this.height - 12);
        int x = (this.width - panelW) / 2;
        int y = (this.height - panelH) / 2;

        int hx = x + 3;
        int hy = y + 3;
        int hw = panelW - 6;
        int closeBtnX = hx + hw - 14;
        int searchBtnX = closeBtnX - 15;

        if (mouseX >= closeBtnX && mouseX < closeBtnX + 13 && mouseY >= hy + 1 && mouseY < hy + 13) {
            this.close();
            return true;
        }

        if (!this.searchActive && mouseX >= searchBtnX && mouseX < searchBtnX + 13 && mouseY >= hy + 1 && mouseY < hy + 13) {
            this.searchActive = true;
            return true;
        } else if (this.searchActive) {
            int boxX = closeBtnX - 81;
            if (mouseX >= boxX && mouseX < closeBtnX - 3 && mouseY >= hy + 1 && mouseY < hy + 13) {
                if (button == 1) this.searchQuery = "";
                return true;
            } else if (this.searchQuery.isEmpty()) {
                this.searchActive = false;
            }
        }

        int innerW = panelW - 10;
        int col1X = x + 5;
        int tabsY = y + 51;
        int tabCount = TIMEFRAME_LABELS.length;
        int tabW = innerW / tabCount;
        for (int i = 0; i < tabCount; i++) {
            int tx = col1X + i * tabW;
            int tw = (i == tabCount - 1) ? (col1X + innerW - tx) : (tabW - 1);
            if (mouseX >= tx && mouseX < tx + tw && mouseY >= tabsY && mouseY < tabsY + 12) {
                this.selectedTimeframe = i;
                if (this.client.player != null) {
                    this.client.player.playSound(SoundEvents.UI_BUTTON_CLICK.value(), 0.3f, 1.2f);
                }
                return true;
            }
        }

        int colGap = 4;
        int colW = (innerW - colGap * 2) / 3;
        int col2X = col1X + colW + colGap;
        int mainTopY = y + 66;

        if (mouseX >= col1X + colW - 14 && mouseX < col1X + colW - 3 && mouseY >= mainTopY + 2 && mouseY < mainTopY + 13) {
            this.filteredConsumerBlock = null;
            return true;
        }
        if (mouseX >= col2X + colW - 14 && mouseX < col2X + colW - 3 && mouseY >= mainTopY + 2 && mouseY < mainTopY + 13) {
            this.filteredProducerBlock = null;
            return true;
        }

        PowerNetworkManager.NetworkSnapshot snap = getOrScanSnapshot(this.client.world);
        List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> filteredConsumers = getFilteredStats(snap.consumers(), CONSUMER_RAW_TICKS);
        List<PowerNetworkManager.MachineGroupStat> filteredProducers = getFilteredStats(snap.producers(), PRODUCER_RAW_TICKS);

        int mainH = panelH - 71;
        int listTopY = mainTopY + 78 + 11;
        int subColW = (colW - 10) / 2;
        int rowH = 14;
        int numRows = Math.max(4, (mainH - (listTopY - mainTopY) - 3) / (rowH + 1));

        for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
                int idx = r + c * numRows;
                int cellX1 = col1X + 4 + c * (subColW + 2);
                int cellY = listTopY + r * (rowH + 1);
                if (idx < filteredConsumers.size() && mouseX >= cellX1 && mouseX < cellX1 + subColW && mouseY >= cellY && mouseY < cellY + rowH) {
                    Block b = filteredConsumers.get(idx).block();
                    this.filteredConsumerBlock = (this.filteredConsumerBlock == b) ? null : b;
                    return true;
                }

                int cellX2 = col2X + 4 + c * (subColW + 2);
                if (idx < filteredProducers.size() && mouseX >= cellX2 && mouseX < cellX2 + subColW && mouseY >= cellY && mouseY < cellY + rowH) {
                    Block b = filteredProducers.get(idx).block();
                    this.filteredProducerBlock = (this.filteredProducerBlock == b) ? null : b;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean charTyped(char chr, int modifiers) {
        if (this.searchActive && chr >= 32) {
            this.searchQuery += chr;
            return true;
        }
        return super.charTyped(chr, modifiers);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean keyPressed(int keyCode, int scanCode, int modifiers) {
        if (this.searchActive) {
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_BACKSPACE && !this.searchQuery.isEmpty()) {
                this.searchQuery = this.searchQuery.substring(0, this.searchQuery.length() - 1);
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) {
                this.searchActive = false;
                this.searchQuery = "";
                return true;
            }
            if (keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_ENTER || keyCode == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_KP_ENTER) {
                this.searchActive = false;
                return true;
            }
            return true;
        }
        if (this.client != null && this.client.options.inventoryKey.matchesKey(keyCode, scanCode)) {
            this.close();
            return true;
        }
        return super.keyPressed(keyCode, scanCode, modifiers);
    }
}

    @Override
    public void render(ElectricPoleBlock.LargePoleBlockEntity entity, float tickDelta, MatrixStack matrices,
                       VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers, int light, int overlay) {
        BlockState state = entity.getCachedState();
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof ElectricPoleBlock pole)) return;
        if (state.get(ElectricPoleBlock.PART) != 0 || state.get(ElectricPoleBlock.UPPER)) return;

        boolean isSubstation = (state.getBlock() == ModBlocks.SUBSTATION || pole.getPoleTier() == 4);
        if (isSubstation) {
            renderSubstationModel(matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay);
        } else {
            renderBigElectricPoleModel(matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay);
        }
    }

        public void render(StorageTankBlock.StorageTankBlockEntity entity, float tickDelta, MatrixStack matrices,
                           VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers, int light, int overlay) {
            BlockState state = entity.getCachedState();
            if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof StorageTankBlock)) return;
            if (state.get(StorageTankBlock.PART) != 4 || state.get(StorageTankBlock.UPPER)) return;

            Direction facing = state.get(StorageTankBlock.FACING);
            float fillRatio = MathHelper.clamp(
                    entity.getFluidAmount() / (float) StorageTankBlock.StorageTankBlockEntity.CAPACITY_MB, 0.0f, 1.0f);

            matrices.push();
            matrices.translate(0.5, 0.0, 0.5);
            matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(-facing.asRotation()));
            matrices.translate(-0.5, 0.0, -0.5);

            renderStorageTankModel(matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, entity.getFluidKind(), fillRatio);
            matrices.pop();
        }

        public static void renderStorageTankModel(MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers,
                                                  int light, int overlay, FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind kind, float fillRatio) {
            BlockRenderManager brm = MinecraftClient.getInstance().getBlockRenderManager();
            BlockState base = Blocks.POLISHED_DEEPSLATE.getDefaultState();
            BlockState steel = Blocks.IRON_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
            BlockState dark = Blocks.NETHERITE_BLOCK.getDefaultState();
            BlockState glass = Blocks.GLASS.getDefaultState();

            // ÐžÐ¿Ð¾Ñ€Ð½Ð°Ñ Ð¿Ð»Ð¸Ñ‚Ð° 3x3 Ð¸ ÑƒÐ³Ð»Ð¾Ð²Ñ‹Ðµ ÑÑ‚Ð¾Ð¹ÐºÐ¸

            // ÐœÐ°ÑÑÐ¸Ð²Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ñ†Ð¸Ð»Ð¸Ð½Ð´Ñ€Ð¸Ñ‡ÐµÑÐºÐ¸Ð¹ Ð±Ð°Ðº (Ð¿ÐµÑ€ÐµÐºÑ€ÐµÑ‰ÐµÐ½Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ Ð²Ð¾ÑÑŒÐ¼Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð°Ð½Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ ÑÐµÐºÑ†Ð¸Ð¸)
            drawBox(brm, steel, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.70f, 0.30f, -0.45f, 2.40f, 1.65f, 1.90f);
            drawBox(brm, steel, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.45f, 0.30f, -0.70f, 1.90f, 1.65f, 2.40f);
            drawBox(brm, dark,  matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.20f, 1.95f, -0.20f, 1.40f, 0.16f, 1.40f);

            // Ð¡Ð¼Ð¾Ñ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ð²Ð¾Ðµ Ð¾ÐºÐ½Ð¾ ÑƒÑ€Ð¾Ð²Ð½Ñ Ð¶Ð¸Ð´ÐºÐ¾ÑÑ‚Ð¸ ÑÐ²ÐµÑ€Ñ…Ñƒ Ð¸ ÑÐ±Ð¾ÐºÑƒ
            drawBox(brm, glass, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay,  0.10f, 0.45f, -0.76f, 0.80f, 1.35f, 2.52f);

            if (fillRatio > 0.01f && kind != FactorioFluidContainer.FluidKind.NONE) {
                BlockState liquidBlock = switch (kind) {
                    case WATER -> Blocks.LIGHT_BLUE_CONCRETE.getDefaultState();
                    case STEAM -> Blocks.WHITE_CONCRETE.getDefaultState();
                    case CRUDE_OIL -> Blocks.BLACK_CONCRETE.getDefaultState();
                    case HEAVY_OIL -> Blocks.RED_TERRACOTTA.getDefaultState();
                    case LIGHT_OIL -> Blocks.YELLOW_CONCRETE.getDefaultState();
                    case PETROLEUM_GAS -> Blocks.PURPLE_CONCRETE.getDefaultState();
                    case LUBRICANT -> Blocks.LIME_TERRACOTTA.getDefaultState();
                    case SULFURIC_ACID -> Blocks.YELLOW_GLAZED_TERRACOTTA.getDefaultState();
                    default -> Blocks.BLUE_CONCRETE.getDefaultState();
                };
                float h = Math.max(0.08f, 1.30f * fillRatio);
                drawBox(brm, liquidBlock, matrices, vertexConsumers, LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE, overlay,
                        0.14f, 0.46f, -0.78f, 0.72f, h, 2.56f);
            }

            // Ð£Ð³Ð»Ð¾Ð²Ñ‹Ðµ Ñ‚Ñ€ÑƒÐ±Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ Ð¿Ð°Ñ‚Ñ€ÑƒÐ±ÐºÐ¸ (ÐºÐ°Ðº Ð² Factorio)
            drawBox(brm, dark,  matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.80f, 0.22f, -1.02f, 0.60f, 0.55f, 0.32f);
            drawBox(brm, dark,  matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay,  1.20f, 0.22f, -1.02f, 0.60f, 0.55f, 0.32f);
            drawBox(brm, dark,  matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, -0.80f, 0.22f,  1.70f, 0.60f, 0.55f, 0.32f);
            drawBox(brm, dark,  matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay,  1.20f, 0.22f,  1.70f, 0.60f, 0.55f, 0.32f);
        }

        public static void renderAccumulatorModel(MatrixStack matrices, VertexConsumerProvider vertexConsumers,

                    ? Blocks.SEA_LANTERN.getDefaultState()

            int glowLight = (chargeState != 0 || chargeRatio > 0.15f) ? LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE : light;

            // ÐšÐ¾Ñ€Ð¿ÑƒÑ 2x2 (X: 0..2, Z: 0..2)
            drawBox(brm, base,  matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, 0.06f, 0.0f, 0.06f, 1.88f, 0.35f, 1.88f);

            float[] offsets = { 0.22f, 1.18f };

                for (float oz : offsets) {
                    drawBox(brm, steel,  matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, ox, 1.00f, oz, 0.60f, 0.90f, 0.60f);
                    drawBox(brm, glow,   matrices, vertexConsumers, glowLight, overlay, ox + 0.08f, 1.25f, oz - 0.02f, 0.44f, 0.45f, 0.64f);
                    drawBox(brm, copper, matrices, vertexConsumers, light, overlay, ox + 0.15f, 1.90f, oz + 0.15f, 0.30f, 0.22f, 0.30f);
                }

            drawBox(brm, glow, matrices, vertexConsumers, glowLight, overlay, 0.72f, 1.00f, 0.72f, 0.56f, 1.15f, 0.56f);
        }
    }

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.client.content.fluids;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.fluids.BoilerScreenHandler;
import net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.DrawContext;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.screen.ingame.HandledScreen;
import net.minecraft.client.render.LightmapTextureManager;
import net.minecraft.client.render.OverlayTexture;
import net.minecraft.client.util.math.MatrixStack;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerInventory;
import net.minecraft.text.Text;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Direction;
import net.minecraft.util.math.MathHelper;
import net.minecraft.util.math.RotationAxis;

public class BoilerScreen extends HandledScreen<BoilerScreenHandler> {

    private float previewYaw = -35.0f;
    private float previewPitch = 25.0f;
    private float previewZoom = 18.0f;
    private boolean draggingPreview = false;

    public BoilerScreen(BoilerScreenHandler handler, PlayerInventory inventory, Text title) {
        super(handler, inventory, title);
        this.backgroundWidth = 236;
        this.backgroundHeight = 220;
    }

    @Override
    protected void drawForeground(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        context.drawText(this.textRenderer, this.title, 8, 6, 0xFFE6E6E6, false);
    }

    @Override
    protected void drawBackground(DrawContext context, float delta, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;

        context.fill(x, y, x + backgroundWidth, y + backgroundHeight, 0xFF161616);
        context.fill(x + 1, y + 1, x + backgroundWidth - 1, y + backgroundHeight - 1, 0xFF313234);

        context.fill(x + 3, y + 3, x + backgroundWidth - 3, y + 16, 0xFF242527);
        int titleEnd = x + 14 + textRenderer.getWidth(this.title);
        for (int gx = titleEnd; gx < x + backgroundWidth - 24; gx += 3) {
            context.fill(gx, y + 5, gx + 1, y + 14, 0xFF1A1B1C);
        }

        boolean hasFuel = handler.getBurnTime() > 0;
        int ledOuter = !hasFuel ? 0xFF661111 : 0xFF115511;
        int ledInner = !hasFuel ? 0xFFFF3333 : 0xFF44FF44;
        int ledX = x + backgroundWidth - 19;
        context.fill(ledX, y + 5, ledX + 10, y + 14, 0xFF111111);
        context.fill(ledX + 1, y + 6, ledX + 9, y + 13, ledOuter);
        context.fill(ledX + 2, y + 7, ledX + 8, y + 12, ledInner);

        int viewLeft = x + 10;
        int viewTop = y + 18;
        int viewRight = x + backgroundWidth - 10;
        int viewBottom = y + 78;
        context.fill(viewLeft - 1, viewTop - 1, viewRight + 1, viewBottom + 1, 0xFF141414);
        drawCheckerboard(context, viewLeft, viewTop, viewRight, viewBottom, 8);

        context.enableScissor(viewLeft, viewTop, viewRight, viewBottom);
        renderBoiler3DPreview(context, (viewLeft + viewRight) / 2, (viewTop + viewBottom) / 2 + 6, delta);
        context.disableScissor();

        drawSlotFrame(context, x + 10, y + 83);
        if (handler.getSlot(0).getStack().isEmpty()) {
            drawFlameSilhouette(context, x + 11, y + 84);
        }

        int redBarX = x + 32;
        int redBarY = y + 87;
        int redBarW = 192;
        int redBarH = 10;
        context.fill(redBarX, redBarY, redBarX + redBarW, redBarY + redBarH, 0xFF141414);
        context.fill(redBarX + 1, redBarY + 1, redBarX + redBarW - 1, redBarY + redBarH - 1, 0xFF222325);

        int burnTime = handler.getBurnTime();
        int maxBurnTime = Math.max(1, handler.getMaxBurnTime());
        if (burnTime > 0) {
            int fillW = Math.min(redBarW - 2, Math.round((burnTime / (float) maxBurnTime) * (redBarW - 2)));
            context.fill(redBarX + 1, redBarY + 1, redBarX + 1 + fillW, redBarY + redBarH - 1, 0xFFC82828);
            context.fill(redBarX + 1, redBarY + 1, redBarX + 1 + fillW, redBarY + 4, 0xFFEA4C3B);
        }

        context.fill(x + 8, y + 131, x + backgroundWidth - 8, y + 132, 0xFF202122);
        context.fill(x + 8, y + 132, x + backgroundWidth - 8, y + 133, 0xFF3E4042);

        int invFrameX = x + 37;
        for (int row = 0; row < 3; row++) {
            for (int col = 0; col < 9; col++) {
                drawSlotFrame(context, invFrameX + col * 18, y + 137 + row * 18);
            }
        }
        for (int col = 0; col < 9; col++) {
            drawSlotFrame(context, invFrameX + col * 18, y + 195);
        }
    }

    private void drawCheckerboard(DrawContext context, int left, int top, int right, int bottom, int cellSize) {
        for (int py = top; py < bottom; py += cellSize) {
            for (int px = left; px < right; px += cellSize) {
                int gx = (px - left) / cellSize;
                int gy = (py - top) / cellSize;
                context.fill(px, py, Math.min(px + cellSize, right), Math.min(py + cellSize, bottom), ((gx + gy) % 2 == 0) ? 0xFF262729 : 0xFF2E3032);
            }
        }
    }

    private void drawSlotFrame(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy) {
        context.fill(sx, sy, sx + 18, sy + 18, 0xFF18181A);
        context.fill(sx + 1, sy + 1, sx + 17, sy + 17, 0xFF3A3C3E);
    }

    private void drawFlameSilhouette(DrawContext context, int sx, int sy) {
        int c = 0xFF626466;
        context.fill(sx + 7, sy + 3, sx + 9, sy + 6, c);
        context.fill(sx + 5, sy + 6, sx + 11, sy + 10, c);
        context.fill(sx + 4, sy + 9, sx + 12, sy + 13, c);
        context.fill(sx + 6, sy + 13, sx + 10, sy + 14, c);
    }

    private void renderBoiler3DPreview(DrawContext context, int centerX, int centerY, float delta) {
        MatrixStack matrices = context.getMatrices();
        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(centerX, centerY, 150.0f);
        matrices.scale(this.previewZoom, -this.previewZoom, this.previewZoom);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(this.previewPitch));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(this.previewYaw));
        matrices.translate(0.0f, -0.6f, -1.0f);

        boolean burning = handler.getBurnTime() > 0;
        FluidMachinesRenderer.BoilerRenderer.renderBoilerModel(Direction.NORTH, burning, matrices, context.getVertexConsumers(), LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE, OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV);

        matrices.pop();
        context.draw();
    }

    private boolean isInsideViewport(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        return mouseX >= x + 10 && mouseX <= x + backgroundWidth - 10 && mouseY >= y + 18 && mouseY <= y + 78;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        if (isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.previewZoom = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewZoom + (float) verticalAmount * 1.8f, 10.0f, 40.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mouseX, mouseY, horizontalAmount, verticalAmount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if ((button == 0 || button == 1) && isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.draggingPreview = true;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        this.draggingPreview = false;
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.draggingPreview) {
            this.previewYaw += (float) deltaX * 1.5f;
            this.previewPitch = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewPitch + (float) deltaY * 1.5f, -80.0f, 80.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        super.render(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);
        drawMouseoverTooltip(context, mouseX, mouseY);
    }
}

    private void drawCheckerboard(DrawContext context, int left, int top, int right, int bottom, int cellSize) {
        for (int py = top; py < bottom; py += cellSize) {
            for (int px = left; px < right; px += cellSize) {
                int gx = (px - left) / cellSize;
                int gy = (py - top) / cellSize;
                int color = ((gx + gy) % 2 == 0) ? 0xFF262729 : 0xFF2E3032;
                context.fill(px, py, Math.min(px + cellSize, right), Math.min(py + cellSize, bottom), color);
            }
        }
    }

    private boolean isInsideViewport(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        return mouseX >= x + 10 && mouseX <= x + backgroundWidth - 10 && mouseY >= y + 18 && mouseY <= y + 70;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        if (isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.previewZoom = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewZoom + (float) verticalAmount * 2.5f, 10.0f, 52.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mouseX, mouseY, horizontalAmount, verticalAmount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if ((button == 0 || button == 1) && isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.draggingPreview = true;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (this.draggingPreview && (button == 0 || button == 1)) {
            this.draggingPreview = false;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.draggingPreview) {
            this.previewYaw += (float) deltaX * 1.5f;
            this.previewPitch = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewPitch + (float) deltaY * 1.5f, -80.0f, 80.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        super.render(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);
        drawMouseoverTooltip(context, mouseX, mouseY);
    }

    private void drawChestSlot(DrawContext context, int slotX, int slotY, boolean lockedByRedX) {
        context.fill(slotX, slotY, slotX + 18, slotY + 18, 0xFF18181A);
        if (lockedByRedX) {

    private void drawRedXButton(DrawContext context, int bx, int by, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        boolean hovered = mouseX >= bx && mouseX <= bx + 18 && mouseY >= by && mouseY <= by + 18;
        boolean hasLimit = handler.getUnlockedSlots() < handler.totalSlots;

        int borderCol = this.limitSelectionMode ? 0xFFFFCC44 : 0xFF141414;
        int bgCol = this.limitSelectionMode ? 0xFFB83227 : (hovered ? 0xFF8F2820 : (hasLimit ? 0xFF752019 : 0xFF3A3C3E));

    }

    private void drawSmallX(DrawContext context, int ox, int oy, int color) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            context.fill(ox + i, oy + i, ox + i + 2, oy + i + 1, color);
            context.fill(ox + 6 - i, oy + i, ox + 8 - i, oy + i + 1, color);
        }
    }

    private int getHoveredChestSlotIndex(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        int gridX = x + FactorioChestScreenHandler.GRID_START_X - 1;
        int gridY = y + handler.gridStartY - 1;

        if (mouseX < gridX || mouseX >= gridX + FactorioChestScreenHandler.COLUMNS * 18
                || mouseY < gridY || mouseY >= gridY + handler.rows * 18) {
            return -1;
        }
        int col = (int) ((mouseX - gridX) / 18);
        int row = (int) ((mouseY - gridY) / 18);
        return col + row * FactorioChestScreenHandler.COLUMNS;
    }

    private void renderChest3DPreview(DrawContext context, int centerX, int centerY) {
        MinecraftClient client = MinecraftClient.getInstance();
        MatrixStack matrices = context.getMatrices();

        matrices.push();
        matrices.translate(centerX, centerY, 150.0f);
        matrices.scale(this.previewZoom, -this.previewZoom, this.previewZoom);
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_X.rotationDegrees(this.previewPitch));
        matrices.multiply(RotationAxis.POSITIVE_Y.rotationDegrees(this.previewYaw));

        BlockState previewState = handler.chestEntity != null
                ? handler.chestEntity.getCachedState()
                : ModBlocks.WOODEN_CHEST.getDefaultState();

        matrices.translate(-0.5f, -0.45f, -0.5f);
        client.getBlockRenderManager().renderBlockAsEntity(
                previewState,
                matrices,
                context.getVertexConsumers(),
                LightmapTextureManager.MAX_LIGHT_COORDINATE,
                OverlayTexture.DEFAULT_UV
        );

        matrices.pop();
        context.draw();
    }

    private void drawCheckerboard(DrawContext context, int left, int top, int right, int bottom, int cellSize) {
        for (int py = top; py < bottom; py += cellSize) {
            for (int px = left; px < right; px += cellSize) {
                int gx = (px - left) / cellSize;
                int gy = (py - top) / cellSize;
                int color = ((gx + gy) % 2 == 0) ? 0xFF262729 : 0xFF2E3032;
                context.fill(px, py, Math.min(px + cellSize, right), Math.min(py + cellSize, bottom), color);
            }
        }
    }

    private void drawDivider(DrawContext context, int x, int y, int width) {
        context.fill(x, y, x + width, y + 1, 0xFF202122);
        context.fill(x, y + 1, x + width, y + 2, 0xFF3E4042);
    }

    private boolean isInsideViewport(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        return mouseX >= x + 10 && mouseX <= x + 76 && mouseY >= y + 20 && mouseY <= y + 86;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseScrolled(double mouseX, double mouseY, double horizontalAmount, double verticalAmount) {
        if (isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.previewZoom = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewZoom + (float) verticalAmount * 2.5f, 12.0f, 42.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseScrolled(mouseX, mouseY, horizontalAmount, verticalAmount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;

        if ((button == 0 || button == 1) && isInsideViewport(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            this.draggingPreview = true;
            return true;
        }

        // ÐšÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¿Ð¾ ÐºÑ€Ð°ÑÐ½Ð¾Ð¹ ÐºÐ½Ð¾Ð¿ÐºÐµ [X] (X: 34..52, Y: 91..109)
        int redBtnX = x + 34;
        int redBtnY = y + 91;
        if (mouseX >= redBtnX && mouseX <= redBtnX + 18 && mouseY >= redBtnY && mouseY <= redBtnY + 18) {
            if (button == 1 || (this.limitSelectionMode && button == 0)) {
                // ÐŸÐ¾Ð²Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÐºÐ»Ð¸Ðº Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ ÐŸÐšÐœ Ð¿Ð¾ ÐºÐ½Ð¾Ð¿ÐºÐµ [X] Ð¿Ð¾Ð»Ð½Ð¾ÑÑ‚ÑŒÑŽ Ñ€Ð°Ð·Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÑ‚ Ð²ÑÐµ ÑÐ»Ð¾Ñ‚Ñ‹ ÑÑƒÐ½Ð´ÑƒÐºÐ°!
                this.limitSelectionMode = false;
                ClientPlayNetworking.send(new ChangeStackSizePayload(handler.targetPos, handler.totalSlots));
            } else if (button == 0) {
                this.limitSelectionMode = true;
            }
            return true;
        }

        // Ð•ÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð°ÐºÑ‚Ð¸Ð²ÐµÐ½ Ñ€ÐµÐ¶Ð¸Ð¼ ÐºÑ€Ð°ÑÐ½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ ÐºÑ€ÐµÑÑ‚Ð¸ÐºÐ° [X] Ð˜Ð›Ð˜ Ð·Ð°Ð¶Ð°Ñ‚ Shift + ÐŸÐšÐœ Ð¿Ð¾ ÑÐ»Ð¾Ñ‚Ñƒ ÑÑƒÐ½Ð´ÑƒÐºÐ°
        int hoveredSlot = getHoveredChestSlotIndex(mouseX, mouseY);
        if (hoveredSlot >= 0) {
            if (this.limitSelectionMode && button == 0) {
                this.limitSelectionMode = false;
                ClientPlayNetworking.send(new ChangeStackSizePayload(handler.targetPos, hoveredSlot));
                return true;
            }
            if (hasShiftDown() && button == 1) {
                int nextLimit = (handler.getUnlockedSlots() == hoveredSlot) ? handler.totalSlots : hoveredSlot;
                ClientPlayNetworking.send(new ChangeStackSizePayload(handler.targetPos, nextLimit));
                return true;
            }
        }

        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (this.draggingPreview && (button == 0 || button == 1)) {
            this.draggingPreview = false;
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double deltaX, double deltaY) {
        if (this.draggingPreview) {
            this.previewYaw += (float) deltaX * 1.5f;
            this.previewPitch = MathHelper.clamp(this.previewPitch + (float) deltaY * 1.5f, -80.0f, 80.0f);
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, deltaX, deltaY);
    }

    @Override
    public void render(DrawContext context, int mouseX, int mouseY, float delta) {
        super.render(context, mouseX, mouseY, delta);

        // Ð•ÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð²ÐºÐ»ÑŽÑ‡Ñ‘Ð½ Ñ€ÐµÐ¶Ð¸Ð¼ Ð²Ñ‹Ð±Ð¾Ñ€Ð° Ð»Ð¸Ð¼Ð¸Ñ‚Ð° [X] â€” Ñ€Ð¸ÑÑƒÐµÐ¼ ÐºÑ€Ð°ÑÐ½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÐºÑ€ÐµÑÑ‚Ð¸Ðº Ñ€ÑÐ´Ð¾Ð¼ Ñ ÐºÑƒÑ€ÑÐ¾Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼ Ð¼Ñ‹ÑˆÐ¸!
        if (this.limitSelectionMode) {
            drawSmallX(context, mouseX + 6, mouseY + 6, 0xFFFF4444);
        }

        int x = (width - backgroundWidth) / 2;
        int y = (height - backgroundHeight) / 2;
        if (mouseX >= x + 34 && mouseX <= x + 52 && mouseY >= y + 91 && mouseY <= y + 109) {
            context.drawTooltip(this.textRenderer,
                    Text.translatable("gui.factoriocore.chest_limit_tooltip"), mouseX, mouseY);
        } else {
            drawMouseoverTooltip(context, mouseX, mouseY);
        }
    }
