                || (prevWatts == 0) != (engine.currentOutputWatts == 0)
                || (dirty && (now % 10) == 0)) {
            engine.sync();
        } else if (dirty) {
            engine.markDirty();
        }
    }

    private static boolean equalizeSteamWithNeighbor(World world, SteamEngineBlockEntity self, BlockPos neighborPos, Direction fromSide) {
        BlockState neighborState = world.getBlockState(neighborPos);
        BlockPos canonical = BlockHealthManager.getCanonicalPos(neighborPos, neighborState);
        BlockEntity be = world.getBlockEntity(canonical);

        if (be instanceof SteamEngineBlockEntity otherEngine && otherEngine != self) {
            int diff = self.steamMb - otherEngine.steamMb;
            if (diff > 10) {
                int move = Math.min(diff / 2, 120);
                otherEngine.steamMb += move;
                self.steamMb -= move;
                otherEngine.markDirty();
                return true;
            }
        } else if (be instanceof PipeBlockEntity pipe) {
            int diff = self.steamMb - pipe.getFluidAmount();
            if (diff > 40 && pipe.canAcceptFluid(FluidKind.STEAM, fromSide)) {
                int offer = Math.min(90, diff / 2);
                int accepted = pipe.insertFluid(FluidKind.STEAM, offer, 165, fromSide);
                if (accepted > 0) {
                    self.steamMb -= accepted;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public void sync() {
        markDirty();
        if (this.world != null && !this.world.isClient) {
            this.world.updateListeners(this.pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_LISTENERS);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public FluidKind getFluidKind() {
        return this.steamMb > 0 ? FluidKind.STEAM : FluidKind.NONE;
    }

    @Override
    public int getFluidAmount() {
        return this.steamMb;
    }

    @Override
    public int getFluidCapacity() {
        return CAPACITY_MB;
    }

    @Override
    public int getTemperatureC() {
        return 165;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canAcceptFluid(FluidKind kind, Direction fromSide) {
        return kind == FluidKind.STEAM && this.steamMb < CAPACITY_MB;
    }

    @Override
    public int insertFluid(FluidKind kind, int maxAmount, int tempC, Direction fromSide) {
        if (kind != FluidKind.STEAM || maxAmount <= 0) return 0;
        int space = CAPACITY_MB - this.steamMb;
        int add = Math.min(space, maxAmount);
        if (add > 0) {
            boolean wasEmpty = (this.steamMb == 0);
            this.steamMb += add;
            if (wasEmpty) {
                this.lastLoadCheckTick = -20L;
                sync();
            } else {
                markDirty();
            }
        }
        return add;
    }

    @Override
    protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
        nbt.putInt("SteamMb", this.steamMb);
        nbt.putInt("CurrentOutputWatts", this.currentOutputWatts);
        nbt.putFloat("SteamRemainder", this.steamRemainder);
    }

    @Override
    protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
        this.steamMb = nbt.getInt("SteamMb");
        this.currentOutputWatts = nbt.getInt("CurrentOutputWatts");
        this.steamRemainder = nbt.getFloat("SteamRemainder");
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public Packet<ClientPlayPacketListener> toUpdatePacket() {
        return BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket.create(this);
    }

    @Override
    public NbtCompound toInitialChunkDataNbt(RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        return createNbt(registries);
    }

                this.amountMb += add;
                markDirty();
                if (wasEmpty || (this.world != null && (this.world.getTime() & 3L) == 0L)) {
                    sync();
                }
            }
            return add;
        }

        @Override
        protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
            super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
            nbt.putString("FluidKind", this.fluidKind.name());
            nbt.putInt("AmountMb", this.amountMb);
            nbt.putInt("TempC", this.temperatureC);
        }

        @Override
        protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
            super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
            try {
                this.fluidKind = FluidKind.valueOf(nbt.getString("FluidKind"));
            } catch (Exception e) {
                this.fluidKind = FluidKind.NONE;
            }
            this.amountMb = nbt.getInt("AmountMb");
            this.temperatureC = nbt.getInt("TempC");
        }

        @Nullable @Override public Packet<ClientPlayPacketListener> toUpdatePacket() { return BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket.create(this); }
        @Override public NbtCompound toInitialChunkDataNbt(RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) { return createNbt(registries); }
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.belt;

    public static final DirectionProperty FACING = Properties.HORIZONTAL_FACING;
    private static final VoxelShape SHAPE = Block.createCuboidShape(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 6.0, 16.0);

    private final int tier;
    private final boolean undergroundBlock;

    public BeltBlock(Settings settings) {

    }

    public BeltBlock(Settings settings, int tier, boolean undergroundBlock) {
        super(settings);
        this.tier = tier;
        this.undergroundBlock = undergroundBlock;
        this.setDefaultState(this.stateManager.getDefaultState().with(FACING, Direction.NORTH));
    }

    public int getTier() {
        return this.tier;
    }

    public boolean isUndergroundBlock() {
        return this.undergroundBlock;
    }

    @Override
    protected MapCodec<? extends BlockWithEntity> getCodec() {
        return CODEC;
    }

    @Override
    protected void appendProperties(StateManager.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
        builder.add(FACING);
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockState getPlacementState(ItemPlacementContext ctx) {
        Direction dir = ctx.getHorizontalPlayerFacing();
        if (ctx.getPlayer() != null && ctx.getPlayer().isSneaking()) {
            dir = dir.getOpposite();
        }
        return this.getDefaultState().with(FACING, dir);
    }

    @Override

    }

    @Override

        }
        return BlockRenderType.ENTITYBLOCK_ANIMATED;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockEntity createBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        return new BeltBlockEntity(pos, state);
    }

    @Nullable

    public <T extends BlockEntity> BlockEntityTicker<T> getTicker(World world, BlockState state, BlockEntityType<T> type) {
        return validateTicker(type, BeltBlockEntity.TYPE,

    public static boolean isLeftSideOfBelt(Direction facing, double relX, double relZ) {
        return switch (facing) {
            case NORTH -> relX < 0;
            case SOUTH -> relX > 0;
            case WEST  -> relZ > 0;
            case EAST  -> relZ < 0;
            default    -> false;
        };
    }

    public static double getProgressAlongBelt(Direction facing, double relX, double relZ) {
        return switch (facing) {
            case NORTH -> 0.5 - relZ;
            case SOUTH -> 0.5 + relZ;
            case WEST  -> 0.5 - relX;
            case EAST  -> 0.5 + relX;
            default    -> 0.5;
        };
    }

    @Override
    protected void onEntityCollision(BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos, Entity entity) {
        Direction facing = state.get(FACING);

        if (entity instanceof ItemEntity itemEntity && !world.isClient && entity.isAlive()) {
            if (world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof BeltBlockEntity beltEntity) {
                ItemStack dropped = itemEntity.getStack();
                if (!dropped.isEmpty()) {
                    double relX = entity.getX() - (pos.getX() + 0.5);
                    double relZ = entity.getZ() - (pos.getZ() + 0.5);

                    boolean isLeft = isLeftSideOfBelt(facing, relX, relZ);
                    double along = getProgressAlongBelt(facing, relX, relZ);
                    int slot = MathHelper.clamp((int) (along * 4.0), 0, 3);

                    if (beltEntity.isSlotCoveredByHood(slot)) {
                        return;
                    }

                    BeltLane lane = isLeft ? beltEntity.getLeftLane() : beltEntity.getRightLane();
                    if (lane.insertAt(slot, dropped)) {
                        dropped.decrement(1);
                        if (dropped.isEmpty()) {
                            itemEntity.discard();
                        } else {
                            itemEntity.setStack(dropped);
                        }
                        syncManualChange(world, pos, state, beltEntity);
                    }
                }
            }
            return;
        }

        if (state.getBlock() instanceof SplitterBlock) {
            return;
        }

        if (!entity.isSneaking() && entity.getY() >= pos.getY() + 0.3) {
            double basePush = 0.045;
            if (state.getBlock() instanceof FastBeltBlock || (state.getBlock() instanceof UndergroundBeltBlock ub && ub.getTier() == 2)) {
                basePush = 0.09;
            } else if (state.getBlock() instanceof ExpressBeltBlock || (state.getBlock() instanceof UndergroundBeltBlock ub && ub.getTier() == 3)) {
                basePush = 0.135;
            }

            Vec3d vel = entity.getVelocity();
            double pushX = facing.getOffsetX() * basePush;
            double pushZ = facing.getOffsetZ() * basePush;
            entity.setVelocity(
                    MathHelper.clamp(vel.x + pushX, -0.4, 0.4),
                    vel.y,
                    MathHelper.clamp(vel.z + pushZ, -0.4, 0.4)
            );
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected ActionResult onUse(BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos, PlayerEntity player, BlockHitResult hit) {
        if (world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof BeltBlockEntity beltEntity) {
            ItemStack stack = player.getStackInHand(Hand.MAIN_HAND);

            if (player.isSneaking() && (!stack.isEmpty() || !beltEntity.isUnderground())) {
                return ActionResult.PASS;
            }
            if (!stack.isEmpty() && stack.getItem() instanceof BlockItem bi
                    && (bi.getBlock() instanceof BeltBlock
                    || bi.getBlock() instanceof InserterBlock
                    || bi.getBlock() instanceof BurnerDrillBlock
                    || bi.getBlock() instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlock
                    || bi.getBlock() instanceof FactorioChestBlock)) {
                return ActionResult.PASS;
            }

            if (world.isClient) return ActionResult.SUCCESS;

            if (beltEntity.isSplitter() && !player.isSneaking()) {
                player.openHandledScreen(beltEntity.getMasterSplitter());
                return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
            }

            if (player.isSneaking() && beltEntity.isUnderground()) {
                boolean nextIsOutput = beltEntity.getUndergroundMode() == BeltBlockEntity.UndergroundMode.INPUT;
                BeltBlockEntity.UndergroundMode nextMode = nextIsOutput
                        ? BeltBlockEntity.UndergroundMode.OUTPUT
                        : BeltBlockEntity.UndergroundMode.INPUT;
                beltEntity.setUndergroundMode(nextMode);

                BlockState updatedState = state.contains(UndergroundBeltBlock.OUTPUT)
                        ? state.with(UndergroundBeltBlock.OUTPUT, nextIsOutput)
                        : state;
                world.setBlockState(pos, updatedState, Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
                syncManualChange(world, pos, updatedState, beltEntity);
                return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
            }

            Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
            double relX = hit.getPos().x - (pos.getX() + 0.5);
            double relZ = hit.getPos().z - (pos.getZ() + 0.5);

            boolean isLeftClicked = isLeftSideOfBelt(facing, relX, relZ);
            double along = getProgressAlongBelt(facing, relX, relZ);
            int clickedSlot = MathHelper.clamp((int) (along * 4.0), 0, 3);

            BeltLane targetLane = isLeftClicked ? beltEntity.getLeftLane() : beltEntity.getRightLane();
            BeltLane secondaryLane = isLeftClicked ? beltEntity.getRightLane() : beltEntity.getLeftLane();

            if (stack.isEmpty()) {
                if (targetLane.hasItemAt(clickedSlot)) {
                    player.giveItemStack(targetLane.extractAt(clickedSlot));
                    syncManualChange(world, pos, state, beltEntity);
                    return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
                } else if (secondaryLane.hasItemAt(clickedSlot)) {
                    player.giveItemStack(secondaryLane.extractAt(clickedSlot));
                    syncManualChange(world, pos, state, beltEntity);
                    return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
                } else if (targetLane.canExtract()) {
                    player.giveItemStack(targetLane.extract());
                    syncManualChange(world, pos, state, beltEntity);
                    return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
                }
                return ActionResult.PASS;
            }

            if (!beltEntity.isSlotCoveredByHood(clickedSlot) && targetLane.canInsertAt(clickedSlot)) {
                ItemStack single = stack.split(1);
                targetLane.insertAt(clickedSlot, single);
                syncManualChange(world, pos, state, beltEntity);
                return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
            } else if (!beltEntity.isSlotCoveredByHood(0) && targetLane.canInsert()) {
                ItemStack single = stack.split(1);
                targetLane.insert(single);
                syncManualChange(world, pos, state, beltEntity);
                return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
            } else if (!beltEntity.isSlotCoveredByHood(0) && secondaryLane.canInsert()) {
                ItemStack single = stack.split(1);
                secondaryLane.insert(single);
                syncManualChange(world, pos, state, beltEntity);
                return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
            }
        }
        return super.onUse(state, world, pos, player, hit);
    }

    public static void syncManualChange(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, BeltBlockEntity beltEntity) {
        beltEntity.clearMovementFlags();
        beltEntity.markDirty();
        world.updateListeners(pos, state, state, Block.NOTIFY_LISTENERS);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onStateReplaced(BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState newState, boolean moved) {
        if (!state.isOf(newState.getBlock())) {
            BlockEntity blockEntity = world.getBlockEntity(pos);
            if (blockEntity instanceof BeltBlockEntity beltEntity) {
                dropLaneItems(world, pos, beltEntity.getLeftLane());
                dropLaneItems(world, pos, beltEntity.getRightLane());
                dropTunnelItems(world, pos, beltEntity.getLeftTunnel());
                dropTunnelItems(world, pos, beltEntity.getRightTunnel());
                world.updateComparators(pos, this);
            }
            super.onStateReplaced(state, world, pos, newState, moved);
        }
    }

    private void dropLaneItems(World world, BlockPos pos, BeltLane lane) {
        for (int i = 0; i < BeltLane.CAPACITY; i++) {
            ItemStack stack = lane.getStack(i);
            if (!stack.isEmpty()) {
                ItemScatterer.spawn(world, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.5, pos.getZ() + 0.5, stack);
            }
        }
        lane.clear();
    }

    private void dropTunnelItems(World world, BlockPos pos, ItemStack[] tunnel) {
        for (int i = 0; i < tunnel.length; i++) {
            if (!tunnel[i].isEmpty()) {
                ItemScatterer.spawn(world, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.5, pos.getZ() + 0.5, tunnel[i]);
                tunnel[i] = ItemStack.EMPTY;
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected float calcBlockBreakingDelta(net.minecraft.block.BlockState state, net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity player, net.minecraft.world.BlockView world, net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos pos) {
        return 0.125f;
    }
}

    public BeltBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(TYPE, pos, state);
        Arrays.fill(this.leftTunnel, ItemStack.EMPTY);
        Arrays.fill(this.rightTunnel, ItemStack.EMPTY);

        if (state.getBlock() instanceof BeltBlock beltBlock) {
            this.beltTier = beltBlock.getTier();
            if (beltBlock.isUndergroundBlock()) {
                boolean isOut = state.contains(UndergroundBeltBlock.OUTPUT) && state.get(UndergroundBeltBlock.OUTPUT);
                this.undergroundMode = isOut ? UndergroundMode.OUTPUT : UndergroundMode.INPUT;
            }
        }
    }

    public int getMoveDelay() {
        return switch (this.beltTier) {

            case 3 -> 1;

    public boolean isSplitter() {
        return getCachedState().getBlock() instanceof SplitterBlock;

        BlockState state = getCachedState();
        return state.contains(SplitterBlock.PART_RIGHT) && state.get(SplitterBlock.PART_RIGHT);
    }

    public BeltBlockEntity getMasterSplitter() {
        if (!isSplitter() || !isRightSplitterPart() || this.world == null) {
            return this;
        }
        Direction facing = getCachedState().get(BeltBlock.FACING);
        BlockPos leftPos = this.pos.offset(facing.rotateYCounterclockwise());
        if (this.world.getBlockEntity(leftPos) instanceof BeltBlockEntity leftPartner && leftPartner.isSplitter()) {
            return leftPartner;
        }
        return this;
    }

    @Nullable
    public BeltBlockEntity getOtherSplitterHalf() {
        if (!isSplitter() || this.world == null) {
            return null;
        }
        Direction facing = getCachedState().get(BeltBlock.FACING);
        BlockPos otherPos = isRightSplitterPart()
                ? this.pos.offset(facing.rotateYCounterclockwise())
                : this.pos.offset(facing.rotateYClockwise());
        if (this.world.getBlockEntity(otherPos) instanceof BeltBlockEntity other && other.isSplitter()) {
            return other;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public void handleSplitterGuiAction(int action) {
        BeltBlockEntity master = getMasterSplitter();
        switch (action) {
            case ACTION_SPLITTER_TOGGLE_IN_PRIORITY -> master.inputPriorityEnabled = !master.inputPriorityEnabled;
            case ACTION_SPLITTER_TOGGLE_IN_RIGHT -> {
                master.inputPriorityRight = !master.inputPriorityRight;
                master.inputPriorityEnabled = true;
            }
            case ACTION_SPLITTER_TOGGLE_OUT_PRIORITY -> master.outputPriorityEnabled = !master.outputPriorityEnabled;
            case ACTION_SPLITTER_TOGGLE_OUT_RIGHT -> {
                master.outputPriorityRight = !master.outputPriorityRight;
                master.outputPriorityEnabled = true;
            }
        }
        master.markDirty();
        if (master.world != null) {
            master.world.updateListeners(master.pos, master.getCachedState(), master.getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
        }
    }

    public boolean isSlotCoveredByHood(int slot) {
        if (this.undergroundMode == UndergroundMode.INPUT) {
            return slot >= 2;
        } else if (this.undergroundMode == UndergroundMode.OUTPUT) {
            return slot <= 1;
        }
        return false;

    @Nullable
    public BeltBlockEntity findPairedOutput(World world, BlockPos pos, Direction facing) {
        if (this.undergroundMode != UndergroundMode.INPUT) {
            return null;
        }
        int maxOffset = getMaxUndergroundOffset();
        for (int d = 1; d <= maxOffset; d++) {
            BlockPos checkPos = pos.offset(facing, d);
            if (world.getBlockEntity(checkPos) instanceof BeltBlockEntity other) {
                if (other.isUnderground() && other.beltTier == this.beltTier) {
                    Direction otherFacing = other.getCachedState().get(BeltBlock.FACING);
                    if (otherFacing == facing) {
                        if (other.undergroundMode == UndergroundMode.INPUT) {
                            return null;
                        }
                        if (other.undergroundMode == UndergroundMode.OUTPUT) {
                            return other;
                        }
                    } else if (otherFacing == facing.getOpposite()) {
                        return null;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static void clientTick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, BeltBlockEntity entity) {
        int delay = entity.getMoveDelay();
        if (entity.renderTicks < delay) {
            entity.renderTicks++;
        }
    }

    public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, BeltBlockEntity entity) {
        if (world.isClient()) {
            return;
        }

        long worldTime = world.getTime();
        int delay = entity.getMoveDelay();
        if (worldTime % delay != 0) {
            return;
        }

        stepBeltChain(world, pos, state, entity, worldTime, 0);
    }

    private static void stepBeltChain(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state,
                                      BeltBlockEntity entity, long worldTime, int depth) {
        if (entity.lastSteppedWorldTime == worldTime || depth > 64) {
            return;
        }

        if (entity.isSplitter()) {
            BeltBlockEntity leftHalf = entity.getMasterSplitter();
            BeltBlockEntity rightHalf = leftHalf.getOtherSplitterHalf();
            if (rightHalf == null) {
                entity.lastSteppedWorldTime = worldTime;
                return;
            }
            if (leftHalf.lastSteppedWorldTime == worldTime) {
                return;
            }
            leftHalf.lastSteppedWorldTime = worldTime;
            rightHalf.lastSteppedWorldTime = worldTime;

            stepSplitterPair(world, leftHalf, rightHalf, worldTime, depth);
            return;
        }

        entity.lastSteppedWorldTime = worldTime;

        Direction facing = state.get(BeltBlock.FACING);
        boolean hadMovingBefore = entity.leftLane.resetMovementFlags() | entity.rightLane.resetMovementFlags();
        boolean thisChanged = false;

        if (entity.undergroundMode == UndergroundMode.INPUT) {
            BeltBlockEntity pairedOutput = entity.findPairedOutput(world, pos, facing);
            if (pairedOutput != null) {
                stepBeltChain(world, pairedOutput.getPos(), pairedOutput.getCachedState(), pairedOutput, worldTime, depth + 1);

                int distanceBlocks = pos.getManhattanDistance(pairedOutput.getPos());
                int tunnelLength = Math.max(4, Math.min(MAX_TUNNEL_SLOTS, distanceBlocks * 4));

                boolean outChanged = false;
                for (int step = 0; step < entity.beltTier; step++) {
                    if (advanceTunnel(entity.leftLane, entity.leftTunnel, tunnelLength, pairedOutput.leftLane)) {
                        thisChanged = true;
                        outChanged = true;
                    }
                    if (advanceTunnel(entity.rightLane, entity.rightTunnel, tunnelLength, pairedOutput.rightLane)) {
                        thisChanged = true;
                        outChanged = true;
                    }
                }

                if (outChanged) {
                    pairedOutput.markDirty();
                    world.updateListeners(pairedOutput.getPos(), pairedOutput.getCachedState(), pairedOutput.getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
                    InserterBlockEntity.wakeUpAdjacentInserters(world, pairedOutput.getPos());
                }
            }

            if (entity.leftLane.tickRange(0, 1)) {
                thisChanged = true;
            }
            if (entity.rightLane.tickRange(0, 1)) {
                thisChanged = true;
            }

            if (thisChanged) {
                InserterBlockEntity.wakeUpAdjacentInserters(world, pos);
            }
            if (thisChanged || hadMovingBefore) {
                entity.markDirty();
                world.updateListeners(pos, state, state, Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
            }
            return;
        }

        BlockPos nextPos = pos.offset(facing);
        BlockEntity nextBe = world.getBlockEntity(nextPos);

        if (nextBe instanceof BeltBlockEntity nextBelt) {
            stepBeltChain(world, nextPos, nextBelt.getCachedState(), nextBelt, worldTime, depth + 1);
        }

        boolean nextChanged = false;

        if (nextBe instanceof BeltBlockEntity nextBelt) {
            if (transferBeltToBelt(world, entity, nextPos, nextBelt, facing)) {
                thisChanged = true;
                nextChanged = true;
            }
            if (nextChanged) {
                nextBelt.markDirty();
                world.updateListeners(nextPos, nextBelt.getCachedState(), nextBelt.getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
                InserterBlockEntity.wakeUpAdjacentInserters(world, nextPos);
            }
        }

        int minSlot = (entity.undergroundMode == UndergroundMode.OUTPUT) ? 2 : 0;
        if (entity.leftLane.tickRange(minSlot, 3)) {
            thisChanged = true;
        }
        if (entity.rightLane.tickRange(minSlot, 3)) {
            thisChanged = true;
        }

        if (thisChanged) {
            InserterBlockEntity.wakeUpAdjacentInserters(world, pos);
        }

        if (thisChanged || hadMovingBefore) {
            entity.markDirty();
            world.updateListeners(pos, state, state, Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
        }
    }

    private static void stepSplitterPair(World world, BeltBlockEntity leftHalf, BeltBlockEntity rightHalf,
                                         long worldTime, int depth) {
        Direction facing = leftHalf.getCachedState().get(BeltBlock.FACING);

        BlockPos nextLeftPos = leftHalf.pos.offset(facing);
        BlockPos nextRightPos = rightHalf.pos.offset(facing);

        if (world.getBlockEntity(nextLeftPos) instanceof BeltBlockEntity nextLeftBelt) {
            stepBeltChain(world, nextLeftPos, nextLeftBelt.getCachedState(), nextLeftBelt, worldTime, depth + 1);
        }
        if (world.getBlockEntity(nextRightPos) instanceof BeltBlockEntity nextRightBelt) {
            stepBeltChain(world, nextRightPos, nextRightBelt.getCachedState(), nextRightBelt, worldTime, depth + 1);
        }

        boolean hadMovingLeft = leftHalf.leftLane.resetMovementFlags() | leftHalf.rightLane.resetMovementFlags();
        boolean hadMovingRight = rightHalf.leftLane.resetMovementFlags() | rightHalf.rightLane.resetMovementFlags();
        boolean leftChanged = false;
        boolean rightChanged = false;

        if (world.getBlockEntity(nextLeftPos) instanceof BeltBlockEntity nextLeftBelt) {
            if (transferBeltToBelt(world, leftHalf, nextLeftPos, nextLeftBelt, facing)) {
                leftChanged = true;
                nextLeftBelt.markDirty();
                world.updateListeners(nextLeftPos, nextLeftBelt.getCachedState(), nextLeftBelt.getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
                InserterBlockEntity.wakeUpAdjacentInserters(world, nextLeftPos);
            }
        }
        if (world.getBlockEntity(nextRightPos) instanceof BeltBlockEntity nextRightBelt) {
            if (transferBeltToBelt(world, rightHalf, nextRightPos, nextRightBelt, facing)) {
                rightChanged = true;
                nextRightBelt.markDirty();
                world.updateListeners(nextRightPos, nextRightBelt.getCachedState(), nextRightBelt.getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
                InserterBlockEntity.wakeUpAdjacentInserters(world, nextRightPos);
            }
        }

        if (leftHalf.leftLane.tickRange(2, 3)) leftChanged = true;
        if (leftHalf.rightLane.tickRange(2, 3)) leftChanged = true;
        if (rightHalf.leftLane.tickRange(2, 3)) rightChanged = true;
        if (rightHalf.rightLane.tickRange(2, 3)) rightChanged = true;

        int maskLeftLanes = routeSplitterSubLanes(leftHalf, leftHalf.leftLane, rightHalf.leftLane, true);
        if ((maskLeftLanes & 1) != 0) leftChanged = true;
        if ((maskLeftLanes & 2) != 0) rightChanged = true;

        int maskRightLanes = routeSplitterSubLanes(leftHalf, leftHalf.rightLane, rightHalf.rightLane, false);
        if ((maskRightLanes & 1) != 0) leftChanged = true;
        if ((maskRightLanes & 2) != 0) rightChanged = true;

        if (leftHalf.leftLane.tickRange(0, 1)) leftChanged = true;
        if (leftHalf.rightLane.tickRange(0, 1)) leftChanged = true;
        if (rightHalf.leftLane.tickRange(0, 1)) rightChanged = true;
        if (rightHalf.rightLane.tickRange(0, 1)) rightChanged = true;

        if (leftChanged) {
            InserterBlockEntity.wakeUpAdjacentInserters(world, leftHalf.pos);
        }
        if (rightChanged) {
            InserterBlockEntity.wakeUpAdjacentInserters(world, rightHalf.pos);
        }

        if (leftChanged || hadMovingLeft) {
            leftHalf.markDirty();
            world.updateListeners(leftHalf.pos, leftHalf.getCachedState(), leftHalf.getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
        }
        if (rightChanged || hadMovingRight) {
            rightHalf.markDirty();
            world.updateListeners(rightHalf.pos, rightHalf.getCachedState(), rightHalf.getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
        }
    }

    private static int routeSplitterSubLanes(BeltBlockEntity master, BeltLane leftBeltLane, BeltLane rightBeltLane, boolean isLeftSubLane) {
        int changedMask = 0;

        boolean checkRightInputFirst;
        if (master.inputPriorityEnabled) {
            checkRightInputFirst = master.inputPriorityRight;
        } else {
            checkRightInputFirst = isLeftSubLane ? master.nextInRightForLeftLane : master.nextInRightForRightLane;
            if (isLeftSubLane) {
                master.nextInRightForLeftLane = !master.nextInRightForLeftLane;
            } else {
                master.nextInRightForRightLane = !master.nextInRightForRightLane;
            }
        }

        for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
            boolean fromRight = (pass == 0) == checkRightInputFirst;
            BeltLane srcLane = fromRight ? rightBeltLane : leftBeltLane;
            int srcBit = fromRight ? 2 : 1;

            if (!srcLane.hasItemAt(1)) {
                continue;
            }

            ItemStack item = srcLane.getStack(1);

            if (master.outputPriorityEnabled && !master.splitterFilter.isEmpty()) {
                boolean matchesFilter = ItemStack.areItemsEqual(item, master.splitterFilter);
                boolean targetRight = matchesFilter ? master.outputPriorityRight : !master.outputPriorityRight;
                BeltLane targetLane = targetRight ? rightBeltLane : leftBeltLane;
                int dstBit = targetRight ? 2 : 1;

                if (targetLane.canInsertAt(2)) {
                    targetLane.insertAtFromBelt(2, srcLane.extractAt(1));
                    changedMask |= (srcBit | dstBit);
                }
                continue;
            }

            boolean preferRightOut;
            if (master.outputPriorityEnabled) {
                preferRightOut = master.outputPriorityRight;
            } else {
                preferRightOut = isLeftSubLane ? master.nextOutRightForLeftLane : master.nextOutRightForRightLane;
            }

            BeltLane firstOut = preferRightOut ? rightBeltLane : leftBeltLane;
            BeltLane secondOut = preferRightOut ? leftBeltLane : rightBeltLane;
            int firstBit = preferRightOut ? 2 : 1;
            int secondBit = preferRightOut ? 1 : 2;

            if (firstOut.canInsertAt(2)) {
                firstOut.insertAtFromBelt(2, srcLane.extractAt(1));
                changedMask |= (srcBit | firstBit);
                if (!master.outputPriorityEnabled) {
                    if (isLeftSubLane) master.nextOutRightForLeftLane = !preferRightOut;
                    else master.nextOutRightForRightLane = !preferRightOut;
                }
            } else if (secondOut.canInsertAt(2)) {
                secondOut.insertAtFromBelt(2, srcLane.extractAt(1));
                changedMask |= (srcBit | secondBit);
                if (!master.outputPriorityEnabled) {
                    if (isLeftSubLane) master.nextOutRightForLeftLane = preferRightOut;
                    else master.nextOutRightForRightLane = preferRightOut;
                }
            }
        }

        return changedMask;
    }

    private static boolean transferBeltToBelt(World world, BeltBlockEntity fromBelt, BlockPos nextPos,
                                              BeltBlockEntity nextBelt, Direction facing) {
        boolean changed = false;
        Direction nextFacing = nextBelt.getCachedState().get(BeltBlock.FACING);

        if (nextFacing == facing) {
            if (nextBelt.undergroundMode != UndergroundMode.OUTPUT) {
                if (fromBelt.leftLane.canExtract() && nextBelt.leftLane.canInsert()) {
                    nextBelt.leftLane.insertFromBelt(fromBelt.leftLane.extract());
                    changed = true;
                }
                if (fromBelt.rightLane.canExtract() && nextBelt.rightLane.canInsert()) {
                    nextBelt.rightLane.insertFromBelt(fromBelt.rightLane.extract());
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
        } else if (isCornerTurn(world, nextPos, nextBelt, nextFacing, facing)) {
            if (fromBelt.leftLane.canExtract() && nextBelt.leftLane.canInsert()) {
                nextBelt.leftLane.insertFromBelt(fromBelt.leftLane.extract());
                changed = true;
            }
            if (fromBelt.rightLane.canExtract() && nextBelt.rightLane.canInsert()) {
                nextBelt.rightLane.insertFromBelt(fromBelt.rightLane.extract());
                changed = true;
            }
        } else if (facing == nextFacing.rotateYClockwise()) {
            if (!nextBelt.isSlotCoveredByHood(2) && trySideInsert(fromBelt.leftLane, nextBelt.leftLane, 2, nextBelt)) {
                changed = true;
            }
            if (!nextBelt.isSlotCoveredByHood(1) && trySideInsert(fromBelt.rightLane, nextBelt.leftLane, 1, nextBelt)) {
                changed = true;
            }
        } else if (facing == nextFacing.rotateYCounterclockwise()) {
            if (!nextBelt.isSlotCoveredByHood(2) && trySideInsert(fromBelt.rightLane, nextBelt.rightLane, 2, nextBelt)) {
                changed = true;
            }
            if (!nextBelt.isSlotCoveredByHood(1) && trySideInsert(fromBelt.leftLane, nextBelt.rightLane, 1, nextBelt)) {
                changed = true;
            }
        }
        return changed;
    }

    private static boolean advanceTunnel(BeltLane inputLane, ItemStack[] tunnel, int tunnelLength, BeltLane outputLane) {
        boolean moved = false;

        int lastIdx = tunnelLength - 1;
        if (!tunnel[lastIdx].isEmpty() && outputLane.canInsertAt(2)) {
            outputLane.insertAtFromBelt(2, tunnel[lastIdx]);
            tunnel[lastIdx] = ItemStack.EMPTY;
            moved = true;
        }

        for (int i = lastIdx - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (!tunnel[i].isEmpty() && tunnel[i + 1].isEmpty()) {
                tunnel[i + 1] = tunnel[i];
                tunnel[i] = ItemStack.EMPTY;
                moved = true;
            }
        }

        if (inputLane.hasItemAt(1) && tunnel[0].isEmpty()) {
            tunnel[0] = inputLane.extractAt(1);
            moved = true;
        }

        return moved;
    }

    private static boolean isCornerTurn(World world, BlockPos nextPos, BeltBlockEntity nextBelt,
                                        Direction nextFacing, Direction incomingFacing) {
        if (nextBelt.isUnderground() || nextBelt.isSplitter()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (incomingFacing != nextFacing.rotateYClockwise() && incomingFacing != nextFacing.rotateYCounterclockwise()) {
            return false;
        }

        BlockPos backPos = nextPos.offset(nextFacing.getOpposite());
        if (world.getBlockEntity(backPos) instanceof BeltBlockEntity backBelt) {
            if (backBelt.getCachedState().get(BeltBlock.FACING) == nextFacing
                    && backBelt.undergroundMode != UndergroundMode.INPUT) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        BlockPos oppositeSidePos = nextPos.offset(incomingFacing);
        if (world.getBlockEntity(oppositeSidePos) instanceof BeltBlockEntity otherSideBelt) {
            if (otherSideBelt.getCachedState().get(BeltBlock.FACING) == incomingFacing.getOpposite()
                    && otherSideBelt.undergroundMode != UndergroundMode.INPUT) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static boolean trySideInsert(BeltLane fromLane, BeltLane toLane, int targetSlot, BeltBlockEntity targetBelt) {
        if (!fromLane.canExtract()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!targetBelt.isSlotCoveredByHood(targetSlot) && toLane.canInsertAt(targetSlot)) {
            toLane.insertAt(targetSlot, fromLane.extract());
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

        return 1;

                master.outputPriorityEnabled = true;
            }
            master.markDirty();
            if (master.world != null) {
                master.world.updateListeners(master.pos, master.getCachedState(), master.getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
        nbt.putString(UNDERGROUND_MODE_KEY, this.undergroundMode.name());
        nbt.putInt(BELT_TIER_KEY, this.beltTier);

        nbt.putBoolean("InPriority", this.inputPriorityEnabled);
        nbt.putBoolean("InRight", this.inputPriorityRight);
        nbt.putBoolean("OutPriority", this.outputPriorityEnabled);
        nbt.putBoolean("OutRight", this.outputPriorityRight);
        if (!this.splitterFilter.isEmpty()) {
            nbt.put("SplitterFilter", this.splitterFilter.encode(registries));
        }

        NbtCompound leftTag = new NbtCompound();
        this.leftLane.writeNbt(leftTag, registries);
        nbt.put(LEFT_LANE_NBT_KEY, leftTag);

        NbtCompound rightTag = new NbtCompound();
        this.rightLane.writeNbt(rightTag, registries);
        nbt.put(RIGHT_LANE_NBT_KEY, rightTag);

        writeTunnelNbt(nbt, LEFT_TUNNEL_KEY, this.leftTunnel, registries);
        writeTunnelNbt(nbt, RIGHT_TUNNEL_KEY, this.rightTunnel, registries);
    }

    private void writeTunnelNbt(NbtCompound nbt, String key, ItemStack[] tunnel, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        NbtList list = new NbtList();
        for (int i = 0; i < tunnel.length; i++) {
            if (!tunnel[i].isEmpty()) {
                NbtCompound entry = new NbtCompound();
                entry.putByte("Slot", (byte) i);
                entry.put("Stack", tunnel[i].encode(registries));
                list.add(entry);
            }
        }
        if (!list.isEmpty()) {
            nbt.put(key, list);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
        if (nbt.contains(UNDERGROUND_MODE_KEY)) {
            try {
                this.undergroundMode = UndergroundMode.valueOf(nbt.getString(UNDERGROUND_MODE_KEY));
            } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
                this.undergroundMode = UndergroundMode.NONE;
            }
        }
        if (nbt.contains(BELT_TIER_KEY)) {
            this.beltTier = Math.max(1, Math.min(3, nbt.getInt(BELT_TIER_KEY)));
        }

        this.inputPriorityEnabled = nbt.getBoolean("InPriority");
        this.inputPriorityRight = nbt.getBoolean("InRight");
        this.outputPriorityEnabled = nbt.getBoolean("OutPriority");
        this.outputPriorityRight = nbt.getBoolean("OutRight");
        if (nbt.contains("SplitterFilter")) {
            this.splitterFilter = ItemStack.fromNbtOrEmpty(registries, nbt.getCompound("SplitterFilter"));
        } else {
            this.splitterFilter = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        }

        if (nbt.contains(LEFT_LANE_NBT_KEY)) {
            this.leftLane.readNbt(nbt.getCompound(LEFT_LANE_NBT_KEY), registries);
        }
        if (nbt.contains(RIGHT_LANE_NBT_KEY)) {
            this.rightLane.readNbt(nbt.getCompound(RIGHT_LANE_NBT_KEY), registries);
        }
        readTunnelNbt(nbt, LEFT_TUNNEL_KEY, this.leftTunnel, registries);
        readTunnelNbt(nbt, RIGHT_TUNNEL_KEY, this.rightTunnel, registries);

        if (this.world != null && this.world.isClient()) {
            this.renderTicks = 0;
        }
    }

    private void readTunnelNbt(NbtCompound nbt, String key, ItemStack[] tunnel, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        Arrays.fill(tunnel, ItemStack.EMPTY);
        if (!nbt.contains(key, NbtElement.LIST_TYPE)) return;
        NbtList list = nbt.getList(key, NbtElement.COMPOUND_TYPE);
        for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
            NbtCompound entry = list.getCompound(i);
            int slot = entry.getByte("Slot");
            if (slot >= 0 && slot < tunnel.length && entry.contains("Stack")) {
                tunnel[slot] = ItemStack.fromNbtOrEmpty(registries, entry.getCompound("Stack"));
            }
        }
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public Packet<ClientPlayPacketListener> toUpdatePacket() {
        return BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket.create(this);
    }

    @Override
    public NbtCompound toInitialChunkDataNbt(RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        return createNbt(registries);
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.belt;

import net.minecraft.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.nbt.NbtCompound;
import net.minecraft.nbt.NbtElement;
import net.minecraft.nbt.NbtList;
import net.minecraft.registry.RegistryWrapper;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class BeltLane {

    public static final int CAPACITY = 4;
    public static final int INPUT_SLOT = 0;
    public static final int OUTPUT_SLOT = CAPACITY - 1;

    private static final String ITEMS_NBT_KEY = "Items";
    private static final String SLOT_NBT_KEY = "Slot";
    private static final String STACK_NBT_KEY = "Stack";
    private static final String MOVING_NBT_KEY = "Moving";

    private final ItemStack[] slots = new ItemStack[CAPACITY];
    private final boolean[] moving = new boolean[CAPACITY];

    public BeltLane() {
        Arrays.fill(this.slots, ItemStack.EMPTY);
        Arrays.fill(this.moving, false);
    }

    public boolean resetMovementFlags() {
        boolean hadMoving = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < CAPACITY; i++) {
            if (this.moving[i]) {
                this.moving[i] = false;
                hadMoving = true;
            }
        }
        return hadMoving;
    }

    public boolean isMoving(int slot) {
        Objects.checkIndex(slot, CAPACITY);
        return this.moving[slot];
    }

    public boolean tick() {
        return tickRange(INPUT_SLOT, OUTPUT_SLOT);
    }

    public boolean tickRange(int minSlot, int maxSlot) {
        boolean moved = false;
        for (int i = maxSlot - 1; i >= minSlot; i--) {
            if (!this.slots[i].isEmpty() && this.slots[i + 1].isEmpty()) {
                this.slots[i + 1] = this.slots[i];
                this.slots[i] = ItemStack.EMPTY;
                this.moving[i + 1] = true;
                this.moving[i] = false;
                moved = true;
            }
        }
        return moved;
    }

    public boolean canInsert() {
        return this.slots[INPUT_SLOT].isEmpty();
    }

    public boolean insert(ItemStack stack) {
        if (stack == null || stack.isEmpty() || !this.canInsert()) {
            return false;
        }
        this.slots[INPUT_SLOT] = stack.copyWithCount(1);
        this.moving[INPUT_SLOT] = false;
        return true;
    }

    public boolean insertFromBelt(ItemStack stack) {
        if (stack == null || stack.isEmpty() || !this.canInsert()) {
            return false;
        }
        this.slots[INPUT_SLOT] = stack.copyWithCount(1);
        this.moving[INPUT_SLOT] = true;
        return true;
    }

    public boolean insertAtFromBelt(int slot, ItemStack stack) {
        if (stack != null && !stack.isEmpty() && canInsertAt(slot)) {
            this.slots[slot] = stack.copyWithCount(1);
            this.moving[slot] = true;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public boolean canExtract() {
        return !this.slots[OUTPUT_SLOT].isEmpty();
    }

    public ItemStack extract() {
        if (!this.canExtract()) {
            return ItemStack.EMPTY;
        }
        ItemStack extracted = this.slots[OUTPUT_SLOT];
        this.slots[OUTPUT_SLOT] = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        this.moving[OUTPUT_SLOT] = false;
        return extracted;
    }

    public ItemStack peekOutput() {
        return this.slots[OUTPUT_SLOT];
    }

    public ItemStack getStack(int slot) {
        Objects.checkIndex(slot, CAPACITY);
        return this.slots[slot];
    }

    public boolean isEmpty() {
        for (ItemStack stack : this.slots) {
            if (!stack.isEmpty()) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    public void clear() {
        Arrays.fill(this.slots, ItemStack.EMPTY);
        Arrays.fill(this.moving, false);
    }

    public boolean canInsertAt(int slot) {
        return slot >= 0 && slot < CAPACITY && this.slots[slot].isEmpty();
    }

    public boolean insertAt(int slot, ItemStack stack) {
        if (stack != null && !stack.isEmpty() && canInsertAt(slot)) {
            this.slots[slot] = stack.copyWithCount(1);
            this.moving[slot] = false;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public boolean hasItemAt(int slot) {
        return slot >= 0 && slot < CAPACITY && !this.slots[slot].isEmpty();
    }

    public ItemStack extractAt(int slot) {
        if (hasItemAt(slot)) {
            ItemStack stack = this.slots[slot];
            this.slots[slot] = ItemStack.EMPTY;
            this.moving[slot] = false;
            return stack;
        }
        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
    }

    public void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        NbtList list = new NbtList();
        for (int i = 0; i < CAPACITY; i++) {
            ItemStack stack = this.slots[i];
            if (!stack.isEmpty()) {
                NbtCompound entry = new NbtCompound();
                entry.putByte(SLOT_NBT_KEY, (byte) i);
                entry.put(STACK_NBT_KEY, stack.encode(registries));
                entry.putBoolean(MOVING_NBT_KEY, this.moving[i]);
                list.add(entry);
            }
        }
        nbt.put(ITEMS_NBT_KEY, list);
    }

    public void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        this.clear();
        if (!nbt.contains(ITEMS_NBT_KEY, NbtElement.LIST_TYPE)) {
            return;
        }

        NbtList list = nbt.getList(ITEMS_NBT_KEY, NbtElement.COMPOUND_TYPE);
        for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
            NbtCompound entry = list.getCompound(i);
            if (entry.contains(SLOT_NBT_KEY) && entry.contains(STACK_NBT_KEY)) {
                int slot = entry.getByte(SLOT_NBT_KEY);
                if (slot >= 0 && slot < CAPACITY) {
                    this.slots[slot] = ItemStack.fromNbt(registries, entry.getCompound(STACK_NBT_KEY))
                            .orElse(ItemStack.EMPTY);
                    this.moving[slot] = entry.getBoolean(MOVING_NBT_KEY);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

public class FactorioChestBlockEntity extends BlockEntity implements ExtendedScreenHandlerFactory<BlockPos>, Inventory {

    public static final int MAX_POSSIBLE_SLOTS = 48;

    private final DefaultedList<ItemStack> items = DefaultedList.ofSize(MAX_POSSIBLE_SLOTS, ItemStack.EMPTY);
    private int totalSlots = 16;
    private int unlockedSlots = 16;

    protected final PropertyDelegate propertyDelegate = new PropertyDelegate() {
        @Override
        public int get(int index) {
            return switch (index) {
                case 0 -> unlockedSlots;
                case 1 -> totalSlots;
                default -> 0;
            };
        }

        @Override
        public void set(int index, int value) {
            if (index == 0) unlockedSlots = value;
            if (index == 1) totalSlots = value;
        }

        @Override
        public int size() {
            return 2;
        }
    };

    public FactorioChestBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.FACTORIO_CHEST_BLOCK_ENTITY, pos, state);
        if (state.getBlock() instanceof FactorioChestBlock chestBlock) {
            this.totalSlots = chestBlock.getSlotCount();
            this.unlockedSlots = this.totalSlots;
        }
    }

    public int getTotalSlots() {
        if (getCachedState().getBlock() instanceof FactorioChestBlock chestBlock) {
            this.totalSlots = chestBlock.getSlotCount();
        }
        return this.totalSlots;
    }

    public int getUnlockedSlots() {
        return Math.min(this.unlockedSlots, getTotalSlots());
    }

    public void setUnlockedSlots(int count) {
        this.unlockedSlots = Math.max(0, Math.min(getTotalSlots(), count));
        markDirty();
        if (this.world != null) {
            InserterBlockEntity.wakeUpAdjacentInserters(this.world, this.pos);
        }
    }

    /**
     * ÐŸÐµÑ€ÐµÐ¾Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´ÐµÐ»ÑÐµÐ¼ markDirty(), Ñ‡Ñ‚Ð¾Ð±Ñ‹ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¸ Ñ€Ð°Ð±Ð¾Ñ‚Ðµ Ð¼Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ð¿ÑƒÐ»ÑÑ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ð², Ð±ÑƒÑ€Ð¾Ð² Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÐ°
     * ÑÐ¾Ð´ÐµÑ€Ð¶Ð¸Ð¼Ð¾Ðµ ÑÑƒÐ½Ð´ÑƒÐºÐ° ÐœÐ“ÐÐžÐ’Ð•ÐÐÐž ÑÐ¸Ð½Ñ…Ñ€Ð¾Ð½Ð¸Ð·Ð¸Ñ€Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ð»Ð¾ÑÑŒ Ñ ÐºÐ»Ð¸ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¼ (Ð±ÐµÐ· Ð½ÐµÐ¾Ð±Ñ…Ð¾Ð´Ð¸Ð¼Ð¾ÑÑ‚Ð¸ Ð¾Ñ‚ÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ð²Ð°Ñ‚ÑŒ ÑÑƒÐ½Ð´ÑƒÐº)!
     */
    @Override
    public void markDirty() {
        super.markDirty();
        if (this.world != null && !this.world.isClient) {
            this.world.updateListeners(this.pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Ð¡Ð¾Ð±Ð¸Ñ€Ð°ÐµÑ‚ ÑÐ²Ð¾Ð´ÐºÑƒ ÑÐ¾Ð´ÐµÑ€Ð¶Ð¸Ð¼Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ ÑÑƒÐ½Ð´ÑƒÐºÐ° (Ð¾Ð±ÑŠÐµÐ´Ð¸Ð½ÑÑ ÑÑ‚Ð°ÐºÐ¸ Ð¾Ð´Ð½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚Ð°)
     * Ð¸ ÑÐ¾Ñ€Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÑ‚ Ð¸Ñ… ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ Ð¿Ð¾ Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€ÑÐ´ÐºÑƒ Ð¼ÐµÐ½ÑŽ ÐºÑ€Ð°Ñ„Ñ‚Ð° Factorio!
     */
    public List<ItemStack> getSortedContentSummary(int maxTypes) {
        Map<Item, Integer> counts = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < getTotalSlots(); i++) {
            ItemStack s = this.items.get(i);
            if (!s.isEmpty()) {
                counts.merge(s.getItem(), s.getCount(), Integer::sum);
            }
        }
        if (counts.isEmpty()) {
            return Collections.emptyList();
        }

        List<ItemStack> aggregated = new ArrayList<>(counts.size());
        for (Map.Entry<Item, Integer> e : counts.entrySet()) {
            aggregated.add(new ItemStack(e.getKey(), e.getValue()));
        }

        aggregated.sort(Comparator
                .comparingInt(InventoryAutoSorter::getCategoryOrder)
                .thenComparingInt((ItemStack s) -> InventoryAutoSorter.getFactorioRecipeOrder(s.getItem()))
                .thenComparing(s -> Registries.ITEM.getId(s.getItem()).toString())
                .thenComparingInt((ItemStack s) -> -s.getCount()));

        if (aggregated.size() > maxTypes) {
            return aggregated.subList(0, maxTypes);
        }
        return aggregated;
    }

    @Override
    public int size() {
        return getTotalSlots();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isValid(int slot, ItemStack stack) {
        return slot >= 0 && slot < getUnlockedSlots();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isEmpty() {
        for (int i = 0; i < getTotalSlots(); i++) {
            if (!this.items.get(i).isEmpty()) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public ItemStack getStack(int slot) {
        if (slot >= 0 && slot < getTotalSlots()) {
            return this.items.get(slot);
        }
        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
    }

    @Override
    public ItemStack removeStack(int slot, int amount) {
        ItemStack result = Inventories.splitStack(this.items, slot, amount);
        if (!result.isEmpty()) {
            markDirty();
        }
        return result;
    }

    @Override
    public ItemStack removeStack(int slot) {
        ItemStack result = Inventories.removeStack(this.items, slot);
        if (!result.isEmpty()) {
            markDirty();
        }
        return result;
    }

    @Override
    public void setStack(int slot, ItemStack stack) {
        if (slot >= 0 && slot < MAX_POSSIBLE_SLOTS) {
            this.items.set(slot, stack);
            if (stack.getCount() > this.getMaxCountPerStack()) {
                stack.setCount(this.getMaxCountPerStack());
            }
            markDirty();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canPlayerUse(PlayerEntity player) {
        return Inventory.canPlayerUse(this, player);
    }

    @Override
    public void clear() {
        this.items.clear();
        markDirty();
    }

    @Override
    public Text getDisplayName() {
        return getCachedState().getBlock().getName();
    }

    @Override
    public ScreenHandler createMenu(int syncId, PlayerInventory playerInventory, PlayerEntity player) {
        return new FactorioChestScreenHandler(syncId, playerInventory, this, this.propertyDelegate);
    }

    @Override
    public BlockPos getScreenOpeningData(ServerPlayerEntity player) {
        return this.pos;
    }

    @Override
    protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
        nbt.putInt("TotalSlots", getTotalSlots());
        nbt.putInt("UnlockedSlots", getUnlockedSlots());
        Inventories.writeNbt(nbt, this.items, registries);
    }

    @Override
    protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
        this.items.clear();
        Inventories.readNbt(nbt, this.items, registries);
        if (nbt.contains("TotalSlots")) {
            this.totalSlots = nbt.getInt("TotalSlots");
        }
        if (nbt.contains("UnlockedSlots")) {
            this.unlockedSlots = Math.max(0, Math.min(getTotalSlots(), nbt.getInt("UnlockedSlots")));
        } else {
            this.unlockedSlots = getTotalSlots();
        }
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public Packet<ClientPlayPacketListener> toUpdatePacket() {
        return BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket.create(this);
    }

    @Override
    public NbtCompound toInitialChunkDataNbt(RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        return createNbt(registries);
    }

    public static final int COLUMNS = 8;
    public static final int GRID_START_X = 83;

    private final PropertyDelegate propertyDelegate;
    public final BlockPos targetPos;
    public final FactorioChestBlockEntity chestEntity;
    public final int totalSlots;

                (playerInventory.player.getWorld().getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof FactorioChestBlockEntity chest) ? chest : null,
                new ArrayPropertyDelegate(2));
    }

    public FactorioChestScreenHandler(int syncId, PlayerInventory playerInventory,
                                      FactorioChestBlockEntity chestEntity, PropertyDelegate delegate) {
        super(ModScreenHandlers.FACTORIO_CHEST_SCREEN_HANDLER, syncId);
        this.chestEntity = chestEntity;
        this.targetPos = chestEntity != null ? chestEntity.getPos() : BlockPos.ORIGIN;
        this.totalSlots = chestEntity != null ? chestEntity.getTotalSlots() : 16;
        this.rows = this.totalSlots / COLUMNS;
        // Ð¦ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ñ€Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÐ¼ ÑÐµÑ‚ÐºÑƒ Ð¿Ð¾ Ð²ÐµÑ€Ñ‚Ð¸ÐºÐ°Ð»Ð¸ Ð´Ð»Ñ Ð´ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ²ÑÐ½Ð½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ (2 Ñ€ÑÐ´Ð°) Ð¸ Ð¶ÐµÐ»ÐµÐ·Ð½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ (4 Ñ€ÑÐ´Ð°) ÑÑƒÐ½Ð´ÑƒÐºÐ¾Ð²
        this.gridStartY = 21 + ((6 - this.rows) * 9);

        this.inventory = chestEntity != null ? chestEntity : new SimpleInventory(this.totalSlots);
        this.propertyDelegate = delegate;
        this.addProperties(delegate);

        // 1. Ð¡Ð»Ð¾Ñ‚Ñ‹ ÑÑƒÐ½Ð´ÑƒÐºÐ° (16, 32 Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ 48 ÑÐ»Ð¾Ñ‚Ð¾Ð² Ð² 8 ÐºÐ¾Ð»Ð¾Ð½Ð¾Ðº)
        for (int r = 0; r < this.rows; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < COLUMNS; c++) {
                int slotIdx = c + r * COLUMNS;
                this.addSlot(new Slot(this.inventory, slotIdx, GRID_START_X + c * 18, this.gridStartY + r * 18));
            }

    public ItemStack quickMove(PlayerEntity player, int invSlot) {

        Slot slot = this.slots.get(invSlot);
        if (slot != null && slot.hasStack()) {
            ItemStack originalStack = slot.getStack();
            newStack = originalStack.copy();

            if (invSlot < this.totalSlots) {
                // Ð˜Ð· ÑÑƒÐ½Ð´ÑƒÐºÐ° Ð² Ð¸Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð°Ñ€ÑŒ Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÐ°
                if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, this.totalSlots, this.slots.size(), true)) {

                int unlocked = getUnlockedSlots();
                if (unlocked <= 0 || !this.insertItem(originalStack, 0, unlocked, false)) {
                    return ItemStack.EMPTY;
                }
            }

            if (originalStack.isEmpty()) {
                slot.setStack(ItemStack.EMPTY);
            } else {
                slot.markDirty();
            }
        }
        return newStack;
    }

        // Ð•ÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð·Ð°Ð¶Ð°Ñ‚ Shift â€” Ð¼Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ð¿ÑƒÐ»ÑÑ‚Ð¾Ñ€ ÑÑ‚Ð°Ð²Ð¸Ñ‚ÑÑ Ð»Ð¸Ñ†Ð¾Ð¼ Ðº Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÑƒ!
        if (ctx.getPlayer() != null && ctx.getPlayer().isSneaking()) {

    /**
     * Ð—Ð°Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÑ‰Ð°ÐµÑ‚ ÑÑ‚Ð°Ð²Ð¸Ñ‚ÑŒ Ð¼Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ð¿ÑƒÐ»ÑÑ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‹ Ð´Ñ€ÑƒÐ³ Ð½Ð° Ð´Ñ€ÑƒÐ³Ð° Ð²ÐµÑ€Ñ‚Ð¸ÐºÐ°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾ Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ Ð² Ð²Ð¾Ð·Ð´ÑƒÑ…Ðµ.
     */
    @Override
    protected boolean canPlaceAt(BlockState state, WorldView world, BlockPos pos) {
        BlockPos belowPos = pos.down();
        BlockState belowState = world.getBlockState(belowPos);
        Block belowBlock = belowState.getBlock();

        if (belowBlock instanceof InserterBlock || belowBlock instanceof BeltBlock || belowBlock instanceof BurnerDrillBlock) {
            return false;
        }
        return Block.sideCoversSmallSquare(world, belowPos, Direction.UP);
    }

    @Override
    protected BlockState getStateForNeighborUpdate(BlockState state, Direction direction, BlockState neighborState,
                                                   WorldAccess world, BlockPos pos, BlockPos neighborPos) {

            return Blocks.AIR.getDefaultState();
        }
        return super.getStateForNeighborUpdate(state, direction, neighborState, world, pos, neighborPos);
    }

        super.neighborUpdate(state, world, pos, sourceBlock, sourcePos, notify);
        if (!world.isClient() && world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof InserterBlockEntity inserter) {
            inserter.wakeUp();

    }

    @Override
    protected ActionResult onUse(BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos, PlayerEntity player, BlockHitResult hit) {
        if (!world.isClient()) {
            NamedScreenHandlerFactory screenHandlerFactory = (NamedScreenHandlerFactory) world.getBlockEntity(pos);
            if (screenHandlerFactory != null) {

    }

        if (!state.isOf(newState.getBlock())) {
            if (world.getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof InserterBlockEntity inserter) {
                ItemStack held = inserter.getHeldStack();
                if (!held.isEmpty()) {
                    ItemScatterer.spawn(world, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.5, pos.getZ() + 0.5, held);
                }
                world.updateComparators(pos, this);
            }
            super.onStateReplaced(state, world, pos, newState, moved);
        }
    }

    public void wakeUp() {
        if (this.sleeping) {
            this.sleeping = false;
        }
