            case OUTPUT_SLOT -> m.outputStack;
            default -> ItemStack.EMPTY;
        };
    }

    @Override
    public ItemStack removeStack(int slot, int amount) {
        BurnerDrillBlockEntity m = getMaster();
        if (slot == FUEL_SLOT) {
            ItemStack res = m.fuelStack.split(amount);
            if (m.fuelStack.isEmpty()) m.fuelStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
            m.wakeUp();
            m.syncState();
            return res;
        } else if (slot == OUTPUT_SLOT) {
            ItemStack res = m.outputStack.split(amount);
            if (m.outputStack.isEmpty()) m.outputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
            m.wakeUp();
            m.syncState();
            return res;
        }
        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
    }

    @Override
    public ItemStack removeStack(int slot) {
        return removeStack(slot, 64);
    }

    @Override
    public void setStack(int slot, ItemStack stack) {
        BurnerDrillBlockEntity m = getMaster();
        if (slot == FUEL_SLOT) {
            m.fuelStack = stack;
        } else if (slot == OUTPUT_SLOT) {
            m.outputStack = stack;
        }
        m.wakeUp();
        m.syncState();
    }

    }

    }

    @Override
    public BlockPos getScreenOpeningData(ServerPlayerEntity player) {
        return getMaster().getPos();
    }

    @Override
    protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
        if (!this.fuelStack.isEmpty()) {
            nbt.put("FuelStack", this.fuelStack.encode(registries));
        }
        if (!this.outputStack.isEmpty()) {
            nbt.put("OutputStack", this.outputStack.encode(registries));
        }
        nbt.putInt("BurnTime", this.burnTime);
        nbt.putInt("MaxBurnTime", this.maxBurnTime);
        nbt.putInt("MiningProgress", this.miningProgress);
        nbt.putBoolean("Sleeping", this.sleeping);
    }

    @Override
    protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
        this.fuelStack = nbt.contains("FuelStack")
                ? ItemStack.fromNbtOrEmpty(registries, nbt.getCompound("FuelStack"))
                : ItemStack.EMPTY;
        this.outputStack = nbt.contains("OutputStack")
                ? ItemStack.fromNbtOrEmpty(registries, nbt.getCompound("OutputStack"))
                : ItemStack.EMPTY;
        this.burnTime = nbt.getInt("BurnTime");
        this.maxBurnTime = nbt.getInt("MaxBurnTime");
        this.miningProgress = nbt.getInt("MiningProgress");
        this.sleeping = nbt.getBoolean("Sleeping");
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public Packet<ClientPlayPacketListener> toUpdatePacket() {
        return BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket.create(this);
    }

    @Override
    public NbtCompound toInitialChunkDataNbt(RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        return createNbt(registries);
    }
}

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModBlocks;

public class ElectricDrillBlock extends BlockWithEntity {
    public static final MapCodec<ElectricDrillBlock> CODEC = createCodec(ElectricDrillBlock::new);
    public static final DirectionProperty FACING = Properties.HORIZONTAL_FACING;
    public static final IntProperty PART = IntProperty.of("part", 0, 8);
    public static final BooleanProperty UPPER = BooleanProperty.of("upper");

    private static final VoxelShape BOTTOM_SHAPE = Block.createCuboidShape(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 16.0, 16.0);
    private static final VoxelShape TOP_SHAPE = Block.createCuboidShape(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 24.0, 16.0);

    public ElectricDrillBlock(Settings settings) {
        super(settings);
        this.setDefaultState(this.stateManager.getDefaultState()
                .with(FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                .with(PART, 4)
                .with(UPPER, false));
    }

    @Override
    protected MapCodec<? extends BlockWithEntity> getCodec() {
        return CODEC;
    }

    @Override
    protected void appendProperties(StateManager.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
        builder.add(FACING, PART, UPPER);
    }

    @Override
    protected VoxelShape getOutlineShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        return state.get(UPPER) ? TOP_SHAPE : BOTTOM_SHAPE;
    }

    @Override
    protected VoxelShape getCollisionShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        return state.get(UPPER) ? TOP_SHAPE : BOTTOM_SHAPE;
    }

    @Override
    protected BlockRenderType getRenderType(BlockState state) {
        return BlockRenderType.INVISIBLE;
    }

    @Override
    protected float getAmbientOcclusionLightLevel(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos) {
        return 1.0f;
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean isTransparent(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos) {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    protected float calcBlockBreakingDelta(BlockState state, PlayerEntity player, BlockView world, BlockPos pos) {
        return 0.10f;
    }

    public static BlockPos getPartPos(BlockPos masterPos, Direction facing, int part, boolean upper) {
        int wOff = (part % 3) - 1;
        int dOff = (part / 3) - 1;
        Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
        BlockPos base = masterPos.offset(right, wOff).offset(facing, dOff);
        return upper ? base.up() : base;
    }

    public static BlockPos getMasterPos(BlockPos currentPos, BlockState state) {
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof ElectricDrillBlock)) return currentPos;
        Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
        int part = state.get(PART);
        boolean upper = state.get(UPPER);
        int wOff = (part % 3) - 1;
        int dOff = (part / 3) - 1;
        Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
        BlockPos base = upper ? currentPos.down() : currentPos;
        return base.offset(right, -wOff).offset(facing, -dOff);
    }

    public static boolean hasOreInFootprint(World world, BlockPos originPos, Direction facing) {
        for (int dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -2; dz <= 2; dz++) {
                for (int dy = -2; dy <= 0; dy++) {
                    BlockPos checkPos = originPos.add(dx, dy, dz);
                    if (world.getBlockState(checkPos).getBlock() instanceof com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.world.ore.ResourceOreBlock) {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockState getPlacementState(ItemPlacementContext ctx) {
        Direction facing = ctx.getHorizontalPlayerFacing().getOpposite();
        if (ctx.getPlayer() != null && ctx.getPlayer().isSneaking()) {
            facing = facing.getOpposite();
        }
        BlockPos masterPos = ctx.getBlockPos();
        World world = ctx.getWorld();

        for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
            for (int yOff = 0; yOff <= 2; yOff++) {
                BlockPos checkPos = getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, false).up(yOff);
                if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(checkPos) || !world.getBlockState(checkPos).canReplace(ctx)) {
                    return null;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!hasOreInFootprint(world, masterPos, facing)) return null;
        return this.getDefaultState().with(FACING, facing).with(PART, 4).with(UPPER, false);
    }

    @Override
    public void onPlaced(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, @Nullable LivingEntity placer, ItemStack itemStack) {
        super.onPlaced(world, pos, state, placer, itemStack);
        if (!world.isClient && state.get(PART) == 4 && !state.get(UPPER)) {
            Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    if (part == 4 && u == 0) continue;
                    BlockPos p = getPartPos(pos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    world.setBlockState(p, state.with(PART, part).with(UPPER, u == 1), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected ActionResult onUse(BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos, PlayerEntity player, BlockHitResult hit) {
        if (!world.isClient) {
            BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
            if (world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof ElectricDrillBlockEntity drillBe) {
                player.openHandledScreen(drillBe);
            }
        }
        return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
    }

    @Override
    public BlockState onBreak(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, PlayerEntity player) {
        if (!world.isClient) {
            BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
            Direction facing = state.get(FACING);

            if (world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof ElectricDrillBlockEntity drillBe) {
                ItemScatterer.spawn(world, masterPos, drillBe);
            }

            for (int part = 0; part < 9; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (!p.equals(pos) && world.getBlockState(p).isOf(this)) {
                        world.setBlockState(p, Blocks.AIR.getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL | Block.SKIP_DROPS);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return super.onBreak(world, pos, state, player);
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockEntity createBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (state.get(PART) != 4 || state.get(UPPER)) return null;
        return new ElectricDrillBlockEntity(pos, state);
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public <T extends BlockEntity> BlockEntityTicker<T> getTicker(World world, BlockState state, BlockEntityType<T> type) {
        if (state.get(PART) != 4 || state.get(UPPER)) return null;
        return validateTicker(type, ModBlocks.ELECTRIC_DRILL_BLOCK_ENTITY,
                world.isClient ? ElectricDrillBlockEntity::clientTick : ElectricDrillBlockEntity::tick);
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.production.electric_drill;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.combat.BlockHealthManager;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.electricity.PowerNetworkManager;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.belt.BeltBlock;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.belt.BeltBlockEntity;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.belt.BeltLane;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.inserter.InserterBlockEntity;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.production.furnace.FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.world.ore.ResourceOreBlock;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModBlocks;
import net.minecraft.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.block.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.block.ChestBlock;
import net.minecraft.block.entity.AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.block.entity.BlockEntity;

import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity;

import net.minecraft.network.listener.ClientPlayPacketListener;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.Packet;
import net.minecraft.network.packet.s2c.play.BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket;
import net.minecraft.registry.RegistryWrapper;
import net.minecraft.screen.NamedScreenHandlerFactory;
import net.minecraft.screen.PropertyDelegate;
import net.minecraft.screen.ScreenHandler;
import net.minecraft.text.Text;
import net.minecraft.util.collection.DefaultedList;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Direction;
import net.minecraft.world.World;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class ElectricDrillBlockEntity extends BlockEntity implements Inventory, NamedScreenHandlerFactory {

    public static final int MINING_TIME_TICKS = 40;
    public static final long POWER_CONSUMPTION_WATTS = 90_000L;
    public static final int OUTPUT_SLOT = 4;

    // Ð¡Ð»Ð¾Ñ‚Ñ‹ 0..3 Ð¿Ð¾Ð´ Ð¼Ð¾Ð´ÑƒÐ»Ð¸, ÑÐ»Ð¾Ñ‚ 4 â€” Ð²Ñ‹Ñ…Ð¾Ð´ Ð´Ð¾Ð±Ñ‹Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¹ Ñ€ÑƒÐ´Ñ‹
    private final DefaultedList<ItemStack> items = DefaultedList.ofSize(5, ItemStack.EMPTY);
    private int miningProgress = 0;
    private int resourceCycleIndex = 0;
    private boolean powered = false;
    private boolean activelyMining = false;
    private float clientDrillRotation = 0.0f;

    protected final PropertyDelegate propertyDelegate = new PropertyDelegate() {
        @Override
        public int get(int index) {
            return switch (index) {
                case 0 -> miningProgress;
                case 1 -> MINING_TIME_TICKS;
                default -> 0;
            };
        }

        @Override
        public void set(int index, int value) {
            if (index == 0) miningProgress = value;
        }

        @Override
        public int size() {
            return 2;
        }
    };

    public ElectricDrillBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.ELECTRIC_DRILL_BLOCK_ENTITY, pos, state);
    }

    public boolean isPowered() {
        return this.powered;
    }

    public boolean isActivelyMining() {
        return this.powered && this.activelyMining;
    }

    public ItemStack getOutputStack() {
        return this.items.get(OUTPUT_SLOT);
    }

    public void clearOutput() {
        this.items.set(OUTPUT_SLOT, ItemStack.EMPTY);
    }

    public float getClientDrillRotation(float tickDelta) {
        if (this.powered) {
            return (this.clientDrillRotation + tickDelta * 16.0f) % 360.0f;
        }
        return this.clientDrillRotation;
    }

    public static void clientTick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, ElectricDrillBlockEntity drill) {
        if (drill.powered) {
            drill.clientDrillRotation = (drill.clientDrillRotation + 16.0f) % 360.0f;
        }
    }

    public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, ElectricDrillBlockEntity drill) {
        if (world == null || world.isClient) return;

        Direction facing = state.get(ElectricDrillBlock.FACING);
        ItemStack outStack = drill.items.get(OUTPUT_SLOT);

        if (!outStack.isEmpty()) {
            BlockPos frontOutPos = pos.offset(facing, 2);
            if (drill.tryExportToPos(world, frontOutPos, facing)) {
                drill.sync();
            }
            outStack = drill.items.get(OUTPUT_SLOT);
            if (outStack.getCount() >= outStack.getMaxCount()) {
                return;
            }
        }

        boolean hasPower = PowerNetworkManager.isMachinePowered(world, pos);
        if (drill.powered != hasPower) {
            drill.powered = hasPower;
            drill.sync();
        }
        if (!hasPower) {
            return;
        }

        BlockPos orePos = drill.findOreIn5x5Area(world, pos);
        if (orePos == null) {
            drill.miningProgress = 0;
            if (drill.activelyMining) {
                drill.activelyMining = false;
                drill.sync();
            }
            return;
        }
        if (!drill.activelyMining) {
            drill.activelyMining = true;
            drill.sync();
        }

        Block oreBlock = world.getBlockState(orePos).getBlock();
        if (!(oreBlock instanceof ResourceOreBlock customOre)) {
            return;
        }
        ItemStack product = customOre.createProductStack(1);

        drill.miningProgress++;
        if (drill.miningProgress >= MINING_TIME_TICKS) {
            drill.miningProgress = 0;
            drill.resourceCycleIndex++;

            ResourceOreBlock.consumeOreAt(world, orePos, 1);

            outStack = drill.items.get(OUTPUT_SLOT);
            if (outStack.isEmpty()) {
                drill.items.set(OUTPUT_SLOT, product.copy());
            } else if (ItemStack.areItemsAndComponentsEqual(outStack, product)) {
                outStack.increment(1);
            }

            drill.tryExportToPos(world, pos.offset(facing, 2), facing);
            drill.sync();
        } else {
            drill.markDirty();
        }
    }

    @Nullable
    public BlockPos findOreIn5x5Area(World world, BlockPos masterPos) {
        List<BlockPos> found = new ArrayList<>(25);
        for (int dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -2; dz <= 2; dz++) {
                BlockPos groundPos = masterPos.add(dx, -1, dz);
                if (world.getBlockState(groundPos).getBlock() instanceof ResourceOreBlock) {
                    found.add(groundPos);
                }
            }
        }
        if (found.isEmpty()) return null;
        return found.get(Math.floorMod(this.resourceCycleIndex, found.size()));
    }

    private boolean tryExportToPos(World world, BlockPos targetPos, Direction drillFacing) {
        ItemStack outputStack = this.items.get(OUTPUT_SLOT);
        if (outputStack.isEmpty()) return false;
        BlockEntity directBe = world.getBlockEntity(targetPos);

        if (directBe instanceof BeltBlockEntity belt) {
            Direction beltFacing = belt.getCachedState().get(BeltBlock.FACING);
            boolean inserted = false;

            if (beltFacing == drillFacing) {
                BeltLane rightLane = belt.getRightLane();
                if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(0) && rightLane.insertAt(0, outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                } else if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(1) && rightLane.insertAt(1, outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                }
            } else if (beltFacing == drillFacing.getOpposite()) {
                BeltLane lane = belt.getLeftLane();
                if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(3) && lane.insertAt(3, outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                }
            } else if (beltFacing == drillFacing.rotateYClockwise()) {
                BeltLane nearLane = belt.getRightLane();
                if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(1) && nearLane.insertAt(1, outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                } else if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(2) && nearLane.insertAt(2, outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                }
            } else if (beltFacing == drillFacing.rotateYCounterclockwise()) {
                BeltLane nearLane = belt.getLeftLane();
                if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(1) && nearLane.insertAt(1, outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                } else if (!belt.isSlotCoveredByHood(2) && nearLane.insertAt(2, outputStack)) {
                    inserted = true;
                }
            }

            if (inserted) {
                outputStack.decrement(1);
                if (outputStack.isEmpty()) this.items.set(OUTPUT_SLOT, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                BeltBlock.syncManualChange(world, targetPos, belt.getCachedState(), belt);
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        BlockState targetState = world.getBlockState(targetPos);
        BlockPos canonicalPos = BlockHealthManager.getCanonicalPos(targetPos, targetState);
        BlockEntity be = world.getBlockEntity(canonicalPos);

        if (be instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity furnace) {
            int slot = AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(outputStack) ? 1 : 0;
            ItemStack cur = furnace.getStack(slot);
            if (cur.isEmpty()) {
                furnace.setStack(slot, outputStack.split(1));
                if (outputStack.isEmpty()) this.items.set(OUTPUT_SLOT, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                return true;
            } else if (ItemStack.areItemsAndComponentsEqual(cur, outputStack) && cur.getCount() < InserterBlockEntity.FURNACE_INPUT_LIMIT) {
                cur.increment(1);
                outputStack.decrement(1);
                if (outputStack.isEmpty()) this.items.set(OUTPUT_SLOT, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                furnace.syncState();
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        Inventory inv = null;
        if (targetState.getBlock() instanceof ChestBlock chestBlock && be instanceof ChestBlockEntity) {
            inv = ChestBlock.getInventory(chestBlock, targetState, world, canonicalPos, true);
        } else if (be instanceof Inventory genericInv) {
            inv = genericInv;
        }
        if (inv != null) {
            for (int i = 0; i < inv.size(); i++) {
                if (!inv.isValid(i, outputStack)) continue;
                ItemStack cur = inv.getStack(i);
                if (cur.isEmpty()) {
                    inv.setStack(i, outputStack.split(1));
                    if (outputStack.isEmpty()) this.items.set(OUTPUT_SLOT, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                    inv.markDirty();
                    return true;
                } else if (ItemStack.areItemsAndComponentsEqual(cur, outputStack) && cur.getCount() < cur.getMaxCount()) {
                    cur.increment(1);
                    outputStack.decrement(1);
                    if (outputStack.isEmpty()) this.items.set(OUTPUT_SLOT, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                    inv.markDirty();
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public void sync() {
        markDirty();
        if (this.world != null && !this.world.isClient) {
            this.world.updateListeners(this.pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_LISTENERS);
        }
    }

    @Override public int size() { return this.items.size(); }
    @Override public boolean isValid(int slot, ItemStack stack) { return false; }
    @Override public boolean isEmpty() { return this.items.stream().allMatch(ItemStack::isEmpty); }
    @Override public ItemStack getStack(int slot) { return (slot >= 0 && slot < this.items.size()) ? this.items.get(slot) : ItemStack.EMPTY; }

    @Override
    public ItemStack removeStack(int slot, int amount) {
        ItemStack res = Inventories.splitStack(this.items, slot, amount);
        if (!res.isEmpty()) sync();
        return res;
    }

    @Override
    public ItemStack removeStack(int slot) {
        ItemStack res = Inventories.removeStack(this.items, slot);
        if (!res.isEmpty()) sync();
        return res;
    }

    @Override
    public void setStack(int slot, ItemStack stack) {
        if (slot >= 0 && slot < this.items.size()) {
            this.items.set(slot, stack);
            sync();
        }
    }

    @Override public boolean canPlayerUse(PlayerEntity player) { return Inventory.canPlayerUse(this, player, 10.0F); }
    @Override public void clear() { this.items.clear(); sync(); }

    @Override
    public Text getDisplayName() {
        return Text.translatable("block.factoriocore.electric_mining_drill");
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public ScreenHandler createMenu(int syncId, PlayerInventory playerInventory, PlayerEntity player) {
        return new ElectricDrillScreenHandler(syncId, playerInventory, this, this.propertyDelegate);
    }

    @Override
    protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
        Inventories.writeNbt(nbt, this.items, registries);
        nbt.putInt("MiningProgress", this.miningProgress);
        nbt.putBoolean("Powered", this.powered);
        nbt.putBoolean("ActivelyMining", this.activelyMining);
    }

    @Override
    protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
        this.items.clear();
        Inventories.readNbt(nbt, this.items, registries);
        if (nbt.contains("OutputStack") && this.items.get(OUTPUT_SLOT).isEmpty()) {
            this.items.set(OUTPUT_SLOT, ItemStack.fromNbtOrEmpty(registries, nbt.getCompound("OutputStack")));
        }
        this.miningProgress = nbt.getInt("MiningProgress");
        this.powered = nbt.getBoolean("Powered");
        this.activelyMining = nbt.getBoolean("ActivelyMining");
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public Packet<ClientPlayPacketListener> toUpdatePacket() {
        return BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket.create(this);
    }

    @Override
    public NbtCompound toInitialChunkDataNbt(RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        return createNbt(registries);
    }

            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 9; ++i) {
            this.addSlot(new Slot(playerInventory, i, 37 + i * 18, 201));
        }
    }

    public int getMiningProgress() { return this.propertyDelegate.get(0); }
    public int getMaxMiningTime() { return Math.max(1, this.propertyDelegate.get(1)); }

    @Override
    public ItemStack quickMove(PlayerEntity player, int invSlot) {
        ItemStack newStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        Slot slot = this.slots.get(invSlot);
        if (slot != null && slot.hasStack()) {
            ItemStack originalStack = slot.getStack();
            newStack = originalStack.copy();
            if (invSlot < 5) {
                if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, 5, this.slots.size(), true)) {
                    return ItemStack.EMPTY;
                }
            } else {
                return ItemStack.EMPTY;
            }

            if (originalStack.isEmpty()) {
                slot.setStack(ItemStack.EMPTY);
            } else {
                slot.markDirty();
            }
        }
        return newStack;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canUse(PlayerEntity player) {
        return this.inventory.canPlayerUse(player);
    }

    public static final BooleanProperty UPPER = BooleanProperty.of("upper");

    private static final VoxelShape BOTTOM_SHAPE = Block.createCuboidShape(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 16.0, 16.0);
    private static final VoxelShape TOP_SHAPE = Block.createCuboidShape(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 24.0, 16.0);

    // 1 = ÐšÐ°Ð¼ÐµÐ½Ð½Ð°Ñ Ð¿ÐµÑ‡ÑŒ (0.3125/ÑÐµÐº -> 64 Ñ‚Ð¸ÐºÐ°), 2 = Ð¡Ñ‚Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ð°Ñ Ð¿ÐµÑ‡ÑŒ (0.625/ÑÐµÐº -> 32 Ñ‚Ð¸ÐºÐ°)
    private final int tier;

    public FactorioFurnaceBlock(Settings settings, int tier) {
        super(settings);
        this.tier = tier;
        this.setDefaultState(this.stateManager.getDefaultState()
                .with(FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                .with(PART, 0)
                .with(UPPER, false));
    }

    public int getTier() {
        return this.tier;
    }

    @Override
    protected MapCodec<? extends BlockWithEntity> getCodec() {

    }

    }

        return true;

    public static BlockPos getPartPos(BlockPos masterPos, Direction facing, int part, boolean upper) {
        Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
        BlockPos base = switch (part) {
            case 1 -> masterPos.offset(right);
            case 2 -> masterPos.offset(facing);
            case 3 -> masterPos.offset(facing).offset(right);
            default -> masterPos;
        };
        return upper ? base.up() : base;
    }

    public static BlockPos getMasterPos(BlockPos currentPos, BlockState state) {
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlock)) {
            return currentPos;
        }
        Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
        Direction left = facing.rotateYCounterclockwise();
        Direction back = facing.getOpposite();
        int part = state.get(PART);
        boolean upper = state.get(UPPER);

        BlockPos base = upper ? currentPos.down() : currentPos;
        return switch (part) {
            case 1 -> base.offset(left);
            case 2 -> base.offset(back);
            case 3 -> base.offset(back).offset(left);
            default -> base;
        };
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockState getPlacementState(ItemPlacementContext ctx) {
        Direction facing = ctx.getHorizontalPlayerFacing().getOpposite();
        if (ctx.getPlayer() != null && ctx.getPlayer().isSneaking()) {
            facing = facing.getOpposite();
        }
        BlockPos masterPos = ctx.getBlockPos();
        World world = ctx.getWorld();

        for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
            for (int yOff = 0; yOff <= 2; yOff++) {
                BlockPos checkPos = getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, false).up(yOff);
                if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(checkPos) || !world.getBlockState(checkPos).canReplace(ctx)) {
                    return null;
                }
            }
        }
        return this.getDefaultState().with(FACING, facing).with(PART, 0).with(UPPER, false);
    }

    @Override
    public void onPlaced(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, @Nullable LivingEntity placer, ItemStack itemStack) {
        super.onPlaced(world, pos, state, placer, itemStack);
        if (!world.isClient && state.get(PART) == 0 && !state.get(UPPER)) {
            Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
            for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    if (part == 0 && u == 0) continue;
                    boolean isUpper = (u == 1);
                    BlockPos partPos = getPartPos(pos, facing, part, isUpper);
                    world.setBlockState(partPos, state.with(PART, part).with(UPPER, isUpper), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public BlockState onBreak(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, PlayerEntity player) {
        if (!world.isClient) {
            BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
            Direction facing = state.get(FACING);

            if (world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity masterBe) {
                for (int i = 0; i < masterBe.size(); i++) {
                    ItemStack stack = masterBe.getStack(i);
                    if (!stack.isEmpty()) {
                        ItemScatterer.spawn(world, masterPos.getX() + 1.0, masterPos.getY() + 0.5, masterPos.getZ() + 1.0, stack.copy());
                        masterBe.setStack(i, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos partPos = getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, u == 1);
                    if (!partPos.equals(pos) && world.getBlockState(partPos).isOf(this)) {
                        world.setBlockState(partPos, Blocks.AIR.getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL | Block.SKIP_DROPS);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return super.onBreak(world, pos, state, player);
    }

    @Override
    protected ActionResult onUse(BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos, PlayerEntity player, BlockHitResult hit) {
        if (!world.isClient) {
            BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
            if (world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity masterBe) {
                player.openHandledScreen(masterBe);
            }
        }
        return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
    }

    @Override
    protected void neighborUpdate(BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos, Block sourceBlock, BlockPos sourcePos, boolean notify) {
        super.neighborUpdate(state, world, pos, sourceBlock, sourcePos, notify);
        if (!world.isClient) {
            BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
            if (world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity masterBe) {
                masterBe.wakeUp();
            }
        }
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockEntity createBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (state.get(PART) != 0 || state.get(UPPER)) { return null; } return new FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity(pos, state);
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public <T extends BlockEntity> BlockEntityTicker<T> getTicker(World world, BlockState state, BlockEntityType<T> type) {
        if (state.get(PART) != 0 || state.get(UPPER)) {
            return null;
        }
        return validateTicker(type, ModBlocks.FACTORIO_FURNACE_BLOCK_ENTITY,
                world.isClient ? null : FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity::tick);
    }

    @Override
    protected float calcBlockBreakingDelta(net.minecraft.block.BlockState state, net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity player, net.minecraft.world.BlockView world, net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos pos) {
        return 0.10f;
    }

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.production.furnace;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.logistics.inserter.InserterBlockEntity;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModBlocks;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModItems;
import net.fabricmc.fabric.api.registry.FuelRegistry;
import net.fabricmc.fabric.api.screenhandler.v1.ExtendedScreenHandlerFactory;
import net.minecraft.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.block.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.block.entity.AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerInventory;
import net.minecraft.inventory.Inventory;

import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.math.Direction;
import net.minecraft.world.World;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.Optional;

public class FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity extends BlockEntity implements ExtendedScreenHandlerFactory<BlockPos>, SidedInventory {

    public static final int INPUT_SLOT = 0;
    public static final int FUEL_SLOT = 1;
    public static final int OUTPUT_SLOT = 2;

    public static final int STONE_SMELT_TICKS = 64;
    public static final int STEEL_SMELT_TICKS = 32;
    public static final int COAL_BURN_TICKS = 889;

    // Ð’ Factorio Ð½Ð° Ð²Ñ‹Ð¿Ð»Ð°Ð²ÐºÑƒ 1 Ð¡Ñ‚Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾Ð¹ Ð±Ð°Ð»ÐºÐ¸ Ñ‚Ñ€ÐµÐ±ÑƒÐµÑ‚ÑÑ 5 Ð–ÐµÐ»ÐµÐ·Ð½Ñ‹Ñ… Ð¿Ð»Ð¸Ñ‚ (ÑÐ»Ð¸Ñ‚ÐºÐ¾Ð²)
    public static final int IRON_PER_STEEL_PLATE = 5;

    private static final int[] TOP_SLOTS = new int[]{ INPUT_SLOT };
    private static final int[] SIDE_SLOTS = new int[]{ FUEL_SLOT, INPUT_SLOT };
    private static final int[] BOTTOM_SLOTS = new int[]{ OUTPUT_SLOT, FUEL_SLOT };

    private ItemStack inputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
    private ItemStack fuelStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
    private ItemStack outputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;

    private int burnTime = 0;
    private int maxBurnTime = 0;
    private int cookTime = 0;
    private boolean sleeping = false;

    protected final PropertyDelegate propertyDelegate = new PropertyDelegate() {
        @Override
        public int get(int index) {
            return switch (index) {
                case 0 -> burnTime;
                case 1 -> maxBurnTime;
                case 2 -> cookTime;
                case 3 -> getRequiredCookTime();
                case 4 -> sleeping ? 1 : 0;
                default -> 0;
            };
        }

        @Override
        public void set(int index, int value) {
            switch (index) {
                case 0 -> burnTime = value;
                case 1 -> maxBurnTime = value;
                case 2 -> cookTime = value;
                case 4 -> sleeping = (value != 0);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public int size() {
            return 5;
        }
    };

    public FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.FACTORIO_FURNACE_BLOCK_ENTITY, pos, state);
    }

    public int getTier() {
        BlockState state = getCachedState();
        if (state.getBlock() instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlock furnaceBlock) {
            return furnaceBlock.getTier();
        }
        return 1;
    }

    public int getRequiredCookTime() {
        int base = (getTier() >= 2) ? STEEL_SMELT_TICKS : STONE_SMELT_TICKS;
        if (!this.inputStack.isEmpty() && this.inputStack.isOf(Items.IRON_INGOT)) {
            return base * 2;
        }
        return base;
    }

    public static int getRequiredInputCount(ItemStack input) {
        if (input.isOf(Items.IRON_INGOT)) {
            return IRON_PER_STEEL_PLATE;
        }
        return 1;
    }

    public FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity getMaster() {
        if (this.world == null) return this;
        BlockState state = getCachedState();
        if (state.getBlock() instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlock) {
            if (state.get(FactorioFurnaceBlock.PART) == 0 && !state.get(FactorioFurnaceBlock.UPPER)) {
                return this;
            }
            BlockPos masterPos = FactorioFurnaceBlock.getMasterPos(this.pos, state);
            if (this.world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity master) {
                return master;
            }
        }
        return this;
    }

    public void wakeUp() {
        FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity master = getMaster();
        if (master.sleeping) {
            master.sleeping = false;
        }
    }

    public boolean isBurning() {
        return getMaster().burnTime > 0 && !getMaster().sleeping;
    }

    public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity entity) {
        if (world == null || world.isClient) return;

        boolean wasSleeping = entity.sleeping;
        if (entity.sleeping) {
            if (world.getTime() % 10 != 0) {
                return;
            }
            entity.sleeping = false;
        }

        int requiredInput = getRequiredInputCount(entity.inputStack);
        if (entity.inputStack.isEmpty() || entity.inputStack.getCount() < requiredInput) {
            boolean hadCookTime = entity.cookTime > 0;
            entity.cookTime = 0;
            entity.sleeping = true;
            if (!wasSleeping || hadCookTime) {
                entity.syncState();
            }
            return;
        }

        ItemStack recipeResult = getSmeltingResult(world, entity.inputStack);
        if (recipeResult.isEmpty() || !canAcceptOutput(entity.outputStack, recipeResult)) {
            boolean hadCookTime = entity.cookTime > 0;
            entity.cookTime = 0;
            entity.sleeping = true;
            if (!wasSleeping || hadCookTime) {
                entity.syncState();
            }
            return;
        }

        if (!entity.ensureFuel()) {
            entity.sleeping = true;
            if (!wasSleeping) {
                entity.syncState();
            }
            return;
        }

        if (wasSleeping) {
            entity.syncState();
        }

        entity.burnTime--;
        entity.cookTime++;

        int requiredTicks = entity.getRequiredCookTime();
        if (entity.cookTime >= requiredTicks) {
            entity.cookTime = 0;
            entity.inputStack.decrement(requiredInput);
            if (entity.inputStack.isEmpty()) {
                entity.inputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
            }

            if (entity.outputStack.isEmpty()) {
                entity.outputStack = recipeResult.copy();
            } else {
                entity.outputStack.increment(recipeResult.getCount());
            }

            wakeUpSurroundingInserters(world, pos, state);
            entity.syncState();
        } else if (entity.burnTime == 0) {
            entity.syncState();
        } else {
            entity.markDirty();
        }
    }

    public static void wakeUpSurroundingInserters(World world, BlockPos masterPos, BlockState state) {
        if (world == null || world.isClient) return;
        Direction facing = state.contains(FactorioFurnaceBlock.FACING) ? state.get(FactorioFurnaceBlock.FACING) : Direction.NORTH;
        for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
            BlockPos partPos = FactorioFurnaceBlock.getPartPos(masterPos, facing, part, false);
            InserterBlockEntity.wakeUpAdjacentInserters(world, partPos);
        }
    }

    private boolean ensureFuel() {
        if (this.burnTime > 0) {
            return true;
        }
        if (!this.fuelStack.isEmpty() && AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(this.fuelStack)) {
            Integer vanillaTicks = FuelRegistry.INSTANCE.get(this.fuelStack.getItem());
            int base = (vanillaTicks != null && vanillaTicks > 0) ? vanillaTicks : 1600;
            int factorioTicks = Math.max(40, Math.round(base * (COAL_BURN_TICKS / 1600.0f)));
            this.burnTime = factorioTicks;
            this.maxBurnTime = factorioTicks;

            Item remainder = this.fuelStack.getItem().getRecipeRemainder();
            this.fuelStack.decrement(1);
            if (this.fuelStack.isEmpty()) {
                this.fuelStack = (remainder != null) ? new ItemStack(remainder) : ItemStack.EMPTY;
            }
            syncState();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static ItemStack getSmeltingResult(World world, ItemStack input) {
        if (input.isOf(Items.IRON_INGOT)) {
            if (!com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.research.ResearchManager.isTechResearched("steel_processing")) {
                return ItemStack.EMPTY;
            }
            return new ItemStack(ModItems.STEEL_PLATE, 1);
        }
        if (world == null || input.isEmpty()) return ItemStack.EMPTY;
        SingleStackRecipeInput recipeInput = new SingleStackRecipeInput(input);
        Optional<RecipeEntry<SmeltingRecipe>> match = world.getRecipeManager()
                .getFirstMatch(RecipeType.SMELTING, recipeInput, world);
        return match.map(entry -> entry.value().getResult(world.getRegistryManager()).copy())
                .orElse(ItemStack.EMPTY);
    }

    private static boolean canAcceptOutput(ItemStack currentOutput, ItemStack result) {
        if (currentOutput.isEmpty()) return true;
        if (!ItemStack.areItemsAndComponentsEqual(currentOutput, result)) return false;
        return currentOutput.getCount() + result.getCount() <= currentOutput.getMaxCount();
    }

    public void syncState() {
        markDirty();
        if (this.world != null) {
            this.world.updateListeners(this.pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_LISTENERS);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int size() {
        return 3;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isValid(int slot, ItemStack stack) {
        if (slot == OUTPUT_SLOT) {
            return false;
        }
        if (slot == FUEL_SLOT) {
            return AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(stack);
        }
        return !AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(stack);
    }

    @Override
    public int[] getAvailableSlots(Direction side) {
        if (side == Direction.DOWN) return BOTTOM_SLOTS;
        return side == Direction.UP ? TOP_SLOTS : SIDE_SLOTS;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canInsert(int slot, ItemStack stack, @Nullable Direction dir) {
        return isValid(slot, stack);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canExtract(int slot, ItemStack stack, Direction dir) {
        if (slot == FUEL_SLOT) {
            return stack.isOf(Items.BUCKET);
        }
        return slot == OUTPUT_SLOT;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isEmpty() {
        FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity m = getMaster();
        return m.inputStack.isEmpty() && m.fuelStack.isEmpty() && m.outputStack.isEmpty();
    }

    @Override
    public ItemStack getStack(int slot) {
        FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity m = getMaster();
        return switch (slot) {
            case INPUT_SLOT -> m.inputStack;
            case FUEL_SLOT -> m.fuelStack;
            case OUTPUT_SLOT -> m.outputStack;
            default -> ItemStack.EMPTY;
        };
    }

    @Override
    public ItemStack removeStack(int slot, int amount) {
        FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity m = getMaster();
        ItemStack res = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        if (slot == INPUT_SLOT) {
            res = m.inputStack.split(amount);
            if (m.inputStack.isEmpty()) m.inputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        } else if (slot == FUEL_SLOT) {
            res = m.fuelStack.split(amount);
            if (m.fuelStack.isEmpty()) m.fuelStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        } else if (slot == OUTPUT_SLOT) {
            res = m.outputStack.split(amount);
            if (m.outputStack.isEmpty()) m.outputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        }
        if (!res.isEmpty()) {
            m.wakeUp();
            m.syncState();
            if (m.world != null) {
                wakeUpSurroundingInserters(m.world, m.pos, m.getCachedState());
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    @Override
    public ItemStack removeStack(int slot) {
        return removeStack(slot, 64);
    }

    @Override
    public void setStack(int slot, ItemStack stack) {
        FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity m = getMaster();
        switch (slot) {
            case INPUT_SLOT -> m.inputStack = stack;
            case FUEL_SLOT -> m.fuelStack = stack;
            case OUTPUT_SLOT -> m.outputStack = stack;
        }
        m.wakeUp();
        m.syncState();
        if (m.world != null) {
            wakeUpSurroundingInserters(m.world, m.pos, m.getCachedState());
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canPlayerUse(PlayerEntity player) {
        return Inventory.canPlayerUse(getMaster(), player, 10.0F);
    }

    @Override
    public void clear() {
        FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity m = getMaster();
        m.inputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        m.fuelStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        m.outputStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        m.wakeUp();
        m.syncState();
    }

    @Override
    public Text getDisplayName() {
        return getMaster().getCachedState().getBlock().getName();
    }

    @Override
    public ScreenHandler createMenu(int syncId, PlayerInventory playerInventory, PlayerEntity player) {
        FactorioFurnaceBlockEntity master = getMaster();
        return new FactorioFurnaceScreenHandler(syncId, playerInventory, master, master.propertyDelegate);
    }

    @Override
    public BlockPos getScreenOpeningData(ServerPlayerEntity player) {
        return getMaster().getPos();
    }

    @Override
    protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
        if (!this.inputStack.isEmpty()) nbt.put("InputStack", this.inputStack.encode(registries));
        if (!this.fuelStack.isEmpty()) nbt.put("FuelStack", this.fuelStack.encode(registries));
        if (!this.outputStack.isEmpty()) nbt.put("OutputStack", this.outputStack.encode(registries));
        nbt.putInt("BurnTime", this.burnTime);
        nbt.putInt("MaxBurnTime", this.maxBurnTime);
        nbt.putInt("CookTime", this.cookTime);
        nbt.putBoolean("Sleeping", this.sleeping);
    }

    @Override
    protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
        this.inputStack = nbt.contains("InputStack")
                ? ItemStack.fromNbtOrEmpty(registries, nbt.getCompound("InputStack")) : ItemStack.EMPTY;
        this.fuelStack = nbt.contains("FuelStack")
                ? ItemStack.fromNbtOrEmpty(registries, nbt.getCompound("FuelStack")) : ItemStack.EMPTY;
        this.outputStack = nbt.contains("OutputStack")
                ? ItemStack.fromNbtOrEmpty(registries, nbt.getCompound("OutputStack")) : ItemStack.EMPTY;
        this.burnTime = nbt.getInt("BurnTime");
        this.maxBurnTime = nbt.getInt("MaxBurnTime");
        this.cookTime = nbt.getInt("CookTime");
        this.sleeping = nbt.getBoolean("Sleeping");
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public Packet<ClientPlayPacketListener> toUpdatePacket() {
        return BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket.create(this);
    }

    @Override
    public NbtCompound toInitialChunkDataNbt(RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        return createNbt(registries);
    }
}

    public ItemStack quickMove(PlayerEntity player, int invSlot) {

        Slot slot = this.slots.get(invSlot);
        if (slot != null && slot.hasStack()) {
            ItemStack originalStack = slot.getStack();
            newStack = originalStack.copy();

            if (invSlot < 3) {
                if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, 3, this.slots.size(), true)) {
                    return ItemStack.EMPTY;
                }
            } else {
                if (AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.canUseAsFuel(originalStack)) {
                    if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, 1, 2, false)) {
                        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
                    }
                } else {
                    if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, 0, 1, false)) {
                        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (originalStack.isEmpty()) {
                slot.setStack(ItemStack.EMPTY);
            } else {
                slot.markDirty();
            }
        }
        return newStack;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canUse(PlayerEntity player) {
        return this.inventory.canPlayerUse(player);
    }

public class LabBlock extends BlockWithEntity {
    public static final MapCodec<LabBlock> CODEC = createCodec(LabBlock::new);
    public static final DirectionProperty FACING = Properties.HORIZONTAL_FACING;
    public static final IntProperty PART = IntProperty.of("part", 0, 8);
    public static final BooleanProperty UPPER = BooleanProperty.of("upper");
    private static final VoxelShape UPPER_SHAPE = Block.createCuboidShape(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 12.0, 16.0);

    public static Consumer<BlockPos> clientTechTreeOpener = null;

    public LabBlock(Settings settings) {
        super(settings);
        setDefaultState(getStateManager().getDefaultState().with(FACING, Direction.NORTH).with(PART, 4).with(UPPER, false));
    }

    @Override protected MapCodec<? extends BlockWithEntity> getCodec() { return CODEC; }

    @Override
    protected void appendProperties(StateManager.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
        builder.add(FACING, PART, UPPER);
    }

    public static BlockPos getPartPos(BlockPos centerPos, Direction facing, int part, boolean upper) {
        int row = part / 3 - 1;
        int col = part % 3 - 1;
        Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
        BlockPos p = centerPos.offset(facing, row).offset(right, col);
        return upper ? p.up() : p;
    }

    public static BlockPos getMasterPos(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof LabBlock)) return pos;
        int part = state.get(PART);
        Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
        boolean upper = state.get(UPPER);
        int row = part / 3 - 1;
        int col = part % 3 - 1;
        Direction right = facing.rotateYClockwise();
        BlockPos base = upper ? pos.down() : pos;
        return base.offset(facing, -row).offset(right, -col);
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockState getPlacementState(ItemPlacementContext ctx) {
        World world = ctx.getWorld();
        BlockPos center = ctx.getBlockPos();
        Direction facing = ctx.getHorizontalPlayerFacing().getOpposite();
        if (ctx.getPlayer() != null && ctx.getPlayer().isSneaking()) {
            facing = facing.getOpposite();
        }
        for (int p = 0; p < 9; p++) {
            for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                BlockPos check = getPartPos(center, facing, p, u == 1);
                if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(check) || !world.getBlockState(check).canReplace(ctx)) {
                    return null;
                }
            }
        }
        return getDefaultState().with(FACING, facing).with(PART, 4).with(UPPER, false);
    }

    @Override
    public void onPlaced(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, @Nullable LivingEntity placer, ItemStack itemStack) {
        super.onPlaced(world, pos, state, placer, itemStack);
        if (world.isClient) return;
        Direction facing = state.get(FACING);
        for (int p = 0; p < 9; p++) {
            for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                if (p == 4 && u == 0) continue;
                BlockPos partPos = getPartPos(pos, facing, p, u == 1);
                world.setBlockState(partPos, getDefaultState().with(FACING, facing).with(PART, p).with(UPPER, u == 1), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public BlockState onBreak(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, PlayerEntity player) {
        BlockPos master = getMasterPos(pos, state);
        BlockState masterState = world.getBlockState(master);
        if (masterState.getBlock() instanceof LabBlock) {
            Direction facing = masterState.get(FACING);
            if (!world.isClient && world.getBlockEntity(master) instanceof LabBlockEntity labBe) {
                ItemScatterer.spawn(world, master, labBe);
            }
            for (int p = 0; p < 9; p++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos tp = getPartPos(master, facing, p, u == 1);
                    if (!tp.equals(pos) && world.getBlockState(tp).getBlock() instanceof LabBlock) {
                        world.setBlockState(tp, Blocks.AIR.getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL | Block.SKIP_DROPS);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return super.onBreak(world, pos, state, player);
    }

    @Override
    protected ItemActionResult onUseWithItem(ItemStack stack, BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos,
                                             PlayerEntity player, Hand hand, BlockHitResult hit) {
        BlockPos master = getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (world.getBlockEntity(master) instanceof LabBlockEntity lab) {
            int packSlot = LabBlockEntity.getSlotForPack(stack.getItem());
            if (packSlot >= 0) {
                if (!world.isClient) {
                    ItemStack cur = lab.getStack(packSlot);
                    if (cur.isEmpty()) {
                        lab.setStack(packSlot, stack.copy());
                        if (!player.isCreative()) stack.setCount(0);
                    } else if (cur.getCount() < cur.getMaxCount()) {
                        int add = Math.min(stack.getCount(), cur.getMaxCount() - cur.getCount());
                        cur.increment(add);
                        if (!player.isCreative()) stack.decrement(add);
                        lab.sync();
                    }
                    world.playSound(null, master, SoundEvents.BLOCK_BREWING_STAND_BREW, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 0.5f, 1.2f);
                    player.sendMessage(Text.literal("Â§aÐšÐ¾Ð»Ð±Ð¾Ñ‡ÐºÐ¸ Ð·Ð°Ð³Ñ€ÑƒÐ¶ÐµÐ½Ñ‹ Ð² Ð»Ð°Ð±Ð¾Ñ€Ð°Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ð¸ÑŽ! [Â§e"
                            + lab.getStack(0).getCount() + " ÐºÑ€, "
                            + lab.getStack(1).getCount() + " Ð·ÐµÐ», "
                            + lab.getStack(2).getCount() + " Ð²Ð¾ÐµÐ½, "
                            + lab.getStack(3).getCount() + " ÑÐ¸Ð½Â§a]"), true);
                }
                return ItemActionResult.SUCCESS;
            }
        }
        return super.onUseWithItem(stack, state, world, pos, player, hand, hit);
    }

    @Override
    protected ActionResult onUse(BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos, PlayerEntity player, BlockHitResult hit) {
        BlockPos master = getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (player.isSneaking()) {
            if (world.isClient && clientTechTreeOpener != null) {
                clientTechTreeOpener.accept(master);
            }
            return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
        }
        if (!world.isClient && world.getBlockEntity(master) instanceof LabBlockEntity labBe) {
            player.openHandledScreen(labBe);
        }
        return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
    }

    @Override protected VoxelShape getOutlineShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        return state.get(UPPER) ? UPPER_SHAPE : VoxelShapes.fullCube();
    }

    @Override protected VoxelShape getCollisionShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        return state.get(UPPER) ? UPPER_SHAPE : VoxelShapes.fullCube();
    }

    @Override protected BlockRenderType getRenderType(BlockState state) { return BlockRenderType.INVISIBLE; }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockEntity createBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        return (state.get(PART) == 4 && !state.get(UPPER)) ? new LabBlockEntity(pos, state) : null;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public <T extends BlockEntity> BlockEntityTicker<T> getTicker(World world, BlockState state, BlockEntityType<T> type) {
        if (world.isClient || state.get(PART) != 4 || state.get(UPPER)) return null;
        return validateTicker(type, ModBlocks.LAB_BLOCK_ENTITY, LabBlockEntity::tick);
    }

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.research;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.electricity.PowerNetworkManager;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModBlocks;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModItems;
import net.minecraft.block.Block;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

public class LabBlockEntity extends BlockEntity implements SidedInventory, NamedScreenHandlerFactory {

    public static final long POWER_CONSUMPTION_WATTS = 60_000L;
    private static final int[] SLOTS = new int[]{0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6};

    // 7 ÑÐ»Ð¾Ñ‚Ð¾Ð² Ð¿Ð¾Ð´ Ð½Ð°ÑƒÑ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ ÐºÐ¾Ð»Ð±Ð¾Ñ‡ÐºÐ¸ (0..3 Ð°ÐºÑ‚Ð¸Ð²Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ, 4..6 Ñ€ÐµÐ·ÐµÑ€Ð² Ð¿Ð¾Ð´ Ñ„Ð¸Ð¾Ð»ÐµÑ‚Ð¾Ð²ÑƒÑŽ/Ð¶Ñ‘Ð»Ñ‚ÑƒÑŽ/Ð±ÐµÐ»ÑƒÑŽ Ð½Ð°ÑƒÐºÑƒ)
    private final DefaultedList<ItemStack> inventory = DefaultedList.ofSize(7, ItemStack.EMPTY);
    private boolean isPowered = false;
    private boolean isWorking = false;

    protected final PropertyDelegate propertyDelegate = new PropertyDelegate() {
        @Override
        public int get(int index) {
            return switch (index) {
                case 0 -> isWorking ? Math.max(1, Math.round(ResearchManager.getOverallProgressRatio() * 100.0f)) : 0;
                case 1 -> 100;
                default -> 0;
            };
        }

        @Override
        public void set(int index, int value) {
        }

        @Override
        public int size() {
            return 2;
        }
    };

    public LabBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(ModBlocks.LAB_BLOCK_ENTITY, pos, state);
    }

    public boolean isPowered() { return isPowered; }
    public boolean isWorking() { return isWorking; }

    public static int getSlotForPack(Item item) {
        if (item == ModItems.AUTOMATION_SCIENCE_PACK) return 0;
        if (item == ModItems.LOGISTIC_SCIENCE_PACK) return 1;
        if (item == ModItems.MILITARY_SCIENCE_PACK) return 2;
        if (item == ModItems.CHEMICAL_SCIENCE_PACK) return 3;
        return -1;
    }

    public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, LabBlockEntity be) {
        if (world == null || world.isClient) return;
        if (state.get(LabBlock.PART) != 4 || state.get(LabBlock.UPPER)) return;

        boolean hasPower = PowerNetworkManager.isMachinePowered(world, pos);
        ResearchManager.TechNode activeTech = ResearchManager.getActiveTech();
        boolean canResearch = hasPower && activeTech != null && be.hasRequiredPacks(activeTech);

        if (be.isPowered != hasPower || be.isWorking != canResearch) {
            be.isPowered = hasPower;
            be.isWorking = canResearch;
            be.sync();
        }

        if (canResearch) {
            boolean unitFinished = ResearchManager.advanceResearchTickFromLab(activeTech);
            if (unitFinished) {
                be.consumePacks(activeTech);
                be.sync();
            }
        }
    }

    public boolean hasRequiredPacks(ResearchManager.TechNode tech) {
        if (tech == null) return false;
        for (ResearchManager.SciencePack sp : tech.packs) {
            int slot = sp.ordinal();
            ItemStack st = inventory.get(slot);
            if (st.isEmpty() || !st.isOf(sp.getItem())) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    private void consumePacks(ResearchManager.TechNode tech) {
        for (ResearchManager.SciencePack sp : tech.packs) {
            int slot = sp.ordinal();
            ItemStack st = inventory.get(slot);
            if (!st.isEmpty()) {
                st.decrement(1);
            }
        }
    }

    public void sync() {
        markDirty();
        if (world != null && !world.isClient) {
            world.updateListeners(pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_LISTENERS);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isValid(int slot, ItemStack stack) {
        return getSlotForPack(stack.getItem()) == slot;
    }

    @Override public int[] getAvailableSlots(Direction side) { return SLOTS; }
    @Override public boolean canInsert(int slot, ItemStack stack, @Nullable Direction dir) { return isValid(slot, stack); }
    @Override public boolean canExtract(int slot, ItemStack stack, Direction dir) { return false; }

    @Override public int size() { return inventory.size(); }
    @Override public boolean isEmpty() { return inventory.stream().allMatch(ItemStack::isEmpty); }
    @Override public ItemStack getStack(int slot) { return (slot >= 0 && slot < inventory.size()) ? inventory.get(slot) : ItemStack.EMPTY; }
    @Override public ItemStack removeStack(int slot, int amount) { ItemStack r = Inventories.splitStack(inventory, slot, amount); if (!r.isEmpty()) sync(); return r; }
    @Override public ItemStack removeStack(int slot) { ItemStack r = Inventories.removeStack(inventory, slot); if (!r.isEmpty()) sync(); return r; }
    @Override public void setStack(int slot, ItemStack stack) { if (slot >= 0 && slot < inventory.size()) { inventory.set(slot, stack); sync(); } }
    @Override public boolean canPlayerUse(PlayerEntity player) { return Inventory.canPlayerUse(this, player, 10.0F); }
    @Override public void clear() { inventory.clear(); sync(); }

    @Override
    public Text getDisplayName() {
        return Text.translatable("block.factoriocore.lab");
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public ScreenHandler createMenu(int syncId, PlayerInventory playerInventory, PlayerEntity player) {
        return new LabScreenHandler(syncId, playerInventory, this, this.propertyDelegate);
    }

    @Override
    protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
        Inventories.writeNbt(nbt, inventory, registries);
        nbt.putBoolean("Powered", isPowered);
        nbt.putBoolean("Working", isWorking);
    }

    @Override
    protected void readNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
        inventory.clear();
        Inventories.readNbt(nbt, inventory, registries);
        isPowered = nbt.getBoolean("Powered");
        isWorking = nbt.getBoolean("Working");
    }

    @Nullable @Override public Packet<ClientPlayPacketListener> toUpdatePacket() { return BlockEntityUpdateS2CPacket.create(this); }
    @Override public NbtCompound toInitialChunkDataNbt(RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) { return createNbt(registries); }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.research;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.registry.ModScreenHandlers;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerEntity;
import net.minecraft.entity.player.PlayerInventory;
import net.minecraft.inventory.Inventory;
import net.minecraft.inventory.SimpleInventory;
import net.minecraft.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.screen.ArrayPropertyDelegate;
import net.minecraft.screen.PropertyDelegate;
import net.minecraft.screen.ScreenHandler;
import net.minecraft.screen.slot.Slot;

public class LabScreenHandler extends ScreenHandler {
    private final Inventory inventory;
    private final PropertyDelegate propertyDelegate;

    public LabScreenHandler(int syncId, PlayerInventory playerInventory) {
        this(syncId, playerInventory, new SimpleInventory(7), new ArrayPropertyDelegate(2));
    }

    public LabScreenHandler(int syncId, PlayerInventory playerInventory, Inventory inventory, PropertyDelegate delegate) {
        super(ModScreenHandlers.LAB_SCREEN_HANDLER, syncId);
        this.inventory = inventory;
        this.propertyDelegate = delegate;
        this.addProperties(delegate);

        int slotsStartX = (236 - (7 * 19)) / 2 + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            final int slotIndex = i;
            this.addSlot(new Slot(inventory, slotIndex, slotsStartX + i * 19, 103) {
                @Override
                public boolean canInsert(ItemStack stack) {
                    return LabBlockEntity.getSlotForPack(stack.getItem()) == slotIndex;
                }
            });
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 9; ++j) {
                this.addSlot(new Slot(playerInventory, j + i * 9 + 9, 37 + j * 18, 137 + i * 18));
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 9; ++i) {
            this.addSlot(new Slot(playerInventory, i, 37 + i * 18, 195));
        }
    }

    public int getResearchProgress() { return this.propertyDelegate.get(0); }
    public int getMaxResearchTime() { return Math.max(1, this.propertyDelegate.get(1)); }

    @Override
    public ItemStack quickMove(PlayerEntity player, int invSlot) {
        ItemStack newStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        Slot slot = this.slots.get(invSlot);
        if (slot != null && slot.hasStack()) {
            ItemStack originalStack = slot.getStack();
            newStack = originalStack.copy();

            if (invSlot < 7) {
                if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, 7, this.slots.size(), true)) {
                    return ItemStack.EMPTY;
                }
            } else {
                int targetPackSlot = LabBlockEntity.getSlotForPack(originalStack.getItem());
                if (targetPackSlot >= 0) {
                    if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, targetPackSlot, targetPackSlot + 1, false)) {
                        return ItemStack.EMPTY;
                    }
                } else {
                    return ItemStack.EMPTY;
                }
            }

            if (originalStack.isEmpty()) {
                slot.setStack(ItemStack.EMPTY);
            } else {
                slot.markDirty();
            }
        }
        return newStack;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canUse(PlayerEntity player) {
        return this.inventory.canPlayerUse(player);
    }
}

    private static void register(TechNode node) {
        TECHS.add(node);
        for (String recId : node.unlockedRecipeIds) {
            RECIPE_TO_TECH.put(recId, node.id);
        }
    }

    public static void resetToDefaults() {
        init();
        RESEARCH_QUEUE.clear();
        currentUnitTickProgress = 0;
        for (TechNode t : TECHS) {
            t.status = t.initialStatus;
            t.completedUnits = (t.initialStatus == TechStatus.RESEARCHED) ? t.costCount : 0;
        }
        recalculateAvailability();
    }

    public static void tickServer(MinecraftServer server) {
        if (server == null) return;
        if (loadedServer != server) {
            loadedServer = server;
            loadForServer(server);
        }

        if ((server.getTicks() % 10) == 0) {
            checkCraftTriggersForPlayers(server);
        }

        if (dirtyForSave && (server.getTicks() % 40 == 0)) {
            saveForServer(server);
            dirtyForSave = false;
        }
    }

    private static void checkCraftTriggersForPlayers(MinecraftServer server) {
        init();
        List<ServerPlayerEntity> players = server.getPlayerManager().getPlayerList();
        if (players.isEmpty()) return;

        boolean anyTriggered = true;
        while (anyTriggered) {
            anyTriggered = false;
            for (TechNode tech : TECHS) {
                if (tech.status == TechStatus.AVAILABLE && tech.packs.isEmpty() && !tech.craftTrigger.isEmpty()) {
                    Item triggerItem = tech.craftTrigger.getItem();
                    for (ServerPlayerEntity player : players) {
                        if (hasItemInInventory(player.getInventory(), triggerItem)) {
                            completeImmediately(tech.id);
                            notifyTriggerTechCompleted(server, tech);
                            anyTriggered = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static boolean hasItemInInventory(PlayerInventory inv, Item target) {
        for (int i = 0; i < inv.main.size(); i++) {
            ItemStack st = inv.main.get(i);
            if (!st.isEmpty() && st.isOf(target)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static void notifyTriggerTechCompleted(MinecraftServer server, TechNode tech) {
        Text msg = Text.literal("Â§a[FactorioCore] Â§e")
                .append(Text.translatableWithFallback("tech.factoriocore." + tech.id + ".name", tech.name))
                .append(Text.literal(" Â§7("))
                .append(tech.craftTrigger.getName())
                .append(Text.literal(")"));
        for (ServerPlayerEntity p : server.getPlayerManager().getPlayerList()) {
            p.sendMessage(msg, false);
            p.playSoundToPlayer(ModSounds.RESEARCH_COMPLETED, SoundCategory.PLAYERS, 0.7f, 1.0f);
        }
    }

    public static void loadForServer(MinecraftServer server) {
        resetToDefaults();
        try {
            Path dataDir = server.getSavePath(WorldSavePath.ROOT).resolve("data");
            File file = dataDir.resolve("factoriocore_research.nbt").toFile();
            if (file.exists()) {
                NbtCompound nbt = NbtIo.readCompressed(file.toPath(), NbtSizeTracker.ofUnlimitedBytes());
                fromNbt(nbt);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
    }

    public static void saveForServer(MinecraftServer server) {
        if (server == null) return;
        try {
            Path dataDir = server.getSavePath(WorldSavePath.ROOT).resolve("data");
            dataDir.toFile().mkdirs();
            File file = dataDir.resolve("factoriocore_research.nbt").toFile();
            NbtIo.writeCompressed(toNbt(), file.toPath());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
    }

    public static NbtCompound toNbt() {
        init();
        NbtCompound nbt = new NbtCompound();
        nbt.putInt("UnitTickProgress", currentUnitTickProgress);

        NbtList techList = new NbtList();
        for (TechNode t : TECHS) {
            NbtCompound tc = new NbtCompound();
            tc.putString("Id", t.id);
            tc.putString("Status", t.status.name());
            tc.putInt("CompletedUnits", t.completedUnits);
            techList.add(tc);
        }
        nbt.put("Techs", techList);

        NbtList queueList = new NbtList();
        for (String qId : RESEARCH_QUEUE) {
            queueList.add(NbtString.of(qId));
        }
        nbt.put("Queue", queueList);
        return nbt;
    }

    public static void fromNbt(NbtCompound nbt) {
        init();
        currentUnitTickProgress = nbt.getInt("UnitTickProgress");

        if (nbt.contains("Techs", NbtElement.LIST_TYPE)) {
            NbtList techList = nbt.getList("Techs", NbtElement.COMPOUND_TYPE);
            for (int i = 0; i < techList.size(); i++) {
                NbtCompound tc = techList.getCompound(i);
                TechNode node = getById(tc.getString("Id"));
                if (node != null) {
                    try {
                        node.status = TechStatus.valueOf(tc.getString("Status"));
                    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ignored) {
                    }
                    node.completedUnits = Math.max(0, Math.min(node.costCount, tc.getInt("CompletedUnits")));
                }
            }
        }

        RESEARCH_QUEUE.clear();
        if (nbt.contains("Queue", NbtElement.LIST_TYPE)) {
            NbtList queueList = nbt.getList("Queue", NbtElement.STRING_TYPE);
            for (int i = 0; i < queueList.size(); i++) {
                String qId = queueList.getString(i);
                TechNode node = getById(qId);
                if (node != null && node.status != TechStatus.RESEARCHED && !RESEARCH_QUEUE.contains(qId)) {
                    RESEARCH_QUEUE.add(qId);
                }
            }
        }
        recalculateAvailability();
    }

    public static TechNode getById(String id) {
        init();
        for (TechNode t : TECHS) {
            if (t.id.equals(id)) return t;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static TechNode getActiveTech() {
        init();
        if (RESEARCH_QUEUE.isEmpty()) return null;
        return getById(RESEARCH_QUEUE.get(0));
    }

    public static boolean isTechResearched(String techId) {
        TechNode t = getById(techId);
        return t != null && t.status == TechStatus.RESEARCHED;
    }

    public static boolean isRecipeUnlocked(String recipeId) {
        init();
        String reqTech = RECIPE_TO_TECH.get(recipeId);
        if (reqTech == null) return true;
        return isTechResearched(reqTech);
    }

    public static void recalculateAvailability() {
        init();
        for (TechNode t : TECHS) {
            if (t.status == TechStatus.RESEARCHED) continue;
            boolean allPreMet = true;
            for (String preId : t.prerequisites) {
                TechNode pre = getById(preId);
                if (pre == null || pre.status != TechStatus.RESEARCHED) {
                    allPreMet = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            t.status = allPreMet ? TechStatus.AVAILABLE : TechStatus.LOCKED;
        }
    }

    public static void queueTech(String techId) {
        TechNode t = getById(techId);
        if (t == null || t.status != TechStatus.AVAILABLE) return;

        if (t.packs.isEmpty()) {
            completeImmediately(techId);
            return;
        }

        if (!RESEARCH_QUEUE.contains(techId)) {
            RESEARCH_QUEUE.add(techId);
            dirtyForSave = true;
        }
    }

    public static void removeQueueAt(int index) {
        if (index >= 0 && index < RESEARCH_QUEUE.size()) {
            RESEARCH_QUEUE.remove(index);
            if (index == 0) currentUnitTickProgress = 0;
            dirtyForSave = true;
        }
    }

    public static void completeImmediately(String techId) {
        TechNode t = getById(techId);
        if (t != null) {
            t.status = TechStatus.RESEARCHED;
            t.completedUnits = t.costCount;
            RESEARCH_QUEUE.remove(techId);
            currentUnitTickProgress = 0;
            recalculateAvailability();
            dirtyForSave = true;
        }
    }

    public static int getTicksPerUnit(TechNode tech) {
        int baseTicks = Math.max(20, tech.timeSeconds * 4);
        if (isTechResearched("research_speed_1")) {
            baseTicks = Math.max(15, (int) (baseTicks * 0.75f));
        }
        return baseTicks;
    }

    public static boolean advanceResearchTickFromLab(TechNode activeTech) {
        if (activeTech == null || activeTech.status == TechStatus.RESEARCHED) return false;
        currentUnitTickProgress++;
        int neededTicks = getTicksPerUnit(activeTech);
        if (currentUnitTickProgress >= neededTicks) {
            currentUnitTickProgress = 0;
            activeTech.completedUnits++;
            if (activeTech.completedUnits >= activeTech.costCount) {
                activeTech.status = TechStatus.RESEARCHED;
                RESEARCH_QUEUE.remove(activeTech.id);
                recalculateAvailability();
            }
            dirtyForSave = true;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static float getOverallProgressRatio() {
        TechNode active = getActiveTech();
        if (active == null || active.costCount <= 0) return 0.0f;
        float unitPart = currentUnitTickProgress / (float) getTicksPerUnit(active);
        return Math.min(1.0f, (active.completedUnits + unitPart) / (float) active.costCount);
    }
}

    private static void replaceWithDepletedGround(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {

        world.setBlockState(pos, depletedGround, Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
        world.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.BLOCK_GRAVEL_BREAK, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 0.8f, 0.85f);
    }
