    public TurretBlockEntity getMaster() {
        if (this.world == null) return this;
        BlockState st = getCachedState();
        if (st.getBlock() instanceof TurretBlock) {
            BlockPos masterPos = TurretBlock.getMasterPos(this.pos, st);
            if (this.world.getBlockEntity(masterPos) instanceof TurretBlockEntity m) {
                return m;
            }
        }
        return this;
    }

    public static void clientTick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, TurretBlockEntity turret) {
        if (turret.activeFiringTicks > 0) {
            turret.activeFiringTicks--;
        }
    }

    public static void tick(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, TurretBlockEntity turret) {
        if (world == null || world.isClient) return;

        int kind = turret.getTurretKind();
        boolean dirty = false;

        if (kind == 1) {
            boolean hasPower = PowerNetworkManager.isMachinePowered(world, pos);
            if (turret.powered != hasPower) {
                turret.powered = hasPower;
                dirty = true;
            }
        } else {
            turret.powered = true;
        }

        if (turret.fireCooldown > 0) {
            turret.fireCooldown--;
        }
        if (turret.activeFiringTicks > 0) {
            turret.activeFiringTicks--;
            if (turret.activeFiringTicks == 0) dirty = true;
        }

        boolean canAttack = switch (kind) {
            case 0 -> turret.ensureBulletLoaded();
            case 1 -> turret.powered;
            case 2 -> turret.fuelFluidMb >= 10;
            default -> false;
        };

        if (!canAttack) {
            if (dirty) turret.sync();
            return;
        }

        int range = (state.getBlock() instanceof TurretBlock tb) ? tb.getAttackRangeBlocks() : 18;
        Vec3d muzzlePos = new Vec3d(pos.getX() + 1.0, pos.getY() + 1.65, pos.getZ() + 1.0);
        LivingEntity target = findNearestHostileTarget(world, muzzlePos, range);

        if (target != null) {
            Vec3d targetCenter = target.getBoundingBox().getCenter();
            double dx = targetCenter.x - muzzlePos.x;
            double dy = targetCenter.y - muzzlePos.y;
            double dz = targetCenter.z - muzzlePos.z;
            double horizDist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);

            float desiredYaw = (float) (MathHelper.atan2(dz, dx) * (180.0 / Math.PI)) - 90.0f;
            float desiredPitch = (float) -(MathHelper.atan2(dy, horizDist) * (180.0 / Math.PI));

            turret.turretYaw = desiredYaw;
            turret.turretPitch = MathHelper.clamp(desiredPitch, -45.0f, 45.0f);
            turret.targetX = (float) targetCenter.x;
            turret.targetY = (float) targetCenter.y;
            turret.targetZ = (float) targetCenter.z;

            if (turret.fireCooldown <= 0 && world instanceof ServerWorld serverWorld) {
                turret.fireAtTarget(serverWorld, kind, muzzlePos, target);
                dirty = true;
            }
        }

        if (dirty) {
            turret.sync();
        }
    }

    @Nullable
    private static LivingEntity findNearestHostileTarget(World world, Vec3d center, int range) {
        Box searchBox = Box.of(center, range * 2.0, 18.0, range * 2.0);
        double maxDistSq = range * range;
        List<LivingEntity> hostiles = world.getEntitiesByClass(LivingEntity.class, searchBox, e ->
                e instanceof Monster && e.isAlive() && !e.isSpectator() && e.squaredDistanceTo(center) <= maxDistSq);
        if (hostiles.isEmpty()) return null;
        hostiles.sort(Comparator.comparingDouble(e -> e.squaredDistanceTo(center)));
        return hostiles.get(0);
    }

    private boolean ensureBulletLoaded() {
        if (this.currentMagazineRounds > 0) return true;
        ItemStack magStack = this.inventory.get(0);
        if (!magStack.isEmpty() && magStack.getItem() instanceof FactorioWeapons.AmmoMagazineItem mag) {
            this.currentMagazineRounds = mag.getRoundsPerMagazine();
            this.maxMagazineRounds = mag.getRoundsPerMagazine();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private void fireAtTarget(ServerWorld world, int kind, Vec3d muzzlePos, LivingEntity target) {
        float healthBefore = target.getHealth();
        target.timeUntilRegen = 0;

        if (kind == 0) {
            // 1. ÐŸÑƒÐ»ÐµÐ¼Ñ‘Ñ‚Ð½Ð°Ñ Ñ‚ÑƒÑ€ÐµÐ»ÑŒ (ÑÐºÐ¾Ñ€Ð¾ÑÑ‚Ñ€ÐµÐ»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾ÑÑ‚ÑŒ 5 Ð²Ñ‹ÑÑ‚Ñ€./ÑÐµÐº = ÐºÐ°Ð¶Ð´Ñ‹Ðµ 4 Ñ‚Ð¸ÐºÐ°)
            ItemStack magStack = this.inventory.get(0);
            float dmg = 5.0f;
            if (!magStack.isEmpty() && magStack.getItem() instanceof FactorioWeapons.AmmoMagazineItem mag) {
                dmg = mag.getDamagePerShot();
            }

            target.damage(world.getDamageSources().mobProjectile(null, null), dmg);
            this.currentMagazineRounds--;
            if (this.currentMagazineRounds <= 0 && !magStack.isEmpty()) {
                magStack.decrement(1);
                if (magStack.isEmpty()) {
                    this.inventory.set(0, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                } else if (magStack.getItem() instanceof FactorioWeapons.AmmoMagazineItem nextMag) {
                    this.currentMagazineRounds = nextMag.getRoundsPerMagazine();
                }
            }

            this.fireCooldown = 4;
            this.activeFiringTicks = 3;
            world.playSound(null, this.pos, SoundEvents.ENTITY_FIREWORK_ROCKET_BLAST, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 0.55f, 1.45f);
            world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.FLAME, muzzlePos.x, muzzlePos.y, muzzlePos.z, 3, 0.08, 0.08, 0.08, 0.02);
            world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.CRIT, target.getX(), target.getBodyY(0.5), target.getZ(), 4, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.05);
        } else if (kind == 1) {
            // 2. Ð›Ð°Ð·ÐµÑ€Ð½Ð°Ñ Ñ‚ÑƒÑ€ÐµÐ»ÑŒ (ÑƒÑ€Ð¾Ð½ 10 ÐµÐ´. ÐºÐ°Ð¶Ð´Ñ‹Ðµ 8 Ñ‚Ð¸ÐºÐ¾Ð², 3D-Ð»ÑƒÑ‡ Ñ€Ð¸ÑÑƒÐµÑ‚ÑÑ Ð½Ð° ÐºÐ»Ð¸ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ðµ)
            target.damage(world.getDamageSources().magic(), 10.0f);
            this.fireCooldown = 8;
            this.activeFiringTicks = 6;
            world.playSound(null, this.pos, SoundEvents.BLOCK_BEACON_DEACTIVATE, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 0.45f, 1.95f);
            world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.END_ROD, target.getX(), target.getBodyY(0.5), target.getZ(), 4, 0.12, 0.12, 0.12, 0.03);
        } else if (kind == 2) {
            // 3. ÐžÐ³Ð½ÐµÐ¼Ñ‘Ñ‚Ð½Ð°Ñ Ñ‚ÑƒÑ€ÐµÐ»ÑŒ (Ð±Ð¾Ð½ÑƒÑ ÑƒÑ€Ð¾Ð½Ð°: ÐÐµÑ„Ñ‚ÑŒ 100%, ÐœÐ°Ð·ÑƒÑ‚ 105%, Ð”Ð¸Ð·ÐµÐ»ÑŒ 110%)
            float fuelMul = (this.fuelFluidKind == FluidKind.LIGHT_OIL) ? 1.10f
                    : (this.fuelFluidKind == FluidKind.HEAVY_OIL ? 1.05f : 1.00f);
            this.fuelFluidMb = Math.max(0, this.fuelFluidMb - 12);
            if (this.fuelFluidMb == 0) this.fuelFluidKind = FluidKind.NONE;

            Vec3d targetPos = target.getBoundingBox().getCenter();
            Vec3d dir = targetPos.subtract(muzzlePos).normalize();
            double dist = muzzlePos.distanceTo(targetPos);

            for (double d = 0.8; d <= dist; d += 1.2) {
                Vec3d p = muzzlePos.add(dir.multiply(d));
                world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.FLAME, p.x, p.y, p.z, 3, 0.18, 0.12, 0.18, 0.02);
                if (d > 3.0) {
                    world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.LARGE_SMOKE, p.x, p.y + 0.1, p.z, 1, 0.15, 0.1, 0.15, 0.01);
                }
            }

            // ÐŸÐ¾Ð´Ð¶Ð¸Ð³Ð°ÐµÐ¼ Ð¸ Ð½Ð°Ð½Ð¾ÑÐ¸Ð¼ ÑƒÑ€Ð¾Ð½ Ð¿Ð¾ Ð¾Ð³Ð½ÐµÐ½Ð½Ð¾Ð¼Ñƒ Ð¿ÑÑ‚Ð½Ñƒ Ð² Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ‡ÐºÐµ Ð¿Ð¾Ð¿Ð°Ð´Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ñ
            Box fireSplash = Box.of(targetPos, 4.5, 3.0, 4.5);
            for (LivingEntity victim : world.getEntitiesByClass(LivingEntity.class, fireSplash, e -> e instanceof Monster && e.isAlive())) {
                victim.timeUntilRegen = 0;
                victim.setOnFireFor(5);
                victim.damage(world.getDamageSources().onFire(), 8.0f * fuelMul);
            }

            this.fireCooldown = 5;
            this.activeFiringTicks = 5;
            world.playSound(null, this.pos, SoundEvents.ITEM_FIRECHARGE_USE, SoundCategory.BLOCKS, 0.65f, 0.90f);
        }

        float dealt = Math.max(0.0f, healthBefore - Math.max(0.0f, target.getHealth()));
        this.totalDamageDealt += dealt;
        if (!target.isAlive()) {
            this.killsCount++;
        }
    }

    public void sync() {
        markDirty();
        if (this.world != null && !this.world.isClient) {
            this.world.updateListeners(this.pos, getCachedState(), getCachedState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
        }
    }

    // === Ð–Ð˜Ð”ÐšÐžÐ¡Ð¢ÐÐ«Ð™ Ð˜ÐÐ¢Ð•Ð Ð¤Ð•Ð™Ð¡ Ð”Ð›Ð¯ ÐžÐ“ÐÐ•ÐœÐÐ¢ÐÐžÐ™ Ð¢Ð£Ð Ð•Ð›Ð˜ ===
    @Override public FluidKind getFluidKind() { return this.fuelFluidMb > 0 ? this.fuelFluidKind : FluidKind.NONE; }
    @Override public int getFluidAmount() { return this.fuelFluidMb; }
    @Override public int getFluidCapacity() { return getTurretKind() == 2 ? FLAME_CAPACITY_MB : 0; }
    @Override public int getTemperatureC() { return 25; }

    @Override
    public boolean canAcceptFluid(FluidKind kind, Direction fromSide) {
        if (getTurretKind() != 2) return false;
        boolean validFuel = (kind == FluidKind.CRUDE_OIL || kind == FluidKind.HEAVY_OIL || kind == FluidKind.LIGHT_OIL);
        return validFuel && (this.fuelFluidMb == 0 || (this.fuelFluidKind == kind && this.fuelFluidMb < FLAME_CAPACITY_MB));
    }

    @Override
    public int insertFluid(FluidKind kind, int maxAmount, int tempC, Direction fromSide) {
        if (!canAcceptFluid(kind, fromSide) || maxAmount <= 0) return 0;
        int space = FLAME_CAPACITY_MB - this.fuelFluidMb;
        int add = Math.min(space, maxAmount);
        if (add > 0) {
            boolean wasEmpty = (this.fuelFluidMb == 0);
            this.fuelFluidKind = kind;
            this.fuelFluidMb += add;
            if (wasEmpty || (this.world != null && (this.world.getTime() & 3L) == 0L)) sync();
            else markDirty();
        }
        return add;
    }

    @Override public int[] getAvailableSlots(Direction side) { return getTurretKind() == 0 ? SLOTS : new int[0]; }

    @Override
    public ItemStack removeStack(int slot, int amount) {
        TurretBlockEntity m = getMaster();
        ItemStack r = Inventories.splitStack(m.inventory, slot, amount);
        if (!r.isEmpty()) m.sync();

                m.currentMagazineRounds = mag.getRoundsPerMagazine();
                m.maxMagazineRounds = mag.getRoundsPerMagazine();
            }
            m.sync();
        }
    }

    @Override public boolean canPlayerUse(PlayerEntity player) { return true; }
    @Override public void clear() { getMaster().inventory.clear(); getMaster().sync(); }

    @Override

    @Override
    protected void writeNbt(NbtCompound nbt, RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup registries) {
        super.writeNbt(nbt, registries);
        Inventories.writeNbt(nbt, this.inventory, registries);
        nbt.putInt("CurrentRounds", this.currentMagazineRounds);
        nbt.putInt("MaxRounds", this.maxMagazineRounds);

        nbt.putFloat("TargetX", this.targetX);
        nbt.putFloat("TargetY", this.targetY);
        nbt.putFloat("TargetZ", this.targetZ);

        super.readNbt(nbt, registries);
        this.inventory.clear();

        this.currentMagazineRounds = nbt.getInt("CurrentRounds");
        this.maxMagazineRounds = Math.max(1, nbt.getInt("MaxRounds"));
        try {

        this.fuelFluidMb = nbt.getInt("FuelMb");
        this.turretYaw = nbt.getFloat("TurretYaw");

        this.totalDamageDealt = nbt.getFloat("TotalDamage");
        this.targetX = nbt.getFloat("TargetX");
        this.targetY = nbt.getFloat("TargetY");
        this.targetZ = nbt.getFloat("TargetZ");
    }

import net.minecraft.screen.PropertyDelegate;

import net.minecraft.screen.slot.Slot;
import net.minecraft.util.math.BlockPos;

public class TurretScreenHandler extends ScreenHandler {

    private final Inventory inventory;
    private final PropertyDelegate propertyDelegate;
    public final TurretBlockEntity turretEntity;

    public TurretScreenHandler(int syncId, PlayerInventory playerInventory, BlockPos pos) {
        this(syncId, playerInventory,
                (playerInventory.player.getWorld().getBlockEntity(pos) instanceof TurretBlockEntity t) ? t.getMaster() : null,
                new ArrayPropertyDelegate(7));
    }

    public TurretScreenHandler(int syncId, PlayerInventory playerInventory, TurretBlockEntity turretEntity, PropertyDelegate delegate) {
        super(ModScreenHandlers.TURRET_SCREEN_HANDLER, syncId);
        this.turretEntity = turretEntity;
        this.inventory = turretEntity != null ? turretEntity : new SimpleInventory(1);
        this.propertyDelegate = delegate;
        this.addProperties(delegate);

        // Ð¡Ð»Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð¼Ð°Ð³Ð°Ð·Ð¸Ð½Ð° Ð¿Ð°Ñ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ð½Ð¾Ð² (Ð°ÐºÑ‚Ð¸Ð²ÐµÐ½ Ð´Ð»Ñ ÐŸÑƒÐ»ÐµÐ¼Ñ‘Ñ‚Ð½Ð¾Ð¹ Ñ‚ÑƒÑ€ÐµÐ»Ð¸)
        this.addSlot(new Slot(this.inventory, 0, 11, 88) {
            @Override
            public boolean canInsert(ItemStack stack) {
                return getTurretKind() == 0 && stack.getItem() instanceof FactorioWeapons.AmmoMagazineItem;
            }

            @Override
            public boolean isEnabled() {
                return getTurretKind() == 0;
            }
        });

        int invStartX = 38;
        for (int row = 0; row < 3; row++) {
            for (int col = 0; col < 9; col++) {
                this.addSlot(new Slot(playerInventory, col + row * 9 + 9, invStartX + col * 18, 138 + row * 18));
            }
        }
        for (int col = 0; col < 9; col++) {
            this.addSlot(new Slot(playerInventory, col, invStartX + col * 18, 196));
        }
    }

    public int getTurretKind() { return this.propertyDelegate.get(0); }
    public int getCurrentRounds() { return this.propertyDelegate.get(1); }
    public int getMaxRounds() { return Math.max(1, this.propertyDelegate.get(2)); }
    public int getFuelFluidMb() { return this.propertyDelegate.get(3); }
    public boolean isPowered() { return this.propertyDelegate.get(4) != 0; }
    public int getKillsCount() { return this.propertyDelegate.get(5); }
    public int getTotalDamage() { return this.propertyDelegate.get(6); }

    @Override
    public ItemStack quickMove(PlayerEntity player, int invSlot) {
        ItemStack newStack = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        Slot slot = this.slots.get(invSlot);
        if (slot != null && slot.hasStack()) {
            ItemStack originalStack = slot.getStack();
            newStack = originalStack.copy();
            if (invSlot == 0) {
                if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, 1, this.slots.size(), true)) {
                    return ItemStack.EMPTY;
                }
            } else if (getTurretKind() == 0 && originalStack.getItem() instanceof FactorioWeapons.AmmoMagazineItem) {
                if (!this.insertItem(originalStack, 0, 1, false)) {
                    return ItemStack.EMPTY;
                }
            } else {
                return ItemStack.EMPTY;
            }
            if (originalStack.isEmpty()) slot.setStack(ItemStack.EMPTY);
            else slot.markDirty();
        }
        return newStack;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canUse(PlayerEntity player) {
        return this.inventory.canPlayerUse(player);
    }
}

    public static class AmmoMagazineItem extends Item {
        private final float damagePerShot;
        private final int roundsPerMagazine;
        private final boolean armorPiercing;

        public AmmoMagazineItem(Settings settings, float damagePerShot, int roundsPerMagazine, boolean armorPiercing) {
            super(settings);
            this.damagePerShot = damagePerShot;
            this.roundsPerMagazine = roundsPerMagazine;
            this.armorPiercing = armorPiercing;
        }

        public float getDamagePerShot() { return this.damagePerShot; }
        public int getRoundsPerMagazine() { return this.roundsPerMagazine; }
        public boolean isArmorPiercing() { return this.armorPiercing; }

        @Override
        public void appendTooltip(ItemStack stack, TooltipContext context, List<Text> tooltip, TooltipType type) {
            tooltip.add(Text.literal("Ð‘Ð¾ÐµÐ·Ð°Ð¿Ð°Ñ Ð¼Ð°Ð³Ð°Ð·Ð¸Ð½Ð°: ").formatted(Formatting.GRAY)
                    .append(Text.literal(roundsPerMagazine + " Ð²Ñ‹ÑÑ‚Ñ€.").formatted(Formatting.YELLOW)));
            tooltip.add(Text.literal("Ð¤Ð¸Ð·Ð¸Ñ‡ÐµÑÐºÐ¸Ð¹ ÑƒÑ€Ð¾Ð½: ").formatted(Formatting.GRAY)
                    .append(Text.literal(String.valueOf(damagePerShot)).formatted(armorPiercing ? Formatting.GOLD : Formatting.WHITE)));
        }
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 2. Ð¡Ð¢Ð Ð•Ð›ÐšÐžÐ’ÐžÐ• ÐžÐ Ð£Ð–Ð˜Ð• (ÐŸÐ˜Ð¡Ð¢ÐžÐ›Ð•Ð¢, ÐÐ’Ð¢ÐžÐœÐÐ¢, Ð”Ð ÐžÐ‘ÐžÐ’Ð˜Ðš)
    // =========================================================================
    public static class FactorioGunItem extends Item {
        public enum GunKind {
            PISTOL(18.0, 8, 1, 1.0f),
            SUBMACHINE_GUN(20.0, 3, 1, 2.2f),
            SHOTGUN(15.0, 14, 12, 7.5f);

            public final double range;
            public final int fireIntervalTicks;
            public final int pellets;
            public final float spreadDegrees;

            GunKind(double range, int fireIntervalTicks, int pellets, float spreadDegrees) {
                this.range = range;
                this.fireIntervalTicks = fireIntervalTicks;
                this.pellets = pellets;
                this.spreadDegrees = spreadDegrees;
            }
        }

        private final GunKind gunKind;

        public FactorioGunItem(Settings settings, GunKind gunKind) {
            super(settings);
            this.gunKind = gunKind;
        }

        public GunKind getGunKind() {
            return this.gunKind;
        }

        @Override
        public int getMaxUseTime(ItemStack stack, LivingEntity user) {
            return 72000;
        }

        @Override
        public UseAction getUseAction(ItemStack stack) {
            return UseAction.BOW;
        }

        @Override
        public TypedActionResult<ItemStack> use(World world, PlayerEntity user, Hand hand) {
            ItemStack gunStack = user.getStackInHand(hand);
            if (this.gunKind == GunKind.SUBMACHINE_GUN) {
                user.setCurrentHand(hand);
                tryFireShot(world, user, gunStack);
                return TypedActionResult.consume(gunStack);
            } else {
                if (tryFireShot(world, user, gunStack)) {
                    user.getItemCooldownManager().set(this, this.gunKind.fireIntervalTicks);
                    return TypedActionResult.success(gunStack, world.isClient());
                }
                return TypedActionResult.fail(gunStack);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void usageTick(World world, LivingEntity user, ItemStack stack, int remainingUseTicks) {
            if (user instanceof PlayerEntity player && this.gunKind == GunKind.SUBMACHINE_GUN) {
                int elapsed = getMaxUseTime(stack, user) - remainingUseTicks;
                if (elapsed > 0 && elapsed % this.gunKind.fireIntervalTicks == 0) {
                    if (!tryFireShot(world, player, stack)) {
                        player.stopUsingItem();
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        private boolean tryFireShot(World world, PlayerEntity player, ItemStack gunStack) {
            AmmoMagazineItem ammoType = findAndConsumePlayerAmmo(player, this.gunKind == GunKind.SHOTGUN, !world.isClient);
            if (ammoType == null) {
                if (!world.isClient) {
                    world.playSound(null, player.getBlockPos(), SoundEvents.BLOCK_DISPENSER_FAIL, SoundCategory.PLAYERS, 0.5f, 1.5f);
                    player.sendMessage(Text.literal("Â§cÐÐµÑ‚ Ð¿Ð°Ñ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ð½Ð¾Ð² Ð² Ð¸Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð°Ñ€Ðµ!"), true);
                }
                return false;
            }

            if (!world.isClient && world instanceof ServerWorld serverWorld) {
                float baseDamage = ammoType.getDamagePerShot();
                Vec3d eyePos = player.getEyePos();
                Vec3d lookVec = player.getRotationVec(1.0f);

                for (int p = 0; p < this.gunKind.pellets; p++) {
                    Vec3d dir = applySpread(lookVec, world, this.gunKind.spreadDegrees);
                    fireHitscanRay(serverWorld, player, eyePos, dir, this.gunKind.range,
                            this.gunKind == GunKind.SHOTGUN ? (baseDamage * 0.45f) : baseDamage,
                            ammoType.isArmorPiercing());
                }

                if (this.gunKind == GunKind.SHOTGUN) {
                    world.playSound(null, player.getX(), player.getY(), player.getZ(),
                            SoundEvents.ENTITY_GENERIC_EXPLODE.value(), SoundCategory.PLAYERS, 0.7f, 1.65f);
                } else {
                    world.playSound(null, player.getX(), player.getY(), player.getZ(),
                            SoundEvents.ENTITY_FIREWORK_ROCKET_BLAST, SoundCategory.PLAYERS, 0.65f,
                            this.gunKind == GunKind.SUBMACHINE_GUN ? 1.55f : 1.35f);
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        private static AmmoMagazineItem findAndConsumePlayerAmmo(PlayerEntity player, boolean isShotgun, boolean consumeServer) {
            if (player.isCreative()) {
                return isShotgun
                        ? (AmmoMagazineItem) ModItems.SHOTGUN_SHELL
                        : (AmmoMagazineItem) ModItems.PIERCING_ROUNDS_MAGAZINE;
            }

            var inv = player.getInventory();
            Item[] priority = isShotgun
                    ? new Item[]{ ModItems.SHOTGUN_SHELL }
                    : new Item[]{ ModItems.PIERCING_ROUNDS_MAGAZINE, ModItems.FIREARM_MAGAZINE };

            for (Item targetItem : priority) {
                for (int i = 0; i < inv.main.size(); i++) {
                    ItemStack st = inv.main.get(i);
                    if (!st.isEmpty() && st.isOf(targetItem) && st.getItem() instanceof AmmoMagazineItem mag) {
                        if (consumeServer) {
                            // 1 Ð¼Ð°Ð³Ð°Ð·Ð¸Ð½ = 10 Ð²Ñ‹ÑÑ‚Ñ€ÐµÐ»Ð¾Ð² (ÑÐ¿Ð¸ÑÑ‹Ð²Ð°ÐµÐ¼ Ð¼Ð°Ð³Ð°Ð·Ð¸Ð½ Ñ Ð²ÐµÑ€Ð¾ÑÑ‚Ð½Ð¾ÑÑ‚ÑŒÑŽ 1/roundsPerMagazine Ð½Ð° Ð²Ñ‹ÑÑ‚Ñ€ÐµÐ»)
                            if (player.getRandom().nextInt(mag.getRoundsPerMagazine()) == 0) {
                                st.decrement(1);
                                if (st.isEmpty()) inv.main.set(i, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                                inv.markDirty();
                            }
                        }
                        return mag;
                    }
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        private static Vec3d applySpread(Vec3d dir, World world, float spreadDeg) {
            if (spreadDeg <= 0.01f) return dir;
            double rad = Math.toRadians(spreadDeg);
            double rx = (world.random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 2.0 * rad;
            double ry = (world.random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 2.0 * rad;
            double rz = (world.random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 2.0 * rad;
            return dir.add(rx, ry, rz).normalize();
        }

        public static void fireHitscanRay(ServerWorld world, LivingEntity shooter, Vec3d start, Vec3d dir,
                                          double maxRange, float damage, boolean armorPiercing) {
            Vec3d end = start.add(dir.multiply(maxRange));
            BlockHitResult blockHit = world.raycast(new RaycastContext(
                    start, end, RaycastContext.ShapeType.COLLIDER, RaycastContext.FluidHandling.NONE, shooter));

            double hitDistSq = maxRange * maxRange;
            Vec3d finalEnd = end;
            if (blockHit.getType() != HitResult.Type.MISS) {
                finalEnd = blockHit.getPos();
                hitDistSq = start.squaredDistanceTo(finalEnd);
            }

            Box searchBox = new Box(start, finalEnd).expand(1.0);
            EntityHitResult entityHit = ProjectileUtil.raycast(
                    shooter, start, finalEnd, searchBox,
                    e -> !e.isSpectator() && e.isAlive() && e.canHit() && e != shooter,
                    hitDistSq
            );

            if (entityHit != null && entityHit.getEntity() instanceof LivingEntity target) {
                finalEnd = entityHit.getPos();
                target.timeUntilRegen = 0; // Ð£Ð±Ð¸Ñ€Ð°ÐµÐ¼ Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¸Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¸Ð¼Ð¼ÑƒÐ½Ð¸Ñ‚ÐµÑ‚ Ðº Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´ÑÐ¼!
                target.damage(
                        armorPiercing ? world.getDamageSources().indirectMagic(shooter, shooter)
                                : world.getDamageSources().mobAttack(shooter),
                        damage
                );
                world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.CRIT, finalEnd.x, finalEnd.y, finalEnd.z, 4, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.08);
            } else if (blockHit.getType() == HitResult.Type.BLOCK) {
                world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.SMOKE, finalEnd.x, finalEnd.y, finalEnd.z, 2, 0.04, 0.04, 0.04, 0.01);
            }

            // Ð¢Ñ€Ð°ÑÑÐµÑ€ Ð¿ÑƒÐ»Ð¸
            double totalDist = start.distanceTo(finalEnd);
            for (double d = 1.2; d < totalDist; d += 2.2) {
                Vec3d p = start.add(dir.multiply(d));
                world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.CRIT, p.x, p.y, p.z, 1, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void appendTooltip(ItemStack stack, TooltipContext context, List<Text> tooltip, TooltipType type) {
            tooltip.add(Text.literal("Ð”Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾ÑÑ‚ÑŒ ÑÑ‚Ñ€ÐµÐ»ÑŒÐ±Ñ‹: ").formatted(Formatting.GRAY)
                    .append(Text.literal((int) gunKind.range + " Ð±Ð».").formatted(Formatting.AQUA)));
            String rate = String.format("%.1f Ð²Ñ‹ÑÑ‚Ñ€./ÑÐµÐº", 20.0f / gunKind.fireIntervalTicks);
            tooltip.add(Text.literal("Ð¡ÐºÐ¾Ñ€Ð¾ÑÑ‚Ñ€ÐµÐ»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾ÑÑ‚ÑŒ: ").formatted(Formatting.GRAY)
                    .append(Text.literal(rate).formatted(Formatting.YELLOW)));
        }
    }

    // =========================================================================
    public static class GrenadeItem extends Item {
        public GrenadeItem(Settings settings) {
            super(settings);
        }

        @Override
        public TypedActionResult<ItemStack> use(World world, PlayerEntity user, Hand hand) {
            ItemStack stack = user.getStackInHand(hand);
            user.getItemCooldownManager().set(this, 15);
            world.playSound(null, user.getX(), user.getY(), user.getZ(),
                    SoundEvents.ENTITY_SNOWBALL_THROW, SoundCategory.PLAYERS, 0.6f, 0.75f);

            if (!world.isClient && world instanceof ServerWorld serverWorld) {
                Vec3d pos = user.getEyePos().add(user.getRotationVec(1.0f).multiply(0.5));
                Vec3d vel = user.getRotationVec(1.0f).multiply(0.95).add(0.0, 0.12, 0.0);
                ACTIVE_GRENADES.add(new FlyingGrenade(serverWorld, user, pos, vel, 45));
                if (!user.isCreative()) {
                    stack.decrement(1);
                }
            }
            return TypedActionResult.success(stack, world.isClient());
        }

        @Override
        public void appendTooltip(ItemStack stack, TooltipContext context, List<Text> tooltip, TooltipType type) {
            tooltip.add(Text.literal("Ð’Ð·Ñ€Ñ‹Ð²Ñ‡Ð°Ñ‚ÐºÐ° Ð¿Ð¾ Ð¿Ð»Ð¾Ñ‰Ð°Ð´Ð¸ (Ñ€Ð°Ð´Ð¸ÑƒÑ 4.5 Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ°).").formatted(Formatting.GRAY));
            tooltip.add(Text.literal("Ð Ð°ÑÑ‡Ð¸Ñ‰Ð°ÐµÑ‚ Ð´ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ²ÑŒÑ Ð¸ ÑƒÐ½Ð¸Ñ‡Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¶Ð°ÐµÑ‚ ÐºÑƒÑÐ°Ðº, Ð½Ðµ Ð»Ð¾Ð¼Ð°Ñ Ð·Ð°Ð²Ð¾Ð´!").formatted(Formatting.GREEN));
        }
    }

    private static class FlyingGrenade {
        final ServerWorld world;
        final PlayerEntity thrower;
        Vec3d pos;
        Vec3d vel;
        int fuseTicks;

        FlyingGrenade(ServerWorld world, PlayerEntity thrower, Vec3d pos, Vec3d vel, int fuseTicks) {
            this.world = world;
            this.thrower = thrower;
            this.pos = pos;
            this.vel = vel;
            this.fuseTicks = fuseTicks;
        }
    }

    private static final List<FlyingGrenade> ACTIVE_GRENADES = new ArrayList<>();

    public static void registerServerTick() {
        ServerTickEvents.END_SERVER_TICK.register(server -> {
            if (ACTIVE_GRENADES.isEmpty()) return;
            Iterator<FlyingGrenade> it = ACTIVE_GRENADES.iterator();
            while (it.hasNext()) {
                FlyingGrenade g = it.next();
                g.fuseTicks--;
                Vec3d nextPos = g.pos.add(g.vel);

                g.world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.SMOKE, g.pos.x, g.pos.y, g.pos.z, 2, 0.04, 0.04, 0.04, 0.0);

                BlockHitResult hit = g.world.raycast(new RaycastContext(
                        g.pos, nextPos, RaycastContext.ShapeType.COLLIDER, RaycastContext.FluidHandling.NONE, g.thrower));

                if (hit.getType() != HitResult.Type.MISS || g.fuseTicks <= 0) {
                    Vec3d boomPos = (hit.getType() != HitResult.Type.MISS) ? hit.getPos() : nextPos;
                    detonateGrenade(g.world, g.thrower, boomPos);
                    it.remove();
                } else {
                    g.pos = nextPos;
                    g.vel = g.vel.multiply(0.96).subtract(0.0, 0.055, 0.0);
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private static void detonateGrenade(ServerWorld world, PlayerEntity thrower, Vec3d center) {
        world.playSound(null, center.x, center.y, center.z,
                SoundEvents.ENTITY_GENERIC_EXPLODE.value(), SoundCategory.PLAYERS, 1.0f, 1.05f);
        world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.EXPLOSION_EMITTER, center.x, center.y + 0.2, center.z, 1, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
        world.spawnParticles(ParticleTypes.FLAME, center.x, center.y + 0.2, center.z, 24, 1.2, 0.4, 1.2, 0.06);

        // 1. ÐÐ°Ð½Ð¾ÑÐ¸Ð¼ ÑƒÑ€Ð¾Ð½ Ð²Ñ€Ð°Ð³Ð°Ð¼ Ð² Ñ€Ð°Ð´Ð¸ÑƒÑÐµ 4.5 Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ¾Ð²
        Box blastBox = Box.of(center, 9.0, 6.0, 9.0);
        for (LivingEntity target : world.getEntitiesByClass(LivingEntity.class, blastBox, Entity::isAlive)) {
            if (target == thrower) continue;
            double dist = Math.sqrt(target.squaredDistanceTo(center));
            if (dist <= 4.6) {
                float factor = (float) Math.max(0.3, 1.0 - (dist / 4.8));
                target.timeUntilRegen = 0;
                target.damage(world.getDamageSources().explosion(thrower, thrower), 35.0f * factor);
            }
        }

        // 2. Ð Ð°ÑÑ‡Ð¸Ñ‰Ð°ÐµÐ¼ Ð´ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ²ÑŒÑ Ð¸ Ð»Ð¸ÑÑ‚Ð²Ñƒ Ð² Ñ€Ð°Ð´Ð¸ÑƒÑÐµ 4 Ð±Ð»Ð¾ÐºÐ¾Ð² (ÐºÐ°Ðº Ð³Ñ€Ð°Ð½Ð°Ñ‚Ñ‹ Ð² Factorio!)
        BlockPos origin = BlockPos.ofFloored(center);
        for (int dx = -4; dx <= 4; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -4; dz <= 4; dz++) {
                if (dx * dx + dz * dz > 18) continue;
                for (int dy = -2; dy <= 7; dy++) {
                    BlockPos p = origin.add(dx, dy, dz);
                    BlockState st = world.getBlockState(p);
                    if (st.isIn(BlockTags.LOGS) || st.isIn(BlockTags.LEAVES)) {
                        world.breakBlock(p, false);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static void register(String id, Category cat, int row, ItemStack out, int ticks, Ingredient... ings) {
        Recipe r = new Recipe(id, cat, row, out, ticks, List.of(ings));
        ALL.add(r);
        BY_ID.put(id, r);
        BY_OUTPUT_ITEM.put(out.getItem(), r);
    }

    public static int getRecipeIndex(String id) {
        if (id == null || id.isEmpty()) return -1;
        init();
        for (int i = 0; i < ALL.size(); i++) {
            if (ALL.get(i).id().equals(id)) return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    public static String getRecipeIdByIndex(int index) {
        init();
        if (index >= 0 && index < ALL.size()) {
            return ALL.get(index).id();
        }
        return "";
    }

    public static Recipe getById(String id) {
        init();
        return BY_ID.get(id);
    }

    public static Recipe getByOutput(Item item) {
        init();
        return BY_OUTPUT_ITEM.get(item);
    }

    public static List<Recipe> getByCategory(Category category) {
        init();
        List<Recipe> list = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Recipe r : ALL) {
            if (r.category() == category && ResearchManager.isRecipeUnlocked(r.id())) {
                list.add(r);
            }
        }
        return list;
    }

    /**
     * Ð“Ñ€ÑƒÐ¿Ð¿Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÑ‚ Ð¾Ñ‚ÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ñ‚Ñ‹Ðµ Ñ€ÐµÑ†ÐµÐ¿Ñ‚Ñ‹ Ð¿Ð¾ ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÐ°Ð¼ Ð±ÐµÐ· Ð¿ÑƒÑÑ‚Ñ‹Ñ… ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾Ðº-Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð±ÐµÐ»Ð¾Ð²!
     * Ð•ÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð² Ð½Ð°Ñ‡Ð°Ð»Ðµ Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ñ‹ Ð² ÐºÐ°Ñ‚ÐµÐ³Ð¾Ñ€Ð¸Ð¸ Ð¾Ñ‚ÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ñ‚Ð¾ Ð¼Ð°Ð»Ð¾ Ñ€ÐµÑ†ÐµÐ¿Ñ‚Ð¾Ð² Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÐ° Ð¿ÑƒÑÑ‚Ð°,
     * ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÐ¸ Ð°Ð²Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¼Ð°Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ‡ÐµÑÐºÐ¸ ÑÐ´Ð²Ð¸Ð³Ð°ÑŽÑ‚ÑÑ Ð²Ð²ÐµÑ€Ñ… Ð±ÐµÐ· Ð´Ñ‹Ñ€.
     */
    public static List<List<Recipe>> getCompactedRows(Category category, String searchQueryLower, int maxColsPerRow) {
        List<Recipe> unlocked = getByCategory(category);
        Map<Integer, List<Recipe>> byOriginalRow = new TreeMap<>();

        for (Recipe r : unlocked) {
            if (searchQueryLower != null && !searchQueryLower.isBlank()) {
                String nameLower = r.output().getName().getString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
                if (!nameLower.contains(searchQueryLower)) {
                    continue;
                }
            }
            byOriginalRow.computeIfAbsent(r.row(), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(r);
        }

        List<List<Recipe>> rows = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Recipe> currentBuffer = new ArrayList<>();

        for (List<Recipe> group : byOriginalRow.values()) {
            // Ð•ÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð² Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ñ‹Ð´ÑƒÑ‰ÐµÐ¹ ÑÑ‚Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÐµ Ð²ÑÐµÐ³Ð¾ 1 Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚, Ð° Ð½Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ñ Ð³Ñ€ÑƒÐ¿Ð¿Ð° Ð¿Ð¾Ð¼ÐµÑ‰Ð°ÐµÑ‚ÑÑ Ñ€ÑÐ´Ð¾Ð¼ â€” Ð¾Ð±ÑŠÐµÐ´Ð¸Ð½ÑÐµÐ¼ Ð¸Ñ…, Ñ‡Ñ‚Ð¾Ð±Ñ‹ Ð½Ðµ Ð±Ñ‹Ð»Ð¾ Ð¾Ð´Ð¸Ð½Ð¾ÐºÐ¸Ñ… Ð¸ÐºÐ¾Ð½Ð¾Ðº!
            if (!currentBuffer.isEmpty() && currentBuffer.size() <= 2 && currentBuffer.size() + group.size() <= maxColsPerRow) {
                currentBuffer.addAll(group);
            } else {
                if (!currentBuffer.isEmpty()) {
                    rows.add(currentBuffer);
                }
                currentBuffer = new ArrayList<>(group);
            }
        }
        if (!currentBuffer.isEmpty()) {
            rows.add(currentBuffer);
        }
        return rows;
    }

    public static Map<Item, Integer> snapshotInventory(PlayerInventory inv) {
        Map<Item, Integer> map = new HashMap<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < inv.main.size(); i++) {
            ItemStack s = inv.main.get(i);
            if (!s.isEmpty()) {
                map.merge(s.getItem(), s.getCount(), Integer::sum);
            }
        }
        return map;
    }

    public static int getCraftableCount(PlayerInventory inv, Recipe recipe) {
        Map<Item, Integer> pool = snapshotInventory(inv);
        int crafts = 0;
        List<QueueStep> dummy = new ArrayList<>();
        while (crafts < 999 && tryConsumeOrSubcraftBatch(pool, recipe, 1, false, dummy, 0)) {
            crafts += recipe.output().getCount();
        }
        return crafts;
    }

    public static List<QueueStep> planAndConsume(PlayerInventory inv, Recipe targetRecipe, int requestedCrafts) {
        Map<Item, Integer> initialSnapshot = snapshotInventory(inv);

        int maxAffordable = 0;
        for (int test = 1; test <= requestedCrafts; test++) {
            Map<Item, Integer> testPool = new HashMap<>(initialSnapshot);
            List<QueueStep> testSteps = new ArrayList<>();
            if (tryConsumeOrSubcraftBatch(testPool, targetRecipe, test, true, testSteps, 0)) {
                maxAffordable = test;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }

        if (maxAffordable <= 0) {
            return Collections.emptyList();
        }

        Map<Item, Integer> simulatedPool = new HashMap<>(initialSnapshot);
        List<QueueStep> rawSteps = new ArrayList<>();
        tryConsumeOrSubcraftBatch(simulatedPool, targetRecipe, maxAffordable, true, rawSteps, 0);

        List<QueueStep> groupedSteps = consolidateStepsByFirstAppearance(rawSteps);

        for (Map.Entry<Item, Integer> entry : initialSnapshot.entrySet()) {
            Item item = entry.getKey();
            int before = entry.getValue();
            int after = simulatedPool.getOrDefault(item, 0);
            int toRemove = before - after;
            if (toRemove > 0) {
                removeFromPlayerInventory(inv, item, toRemove);
            }
        }

        for (Map.Entry<Item, Integer> entry : simulatedPool.entrySet()) {
            Item item = entry.getKey();
            int before = initialSnapshot.getOrDefault(item, 0);
            int after = entry.getValue();
            int surplus = after - before;
            if (surplus > 0) {
                inv.offerOrDrop(new ItemStack(item, surplus));
            }
        }

        return groupedSteps;
    }

    public static List<QueueStep> consolidateStepsByFirstAppearance(List<QueueStep> steps) {
        Map<String, List<QueueStep>> intermediatesById = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        List<QueueStep> finalTargets = new ArrayList<>();

        for (QueueStep step : steps) {
            if (step.deliverToPlayer()) {
                finalTargets.add(step);
            } else {
                intermediatesById.computeIfAbsent(step.recipe().id(), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(step);
            }
        }

        List<QueueStep> result = new ArrayList<>(steps.size());
        for (List<QueueStep> group : intermediatesById.values()) {
            result.addAll(group);
        }
        result.addAll(finalTargets);
        return result;
    }

    private static boolean tryConsumeOrSubcraftBatch(Map<Item, Integer> pool, Recipe recipe, int batchesNeeded,
                                                     boolean isTopLevelTarget, List<QueueStep> outSteps, int depth) {
        if (depth > 8 || batchesNeeded <= 0) return false;

        for (Ingredient ing : recipe.ingredients()) {
            int needed = ing.count() * batchesNeeded;
            int have = pool.getOrDefault(ing.item(), 0);

            if (have >= needed) {
                pool.put(ing.item(), have - needed);
            } else {
                int missing = needed - have;
                pool.put(ing.item(), 0);

                Recipe subRecipe = getByOutput(ing.item());
                if (subRecipe == null) {
                    return false;
                }

                int subOutCount = subRecipe.output().getCount();
                int subBatchesNeeded = (missing + subOutCount - 1) / subOutCount;

                if (!tryConsumeOrSubcraftBatch(pool, subRecipe, subBatchesNeeded, false, outSteps, depth + 1)) {
                    return false;
                }

                int produced = subBatchesNeeded * subOutCount;
                int leftover = produced - missing;
                if (leftover > 0) {
                    pool.merge(ing.item(), leftover, Integer::sum);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < batchesNeeded; i++) {
            outSteps.add(new QueueStep(recipe, isTopLevelTarget));
        }
        return true;
    }

    private static void removeFromPlayerInventory(PlayerInventory inv, Item item, int amount) {
        int remaining = amount;
        for (int i = 0; i < inv.main.size() && remaining > 0; i++) {
            ItemStack s = inv.main.get(i);
            if (!s.isEmpty() && s.isOf(item)) {
                int take = Math.min(remaining, s.getCount());
                s.decrement(take);
                if (s.isEmpty()) {
                    inv.main.set(i, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                }
                remaining -= take;
            }
        }
        inv.markDirty();
    }

    public static Map<Item, Integer> calculateTotalRaw(Recipe recipe) {
        Map<Item, Integer> raw = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        accumulateRaw(recipe, 1.0, raw, 0);
        return raw;
    }

    private static void accumulateRaw(Recipe recipe, double multiplier, Map<Item, Integer> raw, int depth) {
        if (depth > 6) return;
        for (Ingredient ing : recipe.ingredients()) {
            Recipe sub = getByOutput(ing.item());
            if (sub != null) {
                double batches = (ing.count() * multiplier) / sub.output().getCount();
                accumulateRaw(sub, batches, raw, depth + 1);
            } else {
                int add = Math.max(1, (int) Math.ceil(ing.count() * multiplier));
                raw.merge(ing.item(), add, Integer::sum);
            }
        }
    }
}

    public static void tickPlayerInventory(ServerPlayerEntity player) {
        // ÐÐµ ÑÐ¾Ñ€Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÐ¼, Ð¿Ð¾ÐºÐ° Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾Ðº Ð´ÐµÑ€Ð¶Ð¸Ñ‚ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚ Ð½Ð° ÐºÑƒÑ€ÑÐ¾Ñ€Ðµ Ð¼Ñ‹ÑˆÐ¸ Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ Ð¸ÑÐ¿Ð¾Ð»ÑŒÐ·ÑƒÐµÑ‚ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚

            return;
        }

        PlayerInventory inv = player.getInventory();
        boolean changed = false;

        // Ð¨Ð°Ð³ 1. ÐžÐ±ÑŠÐµÐ´Ð¸Ð½ÑÐµÐ¼ Ð²ÑÐµ Ð½ÐµÐ¿Ð¾Ð»Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ ÑÑ‚Ð°ÐºÐ¸ Ð¾Ð´Ð¸Ð½Ð°ÐºÐ¾Ð²Ñ‹Ñ… Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚Ð¾Ð² Ð¿Ð¾ Ð²ÑÐµÐ¼Ñƒ Ð¸Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð°Ñ€ÑŽ (0..35)
        for (int i = 0; i < 36; i++) {
            ItemStack target = inv.main.get(i);
            if (target.isEmpty() || target.getCount() >= target.getMaxCount()) {
                continue;
            }
            for (int j = i + 1; j < 36; j++) {
                ItemStack source = inv.main.get(j);
                if (!source.isEmpty() && ItemStack.areItemsAndComponentsEqual(target, source)) {
                    int space = target.getMaxCount() - target.getCount();
                    int move = Math.min(space, source.getCount());
                    if (move > 0) {
                        target.increment(move);
                        source.decrement(move);
                        if (source.isEmpty()) {
                            inv.main.set(j, ItemStack.EMPTY);
                        }
                        changed = true;
                        if (target.getCount() >= target.getMaxCount()) {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Ð¨Ð°Ð³ 2. Ð¡Ð¾Ñ€Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ€ÑƒÐµÐ¼ Ð¸ ÑƒÐ¿Ð»Ð¾Ñ‚Ð½ÑÐµÐ¼ ÑÐ»Ð¾Ñ‚Ñ‹ Ð¸Ð½Ð²ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð°Ñ€Ñ (9..35), Ð° ÐµÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð² Ñ…Ð¾Ñ‚Ð±Ð°Ñ€Ðµ (0..8) Ð½ÐµÑ‚ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚Ð¾Ð² Ð¸Ð»Ð¸ Ð¾Ñ‚ÐºÑ€Ñ‹Ñ‚Ð¾ Ð¾ÐºÐ½Ð¾ â€” ÑƒÐ¿Ð»Ð¾Ñ‚Ð½ÑÐµÐ¼ Ð±ÐµÐ· Ð´Ñ‹Ñ€
        if (sortMainRange(inv, 9, 36)) {
            changed = true;
        }

        if (changed) {
            inv.markDirty();
            player.currentScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
            player.playerScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
        }
    }

    private static boolean sortMainRange(PlayerInventory inv, int startInclusive, int endExclusive) {
        List<ItemStack> nonEmpty = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = startInclusive; i < endExclusive; i++) {
            ItemStack s = inv.main.get(i);
            if (!s.isEmpty()) {
                nonEmpty.add(s.copy());
            }
        }

        if (nonEmpty.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }

        nonEmpty.sort(Comparator
                .comparingInt(InventoryAutoSorter::getCategoryOrder)
                .thenComparingInt((ItemStack s) -> getFactorioRecipeOrder(s.getItem())).thenComparing(s -> Registries.ITEM.getId(s.getItem()).toString())
                .thenComparing((ItemStack s) -> -s.getCount()));

        // ÐŸÑ€Ð¾Ð²ÐµÑ€ÑÐµÐ¼, Ð¾Ñ‚Ð»Ð¸Ñ‡Ð°ÐµÑ‚ÑÑ Ð»Ð¸ Ð½Ð¾Ð²Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¿Ð¾Ñ€ÑÐ´Ð¾Ðº Ð¾Ñ‚ Ñ‚ÐµÐºÑƒÑ‰ÐµÐ³Ð¾ (Ñ‡Ñ‚Ð¾Ð±Ñ‹ Ð½Ðµ ÑÐ»Ð°Ñ‚ÑŒ Ð»Ð¸ÑˆÐ½Ð¸Ðµ Ð¿Ð°ÐºÐµÑ‚Ñ‹, ÐµÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð²ÑÑ‘ ÑƒÐ¶Ðµ Ð¾Ñ‚ÑÐ¾Ñ€Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ€Ð¾Ð²Ð°Ð½Ð¾)
        boolean anyDiff = false;
        for (int i = startInclusive; i < endExclusive; i++) {
            int listIdx = i - startInclusive;
            ItemStack expected = (listIdx < nonEmpty.size()) ? nonEmpty.get(listIdx) : ItemStack.EMPTY;
            ItemStack current = inv.main.get(i);
            if (!ItemStack.areEqual(current, expected)) {
                anyDiff = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!anyDiff) {
            return false;
        }

        for (int i = startInclusive; i < endExclusive; i++) {
            int listIdx = i - startInclusive;
            inv.main.set(i, (listIdx < nonEmpty.size()) ? nonEmpty.get(listIdx) : ItemStack.EMPTY);
        }
        return true;
    }

        public static int getFactorioRecipeOrder(Item item) {
        FactorioRecipes.init();
        for (int i = 0; i < FactorioRecipes.ALL.size(); i++) {
            if (FactorioRecipes.ALL.get(i).output().isOf(item)) {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return 1000;
    }

    public static int getCategoryOrder(ItemStack stack) {
        Item item = stack.getItem();
        FactorioRecipes.Recipe r = FactorioRecipes.getByOutput(item);
        if (r != null) {
            return switch (r.category()) {
                case LOGISTICS -> 1;
                case PRODUCTION -> 2;
                case INTERMEDIATE -> 3;
                case COMBAT -> 4;
            };
        }
        if (item == ModItems.STEEL_PLATE || item == ModItems.IRON_GEAR_WHEEL
                || item == ModItems.COPPER_CABLE || item == ModItems.ELECTRONIC_CIRCUIT || item == ModItems.IRON_STICK) {
            return 3;
        }
        if (item instanceof BlockItem) {
            return 5;
        }
        return 6;
    }
}

package com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.crafting;

import com.fixplot.factoriocore.content.research.ResearchManager;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.network.RequestCraftPayload;
import com.fixplot.factoriocore.network.SyncCraftQueuePayload;
import net.fabricmc.fabric.api.networking.v1.ServerPlayNetworking;
import net.minecraft.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.server.network.ServerPlayerEntity;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundCategory;
import net.minecraft.sound.SoundEvents;

import java.util.*;

public class ServerCraftingQueueManager {

    private static final Map<UUID, List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep>> QUEUES = new HashMap<>();
    private static final Map<UUID, Integer> ACTIVE_PROGRESS = new HashMap<>();

    public static void handleCraftRequest(ServerPlayerEntity player, RequestCraftPayload payload) {
        FactorioRecipes.init();
        UUID uuid = player.getUuid();
        List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> queue = QUEUES.computeIfAbsent(uuid, k -> new ArrayList<>());

        // ÐžÑ‚Ð¼ÐµÐ½Ð° ÑÐ»ÐµÐ¼ÐµÐ½Ñ‚Ð° Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸ Ð¿Ð¾ ÐºÐ»Ð¸ÐºÑƒ Ð² Ð»ÐµÐ²Ð¾Ð¼ Ð½Ð¸Ð¶Ð½ÐµÐ¼ ÑƒÐ³Ð»Ñƒ
        if (payload.action() < 0) {
            if (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                int targetIndex = findLastMatchingStepIndex(queue, payload.recipeId());
                if (targetIndex >= 0) {
                    cancelStepWithCascade(queue, targetIndex, player);
                }
                if (queue.isEmpty()) {
                    ACTIVE_PROGRESS.put(uuid, 0);
                }
                player.currentScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
                player.playerScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
                syncQueueToClient(player);
            }
            return;
        }

        FactorioRecipes.Recipe recipe = FactorioRecipes.getById(payload.recipeId());
        if (recipe == null) return;

        int requested = payload.action();
        if (requested >= 999) {
            int maxPossible = FactorioRecipes.getCraftableCount(player.getInventory(), recipe);
            requested = Math.max(1, maxPossible / Math.max(1, recipe.output().getCount()));
        }

        if (player.isCreative()) {
            int countToQueue = Math.min(requested, 20);
            for (int i = 0; i < countToQueue; i++) {
                queue.add(new FactorioRecipes.QueueStep(recipe, true));
            }
            syncQueueToClient(player);
            return;
        }

        List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> planned = FactorioRecipes.planAndConsume(player.getInventory(), recipe, requested);
        if (!planned.isEmpty()) {
            queue.addAll(planned);
            player.currentScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
            player.playerScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
            syncQueueToClient(player);
        } else {
            player.playSoundToPlayer(SoundEvents.BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_BASS.value(), SoundCategory.PLAYERS, 0.5f, 0.7f);
        }
    }

    private static int findLastMatchingStepIndex(List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> queue, String recipeId) {
        if (recipeId != null && !recipeId.isEmpty()) {
            for (int i = queue.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                if (queue.get(i).recipe().id().equals(recipeId)) {
                    return i;
                }
            }
        }
        return queue.size() - 1;
    }

    /**
     * ÐšÐ°ÑÐºÐ°Ð´Ð½Ð¾ Ð¾Ñ‚Ð¼ÐµÐ½ÑÐµÑ‚ Ð²Ñ‹Ð±Ñ€Ð°Ð½Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÑˆÐ°Ð³ ÐºÑ€Ð°Ñ„Ñ‚Ð°:
     * - Ð•ÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð¾Ñ‚Ð¼ÐµÐ½ÑÐµÑ‚ÑÑ Ñ„Ð¸Ð½Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚, Ð´Ð»Ñ ÐºÐ¾Ñ‚Ð¾Ñ€Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ Ð² Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸ ÐµÑ‰Ñ‘ Ð»ÐµÐ¶Ð°Ñ‚ Ð½ÐµÐ²Ñ‹Ð¿Ð¾Ð»Ð½ÐµÐ½Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼ÐµÐ¶ÑƒÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ ÑˆÐ°Ð³Ð¸ (deliverToPlayer == false),
     *   ÑÑ‚Ð¸ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼ÐµÐ¶ÑƒÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ ÑˆÐ°Ð³Ð¸ Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¶Ðµ ÑÐ½Ð¸Ð¼Ð°ÑŽÑ‚ÑÑ Ñ Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸, Ð° Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾ÐºÑƒ Ð²Ð¾Ð·Ð²Ñ€Ð°Ñ‰Ð°ÐµÑ‚ÑÑ Ð±Ð°Ð·Ð¾Ð²Ð¾Ðµ ÑÑ‹Ñ€ÑŒÑ‘.
     * - Ð•ÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾Ðº Ð¾Ñ‚Ð¼ÐµÐ½ÑÐµÑ‚ Ð½Ð°Ð¿Ñ€ÑÐ¼ÑƒÑŽ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼ÐµÐ¶ÑƒÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ð¹ ÑˆÐ°Ð³ (deliverToPlayer == false),
     *   Ð°Ð²Ñ‚Ð¾Ð¼Ð°Ñ‚Ð¸Ñ‡ÐµÑÐºÐ¸ Ð¾Ñ‚Ð¼ÐµÐ½ÑÐµÑ‚ÑÑ Ð·Ð°Ð²Ð¸ÑÐ¸Ð¼Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð½ÐµÐ³Ð¾ Ñ„Ð¸Ð½Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ñ‹Ð¹ Ð¿Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¼ÐµÑ‚, Ñ‡Ñ‚Ð¾Ð±Ñ‹ Ð¸Ð·Ð±ÐµÐ¶Ð°Ñ‚ÑŒ Ð±ÐµÑÐ¿Ð»Ð°Ñ‚Ð½Ð¾Ð³Ð¾ ÐºÑ€Ð°Ñ„Ñ‚Ð°.
     */
    private static void cancelStepWithCascade(List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> queue, int index, ServerPlayerEntity player) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= queue.size()) return;

        FactorioRecipes.QueueStep step = queue.get(index);

        // Ð•ÑÐ»Ð¸ Ð¸Ð³Ñ€Ð¾Ðº ÐºÐ»Ð¸ÐºÐ½ÑƒÐ» Ð¿Ð¾ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼ÐµÐ¶ÑƒÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ð¾Ð¼Ñƒ ÑˆÐ°Ð³Ñƒ (deliver == false), Ð¸Ñ‰ÐµÐ¼ Ð·Ð°Ð²Ð¸ÑÑÑ‰Ð¸Ð¹ Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð½ÐµÐ³Ð¾ Ñ€Ð¾Ð´Ð¸Ñ‚ÐµÐ»ÑŒÑÐºÐ¸Ð¹ ÑˆÐ°Ð³ Ð¿Ñ€Ð°Ð²ÐµÐµ Ð² Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸
        if (!step.deliverToPlayer()) {
            Item intermediateOut = step.recipe().output().getItem();
            for (int i = queue.size() - 1; i > index; i--) {
                FactorioRecipes.QueueStep later = queue.get(i);
                for (FactorioRecipes.Ingredient ing : later.recipe().ingredients()) {
                    if (ing.item() == intermediateOut) {
                        cancelStepWithCascade(queue, i, player);
                        return;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        boolean wasFirst = (index == 0);
        queue.remove(index);
        if (wasFirst) {
            ACTIVE_PROGRESS.put(player.getUuid(), 0);
        }

        if (player.isCreative()) {
            return;
        }

        refundIngredientsOrCancelSubsteps(queue, step.recipe(), player);
    }

    private static void refundIngredientsOrCancelSubsteps(List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> queue,
                                                          FactorioRecipes.Recipe cancelledRecipe,
                                                          ServerPlayerEntity player) {
        for (FactorioRecipes.Ingredient ing : cancelledRecipe.ingredients()) {
            int remainingToRefund = ing.count();

            // ÐŸÑ€Ð¾Ð²ÐµÑ€ÑÐµÐ¼ Ñ ÐºÐ¾Ð½Ñ†Ð° Ð¾Ñ‡ÐµÑ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸, ÐµÑÑ‚ÑŒ Ð»Ð¸ Ð¾Ð¶Ð¸Ð´Ð°ÑŽÑ‰Ð¸Ðµ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¼ÐµÐ¶ÑƒÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‡Ð½Ñ‹Ðµ ÑˆÐ°Ð³Ð¸ (deliverToPlayer == false), Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð¸Ð·Ð²Ð¾Ð´ÑÑ‰Ð¸Ðµ ÑÑ‚Ð¾Ñ‚ Ð¸Ð½Ð³Ñ€ÐµÐ´Ð¸ÐµÐ½Ñ‚
            for (int i = queue.size() - 1; i >= 0 && remainingToRefund > 0; i--) {
                FactorioRecipes.QueueStep candidate = queue.get(i);
                if (!candidate.deliverToPlayer() && candidate.recipe().output().isOf(ing.item())) {
                    int outCount = candidate.recipe().output().getCount();
                    if (outCount <= remainingToRefund) {
                        boolean removedFirst = (i == 0);
                        queue.remove(i);
                        if (removedFirst) {
                            ACTIVE_PROGRESS.put(player.getUuid(), 0);
                        }
                        remainingToRefund -= outCount;
                        refundIngredientsOrCancelSubsteps(queue, candidate.recipe(), player);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (remainingToRefund > 0) {
                player.getInventory().offerOrDrop(new ItemStack(ing.item(), remainingToRefund));
            }
        }
    }

    public static void tickServer(MinecraftServer server) {
        ResearchManager.tickServer(server);

        for (ServerPlayerEntity player : server.getPlayerManager().getPlayerList()) {
            UUID uuid = player.getUuid();
            List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> queue = QUEUES.get(uuid);
            if (queue == null || queue.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }

            FactorioRecipes.QueueStep current = queue.get(0);
            int progress = ACTIVE_PROGRESS.getOrDefault(uuid, 0) + 1;
            int maxTicks = Math.max(1, current.recipe().timeTicks());

            if (progress >= maxTicks) {
                queue.remove(0);
                ACTIVE_PROGRESS.put(uuid, 0);

                if (current.deliverToPlayer()) {
                    ItemStack result = current.recipe().output().copy();
                    player.getInventory().offerOrDrop(result);
                    player.currentScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
                    player.playerScreenHandler.sendContentUpdates();
                    player.playSoundToPlayer(SoundEvents.ENTITY_ITEM_PICKUP, SoundCategory.PLAYERS, 0.4f, 1.3f);
                } else {
                    player.playSoundToPlayer(SoundEvents.BLOCK_SMITHING_TABLE_USE, SoundCategory.PLAYERS, 0.2f, 1.6f);
                }
                syncQueueToClient(player);
            } else {
                ACTIVE_PROGRESS.put(uuid, progress);
                if (progress % 2 == 0) {
                    syncQueueToClient(player);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void syncQueueToClient(ServerPlayerEntity player) {
        UUID uuid = player.getUuid();
        List<FactorioRecipes.QueueStep> queue = QUEUES.get(uuid);
        if (queue == null || queue.isEmpty()) {
            ServerPlayNetworking.send(player, new SyncCraftQueuePayload(List.of(), List.of(), 0, 1));
            return;
        }

        List<String> ids = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> counts = new ArrayList<>();

        for (FactorioRecipes.QueueStep step : queue) {
            String rId = step.recipe().id();
            int outCount = step.recipe().output().getCount();
            if (!ids.isEmpty() && ids.get(ids.size() - 1).equals(rId)) {
                int lastIdx = counts.size() - 1;
                counts.set(lastIdx, counts.get(lastIdx) + outCount);
            } else if (ids.size() < 64) {
                ids.add(rId);
                counts.add(outCount);
            }
        }

        int prog = ACTIVE_PROGRESS.getOrDefault(uuid, 0);
        int max = Math.max(1, queue.get(0).recipe().timeTicks());
        ServerPlayNetworking.send(player, new SyncCraftQueuePayload(ids, counts, prog, max));
    }
}

public class ElectricPoleBlock extends Block implements BlockEntityProvider {

    public static final IntProperty PART = IntProperty.of("part", 0, 3);
    public static final BooleanProperty UPPER = BooleanProperty.of("upper");

    private static final VoxelShape POLE_1X1_SHAPE = Block.createCuboidShape(5.0, 0.0, 5.0, 11.0, 16.0, 11.0);
    private static final VoxelShape POLE_2X2_BOTTOM = Block.createCuboidShape(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 16.0, 16.0);
    private static final VoxelShape POLE_2X2_TOP = Block.createCuboidShape(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 16.0, 24.0, 16.0);

    private final int supplyRadius;
    private final double wireReach;
    private final boolean footprint2x2;
    private final int poleTier; // 1 = Small, 2 = Medium, 3 = Big (2x2), 4 = Substation (2x2)

    public ElectricPoleBlock(Settings settings, int supplyRadius, double wireReach) {
        this(settings, supplyRadius, wireReach, false, 1);
    }

    public ElectricPoleBlock(Settings settings, int supplyRadius, double wireReach, boolean footprint2x2, int poleTier) {
        super(settings);
        this.supplyRadius = supplyRadius;
        this.wireReach = wireReach;
        this.footprint2x2 = footprint2x2;
        this.poleTier = poleTier;
        this.setDefaultState(this.stateManager.getDefaultState().with(PART, 0).with(UPPER, false));
    }

    @Override
    protected void appendProperties(StateManager.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
        builder.add(PART, UPPER);
    }

    public boolean isFootprint2x2() {
        return this.footprint2x2;
    }

    public int getPoleTier() {
        return this.poleTier;
    }

    public int getSupplyRadius() {
        return this.supplyRadius;
    }

    public int getSupplyAreaSize() {
        return this.footprint2x2 ? (this.supplyRadius * 2) : (this.supplyRadius * 2 + 1);
    }

    public double getWireReach() {
        return this.wireReach;
    }

    public static boolean isMasterPoleNode(BlockState state) {
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof ElectricPoleBlock pole)) return false;
        if (!pole.footprint2x2) return true;
        return state.get(PART) == 0 && !state.get(UPPER);
    }

    public static BlockPos getPartPos(BlockPos masterPos, int part, boolean upper) {
        int dx = part % 2;
        int dz = part / 2;
        return masterPos.add(dx, upper ? 1 : 0, dz);
    }

    public static BlockPos getMasterPos(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (!(state.getBlock() instanceof ElectricPoleBlock pole) || !pole.footprint2x2) {
            return pos;
        }
        int part = state.get(PART);
        boolean upper = state.get(UPPER);
        return pos.add(-(part % 2), upper ? -1 : 0, -(part / 2));
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockState getPlacementState(ItemPlacementContext ctx) {
        if (!this.footprint2x2) {
            return this.getDefaultState();
        }
        World world = ctx.getWorld();
        BlockPos masterPos = ctx.getBlockPos();
        for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
            for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                BlockPos check = getPartPos(masterPos, part, u == 1);
                if (!world.getWorldBorder().contains(check) || !world.getBlockState(check).canReplace(ctx)) {
                    return null;
                }
            }
        }
        return this.getDefaultState().with(PART, 0).with(UPPER, false);
    }

    @Override
    public void onPlaced(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, @Nullable LivingEntity placer, ItemStack itemStack) {
        super.onPlaced(world, pos, state, placer, itemStack);
        if (!world.isClient && this.footprint2x2 && state.get(PART) == 0 && !state.get(UPPER)) {
            for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    if (part == 0 && u == 0) continue;
                    BlockPos p = getPartPos(pos, part, u == 1);
                    world.setBlockState(p, state.with(PART, part).with(UPPER, u == 1), Block.NOTIFY_ALL);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public BlockState onBreak(World world, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, PlayerEntity player) {
        if (!world.isClient && this.footprint2x2) {
            BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
            for (int part = 0; part < 4; part++) {
                for (int u = 0; u <= 1; u++) {
                    BlockPos p = getPartPos(masterPos, part, u == 1);
                    if (!p.equals(pos) && world.getBlockState(p).isOf(this)) {
                        world.setBlockState(p, Blocks.AIR.getDefaultState(), Block.NOTIFY_ALL | Block.SKIP_DROPS);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return super.onBreak(world, pos, state, player);
    }

    @Override
    protected ActionResult onUse(BlockState state, World world, BlockPos pos, PlayerEntity player, BlockHitResult hit) {
        if (player.isSneaking()) {
            return ActionResult.PASS;
        }
        BlockPos masterPos = getMasterPos(pos, state);
        if (world.isClient && PowerNetworkManager.clientGuiOpener != null) {
            PowerNetworkManager.clientGuiOpener.accept(masterPos.toImmutable());
        }
        return ActionResult.SUCCESS;
    }

    @Override
    protected BlockRenderType getRenderType(BlockState state) {
        return this.footprint2x2 ? BlockRenderType.INVISIBLE : BlockRenderType.MODEL;
    }

    @Override
    protected VoxelShape getOutlineShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        if (!this.footprint2x2) return POLE_1X1_SHAPE;
        return state.get(UPPER) ? POLE_2X2_TOP : POLE_2X2_BOTTOM;
    }

    @Override
    protected VoxelShape getCollisionShape(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos, ShapeContext context) {
        if (!this.footprint2x2) return POLE_1X1_SHAPE;
        return state.get(UPPER) ? POLE_2X2_TOP : POLE_2X2_BOTTOM;
    }

    @Override
    protected float getAmbientOcclusionLightLevel(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos) {
        return 1.0f;
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean isTransparent(BlockState state, BlockView world, BlockPos pos) {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    protected float calcBlockBreakingDelta(BlockState state, PlayerEntity player, BlockView world, BlockPos pos) {
        return 0.125f;
    }

    @Override
    public void appendTooltip(ItemStack stack, Item.TooltipContext context, List<Text> tooltip, TooltipType options) {
        int area = getSupplyAreaSize();
        tooltip.add(Text.translatable("hud.factoriocore.supply_area", area + "Ã—" + area).formatted(Formatting.GRAY));
        tooltip.add(Text.literal("Ð”Ð°Ð»ÑŒÐ½Ð¾ÑÑ‚ÑŒ Ð¿Ñ€Ð¾Ð²Ð¾Ð´Ð°: " + this.wireReach + " Ð±Ð».").formatted(Formatting.AQUA));
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockEntity createBlockEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (!this.footprint2x2 || state.get(PART) != 0 || state.get(UPPER)) return null;
        return new LargePoleBlockEntity(pos, state);
    }

    ) {
        public int getAccumulatorCount() {

                    return stat.count();
                }

            if (accumulatorCapacityJoules > 0L) {

    private static String unitOrFallback(String translationKey, String fallback) {
        String translated = Text.translatable(translationKey).getString();
        return translated.equals(translationKey) ? fallback : translated;
    }

    public static String formatWatts(long watts) {
        if (watts >= 1_000_000_000L) {
            return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.1f %s", watts / 1_000_000_000.0, unitOrFallback("unit.factoriocore.gw", "GW"));
        }
        if (watts >= 1_000_000L) {
            return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.1f %s", watts / 1_000_000.0, unitOrFallback("unit.factoriocore.mw", "MW"));
        }
        if (watts >= 1_000L) {
            return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.1f %s", watts / 1_000.0, unitOrFallback("unit.factoriocore.kw", "kW"));
        }
        return watts + " " + unitOrFallback("unit.factoriocore.w", "W");
    }

    public static String formatAxisWatts(long watts) {
        if (watts >= 1_000_000_000L) {
            return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.0f %s", watts / 1_000_000_000.0, unitOrFallback("unit.factoriocore.gw", "GW"));
        }
        if (watts >= 1_000_000L) {

        }
        return watts + " " + unitOrFallback("unit.factoriocore.w", "W");
    }
